reviews.title: great halong cruise trip reserved via HALONG BAY CRUISE HUNTERS agent TRIPADVISOR
reviews.content: We were recommended to book overnight cruise trip from Hanoi on Tripadvisor via HALONG BAY CRUISE HUTNERS agent. and it was turned out excellent with all activities incldued as promised. We loved kayaking the most and activities onboard were amazing,too. highly commend for overnight cruise tour but not short one day tour

reviews.author: Valeda
reviews.title: Sensory overload and tourist tat
reviews.content: The Old Quarter night market was overwhelming in the worst way. The constant hawking, crowded streets, and cheap souvenirs gave us a headache. Not a romantic experience for couples. Save your energy for something more relaxing.

reviews.author: Harry
reviews.title: Crazy traffic in Hanoi
reviews.content: Crossing the street in Hanoi was an absolute nightmare! The motorcycles never seem to stop, and it honestly felt a bit dangerous.

reviews.author: Mandel Williams
reviews.title: Night market adventure in the Old Quarter
reviews.content: Hanoi's Old Quarter night market was a sensory overload! We weaved through bustling streets, hand-in-hand, marveling at the vibrant displays of handicrafts and local delicacies. We even snagged some unique souvenirs.

reviews.author: Tessi
reviews.title: A maze of history
reviews.content: We loved getting lost in Hanoi's Old Quarter. Bustling streets, delicious street food, and ancient temples around every corner - what an experience!

reviews.author: mfilcol2014
reviews.title: Organized confusion
reviews.content: Hanoi's old quarter is everything you could imagine. Cafes, restaurants, shops selling everything and anything, lots of people and thousands of motorbikes. It's just a  organized confusion. You can see everything here, from street food .  to even the most sophisticated restaurant. It's worth getting lost in this confusion of streets. Very very funny and interesting . But sometimes this disorganization becomes tiring and uncomfortable.

reviews.author: Kuhan
reviews.title: A labyrinth of culture and commerce
reviews.content: The Old Quarter is the beating heart of Hanoi.  We loved getting lost in its maze of narrow streets, discovering bustling markets and vibrant street life.  Every corner offers a new surprise – hidden temples, generations-old shophouses, and trendy cafes with a charming atmosphere. It's the perfect place to soak up the authentic energy and history of this captivating city.

reviews.author: Mo X
reviews.title: wonderful overnight Halong cruise booked via HALONG BAY CRUISE HUNTERS
reviews.content: we found the agent on TRIPADVISOR, and all services and packages were booked and included as promised, they also transfered back to Old quarter area where we had great time here. Kayaking tours and cave tours were fantastic and they also helped us to buy some essential stuffs

reviews.author: suleiman k
reviews.title: History and Modernity
reviews.content: The streets are a maze of traditional architecture and quaint shops selling everything from silk to souvenirs. We enjoyed exploring its vibrant art scene tucked into galleries and cafes. The neighborhood is also home to scenic lakes like Hoan Kiem Lake, a nice respite from the bustling environment. A few tips: be prepared to bargain in the markets, wear comfortable shoes for walking on uneven pavement, and keep an eye on your valuables, as it can get crowded. Overall, the Old Quarter is a must-visit to experience Hanoi's unique charm.

reviews.author: LolaGo1
reviews.title: Not good for walking, no sidewalks!
reviews.content: I stayed in a small Guest House here during my 3-day  visit of Hanoi. There are lots of shops, Guest Houses, restaurants, travel agencies,  bike rental places, etc.  My concern was the absence of sidewalks, they are being used to park the motorbikes for rent or to display the goods for sale. Pedestrians then walk in the narrow streets, with all the traffic coming and going. I’m just surprised not see pedestrians being hurt or accidents between cars and motor bikes.

reviews.author: Fiona
reviews.title: Must-see!!
reviews.content: Very interesting! Paradise of shopping while street good is tasty. I love egg coffee at 10 Hang Manh street, Beef noodles in O Quan Truong street and sweet rice cake at 52 Hang   Chieu

reviews.author: Agnes Lang
reviews.title: delicious organized chaos
reviews.content: The traditional architecture, the beautiful temples, the typical cafes, and this mix of old and new create a unique atmosphere. You have to be prepared for the noise of scooters and street vendors, but that's part of the charm! We found wonderful souvenirs in the little artisan shops and enjoyed the street food. An essential visit to discover the authentic heart of Hanoi, but beware of scams, especially in taxis!

reviews.author: Alams M
reviews.title: group friends arranged Halong cruise trip from HALONG BAY CRUISE HUNTERS tripdavisor
reviews.content: picked up for Halong Bay from Hanoi old quarter , it was a bit delay but was not a matter for us, were recommended to a point in town and had coffee like a boss and wait for bus to be picked up. Activities in Halong Bay were amazing and food was tasty. We definitely come back Hanoi, Halong Bay next year.

reviews.author: Eduardo M
reviews.title: Essential
reviews.content: Impressive first contact with the culture of Southeast Asia.Chaos, motorcycles, motorcycles, motorcycles...Life...on the street.Nice people.Recommended to take a good walk around the area

reviews.author: Brett Mason
reviews.title: Hustle Bustle
reviews.content: Wow. Absolutely sensational. Squeezing between bikes, stalls, people and cars - this place has it all. Great for shopping, food and fun - seriously impressed we had a fantastic time here. You can get lost in the Old Quarter and honestly it just feels lived in! Be careful with some of the more touristy spots - they will rip you off! Also bargain hard with the vietnamese sellers - they love it! The moment you respond with a counter offer they light up! Its a great big game and it is so much fun.

reviews.author: Con cặc N
reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.content: Old town, a very familiar name. Small streets and alleys with names that are very impressive to tourists visiting this place. In the past ten years, the old town has also changed a lot, with many houses. High-rise buildings are rising, gradually losing the ancient look of this place. People are increasingly absorbing advanced technology in the world, but they have forgotten many habits of the ancients. I was not born and raised here, but I still I had a period of time living and working here. The feeling is hard to describe, but no matter where I go, I find there is no place I like as much as here.

reviews.author: Janessa Larkin
reviews.title: a happy mess
reviews.content: We loved getting lost in the Old Quarter of Hanoi! It's an explosion of color, bustling vendors, a vibrant art scene, friendly locals, and there are pretty temples hidden everywhere. A word of advice: don't forget your negotiating skills, and prepare to be pushed around a little... in a good mood of course!

reviews.author: Tracy
reviews.title: Unforgetable memories in the Old Quarter
reviews.content: The Old Quarter in Hanoi is known for its vibrant atmosphere, historical charm, and bustling streets filled with shops, markets, and street food stalls. Visitors often praise its lively ambiance, rich cultural heritage, and diverse culinary scene. It's a must-visit destination for those seeking an authentic taste of Vietnam's traditional culture and urban life.

reviews.author: Wilek Grugerr
reviews.title: a charming and lively labyrinth
reviews.content: The traditional architecture is stunning and we loved discovering the vibrant art scene, with hidden art galleries and craft stores. The bustling markets were a feast for the senses. Get ready to haggle and taste some delicious street food. An unforgettable experience in the heart of Hanoi authenticity!

reviews.author: Jasmine
reviews.title: Good for shopping
reviews.content: Interesting shopping streets selling a variety of local products, food and clothes etc. each street used to specialise in certain areas eg one street sold lanterns and one silk etc back in the day but with times, this has changed but you can see the remnants of this.Not stroller or wheelchair friendly- please do not take young children as traffic is really bad. Uneven footpaths and broken pavings make it dangerous to walk and motorcycles regularly drop be in the footpath. This is an extremely busy area

reviews.author: ASIA HOLIDAY TRAVEL
reviews.title: Great experience in Hanoi Old Quarter
reviews.content: Hanoi Old Quarter is considered the heart and soul of Hanoi Capital, Vietnam. From ancient houses with hundred-year-old moss rooms to bustling small streets filled with shops... The people living in "36 Pho Phuong" have built a very unique culture of Hanoi "No". Fragrant like jasmine / Even though it's not elegant, it's still from Trang An...". Hanoi's Old Quarter bears the thousand-year mark of the capital Thang Long. The cuisine and snacks of the old town will be one of the most memorable experiences when coming to Hanoi.

reviews.author: Wonder A
reviews.title: The Enchanting Old Quarter
reviews.content: When in Hanoi, one must make it a point to visit the Old Quarter. A precious legacy of Hanoi's ancient past, it is one of the best place to relish Hanoi's history.

reviews.author: Voyageur
reviews.title: Amazing life
reviews.content: We love getting lost there for hours, an incredible atmosphereDifficult to eat there with proper hygiene rules but you won't have to go far

reviews.author: Abbssi
reviews.title: Where mopeds honk and life pulsates
reviews.content: Narrow streets full of mopeds, street vendors, food stalls... a single but fascinating anthill. We just went with the flow and went with the flow, browsing in hidden shops and sampling amazingly good food on tiny plastic chairs.Tip: If you don't like noise, you should stay at home. The background noise is not for the faint of heart. There are colorful lights everywhere, hustle and bustle and always something to look at. The old town is tiring, but also lively and full of surprises. Anyone who gets involved will be rewarded with an unforgettable experience (and maybe even learn to cross the street in the chaos of a moped).

reviews.author: Wong Tai Man
reviews.title: The vitality and charm of Hanoi’s ancient streets
reviews.content: We had a wonderful time in Hanoi Old Street. It has a vibrant arts scene, enthusiastic street vendors and a strong cultural atmosphere. As we strolled through the streets, we were attracted by the bustling crowds and colorful cultural scene. The friendly local residents made us feel at home and their warm hospitality warmed us. Hanoi Old Street is a vibrant and charming place that made us feel the diversity and uniqueness of Vietnamese culture. We will always miss this time in the ancient streets of Hanoi.

reviews.author: Ben H
reviews.title: Lovely area to stroll around
reviews.content: We stayed in the old quarter so we could be in the heart of the city , It’s certainly very busy and crossing the road is an event on its own with the hundreds of scooters everywhere!!Loads of streets to wander around taking in the atmosphere Bars/restaurants and street food everywhere so loads of options Just a great place to see

reviews.author: Arnaud g
reviews.title: It is a shame that such practices can taint our stay in this beautiful country.

Very kindly they tell you that it must have been the police who carried out his kidnapping. They will even accompany you to the station. Wasn't that adorable?Subsequently, these nice police officers ask you to pay a fine if you want to get your scooter back (200,000). That's what we did.These police officers, even if they are poorly paid, are a disgrace and dishonor the uniform they wear.So be careful if you ride a scooter in this very beautiful neighborhood!

reviews.author: SEALS
reviews.title: The streets are cluttered with small and medium sized shops. There is a night market on weekends and this area is very fun. You can find delicious food.
reviews.content: Hanoi's Old Quarter is the area north of Hoan Kiem Lake, and there are few large commercial facilities, but 36 Street is lined with many small and medium-sized stores. There are also tourist attractions such as water puppet shows and famous stores introduced in guidebooks, making it an area that attracts tourists from all over the world. Hanoi's largest Dong Xuan Market and Hansa Market are also located in the Old Quarter. I especially recommend the night market that opens from Friday to Sunday night, with countless stalls lined up. Since I arrived early on Friday morning and departed late on Monday night, I went to the night market every night because the hotel I stayed at was close to Hoan Kiem Lake. In addition to stalls selling toys and restaurants, there are a wide variety of clothes, bags, accessories, etc. There were many stalls selling colorful decorations due to the season, and it was bright, lively, and fun. I made custom-made rubber stamps and bought Vietnamese T-shirts as souvenirs to give to friends. As in Taiwan and Korea, it's fun just to walk around the night markets in Asia. There are also many stylish cafes and restaurants in this area, where you can enjoy Vietnamese coffee and sweets. I also saw many flower shops and Buddhist altar shops. There were so many restaurants that it was hard to choose, and the pho and Asian food restaurants were good, but the pasta restaurant in front of the hotel was also delicious. There were also many massage parlors with Japanese menus in the old town, and I ended up spending my time at a foot massage parlor after a massage because it felt so good. It was the weekend, so there were a lot of people there even during the day, and I was advised to be careful with my smartphone and valuables. Also, as is common in Asia, the toilets are generally bad, so if you find a clean one, be quick. But it was fun here.

reviews.author: Monmi
reviews.title: A blend of tranquility and urban buzz
reviews.content: Hanoi's Old Quarter captivated us with its unique blend of historical charm, vibrant street life, and surprising pockets of peace within the bustling city.  Each of its winding streets feels like a microcosm of Vietnamese culture.A morning stroll is best to appreciate the area's heritage. We wandered through quiet temples and marveled at ancient French Colonial architecture.  Just a few steps away, the atmosphere transforms with animated markets showcasing local crafts and goods. As the sun set, street vendors took center stage, their calls mingling with the inviting aromas of freshly prepared street food.For a taste of traditional artistry, we visited a few galleries along Hang Gai, a street known for its silk paintings and embroidery.  When seeking respite from the city's energy, we found solace in Hoan Kiem Lake. Surrounded by locals practicing tai chi and playing games,  the lake's tranquil beauty juxtaposed with the city's pulse is what makes the Old Quarter special.

The narrow, meandering streets brimmed with an energy that's both exhilarating and intimate, perfect for couples like us seeking both adventure and romance.By day, we explored the myriad of hidden gems—from quaint coffee shops tucked in ancient nooks to artisanal shops echoing the craftsmanship of yesteryears. Old Quarter Hanoi offers valuable experiences and creates memorable memories for travelers. You will never regret visiting this place!

reviews.title: Old Quarters visit.. have beer and stay cuddled with your near ones while the train passes
reviews.content: Very Vibrant ... loved the local food and people. Super experience. We booked through Viator Jeep trip and they took us to every nooks of the city.. Lived the city and its age old vibrance

reviews.author: Constantino Jos... L
reviews.title: An eclectic mix of old and new!
reviews.content: Hanoi's old quarter is an amazing place to visit. The nightlife is vibrant, with a vibrant arts scene. If you want a great experience, this is the place to be! You will not regret!

reviews.author: maorize
reviews.title: Hanoi old town
reviews.content: Souvenir shops are flourishing, sometimes insistent, but still very pleasant, always the shoe cleaners and touts for 'happy ending' massages very insistent but nothing too bad. The traffic is very dense as my T-shirt says '´I survived in Hanoi traffic'' the street food remains incredible, the restaurants too, the Blue Butterfly gives Vietnamese cooking classes, excellent atmosphere, very friendly, very complete (to do) .So very interesting city.Don't miss the puppet show!!!

reviews.author: Mumma&Co
reviews.title: Love it
reviews.content: Super busy, frentic, eclectic streets & our hotel was in the middle of it. Absolutely love the chaos, the noise, the sights, the sounds!!

reviews.author: stefan1001
reviews.title: Busy and happening
reviews.content: Busy and bustling Old Quarter. Everything going on, in and around. From Restaurants for all tastes and budgets, to street food & local coffee shops.Not to mention the endless foot & body Massages places. I tried serene Spa which was double the price of the 100’s of standard massage places and for just under £20 it was so worth is to get a proper masseuse and the service is top class as soon as you walk in the door.

reviews.author: Mapiri Q
reviews.title: Hanoi tour by scooter!
reviews.content: It's a very crazy experience. We were nervous when seeing how traffic here go and joined it by scooter was realy crazy. It's a good way to travel around Hanoi. We could also enjoy many different kinds of street food, and enter small lames to see real life of the local. We also stayed at a hotel in the center and could walk around at free time.

reviews.author: Sanjay Mundhra
reviews.title: Great Hanoi Street Food guided tour
reviews.content: Loved the cultural and food tour facilitated by Ms Yen, speaks very good English and has good knowledge of the local culture. Would recommend this trip if you want to visit the local delicacies and hidden treasures which you might otherwise miss. Great job Ms Yen, thank you.

reviews.author: Leatherlion
reviews.title: The perverse charm of total chaos
reviews.content: Yes, it's true that the old quarter of Hanoi is chaotic, dirty, full of people, cars, scooters and therefore smog, but this is also its charm.

reviews.author: Christ C
reviews.title: Hanoi's Old Quarter with BC family tour on Tripadvisor
reviews.content: Exploring Hanoi's Old Quarter was like stepping back in time, a vibrant blend of culture and history. Our journey continued with BC Family Tour to Halong Bay and Cat Ba Island, including the mesmerizing Lan Ha Bay and Laos, Thailand. The seamless organization, knowledgeable guides, and breathtaking landscapes made it an unforgettable experience. Highly recommend BCFamilytour.com for an authentic and enriching adventure!You can contact them via whatsApp +84886559609 or mail or find them on Tripadvisor/ Lonely Planet

reviews.author: Michael T
reviews.title: Best explored on foot
reviews.content: The Hanoi Old Quarter is best explored on foot. The challenge is crossing the road (without getting hurt) when faced with a never ending stream of motorbikes coming at you from all directions. Not for the faint hearted. We stayed in a hotel in the Old Quarter so we enjoyed the convenience of living the heartbeat of Hanoi, taking in its light, sound, smell and pulse of this vibrant old city.I particularly enjoyed the walk from our hotel to Hoan Kiem Lake. Part of the fun was seeing and observing the locals’ daily activities: chatting, exercising and dancing with their fellow friends.

reviews.author: Sophie G 🏖🧚🏻‍♀️☀️🌴
reviews.title: A must do 👍🏼
reviews.content: Our hotel was located in the middle of the old quarter of Hanoi!! Le May de ville, very well located!!In this neighborhood, you have everything nearby. If one evening you want to eat something other than Vietnamese food, I suggest you go eat a delicious pizza, super good at Belga, a stone's throw from the hotel where we were staying. There is also the night market and all the small streets surrounding where you can find what you are looking for for some purchases. Also go around the lake, and stroll around...you won't regret it...it's teeming with people until 11 p.m.!!

reviews.author: Phyu
reviews.title: Love the Old Quarter
reviews.content: If you like huddles and bussels you will like the old quarter. We love it. It has everything we want, famous food stalls, roadside vendors, massage shops, tourist attractions, coffee shops, souvenirs and the list goes on. If you don’t like the busy city it’s not for you.

reviews.author: Coscojar
reviews.title: It’s a MUST visit
reviews.content: Everyone should do a walking tour of the Old Quarter of Hanoi and I would highly recommend ‘Free Walking Tours Hanoi’.  So much to see in this bustling area of the capital.  Experience it for yourself, you won’t be disappointed!!

reviews.author: Saidray
reviews.title: Vibrant culture and rich history
reviews.content: A vibrant and unique area of the city that offers a glimpse into its rich history and culture. With its narrow streets and colorful atmosphere, it's the perfect place to explore and experience the vibrant art scene and culture of the city. From the traditional architecture to the bustling markets, the Old Quarter is full of life and energy. Whether you're looking for an authentic Vietnamese experience or simply want to explore the city's past, the Old Quarter is a must-see.

reviews.author: Bobbi S
reviews.title: Love The Energy Here
reviews.content: Going through the Old Quarter, whether by open back jeep, cyclo, walking (each of which we did) is like opening up a new birthday present every moment. Every turn, every sight brings a new surprise, a new gift. There is so much energy, action, chaos, history, mish mosh of architecture, personalities, bicycle overloaded with non las, flowers, fruit, foot wide crunch crackers...any & everything awaits you opening that gift & enjoying it. Walk around Hoan Kiem Lake in the early morning & see locals playing badminton, doing synchronized dance, boxing, school kids stopping foreigners to practice their English (that was us!), go to Beer Street for $1 USD beers, Zipper St (for, you guessed it, zippers!), Undergarment St....find the best rice paper rolls, the best egg coffee, the best pho, banh mi, the best & loudest music, neon lights, the most motorbikes, the tightest gathering of local GenZ'ers & Milennials, seated on low plastic stools, eating, drinking & checking their cell phones together, late into the night...it's all here & it's great! Happy birthday to you. Enjoy your gifts.

reviews.author: Linh C
reviews.title: Hanoi my love
reviews.content: Beautiful scenery, friendly people, a wonderful experience in Hanoi. I really enjoyed it and will definitely come back

reviews.author: Erik2412
reviews.title: Always worth a trip
reviews.content: For us, this is the first address in Ha Noi. Lively life, great atmosphere, colorful and always worth a visit. Be sure to try an egg coffee in one of the beautiful cafes.

reviews.author: J Paul L
reviews.title: For the unusual
reviews.content: The neighborhood where we stay each time we stay. The sidewalks are not for pedestrians, shopping enthusiasts will be delighted.

reviews.author: Amira
reviews.title: Unique mix of bustling cafes, hidden gems, and vibrant street vendors
reviews.content: Discover the hidden gems, explore the bustling cafes, and experience the vibrant street vendors. From peaceful parks to chaotic markets, this area of the city is a must-visit for any traveler. Enjoy this vibrant part of Hanoi!

reviews.author: grazia m
reviews.title: I wouldn't even want to go...
reviews.content: The passion of the people for this place is incomprehensible - small shops full of rubbish, dirt and stink, motorbikes everywhere...after seeing 7 medinas in Tunisia I asked myself why I even go there...maybe I'm a masochist.Perhaps the only memorable experience is Train Street - at 8.20 we could see the Hanoi-Saigon train whizzing by a few centimeters from our faces (?)

reviews.author: Roger W
reviews.title: an ideal start for a visit to Vietnam
reviews.content: The Old Quarter of Hanoi is where many restaurants, hotels and souvenir shops are located. Since many tours start from Hanoi, it is also the first feeling of Vietnam with its countless motorbikes. Although hectic and noisy, the quarter also has its special charm that defines the whole of Vietnam. A must visit.

reviews.author: LRF
reviews.title: Chaotic efficiency
reviews.content: Great place. Feels really safe. Not hot in December (but warm for a Yorkshire person) they sell everything here !             Vvvvvvv

reviews.author: shirak g
reviews.title: A must-visit
reviews.content: Enjoy beautiful temples, vibrant nightlife, and friendly locals. Take a stroll through the winding streets and soak in the atmosphere, or simply sit in a cafe and watch the locals go about their day.

reviews.author: Filiz Baltacı
reviews.title: complete chaos, cars, motorcycles, crowd
reviews.content: It's very complicated, they took me around with buggies, there used to be knock-knocks, but there is no such thing as traffic rules, there are shops selling fake products left and right, food places selling street products (it smelled very bad), even though there are eye-catching products on some streets, it is very difficult to walk around there. It's difficult, no one follows the rules, sellers start bargaining with almost ten times the price, I didn't enjoy it

reviews.author: Celine_2327
reviews.title: Hanoi Old Quarter Reviews
reviews.content: Very beautiful, magnificent architecture combining that of the French and that of the Vietnamese, wonderful food. I have the impression of Bun Cha, the egg cafe, but too crowded sometimes traffic jams and too much noise in the street

reviews.author: Chris on tour
reviews.title: Ditch the map
reviews.content: Just book a hotel in it and wander around.  No need for a map or a phone it's not that big, just immerse yourself in it. If you get lost there's plenty of bikes to take you back to the hotel. Just carry their business card.

reviews.author: Mac G
reviews.title: Brilliant
reviews.content: Customer service excellence second to none. The entire team took great care of us; we had a great time as a result. Nothing was too much trouble. We would definitely visit again.

reviews.author: Wikumj
reviews.title: Crazy and chaotic, part of the charm
reviews.content: Crazy and chaotic, but that is part of the charm, there are just so many sights and sounds at any one moment. It can be overwhelming but there are lots of shops and restaurants and shops you can pop into for a calming break. All sorts of shops selling all sorts of things. Interesting to just observe the daily hum of activity on the streets, and the interesting architecture, the narrow buildings and store fronts, sometimes with a French influence. It's very easy to just spend an entire day wandering around the old quarter, popping into shops, stopping by the cafes and restaurants and soaking in the atmosphere. A warning that there are lots of motorbikes in the area so you need to get used to that and developing confidence when crossing the road.

reviews.author: Al37_11
reviews.title: To be explored on foot, to get lost!
reviews.content: It is the ideal place to visit the city.The site is easily passable on foot, especially as the narrow streets and tiny alleys do not allow access to cars.You have to stroll along all these shops whose activity is almost non-stop, partly carried out on the sidewalks with hardworking, smiling staff who charge relatively attractive prices. Don't hesitate to bargain, it's part of the game!It’s a shame that too many of these people don’t speak foreign languages, which makes conversation difficult.I remember observing the gradual opening of the shops at the start of the day, the reinstallation of products on the sidewalk, even on Sundays.The neighborhood is an inexhaustible source of photos.

reviews.author: Vacation32980941349
reviews.title: Hanoi's Old Quarter - everything is within reach
reviews.content: One place that I definitely spend my weekend for exploring is Hanoi's Old Quarter. Here I can freely shop for all kinds of products, from traditional food, clothes to personal items, etc. It feels like I can find everything here. It's more convenient when Hanoi's Old Quarter very close to the Ha Noi center and many hotels. Come and experience this place, I'm sure you'll have a great time

reviews.author: Getaway19027996903
reviews.title: Review of the wonderful life of the people of the old town and the interesting experiences of tourists when visiting and exploring this place.
reviews.content: There are many beautiful street cafes and bustling scenes of people. I am very satisfied when experiencing traveling here

reviews.author: Minh Hiền
reviews.title: This is an interesting, comfortable trip to the capital. In the midst of a noisy, bustling capital, there still exists a peaceful neighborhood
reviews.content: Hanoi's Old Quarter stands out with its ancient beauty on every roof and street corner. This place is a destination not to be missed when arriving in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Flyer08907201977
reviews.title: Hanoi
reviews.content: Beautiful, nostalgic, old style, diverse products, delicious food, friendly and lovely people, diverse and convenient services

reviews.author: Happiness13085297924
reviews.content: I like the scenery of Vietnam very much. I hope to travel here again. It is a great country. The beauties here are very beautiful. I love it. I just watched Jingfang granules in the third class. The Louvre opened

reviews.author: DomCanada
reviews.title: Wow!
reviews.content: Hanoi is now probably my favourite city in South East Asia! It's wild, authentic, and super fun. Yes, walking the street can be a bit intimidating (given the motorcycles) but hire yourself a guide and get a taste of a real city.

reviews.author: Flom
reviews.title: Welcome to the unique culture capital of the world!
reviews.content: This vibrant city is a feast for the senses, with its unique culture, vibrant art scene, and delicious food. From the streetside cafes to the traditional markets, you'll find something to tantalize your taste buds. And if you're looking to explore the city's rich history, you'll find plenty to see and do. Old Quarter Hanoi is a must-visit destination for anyone looking for a unique and unforgettable experience!

reviews.author: JnVSydney
reviews.title: Crazy....Chaotic....Overwhelming....All part of the fun
reviews.content: However, a 3 night visit over a weekend, is more than enough, in our opinion, Whilst we can play the haggling game with the best of them, old town has some shady vendors and whilst we found a great jacket on an outside rack with a big sign saying 200K… we ended up having to walk away, after the price miraculously went up to 500K. Being Friday it was the start of the weekend and thus the start of the Hanoi Night Markets! Woo hoo! They more or less close off the street that runs from the lake to the Dong Xuan market and we took a long walk up one side and down the other.  (I say more or less - but scooters still sneak through and terrorise shoppers.)  generally enjoying the market vibe, we did all our shopping here, the shop owner and vendors were less push. Aalishan Indian Restaurant, just opposite the hotel (gets a special mention) it was dead set brilliant! So yummy - naan bread, mango lassi and some great curries. We were making hugely happy noises as we sat there and enjoyed ourselves immensely. so much so we visited two nights running.Other sights to see Train street (no train… more run on weekends apparently), Food alley, is not to be missed if you want authentic street food.The square, especially at night crazy with light sounds and trafficThe Dong Xuan Market (which was chaotic and really more of a wholesale place),.Bicycle hawkers, it is amazing what they can fit on a bikePaper Street (which was chock-a-block with Christmas decorations, Santa's, reindeers and polar bears).We must say we loved the cooler temps able to enjoy old town without melting.

reviews.author: troyba
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.content: Nice place with recommendation from my hosrt. I will be back for the next time. And acient buildings were one of my favorite.

reviews.author: Elina798!
reviews.title: The heart of Hanoi capital!
reviews.content: I love this old town. Very hustle and bustle where everything gathering together. You can find the best authentic food anywhere as well as do shopping. The local people are so friendly and they are always smile at you. My favorite part of Hanoi’s discover journey.

reviews.author: Nadine E
reviews.title: Hanoi Jeep Tour
reviews.content: We did a private city tour by Jeep. It's so nice seeing very crazy by this way. We stayed  at a hotel near the Hoankiem lake. Good to walk around. Lots of good restaurants. People were so nice.

reviews.author: Jung Hee
reviews.title: A must-visit place to experience vibrant culture, narrow streets, and vivid history.
reviews.content: Hanoi's Old Quarter is a must-visit for its vibrant culture, narrow streets and vibrant history. It is a popular tourist destination for exploring the history of ancient East Asia. The Old Quarter is bustling with numerous shops and stores, where you can encounter historical traditions and culture, and find traditional foods and ingredients to buy products. The place is also busy with various performances and festivals. We provide new experiences and enjoyment to everyone who visits. Hanoi Old Quarter offers new experiences to everyone who participates due to its historical background and vibrant culture.

reviews.author: Jorge N
reviews.title: Very beautiful places and a lot of life
reviews.content: A city without a doubt that you have to visit, a lot of traffic chaos but every corner and every smile is worth it, charming people

reviews.author: Ms. Beulah AR
reviews.title: Old quarter in Hanoi
reviews.content: A true sight of structures showing the old quarter. Busy bustling street with loud music nights. Full of Spa, pedicure, manicure, body massages. Vietnamese coffee of varieties can be tried here. Varieties of Vietnamese food. Shops after shops to buy things and so many varieties of clothes. Dong Xuan market to buy gifts and varieties of things. All day and all nights bustling motorbikes, trishaws, and Vietnamese people are very humble and lovely people.

reviews.author: Craig W
reviews.title: A memorable old town
reviews.content: I really enjoyed the vibes and moods in the old town. The atmoshere was nostalgic. There was a Christmas market during our trips. Highly recommend to stay within the area as there are a lot of activities and good eats around.

reviews.author: OneTrip with local
reviews.title: The best part of Hanoi to discover.
reviews.content: The busy part of Hanoi with lots of great local restaurants and hidden gems. Hanoi in November is much cooler so it's easier to get around without worrying about the heat.

reviews.author: Oliver
reviews.title: Old Quarter
reviews.content: So ancient and full of nostalgia, this place cannot be missed. Even though the outside has been covered with a layer of modernity, it still has an ancient soul. Come here to enjoy

reviews.author: Willy G
reviews.title: Like a time machine to the old times while enjoying delicious coffee and foods
reviews.content: Crowded, chaotic, noisy. Absolutely love it. This is what you should expect for an old place that sells everything in life. Get a lost in the narrow streets, get honked at by the zipping motor bikes, and eat yourself silly while sitting on those tiny plastic stools.

reviews.author: bhavya b
reviews.title: Good
reviews.content: A distinctive neighborhood of Vietnam where you can admire French buildings. The shops, spas and restaurants are okay.

reviews.author: Anne Z
reviews.title: our walking tours/ halong bay cruise booked with HALONG BAY CRUISE HUNTERS tripadvisor
reviews.content: It was so great for our holiday with friends since HALONG BAY CRUISE HUTNERS agent arrange beautiful HALONG BAY CRUISE and  a cheap walking trip tour with free tour guide around Old quarter area, we had great time for enjoying food, drinks and having some great local coffee, too. HALONG BAY CRUISE  tour is also a must do !

reviews.author: DOUME
reviews.title: The district with 36 faces...
reviews.content: From 5:30 a.m., the neighborhood is bustling... Wander through the bustling streets... The sidewalks are busy with sellers and piles of goods, craftsmen working, people eating... The alleys are teeming sellers, tuk-tuks, motorbikes, cars honking, which do not respect any priority or traffic light, tourists lost in this hubbub and this frantic dancing...You go from the pleasant scents of the street of flowers to that of tools...Take a tuk-tuk to join this hectic life, this constant ballet of two, three and four-wheeled vehicles...Ideal place to reside...

reviews.author: Mazo
reviews.title: Stroll through the ancient Hanoi Old Quarter and experience the rich and colorful culture
reviews.content: There are many ancient buildings here. Along the meticulous alleys, you can appreciate Hanoi's traditional cultural customs and experience the blend of different cultures. Here, you can taste a variety of delicious food and enjoy the relaxed atmosphere in lively cafes. In addition, the scenery of the lake can also make you relax and add more fun to your trip. Hanoi Old Quarter is really a place worth visiting, allowing you to experience the colorful cultural customs.

reviews.author: svb
reviews.title: organized chaos
reviews.content: Organized chaos. A space full of all types of establishments where life bustles. The streets crowded with mopeds, in a background noise of engines and beeps that never stops and where pedestrians and vehicles coexist without much stridency. A place where you can walk, despite everything, with safety and tranquility

reviews.author: Sammychanda
reviews.title: Fabulous place
reviews.content: This place is the heart of the city and a stone's throw away from Hoam Kim lake, train street and Opera house. The street is bustling with shops, eateries, people and has a festive air to it. Loved it.

reviews.author: GoPlaces51924752933
reviews.title: Old Town streets Hanoi
reviews.content: Loved it. But seriously crazy traffic. Relatively slow. One has to be brave and strike out at times. No-one seems to be really trying to kill you. Fascinating streets specialising in areas if trade or goods. Haberdashery is phenomenal - if you have a plain piece of clothing you fancy embellishing take it with you and browse. Allsorts if things are fixed on the street / pavement. Fascinating.

reviews.author: kim tae h
reviews.title: We are so lucky because we booked the Sapa bus and tours here
reviews.content: The best bus we have is in Vietnam and Southeast Asia. The bus from Hanoi to Sapa is a spa.
