reviews.author: HIROYUKI SHIMIZU
reviews.title: Old Quarter
reviews.content: This is the so-called Old Quarter. There are restaurants, souvenir shops, massage, specialty shops, everything. It was fun to explore without relying on a map. This is an area where you can feel the power and heat of Asia.

reviews.author: Mariella R
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: Excellent guide and we loved the city and the food. We will come back next year We enjoyed the history behind the city and the Hoshi Ming museum

reviews.author: Rodrigo Ronaldo M
reviews.title: Street Chaos
reviews.content: The place is chaotic with drivers parking their cars anywhere. Taxi driver would wait for passengers at the corner of the street. Motorcycle drivers would traverse the street without any caution.One could have enjoyed the shopping along the streets but you would have to focus not to be hit by the motocycles.

reviews.author: 唯羯 徨
reviews.title: Easy to walk around, but very messy
reviews.content: There are many shops in the old town, which are very easy to browse, including many unique shops and old shops.Small vendors are also common on the sidewalks, and the shops are completely different day and night. You can even see small drink stalls setting up casually on the roadside in the middle of the night.In addition, you will see rickshaws recruiting customers in this area, but basically it is more cost-effective to use GRAB for transportation.However, the area is a mixed bag of people and vehicles, with almost no sidewalks, making it very time-consuming to actually visit.It is recommended that the old city should be properly planned as a pedestrian area or the existing sidewalks should be completely managed

reviews.author: Hui L
reviews.title: If you don’t come to the Old Quarter, you can’t say you’ve been to Hanoi.
reviews.content: There are cafes everywhere, both local and modern, complex and very attractive. The old town is a microcosm of the life of local people. They live in the city and behave like they are in the countryside. They get up early and gather together to eat and chat because their houses are narrow. , so meals are all served outside. The old house carries long-lasting memories and gives tourists a retro and nostalgic feeling. This is my first trip to Hanoi.

reviews.author: Patrick
reviews.title: Grim. If they dealt with litter/waste and pollution, the whole area would be very charming.
reviews.content: Some may find the chaos and activity interesting and authentic, and perhaps it is. However I personally found the whole area pretty grim.Everywhere you go there is litter, mysterious liquids, and animal corpses (both vermin, and for preparation as food) all over the floor.Traffic is insane, but manageable once you get used to crossing the street.

reviews.author: Bernadina E
reviews.title: Lovely crazy city!
reviews.content: It's very noisy and crowded all the day. Stayed in the center and we could find all just around us. It's hard and crazy when you want to cross the streets.  Good food and restaurants can be found any where! Make sure you stay some where in the Old Quarter!

reviews.author: Lizette T
reviews.title: Authentic and good food
reviews.content: A great place to stroll around. Just  look how vietnamees live en taste some streetfood. Where it is busy it is usual safe for us to eat. Nice place to sleep is tirant hotel.

reviews.author: Cs x mundo
reviews.title: The most fun
reviews.content: The most fun in all of HanoiSpectacular coffee with eggAnd train street, at 9:30 p.m. 3 trains passRecommended x 1000

reviews.author: Culture13607538725
reviews.title: Plain lame
reviews.content: This place is a mess. First day I was here, I felt like I was risking my life whenever I try to cross the street. I did get used to the traffic later so it didn't bother me much afterward. Overall it's dirty, expect some vendors ripping you off. For example I tried to buy sugar cane juice and the vendor wanted 50 when it should cost anywhere from 12-20.The food in the area is quite good if you pick the high rating ones from Google map.Not much to see in this area. Endless repetitive poor quality souvenirs. Also there is a lake in this area, I don't have much to say about it.

reviews.author: lnswest
reviews.title: We had a great time in Hanoi , the people very humble and friendly and there are many things to see
reviews.content: We a had a great time in the old quarter and you are able to see what they have gone thru to live there. They r very humble and polite people lots of things to see.

reviews.author: Coopper29
reviews.title: Take lots of photos
reviews.content: We were lucky our hotel was just by the old quarters and well worth visiting plenty of things to see and do, it gives one a good atmosphere of old Hanoi

reviews.author: Global827178
reviews.title: Old Quarter magic
reviews.content: Fabulous place to stay. Great vibe, hustle and bustle but always friendly. Overwhelming at first, but settle in and relax into it. It's a place to enjoy at your own pace.

reviews.author: loonylou78
reviews.title: Crazy but fab Hanoi!
reviews.content: What an absolutely crazy place this is! Coming from a relatively sedate UK this really woke us up!! We loved being able to walk round and have a coffee in one of the many coffee shops, lunch wherever we fancied and usually with the locals in some quaint restaurant, and just enjoying the craziness of the place. It was a bit daunting walking in the road and constantly avoiding the scooters but it was actually fun in the end, almost like a quest for survival!!! We escaped for a walk round Hoan Kiem lake one morning and that was a lovely experience. We also loved the fact that at the weekend some roads get shut off and are solely used for pedestrians. We loved to see families out and about enjoying their time together and all the lovely locals dressed in their traditional clothing.We also braved beer street one evening and that was fun, Hanoi is like a different world at night, and streets are again closed off for people to enjoy their evenings. We are not city people usually, but we really enjoyed our time here and would return!

reviews.author: Cokro S
reviews.title: Nice vibe and energy in this part of town
reviews.content: Pretty walkable although you must be somewhat agile when crossing roads or stepping on the sidewalks. The bikers have a different perception of space with you! The open air eateries are all friendly and delicious and pretty cheap. Just make sure to come here in the right season. I went in late July and it was the height of summer so it was really really hot and humid with almost no place to hide from the hot wind.

reviews.author: Ching X
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: This place you should not miss when you travel to Hanoi. They close the traffic every weekend which make the street more safe for you to walk around. Only one thing is a little bit hot in the evening

reviews.author: Roy R
reviews.title: Enjoy the Old Quarter
reviews.content: The old quarter area is filled with shops and restaurants.  I recommend staying here because of the endless variety of activities all in close proximity.  The lake area is beautiful and you can enjoy a walk around the lake comfortably and safely.   We ate at small sidewalk cafes offering Vietnamese cuisine at very moderate prices.  As I've experienced Vietnam I have learned that they offer the best in coffee which is available everywhere.

reviews.author: Lauren W
reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.content: A fascinating snippet of Hanoi - the sights, the sounds, the smells, the spas and the scooters! Wish we could have stayed longer.

reviews.author: Traveler29118646113
reviews.title: Hanoi Old Quarter
reviews.content: A great place to explore every weekend, especially on holidays, it will be decorated quite eye-catching, with many activities on the street. The morning walk was great

reviews.author: Jessica
reviews.title: Old Quater in Ha Noi
reviews.content: It's great to be able to dine at a restaurant with a view of Hoan Kiem Lake and the bridge. See the entire view from the 12th floor - well worth the experience!

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.title: Evaluate
reviews.content: Hanoi is very beautiful, with 36 streets that have become an arbitrary destination for everyone to visit. We can see Hoan Kiem Lake, especially in this weather, when it is not pleasant, why not visit the old town to enjoy delicious food and enjoy the pleasant atmosphere?

reviews.author: RTV2809
reviews.title: An unforgettable walking experience
reviews.content: Walking around was an amazing experience, regardless of what time and day you strolled around. Booking a hotel here is a must, especially for tourists. You'll definitely feel the essence of the country when you spend at least a day here. There's an endless amount of food in restaurants and stalls that you could even feel overwhelmed. Popular tourist sites are within walking distance as well.

reviews.author: Zimminaroundtheworld
reviews.title: Beautiful, Chaotic, Dirty, Exciting - A Must!
reviews.content: The Old Quarter in Hanoi like my title says is beautiful, chaotic, dirty, exciting, etc.. I stayed here for a week and had a blast exploring this part of Hanoi. There are many attractions, restaurants, cafés, and hotels in the area. I loved just watching all the mopeds drive by and walking down all the roads. There is plenty to do here to keep you active for days. The Old Quarter will definitely keep you alert and awake. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: MegsM
reviews.title: Immerse yourself in the Old Quarter
reviews.content: Loved getting lost in the streets and markets of the Old Quarter. Even crossing the road is an experience amidst all those scooters! We felt safe and did not feel overly harassed by shop keepers which can always mar this kind of experience. Lots of great places to stop and have a Bia hoi and watch the world go by.

reviews.author: Zoo_Fanatic22
reviews.title: This place is phó real!
reviews.content: Every store is special, and there’s just so many! Highly recommend a food tour to find the best of the best. Visit the lake in the morning for friendly encounters with locals and wholesome content.

reviews.author: Dave F
reviews.title: Definitely go to the Old Quarter
reviews.content: We stayed in the Old Quarter for 4 days.  Just absolutely love the Old Quarter.  So many lights, sounds, places to eat, places to shop, people to watch, and things to do.

reviews.author: Isabell8785
reviews.title: Chaotic but friendly
reviews.content: Very cool! Definitely culture shock if you start your Vietnam journey here but as chaotic as it is - everyone is super friendly, the food is amazing and the party on the street shouldn’t be missed!

reviews.author: Greenbelle
reviews.title: Crowded and noisy, can be fun, soak the culture but be weary taxis. Get a Grab taxi instead.
reviews.content: Very noisy, crowded and full of motorcycles and tourist bus. Want the experience of street food and tourist shops, visit the old quarter. Haggle down to half price and be ready to walk away. Many stores with same things. It’s also very close to the lake of the turtle island. Be careful crossing and walking around. Download Grab app is you are traveling anywhere in Vietnam. Don’t just get into a taxi with a meter on the street waiting at the big tourist places.He  took us the long way and cost us 3X what Grab charged us. They also reached for our money and tried to hide what he grabbed behind him. Was not a good experience. Traveling long distance we used Govntravel. Half the price and reasonable. Very professional but they will offer tours that you can take or leave. There is also an HSBC bank close to the lake which gives a higher limit for withdrawals than local banks.

reviews.author: Companion04426403312
reviews.title: Beutiful
reviews.content: The scenery is beautiful, the people are friendly and kind. I hope to have a nice trip in Hanoi………..

reviews.author: Anne
reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.content: The neighborhood has ancient Vietnamese beauty.  There are many delicious cafes and restaurants. I was very impressed with the pan bread and coconut coffee.

reviews.author: Curiositytraveller
reviews.title: A must see
reviews.content: Beautiful view with tasty street food. Captivating neighborhood with ancient feel.this place is full of charm,shopping and tasty food

reviews.author: makon-b
reviews.title: If you're going, now is the time
reviews.content: The messy electric wires and smelly atmosphere of 10 years ago are gone, but the number of motorbikes and people has increased, and the place is full of horns and energy. And one of our goals was to eat as much B-grade gourmet food as we could!

reviews.author: Akan S
reviews.title: The city at night
reviews.content: I really love this area in Hanoi city. It is actually the center of the capital where people gather and tourists come. Worth seeing

reviews.author: MizuhoK
reviews.title: Wandering around is so much fun
reviews.content: Old quarter at north side of Hồ Hoàn Kiếm lake. Food stands, souvenir shops, Chinese medicine, stamps… it’s fun to wander around even without setting any purpose. Atmosphere is different between night and day. Some souvenir shops are lit colorfully with lanterns.

reviews.author: NhanNguyen
reviews.title: A bit crowded
reviews.content: Hanoi is quite interesting, there are many dishes that I like, shopping is also cheap. I was able to sew a few clothes at quite reasonable prices. Maybe will come back here on the next vacation.

reviews.author: Annie G
reviews.title: Nice evening tour around the place
reviews.content: We had a nice evening walking street food tour there to enjoy the local dishes and witness the local lives of this city.

reviews.author: Akshay Sharma
reviews.title: A jam packed street full of restaurants, shops and night market
reviews.content: This is the bustling space in Hanoi full of  restaurants, shops and night market. There are massage parlours, shops selling variety of goods and two wheelers bustling in and out. One must visit during night time to see the full glamour of this area and enjoy the street food.

reviews.author: Michael S
reviews.title: Great place to wander
reviews.content: The Old Quarter is a fascinating place to just wander around.  There are shops everywhere, selling almost anything you could want.  There tend to be clusters of similar shops, for instance, one street we wandered down had shops for everything you need for your motorcycle.  Seats, accessories, repair, you name it.  Another street was ceramics, one was light bulbs and lanterns. The south end of the the Old Quarter is where it is most touristy, at the north end of the lake, so you will be accosted a little more in that area.

reviews.author: Thas N
reviews.title: A family holiday to enjoy the local food and culture of Hanoi!
reviews.content: We picked this location for a family lunch based on Insta posts and went there without high expectations. We were pleasantly surprised by the excellent service and great food. We tried the egg coffee ( served with a sketch of ourselves on top) and An specialty food. We were genuinely impressed.

reviews.author: Spring Nguyen
reviews.title: Nice to walk around and enjoy street food
reviews.content: Hanoi is famous because it has lots of beautiful small streets and great street food. Try to eat here you will love the food

reviews.author: cramac
reviews.title: To experiment
reviews.content: Oppressive heat and humidity. The evening is bedlam. Scooters whiz by everywhere. But it's worth it. Certainly one of the most curious attractions in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Fulvio G
reviews.title: Chaotic and impossible
reviews.content: Chaotic impossible.For hotels and restaurants to avoid. Prefer other neighborhoods such as the French Quarter.It's worth a visit at most

reviews.author: Geo H
reviews.title: Authentic Vietnam!
reviews.content: Old part of the city of Hano around the Lake. Essential visit and highly recommended. Great nightlife with local people

reviews.author: Paulo N
reviews.title: Shopping place
reviews.content: You can find everything there. Get lost in the streets, go into all the shops and cafes, but be careful with the traffic.

reviews.author: Thanh N
reviews.title: 36 streets
reviews.content: You should go to the old town early in the morning to be able to feel all the beauty of Hanoi's 36 streets. Hoan Kiem Lake late at night on the weekend is also worth seeing

reviews.author: bbhesania
reviews.title: Vietnamese experience
reviews.content: Walk, stroll and enjoy the sites and sounds of Hanoi, stop for coffee or sip a sugarcane juice. Take in the vibe

reviews.author: Abdul
reviews.title: The perfect getaway for the adventurous
reviews.content: If you're looking for a place to explore and experience the vibrancy of Southeast Asia, then Old Quarter Hanoi is the perfect destination for you! With its rich history, vibrant street vendors, vibrant nightlife, narrow streets, and lot of restaurants and cafe shops, you'll never run out of things to do. From a relaxing stroll through the narrow streets to a night out in the buzzing bars and clubs, Old Quarter Hanoi is the perfect place to let your adventurous side out!

reviews.author: Luh K. A. Mega Andhini
reviews.title: Old but Gold
reviews.content: An amazing place to hang out, enjoying almost everything that Hanoi has to offer, from view, people, food and entertainment! Totally worth to visit.

reviews.author: duuuudi
reviews.title: Must visit on weekend
reviews.content: I like this area, especially during the weekend nights. They close the road around this area so no cars can inter just for walkers, you can make shopping and get pleasure and they still  open till about midnight

reviews.author: Dara-Khmer
reviews.title: Always interesting
reviews.content: If you haven’t been to Vietnam, the old quarter is full of charm, shopping and food. Second visit and despite the hot weather was well worth the visit

reviews.author: B K
reviews.title: Hustle Bustle and interesting mix of shops , fun to go around and shop
reviews.content: The old quarter has many streets , some more interesting than others, selling everything from utility items for locals to souvenirs and craftworks for tourists. There were shops for jewellery, pearls ,clothes, footwear, ,handbags, luggage and accessories.  It was a pleasure to stroll through the roads and shop for things.We had been advised to bargain hard in Vietnam. What I observed - Not all shopkeepers quote escalated prices.Some of them quoted more than double , some even triple the price. But some also had no bargain prices and some bargained a mere 10 or 15 pct.So my advise is to window shop at few places ,check out and compare the price and quality.Then go-ahead and quote what you deem fit.One interesting thing I observed is that shops selling one kind of goods are generally placed together. So you have a row with all shops selling toys or kitchenware or footwear.The day we arrived , we went for a one hour Cyclo ride that gave us an opportunity to know the place ( 100 K VND per person for 1 hr )We also did the electric car ride (available from a station on Hoan Kiem Lake ) that took us around to some different streets. ( 245 K VND per electric car - 45 minutes)But most times we explored on foot.Grabs are very easily available and very reasonably priced ( beginning 33K VND for approx 5-7 kms )It has the hustle bustle and feel of old town ( obvious as per the name) , so do not expect a  fancy market.

reviews.author: Kathy Collin
reviews.title: Good destination to see in Hanoi
reviews.content: It is such a great experinece to wander around Hanoi Old Quarter and witness the daily lives with stores, local restaurants and night markets, and local people going about.

reviews.author: V A
reviews.title: Disgusting smelly place
reviews.content: Old quarter is a crowded, noisy place and smells like sewer and diesel (from all the motorbikes). I dont understand what the good reviews are about. I saw the most disgusting things here, from unrefrigerated meat being cooked in 40 degree heat on side street to rats running in and out restaurants and local people blowing their noses and taking baths where they eat. I couldn’t eat or drink anything here.

reviews.author: normouaden
reviews.title: Experience the bustling nightlife and charming atmosphere of Hanoi
reviews.content: Located in the heart of Hanoi, this vibrant and bustling area is filled with restaurants, bars, and shops that will make your stay an unforgettable one. The riverfront is bustling and alive with locals and tourists alike, and the streets are filled with the sounds of music and laughter. The atmosphere is truly captivating, and you can't help but be drawn in by the vibrant energy of the area. Whether you are looking for a romantic dinner, a night out with friends, or just a place to explore, the Old Quarter is sure to provide you with an experience you won't soon forget.

reviews.author: Parul B
reviews.title: Amazing shops , local food and spa centers. Must visit.
reviews.content: Old quarters is full of local shops selling clothes, souvenirs, local food and spa centers. Its very cheap and good quality. Dont forget to bargain though.

reviews.author: Ansalem 😜
reviews.title: A must-visit destination for anyone looking for a unique cultural experience
reviews.content: This vibrant city is full of scenic lakes, a bustling riverfront, and a vibrant nightlife. Whether you're looking for a peaceful stroll along the lake, a night of revelry, or a shopping spree, Old Quarter Hanoi has something for everyone. The streets are lined with traditional Vietnamese architecture, and the markets are full of delicious local delicacies. Don't miss the opportunity to explore the city's rich cultural heritage and experience the unique sights and sounds of Old Quarter Hanoi.

reviews.author: Robert H
reviews.title: amzing
reviews.content: best place to visit in hanoi, the food is very good, people is friendly, crowded on weekend. Traffic is very terrible

reviews.author: Dr N. Vijayan
reviews.title: Place to stay, dine and shop
reviews.content: Good place to experience Hanoi. Although the place is clustered there is sufficient space and cleanliness in the hotel and dining areas. You will also get used to crossing the roads in Hanoi.

reviews.author: ilove2xplore
reviews.title: Great place to explore
reviews.content: Since our hotel nearby old quarter Hanoi, so many shops such as cafe’s, local restaurants and vendors buying souvenirs ( need to do bargaining skills or else you will be ripped off ) 😅 and great place to explore and meet local people whose very friendly and helpful, and watch out crossing the street ( kinda scary since the traffic light system seemed odd 😂 either left or right all vehicles 🚗 🏍️ will just running even it’s on the green light - be very careful ) ..make sure bring along hat 👒 🧢, sunscreen with you or umbrella 🌂 the weather is extremely hot in Hanoi..we had so much fun exploring the area ..Highly recommended 🙌🏻👍🏻👍🏻

reviews.author: Ethan J
reviews.title: Must visit
reviews.content: A hectic party of the city we’re your head must be on a swivel at all time to avoid being run down by a motor bike. However, the beautiful French buildings everywhere. It’s a must visit as you can take an walk around enjoying the building.

reviews.author: CoolGuy
reviews.title: Just the way you are as I remembered! Old Quarter!
reviews.content: Been here before few times before Covid period. I was here for business trip 29 May to 3 June 23. Weather is extremely hot in the day time. So on my first day of arrival. I managed only to walk a very short while around in the afternoon and then walk longer around the old quarters in the cooling night, on my first day of arrival.I managed to buy two hats, 3 sleeveless t-shirts, all each at 100k dong. The rest are coffee powders/ 3-1 & 2-1 instant coffee, and can drinks coffee from highlands coffee.Too hot to walk. so better to come at night. But some shops may close early around 9pm... In this trip, I ate chicken pho, beef pho, fried spring rolls, fried morning glory, fried eggs, sticky rice with pork, sweet corn milk drink, mango sticky rice, cold dessert etc.For me personally, I prefer Hanoi than HCM. More historic buildings and things to see, and more food choices for me.

reviews.author: Harris L
reviews.title: Crazy Hanoi City!
reviews.content: Our hotel was just in the city center and walking distance to all. It's supper hot during  our stay. Here you can find everything just around the hotel. We liked local street food. Our local guide showed us much and took us to all the comers during the street food tour.

reviews.author: Dr.Abhijit B
reviews.title: KNOWING HANOI
reviews.content: Took a stroll through the souvenir shops,street food,,train line, on our own. It was amazing to see how modernisation took place from the ruins of past. Good to see how essence of past has been preserved.

reviews.author: Niccum
reviews.title: Delicious food, bustling street life, vibrant nightlife, and an eclectic mix of old and new
reviews.content: This historic area of the city is full of winding lanes and alleyways where you can explore traditional markets, sample local delicacies, and take in the sights and sounds of this bustling city. The streets are alive with the sound of vendors selling their wares, from fresh fruits and vegetables to traditional handicrafts. You can also find a wide variety of restaurants, cafes, and bars, offering up an eclectic mix of both traditional and modern Vietnamese cuisine. At night, the area comes alive with its vibrant nightlife, with plenty of bars and clubs to explore. Whether you're looking for a relaxing evening or an energetic night out, you'll find it all in the Old Quarter. With its delicious food, bustling street life, and vibrant nightlife, Hanoi's Old Quarter is a must-visit for anyone looking for an unforgettable experience.

reviews.author: Loucelle
reviews.title: Very Good
reviews.content: So nice and good ambiance and very authentic plae and th coffee was so good thank hoping to visit again one day.

reviews.author: InternationalPillow
reviews.title: Overwhelming but the heart of Hanoi
reviews.content: We stayed in the Old quarters and spent most of our evenings walking around, from the streets to the lake and Night markets. It was overwhelming at first- the bustle, the traffic, the crowds. However after day two, we started to appreciate the Old quarter for what it was- an opportunity to see how life in Hanoi is. We saw walkways lined with people having their evening dinner at the hole in the wall stalls. We saw middle aged ladies dancing to country music at the lake. We saw friends, families, couples walking and enjoying the lake view. We saw tourists walking the quarter trying to make sense of the place. We saw the locals and tourist crowds enjoy food and drinks at night.One stand out was how safe the place was- we kinda expected pick pockets or scammers but didnt have any experiences or vibes. The other stand out was how wholesome the place was- Friday night and everyone is well behaved, sound music, families out and about.

reviews.author: mike h
reviews.title: Hanoi Old Quarter
reviews.content: Incredible experience, cheap prices, best to negociate, offer half or 2/3 of what they ask for. I guess about 80% of the shops speak English

reviews.author: Trần Anh Quốc
reviews.title: Experience the culture of Hanoi people
reviews.content: Hanoi's old quarter is crowded with delicious restaurants, bars for tourists are springing up like mushrooms, the feeling of the street is open 24 hours a day.

reviews.author: Line et Bruno
reviews.title: Incomparable Hanoi
reviews.content: An unparalleled tumult that stimulates all the senses.  A complete change of scenery.  Warm people.  Narrow and dense streets.  An ancient, thousand-year-old city that is gradually modernizing.  Full of shops to meet the demands of tourists.  A well-exploited lake tour that gives vitality to this city.

reviews.author: Piotr M
reviews.title: great to visit
reviews.content: all the streets are crowded with people and cars/motorbikes, but the atmosphere is unforgettabe and special

reviews.author: marri
reviews.content: extremely beautiful. Really feel very beautiful when coming to this place. The old quarters are lovely people. I hope next time I come here, I will go with my family to experience this wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Arun P
reviews.title: start of vietnam tour
reviews.content: old quarter is the happening place in hanoi .good for tourist all facilities are nearby.  you start vietnam tour from hanoi .hotels are cheap ,food is available near ,site seeing to sapa ninh binh, halong bay etc .can book from hear

reviews.author: Glen
reviews.title: A vibrant and noisey place
reviews.content: An area full of character but you have to have your wits about you when navigating the streets, motor bikes everywhere and red lights don't mean anything to them.

reviews.author: Camille B
reviews.title: Excellent expérience
reviews.content: An incredible experience I recommend it. The bun cha ta was excellent and the passion jus too. The staff was really nice

reviews.author: Clémentine G
reviews.title: Amazing restaurant!
reviews.content: very good restaurant that I highly recommend, the staff is really nice and the food is great, not overpriced

reviews.author: G S
reviews.title: A Visit to Ha Noi's Wonderful Old Quarter
reviews.content: I stayed in Ha Noi's Old Quarter for a week in March 2023.  This was organized by Nguyen Hoai of Vivu Travel in Ha Noi.  I had a wonderful time walking around the lake and watching the various activities there.  On the weekends, the area is alive with music and families out enjoying the atmosphere.  I was luck to have superb weather, which I'm sure was oganized by my wonderful travel agent, Hoai.I visited the fantastic Water Puppets several times.  This is a wonderful show of puppets on water that takes place in a theater alongside the lake.  It''s difficult to understand how they can manipulate the puppets from under the water, but they manage to do it, somehow.  The show is enhanced by the presence of a wonderful live orchestra that uses traditional instruments.I watched a military band commemorate the 75th Anniversary of the Vietnamese Army and saw numerous balloon sellers and other musical acts around the lake.  I can highly recommend Ha Noi as an interesting city to visit.  There are also numerous other sightseeing trips available from Ha Noi, such as a wonderful cruise on the picturesque Ha Long Bay which can be organized for you by Hoai at Vivu Travel.I also visited the B-52 Museum and went to the Laika cafe' which is named after the first dog in space (launched by the Soviet Union on the Sputnik 2 in 1957).

reviews.author: Anil K
reviews.title: Old town was as expected
reviews.content: It gives a feel for old Hanoi, worth a drive through and a roadside meal - certainly a nice vibe to experience

reviews.author: Shelley M
reviews.title: Just didn't love it
reviews.content: Really thought we would love this place.  Didn't hate it, but really didnt enjoy it either.  The traffic is crazy and the cafes are super cool and there is a lot going on, cool hotels, it is a tourist hotspot, so super crowded but filthy.  I think that was what made us not enjoy it, stuff dripping on you from overhead (not raining), blood or fish guts all over footpath, or grease from bike shop.  It was constant, much cleaner walking on the road.

reviews.author: birchwoodfarm
reviews.title: Best by cyclo
reviews.content: If its hot, then walking tHe crowded streets can take the fun out of it. Riding in a cyclo however is great fun. It's like you are in an invisible forcefield as they drive through the crazy traffic. We stopped to look st various things that interested us then asked our driver to take us to the number 1 best egg coffee shop. The coffee is cheap and delicious. The pace by cyclo is perfect and you won't overheat. A couple of hours, day or night well worth spending.

reviews.author: book_of_dreams
reviews.title: Bustling
reviews.content: This is a vibrant part of the city, with narrow bustling streets filled with atmospheric cafes, tourist bars, crazy traffic, authentic eateries and street food. It is heavily touristed and many businesses cater for this, but you can still easily find local food and coffee. The area has a high concentrration of affrodable accommodation.

reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.title: Pretty old buildings and lanterns
reviews.content: Hoi An Old city is the best part to visit for market life and tailor shops. People are friendly and helpful. You must try an egg coffee in one of the small local coffee shops as it is delicious 😋

reviews.author: Pradeep53
reviews.title: Cyclo Tour of the Old Quarter
reviews.content: The best way to go through the Old Quarter. Very enjoyable especially if you have a problem walking long distances and are not so agile to avoid traffic.

reviews.author: Paula8766
reviews.title: Smaller city than Saigon
reviews.content: Hanoi is not as large as Saigon, we manged to walk around most of the tourist areas in about 6 hours.  Very traditional but streets a bit dirty.  Would recommend trip to the old prison

reviews.author: Leanne Houston
reviews.title: One of the hidden gems of Vietnam
reviews.content: It's a bustling city full of friendly locals, vibrant culture and bustling markets. From the moment you arrive, you'll be overwhelmed by the sheer energy of the place. The streets are alive with the sound of motorbikes, the smell of street food and the sight of locals going about their day. The markets are a great place to find unique souvenirs and explore the local culture. You can even find some of the best street food in the world here. But the real highlight of Old Quarter Hanoi is the friendly locals. They are so welcoming and eager to help you explore their city. Even if you don't speak the language, they will make sure you feel at home. Whether you're looking for a hidden gem, friendly locals, vibrant culture or bustling markets, Old Quarter Hanoi has it all. It's the perfect destination for anyone looking for a unique and unforgettable experience.

reviews.author: Luccie
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: beautiful.worth a visit.A feature of the old town.recommend everyone to come and experience this beautiful place

reviews.author: GeraldH75
reviews.title: An idea of hell
reviews.content: Very noisy area ! And definitely not a walkable district ! Too many street restaurants and motorbikes parked on sidewalks preventing the pedestrians walking . Hectic traffic ! Red light at traffic lights does not stop vehicles to go ahead ...

reviews.author: must_travel_soon_10
reviews.title: Sensory overload
reviews.content: The old quarter has an amazing energy, some good, some not so good. The 2 & 4 wheel vehicles are just bursting through the streets, so be cautious. The shops, vendors and people are overflowing with activity. Unique experience with some good shopping and eating.

reviews.author: parakeets
reviews.title: We loved it.
reviews.content: Easy to walk around.  We saw many of the well known sites in it all on foot.  If you're a good walker and the weather allows.  Apart from the mental traffic it's easy to do on foot and you see so much more.

reviews.author: Bryan M
reviews.title: Great place to visit
reviews.content: I love the Old Quarter Hanoi, great food and amazing architecture.just a great place to chill out and relax.

reviews.author: Dji
reviews.title: We love the history, culture and street food
reviews.content: The narrow streets are packed with shops, cafes, temples and vendors selling everything from souvenirs to snake wine. You can easily spend hours wandering around and soaking up the atmosphere of this vibrant and chaotic place. The best way to explore the Old Quarter is by foot or by cyclo, a traditional bicycle taxi. You will be amazed by the sights, sounds and smells of this ancient part of the city. Don't miss the night market, where you can find bargains on clothes, accessories and handicrafts.

reviews.author: kerry b
reviews.title: Streets of Hanoi
reviews.content: Spent my first day wandering the streets, crazy traffic. Had to be mindful but such a different place I enjoyed looking and watching the day to day life around me

reviews.author: Nasick
reviews.title: Amazing place to explore!
reviews.content: The streets are full of friendly locals and bustling markets selling delicious food. The eclectic mix of old and new makes it a great place to explore. From the ancient temples to the modern skyscrapers, there is something for everyone. The food is amazing, with a huge variety of dishes to try. The night markets are also great, with a wide range of goods to choose from. The atmosphere is vibrant and the locals are always willing to help.

reviews.author: Phi Somchai
reviews.title: Chaotic yet charming
reviews.content: This is the busy and lively part of town.  Everywhere is bustling with activities and lots of traffic.  The chaos gave the place character and charm.There are lots of small eatery and street food here.  There are also different streets specifically in selling one type of goods or service only.  For example, ceramics, toys, stationary, etc.

reviews.author: Geffers O
reviews.title: Unique and authentic experience in Vietnam
reviews.content: The narrow streets are lined with vendors selling delicious food, and the peaceful parks are perfect for relaxing and taking in the charming atmosphere. The whole area has a certain charm that is hard to find anywhere else. The food is amazing, with a variety of dishes to try. The atmosphere is lively and bustling, with plenty of people milling around and enjoying the sights and sounds. The parks are tranquil and peaceful, with plenty of greenery and a relaxed atmosphere.

reviews.author: Jimmy
reviews.title: Charming old quarter
reviews.content: There are more than 60 streets here and do have a from the hotel for you to navigate. There are night markets on Fri, sat and sun at old quarter from 7 pm to 11 pm. Do check the season when you plan your tour to Hanoi.Beware of heavy traffic

reviews.author: Monica S
reviews.title: Very polluted place- tourists are harassed by local vendors
reviews.content: Extremely busy, dirty area, you will be harassed at every step by people trying to sell you something. Sometimes they will also follow you, making it even more scary and unpleasant.

reviews.author: Soko37
reviews.title: Nice walk
reviews.content: Old colonial architecture, shops with souvenirs, coffee shops, restaurants. History connected with present and business. Great to sit, having coffee or street food and enjoy atmosphere

reviews.author: vistorvistor
reviews.title: Used to be hectic, now it's chaos
reviews.content: This place has become too much of everything. Used to be a bit hectic a couple of years ago but now it's utterly mayhem to the point it's hard to enjoy the very cool things this neighborhood has to offer.Go on a weekend and find the streets where traffic is not allowed

reviews.author: errearra
reviews.title: Full of life
reviews.content: Fascinating to see how people live on the streets and do not hide in their flats. Streetfood is the norm not a fashion. As other neighbourhoods of Hanoi are much more advanced, not sure the Old Quarter will resist modernisation. Come to see and experience as long as you can. The atmosphere may have been similar in many other cities a few centuries or decades ago.

reviews.author: rukeaustria2018
reviews.title: Very busy district
reviews.content: Take your time to browse at all the shops, boutiques and coffe spezialities, enjoy icecream or nice Vietnames food at any corner...

reviews.author: Hana
reviews.title: Interesting place, a must see when visit Hanoi
reviews.content: Old Quarter Hanoi is a must-see destination for anyone visiting Vietnam. With its scenic lakes, hidden gems, and bustling riverfront, it's the perfect place to explore and experience the city's vibrant culture. From the iconic Hoan Kiem Lake to the narrow alleyways of the Old Quarter, there's something for everyone. The food is delicious and the nightlife is vibrant. Whether you're looking for a quiet stroll by the river or a night out on the town, Old Quarter Hanoi has it all.

reviews.author: Bruce C
reviews.title: Be weary - dog attack
reviews.content: This was our second visit to Hanoi Old Quarter. First time was in 2017 and we enjoyed it so much we planned a return visit. The reason I'm giving it 1 star this time is because of an unprovoked dog attack. This happened on the sidewalk in Old Quarter, where a medium to large dog (~18kg) bit my leg while I was walking the street. Didn't even see it until it was too late. The dog was being kept by one of the shop owners. Long story short, upon doing some research, found that Vietnam still has a rabies problem and because of it I decided to go to a 24 hour medical centre in the middle of the night, get the wounds cleaned and start a series of rabies vaccinations and serum shots (I haven't had any prior rabies protection so needed it and this is what cost a lot) - total cost was US$515.Went to the FMP Hanoi - International Clinic. They spoke decent English and while expensive, if you have travel insurance, I'd definitely recommend them. I still need 3 more vaccinations to complete the set, which I'll be getting in Phu Quoc - I'll follow up with where you can get rabies vaccinations in Phu Quoc. This has caused problems with our itinerary and now have to take time out to visit clinics for rabies shots not to mention the pain and trauma my wife and I experienced.While we looked forward to visiting Hanoi for its food and massages, it will be a long time before we consider revisiting Hanoi again.As for the dog, we provided the hotel with the dog/shop details who said they'd follow up with the authorities.

reviews.author: Iadine O
reviews.title: Lovely Buncha
reviews.content: Bucha local food is one of the best cuisine you should be trying it if you're traveling in Hanoi vietnam. We impressived this food only when we have 4 nights in Hanoi and would back here in the future

reviews.author: Jonny
reviews.title: Good for Pho is the best in Vietnam
reviews.content: I am voving from Cau giay dist to Old Quarter by motorbikecycle about 20 minutes. I liked street food here, special Pho Bo is number one ( address place on Ly Quoc Su), visit Lang Bac, walking to night market...only trouble for me is lost way to back hotel/

reviews.author: Jennie M
reviews.title: Uninspiring, uninteresting, dangerous.
reviews.content: As old quarters go this one is poor. There are a few “tourist tat” shops, and many “local” unfriendly restaurants. Independent stores or restaurants are few and far between. Maybe if you visit at a weekend when the streets are closed to the traffic for a night market it would be a more pleasant experience . Visiting midweek it’s basically an exercise in dodging traffic, walking past dumps of shops and cafes looking for the illusion Tripadvisor recommendation. It’s beyond me why Tripadvisor has rated it.

reviews.author: TravelBrianCO
reviews.title: Goes on forever
reviews.content: Similar to other jammed packed areas in large southeast Asian cities but fun nonetheless.  Overwhelming everything. Fun to walk around and see the sites. Close to the lake and a lot of good restaurants.  Cyclo tours everywhere if that is your thing. Suggest going late afternoon so you can see the transformation as it gets dark.  It comes to life at night!  It is very busy so watch where you are walking.

reviews.author: Malcolm L
reviews.title: Old Quarter Hanoi
reviews.content: Fascinating experience and everything you would imagine Hanoi to be.Sights, sounds, smell and movement.As a destination, I would wholeheartedly recommend The Old Quarter Hanoi.

reviews.author: JA
reviews.title: Revolting
reviews.content: Can I give zero stars?This is the worst place I've visited in the world, and I've visited a LOT of places.This area is not fit for humans. Avoid, avoid, avoid.

reviews.author: Sylvia H
reviews.title: Fascinating Part of the world
reviews.content: We could spend hours just studying the rich diversity of activities on the streets, this part of the world is so different to live as we know it!

reviews.author: Upendra P
reviews.title: Life in Hanoi
reviews.content: Walking through Old quarter gives you a good idea how Vietnam was several years ago under French and the new Vietnamese government.  The food street during weekend was so crowded. Again gave you how normal life goes on here.

reviews.author: Laura
reviews.title: Authentic part of Hanoi
reviews.content: Such a nice authentic place of Hanoi. Stayed here all the nights in different hostels. We really felt like we were where everything happened and in walking distance to everything. The old quarter is charming. Definitely worth a visit and I 100 % recommend booking your accommodation somewhere here.

reviews.author: William Chen
reviews.title: Charming Place
reviews.content: Charming and bustling neighborhood located in the heart of the city. The area is known for its narrow streets, historic architecture, and traditional culture. It's a fantastic place to wander and explore, with plenty of shops, restaurants, and cafes to discover.

reviews.author: Afton
reviews.title: Bustling Markets
reviews.content: One of the most impressive things about the Old Quarter is its well-preserved architecture. The buildings here date back centuries, and many of them have been lovingly restored to their original glory. Walking through the streets of the Old Quarter is like stepping back in time to a bygone era.

reviews.author: Chris S
reviews.title: fascinating, energetic, historic
reviews.content: Busy-paced very exciting, and our tour guide was so well versed in history, tradition and Vietnamese culture.

reviews.author: Ali07London
reviews.title: Stay and enjoy all its got to offer
reviews.content: We stayed in two different hotels in the Old quarter whilst using it as a base to explore Northern Vietnam (Sapa and Ha long bay).  The streets are buzzing and there are lots of small shops and restaurants.  Once you get used to dodging the mopeds its a really great place to visit.  From the Night market to Beer corner there is something for everyone.  Lots of sky bars etc.

reviews.author: Naim00
reviews.title: Wonderful little streets, full of color and life.
reviews.content: You have to spend a  day there; walking around, feeling the vibe, mingling with the crowds. A unique experience. Might take you a while to get used to it and to the traffic but then it kicks in; this place is so alive.It is clean believe it or not, no beggers, no homeless people, no trash on the ground.  Just nice people going on with their lives and trying to make an honest living. Love it!

reviews.author: scholken
reviews.title: Hanoi old quarter
reviews.content: Old street is much more crowed. There are a lot of food here. Bring your camera , everything you look is something to photograph

reviews.author: Balabac Palawan
reviews.title: Beautiful Chaos
reviews.content: We liked our daily visits to Old Quarter while in Hanoi for food, shopping and sighteeing. We went to the night market everynight and regretted that we didnt buy all take-home items from here. We went to Saigon after Hanoi but everything is more expensive.

reviews.author: caroline w
reviews.title: Very special
reviews.content: Adore Hanoi. There is abuzz, a vibe, a happiness and energy to this wonderful capital. If you walk around the Lake on a Sunday, enchanting young Vietnamese rush up to you and ask to practise their English with you. Always sit down and spend time with them; they love it, you enjoy it and helps them - the main point of the exercise.

reviews.author: ljd4
reviews.title: Old Quarter is an area you must explore
reviews.content: A must area to explore. Be prepared to walk and walk and walk and get lost. The streets are like a maze. We found that when we got “lost” we would ask someone the direction to the lake and it helped with orienting ourselves.  Great area for shopping, eating, drinking and exploring. Be sure to look up to see the beautiful old buildings.

reviews.author: Lynda S
reviews.title: Atmospheric and chaotic
reviews.content: We felt entirely at ease wandering amongst the narrow streets and alleys or crossing the crazy traffic at a slow pace as advised.So much produce whether cultivated or produced, its mind boggling.  Enjoyed the experience and pleased we chose to reside in this area.

reviews.author: nmimbulgoda
reviews.title: Unique blend of French colonial Architecture ,shops and coffee and Vietnam food
reviews.content: Hanoi train street, is unique, where one could enjoy sitting in a cafe just next to rail road. Vietnam people doing their best to prevent overcrowding along this rail road. Listening to the story the origin  of Vietnam delicious egg coffee, I enjoyed was a memorable experience

reviews.author: Hannah P
reviews.title: Smelly, dirty, awful
reviews.content: The streets are full of rubbish, there is a different awful smell every 30 seconds. Huge disappointment, wouldn’t recommend Hanoi never mind things in it

reviews.author: Hang94
reviews.title: Lovely place to entertaiment
reviews.content: As a local, I would highly recommend visiting the Old Quarter in Hanoi for a truly authentic experience of the city's history and culture. Walking around the narrow streets and alleys, you can discover traditional crafts, food vendors, and ancient temples, all of which give you a glimpse of Hanoi's rich heritage. However, be prepared for the crowds and chaotic traffic, as this is one of the busiest tourist spots in the city.

reviews.author: S Sewpersad
reviews.title: Vibrant Old Quarter
reviews.content: Stayed at the Golden Rooster Hotel in the old quarter. Walking the streets in the evening and you can get a sense of the vibrancy and culture. Very busy streets with shops that are open till 10pm and you can find anything you want. I enjoyed the side street with pavement food stalls. An interesting and a must visit to the old quarter when you are in Hanoi.

reviews.author: jessica
reviews.title: so much fun for walking
reviews.content: we spent a half day in this area and so much fun for strolling around this area . there are so many streets fod food , beer and shops there . in the evenings of weekend there were a lot of activities like game playing, dancing , singing. it was only only for walking at the weekend so it was nice for strolling around . take a food tour in the afternoon was nice .Thank you Vietnam Escape Tours Travel for a best streetfood tour

reviews.author: Asia Mystika Travel
reviews.title: Facisnatiing place in Hanoi
reviews.content: Hanoi's Old Quarter is a bustling and vibrant area that is steeped in history and culture. This is the heart of the city and is a must-visit for anyone traveling to Hanoi. The streets are narrow and winding, and filled with shops, cafes, and markets. It's a great place to explore on foot, as you'll come across hidden alleys and beautiful architecture at every turn.

reviews.author: DGSmanila
reviews.title: Average down town
reviews.content: The old Quarter is mainly shopping streets.Few interesting temples, nice street food, but nothing unique if you not knowthe exact places to visit.

reviews.author: Vandana Khanar
reviews.title: A nice little Old Town
reviews.content: A lot of street foods and they're all so delicous. We have taken a cooking class in a small restaurant and it's great. A walking through the small alleys is not a bad option for you guys.

reviews.author: Bhavyesh S
reviews.title: Can’t miss it!
reviews.content: This neighbourhood has a lot to offer. Street food, Street-side shops, weekend night market, and some tourists attractions! Definitely recommended! :)

reviews.author: Janowski Sarah
reviews.title: Interesting Town!
reviews.content: There're both ancient and modern architectures in this area. We've also experience the local daily life in the small alleys and local market. We saw that there're many foreigners joined local beer at night time in Old Town right on the treets, good atmostphere.

reviews.author: Radhika K
reviews.title: Great atmosphere
reviews.content: If you wish to soak in the culture of Hanoi/ Vietnam and understand what the country is about you should spend time in the Old Quarter. Its noisy, its chaotic and yet it is where the action is.

reviews.author: Omni F
reviews.title: So much fun!
reviews.content: Don't even have a route in mind when you start wandering around the Old Quarter -- wandering aimlessly is the best way to visit this area!  You will find so many tiny shops, great coffee houses and the smallest restaurants serving up some delicious food.  Then once you're finally done roaming around, pull out your phone and find the way back to your hotel.

reviews.author: Ken U
reviews.title: Hanoi Lion Boutique Hotel made our stay @
reviews.content: Great area, highly recommended Hanoi Lion Boutique Hotel ! Clean , nicely equipped, service was amazing.  Great breakfast and very reasonable rates

reviews.author: Laurie S
reviews.title: Hanoi Old quarter with street food
reviews.content: We had a half day walking around the old quarter and enjoyed street food with my guide. Very strange feelings: the noise, the food smell, the crazy traffic etc.  Do stay at  a hotel in center. We chose a small boutique one.

reviews.author: Celtic3401
reviews.title: A Glimpse of Hanoi Street Life
reviews.content: A fascinating maze of back streets, restaurants and shops  We did a 1 hour cycle tour with a driver/peddler  No trip to Hanoi would be complete without doing this

reviews.author: Mandy M
reviews.title: core vietnam noisy chaos
reviews.content: real feel of old vietnam but motornikes everywhere honking and all parked on paths so can only walk on the road which causes more honking.  it all assails your senses.  find a temple for a bit of relief

reviews.author: David D
reviews.title: Old Hanoi culture
reviews.content: Booked hotel in the Old Quarter, enjoy the culture of old Hanoi: Busy street, heavy traffic with many small, deep alleys, small streets. Street food was interesting with cheap price. The night market is just a few walks from our hotel.

reviews.author: Bouy TorQue
reviews.title: Fantastic area
reviews.content: I just love this whole area during the day and it really livens up when the sun goes down. So many restaurants and bars to choose from that will shake your tastebuds and quench your thirst.

reviews.author: Arun771512
reviews.title: buzzing with life
reviews.content: the best part of hanoi small restaurants, the lake, shopping markets and much more. would suggest you book a hotel here

reviews.author: Chloe
reviews.title: Was Amazing !!
reviews.content: I love the old quarter so much. That was awesome ! I can find anything around here. The food and the local were nice to me.

reviews.author: VR
reviews.title: Are you visiting Hanoi? It's a must go to the old quarter
reviews.content: Don't miss the it. The bustling of local life, the dedicated streets from to different jobs, from silverware to leather or food and local markets

reviews.author: Wt A
reviews.title: Must to eat Pho here
reviews.content: Noodle soup with beef Ly Quocsu str are the best food if you find any palace for noodle soup in Old Quater. Hanoi is a peace city in Vietnam. Good palace in southest Asia

reviews.author: albul
reviews.title: A total mess but lots of fun!!!
reviews.content: Sidewalks practically don't exist, since they are turned into motorbike parking lots, barber shops, restaurants, shops... Motorbikes everywhere (but they won't run you over, don't worry!) very nosy and terribly polluted (wear a mask!!!) in spite of all this you'll love it, it's very funny.

reviews.author: dimpoo1971
reviews.title: night market
reviews.content: Very happening area of Hanoi,with narrow lanes andyou will also find lot of street food being sold but only for non vegeterians. it has lot of cafes,and you can enjoy coffee which comes in great varieties.Make sure to go to the night market and also try the beer at beer street.

reviews.author: Oana & Akos
reviews.title: Unique Christmas experience in Hanoi 💕
reviews.content: Just walking through the busy streets in the old quarter was an experience in itself. We traveled there during Christmas and there were concerts and street events organized everywhere. You get overwhelmed with the lights, food smell, street vendors etc. It’s a must! 🤩

reviews.author: Kavinmcthurn
reviews.title: Amazing stop on our trip
reviews.content: Our local tour guide from Deluxe Vietnam Tours helped us to see the real Hanoi Old Quarter. Get off the beaten track - surely without him, we could not see these amazing daily life activities

reviews.author: Anne Mathilde T
reviews.title: Noisy, Busy, deliciously worthy
reviews.content: Let's get lost, it's only way to explore the place.  Take at least half a day of walking, shopping, eating and drinking. Each street is dedicated to a corporation, you'll find every thing in this giant market place.

reviews.author: fidoshtabassum
reviews.title: Must spend some time here
reviews.content: Interesting to explore this area with street food tour and cyclo tour. Interesting to go into in the small alleys,but it is hard for us to find if we do not travel with a local tour guide

reviews.author: Kedia Sar
reviews.title: Interesting to explore
reviews.content: We explored the old town on our own but we did not get the real life of the local until our tour guide from a local tour company showed the inside - interesting

reviews.author: Leonhkny
reviews.title: Authentic Hanoi neighborhood
reviews.content: This is Hanoi's historic center. Dotted with some souvenir shops and tourist restaurants, it is still largely a local neighborhood. Many of the buildings are quite rundown and the surrounding can be filthy, raucous and chaotic. Adjust your expectation before visiting.

reviews.author: Rbansal2014
reviews.title: Walk around in the busiest spot in Hanoi!
reviews.content: The Old Quarter in Hanoi is flocked with tourists, local people, vendors, bikes.It is a buzzing area right from the morning to late at night. It is lively and vibrant, it hosts numerous cafes, restaurants , shops of many kinds. It is a great area to spend your time, and browse many different shops and probably take a pit stop at any of the coffee shops!

reviews.author: fal3
reviews.title: The worst parts of Vietnam in one place.
reviews.content: I’ve been to most major cities in Vietnam and the old quarter has nothing special or unique about it.The only defining characteristic is being forced to constantly walk on the roads.The air is thick with pollution. The drivers around here are particular lunatics, and it is teeming with scams and hostile locals.Funnily enough, I would recommend going for the “experience”. You will also find that most recommended places to visit and eat are in the old quarter, so it is unavoidable.

reviews.author: Kevin W
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: Great experience, Train Street when a train comes through in the evening is a must do in Hanoi. Good restaurants and bars

reviews.author: Bipin D
reviews.title: Heavenly hanoi
reviews.content: Old is gold, authentic and exhilarating.You can shop till you drop.Throw your caution to the winds and explore at leisure the egg cafe, the history, souvenirs galore, red wood work, egg shell and duck shell lacquer paintings,magnets that portray Vietnam, silk and bamboo shirts,vtee shirts with faux brands that are difficult to distinguish.The street food is awesome, the whole sale markets have great options and good bargaining possibilities.Upmarket handicraft made by specially abled people out of silk threads is out of this worldIcecreams, crepes,vwalking streets , music is so well orchestrated around the serene lake and pagoda.Even a month there may fall short.

reviews.author: Vipul
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.content: Great to roam around in the beautiful alleys. Nice shopping, well lit, good food options, nice cafes

reviews.author: daisy21988
reviews.title: Very chaotic!
reviews.content: The Old Quarter is a very chaotic area of Hanoi. We booked a hotel in the heart of the madness with our 7 month old baby and it was very challenging to get around the neighborhood with him. If I had known how active this area was I probably would have looked for a hotel elsewhere, but we did our best to try to find the quieter streets and to find restaurants that we could hang out at to take a break. The park and lake are gorgeous and we spent quite a bit of time there too. I think this area would be much more enjoyable for people without kids, but it's definitely not an area to be missed in Hanoi!

reviews.author: Demaras
reviews.title: Beautiful Old Quarter
reviews.content: Great for travellers, shoppers, and foodies, plus an option to go to a few lovely bars for happy hour.  Even the traffic is hectic there is a method to there madness, and the people of some of the best i have met in the world

reviews.author: NavUK1503
reviews.title: Cyclos tour of the old quarter.
reviews.content: We had a Cyclos tour - which gave us a great perspective of the life here and of the old quarter. Would recommend this as there are a lot of motor bikes that could make walking difficult

reviews.author: Monica G
reviews.title: Great vibes
reviews.content: I love this place! It is covered with nice people, awesome food and a lot of things to do! Love it both during day time and night time, and the walking street at weekend too.

reviews.author: Ambareesh
reviews.title: Not for an indian who saw similar life :)
reviews.content: Being an indian, we have such old quarters in almost every city and used to such rush. Luckily i just stayed only 1 day :)

reviews.author: Sunny eng
reviews.title: Good for walking around for shopping
reviews.content: That is very nice to walk around Hanoi Old Quarter. There are a lot of bar, restuarants and shops in Hanoi Old Quarter and you can spend a day there. Wish that we had more time but all good.

reviews.author: Hemant_Ggn
reviews.title: The best place for tourists
reviews.content: It is the happening place of Hanoi with street food, beer street, night mkt on weekends etc. Very lively, however mostly winds up by 11PM on weekdays.

reviews.author: srimanone
reviews.title: VERY BUSY AREA AND LOTS OF CROWDS
reviews.content: Extremely busy and vibrant , lots of massage shops and food stalls. Some good hotels in area but if you don’t like crowded places not for you

reviews.author: dasreiseteam
reviews.title: Outstanding experience
reviews.content: The city is so vibrant, restaurants, cafes, interesting shops and colonial architecture everywhere. Walking through the narrow streets is a unique experience. People are friendly, it is quite clean and definitely safe.

reviews.author: Jeff H
reviews.title: A perect location for street photography
reviews.content: Walking the streets of the Old Quarter in Hanoi was a special experience I won't soon forget. The local charm is off the charts.

reviews.author: Laust Kehlet
reviews.title: This is where you get the vibe of Hanoi
reviews.content: Just walk around and try some of the local restaurants. Also, make sure to go to the night market and also try the beer street - that is a crazy place :-)

reviews.author: DuaneThia
reviews.title: An old city with old charm.
reviews.content: Was there during their 'winter season' - averaging 12-20 degrees celcius during our family trip there.Went on the Ha Long Bay Cruise -  Absolute MUST. (Wil share more on the ERA Cruise)

reviews.author: TC F
reviews.title: Boring
reviews.content: Hanoi is boring period. Not as vibrant and exciting as HCMC Saigon. Only go here to go to Halong Bay or Sapa.

reviews.author: Nguyễn Thành Nam
reviews.title: Very good
reviews.content: Very good! I can feel Vietnamese street, people and culture. It's so special for me now, I hope I can come back to vietnam one more time.

reviews.author: PLS
reviews.title: Not for me!
reviews.content: A lot of people may find this area fascinating but I hated it. I knew about the millions of scooters in Hanoi but was not prepared for them to be parked all over the pavements as well. You literally take your life in your hands when out and about. You cant stop to look at anything because of the chaos. I do not like the idea of playing chicken but that is what you have to do if you need to cross the road. On a weekend the roads around the old quarter are closed to traffic but guess what some of the scooters do not obey the rules which makes it more dangerous as you are not expecting one of these contraptions to come flying up to the pavement at speed. Make sure you have travel insurance if you go to Vietnam.

reviews.author: aledm
reviews.title: Not too interesting
reviews.content: It's noisy, crowded and doesn't have much of interest for us. We started on a Lonely Planet Walking Tour and then had a coffee and left.

reviews.author: Long H
reviews.title: Best place to enjoy local life
reviews.content: Hanoi Old Quater is so special with life, street food. Every sound, smell are quite unique. Sometime the streets are crowded and noisy but unique

reviews.author: Julia
reviews.title: Hanoi spa
reviews.content: Walked around Old Quarters to get shopping done and stumbled across Hanoi Spa. Tried the Vietnamese, Aromatic, Stone and Facial massages. Everything was very good. Reception was excellent as the girls were able to explain in English on the different types of treatments. The brochure is also very clear in description. The masseurs were efficient and professional.Also visited Hand Ma street where all kinds of great decor for festivities can be found.Enjoyed the week-end night market too as many things to see/eat/buy and activities to enjoy too!

reviews.author: Hanni T
reviews.title: good
reviews.content: Hanoi is a dreamy city that has infatuated the human heart. Besides the noise and busyness, that is the poetic and peaceful beauty.

reviews.author: SYDBKK
reviews.title: Busy Vintage Town where footpath s are for motoebike parking.
reviews.content: Love the feel of intage town with hint of french colony, they preserved. Lots of big trees. Busy with predestrains and traffic. Street food everywhere. Strongly unique city in the world.

reviews.author: Rachel Ong
reviews.title: Nice area to enjoy the beautiful sights of Hanoi
reviews.content: The old quarter is a great area to explore the beautiful sights and wonderful eats of Hanoi.Cafes decked with small chairs and tables and sitting by the roadside for people watching. There are also many good restaurants serving great food at affordable price. Definitely worth a visit when in Hanoi. Tips for crossing the road: Just do it, do not rush as the bikes will maneuver their way around you.

reviews.author: Ali921
reviews.title: The bustling heart of Hanoi
reviews.content: The bustling heart of Hanoi for tourists and locals. Full of life, cars and motorcycles/scooters. Each street sells one particular product, I enjoyed "Christmas Street". A whole section of the old quarter is closed off in the evening when everyone eats and drinks in the open without traffic.

reviews.author: Kihan
reviews.title: You have go to
reviews.content: A must-go-to area if you are in Hanoi. The Water Puppet Theatre is definitely worth a visit, and so are many of the key points in the area: HoaLo Prison, the museum of modern history, St Joseph's Cathedral

reviews.author: Belgo
reviews.title: Bustling
reviews.content: A must-go-to area if you are in Hanoi. "Chaos that works" once you get the hang of it amidst the constant sounds and with cars and bikes coming from every direction with no apparent order. Yet everything works out smoothly. The Old Quarter is filled with shops, restaurants and coffee shops of all kinds, and there are plenty of cultural sites or buildings within walking distance. The Water Puppet Theatre is definitely worth a visit, and so are many of the key points in the area: the old central Prison, the museum of modern history, St Joseph's Cathedral and the small temple to King Le just nearby and everything around the Hoan Kim lake...

reviews.author: Hewee55
reviews.title: A journey on the line in between the Ages
reviews.content: It was an awesome experience except for the bike's horn and the trash being thrown on the street. Our guide from Tonquin Travel describes the area as the "Market Grid" in the ancient time where people from all around gathered on the 1st and 15th of every month in Lunar Calendar as something that never change over time and how they lived in the past. Kind of a "journey on the line between the Ages" that you can see small details in the way of people and architecture. It hinted at the atmosphere in the past and nowadays and you can feel it your way. Also, you can only find a good taste of food from the real locals here, not the 5 stars restaurant, that is the way people explore gastronomy here, in the Old quarter.

reviews.author: Gregory K
reviews.title: Controlled chaos
reviews.content: Not perfect Every thing you could expect Hustle bustle no uniform order But it works That’s the charm Everyone friendly

reviews.author: Canard
reviews.title: Late night must visit ... just goes off !
reviews.content: Sensational party town packed with people , action and music. late night venue and a must see. Be prepared to stay awile.

reviews.author: Andrew R
reviews.title: Crazy (in a good way)
reviews.content: Essential:Usually footpaths are blocked with parked scooters.Scooters, cars and buses all assume right of way, even on crossing and green 'Walk' lights. To cross, walk confidently, stare down the traffic with your hand towards them  signaling clearly for them to stop.

reviews.author: AlwaysTurnLeft
reviews.title: Energetic, bustling part of the city
reviews.content: Bustling, energetic part of the city that you must visit when in Hanoi. Bursting with life from early in the morning to late at night. Seemed quite overwhelming when first arriving but after a day it all seems quite normal to cross roads and dodge bikes, cars, buses, motorbikes and street vendors all cross crossing and going the wrong way down one way streets, on the wrong side of the road. The traffic does swerve to avoid you but keep looking both ways!

reviews.author: BertSG
reviews.title: Do Everything Here
reviews.content: Place to stay, to eat, to shop, to walk, to sight see, to get your massage....everything you need to do in Hanoi is here. Small lanes tuck with hotels, shops, restaurants, food stalls, souvenir shops, clothing....everything. Traffic can be chaotic but it's organised chaos. Come Fri to Sunday the streets are closed to most traffic in the evenings and its lovely to walk the place. Spend a few days here taking in old Hanoi.

reviews.author: ExpatDaze
reviews.title: Go. Walk. Enjoy.
reviews.content: Just go and walk around stopping by the many cafes and shops etc. it’s super friendly and there’s not a lot of tourists hustlers bothering you.

reviews.author: joanneb196
reviews.title: Where it is all happening.
reviews.content: It seems Old Quarter is the place to be. Vibrant atmosphere lots going on. Busy and bustling with lots of food stalls and drinking venue. Not really hasseled much by vendors. Just politely say no thanks and they leave you alone. Loved the vibe and felt safe walking around.

reviews.author: Brian H
reviews.title: It’s very hectic
reviews.content: We had a nice time wandering around, but be aware it was definitely some culture shock and took a little getting used to the chaos.

reviews.author: Theresaong
reviews.title: Go by foot – the only way to discover more!
reviews.content: I had one night as a solo traveller and i felt totally safe. The side streets are filled with surprises of food smells and street bars.

reviews.author: Sandy H
reviews.title: Love this place
reviews.content: Such a fun place to visit. Super unique and tons to do. We loved it here and will definitely be back again!

reviews.author: Dung H
reviews.title: Old but dynamic area
reviews.content: Just walking around this old quarter and you will find plenty of small but beautiful things. We love the night walking streets around Hoan Kiem Lake.

reviews.author: Skd1406
reviews.title: Hanoi old quarter
reviews.content: Our hotel was in the old quarter so everyday of the week we stayed we set off in a different direction to see what we could find. Saw the train passing, many different activities at the lake and countless quaint shops offering food, clothing,  etc

reviews.author: Wonder A
reviews.title: The charming old quarter
reviews.content: Strolling through the old quarter brought back memories of yester years... when we first visited Vietnam many years ago.

reviews.author: RitaE
reviews.title: View of the Past

reviews.author: Fede
reviews.title: Worth a try. Lovely place
reviews.content: Lovely food and great service by Anna. She showed us how to eat the bun cha and was really sweet and attentive. She even gave us some quick vietnamise lessons.

reviews.author: Renee P
reviews.title: Quaint and beautiful
reviews.content: Quaint and beautiful and chaos all rolled into one. Hundreds of street cafes, coffee for everyone. Shops and more mopeds than you can imagine make this city quite wonderful.

reviews.author: Kendall T
reviews.title: Sights, sounds, smells, beautiful Hanoi.
reviews.content: If you haven't walked around the Old Quarter, you haven't been to Hanoi. Once you get the hang of crossing the busy streets (never hesitate) you'll find the real flavor of Hanoi. I can't call out any specific attractions because it's all wonderful. Get out and explore!

reviews.author: bylandorbyair
reviews.title: One of the World's Great Neighborhoods
reviews.content: Hanoi's Old Quarter is one of the best neighborhoods in the world to walk around in; there is people watching (and dodging - it is hectic and full of traffic), a wide array of food and drink, all kinds of shops, and sites to see. It's a great place to take photos and just enjoy the atmosphere. Locals are incredibly friendly, especially considering how crowded and chaotic it can get. But there is a rhythm to it all, somehow. The best time ot visit is the weekend, when parts of it are closed to cars and scooter/motorbike traffic is limited.

reviews.author: wombatdavid
reviews.title: What a place!
reviews.content: This is a great area of Hanoi to stay, eat and walk in. We followed the Lonely Planet walking map and enjoyed what we saw. We also did our own thing and got trousers altered and ate some cheap food. Be careful crossing the road! But all good fun.

reviews.author: Laura B
reviews.title: Very Energizing, Interesting Area
reviews.content: A bit tricky to walk, as the sidewalks are filled with motorbikes and restaurant seating. However, if you do not have any mobility issues, it is a fun place to explore. Lots of great food options. If you are sensitive to noise or pollution, ear plugs and a face mask will do you good.

reviews.author: Diamond B
reviews.title: Nice to konw about Hanoi
reviews.content: Great experience. We had bia hoi with local people and even chat with them. Really nice to walk around

reviews.author: digant1964
reviews.title: Must visit place in Hanoi
reviews.content: The Old Quarter (Vietnamese: Phố cổ Hà Nội) is the name commonly given to the historical civic urban core of Hanoi, located outside the Imperial Citadel of Thăng Long. This quarter used to be the residential, manufacturing and commercial center, where each street was specialized in one specific type of manufacturing or commerce.Another common name referring to approximately the same area is the 36 streets (Vietnamese: Hà Nội 36 phố phường), after the 36 streets or guilds that used to make up the urban area of the city.

reviews.author: Megan S
reviews.title: Nice atmostphere
reviews.content: Right out of our hotel. Great to walk around the old quarter and the lake. Highly recommend Hanoi street food

reviews.author: Compudex

reviews.author: andy6999
reviews.title: Beautiful to walk around
reviews.content: The Old Quarter is busy and quaint with lots of shops and eateries. It is a great place to walk around with a lot of character and beautiful buildingsNight market is great for eating and shopping

reviews.author: Travelove58
reviews.title: Excellent, convenient & central location: lots of hotels, shops, food, etc
reviews.content: This is an excellent place to stay. Extremely convenient & central - with lots of hotels, shops, cafes, local food, etc, etc.However this being a busy city area ( just like Ho Chi Minh City - HCM ), its a lively place, noisy, with lots of motorbikes. But then you can choose a hotel in one of the quieter streets , like us.We were told that there is 1 motorbike  for every 2 locals ( ratio). This is the cheapest form of transportation for locals. Public transport is non-existent Definitely we would stay at Old Quarters again in next visit.Tip: How to cross the roads safely. We had scary shock trying to cross the roads in HCM City in our first visit to Vietnam. Motorbike criss-crossing each other non stop, weaving in & out around us, & they do not heed traffic lights, constant horning,etc. Now in Hanoi, we learned the correct & safe way to do it. You can wait the whole day & still won't cross road if you expect the Motorbike/cars to stop for u. Just move ahead very slowly, look out for the bikes/cars. Stop if needed. Wave to them to stop. Often they will stop, & u move on again. We had no problem this time crossing roads in Hanoi this way.Warning: Never run across roads nor walk then retreat backwards, as these actions confuses the riders. And highly likely this action will cause an accident.1

reviews.author: Tae Wanderer

reviews.author: Marcus K

Most of the Famous Hanoi local foods are here. Eat till you drop and you are almost eaten most of the Hanoi local food here.
