reviews.content: Just in case you'd love to get some expats into the life of yours here is the house of yours. Yes on weekends a few Vietnamese can be found here to go walking and exercise but usually its full of countless expats. The water isn't actually neat and so even though you may see several Vietnam folks swimming I am going to have a pass on it. It is excellent in the views of its as well as has a few of decent restaurants nearby.

reviews.author: JnVSydney
reviews.title: Largest lake in Hanoi
reviews.content: However not the prettiest, for us that title goes to Hoan kiem Lake (see review), west lake is huge about 17k’s of shore line. The attraction for us was visiting Quan Thanh Temple and Tran Quoc Pagoda. The pagoda in quite beautiful with the lake as a back drop. note: There are a few opportunists vendors walking around selling all kinds of things, and can get pushy, especially, the fruit yoke/shoulder pole carriers, some of the tactics to get you to buy are on the verge of a scam.

reviews.author: Panamajoe2017
reviews.title: Dead fish
reviews.content: If you walk around the larger section of the lake, you will see lots of fish, unfortunately all floating upside down on the surface. This lake is polluted and you can give it a big miss.  Disgusting.

reviews.author: borhancikgu
reviews.title: Flower garden
reviews.content: Amid the crazy traffic and the pollution, I visited west lake to see the flower garden. Was amazed at the variety of flowers blooming here. Had visited Miracle garden in Dubai but here the flowers are of different varieties and also the entrance much cheaper. Agai you have plenty of space among the flowers to take selfie. You can also hire Vietnamese dress at the entrance to take selfies among the flowers. It is worth your money and time to explore and be with nature. Plenty of fluttering butterflies.

reviews.author: _cmonzella
reviews.title: A Must-See in Hanoi
reviews.content: This is the lake where North Vietnamese citizens pulled John McCain out of the water after his plane crashed while on a bombing mission in 1967. We had hired a local guide who explained the nearby sculpture marking that event and also took us to the prison where McCain was held for six years, called by his fellow-captives as the Hanoi Hilton.

reviews.author: Vivien
reviews.title: Nothing much
reviews.content: There's nothing much to see actually in the area, and its practically just a gigantic lake in the middle of Hanoi haha~

reviews.author: Robtane
reviews.title: I love wandering around the lake
reviews.content: I great way to start the day is a wander around the lake. Hanoi is such a bustling city and it is great watching everyone setting up for the day. At night the lake is beautiful as it reflects lights right around the city and draws locals and tourists alike. It is a must photo night destination

reviews.author: Peter s
reviews.title: Damp, smelly and very shabby. Mosquitoes bad too.
reviews.content: To be avoided at all costs. And it's not within walking distance of the main sights in Hanoi.We checked out and went elsewhere. This is a very poor Intercontinental. I am surprised it's part of the brand.On the plus side: the staff are excellent. But don't stay here.

reviews.author: Avinash Chandra A
reviews.title: Biggest lake of Hanoi, picturesque with hotels, parks, pagoda
reviews.content: West lake is the largest lake of Hanoi with several entertainment opportunities, parks, hotels and of court the oldest pagoda Tran Quoc Pagoda in the middle. The lake itself was carved out from the Red River. We could not spend much time, being there as a member of group tour but one must plan to spend at least two hours here.

reviews.author: gordonj258
reviews.title: Nothing special
reviews.content: The largest lake in Hanoi.There are many attractions in the immediate area and also some fine looking properties. There are also restaurants and bars in certain areas.Not worth going out of your way to see it.

reviews.author: puchka
reviews.title: Huge lake
reviews.content: This lake is the largest lake in Hanoi. On it's bank are important hotels and offices.  On an island stands the famous Tran Quoc Pagoda, the oldest Buddhist Pagoda I Hanou. There are water sports activities around the lake shores.  A must place on the tourist sight seeing itinerary.

reviews.author: T Liang
reviews.title: Scams around west lake
reviews.content: This is the only area I experienced serious scam / issues while in Hanoi. Could be bad luck, but it does leave a bad taste.First, a woman talking about feeding her baby insisted on selling me postcards. I chose to buy them for $20k VND, and immediately she put her hand into my wallet and tried to pull a 200k bill instead of 20k. When I caught her, then she tried to take the US$20 bill instead of US$1. I had to slap her hands away to protect my wallet. I ended up paying US$1 but felt a bit shaken up.While walking along the west lake, some of the women tried to block me and other tourists with their loads and insisted that we had to buy the fruits / goods. While I get hassled to purchase in old quarter, it was at least respectful and does not try to hold you hostage.

reviews.author: Heng How N
reviews.title: Drizzling walk
reviews.content: It is the biggest fteshwater lake in Hanoi situated in Tay Ho District and Ba Dinh District. It is a place for many recreation, restaurants, cafes, hotels and villas. One of the oldest temple is located there - Quan Thanh Temple or stabilise nation temple.Besides it is Truc Bach Lake and divided by Thanh Nien Road.

reviews.author: jason neuman
reviews.title: Good place to relax
reviews.content: This lake is among the most prominent lakes in this community. The peaceful, air that is fresh and also romantic! Around these, a little pagoda is quite beautiful. The majority of the international hotels located near the lake. We spent forty minutes a journey around it. In case you thirsty or hungry, you are able to get everything you would like close by there with many little restaurants and some food moving shop over the sidewalk. The north and east sides of the lake are virtually completely costly western food. We actually loved it!

reviews.author: Ditaka V
reviews.title: A quiet Hanoi
reviews.content: If the noise of the car and motorbike is too much for you, try walking along the west lake to enjoy the atmosphere and quietness. Take you time and enjoy people and atmosphere. I would count this as one of the best way to enjoy Hanoi.

reviews.author: Sandra H
reviews.title: West Lake to begin a journey!
reviews.content: Not the rasping comments that my West Lake is riding around the lake. With many cyclists around the lake, it is not too strange to write this article but for me, the first bike to train for the Trans-Vietnam route was different.

reviews.author: Basia H
reviews.title: Pretty only in photos
reviews.content: The lake indeed looks great in photos. The other side of the lake, from wherever you stand, will probably look really good too (especially behind the haze of pollution that gives it a nice watercolour painting effect). Sadly, the air is most definitely not fresh and the lake, especially by the bank, looks like a boiling pot of mud. It also smells like sewage. We wanted to get a pedalo to hide away from the city for a moment, but figured it wouldn’t be a nice experience. The bit of neighbourhood that we visited close to the lake also wasn’t very inviting. There were a lot of small establishments to hang out and have a drink at, but I can’t imagine sitting there and inhaling the stench. I feel bad for saying this, but I feel like the vast majority of reviews here are very unrealistic.

reviews.author: Becky & James
reviews.title: Fresh air walk
reviews.content: Just beautiful and a breathe of fresh air in Hanoi. Get your best food forward and take an afternoon to enjoy the skyline against the many lakes in this area. Lots of little city living curiosities on the way.

reviews.author: Michelle M
reviews.title: ĐEP
reviews.content: A beautiful lake and no matter where you decide to take your morning coffee or afternoon beer, you cant really go wrong. There are so many nice spots to sit by the lake and enjoy the day.

reviews.author: mễ t
reviews.title: nice view
reviews.content: i have been here with my girlfriend.It's nice and peaceful. The lake is very wide. Having many benches to sit. in there having a temple. It is also nice.

reviews.author: RayICue
reviews.title: A Cultural Walk
reviews.content: The lake was not pretty and more of an obstacle as I see it.  But, it a definite part of day to day life here.  The pagoda is peaceful;  but with the pollution and trash everywhere; it screams to be cleaned up.  No respect by a lot of people, a very sad fact. But still a worthy place to walk and look.

reviews.author: nellielim
reviews.title: Largest lake
reviews.content: This is the largest lake located in the centre of Ha Noi. A popular area, it is surrounded by hotels, restaurants, bars and parks.

reviews.author: KP Wong-Sg
reviews.title: serene but hard to get transport back
reviews.content: not much to look at. just walking distance from HCM masoleum. shady walk. a couple of cafes that overlook the 2 lakes including a refurbished boat which is a cafe. crossover to visit this ancient temple with intricate carvings

reviews.author: Nathaniel
reviews.title: Enjoyable
reviews.content: The lake itself here's extremely interesting. In stating that, we enjoyed walking around and seeing all of the activity around it. The walk around the Lake is very good, you are able to visit Fannys and also have an ice cream, you will find cafe's and even locations to enjoy considered a cold beverage. The existing quarter in addition runs off of West Lake so that you are able to have a stroll through there as well. Worth the walk, lots to discover. It was an unusual sight for us to see a lot of folks doing their personal workouts in such a crowded public space. Around the lake, you are going to find a broad range of shops and restaurants to select from the place you are able to purchase or even eat almost anything!

reviews.author: Andres R
reviews.title: Biggest Lake in Hanoi
reviews.content: The West Lake is the biggest lake in Hanoi. Is really big and wonderful , one of the best places in the town. Around the lake you can find amazings bars and restaurants to hang out. Another place to go if you are in Hanoi

reviews.author: KellyS3210
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.content: A very large in Hanoi - 17km circumference so too big to walk around. The sides are littered with rubbish and dead fish floating on the surface. The water absolutely stinks in summer, so much so I had to hold my nose going around the lake! Nothing to see particularly and further round (past the pagoda) there are no shops just apartments. Not worth walking any further beyond the pagoda.

reviews.author: Antoinettebutterfly
reviews.title: Perfect place to stay in Hanoi
reviews.content: It was suggested by a local to stay in this area. Firstly, I loved getting up very early and being out with the locals as everyone was so active; running bike riding and exercising in some capacity. It was also close to get to the Old Quarter by Grab motorbike. There are also a lot of coffee shops, restaurants and bars to choose from.

reviews.author: scubacol11
reviews.title: Big lake in the city
reviews.content: This lake is very big,too big to walk all the way round but you don"t need to,I went there to see the Tran Quoc pagoda in the buddhist temple on a small island in the lake,when I went there were many locals fishing in the lake catching plenty of fish,there is quite a lot of litter in the water that spoils it a bit,it is said to be a good place to see the sunset in the city but I went in the morning so missed it,Worth a look.

reviews.author: Teddy Duong
reviews.title: Biggest lake in Ha Noi
reviews.content: This lake is a biggest lake in Hanoi city as a part of red river before, so this lake also can be one of the reason why we call this city is Ha noi ( river inside).From Ho Chi Minh mausoleum, it's very easy to go to west lake especially the street name Thanh Nien - the border between Truc Bach Lake and West lake also known as a best place to see the sun set in Ha Noi. Fresh air from the lake was blow all the stressful, bad emotions in my mind... Tran Quoc Pagoda and Quan Thanh temple is nearby so this location is a good place to start a trip to the ha noi history...Love to be here....

reviews.author: katebui_97
reviews.title: Best sunset view in Hanoi
reviews.content: I live in Hanoi yet always feel bored of the busy lifestyle here. The way to release all the stress and enjoy my own space, for me, is to take a ride around West Lake. It's really peaceful. Stop by a small pier to enjoy the fresh air and watch the sun going down. The sky looks extraordinarily gorgeous then.

reviews.author: ZhongguoKM
reviews.title: Pretty at sundown
reviews.content: Pretty in the evening. Breeze is cool coming off the water. Small restaurants along the shore. Relaxing place. Not sure if it is really a destination in itself. But stop by if you are in the area for something else.

reviews.author: Iryna
reviews.title: Spoilt by floating rubbish
reviews.content: We walked the half kilometre North from the Presidential Palace. Friendly guards at the gate gave us simple directions. Arrived to the sight of more trash floating around this huge lake. The is a large pagoda to see that is a popular place for weddings. Easy to get a bus or taxi back to town. We took the bus as one gets a better view of street life and not so rushed. It takes you back (as most buses seem to do) to the main terminal at the North end of the long market street. Just seventy cents for the bus ride. Happy again from past experience to bring my sport shoes and woollen socks to do all the many kilometres of street walking

reviews.author: ThomasPham_V
reviews.title: good place for relax
reviews.content: Good place for relax in hot as hell of HanoiAlso doing exercise in here with running or going bicycle

reviews.author: Chloe
reviews.title: relax here
reviews.content: West Lake is the biggest Lake in Hanoi. We offen go there to do exercise and eat Pho Cuon together in the weekend.

reviews.author: Rachel P
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: A beautiful lake on the outskirts of the city with scenic views of the city.  My husband and son enjoyed going on the swan peddaloes.

reviews.author: Muguncjb
reviews.title: beautiful lake
reviews.content: This one is a beautiful lake in Hanoi. When I visited the West lake area it started drizzling. Reached the lake mainly to visit Chua Tran Quoc, a Buddhist temple, which is situated on the West lake. The lake itself is beautiful and added with lite drizzling made it wonderful to watch the surrounding. The West lake can be visited to visit temples viz Chua Tran Quoc -Buddhist temple and Quan Thanh Temple and a botanical garden.

reviews.author: Kevin T
reviews.title: A local favourite
reviews.content: We had a walk around after visiting the pagoda. There is a nice breeze off the water and a favourite resting place for many of the locals. It’s a bit dirty at the waters edge but where isn’t nowadays. Enjoy.....

reviews.author: roymV3677KA
reviews.title: A serene Experience
reviews.content: Stayed in a King Bed Overwater Panoramic View which offers stunning an unrestricted views of the West Lake. The lounge access sorts your evening drinks in a comfy lounge so do avail of that. Staff is extremely friendly. The hotel is far from the old quarter and the french quarter and offers another angle to your stay in Hanoi. I would say that this is a better part of town to be in. Do a few days here and then move to the french quarter.The bun cha is their restaurant is really nice as well.

reviews.author: 888eelc
reviews.title: Nice Lake with a Pagoda
reviews.content: We walked around the lake and stopped over at the Pagoda next to the lake.  Took some good pictures.  There are many lakes in Hanoi, and West Lake is one of the bigger ones.

reviews.author: yansanhon
reviews.title: Good
reviews.content: It is an ideal place to enjoy the leisure time. The views are nice with a lot of coffee shops around. Walking  this place is interesting. Nice!

reviews.author: blackeaglejim
reviews.title: riding around West Lake
reviews.content: Originally a lagoon that was separated fro the Red River by landfills and embankments in the 11th century, West Lake is the largest body of water in Hanoi.  A causeway alongside the eastern shore, built in the 17th century, created Trúc Bạch, the small fishing lake on the other side.  In the past, the lake was a popular site for royal pleasure cruises, palaces and temples.  Today the whole area is built up, but it’s worth a ride around the lake by bicycle or motorbike, 13 kilometers circumference, for the quiet getaway spots and interesting temples.       Beginning at the bottom of Thanh Niên Street, the Quan Thánh Temple is on the right, originally built 11th century, dedicated to the Guardian God of the North Trân Vp and worth a look inside for the big, black 17th century bronze statue of the god.  Further up offshore on the left is the Trấn Quốc Pagoda, Hanoi’s oldest, moved here early 17th century from its original 6th century location downriver.  A little further on, turn left along the lake and pass by Yên Phụ Temple and then several nightclubs, restaurants and bars, with the option of lakeside tables.  Further on is Kim Liên Temple, a fine classic Vietnamese building.  Further on, turning left on the Tây Hồ Peninsula theWest Lake Palace is at the end, dedicated to  Liễu Hạnh, the chief deity in the Holy Mothers pantheon.       Rounding the northern end you pass by the big amusement park as you turn down Lạc Long Quan Road along the lake’s western shore.  There a few quiet temple compounds along the way, each different in architecture and layout from the others.  At the south end you turn left and follow the shoreline Nguyễn Đình Thi Road back to Quan Thánh Temple.  There are other temples, broad views of the lake and many options to eat along this route.

reviews.author: Tikhon S
reviews.title: My favorite place in the city
reviews.content: It is simply a great place to spend time at. There are plenty of coffee shops with very nice views, such as La Cotta. If you are not up to coffee hopping, then you can bring your date there also and sit on a bench. Many people come there to exercise, so did I. One day I decided to go around the lake and it took me around 5 hours to do so (including 1 hour break). My step counter showed the distance of 18km; I was exhausted but content. Highly recommend to visit the place for a beautiful sunset. Enjoy!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Q
reviews.title: Large lake on the outskirts of Hanoi
reviews.content: West Lake is a large lake just outside the city. It is possible to walk all around the lake, the distance being I believe 17 kilometers. The problem with this, as everywhere in Hanoi, is that the pavements are crammed with motor bikes and 4 by 4's so much of the time one has to risk ones life by walking in the road. The pavements are also quite dangerous with broken paving and sudden large lumps of concrete. But if one is brave enough to tackle it, the walk is quite pleasant and there are even seats in places. The lake is polluted, although efforts are made to clean it. It is best viewed at night when all the lights are reflected in the water.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.title: Walked around the southern part of the lake today!
reviews.content: Beautiful day to see the lake. Today the weather was perfect, skies were blue, and I got to see a portion of the southern part of the lake. This lake is the largest fresh water lake in Hanoi so you don't just walk around it. The walking trails are really nice and its a nice getaway from the old quarter and shopping and even Hoan Kiem Lake. Very different and beautiful.

reviews.author: Zonko
reviews.title: Beware of taxis charging inflated prices.
reviews.content: Spent a pleasant hour or so in this area of Hanoi.However, if taking a taxi from this area, check with the cost to your destination with driver. We experienced drivers wanting to charge extortionate fares.Always watch the meter and terminate the journey if the cost escalates rapidly.

reviews.author: smallhausen1
reviews.title: Heaven for fishermen
reviews.content: Probably it is a transport challange to have several lakes - like Hanoi has. West like is largest and it's used for sports and fishing. Either if you would like not to visit it,  you will have to find a way around.

reviews.author: Nga N
reviews.title: Great atmosphere
reviews.content: Come to Hanoi to visit the lake, cool cool space, very comfortable, but the water does not seem very clean.

reviews.author: aukocer
reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.content: We liked this area so much. We highly recomended to drink a coffe at Highland Cafe around the lake. The some ancient temples are also very near to this area.

reviews.author: hilarymunro
reviews.title: Borrow a bicycle and go round this lake
reviews.content: One of the highlights of Hanoi was a bike trip round the lake. There are numerous good coffee shops there and a large flower market. You'll need to take a small detour to get to this. Get a map on your phone to guide you.

reviews.author: santo t
reviews.title: Big lake ... nice lake
reviews.content: This West Lake is much larger than the more famous Hoan Kiem Lake at the city centre, however Hoan Kiem Lake has more publications and attentions than this West Lake. Anyway. the location is slightly away from the city centre, more than 3 km from the Old Quarter, so less busy and crowded tourist scenes like the city centre. Nice large lake using more by locals to do anything they like, walking, running, exercising, or just sitting and watching the sunrise or sunset at the perimeter of the lake. Not too much to see.

reviews.author: ELLlady
reviews.title: took an electric car around the lake
reviews.content: It was a  perfect way to see the lake and the area around Westlake. Later I was able to walk around having used the electric car as a good introduction to area.

reviews.author: Providence_RITom
reviews.title: Pretty lake, but not much to see
reviews.content: I walked here from my hotel and walked partially around the lake one evening. Not really much to see. The other side of the lake has a memorial to Sen. John McCain, which I saw earlier in the day and which is fairly interesting.

reviews.author: BellasWings
reviews.title: Pee lake
reviews.content: Please note that this is infamously called pee lake.Guess why... Vietnamese are not known for their great toilet manners... anywhere anytime is pretty much the way and open Waters are basically an Invitation for this! I wouldnt stay anywhere near it and the smell is also pretty stenchy... Great fact is: Vietnamese also fish in this lake. So lets just call them peefish. Peefish anyone?

reviews.author: Agisagis
reviews.title: Big lake
reviews.content: West lake is a big lake in Hanoi. One of the locals told me that it is about 17 to 18km long walk around it.It has walking paths along a big section of the lake. The footpaths are in fair conditions although one has to look out for trees jutted out in the middle of the foot path.The lake area near to Sheraton and Intercontinental hotels are better developed and nicer to have a walk. One could walk quite a few kilometres following the lake from the hotel. Just wish the lake area could be better developed  and kept clean then it would be a real asset to Hanoi.

reviews.author: yonght
reviews.title: Take A Electric Buggy Around The Lake
reviews.content: We took an electric buggy to tour around the lake which took about an hour to go around the lake. Along the route, you can see Pagoda temple, flowers peddlers, Vietnamese people eating along the side walk, quaint little cafe and shops. Nothing spectacular but it will give you a general insight of the different places around the lake especially if you stayed near the Westlake.

reviews.author: boin2017
reviews.title: pretty
reviews.content: great to walk around the lake if you have time to enjoy all the sites and culture. We went early morning so it was very quiet

reviews.author: John L
reviews.title: Just another dirty water body in Hanoi
reviews.content: You can walk around the lake. Depending on your speed, it takes anywhere from 1 hour to 2 hours. You can see much of Hanoi's life from this walk. It range from quiet alley to upper busy highway, from 5* hotel to garbage dump. You name it, it has it.

reviews.author: Mehul Kirit Shah
reviews.title: Ho Tay
reviews.content: It is the biggest freshwater lake of northwest centre of Hanoi. With a shore length of 17 kilometres and about 5 square kilometres in area, this is the largest lake of the capital, and a popular place for recreation with many surrounding gardens, hotels, and villas. A small part of it is divided by Thanh Nien Road to form Truc Bach Lake.

reviews.author: theunseencolors
reviews.title: Not much to see, not as special as Hoan Kiem
reviews.content: It's a decent place for a walk/bicycle ride, alright, but only travelers really committed to seeing slice-of-life scenes in Hanoi will get something out of it. I'm certainly not recommending avoiding it, I enjoyed my time here and walked around for about 2 hours, enjoying little random bits here and there, but I think I'm objective enough to say that it's not exciting in any way, and not suited for many travelers as a destination unless you're spoiled for time.

reviews.author: vincentlO741VW
reviews.title: Just a normal lake
reviews.content: Hanoi as whole is just an undeveloped city wake lake is part of the lake mark not much expectation can generate from this spot.

reviews.author: doctrav
reviews.title: A quiet gem in Hanoi
reviews.content: Was staying in the busy and noisy Old Quarter before visiting the West Lake. Immediately sensed the huge difference in terms of space and scenery. The huge expanse of the lake, the cool Breeze, quietness close to nature, make this location a wonderful break. Hotels in the area are mainly 4-5 stars international chains with predictable professional service.

reviews.author: On the road
reviews.title: the most dirty lake in Hanoi
reviews.content: 25 years ago, romantic, nice view, relaxing, summer sunset with purple like, two, three rainbown after summer rain, nice fresh wins for hot summerdays.Now and then, strong smell wins blow up 24 hour, dead dogs, animal floating instead of Kayak boat, the lake be come 50% smaller. Drug, poscard, loto saler, cars and motobike sound make you do not feel anything romantic or relaxing when sit in hier.Disapoited !

reviews.author: Ernest W
reviews.title: Smoggy
reviews.content: The first impression you get when you arrive on the shores of the West Lake is that it is extremely smoggy. You really can't see a thing. It is entirely surrounded by buildings, but half of them are not really that visible because of the smog. It is also muggy. If you've ever been to the West Lake in Hangzhou, China, you'll see that this one is pretty similar. But it has less attractions in that there's only one pagoda (Chua Tran Quoc). Also, Hanoi's West Lake is far smaller than Hangzhou's, making it seem more cramped and urbanized. At least if you're in the middle of Hangzhou's West Lake, depending on where you are, you may need binoculars to see the buildings in the distance and realize that you're still in the middle of a highly urbanized area. With Hanoi's West Lake, there's never any doubt about that. There are benches situated around the lake for one to sit on and just relax. But, like many other places in Hanoi, the streets are filled with cars and motorbikes, and the constant honking will give you a massive headache before you've had time to settle down and enter a state of zen. Still, I have fond memories of the ice cream kiosk just across the street from Chua Tran Quoc. A very refreshing coconut cream ice cream cone can be had for only 7000.  After walking back toward the old quarter with it, I got so enamored I turned around and got another one!

reviews.author: ReneMacQ
reviews.title: Massive Lake
reviews.content: Our hotel was on the shore of Westlake. We used the opportunity to over 2 days to explore the area. Walking from the hotel to Ho Chi Min Masoleum took us along a busy promenade with more tourist attractions along the way. We took a taxi back, and because of roadworks he had to return along the opposite bank - it makes you realise how big Hanoi is and how much there is to see and experience. The next day we walked in the opposite direction and discovered many lovely little restaurants and bars along the shore. Also a lot of great apartments.

reviews.author: Rosina M
reviews.title: amzing
reviews.content: We were on a motor bike tour that took us around this lake. Really beautiful. Not much traffic around. You could see the wealthy side of Ha Noi around this lake. Beautiful homes and Hotels. Not manu people around and away from the hustle and bustle of the main centre of town. We were taken to see a beautiful pagoda and temple which we paid homage to it by placing food and pretend money, said a prayer and then burnt the offerings of money. The tour guides that we were with were wonderful in explaining the history of the temple and surrounding area's....

reviews.author: Germ54
reviews.title: Tay Ho and West Lake area Great to visit
reviews.content: You will experience many international and western style restaurants and hotels in this area. Many prices equal to prices in the USA

reviews.author: Alex B
reviews.title: Pleasant Walk Around the Lake
reviews.content: West Lake is the largest lake in Hanoi, about 30 minutes walk from the old quarter.  It's a long walk to go around the lake but it is a pleasant walk, not so crowded (midweek when I went there).  There's pagoda (forgot the name) which closes at 1130 am.  The walk from the old quartier to the West Lake passes through the more genteel, expensive neighborhood of Hanoi.  In all in all a very worthy effort on my part.  On the return I just a taxi back to my hotel which cost me 35,000 VND.

reviews.author: sakazaan
reviews.title: A pleasant escape from the chaos
reviews.content: What a beautiful, calm part of Hanoi. I went specifically to look for homeware goods at YNOT. In the process, I discovered Pingpong with some unique furniture pieces and Oriberry coffee shop with a good selection of ceramic cups and plates. My highlight was the discovery of a gorgeous cafe between YNOT and Pingpong. It is a place with delicious healthy food, coffee roasted on site and a lovely ambience with seating in the garden or in the three storey building.

reviews.author: Kevin V
reviews.title: Chilling around
reviews.content: Take your bicycle and cruise around the West Lake. There are a lot of benches to take a seat and some pictures.

reviews.author: rgeffken
reviews.title: A must see if only for the John McCain monument
reviews.content: For a war veteran like myself who could not have visited Ha Noi except under the worst of circumstance in 1970, this placid lake where John McCain landed must be seen

reviews.author: DCTravelers69
reviews.title: Eh
reviews.content: We walked by here on the way to the botanical gardens.  It's fine, but i would never go out of my way to see it--

reviews.author: Geoff G
reviews.title: Good to cycle round
reviews.content: Did a loop of the lake on push bikes as part of our Intrepid tour.  Lots of things to see, some quiet sections but also plenty of traffic to contend with.

reviews.author: Rihonann
reviews.title: Peaceful place in Hanoi
reviews.content: This lake was very peaceful. It helped me to escape the hustle and bustle of the busy city. Felt so relaxed when walking around this lake.

reviews.author: hungodd94
reviews.title: Nowhere give me calm like West Lake
reviews.content: This is the only place in Hanoi that still give me calm everytime i get by. the water, the breeze, the smells of flowers. A remote place among one of the most busiest city in Vietnam

reviews.author: Anil L
reviews.title: Biggest Lake in Hanoi
reviews.content: A good place for morning jog and evening walks. Also, a nice spot to polish your photography skills.

reviews.author: jessmoss871
reviews.title: Calm
reviews.content: I wanted to get away from the hustle and bustle of the old quarter in Hanoi and West Lake was the perfect escape.

reviews.author: DAVID L
reviews.title: The Big Lake ...
reviews.content: Another of the picturesque lakes of Hanoi, this being the largest one. Pretty greenery all around and restaurants and concessions along the periphery. Lots of young grads out getting photos adds to it all.

reviews.author: Parimal M
reviews.title: Nice lake and lot of people in the evening
reviews.content: A lot of activity with street shops and street food in the evening. Part of the street around the lake is closed to traffic in the evening

reviews.author: Ada E
reviews.title: It was a Lake, bit grubby.. but interesting Pagoda situated on the banks worth a visit.
reviews.content: Didn't think much of the folk selling baby turtles so that you could throw them back into the lake..

reviews.author: Jen78703
reviews.title: Nice place to walk around
reviews.content: This lake is pretty big. I really enjoyed walking around and seeing the side walk vendors as well as just getting out from the craziness of old town. It's quiet and not busy at all

reviews.author: Coryy20
reviews.title: Most besutiful
reviews.content: West lake is in the heart of Hanoi and is the biggest lakes in Hanoi. Lots of restaurants around  and shopping.Walking around or jogging the scene is just breathtakingly beautiful and peaceful. Find a beench sit and just enjoy the scenery.

reviews.author: Xerxes R
reviews.title: Beautiful walk around the lake
reviews.content: We are here now and although the weather is a damper we  enjoyed our walk here. We crossed the highland coffee and the pagoda also walked past the John Mc Cain memorial and liked that as well. Enjoy your walk here.

reviews.author: Mandinka_11
reviews.title: West Lake
reviews.content: we decided to walk round the lake as we couldn’t check into our hotel, arrived early from train station at 5:45 . What a walk this was, 11 miles ! We stopped at a couple of bar/restaurants on the way round. It is worth having a stroll around part of the lake, there isn’t  a lot to see otherwise than the lake, unless you walked into the built up areas.We were fortunate that it was a lovely warm/sunny day.Enjoy, note good walking shoes are a must, oh and don’t forget umbrellas for any showers.

reviews.author: Peter F
reviews.title: Nice walk
reviews.content: A pleasant walk around lake. Some good photo opportunities. Lots of cafes etc around lake in nearby streets. The restaurant on lake is fantastic. Excellent food and service, looks pricey but is quite reasonable.

reviews.author: Mktpro99
reviews.title: Beautiful lake
reviews.content: Lots of restaurants and bars in this area. Nice. Ideal for sunsets across lake. Very romantic. Watch traffic crossing street.

reviews.author: heinzhuynh
reviews.title: Hanoi biggest lake
reviews.content: I came to visit Tran Quoc pagoda and it situated right the west lake. Nice and cool place for a couples shot of pictures

reviews.author: Nicki P
reviews.title: Very pretty
reviews.content: A nice breath of fresh air in a busy city. Highlands Coffee was a good place to rest. Good place to walk.

reviews.author: DeltaWhiskey
reviews.title: The Famous John McCain Lake
reviews.content: Hanoi is a city of lakes, this one being perhaps its largest with restaurant boats and lined by residences & some hotels. Usually hot-humid-windy during the late Spring, Summer, & early Fall.

reviews.author: Enkidu-backpacker
reviews.title: Huge, beautiful from far/Dirty from near
reviews.content: its a huge lake located north of hanoi. the location is where expats chose to live and is quite beautiful to sit and have a tea, beer or coconut juice while looking at the lake but the water is really dirty and u could find anything possible floating on water such as dead fish.

reviews.author: VikingLogarta
reviews.title: Smoker-friendly
reviews.content: I am always thankful for smoker friendly restaurants and bars, though I've been trying to quit for some time. The food was good and the service was acceptable.

reviews.author: vampslayer01
reviews.title: Great Area
reviews.content: Nice area and really great to walk around, there is lots going on around from some temples to locals swimming and different parts of the city to see

reviews.author: Cyprusclaret
reviews.title: Known as west lake byvthe ex pats
reviews.content: This is the expat area of hanoi, you will find many bars and restaurants here with a varied mix of cuisines.There is an expat shop where British an get a few comforts of home ie. Tea bags, marmite etc but at a big premium. It's situated around a lake so mosquito bites are part of the course.A nice area non the less and not far by cab you the old town

reviews.author: karlo a
reviews.title: Nice place for foreigners to chill
reviews.content: The are is teeming with western themed restaurants, take advantage also of visiting Trấn Quốc Pagoda if your in the area. Admission is free, but be sure to wear appropriate clothes as it is an active shrine.

reviews.author: ColonelBangkok
reviews.title: Great Collection of Restaurants
reviews.content: I enjoy staying near Westlake and take advantage of the many VN and Western restaurants that surround the lake, many with alfresco dining. The area is easy to find and makes for a pleasant visit.

reviews.author: Nunngo
reviews.title: Bike riding around the West Lake
reviews.content: Put your life into the hands of the local Hanoi drivers and get on a bike for a ride around this lake.  We hired bikes and with a local friend who knew the safest way and 'technique' to get around the lake on a bike, off we went to experience bike riding in the crazy traffic of Hanoi.  It was an amazing experience and believe it or not, quite safe.  I think the local drivers allow for the bike riders and they do not display the same impatience and 'road rage' as drivers in western countries.  The day (2 October 2016) we rode around West Lake was an interesting one. It was late afternoon and I could see what looked like floating dead fish.  The weather was hot, as usual for Hanoi, and as we rode around towards where the five star hotels are situated on the lake there were literally thousands and thousands of dead fish on the lake.  It was an incredible sight, in that it was so unusual and bizarre.  Our Hanoi friend explained that this is something that happens occasionally in the lake because of the hot water temperatures and the lack of oxygen in the water which is over populated by the fish.  Needless to say what the smell was like.  Interesting!The ride around the lake was a great way to see many local sights, it is a very beautiful lake highly populated with restaurants, bars, cafes, temples, high rise apartments and high end accommodation.

reviews.author: SlowlyinAsia
reviews.title: Nice to Have a Cool Breeze
reviews.content: Took an off the cuff motorbike tour ( I was not the driver ) of HaNoi and ended up at West Lake at one point.at the Tran Quoc Pagoda. Unfortunately, the Pagoda was closed on that day but I still enjoyed mingling with the locals as the milled around, watching the fisherman. One gentleman caught a whopper carp, must have been around five kilos and quickly sold it to someone waiting for such a moment. I had a great time just hanging out.

reviews.author: jenabaintheworld
reviews.title: Beautiful esp early or at sunset
reviews.content: We live along west lake so we are spoiled with the  beautiful views.   The lake is esp nice for walking or biking early morning or around sunset.  It's 17km around or you could walk certain sections that are more picturesque.   Just 10 min taxi from old quarter.

reviews.author: minimize940314
reviews.title: Bigger than Hoan Kiem
reviews.content: West lake is way bigger than Hoan Kiem. You will see local people fishing and jogging. The temple at the shore of the lake is wonderful.

reviews.author: Trang B
reviews.title: Other image of Hanoi
reviews.content: Large, much more beautiful if you visit in summer with lotus flowers . There are lots of restaurants and shop around for you to choose( Vietnamese and European). There are lots of expats stay in this area as more quite than in the centre, then you can easily find out that so many foreigners around.

reviews.author: rsm920
reviews.title: Hire a bike
reviews.content: This was one of my highlights of Hanoi - hire a bike and cycle around the lake.  Takes a couple of hours, but is such a peaceful experience, even with the mopeds weaving around you (it never felt unsafe!).  Such a contrast to the the hustle and bustle of the Old Quarter - a must!

reviews.author: electrixbubble
reviews.title: Biggest Lake in Hanoi
reviews.content: You might know that Hanoi is a city of lakes. This is the largest one. During the hot summer in August, you might need to visit here because the place offers you chill-axing vibe. 360 degree views are also a plus. A friend took me there riding around the lake, it was the best feeling after being in the chaotic city. The activity here you can do is riding a swan boat. I did not try and clueless how much they would charge.

reviews.author: PeterM-Sin
reviews.title: Dirty lake with dead fish inside
reviews.content: Nothing special to see. Just a dirty lake where we saw a lot of dead fishes floating on the surface. Not worse the trip outside the lovely old and french quarter area in Hanoi

reviews.author: Katie Henry
reviews.title: Regarding bike tours
reviews.content: The lake is a lovely location and around are lots of interesting sites that are definitely worth visiting. However for those thinking of doing the bike routes around it, be mindful that it is not as easy as it may sound. All of the route takes place on the busy roads which made us feel a little unsettled, so it probably won't be enjoyable for anyone not confident with cycling. Also the lake is very big so it will take a while. We had to stop halfway as it was too long, and concentrating on the road meant you don't see the lake as well. Definitely go and see the lake but probably better on foot.

reviews.author: Janine F
reviews.title: Not great
reviews.content: The best part is the Pagoda, after that nothing great. Ladies selling turtles that you can release into the lake. Hoan Kiem Lake in the Old Quarter is much better.

reviews.author: PacoGlasgow
reviews.title: Stayed on West lake
reviews.content: Having stayed on the westlake at intercontinental hotel we soon realised we were a good bit away from all the tourist areas....old quarter. We decided to move in to centre of Hanoi. Not really much to do apart from walking round the lake.

reviews.author: adstone888
reviews.title: comparable to Hangzhou West Lake
reviews.content: Hanoi West Lake is as good as Hangzhou West Lake. I was quite taken with the setting of Hanoi Lakes; West and Central Lakes. I feel the I can enjoy better strolling around the lakes. Firstly, there are not as crowded as Hangzhou where people pushes each other. You can relax and enjoy the view and setting without being push on. There are plenty of eateries around the Lakes; especially good quality coffee everywhere.Lastly I feel the whole atmosphere around the lakes are excellent and a real tourist attraction. I would take my time walking and taking in all the good feeling and wash my mind clean of stress.

reviews.author: albertosR7320AZ
reviews.title: On my free time i am driving with my bike!
reviews.content: On shunning days i ride aroud the lake! It takes one hours! Is one of my wy to relax! Try to explore more about hanoi!

reviews.author: Lydia Farmer L
reviews.title: Fun!
reviews.content: While visiting our son and his girlfriend, we visited this area. We had a meal and rode around to an outdoor bar they frequent. Lots of expats and good cold beer!

reviews.author: strongdavid0184
reviews.title: BIG LAKE
reviews.content: Nice walking around west lake with walking city .There are many people but many studens play music . So you feel happy and interesting . Many bar and coffee shop are busy . the food is expensive but good .The traffic is crazy .

reviews.author: Diane D
reviews.title: Worth Cycling round
reviews.content: As part of our trip organised through Selective Asia was a 17km bike ride around West Lake.  Unfortunately this wasn't on pedestrian walkways but on fairly busy roads which was a bit hairy at times but worthwhile.  There are interesting Pagodas, gardens and you see a different side to Hanoi away from the bustle of the Old Quarter

reviews.author: Melfish13
reviews.title: Such a contrast to the centre
reviews.content: I loved West Lake and we went for two out of three days during our trip to Hanoi. We rented bikes for just 60,000 dong each and cycled round the whole things, which is beautiful and the roads are very good. There is loads to see and do as you cycle round, so I'd completely disagree with some other reviewers of the Lake. There is a water park where we spent 4 hours! There is a 50m swimming pool right next to the lake, loads of different cafes and lunch stops, pedalos and that's just on the lake shore.

reviews.author: Miller J
reviews.title: Airy and nice view
reviews.content: We had a motorbike ride going around West Lake. There is nothing too interesting to do in this site but I like the peaceful and romantic scenery of this lake, specially its fresh scenery in the morning. We also found out some stalls selling street foods nearby the lake. They are really tasty.

reviews.author: Hanoidave
reviews.title: West Lake - The Ex Pat enclave of Hanoi
reviews.content: West Lake is a large body of water to the northeast of Hanoi city.In Vietnamese it is called Ho Tay.  The area to the north of the lake is where most western restaurants, bars and hotels are located including the 5 star Sheraton and intercontinental. The lake itself is popular for fishing, boating and even rowing.The shores of the lake abound with cafes and small eating establishments.You can travel around the lakeshore by car, motorbike and bicycle. You will enjoy the cool breeze; and select a cafe with seats right by the lake for coffee, beer and snacks .Recommended by Hanoidave.

reviews.author: SEVENSEAS_Media
reviews.title: Quiet, residential
reviews.content: Don't expect too much from this. I went looking for the lotus flowers and I was clearly in the wrong spot. It's nice and a great place to stay apparently but I wouldn't go out of my way to go there

reviews.author: Michel C
reviews.title: The most impressive lake of Hanoi
reviews.content: Now surrounded by houses and condominium for rich people and expatriates, the west lake, when night arrives, is one of the spot of Hanoi preferred by lovers. Some restaurants around the lake propose good food.

reviews.author: Alireza Z
reviews.title: heart of hanoi
reviews.content: this lake is calm on 6 am poeple are excercising in around the lake . (good for photography ) they do thai chi . there are a lot of stores near the lake and you can find anythink near this place. i think near the lake is best choice for choosing hotel

reviews.author: moonlotus18
reviews.title: Two big lakes with nothing much to see
reviews.content: The west lake may be the biggest lake in the city but apart from that, there is nothing much to see. There is a walking path around it but be aware some parts of it needs maintenance (rickety or broken or uneven). There may be some vendors selling wares in the area. It gets quite hot during the day time so bring a hat/shades. The lake itself is nothing much to see, rather polluted unfortunately. Apart from that, there is the nearby pagodas to visit and the famous spot where John McCain's plane was shot down during the war. Nevertheless if you have nothing much to do, it will serve as a good stroll to take in the local scene.The best thing there was when we stumbled on the Highlands Coffee place located on a 2 storey boat nearby. Very refreshing stop - as it was air conditioned and nice restaurant inside -  in between walking around the lake.

reviews.author: Cathe G
reviews.title: Lovely scenary but not alot to do ...
reviews.content: This was a welcome break from the hustle of Hanoi old quarter, we were amidst large houses and tropical palms with a generous lack veiw and much quieter roads.This is clearly a wealthy area with lots of expats visible and trappings of wealth in the cars driven.We walked around different sides of the lake and its clear development is ongoing with luxury flats being built amongst some traditional markets.There was not alot to see however and on foot there was minimal access to a small number of  restaurants, and alot of casual cafes with warm beer and full of young foreign english teachers but in terms of things to do or see the shopping was very limited and expensive.

reviews.author: enjayaitch
reviews.title: Friday night
reviews.content: Friday night they block traffic around the lake to allow the community to do their thing. You'll be surprised at the goings on that include a variety of street musicians, community involvement in a variety games and the ubiquitous salesperson.

reviews.author: Lou N
reviews.title: Skyline view of hte business dsitrict,
reviews.content: Not a must see but the lake and view make a nice area to stroll with good places to stop for a refreshment.

reviews.author: LarryG392
reviews.title: Amazing sight
reviews.content: I was surprised to find this huge lake in the midst of Hanoi. It is surrounded by hotels. Also the Tran Quoc Pagoda was very impressive.

reviews.author: tony4307
reviews.title: Some Things to Do and See
reviews.content: Several restaurants and even a shopping mall in close proximity to where we stayed.  Nice area to take a stroll, stop in for a brewski, or whatever.

reviews.author: Barbara M
reviews.title: Rather boring residential lake,
reviews.content: particularly by comparison with Hoan Kiem.  Actually the comparison is completely unfair but, if your time is limited, rather focus on the area around Hoan Kiem.

reviews.author: Ken c
reviews.title: Not much to see here as a tourist
reviews.content: We went around the whole lake because we were interested in the Vietnamese real estate market but I wouldn't do this as a tourist and there is little to see here.

reviews.author: Toni S
reviews.title: Large lake with different areas and activities
reviews.content: This is a large lake near the center of Hanoi. Walking around it (about two hours) is a great experience of the city, because it has a little of everything: from a touristic temple/pagoda, to glitzy hotels and condos, to modest houses, cafe, restaurants, parks. Only in a small fraction there are tourist, the rest is a nice residential area for high and middle class locals.

reviews.author: Eugene C
reviews.title: One huge and dirty lake
reviews.content: beautiful part of town although seeing all the dead fish by the side of the lake wasn't a pretty sight. Loads of interesting things to do and see around here if you ever venture out of the Old Quarters. The thought of people fishing out of this lake was a little unsettling

reviews.author: thetransporter10
reviews.title: Nice Hotel
reviews.content: We stayed at the Intercontinental West Lakes. Very nice location. Only about £3 taxi ride to the Old Quarter.

reviews.author: Emma M
reviews.title: If you're staying close its worth a look
reviews.content: We weren't staying too far from here so took a stroll up for a view across the lake. There is not much here but worth it to sit in some relative peace for a while!

reviews.author: sue5290
reviews.title: Pretty, but not a big deal
reviews.content: Although this area was pretty, I don't see the big draw to it. It was just a lake and a bunch of buildings. There was a park here, but nothing special. The big draw is that this is the lake that John McCain was shot down in. Of course, my take as an American is that this was not a place to erect a monument, but I realize that it would be a different feeling on the other side of that. Still, not a place, in my opion, worth going out of your way for, unless I missed something.

reviews.author: kcw10
reviews.title: Peaceful stroll around the lake
reviews.content: This lake was a short walk from our hotel on the way to see the Tran Quoc Pagoda.  It is a very large lake, with peaceful surrounding.  Unfortunately the water is a little dirty.  Vietnamese men were fishing but leaving some dead fish on the pavement.

reviews.author: mcc42017
reviews.title: Fun Place!
reviews.content: We went there twice.  We enjoyed the Highland Coffee Shop close by and went on a Swan Boat ride twice.  It was very relaxing and got good leg exercise out of it.  Loved it!

reviews.author: Feen63
reviews.title: A great surprise
reviews.content: This lake is well worth the walk. What a contrast to the rest of Hanoi. A great treasure and a lovely walk, one one side you get a very calm, peaceful experience, while on the other it is the hustle and bustle that you become accustomed too in Hanoi. Some great views from all sides. Lots of places to just sit, soak up the town and experience all that Hanoi has to offer.

reviews.author: DRLuxury
reviews.title: Far off and polluted
reviews.content: No clue what is so chic about living in a skyscraper on a polluted lake with rusting steamboats remodelked as cafes and restsurants. A bit far off. Even far from the mausoleum. Never sunny. Very depressing :) Glad Zi don't have to visit again....

reviews.author: ailenroc13
reviews.title: Nice walk
reviews.content: We went by bus , then we walked. Not too many tousits, more local people, nice weekend atmosphere, very relaxing

reviews.author: An nguyễn
reviews.title: Sunset from the lake
reviews.content: It's nice to have a walk by the lake. We got a cyclo to take us arround the lake and visit the small temple nearby. People overhere are so warm and kind. Really love this place.

reviews.author: BSinPNS
reviews.title: It's A Lake
reviews.content: Must admit it was raining most of our time in the electric minibus going around the lake.  No narrative, just a ride around a large lake in the middle of town.

reviews.author: Brian
reviews.title: Nice one !
reviews.content: The lake is quite large with lots of restaurants and temples nearby. We also visited the Tran Quoc pagoda and had a 'young rice' icecream at a restaurant across the street.

reviews.author: Johanna d
reviews.title: Best place
reviews.content: Definitely the best place in Hanoi, I understand why the expat community of Hanoi live around this lake now

reviews.author: SimonDabbs
reviews.title: This lake creates nice urban views, but...
reviews.content: The lake must be visible from many parts of Hanoi. The only problem is, it is rather smell. We saw one or two engineering attempts to re-oxygenate the water, which may be helping.

reviews.author: vjv2007
reviews.title: More Beautiful at Night
reviews.content: We did visit the temples near West Lake during the day but the beauty was really after dark.  The buildings are beautiful lit.  The walk along the lake near the Old Quarter was not crowded and fun.

reviews.author: Garys-Tribe
reviews.title: Just A Big Lake to the North of Hanoi
reviews.content: West Lake is very big and dominates the landscape around Tay Ho, probably the largest body of water in Hanoi. There are plenty of districts surrounding the lake, the most prominent being Tay Ho to the East.To visit the lake would be to say, a needle in a haystack......well for some good views from bars, restaurants or cafes, the Tay Ho district is probably the best, or to the North of the Lake where the amusement park is situated.RecommendationTake your scooter and go around the whole lake and see yourself what it has to offer.

reviews.author: Jess
reviews.title: one of the largest lake in Hanoi
reviews.content: I stayed in the hotel next to West lake so it is conveninet to take a walk from the hotel to this site. The ice cream store just opposite the Tran Quoc pagoda is a MUST try. Local people will eat the ice cream (both the cone and stick are delicious) when they pass by.

reviews.author: JohnboyM54
reviews.title: Asian break
reviews.content: Nice walk from the centre of the old quarter about 50 mins, had a coffee break overlooking the boating lake, ok, just average

reviews.author: Niranjan H
reviews.title: Plan an evening during the weekend.
reviews.content: Many activities like street music, dancing, lighting goes on  around this lake. You can walk around the whole lake and enjoy the romantic atmosphere.

reviews.author: PierreMalmaison
reviews.title: Not particularly worthy of a visit
reviews.content: This is a large body of water to the north end of Hanoi. Bisected by a road where the beautiful Trấn Quốc Pagoda lies (and free to visit).  Other than the Pagoda (and the view beyond) there isn't much else to see here.There is a nice place to sit at the south side of the Trúc Bạch lake (the smaller, east lake).

reviews.author: cyp5613
reviews.title: Drove around it
reviews.content: The water seems clean enough and there was a quaint bridge linking to an island at the edge of the lake. It was not very crowded though for a tourist spot.

reviews.author: 358tr_nh
reviews.title: Great!
reviews.content: There're a lot of things you can see... and the air is super fresh. I went there with my guest on the first time. I was completely amazed by the view of this lake! You can ride bikecycle around here to do exercise or relax, or... anything!

reviews.author: owlesey
reviews.title: Good walk
reviews.content: This is the largest lake in Hanoi about 17k right around so nice for a longer walk. There was a lady selling little turtles that you can let go in the lake. I could not help myself and brought a couple to let them free.

reviews.author: Colint50
reviews.title: The walk around the lake was quite enjoyable.
reviews.content: The lake is surrounded by garden beds and well maintained.  We visited day and night times as on the weekends the roads are closed and the night markets are operating.

reviews.author: Teaguemoore
reviews.title: Fascinating but filthy
reviews.content: It's a great walk around the lake, sadly the rubbish is a bit out of control BUT what people throw on the lake is fascinating. The offerings, shrines, Buddhas, vases, flowers and even goldfish are really different and fascinating

reviews.author: Jolie P
reviews.title: Largest lake in Hanoi
reviews.content: We came there last evening to this very large lake with breeze. Quiet and romantic street, good for loving couples.Such a wonderful place. Look for the Banh tom to have during the relax time by the lake.

reviews.author: aychuen
reviews.title: nice stroll
reviews.content: nice stroll around west lake. or only part of it until the pagodai heard there is good clubs around this area but didnt explore further.

reviews.author: DrPradeepBakshi
reviews.title: Great location for evening visit
reviews.content: A walk on the road around the lake is a great experience. Choose a time around sunset and you will see beautiful city light reflections in the lake.

reviews.author: BrisbaneDw1962
reviews.title: Lots of unique restaurants
reviews.content: Had some lovely meals around the lake. Able to walk around the lake. Good place to stop and have a coffee and people watch.

reviews.author: Olga L
reviews.title: A pleasant walk about
reviews.content: We tried, but failed to circumvent this lake.  We failed because we are not 26 any longer but did manage a hearty chunk.  The walk is so enjoyable because as you meader along the edge you run into pockets of "life", you see "life" happening....for example....the day we went there was a group of Vietnamese men with their caged songbirds all strung up on a wire and they were sitting back (in a row) listening to their song.  I took photos and they were delighted.   There are coffee shops, swanky apartments for rent, along the way and the traffic isn't insane.   A lovely way to spend some time and to walk off all those wonderful pastries you've been consuming!

reviews.author: Ridgie14
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.content: This lovely lake that we overlooked from our hotel is in need of some attention rubbish floating on the side dead fish and one day we saw a guy fishing there and at the same time he was urinating into the water?

reviews.author: Ltp_BKK
reviews.title: Nice and relaxing
reviews.content: Even if it located far away from old quarter area but it is worth to visit. The lake is nice and relaxing. Moreover it is not crowded as HoanKiem Lake. You don't have to worry about people who try to sit next to you or worry about your stuff.

reviews.author: litseyk
reviews.title: Must walk around on the weekends.
reviews.content: This place is always busy, but really come to life on the weekends. Street performers come out, street food, activities for kids, paintings, etc.....Just walk around real slow and take it all in. Very relaxing.

reviews.author: Cecily D
reviews.title: Great for People Watching`
reviews.content: Street is closed to motor traffic on the weekend, so lots of people are enjoying their free time walking, talking, eating, playing games (tug of war is popular), playing great music, and enjoying the lovely cool winter weather.

reviews.author: Adeline L
reviews.title: A big lake
reviews.content: A big lake with nothing more. Housed to few 5 stars hotel. A bit out of Old Quarter, but not too far. A Taxi ride from West Lake to Old Quarter is approximate 50,000 - 60,000VietDong.

reviews.author: Ira G
reviews.title: Picturesque area with many monuments
reviews.content: West Lake is a freshwater lake in the center of Hanoi, and is bordered by many significant places in the history of Hanoi and Vietnam. Very peaceful and quiet.  Trấn Quốc Pagoda, the oldest pagoda in Vietnam, is located on a small island in the middle of the lake.

reviews.author: Soon Hin Y
reviews.title: Nothing much to see here except the pagoda
reviews.content: I stayed in Sheraton and it is kind of far from the old quarters. There is nothing much there except the pagoda by the lake. If you really have nothing to do, you can jog by the lake.

reviews.author: KimberleyInOz
reviews.title: A beautiful lake
reviews.content: A lovely large and peaceful lake, also known as Tay Ho or Ho Tay.The Sheraton and The Intercontinental sit on this lake, as does a beautiful temple.Combine with a trip to Tay Ho - the expat area of Hanoi and home to some excellent restaurants and shopping.

reviews.author: jsthouston
reviews.title: Better on a weekend?
reviews.content: Kind of dull during the week though you can walk or bike around much of the lake.  If the weather is nice I was told it is popular on weekends.

reviews.author: AntonioAGSC
reviews.title: Hanoi by the water
reviews.content: The west lake is a large body of water that limits Hanoi city by the west.The life arround the side of this lake is quite interesting to see as well as the buildings reflescting in the water in a windless day

reviews.author: jane_beach
reviews.title: Better part of the city
reviews.content: We caught a taxi over to West Lake it was a nice surprise to find these lakes and lovely parks and gardens and not very crowded in such a big city.There are water activities to enjoy if you wish such as pedal boats, but we visited the Tain Quoc Pagoda which was lovely to walk around and admire.

reviews.author: Asia Journey T
reviews.title: Ho Tay
reviews.content: A biggest lake of Hanoi. It is very nice but was polluted. Hanoian should preserve or take more actions on it to protect enviroment

reviews.author: Emellee
reviews.title: Big beautiful lake worth walking or cycling around
reviews.content: I don't know why there are so many negative comments about the lake. Yes it is a lake, yes there are some areas that have trash, but no one swims in the lake so who cares? There is a sidewalk almost all the way around which makes it nice for running or walking. It's fun to see the water park at the northern tip of the lake. There are a few pagodas along route and many upscale cafes with outdoor seating lakeside also.If the weather is nice for walking, I think it's a great activity.

reviews.author: Foodie247655
reviews.title: Dirty dump
reviews.content: We did not walk all around so there might be nice bits but the section we walked was a dirty smelly dump the government and locals do not take any care of this place. Sections were better where higher restaurants backed on to it but there was still the stench. Like most of this part of Hanoi it is pretty unpleasant with constant beeping of horns.  Not really a relaxing place and to honest best avoided for anymore than a few days.

reviews.author: Joe
reviews.title: Not dirty
reviews.content: Not sure why reviews said it was dirty. I thought it looked okSuper big can use a pedal boat or walk or cycle or use the golf buggy. Many options.  Nice photo opportunity.  Beautiful temple there and pagoda there too.

reviews.author: ScotPerth
reviews.title: Quieter area
reviews.content: West lake is a taxi ride away from the old city and a bit less chaotic.  The pagoda there is lovely with a peaceful feel.  There are paddle boats available at one end if you feel energetic.

reviews.author: mjwnjw
reviews.title: Walked around West Lake
reviews.content: It is a pretty area with different architecture but have a feeling it was a little like "lost in West Lake rather than Saigon" found local food markets and some coffee areas but a little unsure what the attraction might be for tourists.

reviews.author: GREGORY N
reviews.title: A good day tour stop.
reviews.content: I bought a little turtle for 50,000 ($2.50) and released it into the lake. I will now have good luck for a long time!

reviews.author: Thecatsmum4
reviews.title: Largest of the lakes in Hanoi
reviews.content: The locals like to go here and do exercise and there are a few places dotted around, but it is too big to walk around.  We visited early evening around 4pm having walked from the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, to get to the small park on the Thy Khoe road we had to take our lives in our hands crossing the road.  There were young boys playing football near the fountain.To be honest not a lot to see on the lake.

reviews.author: William H
reviews.title: A must...
reviews.content: Another must do....best with a guide and not for walking around its a bike or scooter or taxi..Lots attractions in and around the area...also lots cafes and restaurants about.Good photo opportunities...Recommended.

reviews.author: saschastreule
reviews.title: Nice for Jogging
reviews.content: It s just a great place for sport a walk or sitdown and drink some beer.When you stay near this lake it s a must to go there.

reviews.author: timkannikar
reviews.title: west lake
reviews.content: it is nice for walking not enough flowers and decoration, anyhow just like the natural looking and good for health breathing

reviews.author: Maughin L
reviews.title: Beautiful at night!
reviews.content: We drove around the West Lake at night and it was beautiful. Our best is these bicycles that are parked around the lake selling BO BIA - a rice pancake sort of thing filled with sesame seeds, fresh coconut and strips of sugar cane - mindblowingly good!!!

reviews.author: wildeastern
reviews.title: Nothing much
reviews.content: The lake is very polluted as told because of sewage ...and the authorities are trying to clean it up. Very green and mucky not crystal clear water. Dotted in the horizon are luxury hotels and the city's skyline. A so so visit.

reviews.author: Eli O
reviews.title: Place to visit
reviews.content: This place  is included into the city tour, so you can participate in (9am-3pm or so) or visit by yourself.

reviews.author: Justin W
reviews.title: Up and coming area of Hanoi and will change in the years to come
reviews.content: I stayed at the InterContinental Hotel in the neighborhood north of the city and around the lake. The neighborhood is in a state of transition as the area is being knocked down and rebuilt with more luxury housing and hotels. The old markets are starting to be pushed aside as progress hits this city.The big flower market is around the corner as well as some interesting restaurants. I got to walk around a little but the tours kept us busy all day. Got to see some of the lake and the river flowing through it. It still is a dirty neighborhood but its changing. The InterContinental Hotel is still one of the best hotels I stayed at in the country.

reviews.author: David B
reviews.title: Largest Lake
reviews.content: West Lake, to the north of Hanoi's Old Quarter, is the largest lake in the city.  It was once a branch of the nearby Red River.In itself, if is of little interest to tourists, but it is the site of Chua Tran Quoc Pagoda, a 1,500-year old temple set on a small island in the lake, and this is well worth a visit.West Lake is also the home of many wealthy expatriates who live in Hanoi, and as we were doing a tour of different parts of the city on the back of two motor bikes, it was interesting to compare the standard of living here and in Hanoi Old Quarter.

reviews.author: rholliday
reviews.title: Yep, just a lake
reviews.content: Nice place to walk around and see some interesting people and life.  The weather was perfect the day we walked around and it was full of photographers doing the wedding thing.  Vendors selling fresh fruit and people just hanging having a good time.  You can pick up an electric car tour at one side of the park but not certain what that side is.

reviews.author: noisyminor
reviews.title: Just a lake
reviews.content: And there was a Chinese temple. Good sunset photo opportunity. Some cafes and restaurants nearby. The lake itself was a drab. Saw many dead fish stomached turned floating around. That's about it. Really.

reviews.author: Sail_Scarlett
reviews.title: Biking round the lake
reviews.content: To get out of the craziness of the oldcquarter of Hanoi we decided to bike around West Lake. The Hanoi Bike Collective was fabulous & even opened up for us on their day off ( the accountant was inside). Biking is the best way to get around as theres a lot of broken ground and some derelict areas. But there's not a lot of traffic next to the lake so its a great place to try 2 wheels. And you get to ride thru a variety of quiet suburban areas that are not the frantic city centre. And plenty of places to stop for a coffee, coconut or a meal.

reviews.author: KMils
reviews.title: Dirty and NOT easy to walk around
reviews.content: For those who are saying a walk around the lake is pleasant they can't have walked too far! We walked around the entire lake today (took 6 hours). The paths are not walker friendly and would not accommodate everyone. The water quality is foul- I can't believe there were people doing water activities in this gritty water. Dead fish floating around. This could be a beautiful draw card for tourists but pride can be seen at all.

reviews.author: Enchanted_Trees
reviews.title: Bicycle Around the Lake
reviews.content: We are active folks, so we rented some mountain bikes from old town and biked to West Lake.  I have to admit this was one of my favorites things I did in Hanoi.  From Old Town, across a bridge, around the lake was roughly 20 miles.  I was a little hesitant to bike since scootering looked slightly dangerous.  However, I found that mopeds and cars treated you no differently.  In fact, I thought it was faster to mountain bike than using car/moped.  The lake is great to bike around and was pretty safe (mostly mopeds).  They have a great lane covering entire lake so it was very scenic (and this lake was clean and pretty).

reviews.author: KPNBO
reviews.title: Great to cycle round
reviews.content: Great cycle ride round the lake - c. 20km.  Easy ride most of the way and some of it traffic light.  Once you get the hang of road traffic, not as scary as it first seems!  The only thing that spoiled it was Hanoi's pollution, but that varies by day and on a clear day (which we didn't get) the view must be great.

reviews.author: soemr
reviews.title: Highland Coffee and Swan boat ride
reviews.content: Highly recommended to try out Highland coffee and ride the swan boats at West Lake. The ride cost VND80,000 per-person it was worth it because you can pedal around the lake and enjoy the scenery.

reviews.author: Liz H
reviews.title: Our West Lake Experience
reviews.content: West Lake was very interesting but unfortunately the weather was against the outdoor performance. BUT, the indoor performance was absolutely magical, awesome, fabulous.

reviews.author: Oldjack
reviews.title: A Large Lake In The City Of Hanoi
reviews.content: West lake is a very large lake and rare for such a lake essentially in the city center.It is close to some very interesting historical sites and worth a short walk if the your are at the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum although do not expect anything more than a large expanse of water.

reviews.author: AyeMyaMyaCho
reviews.title: Good Place
reviews.content: West lake was quite huge and nice place for physical activities. It was quite windy along the lake. Good to visit with family.

reviews.author: F4023NZalbertos
reviews.title: was excellent
reviews.content: poisoning of the lakes,makes us big headache to the local government too. to resident here also. butif the lakes is clean again best place tolive in hanoi.

reviews.author: Martin aryeh W
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: Our hotel Pan Pacific was on the lake and has spectacular views the lake area has a range of activities to suit all ages and tastes .

reviews.author: Widdy
reviews.title: Good views, ok for running, but quite dirty
reviews.content: There are some great views from the many cafes surrounding the lake, but it is quite dirty and you'll often see piles of dead fish and spot locals dumping all their rubbish into the lake, so needless to say it can be quite smelly in the summer heat. Not a bad spot for a run if you are looking for some distance, but you'll need to be careful running on the road as the footpaths are mostly useless.

reviews.author: JimmyJackk
reviews.title: Nice lake but
reviews.content: Very nice lake that is surrounded by the tourist area. Lots of aggressive vendors, fake cabs and tourists. Nice to walk around but if your looking for more than typical tourist prices and food, move along.

reviews.author: Michel-AnNguyen
reviews.title: The Biggest lake in town
reviews.content: It is the biggest lake in Hanoi. You can hide a bicycle (around the lake) to have biking around the lake. The road is quite brand new so it is easy to finish it. You should start at Tran Quoc Pagoda - one of famous pagoda in Hanoi. From Ve Ho Street, the road is quite few vehicles. You can see many ancient pagodas that have been decorated. Then you can pass around Water Park, Lotus Lake with blooming flowers (if it is in reason), expat area... It will take 2 hours to finish a round. It would be great in morning. Banh Tom - Shrimp Pancake is the most famous dishes this area. You can find many Shrimp Pancake Restaurant at the entrance road to Tay Ho Temple (Phu Tay Ho). There are many fusion restaurants, Indian Restaurant... in expat area. You should try. It just takes 3 hours in the morning. Have fun.

reviews.author: mrsjoan2016
reviews.title: Walk around the Lake
reviews.content: A beautiful place in the middle of a very bustling city.  Time out for peace and reflection. Can highly recommend a walk around the Lake and in hot weather, a cooling ice cream!

reviews.author: Kimberly B
reviews.title: Nothing special but nice to combine with visiting the Flower Market
reviews.content: It's a nice lake to drive around and to sit down in one of the local restaurants but to be honest it's not something really special or a must see. Near the West Lake there is a expat area called Tay Ho. Its more relaxed than the Old Quarter. You can easily combine it with visiting the Flower Market. In the evening you'll see a lot of young Vietnamese couples around the West Lake watching the colorful lights and enjoying their free time. Locals do some fitness and you will see quite some attributes where they lift weights, do push-ups and running.

reviews.author: David R
reviews.title: Ok lake in the city
reviews.content: The lake is ok as it provides you with something different in a busy city and its reasonably large. There are some nice trees & gardens and walking paths and you can also sit under some shady trees on a hot day and look at the lake. The road is nearby with lots of traffic and so its not quiet being by the lake which is a pity. So its an ok place to visit but there are a lot moremthings I would do in hanoi first before visiting here.

reviews.author: Leonie d
reviews.title: Nice lake, nothing special but worth a visit
reviews.content: This lake is not very different from any other lake in a city, but it's quite big and you can enjoy your cup of coffee or have some dinner with a nice view. There are also very "romantic" peddle boats in swan-shapes. Perhaps it's nicer to visit with sundown, I heard.

reviews.author: Marjolein A
reviews.title: Smelly
reviews.content: A smelly lake which they do try to make a bit more attractive with some nice seats and all and some areas are ok, but we just didn't like Hanoi that much.. for us this was the nicest place in town. View from rooftopbar at night is very cool however

reviews.author: Roddy S
reviews.title: Gigantic lake but not much to do
reviews.content: Gigantic lake but not much to do. There is a nice cafe nearby at which we spent an hour. There are a bunch of "swan boats" for you and your loved one to peddle in. Not sure if they still work.

reviews.author: Happyhappyboots
reviews.title: Not worth visiting .....
reviews.content: A quick view of you happen to be there but we found it not clean at all and a bit depressing with fish floating in the water.....

reviews.author: rolls29
reviews.title: hotel/hospital
reviews.content: stayed in hong ngoc hotel..(cochinchine)ba dinh district..early this year..also visited hong ngoc hospital..over the road as well..very handy to know/as i got the flu whilst in vietnam.during tet celebrations...most shops closed 4 the celebrations 4 three days..but not the hospital.thank goodness..

reviews.author: LaurieandBrent
reviews.title: Beautiful little lake
reviews.content: Nice, level easy walk around a beautifully landscaped lake.  Many restaurants located around it.  On the weekend, locals families hung out and there was a great energy about it.

reviews.author: Karly M
reviews.title: lovely area
reviews.content: This is a lovely area to stay in, no hustle and bustle of the city centre.  Great views and very peaceful.

reviews.author: Gastro-surfing
reviews.title: My favourite part of Hanoi
reviews.content: differant than the old quarter or Hoan Kiem, this is a residential neighborhood with lots of restaurants, bars, shops, art, bikes to rent, fresher air and walking streets.

reviews.author: Diane C
reviews.title: Dinner on the street
reviews.content: Ate seafood at a restaurant on the street where we picked our shrimp and crab from a tank and the owner cooked it right there over a hot fire... Delicious.

reviews.author: pauline o
reviews.title: Worth a walk
