We could see the activity on the lake as well as the city in the (not too) distance. If you want a beautiful walk take the time to walk around the lake (or at least part way as it is quite a large lake). There are cruises and other means that you can take to be on the lake. We did not take advantage of these activities but they looked quite good.

reviews.author: Srinithya N
reviews.title: Good location
reviews.content: Nice location to have a cool relaxed walk in the evening. full of fun and leisure place. was able to know about Vietnam culture their belief etc.

reviews.author: Marysusan2015
reviews.title: Very nice walk
reviews.content: Enjoy the people having a good time. Good coffee and lots of history. A lot of exercise going on in the morning.

reviews.author: Porgester
reviews.title: The land that time forgot
reviews.content: Having glanced at the other reviews here I seem to have had a completely different experience. We walked to the lake past the palace and arrived near the swan boats during the afternoon. Everything was closed & looked really run down. There were no people about & I was glad to get away. Would definitely not recommend.

reviews.author: Sinéad B
reviews.title: Mah it's ok
reviews.content: It's an alright place to watch abit of fishing and relax for a while it's a break from old quarters constant buzz anyways..

reviews.author: Natasha M
reviews.title: A changed from the Bustle of the Old Quarters
reviews.content: We hired a couple of cycles to ride around this lake, at first we regretted our decision as we started our journey in what felt like peak hour traffic but that we discovered what a jam really looked like upon returning our bikes! Some beautiful Old Chinese Temples along the way. We chose to ride through Tay Ho (Expat Region) and past what looked like a European Country side (popular place for photo's). There was less traffic but some cars still decided they could fit down the narrow roads and drive past you, so watch out for them.

reviews.author: Rowena Reagon
reviews.title: Great place to relaxe
reviews.content: It is great place to stay in Hanoi, No traffic jam and the air is very fresh. Ii is also easy to find good restaurants and bars around there.

reviews.author: Nicola V
reviews.title: Take a break
reviews.content: This is generally the expat area of hanoi, but if you are tired of the noise and pollution of Ha Noi this is the place were to go. Enjoy a walk around the lake. At night you can find many good restaurants and bars, mainly on Xuan Dieu St

reviews.author: Ramie E
reviews.title: The most attractive lake in Hanoi
reviews.content: It's great for us to walk around west lake. We could see lots of wonderful scenery as well as tasting many traditional food of Vietnamese.The air  is very fresh and cool.

reviews.author: Ronald G
reviews.title: A Relaxing Walk
reviews.content: we walked in the morning after breakfast .The New Year decor was worthy of admiration,blending well with the natural environment. Street artists, vendors, interesting artifacts completed the picture

reviews.author: travlncheryl10
reviews.title: Loved the area around West Lake
reviews.content: We stayed a few days at the Intercontinental West Lake and spent lots of time walking around the Lake.It's a very interesting area, we really enjoyed seeing what we felt was real people living their lives instead of tourist areas.The lake is nice, there are many small restaurants and shops along the lakeshore.People were incredibly friendly and at no time did we ever feel threatened in any way. If we return to Hanoi we will definitely stay around West Lake.

reviews.author: Zee S.Puad
reviews.title: Big lake
reviews.content: The very big lake in the middle of Hanoi.. Took us one hour to go around the lake using motorbike.. Just big and do it at night.. It is a very calming place to go.. Love it so much!

reviews.author: Arif Z
reviews.title: a walk to remember..
reviews.content: After whole day Hanoi visit I went to that lake side at the evening while distant lights were twinkling like stars and felt a nice gentle breeze over the lake! Indeed, It was amazing to be there. however, in the next morning I had a walk through that lake side as well and found really interesting. So morning or evening any time would be nice to visit west lake :)

reviews.author: wizardj007
reviews.title: Dancing, skating , walking to the sound of the city in Hanoi
reviews.content: Hanoi busy street sounds merging with the laughing children roller skating under the bright street lights , salsa dancers practicing their routines , young lovers hand in hand strolling around the west lake. It is all on show here and people young and old gravitate to the lake shore to exercise and chat during the day and night. A must for  those photo hungry tourists.

reviews.author: Chanlixu I
reviews.title: West Lake
reviews.content: Street artists are everywhere, temples and statues abound lovely walk with coffee shops and restaurants around.

reviews.author: Leo D
reviews.title: A peaceful destination
reviews.content: only coming to West lake, i can have deep breath and stay away from city's noise. i find peace and happiness in my soul whenever walking around this lake. i also know that west lake holds good values about national culture. around the lake, there are 21 pagodas and temples which are ranked national heritage. you can visit and pray for luck as well.

reviews.author: Georgia A
reviews.title: Just another lake!
reviews.content: It is massive! But it is just another lake. Although it is a fantastic place to watch the sunset! Hoam Kiem Lake is better in my opinion, it has a lot more character and is a great place to people watch

reviews.author: pinoytraveller2
reviews.title: Perfect Spot for Recreation
reviews.content: This review is quite late. The West Lake is a fresh water lake located in Tay Ho District. It is the biggest lake in Hanoi, and a perfect spot for recreation. We happen to passed by the West Lake on our way to the Museum of Ethnology. There are hotels, villas, restaurants, coffeeshops, gardens within the area and popular tourist attractions include temples and pagodas, among others.

reviews.author: Stephen-O
reviews.title: Needs some care but worth a visit
reviews.content: West Lake is worth visiting especially to see the pagoda and temple of Chua Tran Quoc. There is a paved footpath that allows you to wander forever if you wish and gives one of the best views in Hanoi. Fisherman practicing an unusual casting method are all around the lake's edges. As you can see for quite a distance across the lake, the air pollution of 3 million scooters and many cars is very evident. At various points along the shoreline the water, quite frankly, stinks. The lake needs some TLC. However, there are many, many eateries around the concourse and it's a good spot to observe the locals at tai chi or simply wandering, enjoying themselves. We spent an hour or so just sitting in the sun on the lake's edge watching the world go by and thoroughly enjoyed it.

reviews.author: G C
reviews.title: Nice place for a stroll & good views
reviews.content: Ha Noi's West Lake has a brick-lined pathway along its shoreline that offers a nice place for a stroll... You will see all manner of local folks partaking in their activities (fishing, selling grilled corn-on-the-cob, even wedding groups having their photos taken)... if you need a caffeine fix, there are numerous excellent shops to choose from (cautious street crossing is advised, of course).  The area near the famous Tran Quoc Pagoda is very scenic (albeit a bit busy & touristy)... the historical Pagoda is quite lovely to view (and sits atop an island that offers wide vista around the lake -- no admission fee, donations are appreciated :), so be sure to stop here at least once during your Ha Noi visit.If you jaunt is in the area of the Somerset West Lake Hotel, be sure to stop in at the DaNang Quan restaurant (address is 67 Trich Sai, on the lakefront road about 2 blocks west of the hotel), and sample their really yummy Vietnamese food (ask for Ms. Van, who speaks excellent English and is very helpful with ordering delightful dishes from their extensive menu).Other parts of the lake are bordered by swank hotels, and excellent restaurants with that marvelous view as well :)Enjoy the West Lake area!

reviews.author: gotwa32
reviews.title: Big Lake
reviews.content: this lake is bigger than Hoan kiem lake if you go walk about 2 hours that right, you can try seafood around this lake. Because you can see have so much for seafood reataunrant with view is nice and romantic if you are couple right.

reviews.author: HolidaytoIndoch... L
reviews.title: West Lake
reviews.content: In fact, it is a big lake in Hanoi and many people like it. I love it too, the beautiful view. you also can eat in the boat on the lake.

reviews.author: CV S
reviews.title: Electronic Car tour
reviews.content: We started with the pagoda near the ticket office.  Would have wanted to charter the e car for our family but we needed 2 cars and it seemed there was a shortage of available cars that time or probably we just didn't have the skills to communicate what we wanted. Nonetheless,  we made the ride around the lake-  would have wanted the car to go slower on certain spots.  There were more than possible stops and you could choose only one. We chose to do so at the other most popular temple for a family picture.  We had to make our way back by taxi to where we chose to have lunch by the west lake- listed among the best buffets in Hanoi- Sen Tay Ho- really the best!

reviews.author: SubiSoph
reviews.title: A must for all
reviews.content: On my second trip to Hanoi, the first thing we did was return to West Lake and walk the whole way round. Lots to see and gives you great start when exploring this fascinating city. Lots of great cafés around the lake.

reviews.author: Jennifer K
reviews.title: Worth a Stroll
reviews.content: Worth a Stroll if you are in the neighborhood. Shopping near by. Hanoi charm. Place to snap a few pictures and look at your map.

reviews.author: Meaghan G
reviews.title: A Must See!
reviews.content: The Westlake is a historic lake inside of the Old Quarter in Hanoi. It is great for taking an afternoon stroll, Visiting some nearby attractions, or even just snapping some good instagram pics. I fully recommend it.

reviews.author: Gus L
reviews.title: The biggest lake in Hanoi
reviews.content: Best part of Hanoi, you can spend some time walk exercise for fresh air in the morning. Clear blue sky make the lake live.

reviews.author: DavidGA986
reviews.title: Walk around the Lake
reviews.content: My wife and I were very disappointed with the southern side of the lake. We found it very dated and very dirty with sewers feeding into the lake. Not very pleasant

reviews.author: Draghignazzo
reviews.title: A lake
reviews.content: Our hotel was located on the lake, yes on it! So it was pretty hard to miss it out. I wont say its extraordinary, to be honest its just a lake but quite big so many things get around it.

reviews.author: Taosgal
reviews.title: Misty lake a worthwhile walk
reviews.content: at dawn, it's true that locals come out for all variety of exercise.  It's the center of a lovely leafy area.  Best part of Hanoi.

reviews.author: Sarah W
reviews.title: Go round on a bike
reviews.content: If you want some exercise it is over 12 km around the lake and you will see lots of different parts of Hanoi. You can stop of to eat and or drink.

reviews.author: bladdamasta
reviews.title: Fun to motor scooter around, but bland when hazy
reviews.content: We went to the lake expecting to find bicycle hire shops. Big mistake - there aren't any. I had to return to the Old Quarter and find a motor scooter hire place (there's actually a few places - 150k dong for 3 hours). Hanoi's a hairy place to ride, but I find that fun. We got to the lake and found the turnoff to the road that runs directly around the lake. 13km or 17km circumference (depending on which book you read).There's some different stretches around the lake. A nice sight are the scullers on one part of the lake with a rowing club on the shore. There's some houses in one part. There's a bizarre field of lavender(?) with some paths through it. In the south west part there's a funny little pub called Motown Gastropub that's worth a look. There looked like a growing bar scene in this area.We've had misty conditions since we arrived so the views as we went around the lake were non existent. I'd imagine on a clear day that it'd look pretty cool.There's a couple of times where you have to rejoin the main road, but for the most part we were on a less crowded road on the lake. Watch for the blind turns as the Vietnamese regard any side of the road as the right side.Fun stuff.

reviews.author: Simlez
reviews.title: average lake
reviews.content: walked from the old quarters all the way to west lake. The distance is around 3km and took us (me with a few elderly) 1 hr to reach there. It was dark when we reached there - saw a few restaurant on the lake. should be a popular place for couples. also saw people fishing along the lake. walk further down for around 10 min to see a pagoda.

reviews.author: C David A
reviews.title: Too big to be intimate & surrounded by buildings
reviews.content: Not much to see - the lake is a bit too big to feel cozy/intimate (unlike its little cousin Lake of Restored Sword, or Hoan Kiem Lake) and it is lined with unattractive buildings.  The shoreline walkway was blocked by various things (full garbage bags waiting for pickup, for one) so it's hardly a relaxing walk.  Suggest to spend an hour or two around the Lake of Restored Lake instead!

reviews.author: 3232_Traveler
reviews.title: The only reason to go to this godforsaken city
reviews.content: Great ex-pat area on the east side of the lake (near sheraton hotel) with relatively clean restaurants, better hotels, and a few less scams...Ho Tay is also a better lake then the one in old quarter. Takes over an hour to walk around, but is much nicer with great views and good cafes/food spread around it.

reviews.author: ggraces
reviews.title: Not very attractive
reviews.content: We went in December 2014 as we heard how West Lake was a haven away from the hustle and bustle from the Old Quarters in Hanoi. However, we were disappointed that besides the Tran Quoc Pagoda which was worth a visit, west lake is just a very large body of water - dirty water in fact. It was too big to walk around so I would suggest getting a car tour or renting a bike. We saw a couple of locals fishing in the lake but the water was really dirty and there were many dead fishes visible in the lake. We also chanced upon someone relieving himself into the lake. We were also not sure if December is really foggy or it was pollution because we could not see much of the lake. On the good side, it was really much more quieter than other areas of Hanoi. The coconut ice creams along west lake is worth a try too. But other than that, I did not find this place very attractive and our group ended up chilling in a cafe instead of going round the lake.

reviews.author: Garry C
reviews.title: Average lake but nice trip around it.
reviews.content: After visiting the temple on West Lake (don't go at lunch time. it's closed!) we were unimpressed until we noticed an electric car tour for 80k VD.  It's just a pity this tour isn't upgraded to it's optimum but for this pittance you get a 1 hour trip around this huge waterway.  You'll see some interesting sights and some expensive real estate. Pity is there is no commentary and no stops. If they fixed these two things this could be a cracker tour.

reviews.author: kola2015
reviews.title: Beautiful lake
reviews.content: Chatting and sharing funs on the boat in the West Lake was one of my unforgettable memories. Very peaceful and everyone should go one time.

reviews.author: Boleslav
reviews.title: Just a large body of water, no charm
reviews.content: We did not find anything appealing about the West lake. It is large lake in Hanoi, surrounded by restaurants, paddle boats and high rises.

reviews.author: retiredone2007
reviews.title: A very large lake indeed.
reviews.content: West Lake is the largest of Hanoi's many lakes.  It is situated in the northwest area of Hanoi but the main attractions, a pagoda, a coffee restaurant on a floating boat, and a Botanical garden are all on the east side.  The Pagoda is very lovely, well-maintained,  and worth visiting. We also enjoyed having coffee after and buying several small bags of their products.  The Botanical gardens leave a lot to be desired if you're expecting flowers which there are almost none, but many nice trees and a few statues worth taking a look at.  The monkey and pheasant cages are so covered with wire mesh that seeing the animals is almost impossible and photo taking not worth the effort.

reviews.author: LakeComoExpert
reviews.title: Haven of peace away from the noise of Hanoi
reviews.content: Worth a visit if you are in the vicinity of HCM's mausoleum. It is a haven of peace after the noise, chaos and pollution of the rest of the city. Visit Highlands coffee house, located on a boat on the lake for really good coffee and cakes.

reviews.author: akeyaranu
reviews.title: Nice to walk around
reviews.content: A nice, scenic getaway from the hassle and bustle of the Old Quarter. It's nice to walk around on a nice sunny day or at night, but you'll get swarmed by ladies selling stuff if you try to sit down on a bench. That, or the locals will come and sit quite closely, almost on you.

reviews.author: Hugo H
reviews.title: Should be improved
reviews.content: The site was nice to visit but the environment and tourist facilities were not in place and made us boring in a short time.

reviews.author: Pawpaw073
reviews.title: Pretty
reviews.content: A great break from the walking with kids around the Old Quarter. The paddle swans were a hit with the kids, but our legs were the wrong size for these, although you can only hire them for an hour. Which with kids is about 30mins too long.

reviews.author: Kach Umandap Howe
reviews.title: Oh Westlake. nice but dirty!
reviews.content: Well, living in Hanoi.. you'll know westlake definitely! We did the swan paddle boat with some friends, it was cool but too afraid as it's filthy water! well, what is awesome are the establishments around westlake!!

reviews.author: AsiaTraveler1950
reviews.title: Peaceful place in a modern capital
reviews.content: Feeling tired and uncomfortable with the noisy and polluted environment. You should be there to take a peaceful and quite moment. Very nice to sit in a stone chair and enjoy fresh air. But sometimes, you feel a little bit inconvenience by the vendor and the bad smell from the lake due to the water level. A highlight in the capital

reviews.author: tumbleweeds023
reviews.title: Nice motorbike ride around the lake
reviews.content: This is one of my favorite spots to go for a motorbike ride. There is a road that starts at the causeway that separates West Lake and Truc Bac Lake, and you can just follow the lake all the way around in a circle that takes about 45 minutes. Along the way, you'll pass a bunch of seafood restaurants (some are quite good), a few pagodas (even a Tibetan Buddhist temple), nice neighborhoods with lots of expats and western restaurants, and a few hundred coffee shops. There are a few parks along the way, including a water park, but not as many as there could be. Someday, this will all be modern and glitzy, but for now, it's a pretty quiet and peaceful spot in a busy and energetic city.

reviews.author: MohammadFahmy
reviews.title: Dirty lake, pushy peddlars
reviews.content: I was disappointed by the sight, and smell, emanating from the lake.  The hawkers and peddlars around the lake can get very aggressive too. Just smile politely and say no.

reviews.author: BM1986
reviews.title: A little oase in town
reviews.content: When you get boored from shops and streatvendors this is the place to go. Near the old quarters but just like a quiet oase. Take a walk around the lake to gather some energy for more shopping.

reviews.author: swift33
reviews.title: Nice to walk round
reviews.content: We walked round the lake, and enjoyed the views. Unfortunately Viet Nam seems to be in a (Industrial ) haze most of the time so nothing looks clear.

reviews.author: Johan H
reviews.title: Beautiful escape in hanoi
reviews.content: Its easy to get stressed in Hanoi and the lake is a great escape. It seemes that all the surrounding sounds just dissappear as soon as you are near the lake. Worth a visit, its beautiful.

reviews.author: Jonathan668
reviews.title: Good view and relax
reviews.content: Feel very relax with good restaurant like Dons, Halia. The views were exellent!!!Stay a couple of days here. Everything is perfect

reviews.author: Sharkbait53
reviews.title: Big Lake
reviews.content: This is a very large freshwater lake where you can see locals boat fishing with nets and rod fishing for snakes! It is a long walk round or you can hire a swan pedalo to potter around in. This is also the site of the Single Pillar Pagoda. There is another smaller lake the other side of the road. Street sellers can be a bit persistant

reviews.author: Johnson_Lam
reviews.title: Take a walk in the morning
reviews.content: Walked around the lake 2 days in a row. Great place to see the buzz of the city at one corner and people relaxing, exercising, dancing and just sit around for a chat around the lake.

reviews.author: Lisa B
reviews.title: Nice lake but bad attitude
reviews.content: It's the biggest lake in Ha Noi and also famous with the lotus pond but it's winter so, all of lotus are gone. A little bit disappointed. I saw lots of peoples went fishing in this lake beside someone who was peeing in the lake. I dont know why did they do that with the most beautiful lake in Ha Noi? Bad scene!

reviews.author: Porepunkah
reviews.title: Beware the hawkers around the lake!
reviews.content: Westlake is a welcome relief from the hectic traffic in Hanoi.Hawkers are everywhere in Vietnam and West lake is no exception.I feel this persistence to buy is very irritating when all you want to do is have a peaceful stroll and enjoy the surroundings.

reviews.author: Chan Sai Keong
reviews.title: Beautiful Lake
reviews.content: West Lake is the largest lake in the center of Hanoi. It is a popular place for recreation with many surrounding gardens, hotels and restaurants.I am staying in Sheraton Hanoi Hotel which is just beside the lake. I like to walk around to explore the surrounding area of the lake. It is very relaxing and gives us different kind of experience while walking in different times. Morning, afternoon and also night views of the lake are awesome.What we are doing there were having our meals in some lovely restaurants, walking around and visited the Tran Quoc Temple.

reviews.author: Alex B
reviews.title: Beautiful lake with fresh air.
reviews.content: Located near my place, I often had a walk for the time I was in Hanoi. The air here felt truly refreshing as it's the biggest lake in Hanoi, so it was less dusty and the area around was very well-aired. Furthermore, there was a very famous pagoda nearby named Tran Quoc that has been around for ages (the name was roughly translated as Guarding the Nation as the tour guide introduced). All in all,West Lake is the best choice for an afternoon walk if you stay nearby.

reviews.author: Haamid J
reviews.title: Evening breeze, a delight around the Lake
reviews.content: Interesting walk with locals stretching out, exercising, picnicking or just romancing.  There are innumerable restaurants and eateries all around.  Establishment neon signs light up the lake.  From our hotel it was a pleasant walk.

reviews.author: davidandmel
reviews.title: Worth a trip
reviews.content: Worth coming out here for a different perspective on the city. The lake has a pedestrian path which you can cycle or walk on and you get great city views back.  There a couple of interesting pagodas and some great bars and restaurants if you come at night

reviews.author: mikemoran737
reviews.title: Lots to see
reviews.content: Enjoyed the temple, pagoda, walking along the lake to another temple with a fine, large bronze Buddha. Artists drawing and men fishing.

reviews.author: terryjose
reviews.title: Lake placid!
reviews.content: An ideal place to relax away from the bustles and hustles of the city. A drive around the circumference of this massive lake is very refreshing and one can visit the Tran Quoc Pagoda on the banks of this lake.

reviews.author: Samuel J
reviews.title: Great for an afternoon walk!
reviews.content: A really massive and gorgeous lake in Hanoi, with fresh air and many nice place to visit like pagodas or temple. Brimming with people's activities, and watching the sunset here was astonishingly romantic.

reviews.author: Kimberly L
reviews.title: Peaceful and fresh.
reviews.content: While in Hanoi, I really liked West Lake. Although it was a little bit far away from the city center, but the air and the atmosphere here are much better, cleaner and less dusty. Watching the sunset here was terrific, as it was the largest lake in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Carlos
reviews.title: Runners paradise
reviews.content: When ever You are looking for a running circiut, try this! Around the lake You can run and run and run.....Less Traffic and really Safe track, not so easy to find in asian Capitals.

reviews.author: waldixon-number9
reviews.title: FLOATING RESTAURANT
reviews.content: I had an excellent meal one night on WEST LAKE with friends. The meal was delicious and the view was great. I cannot remember the name of the boat but there were a number to chose from and all seemed to have a lot of people on board.

reviews.author: adina j
reviews.title: Green lung of the city
reviews.content: You can walk around the lake in the afternoon, pleasant atmosphere, with the elderly, young children, the youth and lovable dogs.

reviews.author: Pamela A
reviews.title: Centre of Hanoi
reviews.content: We walked around the lake several times and each time was a different experience.  There was a race, a wedding and a music video clip being taped on one visit.  Hub of the city with a peaceful edge.

reviews.author: Lucy M
reviews.title: Photography haven for the brides and grooms
reviews.content: Interested in some wedding photography? this area in the afternoon and evening is a mecca for all the brides and grooms getting hitched with accompanying photographers and dressers etc ec. Good fun and good practice!! all apart from the Red Bridge and the painters, sellers and general hawkers as well as a good spot to go walking ( as in purposeful walking).

reviews.author: Georgefromont
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.content: Nice views of Hanoi skyline. Nice to walk around from one side to another. Like other said, clean air, no air pollution. Not heavy traffic like rest of Hanoi. Sad that lake is somewhat polluted with plastic water bottles, food containers, etc. Can sit and watch fish jump. Beautiful sunset behind the skyline

reviews.author: Jord t
reviews.title: peaceful in noisy city
reviews.content: You can find of the best hanoi food here, delicious and event cheap. Worth to try, huh!You can walk and bicycle around the lake in the morning or the evening to have fresh air.

reviews.author: Imran K
reviews.title: Lake View
reviews.content: We got a task to decode the signs mentioned on the pillars out there and to meet the monks and it was beautiful

reviews.author: SaumyeR
reviews.title: to be visited before sun fall
reviews.content: We could only visit the west lake in the evening so have limited opinion. But after sun fall, there was nothing much to do. Options for food around the lake seemed limited and as no boats were going in, we had to stay on the banks

reviews.author: Alfonso
reviews.title: Nice and Peaceful
reviews.content: Big lake. Many activities going on, Street vendors selling items, locals exercising, tourist taking pictures, brides and grooms having photo shoots. Take a slow and relaxing walk at night and the scene is different with the night lighting.

reviews.author: LauraWOA
reviews.title: the pagoda makes this worth a visit
reviews.content: We went to the pagoda in West Lake which was an interedting experience largely due to our guide's knowledge of the area. I would recommend a visit if you have time.

reviews.author: Australialynx
reviews.title: Ok
reviews.content: This lake is a peaceful setting  amongst the chaos of very busy Hanoi. The water is polluted with rubbish which is a shame, the proud people of Hanoi seemingly too busy to clean it up.  The nearby fresh food markets were fascinating.

reviews.author: Andreea D
reviews.title: Go there at 6 a.m. and see how Hanoi wakes up to a new day
reviews.content: West Lake in Hanoi is great at any time of day, but early in the morning (between 5.00  - 7.00 a.m.) it's just amazing! You can take a walk around the lake and see how the locals start their day: by practicing tai chi, slow waling or running, biking and dancing. It's full of life and gives you energy for the day. Then go get a traditional drip coffee by the lake and start exploring!

reviews.author: Dans H
reviews.title: Beautiful lake.
reviews.content: A truly beautiful lake, which is the biggest lake in Hanoi. The air around the lake is fresh and not dusty like other crowded part of the city. Best visited during sunset.

reviews.author: Guardian2013
reviews.title: Nothing special
reviews.content: It's nice to sit on the benches and chill for a while, enjoying the somewhat cooler breeze from across the lake but definitely not something I would go out of my way to visit. The water is fairly polluted (you certainly couldn't swim in it safely) and often has plastic bags and other refuse bobbing around close to the edge but they do try the refuse from getting out of hand. If it wasn't for mosquitoes, bats and trying to avoid fishing lines, it would be pleasant at night.

reviews.author: powerpowerjen1
reviews.title: Nice view - enjoy the whole afternoon
reviews.content: West Lake comes with nice view of pagoda (believe is one of the oldest "Tran Quoc") and good culture and historical site (temples "Quan Thanh" and other buildings). With current temperature, you can rent bicycle or boat to enjoy the whole afternoon. If possible go for roottop Cafe where you can enjoy the wonderful panoramic views of west lake.

reviews.author: cmbreuer2016
reviews.title: Interesting
reviews.content: We caught a taxi to the flower market then walked back to the old quarter via West Lake. The hotels on the lake are upmarket, and the Intercontinental was outstanding as the hotel is in the lake on piles. The area is expensive and very touristy, we prefer Hoan Kiem Lake as there are more locals.

reviews.author: lbhcys
reviews.title: Visit only after covering the other attractions
reviews.content: West Lake is not exactly a tourist attraction. As it is too big to walk around the lake, we took the electric tram for a 1 hour ride around the lake. There was no audio commentary and the driver did not speak English. We were given a map though in English that describes the various points around the lake.Going around the lake, you can see the contrast. Some places are scenic with expensive looking villas and upmarket eateries, while at some places you can smell the stench of rotting fish and the water is deep green. All around you can see pockets of locals fishing. We did see one fisherman pulled in a carp around 2kg.Visit West Lake only after you have covered all the other major attractions and have time to spare.

reviews.author: Florence C
reviews.title: So polluted
reviews.content: What could be a lovely attraction is so dirty and poluted, it is not worth visiting. Dead fish floating on the lake, rubbish everywhere, and so soggy I could not see across the lake. Very dissapointing

reviews.author: Sheilasing
reviews.title: Contrast to Ho Kiem lake
reviews.content: Surrounded by modern buildings upmarket hotels, but nice gardens. A nice place to stroll and visit pagoda. We saw it on a day of blue sky and sun so was quite stunning!

reviews.author: pelangan
reviews.title: Visit the Lake in Early Morning
reviews.content: The lake in central Hanoi, 3-5 minute walk from the Old Quarter, is beautiful and VERY local. You will see al almost only locals there enjoying their daily routines (tai qi, group dancing, exercise and friends meeting) there. The walk around is only about 30-45 minutes, but the photo opportunities especially early morning are great. Try to go between 6-7:30am to enjoy all the locals doing exercises, tai qi, group dancing etc.

reviews.author: Charles B
reviews.title: Out of the meley
reviews.content: More laid back than most of the city.  Easy to walk or bike(rentals available).  No street hawkers at your side.  Many pagodas, only a few of which are major tourist draws.  Good street food and a wide range of multi ethnic restaurants, Spanish, Greek, Turkish, Italian, Mexican and many more as it is an expat area.  $2-3 ride from the Old Quarter.

reviews.author: Graham P
reviews.title: An easy walk through some of Hanoi's best architectural areas
reviews.content: We walked from our hotel in the inner city area near the markets to West Lake and saw lots of fabulous architecture and parks. This area is much more open and spacious and worth visiting.

reviews.author: gt1980
reviews.title: A nice walk, view, you will see it naturally with the old Hanoi
reviews.content: A nice walk, view, you will see it naturally with the old Hanoi.Keep an eye out for the terrapins!!

reviews.author: SwissPinkPanther
reviews.title: Take a walk around the lake in early morning
reviews.content: I highly recommend an early morning stroll around west lake..... The variety of activities that I observed was not to be believed...first and foremost seeing all ages of Vietnamese exercising around the lake.....and this is at 8:00 AM.....in one area I saw 4 groups of people playing badminton while right next to them under a canopy of trees there were a good 2 dozen men and woman dancing the tango !   Listening to the music and watching these local residents dance  , who by the way were mostly all dressed up, was very very special to see.  West lake is less of a photographic destination like the West Lake in Hangzhou but rather a place to sit and watch local Vietnamese life go by.

reviews.author: Ric Malaysia
reviews.title: Nothing but a lake
reviews.content: West Lake is very big. It's not advisable to walk round the whole lake. I took the electric buggy. It makes a complete round and ends at the starting point in about an hour. At 80000 VND person, it is good value. A buggy fits 6 comfortably. The scenery changes as it goes round the lake. Highly recommended as a tourist stop.

reviews.author: KUNPRAPHAT K
reviews.title: Peaceful place in the morning
reviews.content: Walking along the west lake was much more relax with a nice scenery. Then go to Chua Tran Quoc temple to pay respect to the Buddha for your peaceful life.

reviews.author: Ray
reviews.title: Pretty lake
reviews.content: Old quarter surrounds the lake. Lovely to walk around and people watch. Well worth staying in this area as its hustle and bustle is fun to be in.

reviews.author: Promtong M
reviews.title: Huge lake!
reviews.content: The lake is huge! It is a very nice place to walk around & watch local fishermen doing the fishing! We were lucky to see some of them show their fishing skills!

reviews.author: roncon09
reviews.title: Excellent place to chill!
reviews.content: Lots of great places to relax and look out onto the lake. I would not swim in the lake but it is certainly is nice to hang out and enjoy places that look out onto the lake!

reviews.author: voyagerclicks
reviews.title: Large lake for a pleasant walk
reviews.content: This is an upmarket place and most of the expats live near this lake. Its a large and beautiful lake with lots of eating options. Unlike, Hoan Kiem lake, this has wide roads surrounding the lake and also more traffic. So one doesnt get the local flavor but still a good place for a peaceful walk and eat out.

reviews.author: Awaywegoagain22
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.content: Take a stroll around the lake and take in the local life, watching the locals fishing and get a glimpse of all those brides being photographed.

reviews.author: RobP423
reviews.title: Hire a bicycle in Hanoi
reviews.content: I hired a bicycle for $3 a day and had a great day cycling around the lake stopping for a cool drink and a meal on the way. A fun way to see the lake.

reviews.author: Kathy L
reviews.title: West Lake
reviews.content: A great place to visit and take in the surroundings, atmosphere, culture, serenity and relax with a drink or two.

reviews.author: Sophie W
reviews.title: Finally quiet
reviews.content: Happy to find a place where u can walk around without scarf and sunglasses ( such bad air quality in the old center... Suffocating)The west lake is pretty big so its perfect for a longer walk. Also some hotels have a rooftop where you get the view.

reviews.author: Jennie D
reviews.title: You'll love it!!
reviews.content: West Lake (or "Hồ Tây" in Vietnamese) is a freshwater lake in the center of Hanoi. This is the largest lake in the city and a popular place for recreation with many surrounding gardens, hotels and villas. A small part of West Lake is divided by Thanh Nien road (Youth Road in English) to form Trúc Bạch Lake. One district of Hanoi is named after the lake -Tây Hồ District.West Lake is bordered with many significant places in history of the city itself and the country. Take a walk along the lake (in Thanh Nien Road) you will find Trấn Quốc Pagoda, oldest pagoda in Vietnam, was built in the 6th century by Lý Nam Đế and now locates on a small island in the middle of the lake. Near Tran Quoc Pagoda is Quán Thánh Temple, one of the Four Sacred Temples of ancient Hanoi. Chu Van An High School, one of the oldest high schools in Vietnam, also locates close to the lake. This is one of the must-see location when you're in Hanoi :)

reviews.author: Michael P
reviews.title: good walk around the lake
reviews.content: Smack in the middle of the city theres this huge lake. good spot to chill and have a walk.Youll see loads of people taking there wedding photos against trees hanging over the sides of the lake.

reviews.author: steve h
reviews.title: must see
reviews.content: West lake is huge and well worth a visit...it has loads of local life all around it and can be easily reached from the old quarter

reviews.author: VisitHanoiVietnam
reviews.title: The Lake
reviews.content: It's very safe to walk around the Lake even at night because you'll see there's a Police every few Bench away.

reviews.author: LindaLindaLH
reviews.title: Dirty and smelly
reviews.content: The lake has dead fishes over the bank. However, if you look away from the lake, there is a variety of more classy shops compared to what you see in Old Quarters. Lots of cyclists around this area.

reviews.author: Alice M
reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.content: loved it! I am a big fun of nature! so peaceful! Take a leisurely drive around the lake to get a good insight into Hanoi life

reviews.author: fickle_flower
reviews.title: Tranquil scenery outside the craziness of the Old Quarter
reviews.content: Took a taxi there on my last day in Hanoi... just a short ride away from the Old Quarter, I was pleasantly surprised to see it is quite different from Hoan Kiem lake. Much bigger, a vaster surface of water... this lake is a lot more peaceful, and there are some pagodas located on it. Probably a bit too wide a circumference to walk around, unless you have several hours to spare. But it was still nice to take a leisurely walk around sunset, and I wished I had more time to explore the area. Would even have been nice (and tempting) to rent one of those tacky swan water cycles.... but I didn't have the time to do so.

reviews.author: BobKL
reviews.title: Oasis in the busy city
reviews.content: Nothing spectacular, but a nice place to wander around or even be driven around. Some peace in a busy city. And there are some good restaurants and bar in the direct vicinity.

reviews.author: Soon Chee Haur
reviews.title: Great Scenery
reviews.content: You should enjoy cream, dried fruit candies, shrimp cake, rolled "pho" Besides, there are a lot of pagodas, so you have a lot of chance to eat as vegetarian in those pagodas or restaurant for vegetarian.

reviews.author: linhvu9x
reviews.title: Enjoy food and pagoda
reviews.content: - You should enjoy cream, dried fruit candies, shrimp cake, rolled "pho"Besides, there are a lot of pagodas, so you have a lot of chance to eat as vegetarian in those pagodas or restaurant for vegetarian. - In summer, lotus blossoms and many people visit it to enjoy and take photos- Buffet Sen (Lotus) is also thing you shouldn't miss.

reviews.author: Azra M
reviews.title: Very beautiful with amazing views
reviews.content: There are so many reasons to visit the West Lake. The peace & tranquility of the lakeside walk in the warm sunshine was the perfect start to a day's exploration in Hanoi. There are numerous cafés & shopping areas nearby & the views are fantastic.

reviews.author: AhEwe
reviews.title: nice lake, just a bit foggy
reviews.content: this is a nice place of Hanoi. Some say it is the most beautiful lake of Hanoi. When you come to the West Lake, don't forget to taste the "West Lake Shrimp cake".

reviews.author: Sam Aldridge
reviews.title: A nice lake
reviews.content: The thing is, there are lots of lakes and pagodas in Vietnam. As we were travelling across the country, we saw lots of these. However had we just been in Hanoi I would have raved about how cool and tranquil it was to walk around the lake. We even took a tuc tuc ride around it which was fun. there is so much to enjoy here and the lake is just another bonus!

reviews.author: Jenny N
reviews.title: Wide Lake!
reviews.content: It is a big lake and peaceful with fresh air and also suitable for walking around and doing exercise.

reviews.author: Itinerant Ozzie
reviews.title: Large lake close to Hanoi centre
reviews.content: The West Lake is close to the Hanoi old quarter (about 30 mins walk) and is a large expanse of water that often has a pleasant breeze. The Chinese pagoda Qua Tran Quoc is located on the edge of the lake which is probably the main attraction for tourists.A little further along from the Pagoda, there is a coffee shop (the coffee bean & tea leaf) with lovely views across the lake from the 1st floor.If you are looking for some respite from the Hanoi bustle and traffic then the West Lake offers a welcome distraction.

reviews.author: James Adam
reviews.title: A great place to wander around the lake.
reviews.content: West Lake is a bustling crazy place but there a re lots of quiet little spots.very good if you want to stretch your legs and see the sights. and a great place for sunset pics. Lots of bars, restaurants & coffee shops.

reviews.author: Grethe A
reviews.title: Biking around the West Lake
reviews.content: We biked around the lake - in some places a bit scary because of the traffic - in other places we were on our own and could enjoy the view -  it was a very nice trip

reviews.author: Mary C
reviews.title: Nice sunset.
reviews.content: Visited here quite frequently during my business trip. The lake was quite enormous with a famous and interesting Pagoda (named Tran Quoc or something), and the sunset here was absolutely stunning.

reviews.author: gsimpruiz
reviews.title: Another lovely lake in Hanoi
reviews.content: Hanoi is so humid in September that visits to the lakes are a necessary alternative to mausoleums.  There is a Chinese temple here which is really lovely and just walking along the lake distracts you from the omnipresent heat.

reviews.author: suemcgrath100
reviews.title: lovely lake
reviews.content: Very nice and peaceful lake.  Breath of fresh air in a hectic town.  Locals and tourists enjoy it. Night and day it is nice.

reviews.author: Jack P
reviews.title: Nice things around
reviews.content: There isn't much to do on the lake itself - I think there are boats you can hire, but you can barely see anyone doing it.For activities around the lake - I would recommend visiting the Pagoda, grabbing an icecream - or going to the Sofitel bar to overlook the lake (particularly at sunset).It's really beautiful and quite nice to escape from the chaos of the city here.

reviews.author: bluebelltoursvietnam
reviews.title: West Lake - nice to see sunset
reviews.content: West lake is the biggest one in Hanoi and West Lake is where local people hang around. It is the best to visit west lake early in the morning where you will see different of Hanoi. Local set up early morning markets beside the lake, along Thanh Nien Road. You can also visit the lake in the afternoon to experience sunset. The best way to enjoy the view is go to some cafe at the corner of Thanh Nien Road and Pho Duc Chinh Road. Drink is cheap. The best is get to the cafe on 22nd floor of Sofitel Palaza Hotel. You will enjoy stunning views of Red River, Hanoi City ans West Lake but of courses the drinks are expensive. Enjoy

reviews.author: Tuula P
reviews.title: Hanoi
reviews.content: Very nice area. It's nice to walk araud the lake. Beatiful parks and flouwers araud .I did nice fotos  of the lake and old tempelit in the middle of the lake. There are also many shops .

reviews.author: Cecil M
reviews.title: great places around the lake
reviews.content: At the lake you can take a couple of pictures and you can go to the turtle temple. The lake it self is not so much of the attraction but what is all around it. Go for a walk around the lake early morning, visit the café's, Shops, Restaurants and Bars alone the banks. If you lazy take a rickshaw bicycle around the lake, just be aware to confirm the price before hand.

reviews.author: Andy T
reviews.title: Beautiful lake.
reviews.content: We walked down to  West lake and watched the early morning exercise classes,ndividuals going through rigorous routines. In the evening. The restaurant on the lake was a great place to eat in the evening. When the sun almost gone this time, west lake is the most beautiful. This lake very airy and large to sightseeing the view.

reviews.author: Susan O
reviews.title: The Lungs of Hanoi
reviews.content: Could not believe the size of this Lake, Take a leisurely drive around the lake to get a good insight into Hanoi life. Made more pleasant by the gentle breeze off the lake.Many places to stop, temples, street stall etc..

reviews.author: Flora W
reviews.title: It's not an attraction...
reviews.content: It's just a big lake. There's nothing to dislike about it, but this really shouldn't be something you go out of your way to see, unless you really like lakes. It has little natural beauty and is very much like every other Hanoi lake.

reviews.author: Việt Hùng
reviews.title: Wrong Pictures
reviews.content: In the intro picture is the Turtle Tower (Tháp Rùa), which located in the middle of Sword Lake (Hồ Gươm). Please upload the right pictures of West Lake (Hồ Tây).Nice view of Sunset at West Lake btw.

reviews.author: Lahiru P
reviews.title: Beautiful Place
reviews.content: This is one of beautiful and relaxing place in Hanoi VietNam. Hoan Kiam Lake. Must visit place. You can relax as much as you wanted with Thrilling atmosphere...

reviews.author: superbReviewer
reviews.title: Biggest Lake!
reviews.content: Do visit the Oldest Pagoda which is situated near the lake if you ever visit the lake. It is very huge and is just a long the roadside. You can get to experience the noisy traffic of Hanoi too.Opposite the Lake sells local ice cream, do stop by for a bite to help you fight the hot weather of Hanoi. it is also a very good place to go for a short run!

reviews.author: TeacherHanoi
reviews.title: well worth a cycle round in good weather
reviews.content: One of the best ways to experience Hanoi life is to cycle round the west lake, hire a bike and give it a go, fine weather is essential otherwise it becomes a bit of a chore.

reviews.author: HeidifromHahndorf
reviews.title: Looking for a run in Hanoi?
reviews.content: If you're taking your running shoes on holiday in Vietnam you WILL get a reasonable run around West Lake. We started at the pagoda and ran about 7km... hour hotel staff said that was probably about half way. Felt safe, even on the roads in that area, and there are kilometres of paths next to the lake. Take some money and enjoy a post run coffee / breakfast. We got a taxi from the Old Quarter and back.

reviews.author: Greg B
reviews.title: Very impressive
reviews.content: I walk through here and have watched for a long time, a symbol of Hanoi, my friends have told me about the history of Bo Ho, a legend or, so is to stop and relax , very nice

reviews.author: emily h
reviews.title: most beautifull area in hanoi
reviews.content: Yes its Hanoi's largest lake, located right in the center of Hanoi, West Lake is rounding with many gardens, hotels, restaurants and other entertainment centers.Eating price of areas near West Lake is not cheap. Biking  the surrounding in sept is good option

reviews.author: Tomo_Crtl
reviews.title: Quite nice
reviews.content: Its a beautiful, romantic area at nights. In the daytime, it somehow losts its own beauty. At night, however, u can enjoy the breeze from the lake, romantic lights coming from bars, restaurants around. Profiting coconut juice and some snakes while lying on the long chairs at the lake is just so relaxing!

reviews.author: patiria
reviews.title: I expect more
reviews.content: Just normal, the biggest lake in Hanoi. All things for children was closed so we could not make him fun. Very calm and lazy time there.

reviews.author: BritneyTim
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: Rode around this lake at sunset on motor bikes and it was incredible!! The lotus flowers were not all blooming yet but the ones that were smelled so nice!

reviews.author: Laura T
reviews.title: Fresh air
reviews.content: It's ok, romantic environment, fresh air but the price here is a bit expensive. It's good for friend meeting. better in the evening!

reviews.author: Daniel C
reviews.title: Excellent to go
reviews.content: You must go first to the Tran Quoc pagoda. Then if you can come back one night to take a drink on the top of sofitel Hotel, or at highland cafe, you will enjoy the beauty of the city by night.

reviews.author: Martina A
reviews.title: looks like a different Hanoi
reviews.content: if you arrive to Westlake after a few days in the centre you will be blasted. nothing to do with the rest of the city, a very relaxed area. quite easy to walk around, less motorbikes zooming and a lot of nice places to get food from.

reviews.author: Kevin J
reviews.title: Need a break from the pollution?
reviews.content: Oh West Lake, where have you been? It is so refreshing to go from the hustle and bustle and pollution of the downtown core to this lovely open space with lovely breezes and a whole different pace of life. If you are looking for up-scale hotels go to this area but you're going to pay for the luxury. There's a beautiful pagoda area that sticks out into the lake. Highly suggest this area for a visit or part of your stay in Hanoi!!!

reviews.author: Jenny C
reviews.title: So much to do
reviews.content: There is so much to do and see around the lake. Just look at it on a map, it is huge! There are so many restaurants and shops right on the shoreline it is worth exploring. Take your time and enjoy.

reviews.author: allasiatravel2000
reviews.title: Beautiful lake in Hanoi
reviews.content: West Lake is very beautiful Lake that offer a lot of thing to see around the lake, you can visit Tran Quoc Pagoda, Quan Thanh Temple or having lunch at Banh Tom Ho Tay right on the lake. Surround the lake is nice place to sit down and relax.

reviews.author: JollyBee2012
reviews.title: Maybe good at sunset
reviews.content: I have been at Ho Tay (West Lake) a few times over the last 20 years and mostly at day time. As long as you stand not to close to the water its a nice place to be and at sunset surely romantic. But standing a bit closer you can smell the lake and see old paint-pails and other stuff  in the water. The side walk is a bit damaged as well. Over all it could need a little makeover and some cleaning.

reviews.author: LYen24
reviews.title: Awesome sunset view
reviews.content: Ample of benches at the park beside the lake; perfect for family, couples and friends to hang out. A relaxing place and perfect spot to view the sunset. And it is easy to hop on to a cab as well! Just that one might have to walk for a few minutes to get a proper meal. Only Coffee Bean and other similar high-range eating outlets are available nearby.

reviews.author: GlobeSupernova
reviews.title: Enchanting
reviews.content: Lovely lake and walk around it. Take your time. it is worth it. Sadly when I was there it was very misty but charming and mysterious in its own way.

reviews.author: Steve D
reviews.title: Best on a motorbike
reviews.content: Great to ride around the lake on a bike and enjoy the variety of sights and sounds. Weekends can be busy but then this is Hanoi and when isn't it busy?

reviews.author: GreenInfinity
reviews.title: nice walk but very crowded
reviews.content: It's a typical lake in the city and the heart of the community. I didn't find it exceptionally special. It is a good place to see what the local do in the evening.

reviews.author: prrepaid1992
reviews.title: very cool
reviews.content: from old quater you can take taxi about 15 minute to west lake you can try duck response in west lake,or eat some thing also good

reviews.author: pascal9011
reviews.title: amazing
reviews.content: it is a great place to visit in Hanoi when you have time. This is the biggest lake in the city, surrounded many restaurant on the boat. From the boat you have nicest scenery to take photos.. it is also an ideal place for people  to exercises.

reviews.author: helenl
reviews.title: pretty area but dead fish depressing
reviews.content: Lovely area, doesn't really feel like you are in Ha Noi anymore and there are some interesting restaurants, pagodas and fun little side streets, but the lake is full of garbage and when I was there it was also full of dead fish. Kind of sad.

reviews.author: Raintree_Thailand
reviews.title: Surprisingly large lake inside city
reviews.content: Hanoi has may lakes, but none bigger than West Lake.  It's surprisingly large, offering lots of opportunities for hiking, jogging, or just enjoying the scenary.  Surrounded by restaurants and condominiums, this is a more up-scale part of Hanoi.  Personally, I prefer the chaos of the Old Quarter, but this area is nice to visit for a relaxing dinner or to escape from the noise and bustle of central Hanoi.

reviews.author: hoangvl
reviews.title: Hidden monument at the lake bank
reviews.content: As you walk along Thanh Nien street (between West lake and Truc Bach lake), you will find a small, subtle stone monument by the lakeside commemorating the shooting down of future U.S Senetor John McCain during the American bombing of North Vietnam in 1967. It displays a carved figure of McCain with his arms held up in surrender and the inscription reads: "On October 26, 1967 in Truc Bach Lake, the people and military of Hanoi captured alive U.S. Air Force pilot John Sney Macan, whose A-4 jet was shot down onto Yen Phu electric plant". I have heard an intersting story that when visiting back to this site, the old senetor was really upset because the Vietnamese got his military branch wrong as John served as a fighter pilot in the U.S Navy, not U.S. Air Force (His father and grandfather were also top admiral naval officers and he is very proud of his family tradition). Very interesting monument in Ha Noi and sad to see many people, tourists and locals alike, passing by unaware of its presence, let alone its meanings.

reviews.author: panglaofanatics
reviews.title: The center of town
reviews.content: You find most restaurants and shopping  close to the Westlake. We had dinner one night in a restaurant overlooking the lake. It was drizzling and there were colorful lights around the lake. It was quite romantic....

reviews.author: conrohap
reviews.title: Big lake
reviews.content: This lake have view realy nice and beautiful, have 1 pagoda with name is Tran Quoc Pagoda so good, you con discovery about burha and buhist in vietnam and you can go to smaller boat on this lake, so wonderful

reviews.author: Jacqueline P
reviews.title: Another great lake in Hanoi
reviews.content: I like it that this West Lake has many restaurants around it as well as Old Temples. They have a beautiful park as well, for you to rest your tired feet. The two temples as well are worth visiting.

reviews.author: Traveller_Chelly10
reviews.title: Great area to walk in the evening
reviews.content: There is a walking area right around the lake, the best time to go is early evening to watch the sun go down and it is the coolest time of the day.  The reflections on the lake are very beautiful, and there are plenty of photo stops, there are cafes along the route and you will see local Hanoi people out and about enjoying the lake area.

reviews.author: Ihyrg
reviews.title: The best way to see West lake by bike!
reviews.content: It is the biggest lake in Hanoi, the best time to see in the early morning or  late afternoon around 4pm to 6pm! If you are lucky you can see sunrise or sunset! The best way to see it by cycling!

reviews.author: phuketswain
reviews.title: Nice place for evening time
reviews.content: Good place for couples evening time having coffee. Very good place some local people fishing as well there also some coffee shop.

reviews.author: Keith T
reviews.title: Nice Place for Hotels and Entertainment
reviews.content: West Lake is not the lake in the Old Quarter! This lake is farther out of the city to the west (doh!) and represents an "area" of Hanoi. It's a larger lake with many restaurants, night clubs, and hotels in the vicinity. It's especially active at night. Take a look at reviews of the many restaurants in the area and check it out!

reviews.author: Knarf_from_Gent
reviews.title: Nice in the morning
reviews.content: You can't miss this lake, especially if your hotel is in the Old Quarter as it is just next to it. Try to go there in the morning, it is rather funny to see people jogging, doing Tai-Chi and fitness in group at 5.30 AM (because then the weather is cool) ;-)

reviews.author: Morgane D
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: At first i thought west lake was just a regular lake because i had seen it during the day; but one of my friend used took me there at night to get a drink and it was so much nicer! There's plenty of bar with a great view on the lake (a little hard to find) or you can just seat right next to the lake and enjoy the view and the nice fresh air!

reviews.author: ssg99_99
reviews.title: sunset at west lake
reviews.content: beatiful view of hanoi city. a huge lake, very nice view of sunset. many local food stalls around. and a good green walkway all around the lake.

reviews.author: EmillyStephenie
reviews.title: Nice place!
reviews.content: romantice for person who falling in love!Very beautiful scenery and a wonderful place to go if you want to pedal around the west lake on a swan boat. We didn't do this however we went to a place overlooking the water. It was quite an outdated restaurant and we didn't order any food as we were apprehensive to it's quality. However the drinks we received were good. Most of the restaurants don't look great overlooking the west lake. I would go elsewhere to eat.

reviews.author: njaneardude
reviews.title: Long Walk
reviews.content: It's a long walk around the lake and the sidewalk can be pretty iffy at best. Expect big crowds and on Saturdays bicyclist by what seems like the thousands, Nice views all around. Worth a visit/

reviews.author: Isaac S
reviews.title: Natural beauty
reviews.content: Suggested this place to be the best among in Hanoi. If you do no have much time to visit some places outskirt of Hanoi, West Lake is the best choice to save time within Hanoi city. Highly recommend this area and West Lake should be some of the nicest lake in the world inside city center.

reviews.author: Katie C
reviews.title: A great spot in the city :)
reviews.content: The lake is a very peaceful and quiet place to visit and i surrounded by cute boutiques, nice restaurants and cafes.The Tortoise Tower is staggering from all views (do yourself a favour and see it from all around the lake). The temple to the North of the lake is very nice and interesting and only a dollar to go in! With a sweet guy creating calligraphy signs on request to bring luck/success/ love etc.

reviews.author: Fran W
reviews.title: Quiet spot away from crazy city
reviews.content: Lovely quiet spot about 15 minutes out of Hanoi .Great restaurants, massage places . We stayed at the Sheraton which over looked the lake .Loved watching the locals swimming in the lake , beautiful homes and architecture was very interesting .

reviews.author: Thoughtful100
reviews.title: Cycle round the eastern side
reviews.content: We cycled round the lake, great idea.  Our hotel arranged the cheap but good cycle hire, otherwise we would never have found the place once there.  It took us 5 hours to get round including a few dramas, a leisurely lunch and several temples/pagodas and drinks along the way.  4 hours would cover you without our dramas.  2 hours would be the fastest a normal non-cycling tourist might do it if you were to stop and look at one or two things.It would be just as good to cycle up and down the east side - the west side was much worse in terms of road traffic, whereas the eastern side was nearly traffic free.  The eastern side had some very real, lovely faded, slightly run down temples and pagodas and then there are the two prime ones on the southern end.  You can see them as you cycle by and you just go in and wander round - mostly free.  The east side and the north end have huge fields/ponds of lotus flowers and the largest eastern field has a lovely cafe/restaurant where you can take drinks out on delightfully rickety pontoons.   Only locals ate there, no tourists except us.  You can see the verandah of the cafe from the road at the other end of a large lotus field and then you need to cycle a little inland following your common sense to find the entrance. Carry in inland a bit further and then bear left when you can will bring a couple of more temples into your trip.  Totally empty places, serene and other worldly in a non-bling way.We ate at a floating restaurant on the north tip  - very real, all locals, no tourists, just seafood straight out of the lake, fantastic shrimps and water snails.  The fish looked great too.And yes, our little drama ... We had our bag snatched on the west side.  Rookery error, should have known better, but it felt so safe and we had been cycling for hours without any sense of threat prompting us to drop our normal guard.  It was grabbed from the front basket of the bike where it lay unsecured.  A passing moped came up from behind and lifted it as we cycled along.  Ah well. Let's not hold it against lovely Vietnam and its gentle trustworthy people.

reviews.author: HappyBusselton
reviews.title: Great for a Morning Walk
reviews.content: We stayed in the hotel on Westlake and it was beautiful and peaceful.  Went for a big walk in the mornings around the lake.  The people doing Tai Chi and exersing are so friendly to say good morning to.  So pretty to look at also, can walk for miles without even noticing how far you have gone.  Lovely

reviews.author: WeweTu
reviews.title: For Guests staying at Sheraton
reviews.content: For Guests stayin at Sheraton... Just on coming out of the hotel turn left towards the Lake there is a small strip of few restaurants, bars or beer Joints. People do gather here for Beers/Drinks in the evening with the local Ground nuts. Limited Choice of Food but u can order including Pizza's from other places who deliver there.Towards the right there is Good Bakery with some simple food but closes early.

reviews.author: 1962Maurice
reviews.title: Rainy day for us
reviews.content: What was meant as a nice walk around the lake, turned out to be a water ballet. Actually it was amusing, what happens in the poring rain.

reviews.author: Terry R
reviews.title: lovely lake
reviews.content: A good place to experience a Hanoi morning, where you can watch people doing some morning exercise and enjoy a peaceful atmosphere before rushing hour turns Hanoi into a noisy metropolitan.

reviews.author: Aitele
reviews.title: Land o' Lakes
reviews.content: Westlake is the best ordered and prettiest of the many lakes which adorn Hanoi. Wonderful for impromptu picnics.

reviews.author: helpchlz
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: Very beautiful scenery and a wonderful place to go if you want to pedal around the west lake on a swan boat. We didn't do this however we went to a place overlooking the water. It was quite an outdated restaurant and we didn't order any food as we were apprehensive to it's quality. However the drinks we received were good. Most of the restaurants don't look great overlooking the west lake. I would go elsewhere to eat.

reviews.author: Erica M
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.content: We got a electric car and rode around the entire lake . It is so interesting and as you travel around thenAre the scenery changes ...the air is cool and fresh and there are many good restaurant,s around the lake

reviews.author: Lyn112
reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.content: Well worth a visit for sure it's very beautiful and is a nice and relaxing place to go take a stroll or have a seat and admire the views.

reviews.author: Anna L
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.content: I've been in Ho tay so many times and loved to enjoy ice creams then chatted with people there. Fresh wind was amazing

reviews.author: AppleAdam
reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.content: I loved the peace and tranquility early evening of people just relaxing the day away. This is a MUST

reviews.author: sophandjim
reviews.title: An unexpected surprise
reviews.content: Visit the alley ways around the Tay Ho district of the West Lake. There are some amazing doors and gates, not to mention some pleasant discoveries like the The Hanoi Bike Collective.

reviews.author: cdonn19
reviews.title: Quiet retreat
reviews.content: If visiting Hanoi a walk around this park will show you how peaceful this busy city can be. Plenty of places to sit and enjoy the peacefulness.

reviews.author: shazstep
reviews.title: A little bit of peace
reviews.content: It is a lovely place to walk around.  Still be careful with belongings.  Here you can stretch an arm out without hitting someone.  It was a useful landmark as we walked the streets.

reviews.author: Chris101111
reviews.title: North of the Old Quarter
reviews.content: Away from the busy Old Quarter, south end has lots of floating restaurants, you can walk all the way around or take a short cut.Worth visiting and great accommodation in the area.

reviews.author: gborotraveler
reviews.title: Huge Lake Loads of Expats
reviews.content: So west lake is huge. This is where the bulk of the expat community lives so more modern in many aspects. Small amusemt park with roller coasters water slides etc. We stopped at the huge lotus fields for photos. This wwas awe inspiring when you get out in them and see just how vast they are. Also if out this way there are several ice cream places. We had a sundae made from chocolate/green tea/coconut ice cream was delicious. Short taxi ride out to the area.

reviews.author: ganeshWinnipegCanada
reviews.title: Take a taxi to the 36 Streets of the Old Quarter but stay out at West Lake!
reviews.content: The West Lake and Tuc Bach Lake area of HaNoi are a real escape from the frantic pace of the area around the 36 Streets or the main roads linking all parts of this bustling city.  In the morning you can walk arcross the dike to a lovely little pagoda, the Tran Quoc Pagoda.  Continue on and you will find all kinds of coffee and ice cream shops near to the Daoist temple, Quan Thanh Temple.  You can rent a swan shaped paddle boat or just sit and watch the sunset.  There are any number of excellent restaurants - must admit I prefer the smaller Truc Bach Lake because it is much more manageable.  If you are looking for bars and late night action you will also find any number of local establishments as well as the big hotels in the area.

reviews.author: GriffinZZZZ
reviews.title: West Lake - A huge freshwater lake of Hanoi
reviews.content: On the side of Thanh Nien Road, the West Lake is the best place for tourists to escape the heat of summer. It is incredible when you and your lover are walking along the lake. Especially, visiting West Lake will be non sense without eating "West Lake Ice cream" on Thanh Nien Road, opposite Tran Quoc Pagoda.

reviews.author: Vonkhan
reviews.title: Gorgeous!
reviews.content: Next time we come to Hanoi, we will definitely stay here! This place is beautiful, serene, there are pathways to walk around and it is generally an upscale area. I can't believe no one told us about it - this is definitely the best area to live in.

reviews.author: Stefan J
reviews.title: Nice relaxing place, good for photo
reviews.content: Nice and relaxing place where you can take photos, though not offering much more. Apparently John McCains plane went down here during the Vietnam War. There is a coffeehouse, in a very narrow building with a balcony on the 7th floor, close by which is the best way to experience the lake.

reviews.author: Ricroch22
reviews.title: Nice view
reviews.content: Pretty lake which was located close to our hotel.  Lots of options for food + shopping.  We tended to walk from shop to shop to get an icecream or a drink during the day but nice to sit and enjoy the view also.

reviews.author: Erlan2013
reviews.title: Twin Lake
reviews.content: I like this place because of the story the making of this lake. You men and women in Hanoi work hand in hand to renovate this lake together in contribution to their lovely city

reviews.author: Kylie794
reviews.title: Nice area to stroll around
reviews.content: West Lake may smell, however it is a great area to stroll around, especially the smaller lake. You can visit a gorgeous temple on the road between the two lakes as well as visit a real coffee shop! You can ride the swans on the lake in summer and there are some great cafe/restaurants overlooking the swans/lake. Sit upstairs and enjoy the view.

reviews.author: 42lulu42
reviews.title: worth visit in the night time
reviews.content: went there by accident. i didn't know that it was west lake. surrounding by bars on boat shape, its really something and unique design. its quite far from center but i prefer to go there on night time to see the flash of building around and took photograph of it.

reviews.author: pauldeb_13
reviews.title: Very impressive
reviews.content: This is a lovely lake, very big and you can walk as far as you want to.  There are many impressive buildings to see on the skyline.

reviews.author: cyrildason
reviews.title: Awesome place to relax and enjoy the breeze
reviews.content: A lovely place to enjoy the breeze of the city.  Gets very populated in the evening when temperatures are lower.

reviews.author: CosmosTravelVietnam
reviews.title: Exciting place to explore
reviews.content: Leisure walking on the bank of West Lake gives you an opportunity to indulge into daily activities of local people. You have a half day interesting to explore Tran Quoc pagoda, Quan Thanh Temple and West Lake in the fresh air and atmosphere.

reviews.author: ancyancy
reviews.title: Ok...
reviews.content: We stayed at the Intercontinental Hotel which is right by West Lake.It is cute and much quieter than the Old Quarter area, but it definitely is lacking the local bustle. There are some restaurants around the lake, but you get the vibe that it is mainly for the expats who rents their apt around the lake. Unless you are nearby, I don't see why you need to make this a destination.

reviews.author: Prakash51
reviews.title: Worth the time
reviews.content: We took the open electric minibus ride around the lake. It lasts one hour and has recorded commentary which is sometimes inaudible because of street noise. However, it takes you all around the lake and you get to see all the lakeside attractions, which is difficult otherwise.Do be careful though- I lost my camera on the open minibus. I guess it fell out of my pocket onto the street.

reviews.author: Sulaiman
reviews.title: Enjoy walking
reviews.content: This lake is good enough for a short walk. Its great place IF the vietnamis take care of it, it is not clean and the smill is not good. Although you will enjoy walking there.

reviews.author: Confused_ExpatHanoi
reviews.title: Come for the views, stay for the swan boats
reviews.content: While the water is incredibly dirty and often smelly in the summer, many an expat prefers to live in this neighbourhood thanks to the nice breezes and great views.  There are quite a few quiet areas where you can go for a stroll and stop off for an ice cold drink if your feet get tired

reviews.author: caipirina
reviews.title: Hanoi's lung and free fitness center
reviews.content: This lake is a blessing and fun to ride around by bicycle (16km, on mainly low traffic roads), depending on time of day one  can see lots of joggers, cyclers and other fitness nuts around. At dusk smart entrepreneurs wheel in their food stands, provide tarps and lanterns by the water and sell food and drinks.Unfortunately the lake is very polluted, but not dead yet (as evidenced by the many hoppy fisherman pulling out live fish from the lake), more adventurous characters even swim in this lake. In regards to water sports, this lake is still untapped and the main activity seems to be kayaking, but I also spotted 1 lonely wind surfer, one boat dragging a water skier and 2 dragon boats on a race. In one corner there is a rental service for swan shaped foot peddlers.The views over the lake at sunset are fantastic!

reviews.author: SSQuah
reviews.title: Trấn Quốc Pagoda
reviews.content: The Trấn Quốc Pagoda is reputedly the oldest pagoda in Vietnam. Once located beside the Red River, the temple was relocated to a small islet on the West Lake. When we visited Hanoi in May, the city was in the midst of the Wesak celebrations and this pagoda was filled with visiting Buddhist monks from far and wide.

reviews.author: alex p
reviews.title: wonderfull
reviews.content: from hanoi you can take moto bike or taxi about 50 km .its wonderfull i was enjoy my time there. so many old house some house they were 400 years old and some 300 so on........

reviews.author: Phua W
reviews.title: Nice View
reviews.content: Unfortunately the morning when I was there it was drizzling.  Apart from that,  the walk is good. The place is quiet and scenic in the middle of the busy city.You can also see many locals exercising.

reviews.author: MrsSuisse
reviews.title: Nice area to escape busy downtown Hanoi
reviews.content: It's a nice lake situated about 10 minutes via taxi, from the Old Quarter. There are plenty of restaurants and shops around the lake and some water activities are available too. It also has a few very nice hotels if you prefer a more peaceful location while visiting Hanoi.

reviews.author: Bucefalo_Simi
reviews.title: rent one of those swan boat :-)
reviews.content: west lake is a charming relaxing place, especially if you rent one of those cute swan boat and u start pedaling far from the border.. atmosphere is nice and relaxing and u get a different view over the city! nice to spend a couple of hours and get some nice pictures!

reviews.author: Jacqueline A
reviews.title: A little slice of Paris
reviews.content: Take a tranquil stroll around the lake. Watch the local Vietnamese relax playing a game of checkers or sipping a frozen delight at the cafe along the lake. A must if you really want to relax from the hustle and bustle of Hanoi.

reviews.author: Martin P
reviews.title: Place to relax
reviews.content: This is a nice area - especially if you decide to walk to Trấn Quốc Pagoda that is just at the coast - or Phủ Tây Hồ temple.  Close to Trấn Quốc Pagoda is The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf where you can enjoy western quality hot & cold beverages.  Enjoy it - and forget you are still in big city.

reviews.author: 447Wang
reviews.title: Not too bad
reviews.content: the west lake is not too bad. It is very tranquile.

reviews.author: howlermonkey415
reviews.title: Serene getaway from busy Old Quarter craze
reviews.content: Worth seeing if you want to get away from the usual hustle and bustle of Old Quarter (which is where we were staying). Suggested itinerary: You can plan 1 day starting promptly at 8am at the Temple of Literature, then Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum Complex (we skipped the actual viewing of Ho Chi Minh due to the hugely long lines), botanical gardens, then explore West Lake by walking along Thanh Nien bridge. You will pass by 2 beautiful pagodas (great photo spots). There are swan paddle-boat rentals also for 80K VND per hour.There are a spreckling of restaurants (with lots of seafood options) and ice cream shops on the bridge. We ordered a "sundae" with 3 ice cream flavors topped with a chocolate wafer roll from a small shop that only carried Vietnamese menus. (We pointed at what other people were ordering instead of trying to decipher the menu). It cost 25K VND for each ice cream trio. We sat along the waterfront which was charming and peaceful. From there we took a taxi to the Sheraton Hotel area (38K VND) It's lakeside location makes for a quiet and beautiful stroll. You can check out the Xuan Dieu Roan for Western and French foods, even a shopping plaza (where we enjoyed coffee and Banh Mi at Highland Coffee) Finish up in that area with a massage at Yakushi Center (but make an appointment, especially on weekends!). We caught a cab back to Old Quarter for 70K VND ($3.50 USD).Refreshing waterfront without the crowds. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: kengoi2102
reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.content: Been here in the afternoon time , all the scenery was so beautiful , so natural , so relaxing. Walking all the long Thanh Nien str feel the fresh  lake wind , also can see a lot of people fishing here. Should try the Prawn cake in the famous Prawn Restaurant (BBanh tom HoTay) right on the THanh Nien str. A nice place to relax

reviews.author: Grant2508
reviews.title: Do not be afraid of English speaking students
reviews.content: We have done a fair bit of travelling and it is always with trepidation that when approached by locals your original thoughts are "what do they want",Our weekend walk was punctuated by meeting young people sent to practise their english on the tourists, we met some charming young people that by learning english a world of opportunity opens for them.We had excellent fun and it was enjoyable, we also had an early morning jog around the lake just watch the not so level footpaths.We also met a lady with a beautiful dog that had been kidnapped and held for ransom.We would have not had this fun if we had not engaged the people we met

reviews.author: blenden_12
reviews.title: Nice place
