I came just before the peak hour so I was able to savor the food and the place, but soon got crowded with mostly food tour groups. Fairly priced, with a bonus of the gleeful assistance of their staff. Definitely worth it!

reviews.author: Francesca Z
reviews.title: Ottimo Bun Cha
reviews.content:
They made us sit on the second floor with traditional tables. We chose the traditional bun cha with fried pork, pork spring roll, vegetables and rice noodles.
Everything should be mixed together and enjoy!

reviews.author: David T
reviews.title: Bum Cha Ta"A Hidden Gem"
reviews.content: Bun Cha Ta is a hidden gem in Hanoi, serving the best Bun Cha in town. Despite its simple setting, the restaurant was bustling with customers, a testament to its popularity. My wife and I loved the authentic flavors. Highly recommend for anyone craving this iconic dish!

reviews.author: W128
reviews.title: Bun Cha-tastic
reviews.content: Bun Cha-tastic. How great was this place. Went upstairs. Aircons, fans and cold beer. Then combo 1. Bosh. Bosh. Bosh. Fresh noodles. Greens. Charcoal griddled pork. Dip Into the bowl of garlic - whack it on lettuce and greens, bung a piece of pork in and wrap and then eat.  Nom nom nom. Greens into broth. Noddles into broth. Chilli Billy. Nom nom more. Cracking cracking place. Get involved!!!

reviews.author: Phillip
reviews.title: Good food and nice atmosphere
reviews.content: Very good food. Will definitely recommend taking nutshell soup with pigs. Cool atmosphere and nice staff. Great prices in the center

reviews.author: Ka S
reviews.title: Local cuisine to try
reviews.content: We had dinner at this place the first evening we arrived in Hanoi, on the recommendation of the hotel receptionist. Street food served in a simple restaurant, on two floors, they made us sit on the upper floor; before entering the room you take off your shoes.

reviews.author: Dev D
reviews.title: Cheap and delicious
reviews.content: This spot is absolutely perfect for a quick dinner. The Bun cha was absolutely delicious  (the spring rolls particularly). It comes with all the usual accompaniments (fish sauce, chilli, garlic) so you can tailor it to your flavour pallet). Service was friendly and the food also came really quickly.

reviews.author: Egay M
reviews.title: Our Bun Cha Ta Experience
reviews.content:
Came here for lunch.

Classic Bun Cha
Grilled Pork with Noodles. Pork was mostly lean. Well seasoned. Grilled well done. Soup is delicious, inherits the smokeyness of the grilled pork. Noodles slippery smooth. Vegetables and herbs fresh. Lime and a bit of chili enhances the flavor.

Fried Spring Rolls
Doesn't look pretty but tastes good. Good accompaniment to Bun Cha.

Overall, Bun Cha Ta is a good experience.

reviews.author: SerpentSermon
reviews.title: Great Lunch Out
reviews.content: This place was so interesting, because it's like you're sat in the floor of the first floor of somebody's house. The stairs are defiantly a bid steep. However, it's not really a negative until after a few beers. The food is fantastic, full of flavour and very fresh. The staff are friendly and very quick. It feels very personal because there are only 3 or 4 tables upstairs. The price is insane! I couldn't believe how cheap this was for such good food. You are talking about £35 for 5 people including beers. Unreal. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Marc B
reviews.title: Great Food, Allergen Friendly
reviews.content: The best food I ate in Hanoi. They specialise in Bun Cha as per the name and nail it. Everything is gluten free which was great for me as someone with dietary restrictions. Price is cheap. The girl at the front is lovely and speaks great English.

reviews.author: PHOAustralia
reviews.title: Not what we expected
reviews.content:
We first experienced with Bun Cha was 15 years ago in Hanoi and we loved it.  We have had it many times in Melbourne. 

However, the style of BunCha at this place was not to our liking as the pork was already soaked in a bowl of sweet soup. I prefer the style where you build your own bowl with noodles, lettuce, herbs and dipping sauce.  The spring rolls were nice. 

I also didn’t like taking off my shoes (top level of the place) for the seating particularly as it directly outside a toilet that is need of a very good clean.

reviews.author: Kevin C
reviews.title: Upset stomach; dirty; inattentive!
reviews.content:
Place was dirty and full of tourists! Cash only? 

The guy who was in charge of showing me to my table sat there and did not pick up the dirty plates and mess left by the other customers. Instead his phone was more important!

I also ended up with an upset stomach after the visit. 

Never again and I recommend you head elsewhere. 

Michelin? Maybe they were confused with rating it against their tires!

reviews.author: sandy
reviews.title: Delicious, fast and friendly
reviews.content: They are super, super quick with the food and respond when you have any requests. The food is super delicious!!! The service is very friendly. So I would definitely recommend it! The spring rolls are an absolute hit!!

reviews.author: DXB_Maple
reviews.title: Best meal in Hanoi
reviews.content: This was our favourite meal in Hanoi. The flavour was delicious and it tasted so fresh!  Our non-advenurous eater (tween) also loved it. The whole family agreed!

reviews.author: nicolasfre
reviews.title: A must
reviews.content: For less than 6 euros you surely have the best bun cha there is. To do absolutely. Recommended by a tire guide and we know why!

reviews.author: ciaran1sheridan
reviews.title: Good Bun Cha option in Hanoi
reviews.content: Tasty Bun Cha experience in Hanoi Old Quarter. Good paced service, helpful staff & generous helpings. Worth a visit & recommended.

reviews.author: Inna
reviews.title: Delicious lunch in a cozy cafe
reviews.content: On the first day in Hanoi, we drove around a lot, looked for where to change money, and looked around the city. We were very hungry and wanted to try some local Vietnamese cuisine. We did not regret choosing this cafe. We were greeted well by the staff and escorted to the place where we should eat. The room was not very large, on the second floor. You had to take off your shoes before entering the room. We were seated at a large table that could accommodate more than 10 people. As a result, people of Asian appearance sat next to us and had a nice conversation. We asked the girl what she could recommend to us from the menu. In the end, we settled on the traditional bun cha dish. I chose with pork, my companion with chicken. The dish included noodles, fresh herbs, spices and a rich, sweetish hot broth. I recommend visiting this cafe, it is very cozy, they will tell you about traditions, and you will have a good time and eat delicious food

reviews.author: NTN
reviews.title: Michelin Meatballs
reviews.content: It is no coincidence that in the Michelin guide everything is amazing and everything is 100% Local, the meatballs are a must and the price is the lowest possible

reviews.author: B L
reviews.title: Recommend.
reviews.content: Found this place through Trip Advisor and it didn’t disappoint. I ordered the local Hanoi bon cha soup with the sampler spring rolls plus beer and rice whisky. My food was yummy and fresh. The place was clean and the hosts nice.  Recommend.

reviews.author: Caroline
reviews.title: Delicious and tasty
reviews.content:
Super delicious food, we all bought their signature dish which consists of a pork soup with rice noodles and spring rolls on the side. It was really delicious and even the clear soup had a lot of flavor.

The staff were also really nice and smiling.

reviews.author: Meilan
reviews.title: First meal in Hanoi
reviews.content: First meal in Hanoi and it did not disappoint! We had the Bun Cha and an order of spring rolls. The broth was savory with tiny hints of tanginess. The grilled pork was cooked perfectly and accompanied so well with the fresh herbs and noodles. Meant to take pictures, but was so hungry that I devoured most of the food before I remembered to take a pic. Overall a very satisfying meal. Very reasonable prices, but cash only.

reviews.author: lnk1402
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.content: Extremely disappointed, the food was acceptable, and great value. Do not understand the Michelin recommendation at all

reviews.author: Emma H
reviews.title: Must try Hanoi’s Bun Cha here!!!
reviews.content:
Perfect place for authentic bun cha. There are multiple storeys where you can sit on the floor or on lowered tables depending on your comfort. The food was made from such fresh ingredients. Bun Cha is a must try in Hanoi! 

Thank you to Vinh for teaching us how to authentically eat Bun Cha!!

reviews.author: Ella
reviews.title: The best meal I ate in Vietnam
reviews.content: As a coeliac, I loved eating here as everything on the menu was gluten free! I'd highly recommend the bun cha with tofu and ordering extra vegetable spring rolls. It was amazing to eat spring rolls without fear of cross contamination. The menu is not labelled as gluten free, but I first came here as part of a food tour where my Vietnamese tour guide spoke with staff to confirm it was safe to eat as a coeliac. I loved the food so much we visited again on our last night. This restaurant has an interesting layout, as the tables and chairs are set into the floor.

reviews.author: BunchOfLilies
reviews.title: THE place for bun cha
reviews.content:
In my top 3 meals on our whole Vietnam trip. Excellent quality bun cha and absolutely delicious. The spring rolls were also exceptional. Service was flawless and prices reasonable. There was a food tour here when we came so also a good sign how great it is. Wonderful dining experience I could not fault a thing.

If you’re looking for bun cha in Hanoi, this is the place.

reviews.author: George M
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.content: Local color and food to write hone about. The soup was spectacular. Service was great and prices are extremely reasonable Highly recommended

reviews.author: Laura
reviews.title: Everything gluten free and so good
reviews.content: You have to try it! Everything is gluten free (the fried spring rolls too) and it is so yummi. It is so great to find a place were you can eat safely when you have celiac’s disease. We went there twice because we liked it so much. Plus, the location is pretty lovely

reviews.author: Helen Carr
reviews.title: Bun cha specialty restaurant
reviews.content: Traditional authentic restaurant.  Small menu. Must visit to try the local specialty of bun cha. Family owned and operated.

reviews.author: AndreasBrok
reviews.title: Excellent street food type place!! Must eat!
reviews.content: The place is quite underrated when you see it from outside. But going in is something that you must do. The choices are simple but they are super rewarding. I have never eaten pork grilled like that anywhere in Vietnam. Super tasty!!!

reviews.author: iznogoodgood
reviews.title: To discover
reviews.content: Very warm welcome and fast service in this restaurant where the specialty is Bun Cha which I did not know. Soup composed of several ingredients (meatballs, rice noodles, spring rolls, salad, etc.). It’s surprising but, for my part, I liked it without more. To discover.

reviews.author: Michael T
reviews.title: Authentic Vietnamese food
reviews.content:
When I mentioned to friends that we’d been to Bun Cha Ta, their first reaction was “not the one Obama had been to”!

Wife and I didn’t know which restaurant the former president had visited but we love the food at Boon Cha Ta. It is a very popular local restaurant which has a very simple menu.

We’d ordered their signature white rice noodles with fried pork and side dishes of fried spring roll (seafood and vegetarian versions). 

The white noodles and vegetables were served separately so we dipped the noodles and vegetables into the pork soup. Tasted really delicious.

Bun Cha Ta is located in the Old Quarter and was within walking distance from our hotel at Hoan Kiem area.

Staff are friendly and prompt. 

Overall this is a recommended place if you’re in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Vicki H
reviews.title: Fabulous Bun Cha!
reviews.content: It’s a small unassuming place to eat but seriously great Bun Cha alongside excellent service.  We thoroughly enjoyed our visit and we would definitely recommend and return!

reviews.author: M3Traveller
reviews.title: A great place to experience local lunch or bun cha!
reviews.content:
Read about here on Michelin Guide, rated Bib Gourmand and wanted to try something traditional and local to Hanoi.

A very “rustic” feel - we were seated upstairs and it’s shoes off and seated at sunken floor tables. 

The food was delicious - we had the traditional house dish (bun cha, obviously!) and flavours were excellent. Staff explained what it was and how to eat it (add garlic and chilli!).

A great experience for relaxed lunch - and very very reasonable!

reviews.author: Fatima C
reviews.title: Tasty food
reviews.content: Super attentive staff, they recommended the dish to us, the price was very good and the place was very simple. We were sitting on the ground floor but the lady told us to go up and stay on the first floor (more pleasant). It's really worth it because the food is very tasty and fresh.

reviews.author: Mari K
reviews.title: Great food, multiple floors
reviews.content: Cozy place, great food!The restaurant is bigger than it looks from the street as there is a second (and a third?!) floor! We had spring rolls and bun cha - yum!

reviews.author: GenieC
reviews.title: Don't miss this!
reviews.content: Few items on the menu but DELICIOUS from first bite to last.  Don't miss this if you're near old town.  If I had three thumbs, I'd give them 3!!

reviews.author: Clayton J
reviews.title: nice tradional food
reviews.content: nice restaurant serving a traditional food in Hanoi.This kind of food is so famous, the Us president had used it when he came to Vienam

reviews.author: MartK
reviews.title: The best is the view from the second floor
reviews.content: We didn't like it. The beef was stringy and greasy, untypical for beef. The fried spring rolls were too. Overall, too expensive for the quality. The visitors were all tourists, mostly accompanied by tour guides. The stairs up to the second floor are dirty and sticky. The view from the top of the bustling street is interesting, but that's not enough for a good rating.

reviews.author: Alwyn
reviews.title: Full of flavour
reviews.content: We tried a few places but this was our favourite bun cha.  Very flavourful gravy, the grilled and minced pork were to perfection in my view.  The owner and service staff were very knowledgable and polite.  We were there for 5 days and when here 3 times.  the place is small so be a bit patient or go a little off hours.

reviews.author: karoo91
reviews.title: An explosion of flavors
reviews.content:
I went to bun cha to taste my first bun cha. No regrets about my choice, the dish was excellent, as were the spring rolls.
The young waitress was very friendly and smiling and very available to explain how to eat this dish.
Excellent value for money 130,000 dg bun cha + 2 spring rolls + 1 beer

reviews.author: cassie h
reviews.title: Bun Cha at it's BEST
reviews.content:
Absolutely fantastic. We were recommended a few places to give Bun Cha a red hot crack as the dish of Hanoi and this was by far the best. So good we wen't back twice in 24 hours. (And yes, this is way better than Obama Bun Cha which we was good but not worth the hype). 

Food was balanced and fresh. Served in a cute two storey family run establishment, 100% ask for a seat upstairs - you'll see why! 

Service was on point with our orders taken quickly and food delivered within minutes. I would recommend enjoying the #1 combination bun cha & 2 x spring rolls. I have never had spring rolls as delicious - will really struggle back in Sydney now!

Bonus points - the team did not even ask for a review which for anyone who has travelled Vietnam will know is a rarity and why so many places are rated so highly (sometimes unjustly). Makes it very challenging to find the best spots. 

Hope you enjoy as much as we did :)

reviews.author: Fangqi_A
reviews.title: Great introduction to Bun Cha
reviews.content: Went for a late lunch. We ordered grilled pork bun cha, which was served in a soup with plate of vegetables. Grilled pork was flavorful and tasty. The host was patient in explaining how to eat the bun cha. Will recommend this eatery.

reviews.author: Yolanda R
reviews.title: Success
reviews.content: We went to try the typical bun cha and we were right. The place has charm, the staff is friendly and explains how to proceed. The food is abundant and tasty.

reviews.author: Carlota
reviews.title: Great! A must in Hanoi
reviews.content: Great food! Original Vietnamese restaurant with very good bun cha. We didn’t expect such a great atmosphere and welcoming. Definitely recommended! 😊

reviews.author: Lars V
reviews.title: Very tasty food and friendly service
reviews.content:
Very tasty food and friendly service.
Fair price and large portions. I can definitely recommend it!

reviews.author: Marie R
reviews.title: A very good place to taste Bun cha Hanoi
reviews.content: Very good Bun cha Hanoi, we really enjoyed our meal! Prices have increased slightly (110,000d). A charming welcome as often in Vietnam!

reviews.author: familieX
reviews.title: Tasty Bun Cha
reviews.content:
Our guide took us to this restaurant to let us taste Bun Cha. The open space on the 1st floor is nicely decorated.
The Bun Cha with grilled pork was tasty.

reviews.author: Eva
reviews.title: Bun cha at the top
reviews.content: Awesome food, friendly staff, delicious bun cha. Loved the top room with table carved in the floor. Rolls are deli too. Highly recommend

reviews.author: mr g
reviews.title: be careful of the vegetarian bun cha
reviews.content: The pork bun cha was good, nice and balanced.  The vegetarian bun cha broth was way too sweet and barely edible (I think they kept the sugar the same but left out the fish sauce).  Stick to the carnivore offerings.

reviews.author: mamacita1001
reviews.title: Very disappointing,,,,
reviews.content:
This is a TA place. You don’t need to go.

Bun Cha is just disappointing.
It can’t be 100,000 for that quality and the portion.

Deep fried spring roll isn’t good at all as it isn’t filled with much meat and veggies. I found a lot of space in it. And they are rather small.

Bun Cha doesn’t come with many vegetables in the soup and on the side. 
I don’t get why and how this place has got good reputation. 

Far from "best" Bun Cha, this is my opinion.

Tiny amount of Vietnamese rice wine is served in the end as complimentary but the price of it should be already included in the price of Bun  Cha.  (100,000 dong)
As I had to wait for my room (of a hotel) to be ready, I had egg coffee as well. It is also disappointing. You can’t tell if it is just coffee or egg coffee. If you have already tasted authentic egg coffee, you won’t think it is egg coffee. It is just sweet coffee.

reviews.author: Sadie M
reviews.title: Fantastic food -and helpful staff
reviews.content:
Recommended by our hotel - helpful staff, nice dining room upstairs , they ask you to remove shoes . Restaurant with ac.
Food was great- we went option 1 which was rice noodles and herbs that add into a clear soup with pork (meatball and strips of pork) . Accompanied by 2 fried spring rolls . You can add garlic chilli ginger fish sauce as condiments to taste which worked great for the teenagers . Option1 cost  120 000 vnd

reviews.author: Steven
reviews.title: Good buncha
reviews.content: Great food, fast service, reasonable and clear pricing. Visited here three times during my 1 week stay.

reviews.author: benjaminng2016
reviews.title: Enjoyable lunch
reviews.content: The place is clean and the food is tasty. The price is reasonable and the service is good. The local goes there too besides we tourists.

reviews.author: Sophie P
reviews.title: Would definitely recommend
reviews.content: Our first experience of Bun Cha and it was a good one! The service was amazing, we loved the food, and tried their rice wine whisky and got a taste of their dads home brew - delicious.

reviews.author: Sholto D
reviews.title: Good place for Bun cha
reviews.content: Grill pork and spring rolls were excellent. It's very close to our hotel then easy to go. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: KeithChan69
reviews.title: Great tasting local street food in the comfort of a restaurant.
reviews.content:
This is the first time I tried Bun Cha after seeing many on the streets. 
With couple kids in tow this restaurant was a great place to accommodate our needs and taste buds yet without the hustle and bustle of the streets.
The food were so good we finished every bit.

reviews.author: Camper52591290704
reviews.title: Good
reviews.content: Bun cha is a traditional Vietnamese dish that is very delicious, the water and vegetables are very fragrant, the restaurant is clean, and there are delicious drinks

reviews.author: dmct123
reviews.title: Don’t go anywhere else for Bun Cha
reviews.content:
Recommended by our guide and also seen the reviews on Tripadvisor and it certainly didn’t disappoint.
Incredible and authentic.
If you visit Hanoi…this place is an absolute must try!

reviews.author: Richard W
reviews.title: How many 5 star reviews for Bun Cha Ta.
reviews.content: Looking for a good place with traditional food I found Bun Cha Ta in Hoi An. I read the reviews and thought surely it can't be that good, but we gave it a go and WOW, the food was fantastic. Simple broth, noodles and pork slices and patties, but the taste of each element was amazing. We had traditional spring rolls as a side dish and an explanation from the staff of "Bun Cha". The restaurant may seem a bit far out of the old town but from the waterfront it is probably less than 10 mins walk and you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: Piotr M
reviews.title: very good food
reviews.content: very good and tasty food served in this restaurant, not too big choice, but that's good because the dishes are great

reviews.author: Thuy
reviews.title: The best food in Hanoi !
reviews.content:
Food was pretty amazing. We had the Bun cha with seafood nem. 

We stayed in Hanoi for 3 days and everyday we went back here each day. The customer service was so nice!

reviews.author: Andreas
reviews.title: Amazing food and atmosphere
reviews.content: Authentic and amazing Vietnamese food. We had the Bun cha full option and everybody loved it. Plenty of food to a reasonable price. The atmosphere was also really good and the service was great.

reviews.author: Grace R Saporsantos
reviews.title: Bunchafave!
reviews.content: one of our favorite food in Vietnam the Buncha! we will miss this and we will definitely come back because of this dish!

reviews.author: Alyssa B
reviews.title: Amazing gf traditional food!!
reviews.content: Came here after seeing all the reviews and we weren’t disappointed!! Such a cute restaurant with friendly staff, the whole menu is gluten free so I felt very safe eating there. The Bun Cha was so good we came back for dinner again the next night. Highly recommend the deep-fried veggie spring rolls and tofu!!

reviews.author: Marthafebi C
reviews.title: Good location and experience! Tasty food and coffee
reviews.content:
Unique taste. The meat is tender and grilled perfectly with white noodles and lot of veggie. But soup is sweet - might not suitable for savory lovers like me. 

You can find traditional, or seafood spring rolls. Although not so distinguished in term of taste. 

The sticky yoghurt is so gooood. Love it!!
The coffee is good
The chocolate is too sweet

But worth the visit since the location is strategic and near every where

reviews.author: Melissa O
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha in Hanoi!
reviews.content: Wow. The Bun Cha was sooooo incredibly delicious. 2 bowls and 2 sodas for $12 USD. You cannot beat that. And the waitstaff was lovely. Highly recommend for a quick, casual meal!!

reviews.author: hanz95
reviews.title: Great place for first timers
reviews.content: Great place to try Bun Cha for the first time. The menu is set up for first timers, and the friendly staff tell you how to eat it when it is served. We shared one between two as the serving sizes are generous! Probably a bit pricier than other places but given the service I think that’s warranted!

reviews.author: Mamouchka
reviews.title: Delicious food!
reviews.content: Went there to try the Bun Cha as many forum recommend it. Well… it was worth it. The bun cha and the spring rolls were delicious. The service were great (as expected). Make a stop if you close by, you won’t regret it.

reviews.author: Jollyjumper22
reviews.title: Bun cha experience
reviews.content: I ate bun cha in Hanoi and every place I went to, serves delicious bun cha. This place was no exception. The only difference is that this restaurant probably visited by many tourists so the price is quite more expensive than other bun cha restaurant.

reviews.author: Krishna
reviews.title: Must try restaurant at Hamoi
reviews.content:
Must try. I would have certainly missed something incredible if I hadn't visited here for dinner. 

Food style is something I have experienced for the first time. Seating arrangement is also quite unique and soothing.

reviews.author: Amanda
reviews.title: Yummy for lunch
reviews.content: In love with buncha. So tasting with fish sauce flavor.  You must try spring rolls. Nice staff and lovely place. We will come back

reviews.author: Janine T
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha Ta
reviews.content:
Based on our love of Bun Cha and reading reviews decided to walk to BunCha Ta. 
Chose Bun cha full option and was 5/5 for flavour. You are able to select chilli and garlic to your own comfort level. 
The staff gave instructions to us and others how to mix the spices, noodles and herbs into the broth.
At the end she gave everyone a small shot glass of Vietnamese white wine whisky??? and got us to say Một, hai, ba, dzô!’ Nice way to end the lunch. 
Definitely recommend this place!!!!

reviews.author: Piotr H
reviews.title: Best bun cha in Ha Noi
reviews.content: This is the best meal I’ve had in Viet Nam so far. The meat was tender and flavourful. The soup was rich. Spring rolls were to die for. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ron Chio
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha. Must try!!!!
reviews.content: They have a restaurant in Hoi An which was amazing. I coincidentally stopped by their restaurant in Hanoi. Absolutely amazing 😋 Ha was so nice and very cheerful. The Bun Cha here is one of the best I’ve had ever. I totally recommend this place. I’ll be coming back for sure.

reviews.author: Eric H
reviews.title: One of the best meals in Hanoi
reviews.content: Extremely friendly staff and amazing food! Without a doubt one of my favorite meals I’ve had so far in Vietnam. Bun Cha was super flavorful and the price was fair at 100,000 VND.

reviews.author: Soo
reviews.title: not recommend
reviews.content:
food just so so, nothing feel wow about this bun cha, very pricy and many bloger wrote on them but i think they paid for them. not even a local visit their restaurant, we ordered all their expensive meal which have their bun cha and all type of spring roll, but they dont taste any better than the street food, i really not recommended.

没什么好吃的，食物普普通通，和街边的没什么分别。没本地人吃，都是游客客。和外面的贵2倍，我点的都是些最贵的，没什么特别。每个客人我看他们都吃了两口就跑了。不推荐

reviews.author: SS2510
reviews.title: One of the best meals in Vietnam
reviews.content: Amazing meal thanks to our food tour. But loved it so much that went back another time. For a vegetarian they were amazingly accommodating. Strongly recommend - choose #1 for meat lovers and #6 for vegetarian (remember to tell them no fish sauce). Thanks Jenny for taking us

reviews.author: Peter
reviews.title: Bun Cha Ta Hanoi
reviews.content:
It was based on Google reviews that led us to Bun Cha Ta. The staff is friendly and welcomed us with cheerful smiles. The soup is somewhat sweet for my liking but otherwise it is quite delicious. The price is really cheap, Vdn 100,000 to 125,000. I tried several other bun cha better than this and its the reason I would not rank this  as
more than 3 stars. No harm checking it out if you have no idea where to go.
There is another bun cha which the locals called it Bun Cha Obama. That’s because Obama and Anthony Bourdain ate there.

reviews.author: bethiahope
reviews.title: Delicious simple food with such kind people
reviews.content: We were recommended to eat here by our hotel on our first night in Hanoi. It was our first meal in a six week tour of SEAsia and I still Renner how lovely the people were and we really enjoyed the meal. It was delicious, a sweeter broth than expected but that’s what travelling is about. I highly recommend this restaurant. Thank you for being so kind to us as fresh westerners!🙏🏻

reviews.author: Sean C
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha in Hanoi
reviews.content: Best Bun Cha we’ve had in Vietnam. Staff are friendly, food was delicious and the vibe was lovely. A must do if you’re in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Christian
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha in town
reviews.content: Excellent dish, good service, literally, full of food, everything is awesome. Tasty and super yummy, worth to visit. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: fal3
reviews.title: Delicious!!
reviews.content:
A great way to try Hanoi’s most famous dish!

The meat was very tasty. I’m not a fan of rice based noodles but I really liked this. Note this place focuses solely on bun cha, and I can imagine the the sweet and sour flavours may not be for everyone. The only complaint was the food wasn’t that hot.

The staff were excellent and spoke English very well. They clearly get a lot of foreign visitors. A true example of great customer service, which is rare in Vietnam these days.

reviews.author: fnarby
reviews.title: Excellent quality and service
reviews.content: Thank you for an excellent meal of Bun Cha this afternoon. The food quality was excellent and our server was wonderful. Thank you for the rice wine to celebrate the new year. I highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: TonyM277
reviews.title: Worth a visit
reviews.content: Lovely food, good size servings.  Friendly helpful service.    A variety of options available and positively it was a completely Gluten Free menu which was helpful for some of the family. Appears to be a tourist only establishment

reviews.author: CrabisGOOD
reviews.title: Linh is awesome! Great bun cha!
reviews.content:
We randomly chose this restaurant and it did not disappoint. We sat on the second floor and ordered number 1 and number 10. The service is EXCELLENT! Linh is awesome. His English is excellent. He was so helpful. Made suggestions on what to eat and made the experience so great.

We sat on the second and had to take off our shoes, which wasn’t something I liked, but overall it was well decorated with good ambiance.

It is affordable!

reviews.author: Bruce2467
reviews.title: Yummy Bun Cha!
reviews.content:
They serve the best bun cha in town. Quick and friendly service!
My family went back 3 times in a week. Can't get enough of how good Bun Cha is!

reviews.author: Lou
reviews.title: Copious good and pleasant service
reviews.content:
One of my favorite Bun Cha, I often take the recommended dish (the first one) I make discover it to each person who comes to see me in Vietnam because I find the setting very nice! Go to the floors if you go there.
All the waiters are very pleasant and especially very nice.
I highly recommend it!

reviews.author: vivianPham
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha in Hanoi
reviews.content: This restaurant is a must. They get a lot of tours and bookings from influencers for their food popularity. Our family was recommended by a guide book. We went and didn’t leave the restaurant disappointed. The Bun Cha was so delicious and fresh that our family came back the next day to have more of it!

reviews.author: llhleon
reviews.title: Last dinner of our Hanoi trip
reviews.content:
Really like this place, which we went to for our last dinner during our Sapa/Hanoi holidays. It's located not far from our hotel in the old quarters. Made a booking via whatsapp which was promptly attended to. Arrived earlier than appointed time but was seated without issues. Service from the young-ish staff was friendly and welcoming.

We ordered the 'full option' plus a seafood springroll. I only remember having bun cha once before on a previous trip to Vietnam, but i certainly don't remember it being this good. When served, we were told how to enjoy the dish. The herbs, and rice vermicelli, the springrolls and BBQ pork sang in unison when dipped in the sauce (primarily fish sauce). Really good.

After the meal, we ordered 'happy drinks' of rice wine whisky. Smelled potent, but thankfully, it did not come close to knocking us out.

reviews.author: CCTEXAN08
reviews.title: Awesome food
reviews.content: The food was fresh and flavorful.  Cool seating arrangement, the staff was super polite and friendly.  Highly recommend this location.  Ms. Ha was very friendly and welcoming! So delicious we went back for more!

reviews.author: Lindsay N
reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.content: I had a very tasty vegetarian meal here and Jenny who served us was delightfully pleasant and very helpful. An all round great experience.

reviews.author: Samantha C
reviews.title: Great food and excellent service!
reviews.content: We came here as it was highly recommended by our hotel. Excellent food and the service by Anna was great!

reviews.author: Mathilde L
reviews.title: Favorite restaurant in Hanoi!
reviews.content: So delicious I went back 3 times! My favorite Bun Cha in Hanoi. Vegetarian options were just as delicious as meat options. Staff was exceptionally friendly and attentive. Cannot recommend enough!

reviews.author: Cat
reviews.title: Amazing bun cha!
reviews.content: I fantastic restaurant to taste Hanoi’s signature cuisine.  Delicious food and wonderful staff. Great for celiacs!

reviews.author: Aylin
reviews.title: Great
reviews.content: Anna is super friendly hehe. It was actually my first bun cha and I really enjoyed it. Very nice food, very good service. She gave us some advice for activities. ☺️

reviews.author: Nicky S
reviews.title: So good!
reviews.content:
This was our first Bun Cha experience and it did not disappoint. The food was delicious and we loved the spring rolls. Service was great, shout-out to Anna who answered our questions promptly and ensured e had everything we needed.

Thank you!

reviews.author: William munro
reviews.title: 21 Nguyen Huu Huan street
reviews.content: Great traditional very friendly restaurant . Staf were lovely espciallally Anna our server . The food was fresh and delicious as well as reasonably priced . Will definite be back for more.

reviews.author: Cheryl Wang
reviews.title: Unexpected delicious street food!
reviews.content: The food is just fantastic and Anna is super nice taught us how to have the spring roll in the right way. Exellent experience!

reviews.author: Pien K
reviews.title: Lovely restaurant great food and service from Diem
reviews.content: We had a really good time at this restaurant. The service from Diem was great, she made sure we had everything we wanted. Would totally come back.

reviews.author: Sofia M
reviews.title: Very good food
reviews.content: The food is simple and delicious. The waitress super nice. I recommend a visit to the restaurant in Hoi an. ❤️

reviews.author: Joseph T
reviews.title: Absolutely Scrumptious
reviews.content: If you are looking for good Bun Cha in Hanoi, look no further! Bun Cha Ta Hanoi serves delicious, well-made Bun Cha in an air-conditioned room with attractive decor and friendly staff. We enjoyed the food, the banter and the overall atmosphere of this place and will be coming back next time we visit. At the end of our meal, they even offered us a small shot of local alcohol as a traditional chaser to the dish. Five stars!

reviews.author: Nita
reviews.title: Delicious food and lovely staff ^^
reviews.content:
first time for eat bu cha.
staff name is “diem” explained about food and good service to me.
Bun cha very delicious. !!!

reviews.author: Honor E
reviews.title: A very popular place for authentic Bun Cha!
reviews.content: What seems to be a very popular place to eat in Hanoi! Great to experience authentic Bun Cha! The service was 5*, Diem (the girl serving us) was super helpful and attentive…we even got a complimentary sample of their Vietnamese rice whiskey!

reviews.author: Emer
reviews.title: Fabulous Food and Staff
reviews.content: We just ate here this evening and the food was amazing. Our waitress Diem was so helpful and friendly. Such a lovely girl and a lovely place to eat. Very reasonable also. I recommend Bun Bha Ta very much and thank you Diem for great service.

reviews.author: Leannie
reviews.title: Seems very popular
reviews.content:
We came here early evening on sundat and were initially concerned we would not get a seat at all the tables were taken, but we were then instructed to follow the waitress up two flights of stairs to the third floor where eventually we found a floor with space!
The menu was varied and I liked the bun cha with spring roll combo with a few cold beers. The only thing that was a little off putting for me was the lady assigned to our floor every time she took an order just stood at the top of the stairs and shouted the orders at the top of her voice to the kitchen - was a little annoying, as well as just standing there by the door watching everyone eat - a little bit off putting! But overall not bad bun cha and nice spring rolls especially the seafood ones.

reviews.author: Jit Wei K
reviews.title: Fantastic food
reviews.content: The broth was extremely flavourful and the spring rolls were great. The waiter also gave everyone in the restaurant a shot of their house brewed rice wine (on the house of course!) which was a nice touch. Definitely recommended!

reviews.author: Claire A
reviews.title: Best food in Hanoi
reviews.content: We found this place after looking at a bunch of reviews on the internet and I can honestly say it was the best meal we had in Vietnam. If you’re in Hanoi this place is a must visit!

reviews.author: Richard Koh
reviews.title: Hanoi Authentic Food in Old Quarter
reviews.content: Went to this restaurant from a recommendation of our hotel front desk staff.  They serve authentic Vietnamese food, e.g. rice flour noodles, grill pork fried spring roll, grill seafood spring roll etc.and has been open for over a decade. Their service was great, food was good and located at the Old Quarter. The owner, Ms Ha, was very wonderful. A truly recommended restaurant for you!

reviews.author: kilimama
reviews.title: Flavorful local food
reviews.content:
Excellent local food. The dining area is air-conditioned and very nice. The Bun Cha was delicious. The waiter Kai was so helpful and sweet. We enjoyed him as well.
Don’t miss sampling this local dish in the old Quarter of Hanoi

reviews.author: M&M
reviews.title: The BEST Bun Cha in town!
reviews.content: Without doubt the best Bun Cha i ate in Vietnam. Beautiful little restaurant with super friendly staff. I honestly think this was one of the best meals ive had ever. Absolute must visit and 10/10. Amazing.

reviews.author: Travelove58
reviews.title: Cozy, bright & nice decor, friendly service & good food......
reviews.content:
Street food in a very nice restaurant setting. We sat in a 2nd floor room, very cozy, with beautiful nice decor/ambience. The young man serving us was very enthusiastic & friendly.  Besides guiding us the right way to eat, he sat with us throughout & asked lots of questions.
The food is very good. Worth a visit if in Hanoi

reviews.author: Allie Gone Away
reviews.title: Excellent, EXCELLENT
reviews.content:
Such an approachable way to test the street food waters in Hanoi! Delicious, clean, and such quick service. Food was ready in minutes.
Vegetarian options are abundant and delicious!! Ask to sit upstairs for the best experience. 💕

reviews.author: Issy F
reviews.title: Bun cha ta-stic
reviews.content:
Walking away from Bun Cha Ta for the 2nd time in my first week in Vietnam, I can strongly recommend this restaurant to anyone in Hanoi who finds themselves bewildered by the variety of food on offer. Bun Cha Ta is the perfect place to start your journey - quintessentially Vietnamese cuisine with friendly, outgoing service. Khai, our waiter, even explained how to go about eating it! The staff are welcoming, the atmosphere is lovely, the interior (sunken tables and no shoes) immersive, and the food even better! 

***Bun cha is soup with noodles, greens, spring rolls and pork but it is so much greater than the sum of its parts.***

reviews.author: Sean I
reviews.title: Good quality of food, clean, polite servers
reviews.content:
If you are looking for the best restaurants in hanoi, you should come and enjoy :)
The server is really polite, talkative and she speaks english perfectly

reviews.author: Keon A
reviews.title: Great Food!!
reviews.content: I had never previously had the specialty Bun Cha Ta and safe to say I was blown away. The pork was really tender. The broth was swimming with flavour and the spring rolls were some of the best I’ve ever had. I would highly recommend coming here for a meal if you get the chance. The staff was also super friendly and attentive.

reviews.author: Ralf M
reviews.title: Great place for authentic Bun Cha
reviews.content: Authentic Bun Cha in Old Quarters Hanoi. Food was fresh and tasty! Staff was very friendly and helpful! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Juan V
reviews.title: Best Authentic Experience
reviews.content: Had a blast eating at this place. The staff is super friendly, and the food was amazing. They teach you how to mix the food together and the flavor just blows your mind. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Sid
reviews.title: Excellent and wholesome flavours
reviews.content:
The only one of two restaurants we came back to twice during our trip to Hanoi. The Bun Cha is excellent and extremely flavourful. A little on the pricier side compared to competitors, however, the portions are hearty. I suggest trying the “Traditional Bun Cha” over the other options on the menu. 

Pros:
1. Very clean and enclosed restaurant.
2. Very flavourful food with hearty portions.
3. Excellent service.

Cons:
1. None that I can think of.

reviews.author: Chris M
reviews.title: Excellent Local Food and History
reviews.content: We are a family from the US. The hostess at the restaurant spoke fluent English and was happy to share the history of local cuisine while explaining the menu.  The food was excellent the the price is reasonable.

reviews.author: Silje B
reviews.title: Delicious Vietnamese food and authentic experience
reviews.content: Delicious Vietnamese food and great service! Really recommend for those who want to eat typical local food in a have a more authentic experience.

reviews.author: Harps D
reviews.title: The best bun cha in Hanoi!
reviews.content: The bun cha at this restaurant is absolutely delicious and it's definitely the best I've had in Vietnam! I have already been here 4 times because it was so tasty! The family that run the restaurant are super nice and really helpful! For instance they will tell you how to eat the dish correctly if it's your first time having it.

reviews.author: agnese A
reviews.title: Best Buncha ever and lovely Amy!
reviews.content:
We found out Buncha Ta by chance, just browsing on the internet for the best Buncha in Hanoi, we couldn’t be more happy with what we found!

The food is amazing, we went there 3 days in a row and I still have cravings for it after 2 weeks back in Singapore! Go for the “Full Set” option to experience the full Buncha package, they also have vegetarian or pork free option that is not so common to find!

Aside the lovely food, Amy and her family’s kidness played a huge part!
Moved by her passion, Amy made sure everything was all right all the time, took her time to explain us how to enjoy at the best our meals and chat with us!

we are very thankful for the beautiful experience that you provided us and we really looking forward to visit you again as soon as possible! Take care Amy :)

reviews.author: Melanie B
reviews.title: Go Here!
reviews.content: It was suggested by our hotel that we go to this location for Bun Cha whereas many go to the one most known since Obama went.  However, this place is truly authentic and feels like such a local experience.  Food was fabulous and the server had good English and couldn't have been friendlier!

reviews.author: Robin1087
reviews.title: The best Bun Cha in Hanoi!
reviews.content: We craved for food and heard Bun Cha is a speciality in Vietnam. So we went to Bun Cha Ta. What an amazing experience. Thor - the restaurant owner - was so friendly and explained a lot about the food in Vietnam and how to eat Bun Cha. She was amazing! The food was incredible too! The broth and the pork were delicious and tasted fresh with all the herbs and rice noodles. We have limited time here in Hà Nội but when I come back I’ll visit this place again! Thanks a lot Thor! ^_^

reviews.author: Kiah N
reviews.title: Yum!
reviews.content: Delicious meal. The portions are huge, easily shareable. The servers teach you how to eat the dis which was fun. We tried the traditional version as well as the vegetarian option. Both were excellent.

reviews.author: TravellerRumi
reviews.title: What a find!
reviews.content: Never judge from the outside! We were sceptical going in as it was empty but it actually became full whilst we were eating. The food here is so authentic and genuine! It seems like a family run cafe/restaurant and they were very friendly to us. I'm coeliac and showed my coealic card so they made my food fresh. Didn't get ill afterwards!

reviews.author: Cel
reviews.title: Don't be fooled by the lack of people
reviews.content: I first ate here 2018 and it was PACKED all the time, nowadays it isn't very busy but it's still as AMAZING as before! As most places in Hanoi, this specialized in one thing only.  On this trip alone I ate 3 times (would've gone more if my family wanted something else lol). TBH don't even know what bun cha tastes like at other places because once I try and love something I tend not to try it somewhere else. Parents liked the passion fruit juice but I thought it was too sweet. The lady is also very sweet.

reviews.author: MartinH
reviews.title: Excellent Food & Service!
reviews.content: We went to Bun Cha Ta in early evening hours before the Water Puppet Show. The food was superb. Fresh, authentic local dishes, and very tasty. We each had spring rolls + pork or vegetarian soups with rice noodles and salad. The service was quick and friendly. Would also recommend the egg coffee there. Martin

reviews.author: Warren
reviews.title: Grilled Pork Rib and Spring Roll Soup at its finest!
reviews.content: If visiting Hanoi you absolutely must have lunch or dinner at this tiny but fabulous restaurant. And you must order the Bun Cha Ta Full Option. Eat slowly and enjoy immensely!!

reviews.author: TOSH22
reviews.title: Excellent food and service
reviews.content:
Most delicious bun cha with unlimited supply of fresh herbs , everything is just right in terms of taste and ambiance. Lovely setting and comfy place and we got to taste the seasonal homemade apricot drink and the owner, Amy, surprise us with a happy drink, Vietnamese whisky that hits the right spot.
Must visit 🤗💜

reviews.author: David
reviews.title: OK.
reviews.content:
Visited for dinner in Apr 22. The place focuses on a few menu items, so I went for what I now understand to Bun Cha.

It was pleasantly flavoured but I'm not a big fan of Pho/Noodle soup style dishes, so not something I'd normally go for, were it not for the restaurant's speciality.

Customer service was very good.

A downside was thay they didn't have any coca cola or pepsi zero/diet/light. A shame - all restaurants should stock it a low cal cola abd and they even have it on their menu.

reviews.author: Andrew
reviews.title: Bun Cha Ta
reviews.content:
Came here in the evening to find an empty restaurant. We have to asked is the restaurant opened?

I always feel uneasy with empty restaurant, is it the food is bad or expensive?

To my surprise the food is rather good. The restaurant is empty because locals only eat it for breakfast or lunch & not much of foreigners because the country just opened after 2 years of lockdown due to the pandemic.

The nem or spring rolls are tasty. Meats are BBQ just nice.

Good Bun Cha restaurant in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Adrian K
reviews.title: Absolutely Wonderful!
reviews.content: My family & I had the pleasure of dining here twice on our Feb 2020 Vietnam vacation and it was our favorite restaurant of our entire trip!  The Bun Cha was absolutely amazing and the best we’ve ever had!  The atmosphere was nice (we had the room on the second floor with about only 6 tables).  We had the same waitress, Thuy, both times and she was simply an amazing person.  She was so nice and took the time to get to know her customers.  We had some great conversation with her and even got to know the people at the table next to us.  The price was a bit more than most places we eat, but it was totally worth it!  We also had a meal at Bun Cha Huang Lien (the famous place where Obama dined with Anthony Bourdain), but Bun Cha Ta has them beat, so if you have the choice, go to Bun Cha Ta instead, you wont’ be disappointed!

reviews.author: ndcoach
reviews.title: Very good
reviews.content: I will start by saying I went to the place our president Obama had lunch today also I will compare the two first of all displays for the exact same meal was 40,000 dong more I would rate the other place at a 9 1/2 and I would rate this place had a solid eight or five stars to 4 1/2 stars for this page I will return here many many times since it’s only a five minute walk from my hotel and the other place is a 25 minute walk from my hotel everything was great I am just doing the solid comparison since I ate at both places in the same day

reviews.author: Lucy
reviews.title: Lovely staff.
reviews.content: After looking up online where was the best place to have Bun Cha we decided to come here, and we were glad we did. Bun Cha wasnt our favourite Vietnamese dish but Bun Cha Ta made it taste good. We found the staff were really friendly and helpful too.

reviews.author: Westportone
reviews.title: Fantastic local place
reviews.content: Excellent quality local Vietnamese bun cha. Basic restaurant with high quality food. Bun cha was flavors one and the combo spring rolls (we tried both pork and crab) were some of the best we experienced in Vietnam. Inexpensive for a traditional experience. Only one annoying point was one of the waitresses playing music on her iPhone right behind us.

reviews.author: Rochi7
reviews.title: Great place to eat vietnamese food!
reviews.content:
Food was really good! If you go, go upstairs, it's very quiet :)

People there was really nice, specially Thuy who taught me how to eat what I ordered and recommended me some cool places/restaurants.

reviews.author: Brian H
reviews.title: Street food at it's best
reviews.content: A small cafe with a small menu, under ten items on it. The food was  delicious pho based pork or vegetarian noodles with herbs and greens. Started our Hanoi experience here and finished it here too. Well worth a visit.

reviews.author: Ralf Oliv
reviews.title: Very delicious Bun Cha
reviews.content: The food was delicious. The server named Xuan showed how to eat the Bun Cha at the vietnamese way and how to pronounce the most important vietnamese phrases. I recomend this place to anyone who want to have a special experiance insted of just have a normal dinne

reviews.author: Rachel A
reviews.title: Tasty Bun Cha!
reviews.content:
Tasty Bun Cha with help how to eat if you’ve never had it before. Can get with different types of spring rolls on the size too. 100,000VND for Bun Cha and 2 classic spring rolls. Perfect. 
Went here for the first time on the Hanoi Street food tour and had to go again!

reviews.author: Kimberley
reviews.title: One word: Disgusting
reviews.content:
We had time for one final meal in Hanoi after travelling all over Vietnam and enjoying this country's incredible food and ate here after googling the best place in the city for bun cha, our fave dish.

I have no idea why this place has such good reviews - the menu is tiny, the restaurant is small and looks dirty and the food was absolutely disgusting. Our bun cha arrived with stale noodles, broth that smelled like pond water and meat that was squishy and looked like it had gone bad. After this meal we had to take a 16 hour flight back to London where we live and I was absolutely terrified that I was going to spend the entire flight throwing up. The worst meal we had in our entire time in Vietnam, don't eat here!!!

reviews.author: Cédric Ng
reviews.title: So good
reviews.content:
The food was so good and the staff was kind.
We saw this restaurant on a youtube video and we were no Disappointed

reviews.author: Simon0602
reviews.title: good food, very affordable and decent seating
reviews.content: If you want Bun Cha, this was the best we ate in town. Yes you can get a very good option at the roadside for VND45,000 (inc. spring rolls) rather than the VND100,000 you'll pay here but, for me, the herbs were fresh and more varied and you can get a beer to wash it down. It's on the food tour guides route when hosting Europeans but it's not a sterile westerners destination.

reviews.author: Georgie
reviews.title: All round wonderful dining experience
reviews.content: Delicious spring rolls, fresh herby vegetables, generous serving of fresh noodles, and tasty condiments. Additionally, wonderful service from Thuy, our waitress, who even explained how to eat the bun cha properly. Loved the quaint wooden seating arrangement on mats the second storey.

reviews.author: Sandra G
reviews.title: Tasty food, great value, 0 customer service
reviews.content: Great food for a reasonable price. Big portion. Customer service was quite poor. They seated us upstairs which was quite cold. We were the only customers sitting upstairs and the owner was hammering planks of food right next to us whilst we were trying to eat. We ate here because it was close to our hotel and we were quite hungry after a day of travel.

reviews.author: Kristina
reviews.title: The best Bun Cha Ta
reviews.content: The best Bun Cha Ta in Hanoi. I highly recommend! Here you can find very Good price and hight quality!

reviews.author: Wendy
reviews.title: Best food I’ve had in Vietnam
reviews.content: Best food I’ve had in Vietnam.  Highly recommend - very tasty and delicious.  Easy to find in the Old Quarter.

reviews.author: Linbaba
reviews.title: Very good bun cha in a characteristic place
reviews.content: Not much more to say beyond the title of this review. I really liked it as I liked the idea to share the table with other people. Many tourists but also some locals. I would definitely do it again.

reviews.author: Ana
reviews.title: Great traditional meal
reviews.content:
We had a great lunch in Bun Cha Ta, trying one of our first traditional dishes in Hanoi. The staff was really nice and welcoming and the food was also really good and tasteful.
Recommended!

reviews.author: Ash Cole
reviews.title: The best buń chà in Hanoi!!!!
reviews.content: The best buń chà in Hanoi!!!! Staff are super friendly & helpful. I restaurant is unique & clean. I recommend ordering the tofu in tomato. I’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Priya G
reviews.title: Great food and ambience
reviews.content: We went to Bun Cha Ta after reading a ton of reviews online and were very excited. Were we satisfied - YES! The second floor has an interesting set-up for seating and we really enjoyed the authentic experience. Our server was friendly and went above & beyond to make a friendly conversation with us. The bun cha was tasty in my opinion. My husband, who is not a fan of bun chas, thoroughly enjoyed his meal!

reviews.author: K&M rates plates
reviews.title: Beautiful noodles
reviews.content: Came here as part of a food tour to try the Bun cha ta, which are pork noodles. The restaurant is very authentic and the noodles were delicious.

reviews.author: udontnomee3e
reviews.title: 1st place we ate when we arrived
reviews.content:
Our hotel reccomended this place & we were impressed.  Cheap & yummy
They didn't have the fresh spring rolls available unfortunately but we will go back & try these at a later date.

reviews.author: MikeCMelbourne
reviews.title: Locals do not come here
reviews.content: Only tourists come here. Obviously you can tell this is not the best Bun cha around. I went for a food tour and the guide brought me to try bun cha and it was heaps better than this but saying that, this wasn't too bad. Serving size is small though albeit inexpensive. It is edible, waitress speaks good English. Easy to order. No fuss dinner in a cosy environment. As a tourist, I find this acceptable.

reviews.author: RALbby
reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.content: Simple but extremely delicious! We had the bun cha and it was our best meal in Hanoi yet. Recommend visiting.

reviews.author: Gail S
reviews.title: Great food!
reviews.content: We went here when we were staying in old quarter.  The food was good and the service was great.  If we had been there longer we would have gone back.

reviews.author: Emilie G
reviews.title: Average Bun Cha
reviews.content: Average place. The welcome was very friendly but the service rushed. Our waitress was kind to us for a few minutes and ask straight away if we could add a review on tripadvisor, give a good mark and add her name... The bun cha was tasteless, we had better ones in Vietnam. Mid-market price, not worth it.

reviews.author: Pom Ma
reviews.title: Overrated on Tripadvisor
reviews.content:
Totally overrated.
With the overwhelmingly positive reviews, I went for Bun Cha. The food was good but they’re not too great as it was praised on this site.
I literally went to a random restaurant and they had better food. If you’re staying at the area, it’s nice to drop by. But if you’re staying far from it, it’s not worth talking a cab all the way there.

reviews.author: NatO45
reviews.title: Tasty Bun Cha. Would Visit Again
reviews.content: The Bun Cha here is really tasty. The dish we ordered had pork meatballs in rather than slices of grilled pork like we'd had in other Bun Cha dishes. My partner preferred this to some of the other Bun Cha we'd had as he's a bit particular about fatty bits of meat. The portion of rice noodles that we were given was a bit on the small side however other than that, it was a really flavourful and good quality dish.

reviews.author: William P
reviews.title: Underimpressed
reviews.content: The reviews were good, so we decided to go. The food was OK, I had definitely had better Bun Cha. The service just seemed like they wanted us to finish and leave so the next table could come in.Overall experience was meh.

reviews.author: Astri Elise LEstrange
reviews.title: Great Vietnamese Food
reviews.content: Loved the food there, super tasty, feels very authentic, and loads of great vegetarian alternatives!

reviews.author: Xavi
reviews.title: Bunchacha licious
reviews.content: This place is great! We come here every time we have friends over. It's a nice warmer for a real food adventure. This time was even more fantastic because of the great service of Thuy, who made us extra happy (the delicious rice wine helped too). Chuc mung Nam Moi!

reviews.author: Nathan Q
reviews.title: Streetfood at it's finest
reviews.content:
The food bun cha ta full option and the rice wine were so nice!!!
We were served by Thuy. She was so nice, and her english was so good!
I recommend this place!!

reviews.author: Ani
reviews.title: Great food and service
reviews.content: We really enjoyed going to Bun Cha Ta. The food was delicious and our waitress Thuy was lovely, she was super friendly! We had a nice chat and Thuy also told us how to eat everything properly. It was great to enjoy some authentic Vietnamese street food.

reviews.author: Grace P
reviews.title: Not great.
reviews.content: No running water in bathroom. I told the waitress and she sort of just shrugged. Bun Cha was tasteless. Pork wasn’t grilled properly and was cold. We had Bun Cha on Beer Street and it was exceedingly more delicious. Disappointing - not sure why they have such good reviews.

reviews.author: A Partridge
reviews.title: Perfect Bun Cha
reviews.content:
Loved this restaurant for quick and delicious Bun Cha. There’s a good variety of meat and vegetarian options - would recommend the chicken spring rolls!  

The staff are really friendly and helpful with ordering.

Just know this is a casual restaurant with shared tables, no shoes and there are a few fruit flies but that’s just typical of a cheaper eat.

We paid 150K for a Bun Cha and the Tofu meal.

reviews.author: Danielle Y
reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.content:
Nice atmosphere and friendly staff. We were seated at the second level (think they occupy three storeys). The first level has normal table and chair. At the second level, you have to take off your shoes and you sit on the floor (not cross legged there's a "hole" in where the table stands and your leg dangles). Sorry, I don't know what it's called, and not sure if this is traditional Vietnam style. Seem rather Korean style.

We got buncha with fried shrimp roll (120000). Buncha alone is 65000. I don't think the fried shrimp roll was worth the price. Bun cha wise, it's my first time eating so I can't really comment much. It's interesting, haha. Definitely worth a try when you're in hanoi since that's the hanoi specialty. You can definitely find cheaper buncha elsewhere but this place is clean and the service is good.

reviews.author: Max
reviews.title: Great Bun Cha
reviews.content: The Bun Cha here was super flavorful and the greens were very fresh and nice. Thuy was awesome - she talked us through proper technique for taking down our bowls and spoke with us after our meal to give us her suggestions in the area. Thank you!

reviews.author: megnbyte
reviews.title: Great spot with tasty bun cha
reviews.content: The bun cha here is very tasty and fresh, and the service is very friendly. There is a nice and quiet space upstairs to enjoy your meal. Our server Thuỷ was very sweet and fun to talk to. Would recommend!

reviews.author: ET1334
reviews.title: Very fresh herbs and friendly staff
reviews.content:
The meal was tasty, herbs were very fresh and could be added themselves and the vegetarian spring rolls were delicious. The restaurant itself is clean.

Staff is very attentive. Thuy our host is a very nice and enthusiastic young woman. 

Minuspoint: the sink and floor in the bathroom were rather dirty.

I will surely recommend this to my friends.

reviews.author: Mats
reviews.title: Great good, nice people
reviews.content: Had an excellent dinner on our last night in Hanoi and we were kindly served by Thuy, who was friendly and helpful!

reviews.author: Euntaeklee5925
reviews.title: 맛있어요~^^
reviews.content:
Bun cha ta is good food and get great service~!! :)
Specially, thuy staff is very kindly and great service for our. 음식을 정말 맛있게 먹었습니다. 그리고 thuy 직원이 너무 친절해서 음식이 배로 맛있었어요~^^ 담에 온다면 또 오고 싶네요~ 정말 맛있어요

reviews.author: Pallavi Singh
reviews.title: Great Food !
reviews.content:
Tried the Chicken Spring Rolls + Rice Noodles 
Loved it ! The service is quick and food is quite tasty

reviews.author: tolot
reviews.title: Good atmosphere
reviews.content: There are multiple floors on this restaurant, i'd suggest eating upstairs for the atmosphere. You take your shoes off and enter the room. Food comes in fast. Waitress was really sweet, she even told us how to properly eat the food. After that she disappeared. The food was decent, definately not the best in Hanoi. You pay downstairs with the bill the waitress gives you with the food. Our bill was a total mess, wrong numbers, wrong items, and of course wrong price. Decent experience.

reviews.author: Christine W
reviews.title: Caters to tourists
reviews.content: I came here based on the good reviews. If you've never had bun cha before (we hadn't before coming here) this is a decent introduction, but it definitely caters to tourists and as such was extremely overpriced. The pork itself was not grilled well and was soggy from sitting in the sauce. You can find better (and cheaper) in the city.

reviews.author: hanauerl
reviews.title: Good bun cha
reviews.content: We came to this place on the Hanoi Street Food Tour and had excellent Bun Cha (grilled pork in a vinegar/honey sauce), which is their specialty. Nice clean place.

reviews.author: Anthony0909
reviews.title: Nice food and easy to find
reviews.content:
Nice food and good location 
Just to improve on table space and staff can react faster. Overall staff is nice

reviews.author: TravelBoy
reviews.title: Very tasty and healthy.
reviews.content: I came across this place by accident when walking through the old quarter and then when checking the reviews I realized I had walked into a highly rated restaurant, and I could see why. The Bun Cha ta was fresh and filling, the waitress gave me a run down on how to mix it all up to get the best out of the dish, the spring rolls and pork was just too good, highly recommend this place. The price is reasonable as well and it’s a nice and clean place.

reviews.author: TTP89
reviews.title: Okay restaurant for dinner / lunch
reviews.content: Had dinner here with the family after reading all the reviews. Food was fairly standard and the serving size was very small even for Hanoi. Seems a bit of a touristy spot, we could see the lovely waitress was very affable and kind in explaining the menu to first timers. If you’re new to the food this is a safe start but if you’ve had Bun Cha before there are much cheaper and tastier options around the city.

reviews.author: Linbaba
reviews.title: Very good bun cha in a nice setting
reviews.content: My first bun cha and maybe the best I had during my stay in Hanoi. The place was also cozy and give the opportunity to start chatting with the people around you.

reviews.author: Josi Emmerich
reviews.title: Nice traditional food
reviews.content: Bun Cha is a very traditional pork dish from Hanoi, one of my favorite Vietnamese food. They sell a very flavourful Bun Cha in a cosy environment and reasonable price.

reviews.author: Claudianaw
reviews.title: Really nice restaurant in Hanoi
reviews.content: I really like this place! The food is delicious and the staff are very nice! Special thanks to Thuy who is truly adorable! I recommend for sure 👍🏼

reviews.author: Debra S
reviews.title: Our favorite Bun Cha In Hanoi.
reviews.content: Our favorite Bun Cha In Hanoi. The place is not a great place to look at but the food is super fresh, super tasty and super cheap!

reviews.author: Heather R
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.content: Went to the restaurant for dinner, not lunch which not the norm for this type of meal,  staff were lethargic and bored in this humble food outlet. The Bun Cha was tasty but tepid. A female could be heard yelling repeatedly while at the same time new patrons were being turned away. Clearly they wanted to shut shop. We decided to get dessert elsewhere

reviews.author: Pei Ying W
reviews.title: Delicious food
reviews.content: Easy to order, spring rolls and bun cha were delicious!! There’s a set that includes everything that cost about 140k VND.

reviews.author: tjys
reviews.title: Look at the place I’m recommending!!
reviews.content: First the good. It was fairly easy to find. There were a lot of places to sit because there weren’t many people in the place at 1200. The food was pretty good and it was served quickly. Now the down side. It was fairly expensive considering the other Bun cha places we’ve eaten and we only got about 2/3 the serving size of the place below for 25% more in price. Go to Bun Cha Gia Truyen!! It’s a hole in the wall place that was packed for lunch by locals. We were underwhelmed by Bun Cha Ta and saw this place on our way back to the hotel. GO TO BUN CHA Gia Truyen!!!  You will not be disappointed!!

reviews.author: pdr28
reviews.title: Simple food done well
reviews.content: Previous reviews say it all.  The restaurant continues to deliver tasty Bun Cha and nice service .  Well worth stopping for a meal

reviews.author: Brandon
reviews.title: What an experience!
reviews.content: What an experience! However, I am not sure what was better. Was it the amazing food or was it the outstanding friendliness service. Thuy was amazing! Thanks again!

reviews.author: Rebecca Barison
reviews.title: Amazing food and great staff,
reviews.content:
Amazing food and great staff, the venue itself is really cute.
The food is incredibly tasty and Truy was a great host/waitress, I wish the best of luck for her in the law school, I’m sure she will be a great lawyer one day!
My dream would be if they changed the coriander for parsley 🤣 (I hate coriander) hahaha
Best buncha!

reviews.author: 321orh
reviews.title: Very good buncha
reviews.content:
I always come back here
Simply delicious
Thuy is super nice every time!
Worth visit. 
When u are here drop by

reviews.author: RKJP
reviews.title: The best food I had in Vietnam
reviews.content:
The best food I had in Vietnam (and I did multiple food tours).

You could walk past this place and not entertain it... but trust me, the recommended meal, number 1 (100,000 - Bun Cha and veg spring rolls) was phenomenal.  

The toilet was minging, but thats Vietnam for you.

This place was top notch!

reviews.author: Jt271191@gmail.com
reviews.title: Amazing food coupled with amazing service!
reviews.content:
Was recommended this place by a friend and was not disappointed!
First experience eating Bun Cha and the staff were incredibly accommodating, advising the correct way to eat it!
The food was fantastic and had a lovely chat with Thuy afterwards who made sure I had a nice experience.
Hope to come again when I return to Hanoi in a few days!

reviews.author: Legoupil V
reviews.title: Cheap and so good with kindness
reviews.content: Cheap and so good with kindness and curiosity to discover foreign from Thuy . bunchata is a good recommendation : menu 1

reviews.author: Susanne
reviews.title: Very delicious
reviews.content: Came here because of the many positive reviews and were not disappointed. Very limited menu but you really don't need more for good bun cha. Also has options for vegetarians. The girls working on the floors are very nice (we met Thuy who was very accomodating). Very reasonable prices. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Jen
reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.content: Recommended by a family member who visited last year, was the most amazing food! Came as a deconstructed noodle soup, you can add your own flavours like leaves, garlic, chilli! And the spring rolls were AMAZING! Best meal so far in Asia. Made even better with the lovely service from Thuy, very smiley and helpful.

reviews.author: Erin G
reviews.title: Wow!!
reviews.content: Our first night in Hanoi and this blew our minds. Worth the effort of coming here and beats any other option. The service is amazing and huge shout out to Thuy who spent ages speaking with us about local culture and cuisine. Made our night!

reviews.author: Lachie
reviews.title: Bun cha for life
reviews.content:
First night in Hanoi.

This is an exceptional experience. This came recommended by the locals and didn't disappoint. Bun cha is traditional to Hanoi and the only negative I can say is why isn't it anywhere else in the world. For the average pho lover this has many similarities, but is a step up in my opinion. Our waitress was a cut above the rest, her name is Thuy and made us feel warm and welcome from the get go. Thuy even took the time to teach us all the basics in Vietnamese and recommended food options that made the night what it was..... rat ngon ( delicious). 

This is a must when in Hanoi. Ask for Thuy.

reviews.author: Lennyg
reviews.title: So good we went twice
reviews.content: There may be bun cha as good in Hanoi, but probably  none so welcoming and comfortable.  Shoes off, sit on a platform upstairs  with feet down. My very first bite in Hanoi was the delicious spring roll with the bun cha, and my last was finishing the delicious soup the night before we left.   Our server remembered us (old folks) from 5 nights earlier, and of course the bun cha is to die for. Great street food in lovely surroundings, what's not to like?

reviews.author: Wendy
reviews.title: Fantastic Bun cha
reviews.content: Don’t think it’s full if downstairs is busy as there are more floors above. Great bun cha - we went 4 times. Quick service, friendly staff and a great price.

reviews.author: Jason L.
reviews.title: Delicious bun cha, peaceful atmosphere
reviews.content: We enjoyed #1 and #4 on the menu (traditional & seafood rolls). We especially liked the flavor combinations of the herbs served with the bun cha, of which you are given a plentiful amount. The rice wine packs a good punch and the watermelon juice is a refreshing dessert. Ask for seating upstairs as it is a nice detachment from the fray of city life. We recommend and would return to try the rest of the menu!

reviews.author: Tom K
reviews.title: Great Vietnamese food
reviews.content: Great food, friendly staff, reasonable prices. Our server was called Thuy and we were very well looked after. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Amie F
reviews.title: Great service and food
reviews.content: Really nice bun cha and excellent spring rolls, sit upstairs for a great atmosphere! Thuy was really helpful, she explained how to eat bun cha and at the end of the meal gave us recommendations of where else to try traditional foods.

reviews.author: Edrich C
reviews.title: Good experience
reviews.content: Bun Cha Ta is one of the best places to get bun cha in the city as well as being very foreigner-friendly. Thuy (I think that’s how you spell it) was very friendly and was very kind in showing us how to eat the famous local food. Very good experience, highly recommend.

reviews.author: Kelsey S
reviews.title: All around amazing restaurant!
reviews.content: Amazing food, lovely staff. Our waitress, Thuy, was so warm and friendly. She taught us how to eat the Vietnamese dishes correctly and how to ‘cheers’ in Vietnamese! Must visit.

reviews.author: be-yogi
reviews.title: a definate must when you are in Ha Noi. the soup is spectacular!!!!!!!!!
reviews.content: this soup speciallity is amazing, you have to try this while you are in Ha Noi. there are other Bun Cha palces but this one is the best according to the locals.

reviews.author: Eldon-Vancouver
reviews.title: Good Bun Cha
reviews.content: Coming to Vietnam means you have to try the Bun Cha. With so many places to choose from, it was difficult to know where to go, but we chose Bun Cha Ta as it was a very short walk from our hotel. Turned out to be a good choice as the food was delicious and the service was good. We chose to go with the full meal so we got spring rolls as well. It was nice that the server spoke English and was able to explain how to eat the meal. Worth stopping in for a meal.

reviews.author: Christopher C
reviews.title: Bun Cha Ta
reviews.content: Really good Bun Cha for a very reasonable price. Ho for the traditional, which comes with spring rolls which are very tasty.

reviews.author: Damian A
reviews.title: Great food and friendly service
reviews.content: Bun Cha Ta is a great little eatery and a great introduction to bun cha. The food was delicious and our waitress, Thuy, was so friendly in explaining how to eat it and having a chat with us too.

reviews.author: Anemone31
reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.content: The food is really nice with different bun style (bo bun en français !), our waitress Thuy was really cool and learned us to sing while drinking the Vietnamese rice alcohol :)

reviews.author: Sophie B
reviews.title: Great Bun Cha
reviews.content: Small, typical restaurant with Bun Cha specialty. Our waitress, Thuy was awesome. Her English is really good, she helped us order, explained how to eat it and was super friendly.

reviews.author: Jordy Borg
reviews.title: Excellent place to try Bun Cha
reviews.content:
When we arrived in Hanoi, we immediately wanted to try their famous Bun Cha, and we are happy to have come here! The service is quick, the prices are cheap and the staff are very helpful to guideyou through their options.

Definitely recommended as a place to try Bun Cha

reviews.author: Mario d
reviews.title: Very good
reviews.content: Food was great, service friendly. Reasonably priced restaurant for the area and popular with the tourists although it felt like a typical local restaurant. Choice is focused on Bun Cha, hardly surprising given the name. If you've not tried it before give it  go, you get to throw in the amount of garlicky and chillies you want, so you get a degree of control.

reviews.author: Charles Yeo
reviews.title: Great Bun Cha
reviews.content:
Very nice n cheap.. must visit when in Hanoi. A family place that is cosy n warm. 
The best Bun Cha I tried so far.

reviews.author: Maria B
reviews.title: Vegetarian, friendly, great experience
reviews.content: Thuy was the best server ever! Everybody speaks great English and is very helpful and kind. Even learned to cheers in Vietnamese, plus they have vegetarian options which are super delicious!

reviews.author: Clare S
reviews.title: Simply delicious
reviews.content: Went here on my first night in Vietnam - with trepidation because I wasn't sure about going somewhere so local but it was recommended by my hotel so I thought I'd give it a go. Oh my word, the food was delicious. I had the Bun Cha with vegetable spring rolls. I loved it so much I went back in my last night there too - just as good!

reviews.author: PNJ
reviews.title: Delicious Bun Cha
reviews.content:
We came in after seeing all the great reviews and the place lived up to them.  Delicious Bun Cha and springrolls.  Lots of flavourful meatballs in the broth.  Plenty of herbs served alongside.  

We came in hungry.  I tried the bun cha with 3 springrolls, portion was large and I could not finish it all. 

Great value for money as well.  Sit upstairs, cool seating area adds to experience, you have to remove shoes to sit upstairs

reviews.author: Kristi
reviews.title: Sooooo good
reviews.content: If I could give this place 100 stars I would. The best food I’ve had in Vietnam and great pricing. Staff friendly and showed me how to eat it bc I had no idea lol

reviews.author: Nicolas
reviews.title: Really good
reviews.content: Really good restaurant, the food is great and the place is really nice! The food is served really quickly and if you ask they can show you how to eat properly a Bun cha!

reviews.author: Reviewnator S
reviews.title: Good but Not good as expected
reviews.content:
Not every staff was friendly and Table was not Cleaned.. food was good but only little bit over average Level.. visited by many tourists

Be aware of that seafood nem also Made with pork and the Served nuoc mam ngot is warm

Due to the price level for me overall 3.5 to 4 stars Rating.

reviews.author: Makiejac
reviews.title: Sticky tables
