We ended up eating here 3 times in our 4 days in Hanoi. We came once with friends who were vegetarian and they were likewise impressed. This was very good value for money. Try to sit upstairs if you can for the full experience!

reviews.author: Hidde W
reviews.title: Amazing bun cha!
reviews.content: This little place serves amazing bun cha, which is the classic dish to try in Hanoi. It consists of a deliciously flavoured soup, nicely grilled pork, fresh herbs, and crispy Vietnamese spring rolls. We were served by a friendly girl called Nhi, who even invited us to drink a glass of Vietnamese rice wine on the house! A must for anyone going to Hanoi!

reviews.author: clairemcsorley
reviews.title: The best meal we’ve had so far
reviews.content: Cannot say enough good things about our meal here! One of the best vegetarian meals I’ve ever had, let alone in a city that can sometimes be tricky to find meat-free options in. I ordered combo #6 which comes with a bowl of broth, rice noodles, spring rolls, and fresh herbs. My friend ordered combo #1 which is basically the same except it has grilled pork in the soup and in the spring rolls. The broth is perfectly seasoned, the spring rolls are unbelievably crispy and light, and I loved the format of dipping each bite into the broth rather than having everything arrive already sitting in the soup. The servers were also very friendly and explained what each fresh herb was, and gave their recommendations on the best way to eat it. I would normally want to try a new restaurant every night while traveling but this one is SO GOOD we’re going back for the second dinner in a row!

reviews.author: Jozisam
reviews.title: Delicious local cuisine
reviews.content: Recommended by a local and then by a visitor we met in Hanoi, we went for a quick lunch on a typically rainy summer day. Simple yet enjoyable Bun Ca. They're happy to tell you how to eat the meal. We found the ingredients to be fresh and tasty, the spring roll was crisp. Really enjoyable.

reviews.author: selbysontour
reviews.title: Delicious and fun visit!
reviews.content:
We went here on the recommendation of our hotel on a very hot afternoon in Hanoi. We loved the Bun Cha and my husband had the vegetarian version which he also loved. The egg coffee was also delicious. 
The other highlight though was the wonderful service from Katy. We had a wonderful time with her testing each other with riddles and jokes with other diners joining in. My two boys loved the whole experience not just the food but the relaxed fun atmosphere. Thank you Katy for making the whole experience extra special.

reviews.author: TravelExpert32
reviews.title: Amazing Vietnamese Food - especially if you’re new to Vietnam!
reviews.content:
We had just arrived into Hanoi, and needed somewhere to eat that was cheap, but good quality. This absolutely met all those needs.

From the outside it is very small, however it is spread across multiple floors, where you go into the room and take your shoes off beforehand - very different!

Nhi our waitress was very friendly and talked us through the history off the food and how to eat it properly. 

Would recommend!

reviews.author: Maria J G
reviews.title: Bun Cha Fun and Zun
reviews.content: My husband and I were looking for places to eat Bun Cha (one of the most traditional Vietnamese dishes) and came across this place on TripAdvisor. Bun Cha Ta did definitely not disappoint...Incredible Bun Cha and service was impeccable:). With a smile on her face throughout our entire meal, our waitress Zun was the most amicable and friendly person that you’ll have the pleasure to come across in Vietnam. Lovely, attentive and genuinely interested in her guests. Highly recommend the food and the service at this restaurant! Plus, it was exceptional value for the food quality. Thumbs up all the way.

reviews.author: kwebster20
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.content: This restaurant was recommended to us by our hotel and was one of the best (and cheapest) meals we ate during our trip in Vietnam! The staff were really friendly giving us an explanation of the food and how best to eat it and the food was amazing! This place is a must if you are visiting Hanoi!

reviews.author: Cassandra C
reviews.title: Great dinner!
reviews.content: Had a great dinner here! Obviously had the Bun Cha - prepared the soup way, with spring rolls. Was really yummy! Prices are great and location is in the old quarter!

reviews.author: George H
reviews.title: First Meal in Vietnam
reviews.content: Tasty and refreshing food with lovely service! Take off your shoes, find a bench seat, tuck in......and wait for the herb explosion!

reviews.author: 406claudia
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha! Delicious
reviews.content: This is the best place to try Bun Cha in Vietnam. It is absolutely delicious and is perfect- it is home cooked by a grandma. The staff is phenomenal- they explain the whole meal to you. Nhi was so amazing and kept us great company during the meal. We will be back.

reviews.author: Shaunda L
reviews.title: Very good
reviews.content: We went here for dinner. The menu isn’t extensive. But it is delicious. The rice wine whiskey is also very good.

reviews.author: Carsten O
reviews.title: Gooooooood Bun cha food
reviews.content:
This is one of the places to try when visiting Hanoi.
In the very warm weather is nice be inside and rest and cool of.
And getting great lunch 👍👍
Bun cha was fresh and tasty, really good. The staff was kind and friendly.. you will love it.... we will come back for sure

reviews.author: Kiwi_No_Wings
reviews.title: Excellent Bun Cha
reviews.content: Very friendly staff, we returned a number of time for the fresh and tasty delights including an excellent rice wine.

reviews.author: Bhamini R
reviews.title: Tasty food
reviews.content: This was the fist place we ate at when we arrived in Hanoi and we went back a couple of times. The food was super tasty. The staff very helpful and you can go there for a meal or just a snack.

reviews.author: Dương N
reviews.title: Good street food
reviews.content: The noodle with beef here is the best seller. Taste is good and cheap price.  The food also come very fast as well. Good try.

reviews.author: Alan G
reviews.title: Excellent bun cha ta
reviews.content: As said in other reviews, great Bun Cha Ta at reasonable price. We had the number 1 combo for 90k a piece. Very good feed for the price and very tasty. Vaut le detour.

reviews.author: pmurphy1618
reviews.title: Tasty meal
reviews.content: Had a really tasty meal here and great service , enjoyed having a conversation with the waitress Hanh about Vietnam and also helping her to improve her English

reviews.author: SPIRITEDaway91
reviews.title: Very good
reviews.content: Had a very satisfying dinner here with my family. Ordered four portions of pork noodles - they are huge! Very good service.

reviews.author: FoodieJade
reviews.title: Different taste of Bun Cha
reviews.content: The Bun Cha here serve with fresh herb leaves like basil, mint, perilla, along with meat balls and grill pork in a broth, which is different from other Bun Cha I tried before(meat are separated from the broth). The staff showing us how to eat it, by putting noodles and leaves in the broth, also tell us the perilla is specially for Bun Cha, must try it with meat and noodles. Overall, the meats are well seasoning, might not the cheapest Bun Cha but in a big portion(for girl maybe); we also try the spring roll but kinda to greasy in the end(pork and fries).

reviews.author: venny007
reviews.title: Bun cha ta
reviews.content: Friendly clean great food fantastic service. Katy is wonderful service with a smile and very informative and friendly.

reviews.author: Nick Y
reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.content: First time trying bun cha. One of the nicest meals I’ve ever had. Hanh provides amazing service with insights about where to eat in Hanoi. 5 Star

reviews.author: OnAir727082
reviews.title: Amazing food!
reviews.content: First time trying bun cha. Completely lived up to expectations I had. I tried the recommended no.1 dish. Great service by hanh too who told me how it should be eaten etc. As well as information on places to visit in old quarter, I was given a free shot of rice wine at the end. Really recommend

reviews.author: Win P
reviews.title: Great food
reviews.content: Grilled pork meatballs, grilled pork and fried spring roll. Absolutely delicious! Our server Trang was very friendly and nice. Will definitely come back.

reviews.author: Antony E
reviews.title: Heaven in a bowl, cup and plate
reviews.content: Upon arrival i was welcomed with a warm smile and very clean surrounding. The food is incredibly fresh and flavoursome. The only problem was i didnt have room in my stomach for more😁😁😁

reviews.author: Anna C
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha in Hanoi! And Katy was an excellent waitress
reviews.content: Hands down the best Bun Cha I’ve had in Vietnam. Katy was an excellent waitress who explained how to eat the Bun Cha, how the Bun Cha was made, and what the greens were (basil, lettuce, etc.) and what the Vietnamese ate them for (e.g. one type is used to get rid of a headache). She also gave us recommendations on things to do and other restaurants/dessert. I highly recommend you try while in Hanoi :)

reviews.author: Zak G
reviews.title: Authentic Vietnamese food
reviews.content:
We came across bun cha ta while in Hanoi.
great place if you want authentic vietnamese food, good prices, friendly staff and awesome design for tables on the 2nd floor

reviews.author: NaniKunming
reviews.title: Delicious food and great staff
reviews.content: I was told that this place is a must when visiting Hanoi, and I agree. Delicious food at reasonable prices. The friendly waitress, Hanh, made the visit even more pleasant.

reviews.author: Nicole S
reviews.title: Delicious bun cha
reviews.content:
From the moment they open the door, the staff are welcoming and friendly. We ordered the bun cha and when it came out the waitress explained how to eat it and even where the herbs were grown. Very interesting. 
A delicious Hanoi experience.

reviews.author: Frank F
reviews.title: Ill afterward
reviews.content: My friend and me went there on the recommendation of TripAdvisor. First, the Bun Cha was not as good as the one we had in Saigon, which surprised me as Bun Cha traditionally is not southern Vietnamese food. Second, my friend went violently ill 3-4 hours later, vomiting and diarrhea. So don’t go there.

reviews.author: EUGENE C
reviews.title: Great staff and such good bun cha
reviews.content: Can’t recommend this place enough. The best Bun Cha ever with generous portions. The staff, especially Katy, were so friendly and talked to us about Ha Noi’s culture and foods. Great experience, already looking forward to visiting again in the future

reviews.author: margaret1232017
reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.content: You must try this restaurant in the old quarter of Hanoi. When the food arrived it didn’t look appetising, but it was surprisingly very good and tasty. Service was excellent and you get complimentary rice whisky. Cheap and cheerful street food.

reviews.author: millyminett
reviews.title: On a recommendation. Now I’m recommending.
reviews.content:
We met some guys in a bar and they said we should try this place. Omg yes. 

The most amazing bun cha I’ve tried (spring rolls with noodles in a bowl of soupy sauce stuff). 

Inexpensive, I had the veggie option for £2...my other half had the meaty option for £3.30ishh with great juices or beer if you fancy it. 

You come in and go up the stairs, shoes off, sit on a sunken wooden bench. 

Service is very fast, food is superb. If I had another day I would be back.

reviews.author: hannahrose97
reviews.title: A hidden gem
reviews.content: Wow ! This place was incredible ! When we got there we headed up stairs and ordered right away. The food came out so quickly and we were explained the way your meant to eat the meals adding your own amount of chilli and garlic which I loved ! The flavours are so incredible all I can say is that everyone must go here ! My boyfriend and I went twice in our short time in Hanoi and the lovely ladies remembered us which is always a special touch

reviews.author: Mallori N
reviews.title: Yum! Yum!
reviews.content: This was our first meal in Vietnam and the bar was set high! The staff was phenomenal and showed us how to mix the ingredients together.  Definitely get the number 1 and mix the spring rolls in your soup as well!

reviews.author: End33
reviews.title: Great bun cha
reviews.content:
We have tried a few different bun cha out and this place served the best one so far. 
The prices cheap and the service is efficient. 
I had spring roll and bun cha what is was amazing. 
Great location 
I would highly recommend this restaurant

reviews.author: Maps696634
reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.content: After traveling in Asia for 6 months, it has become rare to eat a meal that blows your mind (I say this because so much is wonderful and delicious). This did. We both ordered the combo with the spring rolls.

reviews.author: xoyadingo
reviews.title: Delicious Bun Cha, lovely waiter!
reviews.content: I came here because the restaurant I had planned to go to was closed (it was around 2pm). I sat upstairs and ordered the Bun Cha. When the waitress brought it to me, she explained to me how to eat it. It was fantastic! She also told me a lot about Vietnamese culture. I would highly recommend this place to anyone traveling to Hanoi.

reviews.author: Karen042
reviews.title: Delicious Food.
reviews.content: Was introduced to Bun Cha Ta during  a walking street food tour. So impressed  with the Bun Cha and spring rolls we returned for dinner next night. Delicious, fresh, tasty, we were  very happy with the food and the friendly efficient service, particularly by Hanh,who served us. A very nice young lady who is an asset  to the business. You must try Bun Cha  while in Hanoi at Bun Cha Ta in Nguyen Huu  Huan street in the old quarter.

reviews.author: Fabian S
reviews.title: Excellent food at a great price
reviews.content: Whilst the menu isn’t extensive, the food on offer is excellent and at a great price. We even returned the day after discovering it, that’s how good it was. The staff were very friendly and show you how to eat your Bun Cha also. Would certainly recommend this restaurant to anyone going to the old quarter in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Adam C
reviews.title: Amazing food and lovely staff
reviews.content: First time having Bun Cha in Hanoi and this place was great. The food was so tasteful and there was a lovely staff member named Thang (sounds like Chang). She was very friendly and added to our eating experience.

reviews.author: caitieeem
reviews.title: Yummy food & good service
reviews.content: We had the bun cha and spring rolls which were delicious. We probably could have shared our bun cha and tried a few other options on the menu.  The service is lovely.

reviews.author: Kody B
reviews.title: Lovely lactation for an excellent meal
reviews.content: Such a sweetheart staff with quick service. They told me that the Vietnamese eat pho for the morning but eat bun cha for strength in the afternoon. After a meal here I feel like a superhero who wants to take a nap. Strong but full. Come on by for some delicious authentic Vietnamese food and hospitality

reviews.author: Bryan Tan
reviews.title: Delicious Bun Cha
reviews.content: The Bun Cha served at this store was very delicious. The broth in which the grilled pork was soaking in, was very flavourful. The noodles complemented the salty broth well. The fresh vegetables that was served, was tasty as well. Overall, a very good and authentic tasting Bun Cha.

reviews.author: travelinomuc
reviews.title: A REAL Local Food Place
reviews.content: While in Hanoi you need to try the local food, and Bun Cha offers it at best. Do not expect fancy neighborghood and locale, just focus on local flair and the food. A must try.

reviews.author: Michael P
reviews.title: Great food, better service
reviews.content: Went here for our first bun cha experience and after 2 weeks traveling Vietnam, my friend and I agreed it was some of the best food we've had in the country.  Additionally, the employees were incredibly kind and helped us eat the food correctly, which we sometimes found to be difficult in other traditional restaurants. Moreover, they poured us all complimentary happy water shots and taught us how to yell "cheers" in Vietnamese. Definitely a Hanoi must!

reviews.author: Bora
reviews.title: So delicious!!
reviews.content: It was my first trial for Bun Cha, and was awesome. The best dish we had  while travelling in Vietnam for 2 weeks. Also the staffs are very kind! Must visit!!!

reviews.author: GillK26
reviews.title: OK food OK priced but doesn’t live up to its hype
reviews.content:
Some of us had bun cha, some spring rolls. It was all fine, but don’t know why this restaurant is raved about. We sat up stairs, found it a bit bleak with greasy tables. Staff friendly but serving you like a school lesson rather than a restaurant - you don’t get to eat the food until you’ve been given the instruction how. 
Maybe we’re missing something but we’ve had nice bun cha in more comfortable surroundings.

reviews.author: holliemclean
reviews.title: Delicious food, great spot
reviews.content: Delicious bun cha, make sure to order the ‘recommended’ meal which also comes with spring rolls. Staff are super friendly and happy to give recommendations for Hanoi and other destinations.

reviews.author: Mal S
reviews.title: Great food, friendly and informative staff
reviews.content: The food was delicious and a must try is the Bun Cha Ta. We had the vegetarian spring rolls and the fried tofu was to die for. Our waitress Katie was super helpful, enthusiastic and provided us with many travelling tips for Hanoi and surrounding areas. She was also a super quiz master and provided great entertainment value. She is just such a funny, warm and caring individual. This is one of our favorite restaurants in Hanoi.

reviews.author: jenstar777
reviews.title: Charming place!
reviews.content: Went for lunch yesterday and ordered the number 1 - recommended for a reason! Delicious broth with pork balls, dip the rice noodles in and accompanying salad. Spring rolls were divine too. The staff were all lovely; we even got background on the herbs in our salad and a free shot of rice wine and how to say cheers in Vietnamese. Amazing value, we would definitely go back again.

reviews.author: Pastorino
reviews.title: Superb!
reviews.content: Great service and the quality of food was amazing. Friendly staff and very clean. Could not ask for more...So we visited twice! Found it just as amazing.

reviews.author: Iona W
reviews.title: Great food and amazing service.
reviews.content:
Came here after reading all the reviews and they were so true. 
The food was served quickly and tasted great. 
The service was fantastic, quick, efficient and very friendly. Our waitress was very friendly and super helpful she taught us how to eat bun cha. Every worker we passed was very friendly and we felt very welcome from start to end.

reviews.author: crossy90
reviews.title: Okay nothing to write home about
reviews.content: Went for dinner had 2 x no 1.  Food was okay not the best and not the worst we have had price reasonable at 95000 vnd each.  Wouldn’t rush back.

reviews.author: Daan S
reviews.title: Delicious food!
reviews.content: The food is delicious and not top expensive. We paid for 2 people like 10 dollar. The service is very friendly, we even had a delicious Vietnamese ricewine after dinner.

reviews.author: Marissa V
reviews.title: Tasty food and great service
reviews.content:
We stumbled upon this place while wandering around the Old Quarter in search for food and AC. We were not disappointed! The food was very affordable and so delicious! And we were able to cool off in their AC restaurant. 

Our lovely server (whose name has escaped me) was very friendly and even taught us the way to eat our bun cha. We had previously been to another bun cha place but didn't get a tutorial so it was very helpful to know how you're supposed to eat it. She also chatted with us a bit and even gave us some local tips for enjoying Hanoi. We really liked her! 

Do check out this place if you're hungry, hot, and tired in the Old Quarter!

reviews.author: clementb564
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha in Hanoi
reviews.content:
Being a Bun Cha amateur, I tried several Bun Cha places in Hanoi and Bun Cha Ta is the best so far.
Excellent nems and bun cha. Great service with friendly staff.
A must try when going to Hanoi!

reviews.author: Caroline F
reviews.title: Authentic Vietnamese street food
reviews.content: The menu is rather small but the meal we had was delicious. It was extremely inexpensive for a combination meal of spring rolls and bun cha (grilled pork) with rice noodles. The small restaurant has AC and Wifi inside and the service was great. Would definitely recommend for a quick meal in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Kevin S
reviews.title: Absolutely awesome food
reviews.content: The food was fantastic and a must try if you’re visiting the old quarter. Our waitress Chang was so friendly and nice. They also served us some complimentary rice wine shots ( Happy water 😛). We loved the place so much that we had to go again before leaving the capital. Definitely my favourite restaurant in Hanoi.

reviews.author: caseylove
reviews.title: Best bun cha. Friendliest people
reviews.content: I live in Hanoi one month every year, and Bun Cha Ta is my favorite.  Cool Ac, and he friendliest staff.  They’re tofu is amazing if you don’t eat meat.

reviews.author: Pietro P
reviews.title: Great food and people
reviews.content:
The food amounts to the best street food you can get in Hanoi. There is not much choice, but all the dishes are fantastic! 
The personnel is also incredibly kind. 
I also lost some money in the restaurant, which they gave me back one hour later when I went to check if it was there.
Would definitely reccomend!

reviews.author: sanneopreis
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha in Vietnam with lovely people!
reviews.content: We had Bun Cha before in Saigon, but this Bun Cha was the best we had! Great flavors and also important, lovely staff! The ladies tell you everything about how to eat the Bun Cha and what the ingrediënts can do for your body. Our last night in Hanoi, we had to eat there and it was lovely again. We had a great chat with Nana. She’s so polite and makes you have a memorable time in Vietnam. Thanks to all of you!

reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.title: Tasty!
reviews.content: I'm a huge fan of Pho and Bun Cha was similar, but more flavorful. One of my favorite meals in Vietnam.

reviews.author: Nikola M
reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.content: Went twice. Food is really tasty. Girls, thank you for the great service and keep up the good work! Hint: try the local liquor :D

reviews.author: roshelle h
reviews.title: Absolutely lovely vibe and friendly staff!
reviews.content: We came to here for dinner, I ordered the vegetarian spring rolls with rice noodles and my friend ordered the egg coffee. The food was lovely and was more than enough, it came with a side salad, and the option to add garlic or chilli! The waitress (Trang) was absolutely lovely and spent time talking us through the meal, explaining how the egg coffee originated in Hanoi! Really lovely place :)

reviews.author: Rakha h
reviews.title: Amazing food and very friendly staff!
reviews.content: The food and the Vietnamese egg coffee was absolutely amazing. The decor of the venue is so beautiful and the staff were so kind and helpful!

reviews.author: Hemel S
reviews.title: Amazing Food and Staff!
reviews.content: Went to try local vietnamese street food and had this lovely restaurant ticked all the boxes. Trang who is a staff helped a lot with recommendations and lovely to have a conversation with. Prices are excellent as well...definitely try the Bun Cha Ta and Egg Coffee, you will not be disappointed :)

reviews.author: nic134d
reviews.title: Bun Cha Yum!
reviews.content: Great food and super nice staff.  Very friendly and fun to learn about the different ingredients. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Aaron T
reviews.title: Bun Cha Ta la la la
reviews.content: Had a great meal and our host Chang was very hospitable and gave us some recommendations of other places to indulge. Thanks Chang! 🤗

reviews.author: Aj A
reviews.title: Excellent food, excellent service
reviews.content: We came here with great recommendations and were very pleased when we arrived. We were served by Trang, who was helpful and friendly and informative. She also gave us free rice wine as a kind gesture. Would highly recommend coming here when you visit Hanoi.

reviews.author: amylroche
reviews.title: Great food and really nice staff
reviews.content: The Bun Cha here is amazing. The spring rolls are the best we’ve had in Vietnam. The staff are really friendly and informative about the ingredients in their food.

reviews.author: Dantaylor1990
reviews.title: Nice little place to stop for food!
reviews.content: This place is great food a cheap bite to eat. The room was nice and cool and the seating was comfy. The food was also really nice, hard to finish and they give you lots. Try it..you won't be disappointed

reviews.author: Guilherme Z
reviews.title: Great staff and amazing food
reviews.content: Amazing food, spring rolls are delicious and the pork sausage is the best! I went twice and both times the food was great and Hanh, who works in the second floor was lovely! Super friendly and funny, with a huge smile and a nice chat, giving suggestions about Vietnam, she definitely made our meal more special! Thanks!

reviews.author: Yen K
reviews.title: Good food great service
reviews.content: The waitress also explain to each customer patiently how to eat the food。the grilled meat is delicious

reviews.author: Joseline N
reviews.title: Literally a street food at its finest at Bun Cha Ta!
reviews.content: The food, I ordered pork bun cha and fried spring rolls, are amazingly delicious. The staffs are very friendly and knowledgable about Vietnam culture. They even asked if it’s your first experience eating bun cha so they’ll explain to you on how to eat them, and let you know about all the herbs that’s served.

reviews.author: Audrey H
reviews.title: Ate here twice it was that good
reviews.content: Seriously delicious!! The staff were so kind and showed us the traditional way to enjoy bun Cha and sat down to explain what all the herbs are. They were so great and welcomed us with rice wine shots!! Love this place.

reviews.author: molly_mccallum
reviews.title: Amazing food, friendly staff!
reviews.content: Very glad that someone recommended us Bun Cha Ta, as the food was absolutely delicious (we had the pork noodle soup), the restaurant had a lovely feel and the staff were very welcoming and friendly. Would deffo recommend to anyone who’s in Hanoi to check this place out!!

reviews.author: Alvin_Levi_Dayan
reviews.title: Traditional value, contemporary setting, fantastic service, & delicious menu!
reviews.content:
First time Hanoi visitor, first time Bun Cha eater.  A rainy evening made the perfect setting to try a Hanoi speciality, & my Wife & Inlaws did not regret continueing the trek in the rain to sample a Hanoi staple at Bun Cha Ta.  

Being a "cold" soup didn't not make sense to eat in this weather as it was flavoursome, healthy, & very satisfying; dipping the great fried spring rolls in the broth was the kicker for me :)

I really loved how the menu was conscise; only offering items that were they best they had, which made choosing dishes and beverages super easy.  Big recommendation to the Egg coffee! Don't think it's gross just by the name alone, it really is a creamy and hot, sweetended coffee that i just loved.

Big shout out to the great staff there who explain how to eat Bun Cha to a family a newbies, as well as explain the benefits of eating the herbs with the soup - thumbs up and super thanks for the help in calling a "Grab Taxi" for us to take us back to our hotel, as well as the handful of lychees as a gift when we left.  Simple actions that really make your restaurant shine amongst the rest.

Thank you for a great dinner!

reviews.author: E-Lyn H
reviews.title: great Bun Cha and lovely host
reviews.content: On my last day in hanoi, my girl and I wanted to eat bun cha before leaving to Dong hoi that evening, so we google and decided to try Bun Cha Ta, restaurant were clean and cozy, they guided us upstair very nice sitting too but i do not want to remove my shoe so we came down and settle in a front seat. waitress were friendly. food is delicious. Host shave 2 shots of homemade lime liqueur with us it was so good. Highly recommended this place to anyone.

reviews.author: Kris
reviews.title: Great pick-me-up
reviews.content:
This is such a charming eatery. Great find, along a busy street with many other dining/drinking options. 

Their highly recommended signature dish is a must try. The traditional fried spring rolls that came with it  were so tasty! Food came in less than 3 minutes. The waitress even explained how to eat it. Love the fast and friendly service.

After dinner, the lady at reception helped me book a Grab Taxi. So helpful as it was raining heavily!

reviews.author: Калачинов Д
reviews.title: Good food, nice staff
reviews.content:
Not many things in the menu, but all good. Egg coffee - must try!
Also they have different sorts of Vietnam vines that are very similar to grappa.

reviews.author: Somchai S
reviews.title: Very cool place and services from angels HANH and LAN.
reviews.content: I am very much apprciated this place. It was a really cool traditional vienamese bun cha. The services from Hahn (nice girl)with her colleagues giving a home feel. She explained me of how to prepare bun cha for the way of eating. She repeated this instruction to all new comming tourists. I enjoyed this food, place, very much the serives from angels. Finnaly we exchanged our facebook and contact. She has planned end of this 2018 to travel to my land of smile "Thailand" yes, you re welcome, i' ll take care you and see how real traditional Thai spicy foods in comparison with you bun cha. Guaratee u will cry.

reviews.author: Andria7
reviews.title: Hanh was amazing
reviews.content:
Hanh was great! She went above and beyond for us. The food was also fantastic. 
Would absolutely recommend this place while in Hanoi!

reviews.author: Hungry
reviews.title: I did enjoy.
reviews.content: Bun cha was good and the friendly staff, Hanh, was great. The AC worked so well that I could cool down.

reviews.author: lifesatapestry
reviews.title: Missed the Mark
reviews.content:
We really wanted to give this restaurant a try as it had rated well on Trip Advisor.  We were greeted by friendly staff and decided on the specials.  Bun Cha obviously with spring rolls.

We were given a lesson on how to eat the food, noodles the herbs and lettuce etc. 

The problem was there was a grub in the bowl of lettuce/ herbs.  On closer inspection a lot of the greenery had holes in it where grubs had had a feed.  This was most off-putting and took the anticipation of a great lunch away. We didn’t raise it with staff because I am not sure what that would have achieved.

Sorry Bun Cha Ta but we won’t be back.

reviews.author: Elise A
reviews.title: Vegetarian options for Bun Cha
reviews.content: It's a bit tricky to find vegetarian bun cha in Hanoi, but here you'll have two options. I tried the tofu version, the other one is with spring rolls. The friendly staff member Nana also explained the dish and how to eat it, as I have not had it served this way before. Would recommend this place for veggies!

reviews.author: MettyMetro
reviews.title: Bun Cha Taa very much
reviews.content: the best Bun Cha we had in Hanoi. The young waitress who served is was lovely and spoke great English, giving good explanations into all the food. Everything about the food was fantastic and if it wasn't our last day I'm certain we would've been back!

reviews.author: Hugo C
reviews.title: Best restaurant in Hanoi
reviews.content:
This restaurant was a new experience in Vietnam food!!!
It was really good with a perfect reception and fantastic food! You should try it!😀

reviews.author: Suzanne S
reviews.title: So glad we ate there!
reviews.content: We were lucky that our tour guide offered to take us somewhere local for lunch and that it was close by as it was delicious and flavorsome.  Yummy and well priced (the 3x of us had a bun cha each plus a beer and 2x softdrinks for like AU $13) and the place was clean, staff were friendly, highly recommend...

reviews.author: Dez92
reviews.title: Overrated. Bun cha huon lien is better
reviews.content:
Food: 3/5
Price: 3/5
Customer service: 4/5
Wait time: 5/5

Bun cha Huong Lien is so much better than this. This place I feel is quite overrated. The only thing better than Huong Lien is their meatball and the less oily soup.

The price here for the standard Buncha is 60K VND. It is 20K (30%) more expensive than Bun Cha Ta. They also serve lesser noodles. However their greens are of a better quality: oak leaves and spearmint while Huong Lien serves only spearmint and lettuce. However in my opinion, I prefer lettuce than oak leaves honestly.

Also the broth is less tantalizing than Huong Lien. And the grilled pork less juicy and succulent.
Its hard to give this a good rating especially when I tried Huong lien first. No wonder Obama dined at Huong Lien instead; I was quite sceptical about Bun Cha Ta being the top rated Bun Cha.

The passionfruit juice was nice though. It came at 40K. The watermelon juice on the other hand tasted weird, there was a coconut taste in it.

Between this and Huong Lien, I will choose Huong Lien any day. Even if I have to walk 25mins for it.

reviews.author: E_ee0808
reviews.title: Great Food
reviews.content: This place was our favourite stop from the Hanoi Street food tour! We ended up here every day during our 3 days here in Hanoi just to have their bun cha! 10/10 would recommend.

reviews.author: Ayesha R
reviews.title: Amazing bun cha!!
reviews.content: Wow - my friend and I are hooked! We’ve come every day since we’ve been to Hanoi. Delicious bun cha, we hope to be able to find it back home in Vancouver. The staff are also very lovely and remembered us! Thank you Bun Cha Ta!

reviews.author: Laura O
reviews.title: Lovely traditional food
reviews.content: After been recommended this restaurant by our hotel staff we walked down there on our first night. The food was beautiful and the staff were so helpful explaining and showing how to eat the food. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: NitKot
reviews.title: A must visit
reviews.content: A must visit for anyone visiting Hanoi! The place looks tiny from the outside, but has a few upper floors. The delicious food and the friendly, smiling staff made the experience memorable! We had the Bun Cha Ta (full option) with the spring rolls - simply out of the world! Wish had more time in Hanoi to revisit!

reviews.author: Cme1234
reviews.title: Over-rated and super oily.
reviews.content:
Just went there 2 hours ago. I am personally not a fan of oily food, I mean really very oily. The fried spring roll was oozing out oil when I took a bite. The grill pork (most of it are pork belly with the skin) was soaked with some super oily broth. The rice vermicelli doesn’t have any taste to it and I saw the locals soaking it with another type of broth and raw vegetables. 

If you are a fan of oily foods, then you will probably love this. But not for me.

reviews.author: 108ahj
reviews.title: Yummy Bun Cha Ta! 😋
reviews.content:
Was considering which authentic Vietnam cuisine to start off, after Pho and this came right on the recommended list by the hotel staff. 

Easy to navigate as it was located within Old Quarter, which is short walks from many renowned hotels. Staff were friendly, and the menu was easy to understand. 

Ordered the Bun Cha Ta combo and the staff taught us how to enjoy the dish. The broth was rich, and the deep fried minced pork is crispy despite being soak in the broth. Worth the try! 👍🏼

reviews.author: Isabel R
reviews.title: Yummy Vietnamese food
reviews.content: Very friendly service and delicious food! Nana was very sweet and gave us many tips on how to properly eat the food, as well as other advice on things to do in Hanoi as well! We got the fried tofu with rice noodles and shared sticky black rice. Excited to try other dishes in the future!

reviews.author: rui xiang p
reviews.title: Food poison after eating this
reviews.content:
Went yesterday for dinner, ordered at no. 1, with the pork, noodles and spring roll. Later at night i started vomitting, diarrhea and running a fever.

It's my first day in Hanoi so it's ruined by the dinner.

reviews.author: juzkimmi
reviews.title: tasty and friendly! and fast serving!
reviews.content:
we walked in on a hot and humid day. greeted by the friendly staff and told to go upstairs for our meal. we were met by NANA for our order. she was very friendly and spoke well in English! she explained how we are supposed to consume the dish and the various sides that came with it. overall a very wonderful meal! would not hesitate to come back for more! 

James and SK

reviews.author: HongNgoc93
reviews.title: Average
reviews.content:
Food is average, 'Nem' have so much oil. Bun cha is so so, too. Not thing special or stand out much in tatse.
But the service is good.

reviews.author: Ishmb09
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.content: We visited this place for lunch, the food was really good. We were served by Hanh who was super friendly and explained the ingredients of each Vietnamese dish. She recommended a few dishes (which were really good). Thanks to Hanh, we had a great time!

reviews.author: Kuniko T
reviews.title: great food and staff
reviews.content: Had our first meal in VN and had to come back the next day. The food is 👏👏 and so are the chis. shoutout to Hanh, Le, Nana, Trang. ♥️♥️♥️♥️

reviews.author: Karley M
reviews.title: Yum!
reviews.content: Went for dinner and loved it, small menu but they have perfected it.  We even went back for lunch the next day.  Friendly and helpful waitress!

reviews.author: Julian A
reviews.title: Echo the sentiments here
reviews.content:
Quick bun cha meal here tonight. Staff lovely, friendly and helpful.

Food was brilliant. Simple, fresh and soooo tasty. 

Great place

reviews.author: Adrian D
reviews.title: Great food and staff
reviews.content: First time having bun cha and the server Hanh was super helpful explaining how to eat it and spoke great English. Very friendly and attentive! Food great as well would definitely recommend. Adrian from Canada.

reviews.author: NYely0705
reviews.title: Good food.
reviews.content: Nice place to experience the local food.  Smiling staff and quick service.  Really good dipping sauce,  different from the sauce we tried before.

reviews.author: HappyTraveller213
reviews.title: Upscale Bun Cha Street Food in a Restaurant
reviews.content: Bun Cha is a delicious Northern Vietnamese dish typically served in the street restaurants of Hanoi where you sit down on small tables alongside other customers and enjoy your meal. This place is a regular  restaurant with normal tables and seating arrangements. It is very clean, food is super delicious, yet priced pretty much the same as the street restaurants (95k Dong for Bun Cha with Spring Rolls which is about $4). My favored part are all the delicious herbs and spices they serve along with Bun Cha you really get to challenge all your taste buds.

reviews.author: ooocasey
reviews.title: Very fresh and good
reviews.content: Loved it!  Super nice people working here.  When they served it, she asked if I had it before- I haven't.  Everything was fresh and flavorful.  So she explained how to eat it.  It was very delicious

reviews.author: Heidiswanderings
reviews.title: Amazing Bun
reviews.content: We loved going to this restaurant on our last night in Hanoi. Not only is the atmosphere really inviting, but the service is wonderful too. We had the classic Ban with pork, with spring rolls and beer. Everything was extremely fresh, tasty, seemly authentic. The staff were beyond helpful and nice and the food came out quickly. I would certainly recommend this restaurant to anyone going to Hanoi!

reviews.author: world_traveller_1789
reviews.title: Best local food
reviews.content: Cute little place with really tasty food,good prices and smiling staff. A great place to experience vietnamese food.

reviews.author: Kiet U
reviews.title: Authentic street food in restaurant.
reviews.content: The food here is amazing. Food is authentic street food in a restaurant. The hostess was really nice and also gave a complimentary rice wine shot.

reviews.author: cima2401
reviews.title: Must try in hanoi
reviews.content: Discovered this restaurant during food walk tour and decided next day to go back for lunch as it was really good. We took the regular bun cha ta dish, which is a delicious speciality in Vietnam of noodles, dipping broth, all kind of herbs and bbq pork. Fantastic meal for less then 3 usd..must try!!!

reviews.author: Victoria B
reviews.title: Happy vegetarian :-) soup plus spring rolls make an interesting combination !
reviews.content:
I had never tried this kind of street food before so I didn’t know what to expect food-wise:
First of all, it’s a nice *real* restaurant with a sit-down area upstairs. I saw a lot of groups of people eat there. 

I went there with my vegetarian husband so I hoped that he would find something decent to eat there as well 

We didn’t know the concept of this type of street food before:

You get a soup (clear broth) and put Chili and garlic by yourself. You also get rice noodles and a big bowl of herbs/ salad that you also add to the food. On a separate plate you get spring rolls (vegetarian option available ) which you can dip into the soup.
The veggie option also came with a plate of tofu and tomato, which also landed in the soup. 
Very interesting combination of flavours and textures! Can recommend to give it a try. 
190.000 dong for a meal for 2 and we were both stuffed in the end

reviews.author: Linh V
reviews.title: Good food.
reviews.content:
Good food.Ms.Lan is friendly,nice and professional staff.Highly recommend. Thank you!

Lynn from Texas.

reviews.author: Moni-LS85
reviews.title: Best noodle soup
reviews.content: The place is really authentic, the staff very friendly and the food spectacular!! We will come back for sure.

reviews.author: Bilge M
reviews.title: Best place in Hanoi
reviews.content: Great food, great service at a very reasonable price. The staff were very friendly, the restaurant was very clean and the food tasty. Would happily come again

reviews.author: travel1082018
reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.content: Great place to eat for some traditional and delicious Bun Cha! Clean and friendly restaurant, wonderful food - would recommend!

reviews.author: Ayush V
reviews.title: Three visits in 10 days
reviews.content: Chanced upon it really, and I am really glad I found it. Impeccable service, and it's always nice when that level of service is matched by the quality of food. I kept on coming back for the Bun Cha, it was by far the best I tried in Hanoi. And the price made it even better, paid an average of 90k for a meal and drink.

reviews.author: Vykiss
reviews.title: First Bun Cha ever
reviews.content: So happy this was our first experience. It was so amazing! We were surprised how simple of a dish it is but yet so flavorful. The place was packed and we still got serve in under 5min which is always impressive to us Canadians. Loved it, we will miss it greatly.

reviews.author: cryptoworldtour
reviews.title: Unbelievable!!!! Out of this world
reviews.content: Literally the top 5 dishes of all time.... A taste explosion..... Fresh herbs, perfect grilled meat, soup to die for and the fresh noodles are literally melt in your mouth...

reviews.author: DebaBrush_12
reviews.title: The BEST!!
reviews.content: My daughter found this restaurant on a travel blog.  Since it was only a few blocks from our hotel in The Old Quarter we decided to give it a try.  A busy, multi-story, fast paced restaurant, we were ushered upstairs and seated.  The choices are seven variations of Bun Cha (vegetarian options available upon request). We all ordered the #1.  The presentation and flavors are amazing.  The service is quick, friendly and efficient.  We loved it so much we returned twice more in the two weeks we were in the country.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: thisiscarnage
reviews.title: come here for the Hanoi specialty dish bun cha
reviews.content:
The traditional Vietnamese dish bun cha is a Hanoi specialty and so as soon as we got to Hanoi, we headed straight to this restaurant as it came up favourably in TripAdvisor and Google reviews.

We were sat upstairs and saw that it was set up in a Japanese style with having to take your shoes off before entering the low height table eating area where your feet are below the floor level.

The bun cha meal we ate, had grilled pork pieces and spring rolls, served with plenty of herbs but maybe not enough lettuce and bun noodles. 

We found it strange that they didn't provide a smaller serving bowl for us to prepare our portions. The main bun cha grilled pork is served in a larger bowl submerged in the fish sauce based soup and so by not having a smaller bowl, it is possible to consume too much of the soup when eating the meat, noodles and herbs and thus get thirsty very quickly. We did ask for some smaller bowls and the staff provided them straight away. 

The food was still excellent though and service was fast and efficient. This is a place that you could easily come to several times for lunch and/or dinner while in Hanoi.

reviews.author: jsequeiroz
reviews.title: You will love it.!!!
reviews.content:
This is an excellent restaurant to try “Bun Cha Ta”. This dish is so delicious..!!
We were lucky to find some free seats
in the second floor and we were blessed to have to Ms. Trang who were the person that take care of us for this gastronomic adventure. 

The local is well decorated and it’s most visited by tourists who (like us) follow the recommendations by other people.

The food is high quality and is not expensive. I’m sure you’ll enjoy it.

reviews.author: Grace O
reviews.title: You never forget your first!
reviews.content: This was our first meal in Vietnam and still one of our favourites. We’re vego so bad the tofu version which didn’t disappoint. So fresh, flavourful and an amazing way to jump into street food if you’re a little unsure if your stomach is ready for it.

reviews.author: IntrepidTravellersOZ
reviews.title: Great food, great service - can accommodate a wheelchair + a vegetarian
reviews.content:
We were introduced to Bun Cha Ta as part of the Hanoi Street Food Tour but we made sure we knew how to find out way back.
As my husband is vegetarian, they made a Honey broth for the Bun Cha and a vegetarian spring roll - I enjoyed it so much that when we returned I did not risk having the meat based version! It is hands down the most tasty vegetarian dish I have ever enjoyed.
I am in a wheelchair so we were restricted to the bottom floor and there is a couple of steps to get to that level. They also had to slide the bench seats along for me to fit but the friendly (and busy) ladies that run the place were happy to do so. We had to wait a little while on the second visit (but we knew it would be worth it).

reviews.author: jass_rj
reviews.title: Good dinner :)
reviews.content: It was our first dinner in Vietnam and it doesn’t disappoint :). The staff is very friendly and the atmosphere is cosy. We tried the BBQ pork, it was delicious! It is worth to visit! It has a good value for money.

reviews.author: Ellie1633
reviews.title: My first Bun Cha and it was incredible
reviews.content: The food was SO delicious I am still thinking about it days later... that says it all really. Really recommend going for the option with the seafood spring rolls for full authenticity and you can add your own spice levels which is a nice touch. Despite its popularity on tripadvisor it wasn’t too busy even at peak dinner time.

reviews.author: Peter B
reviews.title: Highly Recommended...
reviews.content:
Bun Cha Ta, Bun Cha Ta. So good we went twice! 
Was recommended by a local (they know the best places to eat), and our accommodation, and it did not disappoint!
Friendly staff and great food (look out pho,  there's a new kid on the block).
Well definitely be heading back next time in Hanoi!!

reviews.author: Natalie S
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha
reviews.content: Best Bun Cha I had in Hanoi. The atmosphere is cool - quite touristy but for a reason, the food is fabulous and people have probably been recommended to go there. Really enjoyed it. Staff are nice and service was quick.

reviews.author: 907pamc
reviews.title: Its worth a try - and we liked it.
reviews.content:
First authentic meal in Hanoi.

As usual, I always check Tripadvisor for any top rated places to eat - and i filtered by "cheap eats".

I was surprised that they only served one type of dish, which is "Bun Cha". Grilled meatball with soup...and rice noodles + greens.

Its worth a try - and we liked it.

Fast service and one of our cheap eats.

reviews.author: Sashiwoo
reviews.title: One of the best meals we had in Vietnam
reviews.content:
We were recommended this place by a friend and can't rate it highly enough.

The food was fresh, delicious and reasonably priced - I'm a vegetarian and had the most amazing bun cha. My husband had the pork bun cha and said it was incredible too. 

A must visit!

reviews.author: Collin C
reviews.title: Best meal I had in Hanoi
reviews.content: This was our first stop on the Hanoi Street Food Tour and it ended up being our favorite dish in Hanoi. We got the rice noodles and pork dish.

reviews.author: VAnne707
reviews.title: The best food that I had in Vietnam
reviews.content: Bun Cha is famous in Hanoi. We tried this at Bun Cha Ta on our first day in Hanoi and we were hooked!!The bun cha is lovely. The broth is so flavourful! The accompanying spring rolls melt in your mouth. It's delicious. A must try in Hanoi!

reviews.author: BaffledSpaniels
reviews.title: Great Vietnamese Bun Cha
reviews.content:
We were taken here on a street food tour and I went back twice. The food is delicious. Bun Cha comes as a bowl of soup with meat balls, separate rice noodles, a basket of herbs and fresh garlic & chilli. You combine all of these in the bowl to make it how you like. Lots of garlic but easy on the chilli for me.

The restaurant has 3 floors and if you go upstairs then you take your shoes off before going into the dining area.

Staff are very helpful and speak English so you'll have no problems.

reviews.author: geofft3056
reviews.title: Limited Menu - But What they do is Great
reviews.content: As per the title there are very limited choices on the menu. But if you are chasing the best spring rolls in Hanoi, or the best Bun Cha then look no further. It's cheap & cheerful & staff are very helpful. Upstairs is great for solo diners if you don't mind taking off your shoes you are seated at a bench with others. A great experience!

reviews.author: Marissa H
reviews.title: Delicious food, nice atmoshpere
reviews.content: Delicious Bun Cha! Food arrives quickly and they explain how to eat it. The second floor is really cute, nicely decorated, and you can hear Hanoi’s traffic noises in the background, but in a quiet way just to give it a more authentic Vietnamese street food feel. Definitely order the recommended dish, with the spring rolls!

reviews.author: Paulo B
reviews.title: One of the best restaurants in Hanoi for the perfect bun cha!!!!
reviews.content: The bun cha is absolutely delicious. One of the best meals we had in Vietnam! We recommend it in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Jenny A
reviews.title: Delicious introduction to bun cha
reviews.content: Popped in here for lunch. Delighted with our choice of venue and of the recommended traditional pork bun cha with fried spring rolls. They were delicious. Our waitress was superb. When our food arrived, she spent time explaining and showing us how to combine all of the ingredients together to create the perfect bun cha. We’re back here again tomorrow!

reviews.author: Tim L
reviews.title: Oh. My. God.
reviews.content:
Love this place!  We visited here twice in a 4 day Hanoi trip, the food is oh-so-good (amazing broth, fresh piquant herbs, flavourful meat and spring rolls) and staff are very friendly.

I would eat this everyday...

reviews.author: Marc d
reviews.title: Amazing streetfood
reviews.content: Great food,nice restaurant and english speaking staff. On the second floor you can eat on low benches and you have to take your shoes off... nice start of an evening in the old quater of Hanoi.

reviews.author: TravellingSoon87
reviews.title: Could eat there everyday...
reviews.content:
Like the title says could eat here everyday.
The Bun Cha here is amazing.
It was one of the stops on my food walking tours.
They provide amazing accompaniments to the Bun Cha. (lettuce, basil, pickled garlic)
There pork tasted like someone took the care and time to do it right.
They do have AC but you might need to ask to have it turned on.
The 2nd floor is where I was seated, you have to take your shoes off and pile it in the sea of other people's shoes.
Other than that they have good service and value.

reviews.author: Bohunx
reviews.title: Best bun cha
reviews.content: Visited based on TripAdvisor reviews. At the door we were a bit reluctant but it turned up to be the best bun cha that we've tried so far! Quick, cheap and super tasty.

reviews.author: meghangw
reviews.title: Om Nom!
reviews.content: I was pleasantly surprised at the awesomeness of this place. It was full of smiling customers. The staff were very helpful in showing us how to eat Bun cha. It was amazing! So delicious. We had the recommended meal, and we are thinking we might go back for more! So delicious, filling and healthy-feeling (when you're tired of all the fried stuff!) 10/10

reviews.author: Ljm88
reviews.title: Definitely visit!
reviews.content: Delicious fresh food and very helpful staff. Great value and easy to order. Spring roll and bun cha set is super filling and less than 100,000 VND. Thank you!

reviews.author: Alain D
reviews.title: So good
reviews.content:
I have been to this restaurant few times last year.  Still one of the best Bun Cha in Old Quarter
Good Bun Cha. Warm atmosphere. But so friendly staff. Nana was so welcoming. All staff very efficient. Delicious. Quick service.

reviews.author: jennydd79
reviews.title: Delicious simple food
reviews.content: Amazing food and extremely fast service. I tried the seafood spring roll rice noodles. Would recommend to add extra chili but only two or three pieces as they are hotter in Vietnam than in Aus.

reviews.author: Estherbaud
reviews.title: GO here when in Hanoi!
reviews.content: Best meal we had in three weeks of traveling Vietnam. We went here three times and are still talking about the delicious flavor and superb spring rolls. A must go when in Hanoi!!

reviews.author: Marvin W
reviews.title: Comfortable
reviews.content: Good spot for food that's just as good as you can buy on the street, but with seats, shade, walls, and a bigger menu.  Totally refreshing and well prepared dishes for small and large appetites

reviews.author: Isabella T
reviews.title: Consistently very tasty and lovely staff
reviews.content: Some of the tastiest food we’ve had in Vietnam so far! And pretty cheap too. We’ve been back several times as we enjoyed it so much, and the staff have always been lovely and very helpful. The restaurant itself is very cute and air conditioned. It’s a good first stop for Bun Cha if you’re trying it for the first time, as they talk you through how to eat it properly. Lan was our waitress for a couple of our visits, and recognised my partner and I. She was particularly friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: 471sally
reviews.title: Don’t be put off by surroundings
reviews.content: We had a delicious stop here as part of the walking food tour and had a great taste of authentic Vietnamese food. Cosy place, basic, but good food and service

reviews.author: Charmagne O
reviews.title: Good good good food and friendly staff!!!
reviews.content: Had Bun Cha Ta”Grilled pork , rice noodles, and spring rolls” serving was good if you’re light eater its heavy ; if you love food definitely just right portion. Egg coffee was good but strong and Vietnamese rice whiskey was cool to try!

reviews.author: Daniel K
reviews.title: Great Bun Cha
reviews.content: We came across Bun Cha Ta on our food tour and had to come back for another delicious and authentic Bun Cha. The owner was very friendly and even gave us free samples of her homemade rice wine! Definitely worth a visit when in Hanoi

reviews.author: stslicker
reviews.title: Great location, Fantastic food, Sincere and Friendly Service. Amazing value. What more can a traveller ask for?
reviews.content:
The restaurant provides an unassuming homely vibe that makes you feel at ease immediately. Despite being relatively small on the 1st floor, there are also tables on the 2nd floor so finding a seat is pretty convenient. Wooden tables and chairs add to the warmth of the atmosphere and you can find yourself settling in immediately after a long day of hectic traffic and avoiding motorcycles. 

Ordering from a Vietnamese menu may be daunting for tourists but the menu is pretty straightforward here- Go for the full package with the deep-fried spring rolls. Easy and delicious.
The bun cha is served hot and fast with plenty of rice paddy herb, mint and lettuce to add to the soup. The pork patties are grilled over a fire, resulting in a nice charred flavor but still maintaining its juiciness in the middle. Adding the raw garlic and chili padis add additional layers of flavor and texture to the soup. If you are feeling adventurous, do try their homemade rice whiskies to finish the meal. The liquor is clear and may be flavored with apples, ginger or peaches depending on what they have.

Service is pretty intimate as this is a family run establishment and service staff are more than willing to help tourists in explaining how to eat the dish "properly". Returning a second time during my stay in Hanoi, Ha Ooi (the service staff) remembered us and was quick with sharing with us the history of the restaurant. 
Her friendliness and sincerity made the experience more unforgettable and it was extremely heartwarming to hear that her grandmother of age 80 was still running the kitchen, ensuring food is served with a high level of consistency and quality.
Overall, I would return to this place in a heartbeat and one of the first few places I would visit for bun cha would be this humble establishment.

reviews.author: antoniacable
reviews.title: Grear bun cha
reviews.content: We were looking for street bun cha, but were caught in the rain so this restaurant was perfect. The menu has a few different combinations of bun cha and spring rolls. All reasonably priced, all delicious. Plenty of room upstairs. The waitress was very helpful, showing us how to eat the dishes and explaining the ingredients. Great lunch option. They have beer 😁

reviews.author: TSPW
reviews.title: quick food taste nice
reviews.content: okay, u gonna make a mess but eating this, all this nodles and spring role ingredient plus the a bit sticky sauce.  But they taste nice, would be better if they are hotter.  Perhaps they don't suppose to be hot?  One yet is only enough for one person and I cannot really tell the different between the sets, they are taste the same.   Not the cheapest Bun Cha I had in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Philip O
reviews.title: Lovely staff but food average
reviews.content:
Staff were excellent and restaurant had a nice ambience. We ate upstairs where shoes needed to be taken off.

Very limited menu as expected and food ok but nothing special.

reviews.author: Danijela P
reviews.title: Excellent restaurant with great food!
reviews.content: During my visit to Vietnam, I was on a special diet, so I could eat a very limited variety of foods, and the whole diet was reduced mainly to bun cha and some other soups. From this reason, I tried this dish on millions of places across Vietnam! And the bun cha at the Bun Cha Ta restaurant was definitely one of the best. The soup was moderately spicy and very tasty, not greasy at all, the meat was so delicious and there was enough of it, the herbs that are served as an additive were varied, and the seafood rolls were definitely one of the better ones I tried!

reviews.author: Gingerfatlad
reviews.title: Really good food!!!
reviews.content: My friend and his family (who are Vietnamese) recommended I come here. The staff are lovely and speak good English, the restaurant is clean, the food is delicious and very well priced! I got the grilled Pork soup, rice noodles, salad and 2 spring rolls at 95kVND! And the chocolate, egg and cream desert for 40kVND which is good!! I come back here without reservation!

reviews.author: Tony B
reviews.title: Good. Safe
reviews.content: This bun cha place is very safe. Good for first time travelers. Eating in Vietnam can be intimidating for the uninitiated. There's so many options to eat in one's view as their strolling down the street, that a place like this indoor, air -conditioned restaurant can be a decent 1st step into the food of Hanoi. Everything here tastes safe, average, compared to the Bun Cha you'd get from one of the street shops. To be honest, the spots i found to eat in Hanoi were restaurants i did not find on Trip Advisor. Best to use your senses. "if it looks good, eat it!" (shameless zimmern plug)

reviews.author: ciara f
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.content: This is clearly a family run restaurant with a homely feel.  The bun cha is really great here.  It is also very cheap.  The staff explained how to eat this meal and told us about the different herbs served.  No frills but delicious.

reviews.author: Katie H
reviews.title: Best food in Hanoi!
reviews.content: We are still going strong in Hanoi and have visited this place 3 times already. The Bun Cha is one of the tastiest dishes I have ever tasted. Vietnamese food at it's finest. This restaurant is a full experience as the staff are so wonderful. They talk to you about the history of the dish and how best to prepare and eat it. The flavours are just unreal. Thankyou so much to the staff who have welcomed us every time. Thanks for the rice wine too!! Woohoo!! We will be back soon.

reviews.author: Kris
reviews.title: Great bun cha, good service & good price @ 95000 for set
reviews.content: Tasty bun cha, good service & good price @ 95000 for set. Sat upstairs in shoes off area. Service was prompt, friendly & the server showed us how to eat & explained different herbs

reviews.author: MM SS
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha in Hanoi at affordable profe
reviews.content: We had the Bun Cha and spring rolls at this restaurant which is recommended in the menu(set). The bun cha is the best we have eaten in Hanoi and the price is cheaper compared with the other restaurant we had went in Hanoi.

reviews.author: sueellen2
reviews.title: Do yourself a favor & eat here!
reviews.content: We were told about this hidden treasure by some fellow travelers who had eaten at this restaurant the night before.  Take your shoes off to sit in the sunken dining area. This was a fantastic restaurant with great food.  The food and drinks were so cheap.   Do yourself a favor and go with the recommended Number 1 on the menu. The service at Bun Cha Ta was so friendly!  All I can say is do yourself a favor and eat here!

reviews.author: Bi66les70
reviews.title: Awesome.
reviews.content:
Best Bun Cha ever. 
A must do in Hanoi. 
Fantastic food, great service and very reasonable price. 
Have eaten here twice and will be back on next visit to Hanoi.

reviews.author: shailender k
reviews.title: Nice Vietnamese Cuisine
reviews.content: This place was near to our hotel and we went there on the recommendation of hotel staff. We were definitely not disappointed. Initially we were lost in the menu card, not knowing what to order. Thankfully one of the staff realised our difficulty and immediately made some recommendations. The food was delicious.

reviews.author: Marcus Kung
reviews.title: The best bun cha I have tried in Hanoi
reviews.content: I have been to the restaurant twice during my 7 days trip in Hanoi. The food is really nice and the price is affordable for backpacker like me. Also the staff there is so friendly with well service. Will go to there again if I visit Hanoi again.

reviews.author: Leicaman8
reviews.title: Highly rated Bun Cha restaurant
reviews.content:
Read the many good reviews so we decided to try this highly rated Bun Cha restaurant. We are familiar with Bun Cha and have eaten Bun Cha regularly in our many visits to Hanoi . 
The staff was very welcoming and restaurant have good seating . Noticed all the clients were mainly western . 
We found the Bun Cha broth to be rather one dimensional and the broth makes or breaks this dish. A good broth should be a good balance between sweetness, sourness and saltiness without one taste overpowering the others. We found the broth lacking balance and rather one dimensional. To our taste the pork patties were too lean ( should be unctuous). The fried spring rolls were not crispy and a bit chewy . 
We rate it 3.5 . Not bad but there are many better Bun Cha Restaurants in the old quarter.

reviews.author: conkiess
reviews.title: Excellent service with really yummy food
reviews.content: Very pleasant dining experience! Staff were all very well-mannered and attentive. Especially when they noticed that we were foreigners and looked lost at the delicacy placed in front of us. They came over and asked us gently if we have tried buncha before and we answered no. They then taught us how to enjoy the meal the local way. Food was great too! The grilled pork is exceotionally flavourful and tender. It was honestly the nicest BunCha I've had in Hanoi. Would totally return to this place again. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: flowergal88
reviews.title: Great Bun Cha
reviews.content: Do order their signature set with the traditional fried spring roll! thier buncha is really tasty compared to those we had on the streets

reviews.author: katiemichelle13
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.content: We had lunch here twice because we enjoyed it so much. The bun cha is such a delicious dish and the ambience and service is top notch. Fairly priced, and our server was so adorable, a highlight of my day. If you want to try the dish of Hanoi I would give this place a shot.

reviews.author: Nancy L
reviews.title: Not surprised this is highly rated
reviews.content: Went there upon recommended by our hotel owners, were very tired in the noon due to hot and dusty weather; and we were glad to have found decent lunch! They serve grilled meatballs and their specialty soup which is not what we get to eat even in authentic Vietnamese restaurants in our home country. Very good service from staff as well.

reviews.author: Saad S
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.content: One of the best restaurants i visited so far in Hanoi. The food is very delicious and authentic. The restaurant has a very beautiful design and the service is extremely nice and friendly. This restaurant is a must try in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Aorm Cho
reviews.title: แนะนำว่าอร่อยมากกก Very Yummy Vietnam Food
reviews.content: I had got a Full Option Menu It’s so good , Good tasty, I love Spring rolls very Crispy , and Soup that served with spring rolls it’s really yummy , good smell , good taste and I love grilled pork in soup OMG!! I really love it. When I back to hanoi Exactly I will back to Bun Cha ta!!!

reviews.author: vanyalouise
reviews.title: Fab soup and spring rolls
reviews.content: We saw this on trip advisor on the near by tab . So glad we went the food was fab , the spring rolls were too , the lady who served and showed us our seats was very nice and helpful and showed us how to eat the soup with the selected herbs for the best flavours . Her English was great , it was very nice .wrll worth the visit

reviews.author: ulicu
reviews.title: Only tourists but good food
reviews.content: There was not one single vietnamese in the restaurant. But besides, we were very happy with the place! The staff is friendly and tries to explain you how to eat the meals. The food was delicious.

reviews.author: Beth D
reviews.title: Bun Cha...way better than Pho
reviews.content: So we’ve already been here twice and will definitely go again before the end of our stay in Hanoi. Yes, it’s right around the corner from our hotel, but the Bun Cha (both the #1 and #4) are delicious and the service is excellent! You get a bowl of rich broth with bits of carrot, 3 mini meat patties (think beef sliders) and pieces of grilled steak. Along with that you get a plate of rice noodles, a bowl of greens (mint, lettuce, purple leaf and another leaf, maybe tarragon?) and a large yummy fried spring roll. They are happy to show you how to eat it, but don’t forget to add garlic and red chilies from the bowls already on your table. Also, be sure to try a shot or two of their rice whiskey...it’ll curl your toes but it’s only $1 and the apple-flavored one is tasty AND strong. Pho is fine, but Bun Cha is a flavor explosion of deliciousness, especially at Bun Cha Ta!

reviews.author: viviantvm
reviews.title: Great food and ambient!
reviews.content: Food here is really delicious, and most importantly they have the menu in English if you cannot understand Vietnamese. Bun Cha (full set) is a must try here!

reviews.author: SuebeePerth
reviews.title: Don't hesitate!
reviews.content: This place is a must in Hanoi for Bun Cha it was SOOO good. Very relaxed, clean, cheap and really friendly. Vegetarians are catered for.

reviews.author: alexandramL7689YM
reviews.title: So delicious!
reviews.content:
Tried Bun Cha for the first time in HCMC, but this was 1000x better! 

Portions are massive, you won’t leave hungry

reviews.author: Lélène
reviews.title: So good !!!
reviews.content: Very good food, nice persons !!! You have to taste ! They explain you how to eat the bun cha ta if it's your first time !

reviews.author: LazyRose
reviews.title: Delicious Food & Friendly Staff
reviews.content: This place was great. There is a restaurant seating area kind of upstairs from where you enter and it is very cozy. The staff are super nice, and they seem to cater to foreigners here. When they bring the food, they'll explain to you how to eat it if you aren't sure how. The bun cha is delicious, and I highly recommend trying it at least once when you are visiting Vietnam.

reviews.author: tompowell16
reviews.title: Incredible!!
reviews.content:
We are here 3/5 nights because it was so good! 
It’s cheap too! We loved the fact the staff explained which each leaf was, but they all went into the pot anyway. Highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: i3abyluv1
reviews.title: Best food we ate in Hanoi!
reviews.content: The broth was so good, not too salty. The meat was flavorful and the egg rolls were delicious we had to order some to take home. Fast and efficient service, highly recommended!!

reviews.author: Mu Z
reviews.title: Good recommendation
reviews.content: Quaint restaurant with delicious food.  Very clean and efficient.  There is an upstairs dining area as well.  Easy to find.

reviews.author: Michaela
reviews.title: Fantastic lunch
reviews.content:
We wanted to try what Vietnamese people call dry noodle. Essentially they give each person a big bowl of a broth-like soup that also contains meat and vegetables, and that serves as a dipping sauce to which you add your own customized that are on the table. Ingredients like hot peppers, garlic, herbs and different sauces. You then dip your cooked rice noodles and spring rolls into it bite by bite or piece by piece,and transfer those dipped items into another small bowl and eat from there. A little hard to explain but much easier if you could see someone do it, and thankfully our guide was there to explain the procedure.

We had their “Full Option” lunch which included grilled pork, traditional fried spring rolls and rice noodles, which cost about $4.00. Absolutely delicious!

reviews.author: tracyaustin777
reviews.title: Best place to enjoy bun cha
reviews.content: We discovered Bun Cha Ta from a recommendation by our hotel. We had eaten bun Cha before on our first visit to Hanoi, but this time this restaurant really made a great experience of the whole meal. The different dining levels make this a very social meal and the staff explain so well the intricacies of adding ingredients to the dish. For the uneniciated Bun Cha is a tasty sweet sour soup with pieces of charcoal grilled pork and accompanied by a basket of fresh and tasty greens, a plate of fine rice noodles and a plate of crispy spring rolls cut into segments. You add garlic and chilli and pepper to suit your taste, and then add small amounts of the other ingredients to the soup and eat. Spring roll segments are dipped into the soup as well. The staff are so friendly and helpful and you feel like you are eating bun Cha like a local by the end of the meal. So good we have gone back to eat a number of times. Really a MUST DO in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Amy B
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.content: I discovered bun cha 6 years ago during my first trip to Hanoi and couldn’t wait to introduce my partner to it this time. He was not disappointed. This place is the best. Service was good the ladies were lovely. But beyond all the flavours were amazing! I would recommend it to anyone who wants some real authentic Vietnamese food.

reviews.author: Catherine R
reviews.title: Amazing food! Full of flavour
reviews.content: Attentive staff that explained exactly how to eat Bun Cha. Loved it so much I went back for a 2nd time! Food was so tasty and the waitress even sent me the recipe by email as I was so fond of it. Great place to try the staple Bun Cha Ta famous in Hanoi!

reviews.author: needlehill
reviews.title: Worth its reputation
reviews.content:
In our quest for the best Bun Cha, we had to try this place.
We were surprised to find mainly meatballs in the bowl, and not the different kinds of pieces, as usual. But as long as they taste good, no problem!
I would say that their Bun Cha is nicer than Bun Cha Huong Lien, but their seafood spring rolls aren't so yummy.
It means that you have to try both places :)
The staff is lively and energetic, we're not bored!

reviews.author: maedbh f
reviews.title: Well worth the visit
reviews.content: Following a recommandation from our hotel we ate here and really enjoyed it. It offers a couple of varieties of the same dish and de chose the full option and seafood option. Food was so fresh and tasty. I had the rice wine whisky which i liked.  Go here for authentic and healthy food

reviews.author: rusky04
reviews.title: Authentic
reviews.content: Great ambience, friendly staff and of course very tasty bun cha! Must try on your visit to Hanoi! Reasonable price too.

reviews.author: ietsanders86
reviews.title: Great local dish
reviews.content: Went here twice, first by TA recommendation and second day on food tour. Take the first option on the menu and you'll have a great noodle dish, Hanoi speciality. Quick and good service and they speak some English, explaining how to eat it. Good value for money.

reviews.author: Celeste P
reviews.title: Best bun cha!
reviews.content:
We had bun cha on our first day in hanoi after hearing all about it from friends and family back home. We went to a different place and we didn’t like it at all. 
A week later we tried it again at Bun Cha Ta and my faith was fully restored. Awesome food, some of the best service we’ve had in Vietnam and a unique environment upstairs.  Thanks team!

reviews.author: Joel C
reviews.title: Great Bun Cha and fun wait staff!
reviews.content: We were sat in their second floor dining room. The waitress was super helpful and taught up some Vietnamese food related words! The broth was delicious and the spring rolls were perfectly fried.  Definitely worth your time if you are swinging through, or sitting for a spell in Hanoi's Old Quarter.

reviews.author: Susan Joy H
reviews.title: My new fav place in Hanoi
reviews.content: I love bun cha. And this place had the best atmosphere and prices are reasonable. Plus the hot chocolate egg drink is a must!!

reviews.author: Amelia
reviews.title: So yummy!!
reviews.content:
We had experienced a bad case of bun cha on our Vietnam trip before, so we were hesitant to try bun cha again but the reviews on Bun Cha Ta made us want to visit. 
The Bun Cha did not disappoint! We sat upstairs at these cosy tables for groups. The Bun Cha was fresh, so tasty, and cheap! Atmosphere was great and the staff were very friendly and welcoming. 

Recommending to my friends :)

reviews.author: R8632DJjonathand
reviews.title: Excellent Bun Cha
reviews.content: Really nice restaurant in Hanoi. The Bun Cha (we took the option 1 on the menu) was very good and the staff was super friendly. They offered free rice wine to the whole room after Vietnam won the semi-finals of the AFC!

reviews.author: Compass711224
reviews.title: Great value for money
reviews.content: We had dinner. It was beautiful so much flavour. Fantastic value relly quick service and the staff were lovely. Don't be deceived by the exterior

reviews.author: ryantravelor
reviews.title: Great bun cha
reviews.content: This place had great bun cha and friendly service.  It's small like many other places in the old quarter, but it's good quality food - especially for the price. A definite place to visit while you are in Hanoi and the old quarter.

reviews.author: sroyall
reviews.title: Absolutely delicious-must visit!
reviews.content:
Delicious and full of flavour. Sit upstairs at the unusual tables. The bun cha and spring rolls are one of the highlights of our stay in Hanoi.
Very friendly waitresses. A bargain at £5.80 for 2x full meals consisting of bun cha, noodles, spring rolls and bottled water.

reviews.author: curlygirlcurlygirl
reviews.title: Loved the Bun Cha!
reviews.content: I had Bun Cha before and I thought this one was delicious. The staff were friendly and were giving us some Vietnamese lessons.  They also gave us some free rice wine.

reviews.author: Tiffany F
reviews.title: Best bun cha!
reviews.content: I’ve been in northern Vietnam for a few weeks and this is the best bun cha I’ve had!! Also AMAZING service - food comes out so quick and staff are so sweet and friendly! I’ve been back so many times and they remember me and give me a free sample of rice wine for coming back again. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sarah T
reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.content: Best Bun Cha ever! The service and quality are great. Highly recommend. You have to try this while you are in Hanoi.

reviews.author: AJICE
reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.content: Make sure to go upstairs as there is more than one floor of seating areas. It is cozier upstairs. They have a very nice chicken soup (Pho). We visited during a street food walking tour.

reviews.author: Siunainai
