reviews.title: Not as good as other Bun Cha!
reviews.content: We went to this restaurant after reading the good reviews from others; but it is quite disappointing after our visit. We had Bun cha at Bun cha Nem Cua Be Dac Kim before we tried this restaurant and in our opinion, in term of taste of food and price, we like other better. This restaurant is nicely decorated but the price of the Bun Cha is expensive. If you want a nice environment and less crowded place and don't mind to pay more, then this maybe your choice. However, if you wanna to go for taste, then you may consider others.

reviews.author: Shimnik
reviews.title: Simple but good!
reviews.content: It seems that place is famous among tourists. I would not call it attractive from outside or inside. It is a simple cafe with limited variation of dishes you can order. Bun cha ta dish consists of a plate with egg vermicelli, bowl of grass and plate with boullione, where grilled pork is floating. Surprisingly, it tastes good and not expensive - 95 or 110.000 dong. You can order rice whiskey for 40.000 or a special Hanoian drink coffee with egg. I liked it, very unusual.

reviews.author: DL1980Brisbane
reviews.title: Loved the food!
reviews.content:
Loved everything we ordered!
Very good street food. The noodles with spring rolls were awesome. Could eat them everyday!

Also the lemon soda and choc egg custard was a must try!

reviews.author: urcrazyboy
reviews.title: Easy set up, yummy food
reviews.content:
Great food served with a brilliant smile. Good price, clean, welcoming. 
The Bun Cha Ta full option was especially delicious with the spring rolls!
Will be here again....

reviews.author: bombkbank
reviews.title: Street food at its finest
reviews.content: We had a great meal there. Bun Cha was well prepared and taste great. Herbs were fresh and taste good. This is the place for clean street food with reasonable price (even lower price than some food stalls down the street). Although, they offer only limited item on their menu, all of them are great. Service was great too. Staffs were extremely friendly. Highly Recommended!!

reviews.author: Gaelle000000000
reviews.title: Love that place!
reviews.content: Semi-accidentally walked into Bun Cha Ta after strolling through the Old Quarter all morning. Absolutely loved the atmosphere and the food! Upstairs, the room is sort of tatami style, shoes off, sound proof from the street, extremely relaxing. I ordered the mixed meal (95k VDN, although, there was more basic meals circa 60k VDN) and it was deliciouuuus. The spring rolls were very yummy and the meatball very tasty. I didn't know that dish and tried another 'recommended place' that evening but it wasn't as good as this one.

reviews.author: GideonHefer
reviews.title: Very tasteful traditional Vietnamese cuisine
reviews.content: Very traditional restaurant with great Bun Cha meals. The prices are very affordable and the service very efficient.

reviews.author: Jaymie D
reviews.title: Must visit in Hanoi
reviews.content: My friend and I chose to eat at Bun Cha Ta after reading through TripAdvisor reviews and were not disappointed. Bun Cha is a Hanoi specialty dish, so why wouldn't you? The staff were so friendly - the lady who saw to us spoke very good English and took the time to explain to us how to eat our meals. We loved the upstairs seating arrangement and very much enjoyed our food! Would visit again :)

reviews.author: dguppy
reviews.title: Safe street food
reviews.content: Great little cafe in the heart of the old quarter. Safe street food, very flavoursome, fresh and a pleasant atomsphere. Good range of simple dishes.

reviews.author: Maxine M
reviews.title: Was expecting better
reviews.content: We were recommended this restaurant by our hotel for lunch. The atmosphere was really lacking with total silence and the manager sitting at the next table doing his accounts or something. Some music would definitely have been appreciated, felt like we couldn’t talk. The food itself was average, the pork didn’t have that much flavour. The spring rolls were good though.

reviews.author: W7221MIannav
reviews.title: Fresh, delicious, cheap!
reviews.content: A lovely little restaurant in the Old Quarter. Staff very kind and attentive and the lady who served us took the time to explain how to eat bun cha properly and taught us some Vietnamese phrases. The pork was DELICIOUS and the noodles and greens fresh. There is garlic and chilli at every table to flavour your dish to your liking. The spring rolls were delicious too :) Would definitely visit again.

reviews.author: Elena
reviews.title: Heaven in a bowl
reviews.content: We found this place on the official Hanoi Street Food Tour and had to go back the next day for lunch. Incredible bun cha. Lovely staff. Accept no substitute!

reviews.author: katlist
reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.content: I was really excited to check out this place after seeing all the amazing trip advisor reviews. Honestly, I was disappointed. The food was pretty good and the set meal was filling, but you can get better, cheaper, and more authentic food all over Hanoi. If it was ever 'off-the-beaten-track', it isn't anymore. The place was filled with tourists--no locals. That should have been a red flag. Altogether, a rather mediocre experience perhaps better suited to a less adventurous tourist than myself.

reviews.author: CK S
reviews.title: My new favourite Vietnamese dish!
reviews.content:
Bun Cha is a traditional norther Vietnamese dish and it is delicious. 

You are served a plate of rice noodles, a basket of greens, a bowl of broth (dipping sauce) and fried spring rolls. You take a bit of noodles, a bit of greens, a piece of spring roll and dip it all in the broth and enjoy. The full combo for one (but enough for two of us) is $95,000 VND. You can order a side of extra spring rolls as they are delicious!

This is one of the best things I ate in Vietnam and Bun Cha Ta does an excellent job on the dish! They also provide excellent service!

You simply have to try it while in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Ambika A
reviews.title: fantastic bun cha!! (and yummy vegetarian options!)
reviews.content: Went here on our first night in Hanoi and absolutely loved the food. The staff was also very friendly and explained to us how to each bun cha and what to order (since some of us were vegetarians.) Order the bun cha and spring rolls, fantastic!

reviews.author: Monica L
reviews.title: Friendly staff delicious food
reviews.content: Super nice food and staff explain how to best enjoy it. We sat on the second floor where we had to take shoes off before entering. Very clean. Worth a visit .

reviews.author: DellaSalway
reviews.title: Bun cha experts
reviews.content: Came here as part of a street food tour, and easy to see why we were brought here.  This was the best bun cha we had on our holiday, nice to have a large bowl of the tasty sauce in which to dip the meat, noodles and veggies.  Delicious and very good value.

reviews.author: Blakey
reviews.title: Try the Bun Cha Set!
reviews.content:
This is a nice place with great Bun cha served as a very generous portion with plenty of delicious minced pork. The soup itself was very tasty and the only thing stopping me giving higher rating is that the soup was not particularly hot. 

I tried the Bun Cha Set with fried Seafood Spring rolls. Spring rolls were decent and not too oily. I'd definitely come back for more - very impressed. 

The restaurant can get quite busy and it seemed to be part of a group food tasting tour. I ended up waiting quite a while to be served when I sat upstairs. The food however more than compensates for this.

reviews.author: happyhok
reviews.title: First try of Bun Cha here and it’s fantastic !
reviews.content: I love Bun Cha ! First time tried at this restaurant and I really love it ! It has become my number one dish for Vietnamese food!

reviews.author: Alex B
reviews.title: Came highly recommended
reviews.content: Bun cha ta gave me a different look at Vietnamese food.  I had the bun cha, but deep friend spring roll with vermicelli. It came with a soup which serves as a dip for the roll.  It was just right for a light lunch.  It isn't quite the same style as the Vietnamese food I have in Canada but it was nice to sample the local style cuisine.  I can recommend the place to visitors to Hanoi.  It did not disappoint.

reviews.author: linh y
reviews.title: Very delicious
reviews.content: I have lunch with my friends. I know Bun Cha Ta because of high ratings on trip advisor and we were not disappointed. Bun Cha is very fit. Staff very friendly and fast. My friends are very satisfied. They also sent me a photo of me. I will recommend restaurants to my friends

reviews.author: misshazeyeyed
reviews.title: Excellent hidden gem, must try!
reviews.content:
​We asked our tour guide where's good, what's off the beaten track, what's a hidden gem, and his first answer was this. Bun Cha Ta is a must-do restaurant in Hanoi. It's two storeys of intimate bun cha (traditional Vietnamese noodle soup). It always seems pretty busy and you've got to be prepared to take your shoes off and sit on the floor.
The menu is relatively limited, but will still have something for everyone and their dietary requirements. The salad is filled with herbs, and the waitress will explain to you how to eat them and what medicinal properties they have. The soup is hearty and flavoursome, like those pots that have been bubbling for generations. I also tried an egg coffee and was pleasantly surprised,  what what a delicious drink! 

This restaurant is such a cool experience and it's wonderful value for money. Don't even bother trying bun cha anywhere else, it just won't be as good.

reviews.author: Axra17
reviews.title: Fantastic food!
reviews.content: Went for a quick lunch. They have a small menu of which there are two vegetarian options - the food was mind-blowing! Fresh vegetables and herbs and yummy broths. Nice service - they taught us how to eat the food. Great value for money - don’t miss out if you can go!

reviews.author: Sze-Wan N
reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.content: Yummy and delicious local flavour! A must try. For those that are familiar with the Pho, this is the lesser known cousin but in my opinion much more flavourful and authentic. Lots of herbs to accompany a broth / dipping sauce for the vermicelli. The broth comes with pork-based meatballs. One of the waitresses (can't remember her name) but she spoke excellent English. She spent so much time explaining the origin of the dish and showed us how to properly enjoy it. The ambience is also very pleasant and clean which added to the experience. Don't leave Hanoi without stopping by this must visit foodie stop.

reviews.author: Tony Ng
reviews.title: Must try!
reviews.content: Been there twice. Staff were so nice, they explained to us everything including the origin of the food and the way to eat it like the locals. And the food were undoubtedly excellent! For my second visit there, they even offered me a shot of wine for free!

reviews.author: sebastiant519
reviews.title: Hanoi Street Food
reviews.content: BBQ Pork that marinated with fish sauce, vinegar, shallot & sugar. Authentic Hanoi food, a must try when you are in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Nixek2810
reviews.title: Addictive
reviews.content: I had no idea how to eat this but the staff kindly taught me how to do it. Basically put the vermicelli and vege into the broth with the meat balls and eat! The broth is a bit sour and sweet and spicy if u add chili and minced garlic. Very appetizing! The fried spring roll is very nice!

reviews.author: Jovern O
reviews.title: Awesome Bun Cha
reviews.content: Good place to have Bun Cha, Service is good. Price is reasonable, total damage was 140k VND. The food is good and the herbs are fresh..

reviews.author: Esther R
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: Wowww very love this local food.. pork grilled with soup, rice noddle and herb vegetable...omg i only try once at Gia Ngu street and its superb !!!

reviews.author: Cathleen D
reviews.title: So good!!
reviews.content: Only had one night in Hanoi and decided to come here for a late lunch. The Bun Cha was delicious and the egg coffee was great! The staff were very friendly and service was great. Amazing food for a good price. Definitely a must try whilst in Hanoi - highly recommend!

reviews.author: Karl H
reviews.title: Yummy “street” food
reviews.content:
Friendly staff, helpful. Great place to escape the bustle and have clean and fresh food - vegetarian spring rolls are worth it alone!

“Street” food flavour and experience although slightly Westernised way to do it. 

Yum!

reviews.author: Glynis031
reviews.title: Delicious bun cha
reviews.content: I went to Bun Cha Ta for Hanoi's famous dish, bun cha, on the recommendation of my hotel. It's a soup with pork, served with a dish of rice vermicelli and a dish of lettuce and herbs - delicious. They explained what to do - put a little lettuce, herbs and rice into the pork soup at a time. The serving was extremely generous. It was so good, I returned a second time.

reviews.author: Criss C
reviews.title: Such amazing food and staff!
reviews.content: Great great great bun cha! They say you missed Hanoi if you miss bun cha, and they're so right about it! Today was my last day in Hanoi, after a full week, and I must admit I would have left disappointed if I wouldn't had this amazing dinner tonight! The flavours are just right, great Ballance of everything, all very fresh and the service is very very good. The ladies there speak v good English and you are told how to flavour and enjoy best your food. I had no 1 from the menu and a generous shot of Rice whiskey for 115.000vd. I will definitely come back! Thank you

reviews.author: Kia A
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.content: We liked it so much we went there a second time! Definitely recommend trying it out. Hoai (hopefully spelling her name right?) was there both times and was a great host!

reviews.author: liangwei
reviews.title: Good food
reviews.content: Wonderful food at reasonable price. Order the egg coffee and drink while it is is warm to enjoy the full delight!

reviews.author: shawney78
reviews.title: Amazing dish
reviews.content:
We couldn't believe how good the Bun Cha is, it was quite a filling stuff and super tasty.
We highly recommend this dish in this restaurant.

reviews.author: Selene Lo
reviews.title: Delicious food and service
reviews.content:
I definitely recommend this place one of the best places I tried in Hanoi, it is well located in the main quarter, the restaurant inside is very clean and comfortable. 

The food was perfect and delicious they even had the nice gesture to explain you in case you are a foreigner and do not know how to start. 

We tried their special with grilled pork which was very tasty. All the staff working in here are really nice, definetel

reviews.author: Jacob H
reviews.title: Awesome food great service
reviews.content: Just finishing up 4 days in Hanoi.  I had lots of great meals but this is the only place I had to go to twice. The Bun Cha was excellent, best I’ve had.  The atmosphere is comfortable and the service was excellent!  Don’t skip the rice wine, I had one soaked in ginger, apple, and apricot all were great!

reviews.author: Dave B
reviews.title: Great meal
reviews.content: First meal after arriving in Vietnam.  Bun Cha was so good....fresh, flavourful and so so good.  I liked that they should us how to eat it as well.  Make sure you add a couple pieces of hot pepper to the broth!

reviews.author: Jesse F
reviews.title: What a spread
reviews.content:
So you are presented with a bowl of a delicious broth, well balanced with a vinegar tang. You are given noodles separately, plus a salad bowl with herbs, and a small bowl with garlic and fresh chilli. We were told to squash the herbs and add them. It was excellent. 

I think the word that comes to mind is fresh! Just beautifully fresh food. Shoes are to be taken off upstairs.

reviews.author: Bronwen E
reviews.title: All Around Fantastic!
reviews.content: We went here when we first arrived in Hanoi and were warmly welcomes by the staff and with a warm bowl of soup :) The atmosphere is clean and cozy and the service is great and friendly. Bun Cha Ta is served with a huge bowl of mixed herbs and greens and the ladies explain how to eat if for the first-timers. We returned tonight and had another wonderful experience! Would recommend to all! Thanks again

reviews.author: Gabi T
reviews.title: Delicios food
reviews.content: Very tasty food in a small friendly restaurant. Small menu but targeted on essential traditional cuisine.

reviews.author: domsurfs
reviews.title: Local heavenly noodles
reviews.content:
Having first experienced eating Bun Cha on a local food tour (see my other review) I had been desperate to eat this wonderful dish again. Bun Cha is a Vietnamese dish consisting of pork meatballs and rice noodles. The way you eat it is quite different - the pork balls come in a sauce with noodles on they side - you then dip noodles into the sauce before eating. Herbs/chilli/garlic are provided which you can add to the sauce as you wish. Believe me it’s delicious!

I found Bun Cha Ta through trip advisor and it is very conveniently located in the old quarter. The restaurant has three floors so plenty of seating and we did not have to wait to be seated. Our waitress was lovely and also provided a shot of complimentary local rice wine for us to try!

reviews.author: Marta I
reviews.title: Amazing food and price
reviews.content: Very simple menu, amazing, tasty Vietnamese food. Really nice staff, who helps you put your meal together. Would definitely go back!!!

reviews.author: Julie P
reviews.title: Lunch for hungry tourists
reviews.content: This spot recommended to us by our guide. We got there and it was so busy- a great sign! Were served immediately and the food was fresh and flavoursome. Enjoyed great spring rolls, there was half a garden of fresh picked herbs on our table. Everything was so fresh! The only non locals in the place so a great sign. Highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: wheng_2159
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha in town
reviews.content: We came here twice, first as part of our Hanoi Street Food tour wherein our guide taught us how to eat the Bun Cha. Second time was on our last day in Hanoi and ordered the same meal we had during the first time. We were quite surprised at how huge the set meal was. Its the best Bun Cha i have ever tried in town.

reviews.author: HWKhor
reviews.title: Bun cha at its finest
reviews.content: We ordered a full option set and it was bombbbb. We thought it looked just average but it got us amazed with what it tastes like. Their rice noodles are springy and the broth can add chillies and garlic to spice it up.

reviews.author: rachelwins
reviews.title: Delicious Bun Cha
reviews.content: The Bun Cha here was really good. Lots of tourist here so I got a bit nervous about the authenticity but it was pretty authentic and one of the best meals we had in Hanoi. They give you a huge bowl of fish sauce that  light and not too salty/fishy.

reviews.author: Poppy A
reviews.title: Now addicted to Bun Cha!
reviews.content: Bun Cha Ta was fantastic, really lovely service and excellent food, best Bun Cha we had in Vietnam (and we tried it all over the place!)

reviews.author: Diana H
reviews.title: Delicious and risk-free street food
reviews.content: I was travelling with friends that are really cautious on health issues but I really wanted to try the Vietnamese street food. This is a safe choice and although I didn't get to try the original one, I'm pretty sure this is quite close. Definitely recommend it

reviews.author: Nancy V
reviews.title: Authentic food and helpful staff
reviews.content: The meal was delicious. The staff was really helpful and came over to help make recommendations and then again to make sure I knew how to eat the Vietnamese dish.  I really enjoyed my experience there.

reviews.author: Ornanim
reviews.title: Simple, tasty. A perfect start
reviews.content: The idea is simple but very tasty. Great service and friendly, unique atmosphere. We chose here for our first day- a great intro to Vietnamese food, with nothing too rich, heavy or alternative. Process explained very well by the waitress. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Excursion736762
reviews.title: Great Experience!
reviews.content: Had never had Bun Cha, and damn what had I been missing! Bun Cha Ta was a wonderful first experience as the staff were incredibly helpful and the food was incredible!

reviews.author: Luke D
reviews.title: Best food in Hanoi!!!
reviews.content: The noodle broth was incredible, the best in Vietnam on our trip so far! Garlic, Chilli which is very hot and herbs are all given on your table to add as you desire. It's great with a little of both! The spring rolls were great, especially when dunked into the broth. If going as two of you buy 1 x No1 and 1 x No2 as the spring rolls are very filling!

reviews.author: Hannah Y
reviews.title: Yummy, scrumptious and service with a smile
reviews.content:
This was my first and favourite experience of Ban Cha. 

The food had incredible depth of flavour and for a chopstick, noodle fiend it was an amazing culinary experience.

Our waitress was one of the most happy and cheerful on our trip (a high accolade as Vietnam has been one of the most cheerful countries I have visited), she had some wonderful riddles and took the time to help me perfect my Vietnamese 'thank you' (she also warned if I said it wrong I would be telling people to shut up instead!)

reviews.author: HasilRoshni
reviews.title: Fantastic concept!
reviews.content:
This restaurant is slightly unusual in that you have garlic, chilli and pepper already on your table when you walk in. All dishes come with rice noodles and greens allowing you to add however much of each you desire. 

There are 7 dishes to choose from including 2 for vegetarians. All of our party of 9 were thrilled with the restaurant and certainly walked out satisfied.

A fantastic concept and certainly worth a visit!

reviews.author: Emilie B
reviews.title: Street food at its best
reviews.content: Had some amazing Bun Cha with spring rolls on the side. The watermelon juice was spot on. There was a great atmosphere and smiling waiters.This place served my absolute favourite meal in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Kristoffer Foss... H
reviews.title: Amazing food
reviews.content: The staff is really friendly, and the food - wow - is amazing! Would eat here every day if I could!!

reviews.author: Jo T
reviews.title: Wonderful bun Cha!
reviews.content: We first discovered this restaurant as part of a street food walking tour. Bun Cha was delicious and we were sure to return! Lovely atmosphere with a kind of sunken seating on level 2 and 3 PLUS delicious bun Cha! We will be back!!

reviews.author: Феодор О
reviews.title: A must in Hanoi
reviews.content: Perfect place. The food is gorgeous, sooo delicious. For two weeks there we spent five or six dinners there, so good. The staff is great as well. So friendly and welcoming. Totally recommend

reviews.author: Krismif
reviews.title: The best!
reviews.content:
Three times in 7 days says it all really. Excellent quality ingredients, friendly staff with great English and sensible prices. Beer for 25 dong too. Just watch out for the chili’s! Don’t add too many. Free Wi-fi as well. 
The herbs are lovely and fresh here, we went to some places where they were old and wilted.

reviews.author: amin_amirali
reviews.country: Prague, Hlavni Mesto Praha, Czech Republic
reviews.title: Tasty bun cha and spring rolls!
reviews.content:
I really loved the food! Had to repeat the spring rolls, both the traditional and the sea food rolls were delicious! Great service aswel! Also nice that you have to remove your shoes when sitting on the second floor, cleeeeann!! :)
I strongly recommend this place!

reviews.author: nala08Australia
reviews.title: Great bun Cha experience
reviews.content: Come here for yummy bun Cha and friendly and fun service. The waitresses were up for a chat and a laugh and the food was incredible.

reviews.author: FoodyInstinct
reviews.title: Awesome Bun Cha
reviews.content: One of the best Bun Cha Restaurants we visited on our Vietnam Tour. The Service was very nice, food very delicious. We can recommend this place.

reviews.author: Sonnycolin
reviews.title: Great!
reviews.content: Bun cha Ta, Nice place. Food was great. Staff excellent. Worth the 5*. Would recommend you to try it out.

reviews.author: Rodney P
reviews.title: Best spring rolls in town, and much more
reviews.content: We met Charlotte in one of our tours and she recommended this place!!  We will forever be grateful to Charlotte!!!  The menu is very short, but what do you need?  great food and you will find it!

reviews.author: Violet R
reviews.title: Best food in Vietnam 🍜
reviews.content: This is by far the best restaurant in Vietnam. My boyfriend and I went back three times because we couldn't get enough. The staff are so so lovely and the environment is perfect to chill out too. We also had caught a sinus flu and there was fresh garlic and chilli on the table which was perfect! Thanks again 🤗

reviews.author: Leroy O
reviews.title: Great for vegetarians. Epic spring rolls
reviews.content:
Went to this place during an amazing foor tour, had to go back for dinner the same day. 
Amazing Bun Cha - super fresh herbs and salad greens. 
Fantastic flavoursome vegetarian spring rolls. 
Not a huge variety (for vego and meat eaters alike) - these guys have a limited menu but the quality and flavours are next level. 

We were extremely full with just VND120K
We'll definitely be going back !!

Such friendly helpful staff.

reviews.author: Ambassador729261
reviews.title: Great meal
reviews.content: Found this place thanks to Hanoi Street Food tour and i loved it. Great grilled pork noodle soup (Bun Cha). Fun and welcoming staff!

reviews.author: PeterChinnock
reviews.title: Great food and friendly staff - lacking veg options
reviews.content:
We visited here twice during our stay, for lunch and dinner.

The soups and spring rolls were great, my girlfriend had the tofu in tomato sauce which was less exciting sadly. 

Staff were very friendly.

reviews.author: J C
reviews.title: Tourist college student spot with solid food
reviews.content:
I don't know why I was expecting this restaurant to be more "authentic" based on the Trip Advisor reviews. Among my party, we ordered the bun cha combination (BBQ pork and fried spring rolls) and the vegetarian combination (tofu and tomato). The BBQ pork and the tofu were particularly good. The sauce for dipping the noodles was not very flavorful and heavy on the oil. Adding the fresh herbs didn't really help much. I was expecting to get tastes of rice wine before we left but we weren't offered this. Despite this, service was quite friendly.

Overall, this place reminds me of a college student fast food spot that you might see at St. Mark's Place in NYC. Totally solid food at a reasonable price, but nothing special.

reviews.author: Derrick M
reviews.title: Great Start to Hanoi
reviews.content: Great way to start off our trip—was recommended by my hotel to try this place to get a taste of local street food. Was a great meal and great way to start off a walking tour around Hanoi. The complimentary rice wine was a good flourish at the end. Ambiance in restaurant is great & service was great. If you’re a hardcore street foodie you’ll be disappointed but the average tourist will enjoy this (it was a hit with my mother-in-law!). Would recommend.

reviews.author: Nicholas C
reviews.title: Amazing, Authentic and Clean
reviews.content: Was very impressed with the food, the presentation and the flavor. Extremely clean, fun and a great place to go on a date or with a small group! Authentic and Original. Started as a food stall on the street and got so popular it's now moved into a restaurant setting. Hurry up before it becomes famous and a must do in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Michaeliew
reviews.title: Bun Cha... meet my other love.
reviews.content: It was love at first bite. I have to admit... my first love of Vietnamese dishes is pho n boy, it’s a hard act to follow. Until now that is. A friend of mine recommended me to try bun cha. I heard of bun cha of course, n with Obama n Bourdain making bun cha even more popular, I figured I had to try it. I was hooked after my first eat at Bun cha ta n this was my 3rd visit here while writing this review. So yeah, I now have a second love n found it at Bun Cha Ta.

reviews.author: Paola M
reviews.title: Worse food ever!!!!!!
reviews.content:
The restaurant has only 1plate that they serve with 3 differents soup all made with Apple ! Disgusting!!! In my plate i Had hair... The noodles were stale... The plate Was awful!!!!! 
The service though Was  excellent... They offer to everybody at The end of The Meal a liquor they make From rice.
 I will advise to stay away From this place if you want to eat!!

reviews.author: Alex W
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha
reviews.content: Sat upstairs and served best bun Cha as part of food tour. Really yum and fresh noodles and tasty barbecue pork.

reviews.author: mattnajd
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.content:
Came here for dinner on a Friday night and it was a good mix of Vietnamese and Foreigners, sat up stairs bare foot on mats. Second time came for breakfast and sat downstairs. Staff was friendly, service was quick, they spent time talking to a variety of tables and treated us kindly. Free shot of whisky! 
Most importantly the food was GREAT both time, nothing disappointed and there was plenty to go around. Would definitely recommend it

reviews.author: cbeer87
reviews.title: Great Bun Cha
reviews.content: The service was truly incredible. It was storming outside and when we came in the waitress pulled off our ponchos and sat us down. When the food came, she told us how to eat bun cha ta in the correct way and wow was it delicious! Highly recommend

reviews.author: Julien G
reviews.title: Lovely little place
reviews.content: We truly enjoyed atmosphere and delicious food of this lovely little restaurant. Fell in love with Bun cha dish and vietnameese spring rolls. Service was very nice and friendly, we also got tasted rise wine alcohol. Definitely reccommended to those who love to try quality local food in good friendly atmosphere.

reviews.author: RobbieMags
reviews.title: Get in my belly
reviews.content: The best Bun Cha Ta I had in Hanoi no doubt. Spot had 3 levels and was quite busy but the staff were quick friendly and spoke good English. Recommend getting option 1 on the menu which gives you the full delicious experience. My friends and I ordered the rice whiskey also which was strong but tasty with 3 flavour options, Apple was the best and if I find myself there again I would only go with the Apple flavour. Do yourself a favour and visit this spot.

reviews.author: Shig1970
reviews.title: Average Bun Cha
reviews.content:
I visited to enjoy bun cha as it was recommended by many people. The staff are nice and the place was clean. But the bun cha was average. It is good for tourists to enjoy and have the first bun cha experience.
Expect to have charcoal grilled porks, but it was not there.

reviews.author: RoyenJiska
reviews.title: Typical vietnamese streetfood in a restaurant
reviews.content: What a great place. There was only one vegetarian option but we both really liked it. You can create your own noodle soup with the fresh herbs, broth, garlic, chilli and noodles. There also came a bowl of tofu in tomato sauce which was very nice. The springrolls were also nice. We ordered a second portion of them. Definitely recommended if you're in Hanoi.

reviews.author: rachie_xo
reviews.title: It was okay - more expensive than my favourite one
reviews.content: Went here after reading the good reviews on TA. I should of been wary when there were only tourists inside... 95,000vnd for an average bun cha. No grilled pork, just mini patties. It was okay, but doesn't come close to my favourite one, and more than double the price. Staff are nice though and they give you some alcohol shot to have afterwards!

reviews.author: Jacqui B
reviews.title: Yum yum yum
reviews.content: So good. Authentic little diner basically just serving different forms of Bun Cha. Nothing fancy so don't expect bells and whistles but just good tasty food. We got the delux recommended version which was the standard bun Cha along with a couple of really yummy spring rolls. Food was fresh and tasty good customer service, and at the end of the meal we were provided with free shots of rice wine.  Both kids and adults loved the dinner. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Reslimpan
reviews.title: Bun Cha 101
reviews.content: This is a good place to go to, to be introduced to the Hanoi Bun Cha Ta. The staff speaks great English. The pork in the soup is really good, however I did find the broth as such to be a bit too sweet. As the service is so great and charming, I do recommend going here.

reviews.author: John A
reviews.title: Really wicked food.
reviews.content: I dont think you can get tired of eating Bun Cha.  This place obviously is rated highly for good reason, the food is delicious.

reviews.author: Vivi S
reviews.title: the best Vietnamese food I've tried
reviews.content:
My most favorite food ever. I'd never think I liked Vietnamese food until I've eaten this food. 

The owner (?) tough me how to mix all ingredient and eat it. She also can speaks English well and told us a story behind the name of Bun Cha Ta. 

I got the second floor in this restaurant, the decoration looks more authentic than the first floor because I must sat in the wooden floor. And before I went the cashier gave me an extra free "arak" (Chinese wine), she told it's good for my digestion.

reviews.author: torks
reviews.title: Great bun cha!!
reviews.content:
Went here to try the local bun cha, I wasn't disappointed.
Unpretentious little cafe serving a delicious version of a popular local dish.
Very friendly service and so cheap for something that is so delicious.

reviews.author: arahaeldes
reviews.title: best Bun Cha in Old Quarters :)
reviews.content: We went here on the recommendation of our hotel, it's pretty close to the original egg coffee place. It was great! The lady taught us how to eat the bun cha and we were pretty hooked after. Flavours were so yummy. Kept coming back here and will definitely eat here again the next time we are in Hanoi

reviews.author: Omri R
reviews.title: Great traditional bun cha
reviews.content:
Went here following TripAdvisor reviews. Had a couple of bun chas but this was one of the best. The meet was served both as grilled meetballs (kebab style) and as marinated slices inside the dipping sauce which was essentially a large sweet, sour and spicy soup. Nem, round rice noodles and lots of fresh herbs were served on the side. A great and super tasty dish. The staff was very friendly and offered a taste of various rice wines at the end.
Recommended

reviews.author: denikster
reviews.title: Really good!
reviews.content: In Hanoi, you see places everywhere to eat Bun Cha. We were told that every place has it's own recipe for the sauce. This is our only Bun Cha-experience but we think their recipe is awesome! Had a great dinner here. Would recommend the place!

reviews.author: VictoriaGreen_11
reviews.title: Yummy food
reviews.content: This little restaurant offers street food off the street. The spring rolls are tasty and the bun Cha or noodle soup delicious. It is a little more pricey than eating on the street but all the flavours are spot on and the staff friendly with some English. We would return

reviews.author: Terra C
reviews.title: Best Bun Cha we had in Hanoi
reviews.content: We re-visited this pleasant restaurant after being introduced to us on a food tasting trip. The place pre- dominantly serves Bun Cha ( Grilled Pork noodle soup) accompanied by Spring Rolls. I agree with Lonely Planet that not to have this combo while in Hanoi should be a crime! The place is catering more for tourists ( but with authenticity not compromised) and a bit pricier (but still affordable) but is a great place to go. We had great Egg Coffee and a shot of their complimentary rice wine too- both recommended.

reviews.author: lorenzm94
reviews.title: Perfect as introduction to Vietnamese cousine
reviews.content: Really nice if you want to try Vietnamese food but hesitate to go to a street kitchen on your first day after flying in!

reviews.author: Enkidu-backpacker
reviews.title: Nice but pricy
reviews.content: We looked for a buncha restaurant on tripadvisor and found this one with lot of good reviews and decided to give it a visit. decoration and sits are nice and food was good quality (we ordered the first one on menu which is grilled pork in sauce, noodle, green leaves and lettuce, fried spring role). but the place was quite smelly, strong smell of garlic and vinegar, also the gentleman who explains bun cha eating style, talks quite aggressive and robotic. food was nice, but you could fine cheaper price for same quality in city.

reviews.author: Garden B
reviews.title: Not clean area. Not delicious as so many places that I've visit. Don't recommend. Low service quality.
reviews.content: Not worth visit. Not clean area. Not delicious as so many places that I've visit. Don't recommend. Low service quality.

reviews.author: Adventure05703998509
reviews.title: Good restaurant
reviews.content: Good cuisine from Hue, the place is a landmark of locals (the person does not speak English). We recommend it for those who want something authentic.

reviews.author: Nargajuna Pillai
reviews.title: Beef Noodle with Hue style
reviews.content: My 1st time try this noodle and it's wasn't dissapoint me. I kinda like the taste of the noodle and also the soup. Especially this contain a pig leg (i guess), look strange but very tasty

reviews.author: john
reviews.title: Excellent food, good prices, popular restaurant for residents and tourists
reviews.content:
It's probably my favourite little restaurant in Ha Noi. The Nem Lui is excellent, skewers of meat, served with salad vegetables, pineapple strips, mango strips and noodles and rice paper, so you can make pancakes of the fillings, comes with a peanut dipping sauce.
The restaurant is just around the corner from the Melia Hotel.
It can be busy as it is popular, rightly so due to the excellent food and good prices.
It has seating upstairs if the outside and ground floor is full.
I look forward to eating again at this excellent little restaurant

reviews.author: John74gr
reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.content: Wow, excellent food, really delicious. We had different dishes and surely I don't remember the names of them. The lady serving was so helpful and friendly. I would say the restaurant is a must visit for every visitor

reviews.author: Nicole
reviews.title: Cheap eat
reviews.content: Mainly came to this place with friends for the Bun Bo Hue noodle soup. Though in the area that has foreigner foot traffic, there didn't seem to be anyone that spoke a little bit of English. The Bun Bo Hue broth is delicious in its self and isn't spicy which allow those that are unable to handle spice to enjoy the soup. There are multiple options of spices on the table for anyone to increase the heat on their dish based on preference. The meat quality is the dish is good but could be better.

reviews.author: justinkieu1994
reviews.title: Average tasting
reviews.content:
We went here around 9AM in the morning. They recently changed location so it’s about 3 to 5 mins walk from the old location. 

The Bun Bo Hue was ok. Tasted kinda bland and watery 

But the desert that we got: Che Thai and Che Buoi was amazing. Not too sweet and hit the right spot!

reviews.author: PnP Wiz
reviews.title: Bun Bo Hue O Xuan - Good and Reasonable Price
reviews.content: This is a good local restaurant with a Vietnam Central region taste.  It is a local restaurant with a minimal English.  The food is very tasty and good with a Vietnam Central region ingredients. The prices are reasonable, and friendly services.  The restaurant has an average clean, and very crowd in the morning and lunch time.  It also has varieties kind of food from the central region, and so you can try different things.  We went there couples of times, and would definitely come back.  It is also a recommended place to eat if you visit Ha Noi.

reviews.author: Benjamin C
reviews.title: Good cheap eats
reviews.content: No English spoken, point and nod works. We just got the special on the front; came with different meats, meatball, a cube, think there was pork and noodles. Very good. 1 bowl is plenty for one person. Many many locals in there, so it must be good!

reviews.author: Love2Travel17a
reviews.title: good basic food eaten with locals
reviews.content: Twp people can eat (water + a main dish) for under £5 total.  No English was spoken but we chose from a menu with pictures.  Meat on skewers with rice pancakes & veg especially recommended.  When I tried to leave a small tip, the staff rushed out into the street with my money, thinking I had forgotten it.  Very basic but we liked it

reviews.author: juliana74
reviews.title: Authentic Local Eating
reviews.content: First sign that you are eating with the locals is that the wait staff don't speak English. But thank goodness they had a menu with photos. I sort of knew what I wanted (Bun Bo Hue), but was presented with various options. I just took a chance, pointed at one photo and knew I'd get something delicious. And I did! If anything, I wish I could have asked for a bigger bowl of noodles!

reviews.author: moonlotus18
reviews.title: Excellent and affordable local cuisine
reviews.content:
This restaurant was a great tip from our hotel staff. We made an effort to find it and was not disappointed. The crowd size during lunch time attested to its popularity with the locals. There is upstairs seating which is cooler than the seating downstairs. We ordered a selection of local dishes and loved the noodles, wraps, and even yummy desserts that they have on menu. The waiter showed us how to wrap the spring roll which was really helpful.
We came back a second time as we loved it so much. Don't miss this place during your time in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Steven S
reviews.title: Something different, beef noodle soup
reviews.content: This is not pho. Good for a change of taste. Beef noodle very similar to pho from the outside, but the soup base is more like tom yum than beef soup. The mix also have beef balls and pork knuckle. The more protein the better I guess. The address has moved from the one marked on Google Maps, so do watch out for it. Location is another part of Hanoi so it's a nice change of pace also.

reviews.author: tmbernong
reviews.title: Special noodles with grilled meat, meatball, hardened blood
reviews.content: Many types of meat, meatballs, one domesticated animal blood cube with mint leaves, vegetables, beansprouts, garlic as garnishes. Staff in blue uniform but bad timing as 2 female staff shouting for very long time arguing which is super annoying!

reviews.author: consultantck
reviews.title: Delicious noodles and yummy side dishes
reviews.content:
The main dish offered by this little local eatery is the soupy 'bun' noodles served with:
- meatball
- pig trotter
- a cube of pig blood

The second time I returned, I only asked for meatballs and there were 2 meatballs served with some pork slices which I appreciated far better. 

The side dishes were starchy cakes that were steamed and eaten with a fish sauce concoctions. 

Nice light meal overall

reviews.author: J K
reviews.title: Heaven in a bowl
reviews.content:
Bun bo Hue is easily my favorite Vietnamese dish. And I came to Vietnam with a mission - not just to eat, but to experience a bowl of bun bo Hue. Since I was not going to be visiting Hue, there was no hope of having the real thing at the real place. But my foodie tour guide assured me that this place was the closest thing available in Hanoi. Very authentic, she said, and the lady who owned the shop was from Hue. She apparently had two locations but this was the better one. 

We came here on our last night in Hanoi. I could not leave Vietnam without having this at least once while we were here. The sidewalk was packed with diners on low tables and even lower chairs. This was eating out Vietnamese style. 

We found corner of a long communal table, sat down and ordered right away. Three bowls of bun bo Hue, an order of banh beo, an order of banh ram it. Memories of our earlier food tour came flooding back.

A separate vendor sat at the far end of our table, selling drinks. We got a couple bottles of Hanoi beer to share, along with glasses of ice, because it was an impossibly hot and humid evening. All the same, I was going to have my bowl of steaming hot noodle soup, come hell or high water!

The food was delivered quickly, faster than I would have expected given the size of the crowd that evening. Banh beo came first - steamed rice cakes in little dishes topped with condiments. Pour a little fish sauce over it, scoop it up with a little metal soup spoon. Goes down like oysters (but do remember to chew). Banh ram it were next - little (rice, I believe) crackers with a blob of sticky tapioca starch steamed on, again topped with condiments. Dip in fish sauce and eat.

Finally, the piece de resistance, the stuff of my dreams, my unicorn -- a bowl of bun bo Hue the size of a small wash basin was placed before me. Except the order was messed up. My dining companions had requested no blood cake. I stopped our guide before she could send it back. I would happily have their blood cake. And it was the best blood cake I've ever had, and a generous cube of it too. The noodles were perfectly chewy, the broth delicate yet flavorful. Heaven in a bowl. What happened next was kinda hazy to me. I remember chopsticks flying, sips of beer, mouthfuls of melting beef, a bowl too big to finish. All I knew was that I did not want the experience to end.

I want to note that other places where I've had it, the bun bo Hue broth here was not served spicy. There's a chili paste and other condiments on the table that you are welcome to add yourself. Although I did end up spicing up my soup, I will say that it really wasn't necessary. The soup was full of flavor and well-balanced all on its own. 

Several waiters wearing t-shirts that bore the shop's name milled around, so you could easily tell whose attention to get. I can't really speak to the service, since our guide was with us and did all the ordering (and corrections) in Vietnamese. But they seemed amenable and responsive to her requests. 

Four girls swooped in and grabbed our spot as soon as we stood up. I'm chalking this one up as mission accomplished.

reviews.author: Garden B
reviews.title: Not clean area. Not delicious as so many places that I've visit. Don't recommend. Low service quality.
reviews.content: Not worth visit. Not clean area. Not delicious as so many places that I've visit. Don't recommend. Low service quality.

reviews.author: J K
reviews.title: Heaven in a bowl
reviews.content:
Bun bo Hue is easily my favorite Vietnamese dish. And I came to Vietnam with a mission - not just to eat, but to experience a bowl of bun bo Hue. Since I was not going to be visiting Hue, there was no hope of having the real thing at the real place. But my foodie tour guide assured me that this place was the closest thing available in Hanoi. Very authentic, she said, and the lady who owned the shop was from Hue. She apparently had two locations but this was the better one. 

We came here on our last night in Hanoi. I could not leave Vietnam without having this at least once while we were here. The sidewalk was packed with diners on low tables and even lower chairs. This was eating out Vietnamese style. 

We found corner of a long communal table, sat down and ordered right away. Three bowls of bun bo Hue, an order of banh beo, an order of banh ram it. Memories of our earlier food tour came flooding back.

A separate vendor sat at the far end of our table, selling drinks. We got a couple bottles of Hanoi beer to share, along with glasses of ice, because it was an impossibly hot and humid evening. All the same, I was going to have my bowl of steaming hot noodle soup, come hell or high water!

The food was delivered quickly, faster than I would have expected given the size of the crowd that evening. Banh beo came first - steamed rice cakes in little dishes topped with condiments. Pour a little fish sauce over it, scoop it up with a little metal soup spoon. Goes down like oysters (but do remember to chew). Banh ram it were next - little (rice, I believe) crackers with a blob of sticky tapioca starch steamed on, again topped with condiments. Dip in fish sauce and eat.

Finally, the piece de resistance, the stuff of my dreams, my unicorn -- a bowl of bun bo Hue the size of a small wash basin was placed before me. Except the order was messed up. My dining companions had requested no blood cake. I stopped our guide before she could send it back. I would happily have their blood cake. And it was the best blood cake I've ever had, and a generous cube of it too. The noodles were perfectly chewy, the broth delicate yet flavorful. Heaven in a bowl. What happened next was kinda hazy to me. I remember chopsticks flying, sips of beer, mouthfuls of melting beef, a bowl too big to finish. All I knew was that I did not want the experience to end.

I want to note that other places where I've had it, the bun bo Hue broth here was not served spicy. There's a chili paste and other condiments on the table that you are welcome to add yourself. Although I did end up spicing up my soup, I will say that it really wasn't necessary. The soup was full of flavor and well-balanced all on its own. 

Several waiters wearing t-shirts that bore the shop's name milled around, so you could easily tell whose attention to get. I can't really speak to the service, since our guide was with us and did all the ordering (and corrections) in Vietnamese. But they seemed amenable and responsive to her requests. 

Four girls swooped in and grabbed our spot as soon as we stood up. I'm chalking this one up as mission accomplished.

reviews.author: TiVoStarfish
reviews.title: For Your Last Night in Hanoi
reviews.content: My husband and I looked for a nice restaurant to enjoy our final day in Vietnam. I avoided this restaurant because it looks very touristy and mostly for foreigners. I tend to want to eat where the locals eat. On a whim, we gave it a try. Truthfully, it was really great! Queen and Kevin are fabulous ambassadors of the restaurant. They go out of their way to show you how to enjoy the food and how to use the sauces on the table. Some people may not appreciate this, but it does make a difference when you take their advice. The spring rolls are not made in house so I would avoid getting those as they are store-bought. They are prepared very well, however! The items you must get are the chef’s specialty beef noodle soup, the lemongrass pork skewers, and the braised pork with rice. Those items are outstandingly delicious and burst with flavor. Email them or find them on Facebook to make a reservation for a guaranteed spot in their cozy little place. It’s an affordable meal in a comfortable location and you will certainly leave satisfied.

reviews.title: Genuine Vietnamese Culinary Experience
reviews.content:
People always say," where can I find genuine cusine " when visiting any country they may visit when enjoying a holiday away from home..

Well, as you will know from my variety of posts that I have written on this particular media page,I always say it as it is,and whether something is good or bad, you get my true and honest views , with pictures to go along side my review..

This very small, and very unassuming family owned and run restaurant, is a true culinary Gem,that if authentic Vietnamese cuisine is something that you wish too not only tast and smell,but too actually learn how to eat some of it in an authentic way,then I absolutely highly recommend that you find the time to search out this authentic dining experience ..

Please pre book if you don't want too be dissapointed and told " sorry we are fully booked for tonight "

They are a 14 covers restaurant..
But as tbe title says, it really is like being invited into the family dinning room to enjoy a family meal,so youre enjoying a delicious meal,full of amazing flavours, textures and some wonderful smells, that, is also accompanied by some food education from the owners and staff, truly does make dining here, a genuine Vietnamese culinary experience..

I have already pre booked my next table ..

reviews.author: Road09027777661

reviews.content:
We found this restaurant by chance and are so glad we did! It’s small inside with only a few tables, but the queue outside speaks for itself. 

The food and service was excellent - particularly recommend starting with the shrimp and pork fried spring rolls! 

I’ll definitely be back on my next visit to Hanoi!

reviews.author: Herbert S
reviews.title: Best place in Hanoi
reviews.content: We stayed here due to a recommendation, fortunately :)! It was incredibly delicious, the service was really great (with the best we had in Vietnam ). If you're hanoi, go here. My friend is vegetarian and she said it was her best food in Vietnam, I can agree with that.

reviews.author: Cherie P
reviews.title: Great restaurant in Hanoi
reviews.content: We came to this restaurant on a friends recommendation and weren’t disappointed. Lovely friendly service - including showing us how to make our own rice paper rolls, lovely fresh ingredients and lovely staff. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Pam S
reviews.title: Delicious food and really friendly staff
reviews.content: We stayed in Hanoi a total of 10 days and this was by far our very favourite restaurant.  So we returned several times. It's only small with few tables so the first time we had to wait for a table but you can book.  Menu is relatively small but all dishes were super tasty and it's very clean.  The staff are so smiley and friendly. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Jemma I
reviews.title: Delicious food
reviews.content: The food was absolutely delicious. I would recommend the Hanoi spring rolls and the Bun Cha - lovely food, great atmosphere and lovely staff.

reviews.author: Finley C
reviews.title: Review
reviews.content: Great experience, lovely service

reviews.author: Anth&Em
reviews.title: Amazing food and amazingly friendly staff - best in Hanoi!
reviews.content:
We had such a great experience at Hanoi Oi that we ended up coming back for a second night—and it absolutely did not disappoint!

On our first visit, we tried the beef with black pepper, spring rolls, and morning glory with garlic. Everything was bursting with flavor, perfectly cooked, and beautifully presented. The beef was especially tender and rich, and the morning glory was fresh and delicious.

We enjoyed it so much that we had to return the next evening. Of course, we ordered the spring rolls again (they’re that good!), along with pork skewers and Vietnamese pancakes. Every dish was incredible—full of authentic flavors and clearly made with care.

The consistency across both visits really stood out. Amazing food, great atmosphere, and a place we’d highly recommend to anyone visiting. Easily a 5-star experience—we’d come back again in a heartbeat!

reviews.author: Julija P
reviews.title: Best Kitchen!
reviews.content:
I had an amazing experience at Hanoi-Oi Kitchen! I discovered this place on Facebook some time ago, and ever since then I’ve dreamed of coming all the way from London to Vietnam and visiting it — and it was absolutely worth it.
The food was incredible, especially the beef soup — easily one of the best I’ve had. The atmosphere was warm, welcoming, and truly authentic. Everything felt so genuine and special.
Thank you for making this visit unforgettable and turning a long-time dream into reality. Highly recommend, and I’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Matthew and Jen... M
reviews.title: Great food, nice atmosphere & wonderful service
reviews.content: Great food in the older quarter, probably the best in Hanoi we have had yet. We had the duck pancake, spring rolls, duck fried rice and beef pho. Ambience and food quality was fantastic as was the service. We had our 19 month old with us and they even held him for a bit so we could eat, highly recommend!

reviews.author: BackPacker603735
reviews.title: Oh wow! Hanoi -Oi
reviews.content: Great restaurant serving excellent food & excellent service. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Leanne B
reviews.title: Beautiful food and friendly faces
reviews.content: Beautiful fresh food and friendly staff. Would definitely recommend a visit to this lovely restaurant!

reviews.author: mika
reviews.title: I'm going back tomorrow!
reviews.content: Nothing to say, you have to wait in front even for an hour. It's okay! Everything is good, just right, from Hanoi cuisine as you should eat!

reviews.author: Steven
reviews.title: Yum
reviews.content: Super delicious food. Truly Vietnamese. I suggest the Bun Cha as it’s soooooo tasty.

reviews.author: Sharon B
reviews.title: Hanoi oi .... simply the best
reviews.content: Stunning restaurant! Outstanding food .... the best Vietnamese meal we had during our 21 day trip.  The staff are lovely, decor is so cute. Simply gorgeous,  would totally recommend 👌

reviews.author: Lesley M
reviews.title: Absolutely out of this world! We
reviews.content: We saw Hanoi Oi advertised on Facebook group and thought the food looked too good not to give it a try. We were not disappointed! You may need to book, but it is absolutely worth every mouthful.

reviews.author: Paula C

reviews.content:

All diners were commenting on how much they enjoyed the food and many were repeat customers. We messaged ahead to book as it’s very small. Highly recommend if you’re in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Michael2810
reviews.title: You will not be disappointed….
reviews.content: Came here for dinner with 3 friends. We were not disappointed. The staff were great and the food was fresh, tasty and each dish had multiple flavours. It is a small establishment and it was full of I counted 16 people having dinner. By the time we left, there was a queue waiting to get in. It’s not a place for a long relaxed dinner, even though we were never rushed. We enjoyed it so much we will be coming again.

reviews.author: Annick Stefan M

reviews.author: Danielle S
reviews.title: Great Dinner

reviews.author: Anne L
reviews.title: Heavenly Hanoi dining experience
reviews.content: Our dinner was an absolute highlight of our trip. The absolute best Pho I have ever had the pleasure of enjoying. Fabulous atmosphere and the service was impeccable. The complete Vietnamese experience.  Book if can but if you have to, wait it’s worth it.

reviews.author: Mia B
reviews.title: Dinner in Hanoi
reviews.content: Beautiful food, service was excellent and very friendly staff. Book a table as it’s super popular!

reviews.author: P S
reviews.title: Best fish dish ever
reviews.content: We stumbled across this restaurant late in the evening and it looked good so we went in. I had a fried fish from the specials menu which was the most amazing dish I have ever tasted - I couldn't believe my luck. Go! Google it and make the effort, you won't be disappointed

reviews.author: nicolabS6901AA
reviews.title: An absolute must go there if you are in Hanoi.
reviews.content: So I've been following their Facebook page for months and everything looked great. Being first time traveller to Vietnam we wanted to be cautious about food until we got used to the way the locals eat. Decided to go here first night and it absolutely did not disappoint. The food was delicious!! If you go here you have to tey the chicken pancake..... don't think you are getting chicken in a pancake,  you are getting a whole new experience!!! The fried rice was amazing and the Morning Glory, a new taste but delicious!!! Oh and the spring rolls were the best in Hanoi. The owner was very friendly and told us all about the local area, the food and even gave us a card and said if we need anything or advice while we're here to contact him. A lovely restaurant,  friendly staff and amazing food. I don't need to see this restaurant it can do that on its own. 100% recommend.

reviews.author: Océane THOMAS
reviews.title: Amazing restaurant !
reviews.content: Amazing restaurant in the heart of Hanoi, fantastic food, it is very tasty and I am sure made with a lot of heart. The staff is very nice and we went several times because it was really good food and quality.

reviews.author: Travellikealocal
reviews.title: Best authentic Vietnamese food
reviews.content: Hanoi Oi Kitchen is a must-visit in the Old Quarter. The Chef’s Special Beef Noodle Soup was rich and aromatic, with tender beef and fresh herbs. The Stir-Fried Chicken with Lemongrass & Chili delivered bold, fragrant flavors with just the right heat. And the Hanoi Fried Spring Rolls were perfectly crisp and packed with flavor. Friendly service and cozy atmosphere make this spot a standout for authentic Vietnamese dining.

reviews.author: mart
reviews.title: Super tasty!
reviews.content: We were surprised and had a great meal! The service is also super friendly. An address to remember.

reviews.author: Alex D
reviews.title: Great
reviews.content: Very good food and service. Bun Cha was very nice

reviews.author: Chris B
reviews.title: Amazing restaurant do not miss
reviews.content: Visited tonight after seeing all the positive reviews. Wow it did not disappoint. Food was amazing and the staff were so friendly. Highly recommend best meal we have had in Hanoi. Thank you so much .

reviews.author: Travel07096581916
reviews.title: Delicious food and service
reviews.content: A delicious meal that was thoroughly enjoyed by my whole family. A wonderful eating experience with great service. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Mobile631701
reviews.title: Great choice
reviews.content:
We chose this intimate and familiar place for our last dinner in Hanoi. The cuisine is simply delicious, full of authentic flavors. The highlight was the plate of skewers served with everything you need to create “wraps” with rice paper, herbs and mint. Raw vegetables and mango julienne, all to be dipped in a beautiful sauce. There super nice waiter showed us how to eat and roll them! We also tried the homemade spring rolls, fragrant and very light, definitely among the best eaten on the road.

Besides the food, what makes this place special is the atmosphere. The owner is an exquisite person: you can see that he puts passion into what he does and loves to tell the story and the ingredients of his dishes. The place is very clean and the staff makes you feel really at home.

Highly recommended for those looking for quality, cleanliness and a genuine welcome!

reviews.author: Evie B
reviews.title: Good food good vibes
reviews.content: Really enjoyed my visit here! The spring rolls are delicious so are is the bun cha. This is a family resturant which shows itself in the food. They make you feel very welcome and are happy to talk you through the menu. Hope to see you back in London!

reviews.author: Melanie W
reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.content: The staff is very attentive and the food is spectacular and abundant. We liked it a lot. Thank you for your attention

reviews.author: Alistair D
reviews.title: Great choice.
reviews.content:

Attentive staff, will be back.

reviews.author: Robin M

reviews.author: Maurice K

reviews.author: luciedurand66
reviews.title: Excellent cuisine
reviews.content: Excellent cuisine, attentive staff! Everything is perfect! The only downside is the far too limited number of tables... there is always, or almost, waiting!

reviews.author: Thanaphut c
reviews.title: This restaurant should not be missed on your visit to Hanoi
reviews.content:
Upon arrival we were immediately attracted by the warm and cozy atmosphere of the restaurant. Once inside, we were particularly friendly received by the staff, which immediately made us feel welcome.

Within a short period of time, the place was completely full – and for good reason. As far as we are concerned, this is the restaurant of Hanoi. The food is really exquisite and prepared with great care.

What makes the experience extra special is the attention to the guests. For foreign visitors, the staff takes the time to explain how the dishes are eaten, and even the fresh mint is carefully cut at the table for the ultimate taste experience.

A perfect combination of hospitality, atmosphere and culinary quality. If you are in Hanoi, a visit to this restaurant simply cannot be missed!

reviews.author: AdventureMonkey12
reviews.title: Oi is this place good!
reviews.content: Oi is this place good. It’s a cozy little spot indoors with AC. Authentic amazing Vietnamese food. The bun cha was the best I ever had. Everything was amazing.

reviews.author: Vacationer298034
reviews.title: Fabulous, authentic, enthusiastic hosts
reviews.content:
What a Gem of a place, authentic, enthusiastic hosts who help to elevate the dining experience by explaining which herbs and accompaniments to add tableside. 
Don’t hesitate, just try it and you’ll be impressed by this small intimate kitchen.  Thank you for making our last night in Hanoi a very memorable one

reviews.author: Mili
reviews.title: A nugget in Hanoi!
reviews.content:
What a magnificent discovery! From the moment we arrived, we were charmed by the warm welcome, the sincere kindness of the service and the excellent advice we were given.

As for the kitchen, everything was a real treat: the Hanoi spring rolls, beef noodle soup and shrimp pho were absolutely delicious, tasty and perfectly executed.

All for a more than reasonable value for money.

An address we recommend with our eyes closed 200%!

reviews.author: Matthew K
reviews.title: Simply wonderful
reviews.content: We didn’t make a booking  and we’re really lucky, they bent over backwards to fit us in,  we had eaten in a few places but this was on a different  level the attention to detail and the hosts enthusiasm for the food outstanding would give a higher rating if possible..

reviews.author: leorabest
reviews.title: Great restaurant.
reviews.content: We usually don't have the kind of high expectations that tourists recommend, but it was different, a small, local restaurant, friendly people, and that's just the start, because we actually came to eat... we took the plate that comes with greens, vegetable strips, and pork fries on the roastline, and the rice leaves the roll ingredients alone. And it was great. We took another dish, plus a banana flower salad, and a wholesale with shrimp.

reviews.author: rarebitwales
reviews.title: Top food, top staff, top atmosphere
reviews.content: Wow! We had an excellent evening in this very small and busy restaurant. Down to earth, buzzy, friendly and, most of all, delicious and authentic food. The tables were close together which added to the atmosphere as people were making recommendations and discussing their different dishes. Not a single person had anything bad to say about the place or food. Go here for a fun night out with exceptional and authentic food very reasonably priced. PS big portions!

reviews.author: RandyT14
reviews.title: A hidden gem
reviews.content: We happened to stumble upon this small, charming restaurant and are so glad we did. The Viennese food was outstanding, served with genuine warmth, and it truly felt like a family-owned gem. We enjoyed it so much that we returned again the very next day.

reviews.author: Ella M
reviews.title: Cosy place with great food
reviews.content:
Kevin the owner was very welcoming and gave great recommendations for my meal. I had the duck fried rice which was really tasty and quite unique! 

Atmosphere is relaxed and all the staff are friendly, I felt well taken care of.

reviews.author: Tsukiji1983
reviews.title: Poor, restaurant to avoid
reviews.content:
We were surprised by the very average, even mediocre, character of the dishes served in this restaurant and very far from the glowing rating given to it on this site. Tasteless Pho spnt and sauces associated with the dishes we have tasted are a problem. Adding chilli sometimes tries to mask their mediocrity.
We can only advise everyone reading this message to choose another place for their lunch.

reviews.author: Zach W
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.content: Best food in Hanoi by far! From the Ban cha to the pancake or skewers. Everything!

reviews.author: Andy_vanderbxyz

reviews.content: Very nice place, friendly staff and great food

reviews.author: nadia B

reviews.content: This is a great restaurant for first timers in Hanoi.  It was so good we had to return before returning home.  The pork lemongrass squewers are the best!

reviews.author: Paul H
reviews.title: Amazing meal and experience
reviews.content: What an amazing meal. Collin was so welcoming along with the rest of the brilliant team. The food was out of this world. If you are in Hanoi, this place is a must visit !!

reviews.author: Stephanie T
reviews.title: Amazing food
reviews.content: The food was amazing and the place is super cute! Would definitely come back

reviews.author: Lia H
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.content: The best food we had in Hanoi! So sad we only found it on the last night

reviews.author: KIr99
reviews.title: Go visit before it becomes a social media hotspot. Fabulous little gem in Hanoi. Highly recommend
reviews.content:
We came here after following their really helpful posts about Hanoi on Facebook. It did not disappoint!
It is a little gem of a restaurant seating only 12-15 people.  
Food was absolutely gorgeous, we tried a variety of dishes - all were amazing and the staff showed us how to prepare each dish.  The egg and veg fried rice was off the scale best fried rice I have ever had! 
Staff were so so friendly and helpful. 

We will head back when we are back in Hanoi next week!

This restaurant is going places, so get in and experience this amazing intimate setting whilst you can.

reviews.author: Helen S
reviews.title: Delicious food and friendly staff
reviews.content: The staff couldn’t be more helpful. We went twice in our stay in Hanoi. The food is soo delicious and so fresh. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Tricia H

reviews.content: Hanoi Oi was our favourite restaurant in Hanoi. Every dish we tried was superb. Fresh, tasty food and friendly service. It was so good that we came every day of our stay.

reviews.author: Paradise01476616015
reviews.title: Best food I Hanoi
reviews.content: Excellent food. The best we have tried in Vietnam. Nice staff og cozy location. Definitely worth a visite❤️

reviews.author: Stella S.
reviews.title: Must try !
reviews.content:
Fantastic food ! Great selection .. try cha ca fish ! Lady owner gives useful tips about Hanoi at facebook check it out ..
lovely experience overall!

reviews.author: David H

reviews.content: Food is fabulous. The staff is friendly and speaks English, which helped us. Chicken pancake, bun cha and bun xeo are totally recommended.

reviews.author: Helen J
reviews.title: Fabulous food.
reviews.content: Delicious food, the service is excellent and friendly. The restaurant is small with a lovely atmosphere.  Highly recommended this restaurant in the Old Quarter for a tasty, stress free meal.  It’s very popular and you may need to wait, but definitely worth a 10 wait!!

reviews.author: John C
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: Came here with my female baby and my wife, it was lit my one year old ate a whole chicken!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Would come again but my wife divorced me and took custody of my darling child George

reviews.author: Frederikke N
reviews.title: Best place
reviews.content: So good food and amazing staff!! The waiting time is worth it.

reviews.author: Heidi A
reviews.title: So good!
reviews.content: So good food. It was so good service

reviews.author: Martin Campbell
reviews.title: Fantastic food in Hanoi
reviews.content: Food is fantastic in a lovely environment.  We loved the experience so much we came two times.  Kevin the owner is very attentive.

reviews.author: Jacqueline B
reviews.title: Wow , a real experience
reviews.content: Amazing , food tastes so fresh a real eye opener! The staff are so attentive , showing how to correctly sample the food ,its just unbelievable, you cannot come here just once !! Will want to comeback again and again,  just wow *************

reviews.author: helen236
reviews.title: Great food. Well worth visiting
reviews.content: Delicious food. We had to wait a few minutes for a table but really worth it. The fish medallions that you make into spring rolls was particularly good. The wine was good but the usual price. We would have returned if we had found it earlier

reviews.author: Jane R
reviews.title: Fabulous meal
reviews.content: We enjoyed our meal at Hanoi Oi restaurant last night .. the host was friendly and helpful as were his staff and it was a pleasure dining here . the food was delicious and the flavors superb and we would definitely recommend .and the restaurant was very clean and tidy as well . we did make a booking thru what's app and i would suggest this as there was a small wait for those without bookings as it's only a small restaurant . recommended

reviews.author: Ray N
reviews.title: A gem in the old quarter of Hanoi
reviews.content:
Great food and fantastic, friendly service. Thoroughly enjoyable meal and so tasty. We were just walking by and even though the restaurant is small and they had reservations, they made room for us. The only regret is that it was our last night in Hanoi and we wish we'd discovered this place earlier. 

I'd recommend booking in advance - there was a queue outside when we left. Definitely not to be missed when in Hanoi Old Quarter.

reviews.author: Jennie S
reviews.title: The best!
reviews.content: The best meal we’ve had in Vietnam so far! The vegetarian crispy pancake was beyond delicious as were all the other dishes we chose. Our only problem is we don’t think we’ll find another restaurant this good on our trip. The staff were all lovely - super friendly and welcoming. Thank you for a lovely evening.

reviews.author: Oscar T
reviews.title: BEST PLACE EVER
reviews.content:
This restaurant is the meaning of life 

Super nice staff who helped decipher how to eat the food!

Food was perfect 🍜🍲

10/10 definitely go here on your trip to Hanoi!

reviews.author: Explore234597
reviews.title: Nice evening at the restaurant
reviews.content: Super meal has this small restaurant but very good quality, impeccable service, the place is small to book but a must in Hanoi

reviews.author: Phil
reviews.title: Outstanding Food and Service 5*
reviews.content:
We visited this restaurant as a party of 8 on the strength of previous Trip Advisor reviews and an excellent social media presence. It was our first night in Hanoi - what a start to our holidays. 
Kevin greeted us warmly and rearranged the tables to suit our party size. We happily took his recommendation of “house specials” and we were all so happy that we did. The food was outstanding, hot, served promptly and with a smile. Portions of spring rolls to share were amazing and all the mains were delicious. To top it off, it was “mama’s/chefs birthday so we got to share a toast to her which was lovely. We really enjoyed our experience. When it came to the bill, the value for money was excellent too. Thanks to all the Hanoi-oi Kitchen team. First Class!!

reviews.author: Heather S
reviews.title: Bloody good food
reviews.content: Really good food here couldn’t fault it , and the staff are very nice ,

reviews.author: Thomas C
reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.content:
We were warmly welcomed the moment we walked through the front door, and their welcome was only surpassed by the quality and flavors of the food. My wife and I both ordered beef Pho and shared an order of morning glory greens,sauteed in a fragrant light sauce made with garlic. Each dish was great and together was a compliment to each other. 
Dinner was absolutely delicious and we will be back to sample many more items on their menu! 
5 stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: Pepa S
reviews.title: Delicious 😋
reviews.content: This was the most delicious meal I had in Vietnam. The bun cha was to die for and Kevin advised us and even showed us how to eat the Vietnamese pancake with shrimp and beef, and was extremely welcoming and friendly. I 100% recommend!

reviews.author: Maria Helena S
reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.content: Oh my! The bun cha is fabulous, the special pancake was wow and the special seafood spring roll was delicious.  Lovely helpful staff and welcoming atmosphere!!

reviews.author: AlisonWH
reviews.title: Amazing food in the heart of Hanoi old town
reviews.content:
My husband and I ate here last night. Food and service were exceptional. We had special spring rolls, bun cha and galangal fish. The tastes were incredible. Staff were extremely friendly and show how to eat their food to get the best taste experience. The price was very cheap 

An absolute must if you are visiting Hanoi

reviews.author: André C
reviews.title: Great food
reviews.content: Very good food and excellent service offered by all the staff, a perfect evening in a nice place to see absolutely, a well kept secret

reviews.author: Benedikte E
reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.content: Great food, friendly and attentive staff. Became our favorite place in Hanoi, so we had to come back last day!

reviews.author: Sue M
reviews.title: Delicious!
reviews.content: Hands down - our best meal in Vietnam. Absolutely exquisite food - and a very lovely and helpful waitress who showed us how to assemble everything.

reviews.author: Sarah G
reviews.title: Excellent food
reviews.content:
Amazing food and great service! The pancake, bun cha, spring rolls, fried tofu were all top tier.

A must visit when in Hanoi!

reviews.author: Andrew H
reviews.title: Really great!
reviews.content: Absolutely amazing food and really great service at a good price. Authentic Vietnamese food. 10/10 would 100% recommend

reviews.author: CXJ
reviews.title: Absolutely fantastic - TRY TRY TRY !!!!
reviews.content:
This is an absolute hidden gem. 
Most fantastic food - the best we tried in Hanoi. 
And the staff was absolutely splendid. So sweet and service-minded. And the manager/owner was so nice and tried to help us all the time. 
I cannot give more than 5 stars - but I would if I could !!!!!!

reviews.author: dannis

The interior & charm of the restaurant so beautiful.

reviews.author: Danielle S

Do your self a favour and have one of the most amazing meals of your life ,

reviews.author: Clare N

reviews.author: Daniel N
reviews.title: Delightfully great Hanoi-Oi Kitchen dinner

reviews.author: Roberta V

reviews.author: Isabelle S

reviews.author: Sidney A

reviews.author: Sonia C

reviews.author: Deg C

reviews.author: Ferhat89

reviews.author: Sierra B

reviews.author: Lindsay Ray
reviews.title: Fresh food at its best.staff excellent and very helpful

reviews.author: Line R

reviews.author: Jan P

Absolutely fresh and very delicious food! 
Small, nice and very clean place.

reviews.author: arlene j

reviews.author: John E
reviews.title: I’ll be back!
