reviews.author: Sherpa65441317903
reviews.title: Great recommendation
reviews.content: Very delicious Vietnamese pancakes with beef and shrimp. The staff was so nice and welcoming. We are pleased that we waited the 10 minutes it took before a table became vacant. Great recommendation from here.

reviews.author: Benholhar
reviews.title: Lovely fresh food
reviews.content: Lovely fresh food, had to return in 20 min where our table was promptly waiting, friendly staff advising way of eating the different dishes.

reviews.author: Pam H
reviews.title: Delicious dinner
reviews.content: We had the chicken curry, fresh shrimp spring rolls and bun cha!! Everything was delicious. The service was exceptional! Thank you!

reviews.author: LauraGrace1126
reviews.title: A gem in Hanoi!
reviews.content: Thank you to the other TripAdvisor reviewers who informed us of this hidden gem!  We felt so fortunate to eat here on our night in Hanoi    The food was excellent!  We shared the soup that was richer than a traditional pho...utterly delicious!   Then we had the grilled fish and spinach.   Everything was excellent including the service by the lovely Thau!   Don't miss this opportunity ❤️

reviews.author: mrmrsrobinson123
reviews.title: Simply the best
reviews.content: If in Hanoi you have to come to this restaurant,  had most of the menu and it is the best we have tasted in a long time. Excellent service all round👌👌👌👌👌

reviews.author: madlen77
reviews.title: Very delicious!!!
reviews.content:
It's the third time we've been here for dinner today. It is always very fresh and very deliciously prepared.
A beautiful, clean and stylish family business.
Highly recommended!

reviews.author: NyonAndy
reviews.title: Simply superb
reviews.content:
Amazingly good food. We had the spring rolls, some pork lemongrass skewers, bun cha and beef with green pepper sauce. 
The restaurant is spotless. The service is flawless and the food is peerless. So good. Lunch for 2 was CHF 26 with 4 beers. 
I cannot make a greater recommendation for a meal in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Sonia R
reviews.title: Very good food
reviews.content: Family restaurant with delicious food at a good price. The deal was excellent. Very clean.

reviews.author: Passenger34842249947

reviews.author: felixcruiser

A perfect meal with super great service !

reviews.author: Emil S
reviews.title: Great character and great food
reviews.content:
We arrived from the airport 
Highly recommend:
Chef special beef noodle,
Hanoi Spring rolls,
Ban Cha. So many good flavours and very satisfactory overall. Highly recommend. The owner is so kind and very good character. Come here for good vibes and good food.

reviews.author: bobstertj
reviews.title: Lovely place, lovely people, lovely food
reviews.content: We enjoyed a fabulous meal in this small family-run restaurant. Delicious creamy tofu in tomato sauce, stir-fried noodles with vegetables and a vegetable fritter. The staff were great (thank you) and rightly proud of their restaurant. Would happily come back (many times).

reviews.author: Jonathan F
reviews.title: Our last meal in Hanoi before going home and was the perfect choice.
reviews.content: Delicious food. Refined and doesn’t lose its authenticity of street food flavours. Very friendly staff who take pride in their dishes. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Aleona G
reviews.title: The best Pho in Vietnam
reviews.content: I seldom write reviews. Only when exceptionally good or exceptionally bad. In this case it was SO good. When we arrived at Hanoi our hotel suggested this place. In sceptical of this so I came with a grain of salt. But omg it was so good! This was THE BEST Pho I’ve eaten in Vietnam (Special beef pho 🍲) and omg. I will also highly recommend the tortilla because uhmmmmm. We came 2 times and it was always 100% amazing. You get all the explanations on flavors, on how to eat and the best attention. So don’t be shy. It’s small and busy for a reason. If I’m ever back , I’m 1000% going back!

reviews.author: Marthe L
reviews.title: Recommended
reviews.content: On our first night in Vietnam, this was immediately a very nice and tasty introduction to Vietnam! The explanation on how to eat things was top and very welcome!!

reviews.author: Tash
reviews.title: Amazing food
reviews.content: Best meal we had in Hanoi, definitely would recommend! great food and friendly sfaff. Would come here again if we were staying longer

reviews.author: tayah i
reviews.title: Family owned restaurant in the heart of Hanoi!
reviews.content: Such amazing food!! A family owned business with quiet and relaxing atmosphere. I recommend for an amazing Vietnamese food! I recommend the vegetable pancake!

reviews.author: Bran
reviews.title: Perfect Hanoi Restaurant For Westerners
reviews.content: An outstanding dinner with the flavours and atmosphere of an authentic family dinner with wonderful hosts. This is a perfect place for families and couples a like with great service and beautiful food.

reviews.author: taryn i
reviews.title: AMAZING!
reviews.content: Amazing food! Such a nice and quiet spot with delicious authentic Vietnamese food. I definitely recommend the veritable pancakes. This family knows how to serve not only amazing food but incredible service! I highly enjoyed the tutorials on how to eat the food as the Vietnamese do!

reviews.author: Wills W
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.content: Nice authentic Vietnamese food ,the boss and staff are super friendly and will teach us how to eat Vietnamese food in proper way

reviews.author: Océane L
reviews.title: Amazing.
reviews.content: Exceptional food, I feasted. The staff is lovely, very friendly. I will return more than once

reviews.author: boater21
reviews.title: YUM!
reviews.content: I was excited to visit this restaurant and we were not disappointed !  Omg the “nem” were to die for - so light and packed full of flavour.  We were recommended to have the fish La Vong - this is dependent on if they have caught  fish!   It arrived sizzling with mushrooms, onions, peppers and we were shown how to make a roll using fresh herbs, vegetables & rice noodles - the rolling technique was not as easy as our waitress made it look but with the dipping sauce it was absolutely delicious.  We then had Bun Cha - succulent pork patties, pork & noodles (and more fresh herbs)   Bloody lovely !   Washed down with a few glasses of wine some water.   If you are in Hanoi I would put it on your must visit list !

reviews.author: Inspire814753
reviews.title: great dinner
reviews.content:
fabulous service and delicious food - egg and vegetable rice was amazing!  A wonderful first meal in Han oi 
Thank you! We will be back

reviews.author: Paul M
reviews.title: Great experience, a delightful manager.
reviews.content: The owner was an absolute pleasure to meet, he even showed us how to make the meal properly and wanted to ensure we had the best experience.. what a man.

reviews.author: toby l
reviews.title: A treat for the taste buds
reviews.content: Whilst in Hanoi we really wanted to try out this restaurant, it did not disappoint, the food and service where second to none, so good to eat food cooked with love and understanding, some really great dishes on the menu, wonderfully curated ..we will be back ❤️

reviews.author: Toby L
reviews.title: Wonderful food and service
reviews.content: We really wanted to sample some authentic Vietnamese food, made with love and passion,  Hanoi-Oi did not disappoint, the food and experience where amazing, everything we had was a real treat, if you’re in Hanoi this is a must visit..we will be back later in the week for seconds ❤️

reviews.author: Antonia
reviews.title: Amazing food!!
reviews.content: Amazing food and service!! Delicious Vietnamese cuisine especially the bun cha and spring rolls ..tbh all fantastic highly recommended and the service from the owner is fantastic

reviews.author: Marine M

Very warm welcome upon arrival. The staff is extremely friendly, attentive and always ready to help. the nems are to fall to the floor.
The quality is there, everything was very good. An address where you really feel welcome. You can go with your eyes closed
☺️😇

reviews.author: AURELIA LOUISA ... J
reviews.title: Good restaurant
reviews.content: The restaurant offers a pleasant dining experience with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made sure we were comfortable throughout our visit. The menu had a good variety of options, and the food was well-prepared, fresh, and full of flavor. Portions were satisfying and nicely presented. The restaurant was clean and well-organized, adding to the overall enjoyment of the meal. Service was prompt without feeling rushed, which allowed us to relax and enjoy our time. Overall, it’s a great place to enjoy a tasty meal, whether dining with family, friends, or colleagues

reviews.author: Charlène B
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.content: It was excellent! Very warm and friendly welcome! We loved it!! We recommend with your eyes closed! In addition the restaurant is really cute!!

reviews.author: Chloé D

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.title: Absolutely beautiful food and service
reviews.content: Absolutely amazing food and service. Staff were so friendly and attentive. Loved every dish we had. Would absolutely recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Helen H
reviews.title: Awesome food & service
reviews.content:
Amazing food & service. Perfect! Read of this restaurant on Facebook and it exceeded our expectations. Value added 

Must visit

reviews.author: Trek433325
reviews.title: Best food in Hanoi

Unlike a lot of other restaurants (5 star on Tripadvisor) the food was not bland and could be adapted to be more spicy etc. we tried a lot of dishes and everything was fantastic. The host was very friendly and happy to give advice on the different dishes based on what you might like. Recommend booking ahead as very busy spot.

reviews.author: Alexandru B
reviews.title: Small gem with good food
reviews.content: The food was great, tasty, the staff and the owner really nice and welcoming. The Bun Cha was exceptional. I really recommend!

reviews.author: Maria B
reviews.title: Fantastic delicious food

reviews.author: Simone B
reviews.title: Amazing food in old quarter!
reviews.content: Amazing food! I got the vegetarian pancake and have not stopped thinking about it! Must try this place. The manager/owner (?) also very kind and helpful.

reviews.author: Nick O
reviews.title: Great meal
reviews.content: Great food . All explained what was in the meals excellent service . Fully recommend the salads spring rolls and pancakes

reviews.author: Michelle G
reviews.title: Good Evening Vietnam!
reviews.content: Just stumbled across Hanoi-oi Kitchen on Dan bat street. Wow!! Truly amazing, authentic food. Kevin gave us the back story to all of our chosen dishes. The hospitality and friendliness of all of the staff helped cement this as somewhere we will definitely eat at again before we go back to England. Stand out dishes were the fried spring rolls and lemongrass pork skewers (ask the staff to show you how to assemble them in a roll)

reviews.author: calindavid
reviews.title: Really good food - exactly what I wished when thinking about food in Vietnam
reviews.content:
Everything I have tries was was really good and we ate half of the menu because we were quite a big group 😂
And the staff is really friendly 👍

reviews.author: Ema
reviews.title: Excelent!
reviews.content:
Excelent!!!  💌

reviews.author: Jane T
reviews.title: Absolutely delicious food! Incredible! Honest advice regarding how many dishes we would need and attentive service.
reviews.content: Honest advice regarding number of dishes and how to best enjoy. Attentive service. The highlight of 4 days of dining in Hanoi! Truly delicious and enjoyable!

Angela
Scotland

reviews.author: Julia C
reviews.title: Just go there - fantastic experience!!
reviews.content: Fantastic experience ☺️ the food delicious and beautiful, the place itself clean, cozy and inviting . The staff great , friendly , fast and helping you to understand the dishes - and I mean everyone from cook to boss . We’ ll come back for sure - the best place we have been eating in Hanoi. 💯 recommended.

reviews.author: Yasmine C
reviews.title: Beautiful discovery in the heart of Hanoi
reviews.content: This restaurant is already highly rated by many travelers. But I confirm that we eat very well, that typical dishes such as Bun Cha are better than elsewhere. A large back of dishes are offered, all better than each other and the service is impeccable. The waiter is funny, nice and welcoming and available to advise and explain the dishes. That is very appreciative. We could only go once due to lack of time but I would have gone back to try other dishes.

reviews.author: HannahBoyd
reviews.title: A great place
reviews.content: This was some of the best food we had during our trip to Hanoi. We would recommend Hanoi-oi kitchen! We particularly enjoyed the spring rolls and bun-cha

reviews.author: Lara H
reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.content:
We arrived for the new year without reservation. The staff did everything for us found a place and we were delighted by the food and service!! 
The staff was so nice and smiling, a real happiness!
The food was also delicious!!
I highly recommend!!

reviews.author: marco
reviews.title: Love this place
reviews.content: We turned up really late at 10.30pm an found this absolute gem of a restaurant. Food was amazing and good prices. We will be coming back for sure

reviews.author: SurreyMartinb
reviews.title: Happy we found it
reviews.content:
Small well presented interior with kitchen upstairs 
It was full when we arrived 
Greeted Nicely by Kevin who introduced himself 
He assured us 10 minutes wait would be no longer ,we’d have a table and that did happen .. it was always full when we dined .
Lovely guy that will give you loads of advice on your visit to Hanoi ..
House red was good first wine we had since landing 2 nights ago 
As for the food .. every dish we ordered was explained in nice detail.
And yes tasted really real good , lovely served up in local bowls / dishes which all felt 
A bit of quality going on ..that’s for 
Sure ! 

Thanks kev ( studied his b a in London ) 
The owner now of this kitchen 
Your staff were great too

reviews.author: CoBa77
reviews.title: A nice casual experience
reviews.content: Place found by accident and I was very lucky. I got the rolls and the pho, both extraordinary. Small but very nice place. The staff was friendly and very nice. Recommended

reviews.author: YvesAM
reviews.title: Don't miss in Hanoi!
reviews.content: Super friendly restaurant, the team were so helpful. Food was really great - the Vietnamese beef and shrimp pancake was incredible. As were the shrimp summer rolls. Best meal in Hanoi. Planning a return trip before leaving Hanoi!

reviews.author: p c
reviews.title: Best food in town
reviews.content: Fantastic food. I ate Bun Cha, Special Chef Noodles Soup, Pho Bo, Braised Pork with Rice and Pork Nem. All were incredible tasty.

reviews.author: Mark A
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: Amazing meal, staff are lovely. We have been in vietnam for 3 weeks and eaten out every night, can safely say this is the best food I’ve had so far. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Samuel James
reviews.title: Pleasant
reviews.content: Best Bun Cha Broth, along with best grilled pork and meatball. Spring rolls are their signature dish and I understood why after tasting it

reviews.author: Calvin C
reviews.title: yum
reviews.content: best of the 4 bun cha spots we visited, our previous champion we revisited twice. it's close. they also have the best spring rolls we tried this trip, and it's not close.

reviews.author: Lucy B
reviews.title: Don’t even hesitate- this place is gold.
reviews.content:
I have literally never written a review on anything in my life and I am 43! I wanted to write about my experience here because I have been to top Michelin starred restaurants and not had such a top notch experience as I did tonight. The food was outstanding… best spring rolls I’ve ever eaten and the crispy pancake was out of this world delicious!!!!! Wow. I can’t say enough good things. To top it all off the sweet waitress made a flower for me out of bottle pieces and straws… it was the sweetest gesture! 
I would come back every day if I could ❤️

reviews.author: noname
reviews.title: Excellent place for a lunch
reviews.content: Service and food 5 stars, charming place in a charing street all was perfect i will probably come back if i go again in hanoi

reviews.author: lisabw
reviews.title: You have to eat here!
reviews.content: I wish we could eat here every day! Whatever the queue is to get inside - it’s so worth the wait! The quality and flavours are fantastic! Thank you for feeding us!

reviews.author: Victoire S
reviews.title: Very good address!
reviews.content: Excellent address in Hanoi, we feasted! We recommend spring rolls and grilled beef with pepper.

reviews.author: Ola A
reviews.title: Best food so far
reviews.content: Best food so far on our 2 week long Vietnamese trip and really helpful and kind staff. The atmosphere is very cosy with a very cute interior.

reviews.author: Trail54851179774
reviews.title: Super Food and Stuff
reviews.content:
Very good food at a fair price. Staff very friendly and too accommodating.
Definitely worth a visit and recommended.

reviews.author: Richard W
reviews.title: Hanoi oi kitchen
reviews.content:
Hands down the nicest restaurant food I have had in Hanoi . My wife and I had eaten her once then it turned into multiple times . We like how Kevin and the staff help you to eat the food the way it should be eaten by showing you what goes with what. 
The staff showed us how to eat the Labong grilled fish, sourced locally and only seasonally. Combined with the fresh herbs , vinaigrette  roasted peanuts and fresh vegetables this dish was outstanding.  Highly recommended!

reviews.author: ICV2014
reviews.title: Everything we expected from a graduate of RMIT!!! WEL done guys !!!
reviews.content: The spring rolls and bun Cha were exceptional!!! We loved the beef pho and how you took the time to show us how to eat it properly!!!

reviews.author: Emmanuelle R
reviews.title: Authentic Vietnamese food in Hanoi
reviews.content: If you are looking for authentic Vietnamese food I highly recommend you visit Hanoi-Oi Kitchen. The restaurant is nicely decorated and the staff is very welcoming. I ordered the spring rolls and the beef Pho, it was excellent and I really like the fact that the restaurant owner showed me how to best enjoy my meal. Great value for the quality of the food, I will definitely be back to try other dishes on the menu. Thank you!

reviews.author: Lym J
reviews.title: Delicious food!
reviews.content: Food was delicious, served quickly & looked and tasted amazing! Staff friendly and menu range is very good! A must go to when in Hanoi!

reviews.author: Ian B
reviews.title: Tasty food and great service
reviews.content: Very tasty food and great service. Food recommendations were spot on.   The artwork on the wall was nice as well.   Would definitely come back

reviews.author: Mafalda B
reviews.title: Best Vietnamese food EVER!!!
reviews.content:
We had great recommendations for this restaurant from friends who used to live in Vietnam, and even our hotel suggested it — but wow, it was way beyond our expectations! We ordered almost all of the chef’s recommendations, and the only reason we didn’t order more was because we literally had no space left in our bellies 😂
The chicken fried rice, sautéed spinach, banana and shrimp salad, and the unforgettable pork belly completely stole our hearts. Every bite felt like heaven!

And the owner, Mr. Kevin, is absolutely lovely — always smiling, explaining how to enjoy each dish, and incredibly kind with our kids. It was our first day in Hanoi and we’re only here for three days, but we will definitely be coming back.
Couldn’t recommend it more!!!

This restaurant deserves a michelin star

reviews.author: nicolas jose v

reviews.author: Jose M

reviews.author: Louise J

reviews.author: Nerissa W

Brilliant authentic food.

Delicious!

reviews.author: Dario

reviews.author: Brandi W

reviews.author: Kristin G

reviews.author: Stock82

reviews.author: oscar p

reviews.author: Manonauvray
reviews.title: Excellent!

Excellent dinner!

reviews.author: Douw S

reviews.author: Cara P

reviews.author: antonpao

reviews.author: Anak Agung Ayu M

reviews.author: Patricia U
reviews.title: Hanoi oi amazing food❤️❤️❤️

reviews.author: Emma M

reviews.author: joannafitzsimons

reviews.author: Flyer49065926052

reviews.author: Oliver P
reviews.title: Great Vietnamese cuisine with nice host

We had an appetizer and he showed us how to prepare it (Lemongrass pork skewers in rice paper).

The food was overall very tasty and the service very accommodating.
This commitment should definitely be supported!
A photo in front of the painted wall gives the impression of sitting outside.
We were there as a couple.

reviews.author: murray714
reviews.title: Amazing

reviews.author: Victoria Océane Ø

reviews.author: Ambra G

reviews.author: Roberto G

reviews.author: Paulina W

reviews.author: Salterry123

Sad we didn’t discover this place earlier on in our stay! 
Would totally recommend to other travellers!

reviews.author: Dean P

reviews.content:
Best meal i ad in Vietnam till today i recommend the grilles fish, simply outstanding!

reviews.author: Lauren J

reviews.author: Martin M
reviews.title: Delicious Vietnamese food

Super spot!

reviews.author: Franck J

reviews.content:
Wonderful experience in Hanoi

reviews.author: David P
reviews.title: Go. Just go.

reviews.author: CierockiNOAH

reviews.author: Maxime B

reviews.author: Arianna L
reviews.title: One of the best restaurants in Hanoi

reviews.author: Maria G
reviews.title: Amazing Food
reviews.content: An place with Great atmosferę delicious food and friendly service. We were delighted. We highlu recommend this place.

reviews.author: Lunette Y
reviews.title: Amazing vietnamese food!

reviews.author: Tom B
reviews.title: The best food I had in Vietnam
reviews.content:
This was hands down the best food I have eaten in Ha Noi and the nicest restaurant. It is a family run place where they take a deep interest in the food they serve and in the service they give. They even turned away other customers who tried to come in after us to ensure the place wasn't too crowded.
I ate the Pho Ga, some vegetable spring rolls and then a plate of the morning glory (garlic and wilted water spinach) - all of which was the best that I've had in Vietnam.
Definitely consider coming to this restaurant if you are in Ha Noi. The price is so reasonable for the service and quality that you get and there is no way you can leave disappointed!

reviews.author: Stephanie I
reviews.title: A must visit for delicious authentic Vietnamese delights.
reviews.content:
By far the best meal I’ve had the Vietnam. The chicken phoga was just fantastic, so much flavour and love went into it. Our server gave us great recommendations on how to improve the dish with fresh lime and chilli sauce.
The vegetables spring rolls were the best I’ve ever had. 
I wish I could get the recipe’s to take home with me.
Fantastic service from this family ran restaurant.
A must visit when in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Colin E
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content:
Top address! 10/10 in all areas 
Thanks for everything! 
Surprised to have discovered a meticulous cuisine and such friendly staff

reviews.author: Rachel C
reviews.title: Amazing dinner and overall experience! Thank you so much

reviews.author: Chez Boleto Pizza & Pizza...

3 minutes later we had a seat next to a lovely German couple.
Exceptional waiter with a lot of humor. The dishes arrived quickly, and they all had lots of flavors.
A treat!

We sympathized with the German couple next door, and we laughed a lot with the boss who is really adorable.
All the staff is very smiling, and efficient.
This restaurant will very quickly become one of the best restaurants in Hanoi, if not the best!

reviews.author: Rodney M

reviews.author: Luke Fox

reviews.author: Lizzy E

reviews.author: Jet66806115957

reviews.author: jean philippe t

reviews.author: AgrajagSurrey

reviews.author: Knud P

reviews.author: Traveler35594836577

Restaurant design is fancy.

Give a try and enjoy!

reviews.author: Fruzsina K

reviews.author: Patricia D

reviews.author: Helena S

reviews.author: catherine C

reviews.author: Juliette G

reviews.author: Tourist22243665936

reviews.author: Marion F

reviews.author: Carole G

reviews.author: Mirko T

reviews.author: Maria d

reviews.author: Madelyn S

reviews.author: Marisa C

reviews.author: Rodica M

Can’t believe this place isn’t jammed already — they’ve only been open two months but absolutely deserve to be!

reviews.author: kathy l

My husband and I had a wonderful meal here and plan to come back because it is so good!!!! Highly recommend to anyone visiting Old Quarter!!’

reviews.author: D_Raess19

reviews.author: Richie R

reviews.author: shelly88

reviews.author: J B
reviews.title: Hanoi-Oi Kitchen — Where Flavor Finds Its Voice Every
reviews.content:
So often, you stumble upon a restaurant that feels less like a discovery and more like a destiny. Wandering with nothing but our hearts and our noses to guide us, my fiancé and I found ourselves at Hanoi-Oi Kitchen—and from the very first moment, it was clear we were in for something extraordinary.
My fiancé ordered the shrimp dumplings, delicate parcels that seemed almost too beautiful to eat. Each bite was a whisper of the sea, wrapped in a thin, silky skin that gave way to an explosion of freshness. I chose the pork skewers, tender and caramelized to perfection, the smoky sweetness balanced by a subtle tang that lingered long after the last bite.
What set Hanoi-Oi apart, however, wasn’t just the food—it was the hospitality and education woven into the experience. Our gracious host took the time to show us how to properly enjoy Vietnamese cuisine: the layering of herbs, the balance of textures, the symphony of flavors that make each dish not just a meal, but a conversation with culture itself. It’s one of the first places I’ve visited that takes such care to teach as well as to serve, and it elevates the experience beyond dining into something almost ceremonial.
I had my heart set on the pork bánh mì, but it seems word has spread—by the time we arrived, they had sold out. No matter; on the host’s recommendation, I tried the beef with garlic, and it was immaculate. Perfectly seared, deeply aromatic, and packed with umami, it was the kind of dish that makes you close your eyes and forget the world for a moment.
To accompany it all, I sipped a simple trà đá—Vietnamese iced tea—crisp and refreshing, the ideal counterpoint to the bold flavors of the meal.
The art and ambience of Hanoi-Oi are as thoughtfully curated as the menu itself. Warm light spills over hand-painted murals and rustic textures, creating a space that feels both intimate and vibrant, much like the streets of Hanoi at twilight.
In a city full of dining options, Hanoi-Oi Kitchen stands out not only for its exquisite flavors, but for its soul. It’s a place that invites you to slow down, to taste, to learn—and to fall in love with Vietnamese cuisine all over again.
No regrets. Only gratitude—and a promise to return, next time early enough to claim that elusive pork bánh mì.

reviews.author: Handancer
reviews.title: A do not miss restaurant in Hanoi
reviews.content:
We had our last night in Vietnam and friends we met along the way, told  us to go to this restaurant and we don’t regret it! From entering the venue, only small (we counted 14 seats) but beautifully decorated with hand paintings along the walls, lovely design from the roof beams, lighting, to the well crafted tables and chairs, immaculate new toilet, this was a very inviting restaurant especially from the hussle and bustle from Hanoi streets. 
Now let’s get to the food and service! The smells as soon as we entered were incredible! We looked at what the other table of a family of four had ordered and asked if it was good, they said it was amazing so we were looking forward to it. 
The owner Kevin seated us and informed us that his dishes are designed to be shared. He was very attentive and noticed when we were looking at something on the menu and would step in and explain it or made suggestions for our group. When speaking to Kevin, he told us that he had only been open 2 months, so the clean fresh restaurant feel made sense. He also told us that all the recipes are family recipes and that in fact, his mother is the cook and is upstairs cooking for the restaurant. His brother hand painted all the beautiful murals on the walls. 
Food! This was literally the best meal by far we had in Vietnam over the 12 days we were there! We had an entree of Banh mi, lovely pork and filling, Vietnamese pancake, yum yum yum! Great texture and nice touch having mango slices in it. We also ordered Braised pork with rice and had Quail eggs, nice addition, 
Chicken lemongrass and chili- delicious! 
Banana blossom salad chef recommendation, fresh crunchy but savoury, loved it and Pork lemongrass skewers. We all loved the food! 
Before we left we asked if we could meet his mother, she had no English but we were all astounded that she cooked such incredible dishes in such a tiny kitchen! See pictures for reference! 
Overall an amazing night of service food and atmosphere! We hope Kevin and his family have many more happy customers so he will be in business for many more years and we can come again. 
Big shout out to Zinzin- a fantastic waiter and best worker who insisted we take extra Vietnamese candy home with us. 
Such a delight to eat here.

!

reviews.author: Hamptonite
reviews.title: Great Ice Cream but….
reviews.content: While researching Hanoi, I found Trang Tien on the must do list for an ice cream with the family. The ice cream certainly lived up to its reputation - it was delicious. Unfortunately the lady on Quay 3 tried the short change scam giving me lots of notes as change for a 200,000 note (4 ice cream’s were 68,000 dong) but missing a 100,000 note in the change. 100,000 dong is only £3 but not great to do this to tourists. I questioned her, she tried throwing in a few confused looks as part of the act , took the change back and slipped in another 100,000 note when giving me a receipt. All correct in the end but a disappointing experience. Hopefully not many other tourists are hit with the same scam.

reviews.author: samay Vora
reviews.title: A Icecrem taste of Hanoi's past
reviews.content:
Kem Tràng Tiền:
Stepping into Kem Tràng Tiền is like stepping back in time. That classic ice cream, so simple yet so perfectly refreshing, especially on a Hanoi day. You can almost taste the memories in every bite. It's more than just a dessert; it's a piece of Hanoi's soul. A must-do for anyone wanting a true local treat!

reviews.author: Kurt

reviews.content: The ice cream was delightfully creamy and not too sweet, a refreshing break from the city's heat. Sharing a cone while watching the bustling street was a simple, yet unforgettable moment for us. A charming, must-visit spot

reviews.author: lilybt
reviews.title: Light flavor
reviews.content: It is a prominent ice cream shop on the way from Opera to Hoan Kiem Lake. The food court-like space, with its large boxes and numerous sales booths, is crowded with customers from morning to night. The temperature at which the ice cream tastes delicious is said to be between 25°C and 30°C, but the light flavored range is optimized in Hanoi, where the temperature is more than half the year. As a standard, it tastes more like ice milk than ice cream, and can be eaten without resistance.

reviews.author: tanya gupta
reviews.title: Roasted Rice Ice Cream-Unique Must Have
reviews.content: Don’t mistake this for a small ice cream shop- this place seems to be an institution for Hanoi. Atleast that was the impression we got from their massive ice cream arcade (parlour would not do justice to the spread) that we came across in the old quarters. I had the roasted rice ice cream and the taste was so unique and something to go back for. We paid in cash and the cashier tried to short change us that didn’t pay us the full amount but we happened to count and ask her so then she paid us- I was only able to do this cause I had read that it’s a common practice Hanoi/Vietnam for the locals to not pay back the full cash assuming most people won’t count it or know the money- which is a sad occurrence so just be careful.

reviews.author: Stella

reviews.content: With a fresh ice cream, sweet at the right point and a soft and creamy texture, it is the perfect dessert to cool off on hot summer days. The shop offers various flavors, such as milk, coconut and chocolate, and especially ice cream on a traditional stick with a crisp crust. The restaurant, near Hoàn Kiếm Lake, creates a relaxing atmosphere while enjoying this delicious ice cream.

reviews.author: Stay44518742581

reviews.author: HappyBird
reviews.title: Delicious ice-cream in a charming setting
reviews.content:
Perhaps the most delicious, refreshing and affordable ice cream we have ever had. The ice cream is made from natural ingredients, such as coconut milk, green beans, taro, cacao and has a unique texture that is not too soft or hard. The ice cream is sold in different forms, such as cones, sticks, mochi and has a variety of flavors to suit everyone's taste. My personal favorite is the cacao flavoured ice cream popsicle, which is chocolatey, creamy and fragrant.

Kem Tràng Tiền is located in the heart of the city right next to the lake and has a spacious and cozy atmosphere, with large open areas and green plants. The staff is somewhat friendly, helpful and the service is fast and efficient. The price is very reasonable, especially for the quality and quantity of the ice cream. You can enjoy your ice cream at the shop or take it home in a box.

If you are looking for a place to enjoy a cool and tasty treat, Kem Tràng Tiền is the perfect choice. It's a part of Hanoi's identity, charm and you don't want to miss this.

reviews.author: angie

I wondered if this was the place to buy something, but when we entered through the entrance, we were surprised at how large the place was. 
There was also a courtyard-like area, and it was crowded with many locals. 
At first glance, they seemed to sell popsicles, ice cream, soft serve ice cream, etc., and there seemed to be separate cash registers for purchasing. 
I wanted soft serve ice cream, so I bought the chocolate flavor. 
It was a mini size, but perfect for when you want to eat just a little to cool down. 
Soft serve ice cream: 15,000VND (about 90 yen) 
Cash

This place seems to be locals’ favorite, so we gave it a try.
When we arrived, it was very crowded, which was a good sign for quality. We picked the “Cốm” flavor. Cốm is made of sticky rice harvested young, yielding a milky, nutty flavor that is great for making desserts. We normally get our cốm from Hanoi where quality is the best. Being said, the ice cream flavor didn’t resemble real cốm. Also, there is more ice than cream. This is actually what street version of Vietnamese ice cream tastes like. I think locals go here for nostalgia, so if you are curious, give it a try, just don’t expect too much.

reviews.author: The Baobab Republic
reviews.title: We love this
reviews.content:
We love this.
Always.
We were told that this is one of the iconic dishes of Hanoians. The ice cream cones with some flavors are quite basic, the appearance is also basic, but there is a huge crowd to enjoy. Whenever we come here, it's always crowded. But especially on weekends, it's extremely crowded. You should also try, when visiting Hanoi, Trang Tien Ice Cream.

reviews.author: JoshP
reviews.title: An institution in Hanoi
reviews.content: This place was always packed with people. You could tell it was a local favourite and has a lot of history associated with it too. The ice cream was good, not the best ever, but it is solid especially for the price and is quick to grab. Would recommend to check this place out.

reviews.author: dianne c
reviews.title: more ice than cream
reviews.content: Huge place with tons of places to take pictures of and sit, queues were long but it moved pretty fast. Got the regular vanilla ice cream with cone. Nothing special, it tasted a lot more than ice though, should have tried the sundae instead.

reviews.author: Ddevi
reviews.title: Famous icecream place
reviews.content: Famous Ice cream shop in Hanoi, they are know because the government opened it up in 1958. There is a delicious range of flavours and different types of ice creams, the coconut cones were good too!

reviews.author: AppleAdam
reviews.title: Rubbish - full of ice
reviews.content: Visited with friends and bought vanilla cones. The ‘ice cream’ was more ice than anything else and tasted of coconut!   You’d be better off buying a tub of TH True vanilla ice cream in a supermarket.

reviews.author: Travelly HN
reviews.title: Childhood gifts of millions of Hanoian
reviews.content:
This would be the best ice cream in every Hanoian's life as it is associated with our childhood memories. Trang Tien ice cream is made from Vietnamese ingredients (beans, coconut, ...). That makes the taste really amazing. In the past, ice cream was a prize for me when I got good grades. Also the price is really affordable! Coconut milk is highly recommended!

This would be the best experience for you when trying local life in Vietnam!

reviews.author: Kiah N
reviews.title: Yum!
reviews.content: Delicious end to our night. We both got ice cream bars and they were delicious and very affordable. Quick service and a popular place among the locals!

reviews.author: John Doe
reviews.title: Don't know where to buy Trang Tien Ice Cream
reviews.content: The Trang Tien ice cream is delicious, but hard to find. Groceries are full of Celano, Walls or Merino ice cream. Every time i want to buy , you have to search online to find the agents. Now I want to take a look at the new packaging of this ice cream brand but it's hard to find.

reviews.author: Hazel Jn
reviews.title: Trang Tien Ice-cream
reviews.content:
I first hear about Trang Tien Ice-cream shop from my friend after her trip to Hanoi. She said the shop is the most famous brand for local ice-creams and she highly recommended that I go there on my upcoming trip to Hanoi. Hearing that made me very excited because who wouldn't want ice-creams on hot summer days?
When my husband and I got to Hanoi and spent time planning for the trip to Hoan Kiem Lake and The Old Quarter, we realized that the ice-cream shop is very near there. We also read reviews about the shop's menu and we found the price really cheap, only 12k VND (a bit more than 0.5 USD) for cones, and 10k VND for ice-cream sticks. It seems that the place is refurnished because we saw a photo of the shop in the past, it does look much more beautiful now.
 We got there in the afternoon, wasn't too crowded and we saw no seats to dine-in (we expected it to be like that thanks to the reviews). The place is clean and bright, the staff was very friendly and luckily she understood English. We were sweating and thirsty so we got quite a lot: 2 vanilla cones, 2 mung bean sticks and 2 young rice sticks. The cones were smaller than I thought and it was too sweet for me. I really enjoyed the other two types, especially the young rice stick. It was a bit more chewy at the end because there are actual young rice bits!! I made a video call with my friend and she was surprised at the new look of the shop.
I'll definitely come back!

reviews.author: egblonder
reviews.title: Cheap & Mediocre
reviews.content: It's a Hanoi classic, but that doesn't mean it's particualrly good. It's forgettable ice cream that doesn't break the bank, mostly famous because it was the first one and it's affordable for everyone. The most interesting flavor is probably the cốm (young rice), but it's only available seasonally.

reviews.author: Celine A
reviews.title: Local ice cream
reviews.content:
Pros:
1) Location is in the old town of Hanoi near Hoan Kiem Lake and the French quarters. Nice walk going to the ice cream shop.
2) You get a taste of of how a local ice cream is. It may taste just like an ordinary vanilla ice cream in a sugar cone but to me it was such a treat.
3) No long lines when we got there in the afternoon.
4) Relatively affordable.
5) The ice cream was perfect in hot weather.

Cons:
1) It is not really a shop where you can dine-in (unless I did not explore or ask around). It only had a counter where you can order your ice cream and eat it on the street.

Overall,  this shop is highly recommended to get a taste of local ice cream.

reviews.author: maddie
reviews.title: not so great experience
reviews.content:
I've just gone there the other day with a friend, got 2, and little did we both know that the seller didn't give us the right amount of money back, the same happened with another friend of mine.
The ice cream taste great nothing to complain

*definitely should you check the price of the ice cream and the amount money that is given back to you*

reviews.author: K&M rates plates
reviews.title: Nice ice cream
reviews.content: Popped here for an ice cream after hearing about the drive thru moped ice cream parlour. The restaurant ice cream is put in a cone in front of you and was very nice, very cheap too

reviews.author: Philip Lim
reviews.title: Ordinary ice cream
reviews.content: This houses a bunch of booths within a complex selling the different types of ice cream made by one company.  There isn't really anything special with the ice cream.

reviews.author: B&P - Gallery Art For Children
reviews.title: typical Vietnamese Ice-cream
reviews.content: It's always nice to eat ice-cream while you walk around Hoan Kiem lake. This place is near to buy. The price is acceptable and you can have different choices

reviews.author: Raymondale
reviews.title: Local taste ice cream
reviews.content: Found that vietnamese love ice cream,so i tried some at kem trang tien,there are many shops along the street,all are belong to the same group.you won skip it.i tried twice,first i bought two vani cone,not too sweet,love it,and also coconut milk ice bar.the other day i bought vani cone again.price is cheap only vnd 10,000,will try again next time.

reviews.author: Jose Angelo S
reviews.title: Yummers ice cream
reviews.content: Super delish ice cteam from a company that's beem making if for decades. Heard about it in the audio of the hop on hop off and I had to try it. Went and tried several flavours in the 2 days I was in Hanoi

reviews.author: Triskellion
reviews.title: Mochi for the first time!
reviews.content: Walked past this place a few times, always busy, so gave Mochi a go for the first time! If you haven’t tried it see if you can find it in the UK, it is delicious, tried the strawberry and the vanilla. Good value, and somewhere continually this busy has to be good!

reviews.author: MarjofromBrissie
reviews.title: Not worth going out of your way
reviews.content: We bought milky ice blocks - I chose coconut and DH had chocolate. They were nothing special but were refreshing nevertheless.

reviews.author: LAzPisa
reviews.title: Cheap ice cream, old flavors!
reviews.content:
Great, simply great. You can find here, for less than 30 eurocents, a cone with the flavors we had decades ago!
Full of local people everytime of the day.
Only point: impossible to sit down, no chairs and tables. But it is ok, real Vietnamese people eat them walking on the road!

reviews.author: Vincent Vanhoutte
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.content: Really good icecream. What more is there to say? The icecream was just amazing. It was good, also it was nice. No better way to cool down on a hot day in hanoi.

reviews.author: JSTrip_77
reviews.title: Good But Just Standard Fare
reviews.content: I'd been told that the main, original location of this ice cream chain in Hanoi had some amazing options that weren't available at the chains. I will say that the ice cream bars were a bit softer but they didn't have any different flavors or options other than bars. That said, I love the coconut milk ice cream bars and that's what I enjoyed on this super-hot Hanoi day.

reviews.author: LNKHN
reviews.title: The ice cream is average but the price is cheap
reviews.content: The ice cream here is average but the price is cheap. The location is perfect on Trang Tien street a main and central street in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Ali B
reviews.title: Heavenly icecream
reviews.content:
If you are in Hanoi and have a sweet tooth you owe yourself a visit to this place.
A slightly less creamy version of typical ice cream, with a hint of coconut.
The inside feels like a garage and may be daunting to some, but its very easy to navigate and get yourself a cone (trust me, just get the vanilla cone).
Work your way to the right in the back, there’s usually no line since service is so fast.
Get one cone. Eat. Repeat.

reviews.author: Chua K
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.content:
I actually prefer Tis kind of ice cream like ice kachang icing instead of those creamy ones. V cheap and Q clears v fast.I've ordered Vanilla but taste like coconut 😂
One of their famous franchises
Everybody happily eatin ice cream makes mi wanna open an ice cream shop 😂

reviews.author: Achit
reviews.title: Normal
reviews.content: I heard this is the best place to try ice cream in Hanoi, we ordered 2 and nothing special, the taste not good like advertised

reviews.author: aaong86
reviews.title: Nice ice-cream for the hot weather
reviews.content: This ice-cream brand is very famous among the locals. The ice-cream is nice but definitely not the best. The ice-cream lacks of milk (i think) which resulted in the lacking of the creamy taste. It feels like eating ice more than ice-cream. It's good esp when the weather is hot but nothing to shout about. Overall, still worth checking out.

reviews.author: Eileen G
reviews.title: Poor food hygiene
reviews.content: Ice cream is more like a sorbet and it is not very nice; definitely not worth the queue. A few of us suffered from food poisoning after having the ice cream. Inside the shop where you could wash hand was very very dirty.

reviews.author: Edmund E
reviews.title: Ice cream stop
reviews.content: looks like a must for everybody here .... crowded with lots of choices.   nevertheless didnt have my durian flavour.  reasonable price

reviews.author: MrShanghai
reviews.title: Go there for the experience
reviews.content: Really a peoples' ice cream shop. Wonderful experience as a shopper experiencing the byone days of ice cream retailing, and people actually buying it. We tasted the popsicle which was very good. A great experience for the uninitiated.Good ice cream.

reviews.author: David M
reviews.title: Unusual ice cream shop
reviews.content: If you want a soft ice cream cone, you have to go to the back of a parking garage, and find the counter which has the flavour you want. The ice cream sticks are on the street side counter. It's clearly not the best ice cream we ever had but the green tea and the coconut ones are good and they are very cheap at 10,000 dg.  There is a sit down shop next door which is quite charmless. It's definitely worth going to if you are in the neighbourhood just for the experience.

reviews.author: domatooo
reviews.title: It's ok
reviews.content: The icecream is petty good but i'm not sure that i want to wait for a long line for just an ok ice cream

reviews.author: Hoaido
reviews.title: The best ice cream in Ha noi
reviews.content: Although Trang Tien ice cream has nothing special , the best quality it is in Ha Noi. Therefore many people, especially local people are fond of it.

reviews.author: J M
reviews.title: Meh
reviews.content: Locals seem to love it but it’s nothing special. Lots of other ice cream shops just down the street.

reviews.author: Cos C
reviews.title: two shops hard to find but good ice cream
reviews.content: the ice cream palour is a bit hard to find and it is confusing whether you need to go into the dodgy motor bike car park out back of the counter at the front. either is fine but i think the locals use the back one. get the more exotic flavours....taro ice cream was very good and coconut also. the vanilla choc coated ice cream was just a plain choc coated ice cream.

reviews.author: PF2UK
reviews.title: Cheap treat!
reviews.content: Fresh tasting and unique ice-cream style. Incredibly cheap. The product has more ice-crystals in it that westerners might be used to but it's lovely all the same.

reviews.author: Voi89
reviews.title: Bad ice cream
reviews.content: Was looking forward to it as it was a rather hot day. what we got was a overly sweet and icy ice cream. I don’t even want a second bite

reviews.author: Vincea S
reviews.title: Nice coconut ice-cream
reviews.content:
Nice coconut ice-cream.
(KEM TRANG TIEN冰淇淋)
Near to Trang Tien Plaza by walking distance.
Locate between the way walk from Hoan Kiem Lake to The Opera House Hanoi.

reviews.author: Rowdo
reviews.title: Yummy, Fun, & Cheap!
reviews.content:
1. Get the young rice ice cream.
2. Make sure you go all the way inside, not just to one of the counters on the street.

Have fun :)

reviews.author: truongsusu1608
reviews.title: Good place for ice cream
reviews.content: It is quite nice ice cream.they have a lot of different flavour.the texture is quite nice and the cost is reasonable .if you like icecream .try it

reviews.author: Hoang M
reviews.title: Fun experience to foreigners
reviews.content: These are kind of Hanoian traditional popsicles. I like the young green rice and milk with coconut strips flavors. Vietnamese people who live out of Hanoi have to come and have at least one when they travel to Hanoi, so foreigners are recommend to try this traditional dessert too.

reviews.author: Tony T
reviews.title: Ice cream heaven
reviews.content: A popular spot - and rightly so. No frills - just very nice ice cream. Worth trying out all of the flavours - but personal favourite were the vanilla cones. Make sure that you go right inside - follow the steady stream of locals on their scooters to find the way in.

reviews.author: Monica Hartono
reviews.title: BEST ICE CREAM EVER
reviews.content:
Best ice cream ever.
the taste's traditional. all of you must try this one. 
i suggest you try VANIILLA first. after that you can try Chocolate and Matcha.
their Matcha also awesome, not too sweet , so it's good.
even a lot of people go there, they alrdy have system of queue-ing. so, it didn't take long time to get the ice cream.

reviews.author: N G
reviews.title: Go here to see a drive thru icecream shop for scooters
reviews.content: The drive thru is fascinating, icecream ok, but really popular with locals, a real Hanoi must visit.

reviews.author: Katie I
reviews.title: It's ok but better ice cream on street food tour
reviews.content: It's good ice cream. A little different from traditional western ice cream in texture. However we got better ice cream on our food and sights tour with Paloma Motorbikes in a tiny street food place.

reviews.author: Neil S
reviews.title: Ride or Walk Right In! Its Cool Inside....
reviews.content:
Our tour advised this was the first ice cream shop in Hanoi - so you simply have to try the local fare!
Like the streets, people and motorbikes everywhere, and you have to be careful....as they literally ride in, unless told to get off the bike!
The icecream itself is pretty good......the thousands that must go there daily would agree!

reviews.author: DavidvPerth
reviews.title: Great ice cream that is also a Hanoi institution
reviews.content:
Taken her by local friends on a recent visit to Hanoi

Certainly not disappointed and could very easily hav gone back for another ice cream

Very cheap and an excellent product that hits the right spot after an evening meal in the local area

If you are in the area then try you will no5 be dispappointed

reviews.author: Mihin711
reviews.title: Must try
reviews.content:
I love chocolate ice-cream. It is very good
Highly recommend it. You should try when you visit Ha Noi

reviews.author: Lee_family_219053
reviews.title: Try their brand of Ice Cream
reviews.content: We were walking the French Quarter towards Hoan Kiem Lake and came across this ice cream place. Great relief from the hot May weather. We each had a scoop of vanilla ice cream on a cone at VND10K each. Saw the menu listing various flavors but sad to only be serving plain vanilla flavor. Can't complain as it was a relief from the heat but only if there was more flavor. When we finished and on way out we saw another queue and discovered they also sell ice cream on a stick. We decided to share a green bean ice lolly. Good intense flavor and well worth the VND7K. They have many flavors for the ice lolly so do give them a go as they are really cheap.

reviews.author: Liezl K
reviews.title: BEST Ice Cream shop / Hanoi
reviews.content: First ice cream shop in hanoi. Where all the locals goes - always busy. Sooo good we went back twice. 1st visit I had a rice popsticle. 2nd visit we tried the green bean popsticle ... sounds weird ... ice cream made of rice and green beans ?!  Worth every bite. I can gladly visit them every day. Sooo cheap.

reviews.author: Toastiehb
reviews.title: Ice Cream Must Try
reviews.content: They have interesting ice-cream choices like coconut and soya bean, etc.. We loved them all. Coconut one is a winner. Must try.

reviews.author: mbungay
reviews.title: Must Try!
reviews.content: Try the rice flake ice cream - it's a flavor you'll never find again!  I really liked it.  It's not ice cream like you find in the US - only bars on a stick.  Definitely worth a try, especially after a hot day at the lake!

reviews.author: mbungay
reviews.title: Ice Cream, With a Slightly Different Take
reviews.content: There are apparently many with the same name that are not the same.  Go to the one here:  35 Tràng Tiền, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội.  It's in the back of a parking garage.  There are no cones, only ice cream bars on a stick.  My favorite was the rice flake - it's a unique flavor.  Not unique as in bad, just something you won't find anywhere else.  I really liked it.  Our tour guide said the one at the address I listed is the real Trang Tien Ice Cream that started in 1958.  After a hot day at the lake, this is the perfect treat!  And it's really cheap!

reviews.author: B146QVelaineg
reviews.title: Fair price
reviews.content: I went for coconut ice cream. Unfortunately only vanila icecream left. Taste a bit different than the usual vanilla icecream, more milky and the cone biscuit is nice

reviews.author: Izzie_bumblebee
reviews.title: Very good ice cream
reviews.content: Tried the Rice Flake ice cream which was good, with a fair price. Would visit again! Not mind-blowing but a nice place.

reviews.author: MurrayInHK
reviews.title: Great Value and Fun Experience
reviews.content: This ice cream is the best value in town, proven by the huge numbers of motorbikes parked in front and all the locals enjoying a cone.  For the price, it's very good, but it's the experience of people watching and enjoying the warm Hanoi weather that makes it so much fun.

reviews.author: Markcviet
reviews.title: Original ice cream
reviews.content: A milk ice cream on a stick will set you back less than 50 cents. I tried the coconut and the green bean. They were both delicious. Queue with the local people to get this winter treat. Why in winter? Because the ice cream doesn't melt?

reviews.author: HD_Lew
reviews.title: cheap
reviews.content: went to eat ice cream with my tour guide. each cone only cost 12k dong which is relatively cheap. They do also sell dairy and bakeries product.

reviews.author: William R
reviews.title: "Drive-in" ice cream!
reviews.content: OK, maybe Americans invented the "drive-in," but if you want to see a literal drive-in you need to come to Vietnam. This one is a purveyor of ice cream in all its forms. For about 50 cents you can get yourself a hand dipped cone - and that includes ample covered parking. Tonight's flavor was coconut so, hopefully, you're happy with that. Last week customers got lucky and had a choice: vanilla or pistachio!

reviews.author: bambiscone
reviews.title: good value, the taste of local vietnam
reviews.content: was a really good value. $0.1 us for a scoop of icecream how can you ask for more? the icecubes tastes more like sorbet. but it's pretty good. a very close location to the lake and it's a must visit for the taste of vietnam.

reviews.author: Hang Ng
reviews.title: Local taste and pretty good!
reviews.content: I was taken here by locals. Didn't have to queue up cause It was raining. Believe or not, need only $3 and you can try all different taste! Try the exotic ones, I pretty like the mung bean flavor and the rice stuffs. It worth to give a try if you have more free time here!

reviews.author: Emma C
reviews.title: Just good but nth special :^|
reviews.content:
About 2.5 years ago, Kem Trang Tien's icecream was pretty good and I took my bf here. 
However, it was not that good at this time and the staffs were terrible. Only one staff can speak English but she also can say "Only Vanilla". Anyway, we ordered a vanilla flavour icecream, and when we finished our ones, we saw the other Vietnamese people eating Rice Flake flavour. The vanilla one was quite sweet for Asians, but I guess western people won't like it a lot because it is far less sweet than western style icecream and the texture of it was like sorbet, rather than icecream texture. 
Btw, you guys have to remember that the shop is not clean at all (they don't even wear plastic gloves) and the environment is quite filthy around there. They don't have any chairs or tables so you guys have to enjoy it on the hot road. 

껨짱띠엔. 2년반 전에 왔을때 그 맛을 잊지못하고 남자친구를 데려왔는데 이상하게도 전의 그 맛이 안났어요..ㅜㅠ

직원들은 원래 불친절하지만 더 4가지 없어졌고요ㅋㅋㅋㅋ 직원들중 단 한명이 영어가 가능한데 그나마도 'Only Vanilla'정도의 수준입니다. 가격은 12000동이고요, 남자친구와 바닐라를 시켜서 먹고있는데 갑자기 베트남인들에게  바닐라 밑에있는 rice flake 맛을 꺼내서 팔기 시작하더라고요..ㅋㅋㅋ 
무튼, 둘다 먹어봤는데 저희입맛에는 riceflake가 훨씬 나았습니다 :)

여기 껨의 텍스쳐는 샤베트(소르베)와 아이스크림의 사이같은데, 바닐라는 한국식당에 있는 공짜 후식 아이스크림맛, (옛~날에 먹었던 단종된 아이스크림 '와' 아시는분? 딱 그맛입니다.) 달아요. 라이스플레이크는 좀더 gooey?쫀득?합니다. 덜 달고 더 진해서 맛있어요. 그리고 둘다 꺼내자마자 오지게 녹아서 질질 흐릅니다ㅋ

무튼, 환경과 위생 매우 더러우며, 테이블과 의자가 없어서 서서 드셔야합니다. 아이스크림 콘 줄때 비닐장갑도 안끼니 예민하신분들은 패스하시고요ㅎㅎ
굳이 찾아갈 맛은 아니고, 맛있는 아이스크림 사드시구요. pho thin쌀국수 드시고 오페라하우스보시고 걸어 올라오시다가 더위에 지칠때쯤 드시면 꿀맛임다ㅎㅎ

reviews.author: moshiyana
reviews.title: Very popular among locals
reviews.content:
When locals like it, you must try it! 

When we were there, there were motorbikes and locals stopping by to but ice cream so I guess it was pretty popular with them.

We bought the ice cream on stick just to try and chose the exotic flavors they had.

reviews.author: AnnaCandy
reviews.title: Basic ice cream
reviews.content: Wherever i go to Hoan Kiem lake, i walk to Trang Tien and enjoy ice cream- Fresh and delicious. only 12.000 vnd

reviews.author: Debbie F
reviews.title: Best ice cream
reviews.content: I don't speak Vietnamese but from what I could figure out there were only a few flavors.  We tried coconut milk and Cocoa.  They were both delicious.  They come looking like a popsicle and each one is .50.  The day before we went to Fanny's ice cream because it was in the tour book and this place was much better.  Highly recommend trying it!

reviews.author: Michel C
reviews.title: The establishment
reviews.content:
Not the best ice creams but the most popular ones are provided by this shop established very near to Hoan Kiem lake since 1958.
Limited choice of flavors!

reviews.author: NDA
reviews.title: What was the buzz about??
reviews.content: I finally got to sample the much talked-about Trang Tien ice-cream and I was disappointed. I tried the vanilla flavor. It was more ice than cream. My husband got chocolate and it seemed to have a coconut aftertaste. Good thing it didn't cost much.

reviews.author: Chelsea M
reviews.title: Nice cool down!
reviews.content: This is a good place to cool treat. Head to the second floor for table service. The chocolate ice cream is the way to go!

reviews.author: moonlotus18
reviews.title: Traditional ice cream parlour
reviews.content: We stopped by this ice cream place during our walking tour of the French Quarter. We all tried different local flavours of ice cream on a stick. It was a lovely break from the hot weather but it was just that, an ice cream on a stick with some different flavours like coconut, young rice etc.. The shop sells a bit of bakery and cakes on the side as well. We were told this is a special street specialising in ice cream in Hanoi an appreciated the history more than the ice cream itself.

reviews.author: CM1980
reviews.title: Best ice cream in town
reviews.content: We had the ice lollies - basically ice cream on a stick - and they were incredible. We had coconut, chocolate and rice flavoured ice creams and each one was delicious. They basically tasted like they were made with condensed milk! Our kids loved chatting to the other local kids in the shop as they slurped their ice lollies. They also serve mochi and ice cream scoops in waffle cone.

reviews.author: John S
reviews.title: Skip the Fanny's - Eat Ice Cream Like A Local
reviews.content:
I was told Fanny's was the place to get ice cream in Hanoi.  But you won't find the locals flocking to this tourist hotspot.  I was already mildly disappointed with the Fanny's in Ho Chi Mihn City. My wife and I were lucky enough to spend a day in Hanoi with two thrifty college students.  We expected to buy them a nice treat at a famous ice cream shop, only to end up on the second floor at Trang Tien Plaza.  

Trang Tien ice cream is delicious.  We purchased four ice cream bars in exotic flavors that included coconut, green tea matcha and bean.  The ice cream was delicious, but the price was even tastier.  When I did the math, the conversion priced out around forty cents per ice cream.  Compared to Fanny's, that is a give-away (expect to pay US prices at Fanny's).

The ice cream shop wasn't much on appearances or atmosphere.  But it was cheap and clean.  And a fun respite from all the walking we did that day.  Definitely a must visit if you are in central Hanoi.  Just to say you did it. (Any excuse to buy ice cream).

reviews.author: atan48842
reviews.title: Good 'Ol Churned Ice-cream
reviews.content: My tour guide brought me to this place to enjoy the ice cream to cool down during a hot and humid May. This ice-cream is a traditional staple of Hanoi and have been around for a long time aka. every Hanoi-an childhood memory. I don't recall the price but it was relatively cheap. In the weekend, there's always a motor bike jam in the surrounding area because of this ice-cream joint.

reviews.author: jsthouston
reviews.title: Good icecream
reviews.content: An institution in Ha Noi and one of its best bargains.  Expect very long lines when the weather is warm, we enjoyed a scoop on a cool day so the line was short.

reviews.author: Dorothy L
reviews.title: Famous, tasty and good price
reviews.content: The place is always crowded with locals. It's my second time to be there and we tried four flavours. I like the Kem Com (ice cream with rice flakes). The shop is near the Hoan Kiem so can go there have a try if you are visiting the city.

reviews.author: Selena K
reviews.title: Mmmm delicious!!
reviews.content:
Delicious and cheap! Sooooo good! A bit hard to find - that's a huge shop with cakes and stuff, but the ice cream shops are hidden in the back - you will see the queues (!!) and that's where the yummies are :)
Rate 4 out of 5 just because not all the flavours were available when we were there :(

reviews.author: mike_4m30nd
reviews.title: Hanoi trade mark Ice Cream
reviews.content: Don't expect anything but an Ice cream that will make you come back again. as simple as that. wide range of ice cream, cheap, fresh, and it was just as good as sitting down on a sunny day and relaxing.

reviews.author: Omar I
reviews.title: Yummy ice cream which is very cheap!
reviews.content:
You know a good place when locals swarm it too for the yummy ice cream. They have set flavours like chocolate, strawberry, coconut etc but the coconut is the best in my opinion! The ice cream costs about 12k dong (dec 2016) which is about 40p! 

Regards
Omar

reviews.author: NhuBao
reviews.title: Good ice cream but bad services
reviews.content: I went there with my family. We bought 2 for each person. The beans are and coco flavors are the best ice creams I have ever tried. It was really cheap.  The bad thing is most staff are not friendly enough. Just buying some and walking around the  Lake to enjoy your ice cream.

reviews.author: EA_Oussov
reviews.title: Great ice cream
reviews.content: We were just walking by and stopped for some ice cream. Presentation was interesting as my coffee mocha was covered in something like Turkish delight and came in 3 balls but was quite nice. And coconut ice-cream was more straight forward ice cream on the stick, which was very yummy

reviews.author: maritanlinz
reviews.title: Not same like my expected
reviews.content: In my memory trang tien ice cream is very famous,we are decided to came here ,but the ice cream is not some my expected,not good any more.the service is very very bad,they not welcome the guest when we are attend even no any customer around.just ignore.need more training to improve

reviews.author: Evelyn
reviews.title: Unique local ice cream
reviews.content: I decided to give this a try based on blog recommendation. At 12,000 VND, it's worth a try and see how locals enjoy their ice cream best. I tried the vanilla as it was my flavour benchmark across all shops around the globe (if they get vanilla right, then they're alright) and I had to say that it was interesting. Do give it a try if you're in the area!

reviews.author: Megsie A
reviews.title: Yummy
reviews.content: The ice cream was good not the best but nice and worth the experience. The line up is fascinating and gave us a giggle. We went here at night time and then explored the French Quarter which made for a nice night out

reviews.author: MilkChocChip
reviews.title: Good Ice Cream but ...
reviews.content:
It's not Italian gelato but the ice cream tastes good and very cheap at 12k VND for a cone. 

However, the service is really really unfriendly. I didn't have the right change ready and she grunted and pointed to the sign. Also, as others have said, it's pretty unhygienic. Scooters can drive right in and the whole place in general looks pretty dingy and dirty. There was a huge trail of melted ice cream around the floor just in front of where they were serving and customers pretty much had no choice but to stand on it to be served. Hmm!

reviews.author: irve2016
reviews.title: Nice Cool Down
reviews.content:
As we walked passed this place was packed, not one to miss out we ventured in.
The ice cream was extremely cheap and refreshing, however not for my palate.

reviews.author: Kisani P
reviews.title: Cool down
reviews.content:
We hear really good things from people at our hotel to come here. After walking around the lake we needed a cool down.
Ice cofee and coconut ice cream, taro icecream amazing.

reviews.author: viet b
reviews.title: A must visit!
reviews.content:
Probably one of the best ice cream places I have tried in Hanoi. It is especially nice after walking half an hour, and you're drenched in sweat because the weather is so hot. So you go and devour a cheap eat ice cream. 
We tried many flavours: Vanilla, taro, green tea mochi ice-cream, and strawberry mochi ice-cream. Their cones are delicious. Nice, light, and crispy. Would go back again and again for the mochi ice cream. Didn't get a chance to try the taro one.

reviews.author: OliverL311
reviews.title: Want to beat the heat on a budget? This place is for you
reviews.content:
This place is insanely popular with the locals, with loads of bikes and scooters parked inside the premises, for the riders stopping by to grab a quick ice cream before hitting the road again. 

You can get ice cream on a cone, or traditionally on a stick. We had two ice creams on a stick, each for 7000-8000VND (Crazy cheap). The coconut ice cream and green rice ice cream. Both were great. Honestly, if you don't mind the relatively dirty shop entrance, you're in for a treat whilst continuing you walk around Hanoi! And come on, Hanoi isn't the cleanest of cities already. The ice cream's definitely safe to eat! 

Great ice cream for a warm sweltering humid day in Hanoi. Definitely worth a stopover whilst walking through the old quarters!

reviews.author: TIRAMESU
reviews.title: Smelly and dirty
reviews.content:
I don't like this place, ice-cream is cheap however, you will have to face unfriendly staffs 
The place is full of smelly rotten ice-cream (dropped on the floor - or rubbish bin)
Fly is everywhere, even some can find them inside their ice-cream

reviews.author: TCADVs
reviews.title: Great inexpensive icecream and an experience!
reviews.content:
Go here after dinner grab some great coconut ice ream for next to nothing, watch out for the scooters and walk with your treat! 
This place is fun and the ice cream is good!

reviews.author: Yan Yan P
reviews.title: Terriblle staffs!!!
reviews.content: This is not a great place for ice cream since the staffs here are terrible. They must learn how to serve their gests in the best way such as how to answer the guest's question. The ice cream here is quite nice but staffs' attitude is very bad. There are many other places serving nicer ice cream and nice staffs.

reviews.author: Brassos
reviews.title: Hanoi institution - a must visit
reviews.content: You've gotta get to this place when in Hanoi. It's where all the locals come to hang out and eat icecream while sitting on their motorbikes - from young couples, teenagers and families. Try both the icy blocks of tasty kem (only 7k VND) - which come in delicious chocolate, coconut, young sticky rice - and I think another couple of flavours I didn't get to - as well as the soft serve (12k VND) which is equally delicious. You can takeaway the ice blocks too - if they can survive the weather.

reviews.author: Wander20
reviews.title: Worth trying
reviews.content: I went there after dinner and the place was very crowed with teenagers. People buy their ice cream and then stand and eat there, a really cool place to visit. The ice cream is really cheap and worth trying.

reviews.author: Mark N
reviews.title: Good
reviews.content: Cool place for stopping by. Really cheap for a delicious ice cream. It's just interesting whether eat inside the place on your scooter or take it out and eat when walking through the street of Hanoi. Like it.

reviews.author: Happy
reviews.title: Great Local Ice Cream
reviews.content: This place is a hot among locals. Try all flavors. I love the coconut ice cream best. You have a choice of ice cream on a stick or on a cone. Several flavors: chocolate, green rice, vanilla, yam and coconut.

reviews.author: WBAfan
reviews.title: Heaven Nectar
reviews.content:
Kem (ice cream) Trang Tien (the street name) is utterly incredible! I don't think I have ever put anything quite like it into my mouth. 

There is just the perfect amount of coconut (which I am not usually a fan of) in every scoop which makes every Kem just so refreshing in the Hanoi heat. And the best part? Each ice cream costs only 12K dong. They're practically giving it away, which really makes Kem Trang Tien a philanthropic organisation.

Many of my best memories from Hanoi involve a Kem Trang Tien in each hand.

reviews.author: tiggo71
reviews.title: The pearl of Ha Noi
reviews.content:
This icecream was recommended to a group of us by a friend before we came to Ha Noi. We are now considering buying him a knighthood after this recommendation. 

The experience alone is brilliant, walking into a shop devoted entirely to icecream that you can drive into as well! It is incredibly busy most.of the time which demonstrates its popularity- they employ guards to help organise the masses on very busy days!! 

The icecream is coconut based and is incredibly refreshing on a hot day in Ha Noi. There are various types of icecream from lollies to Mr whippy style and the original incredible icecream. Over the space of 3 weeks in the area we must have visited the shop 10 times. 

It sounds silly but it was genuinely the highlight of Ha Noi for us! Do yourself a favour a visit this behemoth of an icecream palace.

reviews.author: Traveller_Monkey_123
reviews.title: Cheap yummy ice cream!
reviews.content:
Walked by and saw numerous people rushing to get ice cream. Have never seen so many people enjoy ice cream at the same time at the same place. Service was quick despite the people.

Had the coconut and green tea flavours. Both very refreshing. The cone tasted like fortune cookies.

reviews.author: Alejandro E
reviews.title: Absolutely awsome icecream.
reviews.content:
I really enjoyed. Good quality icecream. Worthit trying it.
Very popular between the locals . Never seen sommany people buying icecream at the same time. An experience. Give it a try!!!

reviews.author: cutia
reviews.title: Anthropological experience
reviews.content:
Have you ever wondered what it's like to have ice cream in a parking lot / warehouse, with Vietnamese youngsters happily sitting on their parked motorbikes while enjoying their "kem com"?

Look no further, this is the place for you. Apart from the odd environment, this is by far the best ice cream flavor around. I know that "green rice ice cream" doesn't sound too appealing, but actually "kem com" tastes like a mix of sweet corn and coconut. Definitely worth the try!

reviews.author: jimbothegreat
reviews.title: Nice ice cream
reviews.content: We saw lots of locals eating ice cream here at 9pm so thought we would give it a go.  12 dong for a single scoop cone.  We thought the cone was mouldy but apparently its sesame?  Ice cream tasted good though.  Coconutty!

reviews.author: Johnny P
reviews.title: Cheap and Good Local Ice cream
reviews.content: Local Ice cream in Vietnam is so special, tasty and cheap. amazing from ice cream near lake. It so cool for walk around lake with ice cream. Good

reviews.author: PacificBlackBird
reviews.title: Coconut milk ice cream in a motorcycle park!
reviews.content: Apparently here since 1959, and popular with every generation. 12K for a cone with one ball; they are batch prepared, and appear to have only one flavour in the garage (vanilla, but with a strong coconut taste since that's the base). More available at the adjacent Key Coffee, but without the experience. I will remember the place more than the ice cream, but good ice cream appears hard to find... Worth a visit.

reviews.author: CHandGT
reviews.title: Bad ice cream in a car park
reviews.content:
Ice cream in an underground car park. Cheap not worth going to as the ice cream is very chalky. There are 3/4 different ice cream stations serving different types of ice creams and flavours.

No idea what all the good reviews are about

reviews.author: PuzzleSolver855
reviews.title: Visit this crazy place for the experience not the ice cream
reviews.content: This is an underground garage that motorbikes pull into, buses expel groups of tourists and chaos ensues!  There is a 2nd level with a bathroom and a couple of seats.  Plan to just stand after you purchase your soft or hard ice cream from one of the 4 vendors spread around the garage.  Don't stop at the entryway to buy it...go on in and have the experience.  We were there before lunchtime and it was packed.  The ice cream wasn't worthy of this but who knew???

reviews.author: chen611
reviews.title: Excellent coconut ice cream
reviews.content: The ice cream here are a mix between vanilla and coconut. It is creamy and icy at the same time. The mix is perfect. There is a board with names of different flavors but it is hard to tell whether you can order these other flavors.

reviews.author: Chattler
reviews.title: Best vanilla ice cream ever!
reviews.content: It's hard to describe how good the ice cream here is. I went twice and always got vanilla ice cream in a cone. Why? Because that's by far the most popular choice and it's worth it. If you like ice cream then don't miss this!

reviews.author: luiting
reviews.title: Coconut ice cream!
reviews.content: Super good ice cream, cheap cheap too! Took a cab there and the place was not easily spotted. Motorbikes could go in there too! It was really cool, and a good find as well!

reviews.author: harriethoughton
reviews.title: Going to miss this place!
reviews.content: The icecream here is so tasty that we've been going every night we've been in Hanoi! They have a fair few different flavours ranging from 7000 - 12000d each but we definitely recommend the coconut/vanilla in the sesame cone. We're usually the only tourists there but it does get busy with locals especially on weekends! Try and get a seat upstairs if you can

reviews.author: Robert C
reviews.title: Pretty good but must have been off-peak
reviews.content: Besides the ice cream bars all they had were pre-made cones of coconut/vanilla flavor. Quite good with the iciness of home made. There were no crowds, thankfully. I'm not sure I'd be happy waiting in a horrendous line for this treat. If you're in the neighborhood and don't have to queue up like you're at the Hajj, then go for it.

reviews.author: Goonerfoodie
reviews.title: Delicious Ice Cream
reviews.content: Someone I met in Hanoi mentioned that the ice cream here is really good and when we were in the vicinity, I asked our Tour Guide to take us there. It was coconut Ice Cream and we tried almost all the flavors they had. Ice Cream was delicious. Try it with the cone.

reviews.author: Ozzy-Kunnu
reviews.title: A MUST MUST MUST HAVE...like really a MUST HAVE
reviews.content:
P.S. - Try anything and everything here BUT Do Not Miss their Coconut Ice Cream served in Sesame Cones...its Out of this World...something that we had not had anywhere.

Its little tricky to find this place since there are few of them, all far away and we had almost given up until we realized there is one very close to Hoan Kiem Lake (also known as Lake of the Restored Sword). Depending on which corner of lake you are it shall not take more than 6 to 15 minutes walk to reach this Ice Cream parlor. This place is MASSIVE (though, few eating joints on the same footpath as to where this humongous place is, sell candies made by this brand but suggestion is to go this place), and it's only when you reach this place you realize how famous this brand is looking at the crowd. 

Just go for anything and everything but make sure you have the coconut ice-cream in sesame cone. Their softies taste of artificial flavors and we would suggest against it but choice is yours.

reviews.author: linhvu9x
reviews.title: When you are in Hoan Kiem Lake, please quickly find Trang Tien ice cream and enjoy one scoop or a freezy cone ice cream
reviews.content: Trang Tien Ice Cream becomes one of famous symbols for Hanoi since 1985 so when you wander in Hoan Kiem Lake/ Sword Lake, you absolutely must try the delicious from Trang Tien cone ice cream. Yummy a lot.

reviews.author: adelinecms
reviews.title: Coconut Popsicle must not missed
reviews.content:
Situated in between the shops of Trang Tien Road.
