You will not missed it coz many motorbikes are riding in & out.  There are 4 types of ice cream in the place.  They have Popsicle, Softee, Ice-cream cone & Mochi. I highly recommended the coconut Popsicle and you taste coconut bits.

reviews.author: Uday T
reviews.title: Strange place but great ice cream
reviews.content:
I was taken here by local friends. It is a big space and I thought we were going into a garage - lots of bikes parked in there
Lots of choice of ice cream but I decided to try a local flavour - sticky rice
This is a green ice cream - made from the October rice harvest (which is celebrated here) and it is young and green in colour
The ice cream has an unusual but delicious flavour
well worth seeking out
It is also incredibly cheap

reviews.author: Linnidity
reviews.title: Interesting local ice cream den experience
reviews.content: It was like an other worldly ice cream experience. There were so many motorbikes parked in rows and rows inside, outside. It kinda resembled an illegal gambling den. But no, it was just a crowd of locals getting their ice cream fix. The ice cream was cheap, at 12,000VND iirc although mine cost a bit more than that because the lady didn't have any change (told to me in vietnamese which I totally did not understand so I was bewildered as I left the queue). My friend managed to snag his for 10,000VND for the same reason. So bringing exact change is recommended. Worth a go just for the experience. Coconut ice cream was okay, a bit more icy than what I am used to. The sesame cone was yummy. Also tried the taro soft serve. I didn't fancy it that much but my friend preferred it to the original.

reviews.author: Cara O
reviews.title: Unique Ice Cream cone
reviews.content: Loved the ice cream cone which had an Asian sesame twist to it. Ice cream itself was mediocre -  McDonald's has better.

reviews.author: Sati77
reviews.title: A must in hanoi
reviews.content:
The packed one is hidden inside compared to the other stalls in front  in trang tien street and seems the inner one has more ice cream types (cones, sticks, etc). Just get in and you will see a lot of locals enjoying the ice cream. I tried vanilla strawberry on cones and Mung bean i guess on sticks. Ice cream stick flavors are written in Vietnamese and staffs dont speak English, so i just picked randomly. Ones on cones had English version written for strawberry, vanilla and taro. The fourth flavor, not written in  i guess is chocolate. Both were great although i prefer ones on cones.  ice cream stick  had strong butter taste and too hard texture taking long time to soften and to finish up unless you bite them,while cone ones had very soft texture and ice cream cone had a great taste of sesame although i did not see the sesame. Maybe it was blended along with other ingredient. Ice cream stick cost 7000 to 8000 dong while cones that i had cost me 10000 dong.
Its located near hoa kim lake and also hoa lo prison. Worth a try to accompany you strolling along the area as no seats are provided on the one i visited.

reviews.author: Joni11311
reviews.title: Local Ice-cream
reviews.content: Enjoy ice-cream with the locals. The place is run-down but the ice-cream is good and the price is reasonable. They have 4 flavour a hut I'm not sure what are the flavours because I don't understand the language. Hehehehe....

reviews.author: sbx7
reviews.title: A surprise find
reviews.content: We saw a place where lots of motorbikes were driving into, and walked in to see what was going on. Turns out to be a very popular ice cream shop. The coconut ice cream we had was very nice!

reviews.author: Tony Y
reviews.title: Quality of this local ice cream still as good as it was !
reviews.content: Had the coconut flavour ice-cream in my first visit to Hanoi in 1998, and learned the Vietnamese word "kem cao cap"  ..... meaning "quality ice-cream". Took it again in my recent visit in August 2015 ...... 17 years later.  Same excellent taste ....... obviously soft and "creamy" coconut flavour - local style.  Worth a try ...... different from the Western Movenpick, Baiskin Robbins, Haagen Dazs, etc...... the shop still crowded with locals especially in the evening. Do what the locals do !!!!!!!

reviews.author: WinnieTan
reviews.title: Yummy refreshing ice cream
reviews.content: It's a must try if u r a tourist in Hanoi. The ice cream is light and refreshing. Yes, it melts so quickly! May be it more like a sorbet with more water content than cream. Or may be it's more natural... What's also nice is the sesame cone. It has such a strong sesame taste. It compliments t coconut ice cream somehow. My 8 year old loves it too! Go try it. Yum !

reviews.author: betoecarnavalero
reviews.title: A twist from Phó and Bah My
reviews.content: Is a nice local restaurant full by locals, a diferent food after only phó and Bah My. The owner super kind to show the food and how to eat it

reviews.author: Life traveller
reviews.title: Nice coconut ice cream, famous among the Vietnamese
reviews.content: This is worth a visit, as it is a famous ice cream parlour in the centre of Hanoi. The coconut ice cream is very nice, and the sesame cone crunchy! For a famous ice cream place in a smart area of town, it is a bit of a dump! When my vietnamese friend took me there, I thought is looked like a run down garage. Perhaps I was being a bit snooty, as this is a place for the locals rather than tourists. So, if you are a tourist, then in my view worth a visit!

reviews.author: travelh00ked
reviews.title: Coconut icecream in sesame cones!
reviews.content:
These were absolutely delicious! The ice cream was light and the cone was crisp with toasted sesame seeds. Yummm.

The only thing I didn't like was that the lady serving the ice cream didn't even wear gloves and used the same hand she used for taking payments! I ate the icecream and just the tip of the cone but the rest of it went into a trash bin (what a shame).

reviews.author: Audrey B
reviews.title: Ice cream that's perfect for a hot day!
reviews.content: The ice cream was great and I would recommend it but the shop and the variety (not much) that is offered was somehow less than I was expecting after being told that it was a famous place in Hanoi.  They have the pre packaged ice cream bars in about 6-7 flavors and if you want an ice cream cone then it's just vanilla or chocolate.  On the two occasions that I was there not many people were inside and there is not much of an environment to the building itself - pretty bland.  Most people just drive up on their scooters and then take off again.  I would still say it's worth a trip there and a very nice treat on a hot day in Hanoi!

reviews.author: Art L
reviews.title: Lovely Ice Cream - must try! But eat fast!
reviews.content: I was here with my family (wife and 4 yr old)... i thought it was really delicious as did the 4 yr old, although my wife was less than impressed. There's no where to sit and enjoy the dessert. There's a fast moving queue with locals buying ice cream by the dozens. The ice cream melts really fast so eat it quickly. Also the price is now VND12000... get the ice cram with a cone as i thought the cone was very unique and tasted great. Lots of young locals patronize this place...

reviews.author: eddyphdhong
reviews.title: in fact I don't understand why vietnameses live this icecream shop
reviews.content: in fact I don't understand why vietnameses live this icecream shop. so and so taste. dirty and noisy shop. not clean environment. so hot and no air conditioning. they must earn big money from hanoi people but don't change so and so interior and so and do taste. but whenever my friends visited hanoi, i brought them here. cuz famous.

reviews.author: Lee Voon F
reviews.title: Nice ice cream!
reviews.content:
Normally am not a fan of ice cream, but this is pretty good. I had it on 3 separate occasions during our 4 days stay in hanoi. The best part of the ice cream was the cone, which was very fresh crunchy and tasty.

Go for the vanilla flavour only, forget the others.

reviews.author: 334shellyl
reviews.title: Good ice cream, no ambiance
reviews.content: Good vanilla ice cream cones that taste a little like coconut. It's a very popular stop for the locals. However, the establishment is a bit weird. There's nowhere to sit and it looks a bit like a parking garage. So don't go if you are looking for a nice place to eat ice cream and relax, but do go if you are simply after a good ice cream cone.

reviews.author: bigboi90
reviews.title: Fresh and natural
reviews.content: The most famous local brand, 50 cent for a vanilla cone is a very good deal. Not my taste but worth a try.

reviews.author: zirconiag
reviews.title: Yum yum
reviews.content: Is a Vietnamese Popsicle. They only have 2 flavours when we were there - vanilla and chocolate. I rather enjoy it because it wasn't too sweet.

reviews.author: Kelley H
reviews.title: Local favourite
reviews.content: Best place in town to get ice cream. They have different types available, the most popular being the coconut cone, as well as some fruit flavoured ice cream bars. All available for around 12k VND, it's definitely worth the cost. Grab a cone and enjoy a walk around Hoan Kiem from there!

reviews.author: tda7
reviews.title: Coconut icecream
reviews.content: Apparently a favourite with locals. The simple coconut ice cream in a cone (priced at 12000 Dong) is delicious and perfect after a good meal or a long walk (any excuse, really!). The surprise was the delicious cone it came in - delicate, fresh with a hint of sesame. Enjoy!

reviews.author: CoolGuy
reviews.title: Cheap and nice coconut ice cream
reviews.content: Cheap and nice coccnut ice cream. Location is easily accessible. It is very popular with the locals.

reviews.author: Marc U
reviews.country: New York City, New York, USA
reviews.title: For Locals
reviews.content: This may be one of the most local ice-cream shop I have ever visited. Walking into a small open space, there are three stands – one for each type of ice cream they serve: soft serve, hard,  and on a stick. Here the locals grab an ice cream to hang out and cool off. The experience of really not feeling like a tourist and enjoying this refreshing snack on a hot and humid day may have been better than the ice cream.

reviews.author: migigawa
reviews.title: A Hanoi Institution
reviews.content: "Kem" means ice cream, in Vietnamese, apparently, and if Hanoians have a thing fir coffee and street food, ice cream has also got to rank high up there. Kem Trang Tien is one of the best places for regular ice cream. The fancy, artisanal ice cream parlors like Fanny's may be better, and way more expensive, but KTT is the authentic local favorite. Drive straight into the place on your scooter, or climb upstairs to the balcony area and watch the locals take their ice cream seriously! Highly recommended for an energy pick-me-upper after a hot and humid day on your feet. It's a no-frills place, just go there for the great but cheap ice cream. it is located though, right on bookstore and art gallery row, near the southernmost tip of Hosn Kiem lake, near the Opera House, so it is pretty nesr where you will want to be, anyway.

reviews.author: Jennie D
reviews.title: Best local ice-cream :)
reviews.content:
"Trang Tien Ice-cream" is a local ice-cream company in Hanoi since 1958. The name 'Trang Tien Ice-cream" came from the street "Trang Tien" where the ice-cream was manufactured and sold (first location was #35 Trang Tien Street, Hoan Kiem District). "Trang Tien Ice-cream" became very popular and familiar with Hanoians. To every kids that grew up in Hanoi, "Trang Tien Ice-cream" attached and became a part of the childhoods. "Trang Tien Ice-cream" has many flavors such as: chocolate, vanilla, coconut milk young rice and the price is very cheap :)

So many placed try to make fake "Trang Tien Ice-cream"; so to get the real one you should go to No. 35 Trang Tien Street...You will have to queue for it, it may take a while but I promise it worths to try. You'll find it always crowded not only in the summer but in the winter as well. While you enjoying the ice-cream, you can take a walk in Trang Tien street where there are many local art galleries, souvenirs, book shops. You can walk to Hoan Kiem Lake or the Opera House which is only 5-10mins walk. Especially during this season Autumn comes to Winter, it's really beautiful :)

reviews.author: Namit1984
reviews.title: Plain, simple and delicious
reviews.content: This is a drive-in (or walk-in) ice cream parlor near Opera House. They serve vanilla flavored ice cream cones which is absolutely delicious. This place is thronged by locals in the evenings.

reviews.author: Kickingkyle
reviews.title: Unique experience
reviews.content: Not only is the ice ceam delicious and very cheap the enviroment is very unique and very busy. This place is buzzing in the evenings with mopeds stopping anywhere near or inside to get a slice of the action. A must see when in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Melisa Travel
reviews.title: cheap and delicious ice cream
reviews.content: This place is always crowded. You must queue to buy ice-cream. The ice cream here is very cheap and delicious. Once you come here you will never forget it.

reviews.author: atripwithme
reviews.title: MUST-HAVE ICE CREAM FOR ICE CREAM LOVERS
reviews.content:
i think that this place serves one of the best ice cream cones ever. it isn't really difficult to find this place cause its near the Hoan Kiem Lake and near the famous Trang Tien Plaza with all the expensive goods. This place is so unique cause there isn't any seats for you to settle down on your ice cream but rather its a place to just buy and go or just stand around eating it. Motorbikes are the bulk of the customers here. 
Now to the juicy and yummiest bit, the ice cream~~ 
it's that good cause the ice cream feels like soft serve but doesn't look like that. It really is delish with the cone because the cones have sesame in them and they taste and smell great! It's just 12kVND for a single cone, just slightly more than 50 cents USD. 
There happens to be 3 stalls inside that sells ice cream, but the original ones are the ones that sell the cone in the center of the place, with a price of 12k VND. There is also another surprise, because they have takeaway boxes of many many flavours that are only at 40k VND. Those are called Kem Hop. 
The staff there can understand English and are more than willing to help you get your hands on those ice cream. Even better when you get it on a hot summer day like now!

reviews.author: CocoonHanoi
reviews.title: Unique icecream place
reviews.content: I have been eating this icecream since i was young. The flavors young rice and green bean are so unique. There is smt so special about this icecream that after many years and having tried other icecream, there is still a special place for this icecream.

reviews.author: vodoxus
reviews.title: Quaint little ice cream place
reviews.content: Awesome little Ice cream place where the scooters just run in and park and then enjoy ice cream! A few flavors to choose from, as well as popsicles , soft serve and normal ice cream

reviews.author: Kyle K
reviews.title: Delicious and unique local treats
reviews.content: We spent a week in Hanoi and visited this place on at least four occasions. Absolutely delicious and unique. The staple here is a scoop of coconut ice cream (not vanilla as stated in other reviews) in a sesame waffle cone for around 55 cents US. The ice cream itself is light and refreshing, more ice than cream based (might even be made with coconut milk) and it gives the unique sensation of being frozen solid but melting instantly in your mouth. The cone is no disappointment either, a sesame seed infused waffle cone that is crisp and tasty and compliments the coconut perfectly. It is absolutely delicious and something that must be tried in Hanoi. They also have popsicles in a variety of local flavors and soft serve but the coconut cone is the highlight. It might be my favorite ice cream ever. Seriously.

reviews.author: Naveen K
reviews.title: Cheap, refreshing vanilla and cone
reviews.content: Went to this "famous" cream shop on a recent trip to Hanoi. It's no Haagen Daaz or Ben and Jerry's but it's less than a US dollar for a cone, it's refreshing and tasty and you get to hang out with locals and their motorcycles. There are very few flavors - but I think the cone is the simplest choice. Worth a try.

reviews.author: Kiku C
reviews.title: A Real Local Delight!
reviews.content:
it's down a dingy lane with many motorbikes coming in and out, so if you're from a very developed country, and grew up with your parents telling  you not to wander down dingy alleys, you may just miss this.

There will be two queues. One is in front - those are ice cream popsicles. On the right, it's ice cream cones - give the ice cream cones a try! It's called "kem oc que" (like "creme ock kway") - it's creamy but light, and it's on a crepe. Worth every penny :)

If you go for a popsicle, there's rice, green tea, green bean and chocolate. Also worth a try. Had like 3 ice creams during my 4 days here. 

After buying your ice cream, people watch in a corner - no seats in this place, so many people bring their bikes in, and sit around on their bikes and chat while the eat.

reviews.author: Nguyen07
reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.content: Trang Tien ice cream is not only delicious in taste but also a particular feature is both true and eat, make Trang Tien ice cream different from other places. In the summer, there are days where no place, people jostling to buy ice cream. And just like Trang Tien ice cream. Perhaps nowhere who buy and eat ice cream in winter like this. It has become a habit of Hanoi

reviews.author: MrGoh
reviews.title: Unique ice cream
reviews.content:
We came looking for this place after reading many posts which says "must try". 

I wouldn't say it's the best ice cream, but it's rather unique flavor and worth a try if you are in Hanoi. 

Make sure you don't get tricked and bought the sticks of ice cream from the store along the main road (we almost did)!

You need to walk to the back of the house where you will see huge crowd eating their ice cream cone!

There is only 1 flavor available. It is served on a cone. Quite delicious I feel.... Try it!!

reviews.author: Mick W
reviews.title: Good place to share with the locals
reviews.content: We found this place after reading of it in a guidebook and after a day of walking through Hanoi just fancied an ice-cream. At first we could not believe that we were there, you go down an alley and passed lots of motorbikes to a covered area with a number of different counters. There were lots of kids around eating ice-creams after school. We wanted chocolate so had to go upstairs to get it. A good taste, not the best but the location and clientele are the things you come for.

reviews.author: Banskali
reviews.title: THE ice-cream spot in Hanoi!
reviews.content:
I had to go to the place 3 times to be successful! The first time someone in the old town had told me that there was a famous ice cream parlour on the street leading to the opera and that they would have my favourite ice-cream "durian" (from that awkward, smelly Asian fruit that divides people in lovers and haters).

I could not find the place! After doing some research on the internet I went again, two days later. I realised now why I had not found it. Because it is in the indoors yard of a big building. In fact you can even take your motorbike inside. 

I felt happy and relieved. But only for a little while! They have 5 or 6 stalls where they sell their ice cream there. And NOBODY in the whole complex speaks English. And, of course, I had not taken into account that "durian" has a different name in Vietnamese! So, no joy! Nobody understood my pleading and beckoning and I had to leave empty-handed!

More research! Equipped with the Vietnamese name (sau rieng) I went there for the third time a few days later. And: no problem. I had my cone of durian ice on no time :)

Alas, I was not too carried away with its taste. Very bland and hardly any particular durian taste. I had had much better (and cheaper) ones in Thailand. But then, I also read somewhere that the durians in Vietnam generally are not as good as in the neighbouring countries.  I cannot verify that, really.

I ended up disappointed after a lot of effort. But you may be very happy with your experience. Apart from the morning hours this place is packed with Vietnamese. They obviously adore the ice...

reviews.author: SunlightDo
reviews.title: Vietnam ice-cream
reviews.content: Trang Tien is not ice-creams, it is cultural and traditional of Hanoi. There are no tables and chairs, people lined up neatly to buy ice-creams, then go to their motorcycle to taste it. It's an exciting experience.

reviews.author: AlexB
reviews.title: Nice ice cream and very interesting place
reviews.content: Amazing and very unusual for western people place. It's beyond my imagination to find very nice and tasty ice cream at the end of the dark pass-way. First time in my life, I saw people seating on moto-bikes and eating ice cream. Queue was not that long, but it was worth while to wait. Very nice    ice cream... and quite cheap... Glad our Vietnamese friends in Australia recommended that place and we found it.

reviews.author: Herewecomeworld
reviews.title: Nostalia Lane for Vietnamese
reviews.content: When you go inside, you have to maneuver around the motor bikes that are parked inside the store. Everyone is happy and smiling there. My wife told me of her father taking the family there when they were kids. Walk around and see what you want because each station sells different ice cream. We ordered ice cream at the first station we walked up to and then had to order more at a different station because I saw others eating soft serve that looked good and was not offered at the station we first went to. The prices are very low, of course, and it is crawling with teens and college age kids.

reviews.author: Maker H
reviews.title: Famous place to enjoy ice cream
reviews.content: With a secret in generating an ice cream, Trang Tien always stand at undeniable roles to give people special taste. Being well-known from middle 20th century, Trang Tiep has made billion ice creams to consumer in Hanoi and other provinces. Using Trang Tien Ice Cream is one of Hanoi people's habits.

reviews.author: CHUN C
reviews.title: FAMOUS ICE CREAM IN VIET NAM
reviews.content:
It is located in Trang Tien street, nearly Hoan Kiem lake. The place is always crowded from morning to evening, especially in hot day and weekend evening. This delicious ice cream is only VND 12.000 for ice cream cone and VND 8.000 for other types - so cheap!!!!. 

Just one drawback: You have to buy tissue since it is NOT free provided. If you unluckily go in the crowded time, you have to queue up in a long line; but it is a exciting experience.

reviews.author: Mervyn C
reviews.title: Queuing and standing up to enjoy ice-cream!
reviews.content: The first time I went there, I found it is very strange and special since people have to queue up to buy the ice-cream and stand to enjoy it without any table serving. It is very traditional and special way with big crowds. People enjoying ice-cream there chit -chat, it is quite noisy but unique. I love its atmosphere. Also the ice-cream is good and cool. If we have a chance to come back, I will enjoy more ice-cream than the past :)

reviews.author: AnnaCandy
reviews.title: Good ice cream
reviews.content:
Trang tien located near Hoan Kiem lake, so it's easy for  traveler to find out. It has delicious fresh ice cream.
It do not have the tables and chairs to sit and eat here. Every people often stand or sit on their motobike when eat ice cream in this place, this is strange experience.

reviews.author: WQ See
reviews.title: Famous Vietnam IceCream
reviews.content: Saw this on a few travel shows and told our guide from hanoikids if she could be nice to bring us there. Is a very interesting experience as many locals visit this place. You can see motorbikes coming in and out of the place.

reviews.author: A P
reviews.title: The place in Hanoi for an Ice-Cream
reviews.content: This is where everyone in Hanoi comes to on their mopeds on a Friday or Saturday evening for an Ice Cream.  You may have to elbow your way to the counter, but this is a real 'local' experience and excellent for people watching ...

reviews.author: Yeye Z
reviews.title: DO NOT MISS! Came here EVERYDAY!
reviews.content: Very delicious homemade ice cream in a fun setting. This place is always mobbed with locals - families, groups of children, dates on motorbike. Make sure to keep walking east on Kem Trang Tien to the very large garage-like area. Walk back to the stand on the right hand side and order the ice cream in a cone. I came here nearly every day of my 5-day stay, even if I was on the other side of the Ho Kiem.

reviews.author: Alvin_Zeragorn
reviews.title: Extremely tasty ice cream at low price
reviews.content:
Believe it or not, this delicious ice cream is only 50 cent each. They have only few flavor, but all of them are yummy. I recommend the green rice with coconut popsicle, those flavors blend together so well and create a balance taste.
Since it's cheap, don't expect caring service from the shop. Togo should be the best solution since it is always crowded inside. Have a 2-3 minutes walk and you can enjoy your treat on a bench in front of the Hoan Kiem Lake. Believe me, having your popsicle in Hoan Kiem Lake is much better than in that crowded and noisy shop.

reviews.author: Esther T
reviews.title: A scoop of old Hanoi
reviews.content:
It's ... special. 
Pros: cheap ($.50/ ice cream), really a local joint. The place was a cooperative of sort, state-run, and started in the 80s or something. Back then it was the only ice cream place in the whole city! It's stayed the same all these years, like a true culture icon. You'll see locals packing in just for a scoop. The ice cream was not half bad either, mine was green and served on a stick instead of a cone. Talking about old school :) 
Cons: Crowded, and you'll really have to elbow your way to the counter.

reviews.author: Vietdragonflytravel
reviews.title: Wow lovely ice cream
reviews.content: We often go to this places for ice-cream. It is so popular and famous and it is a eating ice-cream culture of Hanoi people. You just stand outsite the street and eat...

reviews.author: Lambchoplowry
reviews.title: Taste of Vietnamese culture
reviews.content: Cheap, delicious, and it's what the locals eat - why not try it?! We had the cone versions - chocolate and also vanilla, both with a coconut taste, and both really good. You see locals everywhere, it's a rather iconic Hanoi thing to do, especially in winter, apparently!

reviews.author: TorontoFoodShrink
reviews.title: Get the sticky rice flavor
reviews.content: Don't expect North American style decor or service - expect an authentic Hanoi experience recommended by locals. Go to the back and order the ice cream on a Popsicle stick - specifically the "com" (rhymes with foam) flavor.  It's the flavor of green sticky rice and it's unique to Hanoi. It's delicious!  You also get a window into Hanoi life!

reviews.author: Rose D
reviews.title: Yummy Traditional Vietnamese Ice Cream (Kem)
reviews.content: We found this place by chance when exploring the French Quarter and Trang Tien St. We saw the locals crowding the place and decided to have a look. It turned out to be a very famous Vietnamese ice cream place which was a real treat for a hot summer day. They offer quite a wide range of local ice cream flavour and we tried two different flavours. It was certainly a good local experience!

reviews.author: Jacky Nguyen
reviews.title: Try it but just ice-cream, no service...
reviews.content: Maybe, unrespectable with customers from the staffs is special character there and it make people always remember them when talk about ice-cream in Hanoi, so, its not good for tradination. I love ice-cream there and sometime take my friend to enjoy it but no time before we have it with fun time. However, visit Hanoi you must try this ice-cream, it is the best in Hanoi.

reviews.author: nguyentv61
reviews.title: Best Ice-cream in Hanoi
reviews.content: Best Ice-cream in Hanoi. Should try if you have chances. Love Kem Trang Tien for more than 30 years.

reviews.author: Chali_aomnoi
reviews.title: ice cream
reviews.content:
OH ^^ location Kem Trang Tien 35 Trang Tien Street , Hanoi , Vietnam 
This place is a very famous ice cream shop in Hanoi and i like eat ice cream Kem Trang Tien
 I eat all  time at come hanoi

reviews.author: Johnny
reviews.title: Tradionnal vietnamese icecream
reviews.content: I love the the green icecream, it's made from the green young rice and just for around 10k and it's near the Hoan Kiem lake and the opera.

reviews.author: Ghosthammer
reviews.title: original Hanoi treat
reviews.content:
placed in one of the best places for the business. it have its fame for serving Hanoian for about fourty year or so. the ice cream is good, but you have to carry it all by yourself, because there's no place to sit.
the recycle bin is always full, so it may give you some irritating feeling. apart from that, it's very good place to stop by

reviews.author: ngonluahong87n
reviews.title: god the ice's cold but the asmostphere very cozy. we lkie ice cream and Trang Tien so much
reviews.content: kem trang Tien it mean Trang Tien cream. Hanoian's very friendly and the staff make our very sátisfield

reviews.author: Matto2009
reviews.title: What is special?
reviews.content: I hear many time before but when tried it is just normal ice cream notthings special. The price is runing from 15.000 dong to 20.000 dong for one. When we went inside to see many stalls to show but i dont know where to seat. Its diffirent any restaurant i tried. It has notthings special.

reviews.author: Kenyalang
reviews.title: Why so famous??
reviews.content: This place is a very famous ice cream shop in Hanoi. It seems it also has branches (or just copy shops?). Anyway, I do not know why this shop is soooooo famous and crowded with locals. I could not really find the reasons. Probably really good ice creams are still a dream for most of the average Vietnamese?

reviews.author: pippylotta
reviews.title: Not good as it used to be
reviews.content: I still remember the taste of Trang Tien Ice Cream 10 years ago, really smooth and not too sweet as it is today. The restaurant is located in a small and crowded street which is not really convenient because I went there by motorbike. However, this is still a cultural feature of Hanoi, then many people want to come here, to try it or to recall something they tasted years ago just like me.

reviews.author: Ly P
reviews.title: Better days have passed
reviews.content: I have been going here since I was child and always will but people should know its very crowded and dirty now.  The ice cream tastes the same, very sweet like me :-P but atmosphere too loud and crowded with dirt.  Sadly reminds of Hanoi now too many people, too dirty not like peaceful before.

reviews.author: NganNTP
reviews.title: Poor places
reviews.content:
The icecream is not good and getting worse by years
Too crowded and not clean
You have to stand in a dark, close place, crowd and noise to eat An icecream:(

reviews.author: aliebowitz
reviews.title: A Hanoi institution, you must try it
reviews.content: I don't get how any ice cream lover can give this anything less than 5 stars!  It is such a fascinating place to check out as it is always packed with locals all time of day, and it is like no other ice cream experience you will have.  Then, the ice cream itself is delicious and so amazingly cheap.  I had both a bar and a cone on my first visit, and went back a second time as well.  I like the white (coconut?) flavor so didn't try anything else.  I was told by others to avoid the soft serve and stick to either the fresh bars or the cones.  I also never tried the bars pre-packaged in plastic because that seemed like such a waste.

reviews.author: Sdblue
reviews.title: Locals love it
reviews.content: Went looking for something else put came upon this and couldn't pass it's up since there were 100s of locals everywhere.  Cheap and refreshing.  Coconut ice cream is your only choice but it's good.  Be careful of your wallet, we spent 3 months in SEA and this was the only time we felt a bit unsafe and someone tried to pick pocket my husband.

reviews.author: lthg
reviews.title: bad icecream for a western taste but good for local taste
reviews.content: It's not clean and taste like sugger frozen water added flavors

reviews.author: WoShiHeiRen
reviews.title: Delicious vietnamese ice cream. Recommended
reviews.content:
Recommended by a tour book, we had specifically asked our local guide to bring us to Kem Trang Tien. It was a sunny hot afternoon when we reached the place and there isn't much queue for the ice cream on that particular weekday. 
Kem Trang Tien sell 2 different type of ice creams at 3 different locations within the shop. One type is packed in packages with many flavours and the other sell in cone (vanilia flavour). We had only tried the cone ice cream (each VND10,000) and was amazed by the creamy and it's delicious. This is a good place to try the the Vietnamese ice cream. After which, we went to the same place for ice cream the following day :)

reviews.author: SoloSeat
reviews.title: Best CREAM for Your Mouth...!
reviews.content: Yeah...I am not talking about the naughty variety (get your head out of the trash).  Since 1958, this cult-like establishment has been serving up the best ice cream in town.  There is always a line...but it is quick.  Plus, the ice cream is CHEAP....and the perfect sweet for a sweaty Hanoi day.

reviews.author: Mel B
reviews.title: A part of the history of Hanoi - an experience as well as an ice-cream!
reviews.content:
If you go on a weekend evening you will be lucky to get within 100 metres of Kem Trang Tien - as the young and families congregate there as they have done for decades for their ice cream. The best is a creamy one on a stick and Hanoians will eat little else. An example of its age and place in the culture of Hanoi is that my mother in law (now in her mid-sixties) was offered as many ice-creams from Kem Tran Tien if she came first in her exams. She did and ate Kem Trang Tien ice-cream until she could no longer feel her face! 
An experience as well as an Ice-cream.

reviews.author: Pam M
reviews.title: Still the best icecream
reviews.content: Ride your motorbike into this place, and grab an icecream. Nothing fancy, no seating, but everyone sits around on their bikes before zooming off into the night. Cheap

reviews.author: franinmuc
reviews.title: Kem Trang Tien at no. 57
reviews.content:
I'm putting this review here because we were sent to Kem Trang Tien by our hotel (no house number was given) and when we reached no.57 Trang Tien, we saw Kem Trang Tien and bought our ice-cream there. Maybe there are two places. Anyway our ice-cream looks like the one pictured by the first reviewer.

It was a shop for takeaway (not sure if there was seating inside - we didn't go in any further). We peered into the ice-coolers and one had ice-lollies while the other had balls of ice-cream in cones. We bought the choc cones for 7000VND each. They were delicious. This is Vietnamese style ice-cream and not Haagen Daz. Just as a comparison, we paid 32000VND per scoop in Fanny"s.

reviews.author: Elluminate
reviews.title: Awesome local ice cream
reviews.content:
This place is a gem. 

Although, it is not very well known among foreigners but this is one place where all the local flock to for ice cream at any time of the day. We were brought there by friends and we really enjoyed it.

It's quite an experience, the ice cream kinda melts very fast but never the less, if 'try all local food' is your kind of thing, then I suppose you shouldn't miss this :)

It is situated near the sword lake on Trang Tien street. somewhere along the road towards the Hanoi Opera House.

Oh our friends warn us to beware of counterfeit as there are a lot of counter feit around...

reviews.author: torres f
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.content: It was very nice, relaxing, and wonderful to do

reviews.author: johnhp702
reviews.title: Large statue
reviews.content: This large statue of Ly Thai dominates this tree lined park but apart from that there is nothing else to see.

reviews.author: cranine
reviews.title: Greenery in downtown
reviews.content: Nice green park and very well maintained. Ideal to relax on the walk and enjoy a little quiet despite its location, close to the most touristic area. The very close lake is extremely nice with all these fresh fruit and drink vendors.

reviews.author: OHKSO
reviews.title: The banks of Hoan Kiem Lake
reviews.content: It was a park adjacent to Hanoi Central Post Office. When I was walking around Hoan Kiem Lake, I found a large statue and checked it on a map, and found that the whole area had been developed into a long and narrow park with the statue of Lee Tai Tho. If we had a chance, we could take a rest, but we only wanted to visit the attractive places and cafes around Hoan Kiem Lake.

reviews.author: Crumpled Nomad | Travel Intelligence
reviews.title: Need to read up on the history
reviews.content: Didn’t read much about the history of this site prior to my visitation. Apparently, emperor Ly was the founding member of the Ly dynasty. I found the history very similar to the Chinese one. Anyway, the place was well kept and we took some pictures there. Think only need to spend around 15 minutes and it was located very close to the lake. Maybe reading up a bit of its history will make it a more interesting place to visit.

reviews.author: JnVSydney
reviews.title: Lovely park...
reviews.content: A peaceful hangout for locals and tourists alike to enjoy, the centre piece is a bronze statue of a great leader, which the park is named after,  we visited when the roads were closed which made the visit even better,

reviews.author: Tran Quoc Tuan (Daniel)
reviews.title: Hanoi <3
reviews.content: Hanoi central <3 Km0 <3 You must stay here when you go to Hanoi. If you dont come there, you are never come to Hanoi yet :))))))

reviews.author: Jaroslav Nečas
reviews.title: Small park with monument
reviews.content: Small park with big monument in the center, besides it, there is nothing really interesting.I found the place accidentally just walking around nearby lake.

reviews.author: Scott W
reviews.title: Photo stop when walking around lake
reviews.content: Good spot for photo opportunity and break when walking around the lake. We visited on a Sunday, so there were families relaxing in the park and kids scooting around on roller skates.

reviews.author: TheLeongOhana
reviews.title: Park Across from Ho Hoan Kiem
reviews.content: This was a nice open park facing Sword Lake.  It not your typical green park but completely tiled with trees around the edges.  The tiles make it suitable for a number of different activities.The statue stands out all in black but not much in the way of a description nearby.  I looked him up online and found out he was the 6th King of Vietnam.  Driving the weekend the park was filled with stages setup up for the 2022 ASEAN Police Band Concert.  During my morning walk those stages had since been removed and the park was once more wide open and a much nicer stop for a few minutes.

reviews.author: David
reviews.title: Worth stopping by if you are walking around the lake.
reviews.content: The park of the statue of Ly Thai Tho had just been hosting some form of games event the day I visited, so was in a bit of a state as the detritus was being cleared up. That said the statue itself is really rather stunningWorth stopping by during a walk around the restored sword Lake.

reviews.author: jack M
reviews.title: NICE BREATHING SPACE
reviews.content: A nice open space consisting of parks, open areas and traffic free space in an otherwise suffocating city.  We spent a plasant time walking and looking at local activities. Enjoyed it.

reviews.author: Steve_of_N21
reviews.title: A nice traffic free area adjacent to Hoan Kiem Lake.
reviews.content: Comprising of a concreted area and green section this park is a pleasant spot, especially at weekends when it is used to house events and the locals use it as a place to meet and relax. It is actually more than a park being also a memorial to the first king of the Ly dynasty, LyThai Ho, who moved his seat of power to Hanoi thus turning it into Vietnam’s capital and a fairly recent statue of him dominates a section of the park.

reviews.author: 422iana
reviews.title: Putting up a stage.
reviews.content: They were putting up a stage in front of the statue which spoiled it a bit. It is worth going for the picture, but it is not something you would go out of your way for.

reviews.author: chiangmaicharlies
reviews.title: An inviting area of Hanoi, particularly at weekends
reviews.content: A small city park to the east of the lake, with a fine bronze statue.The statue is significant and other reviewers have done a good job of describing it. Go to 'Patrick D' of Warsaw Poland's review for full details.The park is very busy at weekends and well worth a look.Lots of events happen here.

reviews.author: Frogtwo
reviews.title: Nice big park
reviews.content: This parc on the eastern side of the lake is a good spot to relax. Behind the statue of Lý Thái Tổ is a nice kiosk and plenty of park benches in the shade. In the early morning groups, mainly ladies, exercise or dance. Nice to watch!

reviews.author: KGB777
reviews.title: Pretty city park
reviews.content: This is a small but pretty park located in central Hanoi and near to the Hoan Kiem lake. There's a statue of King Ly Thai To which can be seen here.

reviews.author: Epic-Traveller
reviews.title: Nice Park
reviews.content: This is a nice, well-maintained park near the Old Quarter in Hanoi.There’s a lake, a statue of some king and lots of green spaces where the local Vietnamese work out and play games.Well worth a visit!

reviews.author: Anas A
reviews.title: Nice park
reviews.content: Busy and crowded park during the weekends. It's a good place for families with children to do some activities.

reviews.author: Patrick D
reviews.title: statue of King Ly Thai To
reviews.content: The statue of King Ly Thai To is located in Ly Thai To Garden, Dinh Tien Hoang Street , next to the town hallThis statue aims to honour King Ly Thai To (974 – 1028). ,first king who found Capital Citadel of Thang Long (Hanoi today).In February, 2003, the Hanoi Department of Culture and Information launched a contest to design the statue of King Ly Thai To. The design of sculptor Vi Thi Hoa (Vietnam Fine Arts Association) was selected from 29 other designs. The statue was cast on August  2004 and inaugurated on October 2004. This is the biggest pure bronze statue in Vietnam with weight of 34 tons , height of 10.m . The number 1010 corresponds with foundation year of the Capital Citadel of Thang Long.The octagonal estrade represents 8 directions , the statue portrays King Ly Thai To whose right hand holds Chieu doi do (Decree on the capital’s relocation) and left hand is pointed at the location to found the capital. The statute is the cultural work to celebrate the 50th anniversary of Hanoi’s liberation day (10/10/1954 – 10/10/2004) and lead-up to the 1000th anniversary of Thang Long – Hanoi (1010-

reviews.author: bunko007
reviews.title: Ly Thai to Statue
reviews.content: Chanced upon this attraction while walking around the Hoan Kiem Lake.  Saw some tourists flocking the area so I followed. The statue apparently was that of Ly Thai To, an emperor who founded was it now Hanoi. Kids played with their skateboards in this area of the park while some mature ladies were grouped together having a lively chat among themselves.    A nice park to visit.

reviews.author: kpiddy
reviews.title: Park near Hoan Kiem Lake with a historical meaning.
reviews.content: At the southern end of Hoan Kiem Lake near the Post Office is the small park, Ly Thai To Park, the park gets its name from the large bronze statue in the centre, the Emperor Ly Thai To.  He was the founder of the Ly dynasty of Vietnam from 1009 to 1225, he founded the city of Thang Long in 1010 which in time would be known as Hanoi.  On our first visit to the park on a Sunday evening a marketplace surrounded the park, on another visit the park was being prepared for some sort of event.The park is well placed just away from the noise and rush of the surrounding streets to take a short break.

reviews.author: saul g
reviews.title: beautiful
reviews.content: While doin your own "Discover Hanoi Hoan Kiem Lake area) walking/strolling tour , allow yourselves to enjoy this lovely square with the towering statue of Ly Thai To in its center . Not as crowded as the promenade along the lake , but still - many tourists and local are hanging around , willing to talk to you . Great for people-watchin and some action with your cameras .. Only a couple of minutes from the lake , from Tap Hoa Phong Tower and the impressive  Hanoi Municipal People's Committee building .The area is "only pedestrian" on weekends . Hve your cameras ready  .

reviews.author: shiraziwine
reviews.title: weekend Dance area
reviews.content: This park around the lake is really a peaceful area in Hanoi, very beautiful place for evening or morning walking. in the weekend all sq and streets around were close to the traffic and it was open just for pedestrians. in each corner a group of people were dancing, singing, doing acrobatic things etc. i saw a real happiness there and really enjoyed the weekend in Hanoi style.

reviews.author: iliketomoveandsee
reviews.title: Extra bit of park
reviews.content: Lovely little add-on area of the park to the lake. This area is also a walking zone on a weekend, which makes exploring and wandering around a lot more enjoyable.

reviews.author: nellielim
reviews.title: Popular recreational area
reviews.content: Located opposite Hoan Kiem Lake, this is a popular exercise and recreational area for the locals. The park is an ideal place to enjoy some fresh air and relax. A memorial to the first Ly dynasty king stands here.

reviews.author: Bruinman
reviews.title: Wonderful place to engage with Hà Nội.
reviews.content: I'm lucky enough to have the opportunity to visit Hà Nội about every other year, and I always make it  a point if I'm out on a stroll on my own to visit this park. Aesthetically, it's nothing special, but as is common in 23 September Park in Sài Gòn as well, young Vietnamese will often approach foreigners to practice their English. I've met some very warm-hearted people here and had genuinely wonderful cultural exchanges here that have always made my trips to Hà Nội and Viet Nam that much more unique.

reviews.author: John M
reviews.title: Good place to people watch in the center of Hanoi.
reviews.content: This is the recreational space for the people who live here, and a good place to people watch in the center of Hanoi.

reviews.author: Rui Li A
reviews.title: brings back kampong vibes!
reviews.content: This place is definitely worth a visit **ON SUNDAYS, only on sundays, the roads will be blocked out for families and people of all ages to be roaming  around the streets - chilling, walking dogs, dancing, singing, playing childhood games. It was an amazing feeling and we were truly heartened.

reviews.author: Greg W
reviews.title: A lovely public place
reviews.content: We watched families and young people enjoy this space over the public holiday weekend.  It's in the Old Quarter and part of the lovely walk around the lake.

reviews.author: ruthandvern
reviews.title: Greatest public space in Hanoi!
reviews.content: I think this is where this review should be placed. A lot of the pictures depicted the huge vibe of happiness, community, sharing. We walked down our 1st evening in town, a Sunday evening. Almost every few feet there were games, dancing, musicians, children in tiny cars (all together away from others) picnickers, friends and lovers. It just lifted my heart and filled my spirit. I don't recall ever encountering that in a public park. We took 122 pictures and videos as we walked around enjoying each new space we came across.

reviews.author: kenl461
reviews.title: Ly Thai To Park
reviews.content: Enroute with our tour group to Hoan Kiem Lake, we past by Ly Thai To Park, with a large statue of its namesake.  If I had paid attention to our guide, I would have learned that Ly Thai To is the 1st King who founded what is known as "Hanoi" today.Good place to see what the locals do in their daily lives & spare time.  A nice break from the hustle, bustle & noise from the city.  Nice & clean.

reviews.author: santo t
reviews.title: Nice park at the perimeter of Hoan Kiem Lake
reviews.content: Located in the east side of Hoan Kiem Lake perimeter in the far side perimeter, a small park with a big and tall statue in its centre, Ly Thai To Park with Ly Thai To statue, a memorial to the first king of the Ly dynasty who had moved his seat of power to Hanoi. Nice break after busy walk in Hanoi Old Quarter, locals use this park for their daily exercises, yoga and tai chi, and hang out place for youngsters, free park for everybody. Tourists can relax here while watching how locals spent their leisure times for fun and exercises.

reviews.author: Shi
reviews.title: Good to walk around
reviews.content: We enjoyed walking around the park, mostly saw local youngsters hanging out, some of them skateboarding and displaying some pretty daring stunts. There seems to be tai chi classes held in the park, really good place if you want to observe a bit of local life as it happens. The park was never really crowded during our visits, certainly recommend if you are after a relatively quiet stroll.

reviews.author: hannostamm
reviews.title: Great spot for people watching
reviews.content: Dedicated to the founder of Hanoi, the park is popular with locals of all ages. Early in the morning, the elderly come for Tai Chi and dancing, later during the day it is the skate boarders and many students, especially during graduation for the obligatory graduation photo. Bring your camera.

reviews.author: Xanerin
reviews.title: Local History
reviews.content: What a lovely area just a short walk along the lake.  I think the statue is some famous king but more intriguing was the locals enjoying this space.  Young ones skateboarding and showing off their skills, others exercising - think it was tai chi and older generation just sitting and enjoying the atmosphere.  Beautiful place.

reviews.author: Esther R
reviews.title: History
reviews.content: Well i am not really know who is he.. but i love to see and hear that he is one of inspirative man in vietnam. Walk about 20 minutes from hotel at hang bong street

reviews.author: John S
reviews.title: Early morning exercise
reviews.content: Great place to start your day.Our group came and took part on Laughter yoga, the locals were friendly and welcoming and assisted us in getting it right. Great fun, don't fancy that then there is ballroom dancing nearby or you could join in one of the various aerobic groups that seem to spring up everywhere . A must do place to visit

reviews.author: DAVID L
reviews.title: Park by the Lake
reviews.content: Nice mixture of green space open areas dedicated to a famous Vietnamese king of the same name. It’s a happy place for locals who gather here, for exercise, family outings or just lounging about.

reviews.author: rzsz
reviews.title: Early morning tai chi
reviews.content: Come in the early morning (5:30-7) when local people are there doing aerobics, ballroom dancing, tai chi, soccer. We joined in the tai chi and it was an amazing start to the day.

reviews.author: Nunngo
reviews.title: Lovely park
reviews.content: You can't miss this park, it is directly opposite Hoan Kiem Lake.  It has a large memorial statue of King Ly Thai To.  It is always crowded with locals, families predominately out enjoying down time and play time with their children.  Locals also use it in the mornings and evenings to gather for group exercise.  It is worth a visit to in the morning and at night, two opposing times of day when the parks use is different and equally as entertaining.

reviews.author: minimize940314
reviews.title: Simple park
reviews.content: This is a simple park but you can see the statue of the former king ly thai to. The park was named after that king. Ok place to take a rest

reviews.author: hueyleng
reviews.title: Local atmosphere
reviews.content: Just opposite the Hoan Kiem lake, you won't miss the giant statue of Ly Thai To in the square. We came here during early morning and it was packed with locals doing exercising there. A few big groups doing aerobics while blasting different work out songs away at the same time. Some were playing soccer in the middle. Some were dancing, and a big group was doing a mixture of warm up while listening to instructions thru the loudspeakers, intermittently they held hands and did funny faces and moaned (uniquely local thing and interesting to watch). This place used by mostly adults turned into a playground for children at night, a completely different view. Worth going both day and night to have a glance on locals' lives.

reviews.author: Philipp H
reviews.title: Laid-back, local atmosphere
reviews.content: The park itself isn't that beautiful. But we went there in the evening and liked the laid-back atmosphere. There was an outdoor photo exhibition on display, which we really enjoyed. Moreover, some Vietnamese ladies were dancing to pop music.

reviews.author: d_titzova
reviews.title: Hanoi statue Lý Thái Tó
reviews.content: Statue Lý Thái Tó (974-1028) of first Emperor dynasty Ly is a large bronze sculpture. Was made in 2004, weighs 12 ton and atop a 20 ton pedestal, high 10.10 metres. Monument is located in Indira Gandhi Park (popular by the local people) near Hoan Kim Lake.

reviews.author: Llewellyn53
reviews.title: The Statue makes it special
reviews.content: Right next to the lake it makes crossing the road worthwhile. A large open space dominated by a statue but it would have been handy to have a bit more information on display to explain what it was all about. Some rubbish bins would also help reduce the amount of litter

reviews.author: New Era
reviews.title: For relaxing or moving
reviews.content: Large outside space for many people go dancing, exercise. Group of friends meeting, family,.... Can come any time.

reviews.author: G C
reviews.title: Monument to Vietnam's famous leader
reviews.content: The Ly Thai To Park lies close to the shores of Hoan Kiem Lake and memorializes this famous location plus Vietnam's ancient leader :)) The tall, imposing statue is surrounded by a broad plaza of stone tiles, bonsai trees, and fresh flowers... The park is very popular among the city's residents, and you can observe all manner of activities here... ladies exercising in the early morning, children & parents enjoying rented toys, families walking and chatting, performers on the covered outdoor stage, etc... Find a seat and observe everyone enjoying this lovely spot in the heart of the capital city :))

reviews.author: F4023NZalbertos
reviews.title: Nice small park!
reviews.content: Just in fron of my favourite place in hanoi! Hoàn kiếm lake! I use to come here if no rain, and stay for many hours! Talking to local peoples and even to many of different countries!

reviews.author: kathleensantara
reviews.title: Good location and nice
reviews.content: Located in the center of Hanoi, the front is a sword lake. It is a large square with a big statue. This place is suitable for many sports to come here to enjoy the fresh air, because there are many trees and very wide, especially convenient to travel around the main road.There are also many daily activities, suitable for large groups

reviews.author: ironian
reviews.title: Good place for a stop on your walk around the lake
reviews.content: If you are having a stroll around the lake this is a good park to rest your weary feet for a while and watch the locals going about daily life.  It also has an impressive monument of an old King

reviews.author: Christian O
reviews.title: Local meeting point
reviews.content: During the Chinese New Year celebrations the Ly Thai To Park was transformed into an amusement park and most impressively a book market. There were 1000s of families walking around and entertaining their kids and shopping books. It was a pleasure to see the locals enjoying themselves, and feeling the atmosphere. There were loads of lights during the evening, which made very colourful.

reviews.author: TheShis
reviews.title: A park with a monument.
reviews.content: This is a small park next to the lake.The park features a monument to Ly Thai To, the emperor of 1000 years ago or so.

reviews.author: Linh B
reviews.title: Laughing Yoga in the early morning, young vibe in the evening
reviews.content: Central located and you will pass by for sure during your stay in Hanoi. Best experience can come in the early morning when you can drop by and join the local group practising Laughing Yoga. During the day it's quite quiet, until late afternoon when it filled up with local families, school kids, young artist group rehearsal, tourist... Nice to grab a glimpse of local life.

reviews.author: Diego D
reviews.title: Nice place for walking
reviews.content: This palce is near the lake in the old quarter of Hanoi. It is a nice place where walkimg around with the family. All the area is worth of being visited and walking around the lake.

reviews.author: Laurent C
reviews.title: Rap danse and Childs joyce
reviews.content: In the evening there are many dancers of rap.They chain the complex figures and it is great!The children play with bright electric scooters.Rollers are in on this!

reviews.author: TWal1
reviews.title: Small City Park, Imposing Statue
reviews.content: This park is home to Ly Thai To's statue, which is a recent addition to Hanoi's historical culture. The park is small and is close to Hoan Kiem Lake. It is worth a visit and is popular with local families. Thanks for your vote if you found this review helpful.

reviews.author: DelanA82
reviews.title: Park with Monument to Ly Thai To
reviews.content: Small park close in Hoan Kiem district close to the lake with a statue/monument to Ly Thai To.I went past a few evenings and families with young kids skating, playing and enjoying/relaxing there. It is nicely lit up at night.Good place to see what the locals do outside of work and school.

reviews.author: jeff1955malaysia
reviews.title: people relaxing
reviews.content: it is a small park just off the Hoan Kien Lake. It is by the side of the statue of Ly thai To. You will find people just relaxing, dancing, reading or just resting. it is very greenery and calm. nice place to relax and read a book.

reviews.author: Nada O
reviews.title: People and families
reviews.content: This is certainly a place to go if you are interested in seeing how the Vietnamese live in their private time.  Many Vietnamese go to parks as the space in their homes do not usually include a garden - this is the place for kids to run around, dance or play while the parents sip tea with friends on the small stools in the minute tea spots.  A delight over weekends in good weather

reviews.author: Susana D
reviews.title: Nice park with monument of Ly Thai To
reviews.content: A medium-sized park. Best seen at night due to the lighting. Lots of locals with families and kids on weekends. Lots of old bonsai trees.

reviews.author: Valerie N
reviews.title: If you like to people-watch...
reviews.content: Stumbled upon this place when chasing pikachu there. Happened upon an open air photo exhibition which was a nice surprise. Gets quite crowded at night when the Ly Thai To statue is lit up and there are people blasting music from speakers, street performers entertaining the crowd, live bands rocking out, vendors along the sidewalk hawking their wares, kids playing jump rope & roller skating, families out for a stroll and couples milling about and having their wedding photos taken.

reviews.author: JasonNguyen24
reviews.title: Very relaxed
reviews.content: Going with novntravel.com to visit this Park, after a short walk from the lake, sitting there to enjoy the life of local people. Little children play roller skating. iti is funn

reviews.author: jemikanne
reviews.title: A green haven
reviews.content: Visiting the lake area in the middle of a hot Hanoi day is like a breath of fresh air.  You are surrounded by green and feel calmer and cooler because of it.  It is a lovely respite in the middle of a hectic city.

reviews.author: phoenix7389
reviews.title: Full of people
reviews.content: Sometime Hanoi Youth held out door event here, but almost time it's like a community place for skate board-er, Zumba dancer etc...

reviews.author: JoeG4D
reviews.title: Engage with your Hosts
reviews.content: Many times we would be approached by young kids or students so that they can practice their English, which is taught in schools as a second language. This is a very busy Place!!! Much going on and a great place to stroll and watch how socially interactive the Vietnamese people are in their daily lives. They use technology, technology does use them. The engage each other more than disengage. You see how Happy they are with doing just that

reviews.author: HLalani
reviews.title: Midnight Rendevous
reviews.content: I stumbled into this city Central Park at 1am because I kinda got lost on my way home. At this late time of hour were mostly young couples or groups of friends sitting around chatting. From what I hear a lot of local Vietnamese youth don't get much privacy at home so they congregate in these parks and cafes. None of them were rowdy or anti social at all. Actually really well behaved. It was very peaceful. I finished my beer enjoyed the moment and stumbled on into the night. Oh there is a toilet which I really wanted to use but couldn't figure out the instructions. Doh!

reviews.author: Daniel_lawgg
reviews.title: A place popular for locals and tourists
reviews.content: This is a popular place for locals and tourists alike. Locals like to exercise around the park and offers tourists a glimpse of the their daily life.

reviews.author: Rainie Green
reviews.title: Good place for having a nice rest
reviews.content: We were very surprised at a lot of park in Ha Noi. We are from Ho Chi Minh City which is full of pp, not many park for citizen wlking around, holding activities like this. We appriciate this place.

reviews.author: bronvoyage
reviews.title: Fun atmosphere
reviews.content: go there at 6am.  I joined in the Zumba, Laughter Yoga and watched plenty of other dances.  Really great fun way to wake up to the day in Hanoi and very enjoyable to see locals out dancing wearing lovely clothes and dancing as couples and women dancing with their hats. I enjoyed it so much I did it twice, no point sleeping in on holidays.

reviews.author: Melvin M
reviews.title: Best time is in the evening
reviews.content: The best time to come to the park is in the evening when the statue commemorating the hero of Vietnam's Lý dynasty is lit up to its full glory. It was a quiet and rainy evening when we were there, but it is just a stone's throw to the Hoan Kiem lake, so definitely a place to stroll around a little on the way to the old quarters.

reviews.author: EarlyRetirementAbroad
reviews.title: Wonderful park
reviews.content: One of the favorite parks is Ly Thai To Park.  This is a place where families come together to enjoy live music, kids play sports, and newlyweds getting ready for the photo shots.

reviews.author: pagoda2014
reviews.title: Grab some atmosphere
reviews.content: Go there on a Saturday -may see wedding couples being photographed, people exercising, even dancing. Right by the lake so take a detour while walking around -do some people watching. Sometimes concerts here also.

reviews.author: Trypp Adams
reviews.title: Festivals, open area... a place to celebrate
reviews.content: While I was in Hanoi, Ly Thai To Park hosted events... there was music, dancing, and just a general party most times I walked by and it seemed to cater to the locals. If you are walking around the lake, it's hard to miss the park, worth a stroll through if you have a little extra time.

reviews.author: LG_Kay
reviews.title: Just a local park
reviews.content: Located just across the Hoan Kiem Lake, the commanding statue of Ly Thai To stands out in the park. It is an open space area for locals to gather here, be it relaxing, dancing, exercising etc. Though nothing spectacular, it is a good place to hang around to take a break or observe the locals in their daily activities.

reviews.author: hikkaduwa_10
reviews.title: Nice area
reviews.content: good to walk around and sit on the benches, very close to Hoan Kiem lake and the whole territory of Old Quarter

reviews.author: diploconcierge
reviews.title: Large, paved park next to Hoan Kiem Lake
reviews.content: At most any time of day, you can find people hanging out in Ly Thai To Park, adjacent to Hoan Kiem Lake.  In the early mornings, I hear you might find a group of Hanoians practising laughing yoga.  In the afternoons, especially on a weekend, you might find many kids running around.  The park could be a stop on a stroll from the Metropole to Hoan Kiem Lake or vice versa.

reviews.author: Paulsphotos
reviews.title: Amidst all the tourists, this is the place for local children to play - a real joy to sit and watch.
reviews.content: Much of the week this urban space is largely empty and of little interest to the visitor. However, after school time and at the weekends, particularly on Sunday afternoon, it fills with the laughs of the colourfully dressed children - roller blading, scooting, cycling, chasing bubbles, etc. You just need to sit, relax and enjoy the fun.

reviews.author: Agathe F
reviews.title: Park with children activities
reviews.content: If you have child it worth going. There is a place where your children can go play. There is a play ground. There is also a cafe

reviews.author: Jel86
reviews.title: Just next to the Hoan Kiem lake, with big Ly Thai To statute
reviews.content: Just next to the Hoan Kiem lake, with big Ly Thai To statute. Read your guidebook for the part of history. Nice stone flooring. Skaeboarders squat the space, along with women exercising early in the morning and at night on load dance music.

reviews.author: travelnomadNZ
reviews.title: Relaxing Environment
reviews.content: Pleasant surprise. Great use of open space in the middle of a bustling city of Hanoi with 10.9 million people . Can be used as a playground , tai chi classes and much more. Architectural design has made it user friendly for more than two activities at the same time without conflict.Tip : popular with both locals and tourists. Sunset is a good time to be here . Try and avoid the big crowds

reviews.author: Trường N
reviews.title: Great exercise place for the locals
reviews.content: Many locals takes it as the playground for Taichi, football, biking even though it is little bit small. they know well how to give space to each other. It is crowded at every weekend.

reviews.author: Bolt T
reviews.title: Beautiful at Night!
reviews.content: A walk around Hoan Kiem Lake and a stop at Ly Thai To Park are a great way to spend an inexpensive night out in Hanoi. Everything was beautifully lit and there were friendly people everywhere.

reviews.author: Maria Paalman
reviews.title: Bustling children's playground
reviews.content: Visit this little ground, just off Hoan Kiem Lake, in the (early) evening, when many parents take their small kids here to play, skate, dive around in toy cars etc., while the imposing statue of Ly Thai To is overlooking the action and the whole place is lit up with fancy lighting. Fun to watch. You might also see a group of (mostly) women doing their aerobic exercises on the rhytms of a blaster turned up very loud.

reviews.author: sain21
reviews.title: My favorite place
reviews.content: You should  visit the place with kids.They can see the dance practicing teenagers,skating  .You will the culture of Hanoi.Really enjoyable place....

reviews.author: Jack E
reviews.title: Brilliant hussle and bustle escapism spot
reviews.content: This is the perfect spot at Hoan Kiem Lake to relax and take in the views and the performing locals. Great to escape here from all of the busy streets and the 2.5 million motorbikes. Some bench seats are available but as in all other Vietnamese localities there are not many (they don't want you congregate). It won't be too long before tourists will have to queue to get a seat on one of the benches to rest their tired feet and limbs.Great spot after dark.

reviews.author: VNvet2015
reviews.title: You're going to go by this park anyway
reviews.content: so cross the street from Hoan Kiem lake and do some people-watching of Vietnamese rather than more tourists. The end nearest the lake is where kids learn to rollerblade and families gather to let the kids loose, while other end of the park is usually pretty empty and offers places to sit more quietly. I always enjoy walking through the park when I am coming from or going to streets to the east of the lake. Heading east from the lake you will come out very near the Metropole hotel and a short walk to the Opera House, so the park is convenient to many places of interest. It's not an oasis like the former Lenin park, but it is a change of pace from traffic and shopping.

reviews.author: ekeat79
reviews.title: Nice place for a walk
reviews.content: This park is not exactly a green lung per se, but it consists of a wide cemented space surrounded by colorful flower beds. This park provides ample space for the locals to carry out healthy activities such as tai-chi, jogging, skating, etc. The main landmark in this park is a large bronze statue of Ly Thai To, i.e. former Emperor of ancient Vietnam. A nice place for a walk, especially in the morning or evening.

reviews.author: seedhunter
reviews.title: Very interesting all the time
reviews.content: Located near Hoan-Kiem Lake, "Ly Thai To Park" is veri live place in the city. In the morning joggers and walkers and in evening cyclist, earobics and many more activities to chill out. Be careful with your bags and valuables.

reviews.author: Puppy
reviews.title: Right next to the lake of the restored sword
reviews.content: The park has a massive bronze statue of Ly Thai To (founder and first king of the Ly Dynasty) which dominates the entrance, he reigned from 1009 to 1028 AD. It was he who moved the capital to Hà Nội in 1010. The park is not big but is often home to roller skaters and youngsters having fun.

reviews.author: Rich M
reviews.title: great for early morning people watching
reviews.content: To see everyday life in Hanoi, get up early (5:30 - 6:30) and walk around the lake.  Many people exercising, dancing, meditating, lifting weights, jogging, playing games, etc.  Very interesting and fun.

reviews.author: Chris101111
reviews.title: Entertainment
reviews.content: Fabulous park to watch the locals going about their everyday lives, early morning it's tai chi or badminton and it's fun to watch.I would recommend you come down early and see it.

reviews.author: Vu D
reviews.title: Local entertainment
reviews.content: Facing the Hoan Kiem Lake, this park is a popular place for local people, especially by late night with street dance, cycling, aerobic and even taichi etc. Relax environment and chance to see local life.

reviews.author: Noisrucxe
reviews.title: 【 Morning Gymnastics 】
reviews.content: "Ly Thai To Park" is located near Hoan-Kiem Lake.This park was built by French colonial government in 1887.You should visit this park in early morning time!Because many people are doing gymnastics at this park.You may be able to know Vietnamese-healthy lifestyle.I recommend this experience.

reviews.author: MichaelLau3000
reviews.title: Monument of King Le Thai To
reviews.content: Notice this Monument located near Ly Thai To Park & Hoan Kiem Lake area.It provide some historical background on the national hero Le Loi, the Golden Turtle, The Returned Sword & King Le Thai To.Details are scribbled on the rock in few languages.

reviews.author: nObOdY007
reviews.title: Great Park Next To The Lake
reviews.content: Located In Front Of HOAN KIEM Lake, This Park Is Such A Wonderful Place For Relaxing. At The Night Time, Lots Of People Are Gathering And Doing Some Activities. If You're Tired, Just Walk A Fews Minute And You Will Find The Restaurant For Chilling, Having Hanoi Beer And Great Foods.A Must Visit Place.

reviews.author: chavi2015
reviews.title: My daughters favourite place
reviews.content: This is the favourite place of my daughter as in the evening its crowded with the kids and youngesters practising skates and dancing..Sometimes they organize their cultural programme.So you can get to know vietnamese lifestyle.missing....

reviews.author: G C
reviews.title: Nice park just across the street from Hoan Kiem Lake
reviews.content: The Ly Thai To Park honors one of Viet Nam's famous leaders, who ruled a thousand years ago.  There are two broad, stone-paved plazas in front and behind his statue that are really popular places with the locals for their outdoor activities... Be sure to check out the shaded paths behind the Emperor and the large open gazebo (with classic Vietnamese architecture, of course -- nice spot for a photo)... there are plenty of benches to sit and rest.  When the paths along the Hoan Kiem Lake get busy, I just head across the road to this nice park... There are also several carnivals with rides for small children nearby (these seem to operate during holidays?)  Beautiful flowers adorn this place of honor as well, and it's a frequently used location for wedding photos.  Enjoy Ly Thai To Park as I do :))

reviews.author: Erica W
reviews.title: Fun for kids
reviews.content: Rollerskates for rent in front of the statue.  Behind the park in the next block on the left is Hanoi Children Center they have some carouselles and other simple rides for small children. 15-20 K each. Seems to start around 4-5pm  Fun for an hour or so.

reviews.author: MsAnnHanoi
reviews.title: Small park for rest.
reviews.content: Statue of King Ly Thai To is located at Ly Thai To park in Dinh Tien Hoang Street, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi center. Today, Ly Thai To park is a cultural and architectural beauty.In order to honor of King Ly Thai To, in February, 2004 the Department of Information Hanoi Culture organized a competition design King Ly Thai To statue. After that the statue of King Ly Thai To is located at Ly Thai To park.Monument at Ly Thai To park is one of the main cultural projects to celebrate 50 years of liberation of the capital (10/10/1954 – 10/10/2004), and to celebrate 1000 years of Thang Long – Hanoi (1010 – 2010).

reviews.author: Leo D
reviews.title: special park
reviews.content: it os a place where every people can come to take a rest as well as enjoy the beauty of Hoan Kiem lake. opposite to Hoan Kiem lake, Ly Thai To park is quite large, airy atmosphere for you to relax. you also cannot ignore the big statue in this park - is of king Ly Thai To who removed the capital of Vietnam from Ninh Binh to Hanoi.

reviews.author: pinoytraveller2
reviews.title: Giant Statue at the Park
reviews.content: This review is quite late. The Ly Thai To Park is major city landmark in Hanoi. We passed by this park on our way to the Opera House from the Hoan Kiem Lake. Since it was mid day we were all alone and no other soul was around.

reviews.author: BeeJhoii
reviews.title: Park
reviews.content: Ly Thai To Park is really good to hang out with friends. It is near in Hoan Kiem Lake and the old quarter. At night, there lots of people using roller blades. Just be careful crossing the streetrs.

reviews.author: konshoe
reviews.title: A park opposite of Hoan Kiem Lake
reviews.content: On our tour around the lake, we spotted this park tucked across the street facing the lake, a square with a majestic statue. Crossing the infamously unruly traffic of Vietnam, we reached Lý Thái Tổ garden,Standing tall and lonely in the middle of the square, the statue held a scroll on his right, suggesting his relationship to scholarly wisdom. And reading his biography during my research for this entry, I was enlightened to his significance and importance to Hanoi in particular, so much so that a statue was erected near to a famous landmark.The statue would get its companions in the form of camera toting tourists and strolling locals. An occasional couple or family would stop by the square to enjoy the spacious ground, a luxury hard to come by in the city center of Hanoi. Twirls of smoke wafted from the bowl of incense holder placed at the foot of the majestic emperor, fluttering to nothing as the wind blow past.

reviews.author: SteveJacksonnufc
reviews.title: Hanoi - Ly Thai To Park - What a great place for local people
reviews.content: We were leaving the Hoan Kiem Lake area and heading towards the history museum and passed straight through this park. What a delight it is. It was early evening and the sun was falling but the place was full of local Vietnamese people either dancing, playing games or just generally out with their families enjoying the open space the park has to offer. It is mainly covered in slabs giving a polished flat surface with a few steps in places but it was great to people watch for a while. The kids were loving it and the dancing was superb, even if it was a little dated. I could have sat for an hour or so and watch everyone having a great time. There was no sign of any hassle or trouble and everyone got on brilliantly. At the far end of the park is an impressive statue of Ly Thai To which overlooks everything that is going on. This place was refreshing and an insight into how the locals spend some of their evenings and leisure time.

reviews.author: Chris101111
reviews.title: Good in the morning
reviews.content: Great to see all the Vietnamese people down here early in the morning, playing badminton and exercising. With limited space this is what Vietnam is.

reviews.author: Lonelyplanet_Tam
reviews.title: No thing here..
reviews.content: This "park" is a concrete yard with the Ly Thai To scupture to memory about a Vietnamese king. It is crow on the early morning, people come there to do exercise or evening to learn dance.

reviews.author: bevvadiveloo
reviews.title: Lotto Observation Deck Hanoi
reviews.content: Stunning views and lots to do up there. Really nice experience and free gift was a nice touch too 🫶

reviews.author: sueBRLN
reviews.title: best view in town
reviews.content: Totally underrated- a must do in Hanoi! Great views, great location.

reviews.author: Susanne d
reviews.title: On 65th floor beautiful view over Hanoi
reviews.content: No one was there at all when we visited. Beautiful view.

reviews.author: ChrisMcLaren
reviews.title: Stunning views and well worth it.
reviews.content: How this doesn’t rate in the top 20 “things to do in Hanoi “ is surprising. It has Stunning views, very modern facilities, fun activities and lots of seating just to soak up the 360 degree view. Reasonable pricing (we opted for the drink at the top option).
