Free of charge high strength binoculars (and we found our hotel). Shops selling drinks , food and tourist options on the level. Our day wasn’t the best viewing day but the nice lady did preview what we would see from her phone before purchasing the tickets. The lift up the 65 th floor was flawless and the 2 see through glass bottom floors were exhilarating and gave me shivers.  worth the visit. Chris (Melbourne) 🇦🇺

reviews.author: Departure29314954105
reviews.title: mid
reviews.content: meat experience it’s kind of crazy because I scared the height and the view is not really that special or spectacular. It just buildings are and you know homes at home’s house at the house so I mean if you don’t really have anything else to do is a good spot for CT seeing that I would not really recommend it because I think it’s a bit overpriced

reviews.author: KEVIN MICHEAL D... G
reviews.title: AY, SO WORTH IT! THE WEEKEND DEAL! 🤩
reviews.content: Grabe, the entrance fee is 230K VND, but we snagged the weekend package for 280K VND which already includes a refreshing drink—sulit much! Taking that high-speed elevator to the 65th floor felt like flying straight to the clouds. Seeing Hanoi at night? Bongga! The whole city below looked like a massive, glittering carpet of tangled lights. The cars moving along the crowded roads, the jumbled bahay (houses), and ponds—it was surreal, like we were floating above a complex, breathing organism. Standing on the glass floor with no shoes on was truly nakakapraning (nerve-wracking), but the view of the hustle and bustle from way up there is just unforgettable!

reviews.author: Chris S
reviews.title: Nice view but a little dirty.
reviews.content: Nice place, friendly staff but could be cleaner. Loved the view but a littlw bit overpriced in my opinion. Good view....

reviews.author: A W
reviews.title: WOW! Hidden Gem
reviews.content: What a lovely experience. No crowds or waiting.  2 glass platforms on either side of the building for you to experience floating on air above the city.  Plenty of viewing binoculars and we also did a mission X VR game and Hanoi VR gliding which was hilarious with the family shooting ghosts in a castle and then gliding above city sights. You can stroll around the entire 360° area of the building. Afterwards we enjoyed a cool drink at bar. Clean tidy and staff were attentive.

reviews.author: simonin78
reviews.title: Great view of Hanoi
reviews.content: Nice view of Hanoi, the floor with the lookout offers several VR activities and the space is kept very well, including a nice bar

reviews.author: Edokko
reviews.title: The tallest observation deck in Hanoi?
reviews.content: Visit on July 9, 2025.Since it is the tallest building in Hanoi with 65 floors, I climbed to its observation floor. The entrance is on the basement floor, pay 230K VND and take the high-speed elevator to the 65th floor! I visited in the evening, so I could even enjoy the night view. Hanoi, seen from above, was a mix of high-rise buildings, jumbled areas and ponds, with car lights illuminating the crowded road conditions. There is a glass floor where you can stand without shoes. Even though I knew I was fine, it still made my liver cool!

reviews.author: johnmichaelo954
reviews.title: How to access lotte Skyview observation deck
reviews.content: This 65th floor viewing deck gives amazing outlook over Hanoi. It is a hidden gem and hard to find good info on. So here goes. The mall is a Vietnam one rather than straight tourist trap. English is not a given. The process to gain access to the sky deck is:Go into the mall and ignore the lifts. You must use the escalator to go down to level B1. This will get you to the supermarket (which is worth a trot round), but leave it via its front entrance. This is done by turning right off the escalator. Then pass food vendors, this is Vietnam after all, in front of you is the up escalator but looking right you will see the neon tunnel entrance. The guy you first sees is a greeter who just points you at the ticket booth. Price is 230000d, and for a little extra, you can add a drink. Go through the turnstiles and onto the actual lift to get to the 65th  floor. Super fast and ear popping!Time your visit with the sunset and take as many photos as you can. The glass floor sections are good for those with the stomach for it. There is a couple of bars up there and is well air conditioned. This is a great stop off the beaten track and should  not be missed!

reviews.author: Mirjam G
reviews.title: Beautiful view
reviews.content: Unfortunately it was cloudy and therefore probably not crowded.We went to do the VR Hanoi Gliding and came out sick (this has been warned in advance)The price included another VR thing but it was broken.We took some pictures and then left. Price quality is fine. It's a shame it's so atmospheric.

reviews.author: Dark C
reviews.title: Don't Miss This on Your Visit to Hanoi!
reviews.content: For some reason, the Lotte Skydeck never showed up in ANY of the "top attractions" websites/blogs we looked at when researching our trip to Hanoi.  It was a bit of happenstance that we learned of it, but once we did, we booked a Grab to get there right away (about a 20 minute ride from the Old Quarter). Similar, but higher than the Bitexco Tower in Saigon (65th floor vs. 49th), it also has an enclosed 360° view, with refreshments and souvenirs available at the top. And admission is about the same price. Unlike Bitexco,  however, the Lotte Skydeck features two large glass floor sections you walk onto and see the entire 65 floors right beneath your feet! We enjoyed both towers, and are glad we discovered the Lotte Skydeck.

reviews.author: mslade
reviews.title: Fantastic Views of Hanoi and beyond
reviews.content: Great place to see Hanoi and beyond. Even on a hazy, overcast day, you get to truly appreciate Hanoi. Lots of activities to do on the observation level if you desire. Can have a drink and just gaze.

reviews.author: Wandering Womble
reviews.title: Panoramic view
reviews.content: Great way to get a panoramic view of the whole city and locate all the points of interest. Staff were great - very helpful and took good photos for us.

reviews.author: NotTheLastJedi
reviews.title: Hanoi is a beautiful city particularly to observe from sky high vantage point.
reviews.content: I really enjoyed spending some time at the Lotte Observation Deck. Hanoi is a beautiful city particularly to observe from sky high vantage point. The day we went, it was not too busy, affording us a relaxed environment and many photo opportunities without being photobombed. I would recommend this to visitors as a unique experience in Hanoi.

reviews.author: nick c
reviews.title: Fairly enjoyable hour or so
reviews.content: We visited on a cloudy day but still had good views and overall enjoyed an hour or so over 'sunset' time.  They don't list the ingredients on their cocktails, so if you want to select something based on your favourite spirit(s) you need to know your cocktails.  They have really strong internal lighting which gives reflections on any photos you try to take through the glass.  They have interesting art and extra experiences such as virtual gliding and games, and a robot trolley delivers drinks.  There's a large supermarket and posh shopping on the ground floor of the complex.

reviews.author: Sue V
reviews.title: Well worth a visit
reviews.content: We purchased a ticket that included a drink, which I think was good value. The observation area is enclosed, with floor to ceiling glass windows. There are a couple of areas with glass floors. It was a bit confusing finding the right entrance as we went into the shopping centre first and no one seemed to know what we were looking for. Make sure you go into the hotel entrance.

reviews.author: david.travel
reviews.title: Peaceful place over the crowded city
reviews.content: We visited there after sunset. It is worth buying an entrance ticket combined with a drink. We liked it so much that we stayed for 1-2 more drinks and enjoyed the city. It's especially good that it's open for a long time.

reviews.author: MissL219
reviews.title: Observation Deck
reviews.content: Some lovely views and photo opportunities. We had a great time here getting pictures in front of the giant heart. When we went it was also very quiet which was really nice.

reviews.author: Fang
reviews.title: Include in your Hanoi must do list
reviews.content: One of the most atmospheric decks we have been to, glass floor to walk on, heart and angel wing ornament for pics, really cool and cosy bar.Do get a ticket with welcome drink, it’s totally worth it.Highly recommended

reviews.author: Elin B
reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.content: Great view, sure, but if you want to take pictures you should go during the day. They have gigantic bright lights on, which reflect in every window. But the reflection is probably als a problem during the day. Entrance is ca. 8.50, which is too expensive for what you get.

reviews.author: nzwestie
reviews.title: Get up there and have a fun time!
reviews.content: We brought out tickets downstairs - bottom floor, quick and easy and straight into the lift.  Zoomed right up to the top and out we went.  What a view and so high up.  We walked right around looking at all the different landscapes.  There are glass floors to walk on.  Angel wings to get your pic taken with.  Also a massive heart shape, coloured bright red to get your pic taken in and on the floor another heart.  We had a fun time up there.  Panels etc to tell you what is outside.  After our time up there we whizzed back down and went up to the food market.  Great food supermarket to get all your want.

reviews.author: anders_jensen82
reviews.title: Nice place
reviews.content: Nice place and a nice experience. Unfortunately, we were unlucky with the weather and couldn't see anything.Tried the VR experience; it was ok, not flashy.

reviews.author: jjjoana
reviews.title: Nice view!
reviews.content: Definitely a must visit if you love observatory decks :) And down below in the Mall there is a Mart that you can shop at afterwards for souvenirs and groceries.

reviews.author: Vijay
reviews.title: Enjoy the hight
reviews.content: had nice time .... u can spend 1 to 2 hrs...glass floor amazing... should improve the cafe menu is poor... ticket counter  perons gives suggestions  to buy tickets due climatic conditions very helpful

reviews.author: Dan Sullivan
reviews.title: Fun viewing deck
reviews.content: This was a fun stop on our trip around Hanoi. It’s a bit out of the city so get a grab here for a few dong. Worth the visit. Glass floor to stand on and look down. Great views over the city. They had some VR experiences for those who wanted to try. Bar was expensive as you’d expect. Shopping mall below.

reviews.author: Jay Thompson
reviews.title: My experience at the Lotte observation deck
reviews.content: The observation deck is well-maintained and equipped with modern facilities, including a glass walkway and a virtual reality parachute experience. The glass walkway is a highlight of the observation deck, giving me and my girlfriend the feeling of walking on air. The virtual reality parachute experience allows visitors to experience the thrill of skydiving from a height of 270 meters (as I remembered)

reviews.author: Zee
reviews.title: Maybe.
reviews.content: Giving a 4 for its photo spot. It just didnt give me the wow factor like the one in Korea. Without comparison, it's still nice to visit if you have no other plans.

reviews.author: jls0212
reviews.title: Happy to have gone there.
reviews.content: It wasn’t crowded at all. We had all the time to take many pictures and have drinks on the 65th floor. It was a great way to spend the afternoon. Plus there’s food and shopping on the lower floors.

reviews.author: Wikumj
reviews.title: Expensive but worth it
reviews.content: This is the best place for views over Hanoi. It is quite expensive to go up relative to Vietnam prices, but once you are up there there is quite a lot to do up there and you could easily spend an hour or two up there if you wanted to. Firstly there are the various view points with some interesting gimmicks - the glass floor, the big heart, the angel wings, which all make for some memorable photos. Then then there are various other things to do, VR rides, and art gallery, small exhibitions, a cafe and bar etc. So it is a comfortable place to spend some time. It is open til late so recommend coming in the evening to catch both the sunset and the city lights at night.

reviews.author: LackyTravels
reviews.title: Disappointing in the dark
reviews.content: Because the interior is brightly lit, light reflections can be seen everywhere in the windows. Most of the city's lighting comes from traffic. The combination ticket with a drink only offers a minimal selection. A disappointment for the high price in the dark. Better to visit during the day.

reviews.author: aprl valentine
reviews.title: Recommended
reviews.content: It was a nice experience. Admission tickets were not expensive as well. The place was not jam packed with people, you can take your time touring around.

reviews.author: jdeepak84
reviews.title: Lotte observatory Deck
reviews.content: Good Place to visit when in Hanoi. Lots of spots to click photos. Observatory is situated at the 65th floor and it gives a full 360 degree view of Hanoi. Place is well maintained and can easily spend about an hour and a half here.

reviews.author: Elena M
reviews.title: Relax with the view
reviews.content: The view was fantastic! We liked that there were many spots to sit and enjoy the view for a while. Definitely go when the weather is good and clear.

reviews.author: Travel-future-ahoy
reviews.title: Terrific customer service
reviews.content: Terrific customer service.Just wandered to this location on a rainy day. Was told upfront and shown photo that it was too foggy to see anything from the observation deck.10/10 for honesty and keeping customer at top of mind.As an aside, Lotte department store was a nice place to visit on a rainy day.

reviews.author: enrique_e_r_j
reviews.title: Exciting views.
reviews.content: Modern skyscraper with very good views and exciting viewpoints. We were with the family and the photos from the 65th floor were spectacular.

reviews.author: FreakinKiwi
reviews.title: Great views and thrilling Glas floor
reviews.content: We visited the observation deck in the evening and got one free drink each die to happy hour. The views are amazing (especially since there are no other similarly high buildings around), the cocktails were great and the Glas floor was very exciting.We also liked, that the bar has several areas. Some with loud music and some quieter ones.

reviews.author: duuuudi
reviews.title: Quite and beautiful place
reviews.content: Among many towers we visited, this is the best because of its wide area and few visitors so you can discover, take some beautiful photos and enjoy

reviews.author: Leannie
reviews.title: Rubbish if the weather is not good
reviews.content: Think we just got super unlucky with the weather and so the view was rubbish.Price to enter for foreigners is not cheap and so if it is smoggy when you get up there you don't have much to do. There is seating and bars dotted around, we sat on a chair and got asked to move because we were not buying anything - seemed a cheek as the place was deserted and we had paid the hefty entrance fee to get up there so hardly free loading

reviews.author: pavan p
reviews.title: Waste of time
reviews.content: Though the building is marvellous, the management is poor. I reached around 10.45pm and was denied entry though i had already tickets purchased. Official entry is allowed until 11pm. On a bit argument was allowed in,but to my disappointment most of the attractions lighting were off. Also glasses on the main deck were not clean. How do you expect to enjoy the view with dirty glasses!It has a bar in north wing where no body came to attend us nor were asked any help. On sitting onto a sofa, suddenly a lady came and she was like she would allow us to sit only if we order anything. Anyways for me its a waste of time as the purpose of coming there wasnt fruitful to the level i was expecting. Also coming from old quarter to back is expensive as you end up paying twice in grab fees as compared to the entrance fees of lotte.

reviews.author: Steve L
reviews.title: Fantastic view…
reviews.content: Arrived at Lotte Centre… head into the mall/center… we were wrongly directed by the staff as we asked for direction. Had to ask another guy and he just told us the entrance/ticket counter is at the basement which is where Lotte mart was located. The ticketing counter was outside of Lotte mart tucked in a corner…No queue no crowd, purchase the ticket and went directly up 65 floors… the view was great and breathtaking. The best part I would say is the skywalk glasses. There were 2 of them, 1 with a heart and 1 with angel wings…There were a few paid activities that you can do like rent an traditional Korean costume, VR games and a cafe if I’m not wrong…Overall a great place for pictures and some relaxed chilling to take in the views.

reviews.author: Callum Douglas
reviews.title: Hanoi from above
reviews.content: Explored the Lotte building before ascending to the observation floor. While the day was hazy / smoggy, the view was still spectacular. Add on to you Hanoi visit if you have the time, hopefully will have a clearer day.

reviews.author: Danny L
reviews.title: Awesome view!
reviews.content: This observation deck was cool and worth the money. Standing on the transparent floor gave you a terrible feeling in your stomach but it was cool. I would do it again

reviews.author: Hansblix
reviews.title: Don't go on a smoggy day
reviews.content: It only costs 200,000 vnd to get to the top (about 9usd).  The observation deck is on the 65th floor and if the day is clear, than you'll be able to see most of Hanoi from above.  But on the day I went it was smoggy, so you couldn't see much, which probably explains why there were hardly any other people up there.  The glass floor made the visit at least somewhat fun, even on a bad weather day.

reviews.author: Vũ Thu Huyền
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.content: Even it's expensive but the view was very nice. I really love it. Will come back sometimes again with my family.

reviews.author: Daan_NL
reviews.title: Why does this place have a higher price for foreigners?
reviews.content: At a time of a pandemic, you would think that everyone who is a resident in Vietnam is treated the same. However their nationalistic policies with different prices are crazy during these times. Residency doesn't matter. Only if you are Vietnamese....

reviews.author: Natalija G
reviews.title: Expensive but not forgettable
reviews.content: Very interesting,a bit expensive but really great view from the top.Will recommend this place.Visit!

reviews.author: Herbert C
reviews.title: Mediocre elevating experience!
reviews.content: All cities must have one, and South Korean conglomerate Lotte has ensured that Hanoi gets its observation deck. The building itself is not particularly impressive, nor is the relatively mild height of 267m and entrance fees of VND230,000. But Lotte’s attempt to make up for these is by offering visitors an acrophobic experience and unique photo opportunity with 2 heart-dropping glass platforms 65 floors above street level. The night view is just mediocre and unlike other observation decks where night photos can be taken if you place your phone against the glass, this is disappointingly impossible here, possibly due to the thickness and angle of the glass.

reviews.author: Danielle Y
reviews.title: Just okay
reviews.content: 230000 vnd for adult. Not very worth it I think.... it’s just ok. You probably won’t even need 30 mins up there.  Theres a Lotte mart at the basement, can do some shopping.

reviews.author: Liron
reviews.title: Awesome Experience
reviews.content: Amazing way to see the full city of Hanoi!We unfortunately went when the weather was overcast so the views werent as good as they could be however the experience was still unbelievable!You do have to pay VD230 000 per person however I truly believe it is worth every cent! Theres also options to have professional photos done and printed at a reasonable VD100 000.My recommendation would be to go at later afternoon so you could watch the sunset and then have the opportunity to take pictures in both daylight and nightlight which is really great with the luminating hearts around the building.

reviews.author: Paul C
reviews.title: Great photo opportunities
reviews.content: Great way to see Hanoi. If you are keen you can walk out on to the glass platform and get your photo taken either by a friend or by the professional, which I recommend. It was not busy and the staff very friendly. A must do in Hanoi

reviews.author: Amy Jessica Cheong
reviews.title: Scenic Spot
reviews.content: Admission might be rather pricy, but certainly worth the view. Practically the tallest building around, allowing for far reaching views throughout Hanoi.

reviews.author: Ciara
reviews.title: Scary height
reviews.content: The view at night is beautiful. Somehow they made the heart shape there with strong light, keep distract your sight-seeing. There are different price between foreigner and local people.

reviews.author: Jacob Portner
reviews.title: Beautiful view on the highest point of Hanoi
reviews.content: The place is very beautiful at night. We love the sky view so much even though my partners was scared of height she gained the courage to come there after all. Also, this is a great place for a romantic proposal.

reviews.author: williamn179
reviews.title: Dizzy Hights
reviews.content: The view is a heart throbbing delight.  I love high glass ledge.The entire level has very romantic things to do.  Great for a sweetheart outing at night or kids in the day.

reviews.author: K W T
reviews.title: See the Whole of Hanoi from the Top
reviews.content: Although it was a bit cloudy, we could still see the whole of Hanoi from the Observation Deck. for VND230,000 per person, it is worth it. Very modern design with several coffee outlets, including the Lotteria Fast Food Outlet. There are also sofas for people to sit and appreciate the view. There are also many seats available from the several food outlets, allowing visitors to enjoy the beautiful scenery.  There are also 2 glass decks to take photographs but as usual i am afraid of heights, staying clear of that area!!! There is also an electronic art exhibition as well as some very cool souvenirs for sale.

reviews.author: Ev_kka
reviews.title: NIce during the evening
reviews.content: It is interesting there - as an opposite to the old center of the city. Many photocourts there. And two glass platforms, which is a bit scary to go on, as you cas see down to the ground.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Q
reviews.title: Wonderful Experience
reviews.content: You buy your ticket from the kiosk on the ground floor, accessible by escalator or lift. I was asked to go through an airport-type security test before entering the lift to the Observation Desk. The lift rises rapidly but the lights go out, so if your suffer from claustrophobia don't attempt this. The views from the deck are stunning and you can take as many photos as you wish; there is an area with a glass floor that you can stand on but don't attempt this if you suffer even slightly from vertigo. There are information points all around the deck. There are plenty of places selling food and drink and nice clean loos. The returning lift takes you to the Lotte Supermarket.

reviews.author: Denis Mark
reviews.title: Great view from the top!
reviews.content: Had a heart thumping experience at the sky walk but its worth it!The view was great from 65th floor!Went in the day and it was good as there is no crowd.Awesome experience!

reviews.author: Hanzen
reviews.title: Scary Beautiful
reviews.content: I admit that I have a little fear of heights especially when I can clearly see the height which I might fall into.  However, when I stepped unto the transparent floor of the 360 degrees observation deck on the 65th floor of the Lotte Center,  I was just amazed by the beauty of Hanoi especially at night.

reviews.author: Brenda B
reviews.title: Awesome View
reviews.content: The observation deck is worth a visit, if for nothing else, but the restaurant. The view is great and it's a very nice are of Ho Chi Minh City. The shopping center is also fun with a large restaurant area and an ice rink.

reviews.author: hander22
reviews.title: Dont go at night
reviews.content: The view is really not that great at night because some idiot decided to put a lot of lights in to the floor so you get reflections. Also alot ot annoying chinese people, and the windows are dirty.

reviews.author: Adam_Bang
reviews.title: Reasonable value for money if you have some time to kill in Hanoi
reviews.content: Good attraction to see the skyline (not impressive though) of Hanoi. Highly advisable to go at around 4:30 pm, you'll have a chance to see the city both during the day and during the night

reviews.author: Judit R
reviews.title: One of the must-ones in Hanoi
reviews.content: The observation tower was clean and air-conditioned which was amazing in the hot weather. There were friendly and helpful staff and the tower itself was themed beautifully. The decorations were coordinated really well to maximise photo opportunities. Also, the interactive photo displays  gave a great brief history of the historical places visible on the sky line. Perfect spot.

reviews.author: Johan H
reviews.title: I must do when u visiting Hanoi
reviews.content: The building are incredible and contains everything u can imagine. I will especially recommend a visit to the observation-deck located at 65 floor with a 360^ view over Hanoi. Totally worth a visit 👌🏼

reviews.author: Deepak DB
reviews.title: Sky (walk) High
reviews.content: Located on the 65th floor of Lotte Centre offeres panoramic view of Hanoi. Added to the attraction is the Glass floor sky deck which could be a nightmare for those with fear of heights.This attraction requires you to buy tickets online or at their basement tickets counter. There are offers during specific time of the day and or also for certain age groups. Not sure if it applies to locals or all. Since we landed there at a very short notice we couldn't opt for any. Add to this it was very cloudy evening hence we missed on getting better views but we were happy to see the cloud rush.One can take a picture with professional cameras which are printed and presented in paper frames. There is a 10% odd discount coupon which comes with the entry ticket.Also available there is a bar and restaurant in case you would like to spend more time enjoying the view.The deck is very popular with all hence plan you visit well to avoid crowds which is likely in evenings and weekend.Must Visit!!Please Note: One needs to take off the foot wear when stepping on the sky deck. Socks, stockings, etc are allowed

reviews.author: murielcsmith
reviews.title: Looking down on Hanoi
reviews.content: The tower was recommended to us and we were not disappointed, We bought tickets on the day which were quite cheap and zoomed up to the 65th floor in the lift. It was a quiet day so plenty of time to take advantage of the very clear 360 degree views. We took a few photos ourselves but there was a photographer there taking photos if required. We were lucky in that it was a clear bright day and the views were quite spectacular. Overall, good value for money but don't expect to spend too long in there.

reviews.author: k2711
reviews.title: Glass floor
reviews.content: Amazing 360 view of hanoi, 2 different glass floor observation decks, well worth a visit, cheaper prices for an hour in morning or night too.

reviews.author: Indonesian-Jetset
reviews.title: See Hanoi from the sky
reviews.content: Very nice place to visit on the 65 th floor of Lotte Hotel.Do not for get to go to Top Of Hanoi for some nice roof top drink.

reviews.author: Michelle B
reviews.title: Worth the ride up
reviews.content: We bought one of the package ticket deals offered for admission plus beer, pizza and chicken karage, and were happy with that decision. The pizza was good, the karage was delicious, and the beer was fantastic to enjoy with the corner view in the Observation Deck's bar and lounge. They had great photo opportunities all the way around the deck, and fun, interactive experiences. The Lotteria there is a much nicer one than the one in the basement - which I wish I had known earlier. There's also a lovely little ice cream stand that offers uniquely Vietnamese flavors. The Observation Deck is a great to place to go for a whole new perspective on Hanoi. Just prepare yourself to do a lot of waiting for other tourists to give you a chance to take advantage of the photo ops - not all of them were terribly conscious of other people waiting their turn.

reviews.author: souLondon_england
reviews.title: A 360 degree view of the whole city.
reviews.content: A fantastic place to visit for all. Have your photograph professionally taken standing on the glass floor overlooking the city. We stayed up there until it got dark and the lights all came on. You have full 360 degree views of every part of the city by walking around the 64th floor of this 272 M high building. We caught a taxi there but be careful not to be ripped off and agree the fare 1st. Or get your hotel to book a “ grab” taxi. Only cost us 61,000 d one way from the Old Quarter.

reviews.author: Amy Lopez
reviews.title: A good spot to stand
reviews.content: Although I am not a fan of its price tag, I am happy that I tried. It is not scary to be here as it is sturdy enough with no incidents I suppose. Hanoi isn't small but I does look small and lovelier from this point of view.

reviews.author: Jochips
reviews.title: Great views - well worth the entrance fee!
reviews.content: Fantastic views of the whole city - we went about 4pm and it was beautiful and pretty quiet. Glass floors for you to stand on for some awesome photos - and the heart in the glass wall shown in all the promotional material.

reviews.author: Faith Thong
reviews.title: Quick view of Hanoi City from 272m high
reviews.content: Well this is slightly a bit more expensive but if you wish to see the entire city of Hanoi from above you can come here . You can purchase the ticket on B1 floor and there a lift than bring you up to 65th floor of this building . Inside there some cafe or lounge where you can buy drink and chill while overlooking the city of Hanoi

reviews.author: grimsbygirlusa
reviews.title: birds eye view
reviews.content: Great place to visit to see over the city old and new.A little difficult to find . Go to floor B1 to buy the tickets to go up to the top.  Amazing views. Some insta. Photo ops.

reviews.author: Laura B
reviews.title: Great View of Hanoi
reviews.content: We went aaround 5pm to get a glimpse of the sunset.  Not crowded and easy to find. Great view of Hanoi from 65 floors up.Is a bit out of the way from central tourist spots. A cab takes 20mins from St Josephs.

reviews.author: marwammh
reviews.title: Hanoi from the Top
reviews.content: We went to Lotte Observation Deck, and we enjoyed the view of Hanoi from the top.You can spend around 2 - 3 hours, and they have Lotte burger, some other cafes.

reviews.author: Peter H
reviews.title: a must visit
reviews.content: We had heard about this place so got a taxi to here...great view of Hanoi...get your photo taken on the glass floor by a professional photographer...scary if you don't like hights.

reviews.author: Adrian Lee
reviews.title: Mr. Adrian Lee
reviews.content: Grateful & Thankful To have the opportunity to experience the Lotte Observation Deck in Hanoi. Situated on the 65th floor, 253 meter, 830ft high. Amazed and mesmerized by the design and architecture of the tower deck with its 3D design lift that brought us up there. At the 65th floor were able to view the whole beautiful city of Hanoi and its nature. Love the place and the ambience of Fine Dine restaurant and cafes over at this floor ☺️

reviews.author: andrewlofnes
reviews.title: Fun Activity for an hour
reviews.content: Great views from the top and a decent way to spend some time in Hanoi which has very few activities otherwise. Don’t bother with the shopping centre unless you’ve got a fair bit of cash to spend.

reviews.author: _vco_mcivor
reviews.title: Superb view and service
reviews.content: Go to the top of the hotel (roof lounge) and save the cost of the observation deck.  You will find yourself on the roof with stunning views (great at night) and a bar that serves good food and drinks, if pricey by Ha Noi standards.  Would be among my top 5 of things to in Ha Noi, along with Water Puppet Theatre, three museums and wandering and eating in the old quarter.

reviews.author: Lucia.xiii
reviews.title: the whole view of hanoi
reviews.content: I mean you should go there, definitely by night to see the nightlife of hanoi through the see through glass here but the entrance ticket is not that affordable.

reviews.author: Silvia U
reviews.title: Great City Perspective
reviews.content: You can really get a sense of the city from the observation deck. It is bigger and more spread out than I thought.

reviews.author: Tiffany
reviews.title: Best views of Hanoi!!
reviews.content: This is something that anyone visiting Hanoi must absolutely do. Whilst quite pricey, it is a once in a lifetime experience and really enjoyable. My boyfriend and I only found out about this 2 days before we were leaving, but we found a way to slot it into our itinerary and we are so glad we did.We got to go up 65 storeys into the sky. Whilst we went on a gloomy and cloudy day, the views were still magnificent. I can just imagine what they’re like when it is sunny. Go and observe the whole of Hanoi. Something one should not miss!

reviews.author: Eduardo B
reviews.title: As usual Lotte has an excellent Observation Deck
reviews.content: Everything when I've visit a city want to see it from skyes,  I've found about Lotte deck this time in Hanoi Vietnam... before I went to Observation Deck in Seoul.My family and myself really love it , you can see Hanoi from different angles and take several pictures inside the glass observatories. Everything pas perfect and the staff was very friendly.I went early morning but definitely at night would be nice to see Hanoi.Keep in mind weather might affect visibility so arrange your visit accordingly.I was staying in the old quarter so it took us less than 25 min to get there by taxi

reviews.author: Lyndsey J
reviews.title: Amazing views of the city and not expensive
reviews.content: Was very quiet in the tower but that meant it was peaceful. Great views of the city and a reasonably priced beer at the top.

reviews.author: SherbetMelbourne
reviews.title: Worth a visit
reviews.content: We weren't planning on doing this but decided to do so on  our last day. This is well designed, set out and organised as far as observation decks go. We had fun and had our photo taken. It wasn't busy, we enjoyed the view and the perspective of the city even though the fog / mist / made it hard to see too far off into the distance. There is a great space to sit and enjoy a drink or two. Worth the money.

reviews.author: Rallyman23
reviews.title: A great experience
reviews.content: You'll get the best view of Hanoi from here (if it's not too hazy) and you'll also have the fun of testing your nerve standing on the glass panel!Compared to most attractions it's a bit of a one-trick pony and it's a bit off the beaten track so you may want to get a cab out to it. If you do then take my advice and use Grab (Asia's answer to Uber) instead of a metered taxi as it could be up to 10x cheaper - you have no idea what speed they've set their meters too!

reviews.author: Sigalit B
reviews.title: the best view point in Hanoi
reviews.content: a must see during a visit in Hanoi. give good view of all the city. next to fancy shopping mall and great supermarket

reviews.author: Bsmip82
reviews.title: Great view
reviews.content: Great view at night but the fair quite expensive compare with other places here. Better should go the roof top bar at lotte.

reviews.author: Steve H
reviews.title: Lotte Deck
reviews.content: Great day, we visited on a clear day during the day, with our son who is teaching in Hanoi.  Great view of the city, at relatively modest cost, about £10 per adult I think. Interesting to get an over view of the city and the mono rail under construction.  Did the glass floor ( gulp), worth doing.  There are 2 glass floors and on a Sunday when we visited, not much of a queue, maybe 5-10 people hovering and they cleared off when they saw us approach.

reviews.author: Linhchesky N
reviews.title: Great view of Hanoi
reviews.content: Lotte Observation Deck allows you to see different corners of Hanoi without the crowd. The sky walk platform was definitely not for the faint-hearted though but do try it if you are not scared of height.

reviews.author: Andi H
reviews.title: good view of Vietnam without the crowd
reviews.content: This place gave us literally a bird's eye view of Vietnam.  It was nice to see the place from this vantage point.  It was a different experience from being right in the middle of everything going on.  I was too scared to stand on them, but the kids loved the glass floor observation platforms!  There were hardly any people up there with us, so it was a good change from the crowded experience you usually get when you go around Vietnam.

reviews.author: Jennifer Y
reviews.title: Just like other observation decks
reviews.content: I’ve been to Saigon observation deck and I thought that was better. Maybe it’s because of the weather. It was foggy when I visited Lotte observation deck so view wasn’t good. I went to McDonald in this deck and ordered chicken nuggets. They were all burnt. I liked the heart and angel theme areas. They were great to take pictures.

reviews.author: woodlucy68
reviews.title: Love it
reviews.content: I and my friend went there last week. Love this space. Nice view and great place to take photos. Will be back again.

reviews.author: John E
reviews.title: Great Views
reviews.content: This is a 5 start hotel and shopping mall which also has "The Top of Hanoi" on Level 65 with a bar and restaurant. Good place to go for a drink or meal.

reviews.author: Girlwholovestotravel
reviews.title: Amazing view point
reviews.content: This view point was absolutely amazing! I think it's the highest view point I've ever been on. It had 65 floors and a lot of areas to take photos with flashing lights, such as the flashing heart or the wings on the walls, as in California. Loved this view point. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Sid Rose
reviews.title: Fabulous view of Hanoi
reviews.content: This is great if you want to get an aerial overview of Hanoi without taking a helicopter. There is also a great rooftop bar in the Lotte Tower.

reviews.author: Stefan O
reviews.title: Great Views!!
reviews.content: Lotte Observation Deck gives you a Superior look across Hanoi and its surroundings! A Must See while in Hanoi!!

reviews.author: youbloodytourist
reviews.title: Visit as the sun sets!
reviews.content: If you want to get the most of your money, visit as the sun goes down. This means you'll be able to get some good photos of the city beforehand and see Hanoi all lit up. at night.

reviews.author: OFB17
reviews.title: Great views but not for us
reviews.content: I wanted to see the Lotte Center and its Observation Deck to get a feel for the "new Hanoi" outside the Old Quarter. The building is a very contemporary high-rise and the department store an upscale one that could be anywhere in the world, but one that surely only very, very few locals can afford. The Observation Deck comes with a corresponding price tag of 230k VND ($10) per person, which really is too much for what it is. The views from the 65th floor could probably be great but we only experienced them on a rather normal and typically hazy day. Outside the two small skywalk platforms there is little else to do than walking around completely and maybe having an overpriced coffee. I would not do it again and recommend the 20th floor of the Pan Pacific Hanoi instead, where 230k VND will buy you a good four beers and you get great views for free...

reviews.author: Maxi F
reviews.title: Top rooftop bar
reviews.content: Very nice stuff working there ( minh, tdan, hoa & chi) the prices are ok for a sky bar and its not to crowded. Be careful it can be cold in the Winter.

reviews.author: TheButcherBunch
reviews.title: The View
reviews.content: Something about being able to see for miles. You feel nothing in the elevator going up, just maybe your ears popping. There are no windows so you don't even no your moving except for the numbers flying past on the screen. Once up top you are able to take lots of photos some of which can be on the two see through floors looking down. Have a coffee and take in the view. Lots of information in English to let you know where your looking.

reviews.author: Danny Bui
reviews.title: Not worth experiencing
reviews.content: I got some high expectations when visiting because of the skywalk. The price is fairly okay but the experience is not worth it at all. Walking pass the security point the staff was sitting there and doing nothing. We had to wait and ride the elevator to floor 65 by ourselves. We have to share the elevator with this Korean family and as I wondered around to take photos. The Korean family closes the elevator door quickly so they could have a ride up to the observation deck alone. As they closes the door my brother was stepping in while the door was closing and hit his head hard on the elevator door. There was no single apology from the korean family and the staff doesn’t bother to care. I was really pissed at the family and we had a very awkward ride up to the top. As soon as we got up, I got very disappointed. Staff were just sitting around while tourist were bustling on the skywalk. The limit was only for 10 peoples to be on it at once but I saw about 15-20 people stepping and walking around it. The gift shop didn’t really have anything special to offer, just some simple stuff you could easily get from a nearby market. We got our photos taken and quickly head back down. We only spent 15-20 minutes. Disappointing experience, I would never recommend going here. I’d rather go to their restaurant on the 63rd floor and have a dinner or visit Top of Hanoi (65th floor) to have a drink.

reviews.author: Thuận N
reviews.title: Such a lovely place
reviews.content: I came there several times.One time with my family, my son was very exciting to go and play around. One time I came with my friend in a bar in the evening, so wonderful, delicious food and really nice view. The other time, I came there alone for refresh myself with a cup of drink from Angel in Us in a corner of OD to see a nice Hanoi. It is really a must destination that everyone should go in Hanoi.

reviews.author: ngocph2610
reviews.title: Chill?
reviews.content: Too much chill I melted away!A little Jazz, a little cocktail and a bit of view from the Observation deck, the whole combination kept me warm on a cold night. I love how peaceful Hanoi looks from up here!

reviews.author: Trangthu
reviews.title: Stunning place to visit
reviews.content: I have been here twice with my family. And each time coming, it's like a whole new experience. The view is absolutely perfect and sky walking is a must!!! It's really amazing but not for those who are afraid of heights!!!! ^^

reviews.author: Hako
reviews.title: Delightful place to visit
reviews.content: I haven’t been here so I was really excited to see Hanoi in such high tower. My first time here in Vietnam and I think this is the best place to visit. Very romantic and the sightseeing was mind blowing  and amazing. Romantic place for couple also.

reviews.author: briann
reviews.title: Amazing!!!
reviews.content: Suitable for those who like to see the city from a height. Very clean and the staff was wonderful. I was impressed with friendly and helpful staff. The prices were very reasonable. Time seemed to stop when I was there. Worth visiting if you're in Hanoi. I recommend this place.

reviews.author: Trachala N
reviews.title: Lotte Observation Desk Hanoi, the high advatage poin in the city!
reviews.content: I went with my friends in few months ago, amazing views across HA Noi and there is have a nice bar for chill out, we stayed for sunset and got some absolutely great pictures, there are hours afterWe definitely recommend to visit here.

reviews.author: Phạm Minh Khuê
reviews.title: Best view in Hanoi
reviews.content: A very inexpensive way to get excellent view of all directions of Hanoi.Many places to sit and relax and enjoy the gorgeous view. Must try coconut coffee at Raku Raku coffee shop.

reviews.author: pinkachoo10
reviews.title: Great Views and Cool Skywalks
reviews.content: Had a free day in Hanoi so we decided to check this place out.  Took a taxi from the old quarter which was maybe 15 minutes drive.  The fee to get in was a little expensive considering but it was worth it because we got to see the great views, get out of the rain, and the place was not crowded so it was nice.  We also got to eat some Japanese food at the shopping mall and do a little shopping.  Really good bakeries.

reviews.author: Nguyễn H
reviews.title: Best view in Hanoi
reviews.content: Best view in Hanoi. Its suitable for dating.You can take pictures with two skywalk in OD. Nice view

reviews.author: T_Senaratne
reviews.title: Bird's eye view of Hanoi city
reviews.content: Located in the Lotte Centre which is just a few meters away from the Hanoi Daewoo Hotel.  Unimaginable view of the city from the 65th floor.  Great feeling of walking on air when standing on the glass floor and seeing the vehicles passing beneath your feet.  Better to grab the "happy hour entry" (morning and evening 10pm to 11 pm) when the prices are slashed by 50%.

reviews.author: Tops333
reviews.title: Amazing views
reviews.content: Amazing views food and service , you get a great view of the city served by amazing staff who look after all your needs

reviews.author: Heguang Z
reviews.title: Glass Floor
reviews.content: Not on my must do list but if you have a few hours to spend you could go to the Lotte Center in Hanoi. Observation Deck in on the 65th floor and there are two glass floor decks you can walk on. It was scary at the beginning but you get used to it after a little while. The fee is expensive but if you go early in the morning there is 50% discount. There is a coffee shop and a Lotteria fast food outlet on the same deck.

reviews.author: AlvinSG
reviews.title: Good place to view Hanoi
reviews.content: At 65th storey 272m, beautiful scenery.Advise to go late afternoon for sunset view.Love the thrill of standing on the transparent floor deck at great height.Wt lower floor, have food street and great shopping of many big brands you can name it.Spent 4hrs including my lunch there.Good place to visit for meals n shopping and good view of Hanoi city.

reviews.author: JSTrip_77
reviews.title: Pretty Much Always Hazy - But Still Cool
reviews.content: OK, so this is a really cool option for sightseeing in Hanoi. It is relatively expensive considering the rest of the sights in Hanoi. And yes, there's a pretty obvious price difference for Vietnamese citizens and foreigners. But, that's OK. The real issue is that the views are always hazy because of all of the pollution. But, on the flip side, because the observation deck is so expensive, relatively speaking, there really are no crowds. So, that's nice. And, it's easy to get some good time on the two incredible glass floor outcroppings. Just please, take off your shoes. The signs are obvious but people don't always pay attention.

reviews.author: Dean W
reviews.title: Cloudy views
reviews.content: I did quick trip to the Lotte centre. The price is 230 k. Expensive for what you get. The good part was there was very few tourists  and you can look out  with no rush. The bad part is the views is blocked from smog

reviews.author: Natalia N
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.content: You can go up on the 65th floor/272meters by a speed elevator. The ticket was approx 10usd, the accept credit cards and dongs. The have 50% on early morning and after 22hrs. We went there at 16hrs to see Hanoi both during the daylight and after the sunset. You can take great pictures standing on a glass floor!

reviews.author: Student Q
reviews.title: The Lotte Observation Deck
reviews.content: The Observation Deck has a great view but there is to much smog to see through. Right bellow it is a shopping mall so you could buy things before going up the Observation Deck

reviews.author: madamshalet
reviews.title: Escape from the heat
reviews.content: I imagine this would give some amazing views of an ever growing city, however the day we went up it was really cloudy so we could really see too much.  I think that on a sunny day the views would be amazing

reviews.author: Omzas
reviews.title: Go during the non-peak hours
reviews.content: We've checked and there were 2 non-peak hours (8.30-10.30 and 22.00 to 23.00) where visitors get a 50% discount off its VND230,000 per pax price. Suddenly, it become so much more value for money and you may get to avoid the crowd. Thus, go in the morning for the day view of the entire hanoi city and go in the night for the sunset/night skyline of the city. Worth a try when you got a sufficient dose of museums and monuments in hanoi.

reviews.author: Minh Thuy T
reviews.title: A new adventure in Hanoi
reviews.content: When we first have this in Hanoi, I was so excited to come. The first time ever I could see Hanoi so close and clear. Maybe people in other countries have had this experience for long but for us, Vietnamese, it's new and a must try one.

reviews.author: b0rn2sh0p
reviews.title: Better than I expected
reviews.content: I went there 8:30am and get 50% off. It was nice I got the iview all by myself. I bought some drinks in Lotte mart before I enter the observatory so I don’t have to buy experience drinks there. There are plenty of chairs and photo spots. It was nice place to visit.

reviews.author: Sudesh
reviews.title: Bit costly though
reviews.content: If you are foreigner, you will be charged 230K VND if Vieatnamis 180K VND (elder person), Less people Make sure to go not raining time Any way good experience

reviews.author: Gillsholidays
reviews.title: Worth the visit great views
reviews.content: Spent nearly 2hours up here which was not only a relief from the heat but it was also a great place get your bearings of this awesome city

reviews.author: Maddy F
reviews.title: Overcoming Fear with a View
reviews.content: 2 reasons we came here - the view & the Skywalk. Cannot believe the lack of visitors for the amazing view of Hanoi, which proved to be more than just Hoan Kiem Lake & the Old Quarter.  360degree view, just sit down, have a coffee & watch Hanoi unfold below you. For the added bonus 2 Skywalks - free. This was one of my fears & am happy to report I walked out on both a couple of times. I would highly recommend it & one of those rarities where you get 2 experiences for the price of one.

reviews.author: OseEmma
reviews.title: Nice spot to get an amazing view of Hanoi!
reviews.content: This was an exciting experience and I was able to take great pictures and enjoy the view. Note that entry is not free.

reviews.author: Ivanof_Bcn
reviews.title: Not that great as expected
reviews.content: I was expecting something better. The two  parts with glass floor are not very big. Plus in one of them they have like a photo stage with a heart so it's often occupied with people making the oficial heart  picture and the other ones can't be at that part. I think this photo thing very "touristy". I'm not sure if it's worth the price you pay (more than 8 euros) but still you have nice views of the city.

reviews.author: Ilga U
reviews.title: Glass floor
reviews.content: Breathtaking views of Hanoi! Peacefull, not crowded place.Glass floor not for faint hearted! A must visit

reviews.author: BrisbaneTraveler2009
reviews.title: Amazing views of Hanoi
reviews.content: Awesome view of Hanoi city. Clear glass viewing decks for good pictures. Well worth it. Good aircon.

reviews.author: zoe1606
reviews.title: Don’t look down
reviews.content: By Western prices entry is quite cheap at 230k dong. The deck is located on the 65th floor with lift access from the basement of the shopping centre next to the supermarket. 360 degree views but not much information to say what you are looking at. There are two glass decks for the brave to walk out on to with a professional photo available at one - prices started at 90k for a photo in a presentation wallet. There are several drink / snack places on the floor.

reviews.author: Judith S
reviews.title: WOW
reviews.content: As soon as you exit the lift it is WOW. What a fantastic view. A great place to sit and have a meal and relax. This is a must see when in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Vivek Chauhan
reviews.title: Unique Experience
reviews.content: Now this is a luxury mall with many local luxury brands and some international brands. One needs to visit the SkyDeck on 65th floor which has a complete view of Hanoi. It has a sky deck for interesting pics as well. Be here to spend an hour or two. It has some interesting picture taking worth spots with screens etc. Don’t have anything to eat/ drink up there, it’s not good and is expensive.

reviews.author: edwardcyau
reviews.title: Great views and cafe on the 65th floor
reviews.content: Great day trip to see the skyline of Hanoi West Lake and also enjoy some retail therapy. The entrance is outside the mall on the lower ground floor. Lots of Instagramable photos from above but go on a clear day or after rain so the smoggy atmosphere settles for a better view. Waffle at the cafe was kinda delicious 🤤

reviews.author: Kurtis H
reviews.title: A great experience
reviews.content: A very good way to spend half an hour, and also very convenient since it’s on top of a shopping centre. Amazing 360 degree view around Hanoi. Can see everything. The glass floor is also a fun challenge if you are up to it. Much better than the sky deck in Ho Chi Minh

reviews.author: rchlwllms
reviews.title: A must see view of Hanoi.
reviews.content: The Lotte building itself is very nice and modern, we went to the supermarket and the food court before going to the observation deck. You get an amazing 360 view of Hanoi! There are many photo opportunities with ‘love’ theme set ups. If you’re brave enough, there’s a glass floor interior deck that you can walk out on and look down and over the city. A great sight of West Lake as a love heart which is cute.

reviews.author: John M
reviews.title: Good view of the city, weather permitting
reviews.content: A very impressive building in any country, this is the best view of the city, weather permitting, although our night time photos were not any good. Korean owned, the boss of the company was in the news for money fraud, but no word of that in Vietnamese news!

reviews.author: chae84
reviews.title: Good view of city
reviews.content: I guess here is the only place where you can view the city from the top. View at night is more stunning compare in the evening/morning. We spent couples of hours until 8 where the light of the city is clearly bright. price of the ticket a bit expensive but the photo and experience is more than that.

reviews.author: ArujChoudhary
reviews.title: gratified
reviews.content: Do get snapped by the camera on top those pics will be better anyways. Wow what a view , i grabbed a beer and sat for an hor there... u should also go for sure.

reviews.author: kimbeanz
reviews.title: Lotte Observation Deck
reviews.content: If you want a great view of Hanoi, this is the place!! Although it was slightly far from the Old Quarters which is where most tourists would be at, it was not bad a trip! This place would be good for seeing the sunset- hopefully it wouldn't be too cloudy during your visit. However, the price to go up is rather steep. But then again, the place is great for taking photos so it's up to you! The observation deck is good for couples to spend a little quality time together and taking photos together.

reviews.author: joel s
reviews.title: Heaven!!
reviews.content: Amazing view from the top!! Worth visiting if you are in Hanoi.Prefer day visit, as pics r nice and also do try burger Ar Lotte foodstall at top (reasonable price)

reviews.author: Oleksandr T
reviews.title: Great view
reviews.content: Absolutely amazing view from the top of Hanoi!Must visit!Could see all Hanoi like on your hand:)It costs a bit of money(around 10$), but it definitely worth it!

reviews.author: Melbguy3805
reviews.title: Worth a visit
reviews.content: Went at night and the views of the city are great and was only 230k dong. Well worth a visit.Only downside was when trying to take a picture, the reflection of the windows was constant which was a little annoying.

reviews.author: jlizaso
reviews.title: Awesome view
reviews.content: I was with my wife and we learned about the observation deck in the Lotte Center Mall so we went and checked it out.Though it is not the Burgh Al Khalifa in UAE, but the place provides a very nice overlooking view of Hanoi, I think the entrance fee is a bit pricey, never the less it was a good experience. You get a 360 view as you go around the deck and they have the scopes to zoom in to specific area of interest. There were to section with glass floors and it felt a bit scary at first and you have to take of your shoes to walk the area.It was a nice feeling after you get used to it but my wife have shaky knees that she only stayed up to the edge of the glass floor and went back. Took some good photos and we spent a bit more time until I could get a blue hour photo of the scenic view.I can recommend the place for other tourists.

reviews.author: boonchai t
reviews.title: Staff very helpfull and good service also good view
reviews.content: My phone has been lost in Taxi that i use to came to Lotte Tower i know my phone is already lost after i arrive 65 floor, im tried to contact my phone because im open Roaming but unfortunate the driver unable to speak English that why the staff name “Tran Thi Quynh Huong” come and help me to be translator untill finally i get my phone back with a lot of important information data in there, she doesn’t recive my prize that make me more impress to her, and all staff there is very helpfull too by the way view up there is very super cool i can ensure you can get a great picture if you go there 65 floor.

reviews.author: leelanc2018
reviews.title: Beautiful stunning view of Hanoi.
reviews.content: Wow! What a beautiful stunning view of Hanoi. One of the main attractions to see whole Hanoi is at the Lotte Observation Deck.

reviews.author: bonvojaage
reviews.title: Dizzying view, but bit expensive tickets
reviews.content: A great place the see the whole Hanoi in a glance. Walking on the glassfloor in the 65th floor is a nice photo and selfie opportunity. We found it but difficult to find the elevator up, since it's not in the street level of Lotte Center, but in the bottom floor (...entrance is marked clearly outside the building, but not when you are inside the department store) Tickets at 230.000 VDN (about 8 Euros) felt expensive compared to the general price level in Hanoi

reviews.author: Matlock1lady
reviews.title: Amazing views
reviews.content: We went at about 9 am and had the place virtually to ourselves. A ticket purchased on the ground floor and the a lift up. They have glass floor walkouts and it took us a white to step out. We took our pictures but they insist that you have one taken ‘ free’ , but of course if you want a copy you pay. We didn’t bother as our photos were good.No time limit up there and you can get coffe and a meal if you want. I bet we stayed a couple of hours. This was one of Hanoi highlights.I found it online and we just grabbed a taxi from our hotel to get there.

reviews.author: Olli J.
reviews.title: Very impressive view
reviews.content: If you are looking for an unforgatable view through Hanoi you have to visit the Lotte tower observation deck. You can find there a bar and coffee as well but to be honest, if you’re there do the skywalk - just for those who are NOT afraid of heights :) ... highly recommended

reviews.author: Chibikiu
reviews.title: Good place to see Hanoi from above
reviews.content: Definitely best place to see Hanoi from above, and you can try the Sky Walk. You can get some fun facts about Hanoi which is good. However, It is more expensive for foreigner than local. And there is only some cafe here cause I expected there will be some cocktail or wine.

reviews.author: Cherrychan0214
reviews.title: First time to experience walking on glass on the 65th floor
reviews.content: if you are afraid of height, i would suggest you better not go. it is the first time i experienced to walk on the glass, clear crystal glass, on the 65th floor. it can be quite scary.pity that it was too foggy when we visited, so we did not really see the view clearly. otherwise it would be a very good experience.some of the equipments there are not working. e.g. there is a scanner that you can scan your ticket and leave your comments there plus taking your photo. but it just doens't work.there are some souvenir shops also, which is expected.afterall, it is a good place. i am also the kind of person who love going to observation deck. seems it is the only one in hanoi. don't think there are other buildings that is as tall. you can also visit the lotte mart at the basement to do some shopping, not to say the lotte department.highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Widlydidly
reviews.title: Great night time view of Hanoi
reviews.content: We enjoyed the whole experience, went up in the evening, more romantic. The sky was clear and dark. The roads below glistened with the legendary Hanoi traffic. We did the glass box, amazing. The whole cost was cheap by UK standards. My only problem was not getting to the rooftop. Signage was very poor and the staff understandably had little English, not thier fault. I would reccommend this to visitors to Hanoi.

reviews.author: Jas L
reviews.title: Fun & thrilling experience
reviews.content: The view was not clear that day due to the weather but that didn't dampen our mood. We had so much fun & spent so much time just on the glass skydeck itself; walking & lying around, taking pictures from various angles, watching people trying to overcome their fear of heights by hanging onto the wall & taking one small step at a time.We also like the interactive activity where you can enter a message into the computer and it would appear on the big screen. We would then try to squeeze in to take a picture with our personalised message behind us. Overall, pleasantly surprised that we managed to spend so many hours at this place. Not cheap as compared to other attractions but worthwhile to visit & would recommend.

reviews.author: AdinaHagege
reviews.title: Cool Feeling On Top of the World
reviews.content: Really nice views of Hanoi, cool glass-decked floor. But not a whole lot to DO--1/2 hour of fun and coolness was a bit pricey.

reviews.author: Jo D
reviews.title: Lotte Observation - excellent place to view lakes and areas of Hanoi. Glass skydeck too.
reviews.content: Entrance fee about £7 per person. Well worth it. We spent over an hour up on the deck; the place was very quiet - maybe only 5 other people up there with us. Great views out across the whole city, bar, coffee, gifts, photo opportunities all around as you'd expect.Two glass skydecks - one that comes with an official photographer which we didn't 'play on'.  Scary but great to do...About 65 floors up if I remember.  Recommended. Would need a taxi trip out though from Old Quarter. We walked - we should have taken a cab.

reviews.author: Yas
reviews.title: Great view!
reviews.content: I went to Observation deck at around 4pm and stayed till 6.30. I am glad I chose to go  during day time as after sunset the city is not that lightened .. all you can see are the lights coming from some towers and the car lights. So it doesn’t offer a great view in the evening, although the atmosphere is still magical anyhow.i recommend the place! It is expensive compared to the entrance fees of other sights in Hanoi, but it is still affordable (10 USD). You can have drinks and snacks up there also.

reviews.author: Sungho B
reviews.title: Amazing view and experience
reviews.content: Recommended. Sky walk and love heart zone. beautiful view from 272m on sky. Sky walk experience was amazing..

reviews.author: DaisyEdwards222
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.content: A place to go when coming to Vietnam, I find the space here is very pleasant, very comfortable, watching Hanoi on high is great.

reviews.author: Daoni Nguyen
reviews.title: Awesome place
reviews.content: A place to see Hanoi in its globality, to learn about Hanoi, to see the contrast of its architecture. Treat yourself for some cool pictures!

reviews.author: stoops99
reviews.title: Spectacular views
reviews.content: Our daughter, who lives in Hanoi recommended a visit to the tower. We started off in the department store on the ground floor. They had 3 aisles of coffee!We caught a lift, then had to transfer to another lift to get to the rooftop on the 67th floor. We were on the roof just before sunset, and after some misty rain the sky cleared so we had spectacular views of the sunset and then the night lights of Hanoi while enjoying cocktails from the bar.We had a great evening and we were surprised at how large Hanoi actually is when viewed from above.Entry to the rooftop is free, unlike the observation deck, and the drinks from the rooftop bar were quite reasonably priced, so buying a few cocktails seemed like a better investment than the observation deck!

reviews.author: Viet Vo
reviews.title: Beautiful Hanoi
reviews.content: My first time at Lotte Observation Deck and it was amazing. Decided to go up there after shopping at Lotte. But the cashier advised us to wait for 10 more minutes as the price goes down during night time and it was already dark anyways. Hard to see the whole city at night but it was still sparkling. My girlfriend and I were surely having fun exploring the sky walk, both excited and shaking at the same time. Would recommend this place to everyone.

reviews.author: Coryy20
reviews.title: Thrilling
reviews.content: Wow went up to the to tower around 5pm so I could have seen day and night effects. I so was not disappointed. Wow the day was clear and u got to see Hanoi beautiful buildings from up high both day and night viewHowever the moist thrilling part of my visit was to walk on the glass...thats if you are brave enough..this was such a rush to walk out on the glass and see cars so  very small down below on the streets... really did enjoy this tower.. it reminded me a lot of one in Hong kong.. but this was more fun because of that piece of glass thst goes out of the building.Definitely a must do.

reviews.title: Wow!
reviews.content: Great! 230,000 vnd about £8 so cheap for the the awesome views! Glass floor on 2 sides was amazing! Not as good as the viewing platform in Ho Chi Minh in my opinion but well worth a visit! Little bit out of the way, so take a taxi!

reviews.author: mattnajd
reviews.title: Nice, Kinda Expensive for What It Is
reviews.content: Three of us went to the observatory today. It was nice. The glass floor was a cool experience and made for fun pictures. But 230,000 vnd is expensive to ride an elevator. Especially considering the cost of most other things in Vietnam. It was nice to see the city from this vantage point. But hard to relax and enjoy with the hot temperature inside the building and the kids running laps and yelling for 45 minutes straight.

reviews.author: Benjamin B
reviews.title: Rooftop
reviews.content: Great location for having a great view over Hanoi. There you get the feeling, that Hanoi is not just the Old Quarter, but much more! If you want to enjoy drinks or food, the restaurant on top is all right. The prices are a bit to high for the quality of the food, but you pay for the great feeling of an open air restaurant. If you want to experience the glass balcony, you need to buy the tickets, which is absolutely recommendable, if you have never done this before.

reviews.author: Traveller 912
reviews.title: A must when in Hanoi
reviews.content: A definite must when in Hanoi. Cheap entry. Amazing views! The clear glass viewing deck was scary as hell but so much fun!

reviews.author: misshazeyeyed
reviews.title: Must-do in Hanoi
reviews.content: When in Hanoi, visiting the Lotte Tower is an absolute must. It's a short drive from the Old Quarter (where most tourists stay) and for someone unaccustomed to Vietnam see public transport, such as myself, get yourself a driver. The Lotte Observation Deck sits over sixty floors above Hanoi and boasts breathtaking panoramic views. It's open day and night. We went at night and thoroughly recommend it. For a modest entrance fee, the observation deck offers interactive experiences for people young and old. The highlight for me was the glass skywalk, where you take your shoes off and walk right out into the night sky- not for anyone with vertigo! The Lotte tower also offers a range of eating options, so I recommend making an evening out of the experience. At the skydeck there's a fast food eatery or two, but if you delve a little deeper, you'll find award winning restaurants and bars within the Lotte tower- we went to Top Of Hanoi and had an excellent meal with stunning views.

reviews.author: NL_DINKS
reviews.title: Best 360' view over Hanoi in rooftop bat
reviews.content: Went with group of friendsYou really have full view over whole cityThe seats and lounge sets are very relaxed and modernPrice of drinks is as expected high for Vietnam standards, but worthwhile to see lights of the city, bridges, lakes etc

reviews.author: Traveling is a blessing
reviews.title: Beautiful night view
reviews.content: Went there around 625pm.The counter staff was friendly and help us to save money by telling us that the price will be half by 630pm. He told us to wait.The night view was splendid. We even took a photo at the glass floor where you can see all the way down.It is a pity that we did not manage to catch the sunset view.If you want to catch the sunset view, pay more and you can stay there from 6pm to 7pm to catch the great view.

reviews.author: Andrew M
reviews.title: Worth the effort.
reviews.content: I can see why you come to an observation deck as it puts the size if the city into a little perspective and where you fit in.  Sadly, Hanoi was having one of its misty days but the view was still worth the VND220,000.   This sky deck lacks the plan-o-grams of the city at each viewing location to help you orientate yourself.  That would make it so much better.  I also found the staff at the sky deck in Saigon far far far better.  Here they seemed a little distant.   The sky platform with the glass floor is quite confronting at first.  Over all we enjoyed it but it did lack some atmosphere.

reviews.author: Japai p
reviews.title: Breathtaking view
reviews.content: Only managed to go there on my 3rd visit to Hanoi. How i regret not going much earlierIt has amazing 360 view of Hanoi especially the one facing the Westlake.I had planned for a quick view but ended up taking my time (2 hours+) just enjoying the view and having few cups of tea.Took 2 of my boys along and yes they really enjoyed the experience.Must go place if u are around the area.For foreigners price was VND170k for kids n VND270k for adults

reviews.author: Antoine F
reviews.title: What a point of view!
reviews.content: Amazing point of view. It offers a panoramic city view of Hanoï. You can realize how big the city is. Price : 230,000 VND during the day130,000 VND during the night

reviews.author: AndrewMyers1
reviews.title: Emotionally cold but with with most advances toilets on the 38th floor
reviews.content: After 3 days of very hot weather we decided we needed 5 star consumerism and air conditioningIt was like John Lewis upmarket with security guards and really lacking the customer care.This was expensive and not very pleasant experienceWe tried to go to 63 floor and the 'man' said it was a resteraunt  so no  quick drinkSo he informed us we could go to 38th and got in lift with usTea and couple of cocktails later we did have a great view but felt uncomfortable throughoutThe highlight was the most electronically advanced toilets Seat warmer ,front wash,back wash,dryer all controlled from a control panel next to toiletTried the oscillator button as well, but you can test that yourself There were two other buttons I was terrified they would play musicOverall the view ,the long drinks,the English books we bought and the great air conditioning make this a good two hour visit The electronic lavatory was memorable but does it count as progressThis felt like high security rather than anywhere near us customer care

reviews.author: Delilah W
reviews.title: Fab views
reviews.content: If you have time to kill in Hanoi then visit this place. Great views of the city- we visited in the evening and the views were spectacular. The sky walk is scary but fun.

reviews.author: Jeremy
reviews.title: Get high above it all.
reviews.content: On the top of the Lotte Centre is a bar high above the city. There is a nice open air vibe and DJ at night. They serve drinks and the view is really nice. A nice place to come for a break from the chaos on the street.

reviews.author: Andy S
reviews.title: Skydeck
reviews.content: Best place to see the whole city from the top. Enter before sunset and stay there till night so you can see the city at 2 different side. Dark and light

reviews.author: Kimbacat1
reviews.title: Vietnam trip
reviews.content: A must do. We went at night. Great and spectacular view of Hanoi.Floor 65. No souvenirs of the deck itself in the souvenir shop on that floor at that time. Would we go here again --- definite YES.

reviews.author: Andrew T
reviews.title: restaurant and rooftop bar. interesting
reviews.content: This was our first time up to the restaurant on level 63 and rooftop bar.  Great service and continental food.  We had a special meal well prepared of sirloin and basa that was excellent.  The view, service and ambience in the restaurant was good.  They had a live band playing at the right volume so it didn’t overwhelm the experience as many other places mess this up.  The rooftop could have been better if the original design allowed for more of a seating design on the edge for a more thrilling experience.  Anyways, it’s still a interesting panoramic view of the city.

reviews.author: Jordan F
reviews.title: Amazing view
reviews.content: We visited the observation deck right at 6:30- and it was the perfect time! We paid the lower fee, got to see the city in the light, saw the sunset, and stayed to see the city lights at night. There are 2 glass floor observation areas and they are great for photos. It is difficult to get good photos at night as there are a lot of lights on in the building and so there is a lot of reflection. If you want good photos definitely go during the day or during the sunset.

reviews.author: Chaarvi B
reviews.title: Great view of Hanoi, a must see!
reviews.content: Visited at around 530pm on a weekday. Wasn't too crowded. The evening rates were VND 130,000 for non-nationals. I think the day rates are 230,000/non-nationals. Tickets have to bought from the B1 floor of the Lotte Departmental store. It was a good time to visit, we saw the city in the day time as well as the early evening with all the lights! It definitely looks so so beautiful from that height. All the lakes and buildings look gorgeous. The glass floor are a fun experience but be warned, that it is quite scary if you don't like heights! There are also binoculars on the skydeck so can look in detail. Also a few eateries on the floor.

reviews.author: lozliz7
reviews.title: Great View - loved the sky walk
reviews.content: We visited the observation deck early afternoon but beware it's quite a walk from Hanoi centre, particularly in the heat at this time of day! Recommend getting a taxi at least one way.When you do get there it's worth it though, what a view! Gives you some context around how big the city actually is. You can walk all the way round the floor to get a 360 degree view & there are 2 Sky Walks..... not for the faint hearted but can get you a great picture! Nice cafe on the floor too. Ps- the video in the lift makes for a unique experience !

reviews.author: Wayne T
reviews.title: Great Views of Hanoi
reviews.content: We visited the Lotte Observation deck at around 1100 in the morning. Cost was VND 230,000 each. The entry is discounted in the evening. There were very few people visiting at the time so we practically had the place to ourselves. Views from the top were very clear allowing us to take some great photos. There are also 2 glass floors which allow a great view below...Unlike some towers I have visited, the observation level was nice and wide the entire way around so even if this was busy, I still think there would be plenty of room. There is a cafe and also a fast food restaurant. It was a nice spot to have a coffee afterwards.

reviews.author: fsanchezcv
reviews.title: Great spot. A must in Hanoi
reviews.content: The view of the city is amazing. You get a small discount if you visit after sunset, but the glare from the light inside blocks some of the views.

reviews.author: Tony P
reviews.title: Beautiful views and amazing ambiance
reviews.content: We stayed at the Lotte for a business retreat.  While the hotel is first class all the way, the Observation Deck was something special.  The views of Hanoi were amazing.  The deck is set up very comfortably and as usual the friendly staff catered beyond our needs. We were part of a private group party and there was music, a DJ, dancers, disco lights... everything to make a great party.  One of the best parties ever... danced all night!

reviews.author: CHTrips
reviews.title: Lotte Observation Deck
reviews.content: It's away from the tourist area but a taxi ride (Uber) was only about $5. It's discounted entry after 5:30pm and you get to see excellent view of the entire city.  Also there are two area's that are suspended in the air that you can take pictures off of and lay on and take pictures.

reviews.author: jm
reviews.title: Birds eye view of Hanoi
reviews.content: Good view of Hanoi from the 65th floor of the sky deck. The view would be better if the didn't have so many lights at night, and turned down the loud music which spoils the view

reviews.author: Redviews
reviews.title: Good view point, pity about the smog
reviews.content: We spent a pleasant hour on the observation deck and enjoyed looking at the sights from this tower. But, Hanoi had so much smog while we were there that it was not possible to see anything at a distance.
