reviews.author: Aishling C
reviews.title: beautiful
reviews.content: beautiful wall built to commemorate 1000 years of Hanoi. It stretches for kilometers and has so many beautiful pictures.

reviews.author: roadbum4ever
reviews.title: Beautiful tiles work !
reviews.content: Walked two third of the wall. Had some much fun seeing and photographing the intricate tiles work. Love it!

reviews.author: Janice P
reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.content: Spanning miles along the ighway, this wall was done to celebrate the anniversary of Vietnam and made by children. Easily seen along the road as you travel.

reviews.author: carolynthb
reviews.title: It is a chronology of Vietnam life/history
reviews.content: After going past it a few times in  a vehicle I didn't take much notice, but on the way to the airport I was on that side of the road and looked at it much closer and realised it depicted Vietnamese life in mosaics.

reviews.author: Taduana
reviews.title: Unforgetable place
reviews.content: I never have seen anything like that. The art, the colours, the idea, everything is great. You can forget about the distance and about the heat walking and watching, it is just fantastic.

reviews.author: Ai Cheng Y
reviews.title: Pretty mural along the road
reviews.content: The mural does provide more vibrant in Hanoi city. Something unique as compared to other cities in South East Asia.

reviews.author: David N
reviews.title: Awesome. I love it.
reviews.content: It's great to view from a taxi or a bus as you drive along the road. But if you've got the time I think it's well worth a stroll along the footpath in front of it to check out all the different aspects of Vietnamese life, history and culture it depicts.

reviews.author: Gigi1599
reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.content: Beautiful wall of ceramic mosaic which shows the best of Vietnam and its history! It is so long, that it's better to see it whole by car ;)

reviews.author: Greetingsfromraf
reviews.title: Nice but this is an expressway !!
reviews.content: The mosaic are numerous and beautiful but they are along an expressway !! so you't take pictures or even watch it while walking.So sad because it could have been beautiful...

reviews.author: dardavis01
reviews.title: This is just incredible!
reviews.content: This is a beautiful mosaic wall that runs for approximately six miles down the road in Hanoi. Lots of beautiful artwork by many of the local artists.

reviews.author: DrKayak
reviews.title: Spectacular mural
reviews.content: Wow! GORGEOUS mural (about 4km, longest mural in the world). Commissioned to mark the millenial anniversary of Ha Noi in 2010. Definitely worth seeing. Ask a taxi driver to drive along it's length in the lane closest to the mural while you film in slo-mo so you can review it's beauty again and again and share it with friends on your return home. A taxi VAN would be best so you're above the scooters while filming.  A community that invests in the arts will draw arts-minded travellers in the it's future. Keep it up, Ha Noi!

reviews.author: RobinM
reviews.title: Great way to beautify roadside
reviews.content: We did a "Vespa" tour of Hanoi and so were up close and personal as we headed towards West Lake. Great way to improve what is normally a bit of. Sterile environment

reviews.author: Traveler22DC
reviews.title: Amazing but Why
reviews.content: These Mosaic Mural are extremely beautiful and so will done but i think of the time and money that has gone into creating them and think its money they could have spend helping other areas of the city that need it more.

reviews.author: les f
reviews.title: Worth a look
reviews.content: Hard to get too as it is on a busy road and not much room to stop and have a look,  it depicts a story of vietnam in mosaic and quite good,  you can see it as you drive in to town from the airport, for a quick look.Great work.

reviews.author: Guardian2013
reviews.title: Longest Mural
reviews.content: I have lived next to this mosaic mural for over 2 years and still find new things I've missed. You can only really see it and appreciate it whilst on foot, which can be tricky when there are next to no pavements. Some may find it not 'arty' enough but when you consider how painstakingly slow this mosaic must have taken to make and the problems they must have had getting tiles, tools etc to the site, it is truly remarkable.

reviews.author: Mercedes C
reviews.title: GUINESS PRIZE RECCORD
reviews.content: Very unique and diverse. Much more glamorous than the Western graffiti. A collective master piece, very diverse with lovely colors and local motifs.

reviews.author: Dan B
reviews.title: Such detailed work
reviews.content: Very intricate artistry along a very extensive stretch of road. Tells fascinating stories about life and culture right throughout Vietnam

reviews.author: LorrainePAustralia
reviews.title: Nice Mural But Need to See It Up Close.
reviews.content: We were on a scooter tour so didn't really get to see it up close. It seems to go for quite a way, so would be worth a slow stroll past it to see it up close.

reviews.author: Tourismtiger
reviews.title: a linear story
reviews.content: This is something to look out for as you whiz by in a taxi. It is not really intended as a 'go-to' attraction as such... Interesting that all provinces designed and put up a panel. It runs the length of a busy road so not really much time (nor the environment) to stop and stare... I saw it several time to and from the airport

reviews.author: Sharon J
reviews.title: Work of art
reviews.content: Saw this when traveling to Halong Bay and the airportVery detailed....took years, many people involved, tells a story...room for more

reviews.author: lloyd b
reviews.title: What an excellent example of civic pride and roadside creativity
reviews.content: We weren't looking for it. the taxi was taking us to West lake. Then all of a sudden the wall art begins. It is like a moving art exhibit  that goes on and on for several kilometers and incorporates so many genre. You will be dazzled. The only challenge is to go through it twice; or once slowly. Traffic dictates your viewing time and pace.. Now that is urban art at its purest.  The world's creativity from your taxi window.

reviews.author: kdnicol
reviews.title: Hanoi Ceramic Mosaic Mural
reviews.content: Very beautiful ! saw these quiet a bit as we were being taxied around Hanoi but didn't actually get out to look.

reviews.author: JasonNguyen24
reviews.title: Average points
reviews.content: I only passed this area by car. I saw the long ceramic street with many symbols of life. However, I recommend going on foot for many more beautiful photos

reviews.author: Borgy44
reviews.title: A colourful surprise
reviews.content: Going along the road of Au Co in a taxi this incredible work appears for several kilometres. Had it been easy to walk around, I would have liked to walked along it to really admire the work.

reviews.author: Tushar M
reviews.title: A Warm Welcome to Hanoi
reviews.content: This is really a mesmerizing piece of art and a great welcome to Hanoi...First you notice the mural and you dont imagine that it is one ongoing mural...But after a few seconds you realize and start noticing each and every bit from the car.Too bad you cant stop and appreciate the beauty but it is really worth it and aprt from the Vietnamese Govt there are many international organisations and embassies etc who were involved in this ( as told by our driver). But if you really want to see and capture it please rent a scooter/cycle and do it....We missed doing that you shouldnt

reviews.author: Keith T
reviews.title: Interesting Mosaic
reviews.content: This mural stretches for a long way along Yen Phu and Au Co - a major artery into the city. It's interesting to view while driving by but there really aren't any good places to stop and look at it up close. Portions of the mosaic are beginning to show some age, but it remains interesting to see.

reviews.author: berver65
reviews.title: World of record
reviews.content: This ceramic wall of 3.850 meters has been completed in 2010 for the 1.000 years of history of Vietnam.All the ceramic pieces came from Bat Trang, a famous village next to Hanoi.Too bad that we are going to fast to enjoy it like we should.

reviews.author: Wayfarer65
reviews.title: Awsome mosaic walls Must see!
reviews.content: Try and get to see this, the mosaics go on for miles and miles, and took years to complete really awesome

reviews.author: jennifer G
reviews.title: Unexpected art in a bustling city
reviews.content: We noticed the mural when we were returning to our hotel in a taxi. It is just amazing . The mosaic is fabulous. It ran right by our hotel( Sofitel) and is I estimated, 4 kms in length . Would liked to have seen it up close but we ran out of time.

reviews.author: Patsy C
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: This was mostly viewed from within a car, bus or cab, but it is an amazing piece of Art that you must see, and when I return I will try to walk along the wall and get a different perspective up close.

reviews.author: hardwil
reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.content: We only saw this mosaic from the coach but it is amazing - over 10Km long and beautifully put together.

reviews.author: kristiekeever2
reviews.title: What a surprise upon first arrival to the city!
reviews.content: This was GORGEOUS.  You have to see it in person to truly appreciate this work of art.  There were so many different scenes depicted in this mural.

reviews.author: Katherine P
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: This is a thoughtful piece of art, rather than letting it get sprayed with graffiti. A beautiful and carefully done view, that displays a lot of story.

reviews.author: Deb W
reviews.title: Beautiful art in the city
reviews.content: This 2.6 miles of mosaic wall are gorgeous. It's so much better than graffiti. They artists really helped beautify this area.

reviews.author: Balfour S
reviews.title: A magnificent history of Hanoi ... free to view and enjoy
reviews.content: This wonderful monument to the thousand year history of the region is quite fascinating to take in. Stretching for about two-and-a-half miles, you can try to walk its length, but the road is busy and it is best to either take it in pieces over several days or in a taxi (asking the driver to go as slow as possible). The mural is both serious and playful...enjoy it.

reviews.author: Tali S
reviews.title: Beautiful !
reviews.content: Amazing work, interesting to see different scenes of Vietnam, colorful and fascinating . Couldn't take my eyes off it the whole ride.

reviews.author: Linda D
reviews.title: Great idea
reviews.content: I was just suddenlly passing by this street and love that! There are many different types of pictures that tell the stories of the city.  It is so beautiful and fun to see

reviews.author: Jonny M
reviews.title: Wouldn't see it unless you were looking for it
reviews.content: Cool wall that stretches on for ages. Must have been lots of work to create. Depicts some great scences of Vietnamese history if you look closely. Is next to the busy road so watch for cars. Cool to see at night.

reviews.author: Pete
reviews.title: Nice idea
reviews.content: This mosaic stretches over a long distance and shows Vietnams history. It is located alongside an incredibly busy road and most people will pass it when heading on a tour or travelling to the airport.

reviews.author: Incense Travel
reviews.title: Impressive work
reviews.content: This mosaic wall was built for the 1000 years celebration of Hanoi ( in 2010 ). This wall is approximately 3,85km and is recorded for the longest mosaic wall in the wall by Guinness. It tells different stories of Vietnam through the art of mosaic. It's worth a walk all the way along and discover those stories.

reviews.author: pemblin
reviews.title: odd is the best description
reviews.content: along side a very busy road this mosaic wall obviously has lots of local references but if you don't know them its hard to work out the point of it other than as decoration and a lot of it is just brown and grey

reviews.author: Travelling_Brogue
reviews.title: Not Pedestrian or Tourist Friendly
reviews.content: Conceptually, the mural wall is a great commemoration of Hanoi's millennial anniversary, but this 4km wall isn't really a tourist stop over, but is more of something to witness while driving from the airport to the city...the sidewalks are narrow. I have to note that the mosaic is made from traditional Vietnamese tesserae and the stretch of wall portrays the different dynasties of Vietnam--it is a pity that there isn't much space on the side walk to walk up and down.

reviews.author: Jason G
reviews.title: Very pretty
reviews.content: The mural itself was very pretty, so I can't knock down its rating because it's not really accessible on foot. Basically it seems like if you're staying in the Old Quarter, then you'll pass by here to and from the airport. It really isn't too far of a walk from the Old Quarter, so if you had a little time you could probably wander up and try to find a way across the highway to the sidewalk that goes along the mural. Sidewalk isn't very wide though, so I'm not sure how well you'll really be able to take a step back to admire the scenes without having to worry about traffic. Is worth seeing though even if it's just a drive by.

reviews.author: JanetWK
reviews.title: Charming
reviews.content: The Ceramic Mosaic Mural that runs along the main road in Hanoi adds charm and displays the culture of the city. While there are many different types of pictures depicted, it tells the story of the city. It was fun to see.

reviews.author: Carmencwm
reviews.title: Better if can have a better look
reviews.content: The wall is next to the highway/road which is full of motorbikes and dust. I saw it a few times when I took taxi in and out the old quarter. It would be much much better if I can walk around and take a better look onto the walls.

reviews.author: LouenStephan
reviews.title: interesting, but behind the highway
reviews.content: we wanted t see the wall on different places.  But the wall is build at the outside of a very busy highway.  On most of the places it is nearly impossible to see the wall

reviews.author: katus_no2
reviews.title: A modernising Hanoi
reviews.content: The mural is visible on my regular bus trips into the Old Quarter from Tay Ho, and it's a pleasant alternative view to the bustling of the cars, trucks, and endless motorcycles. A decent activity would be to ride a bicycle/walk it's entirety from start to finish.

reviews.author: niwutgems
reviews.title: very interesting
reviews.content: I think Hanoi is a city of art and artists, literally. Size is also a pillar of the elevated bridge plate mosaic yet.

reviews.author: Laura C
reviews.title: Great mural depicting Vietnamese history located on busy highway
reviews.content: The placement of this mural is odd as it rests along an elevated stretch of highway.  Worth seeing, but if we hadn't driven by it I don't know if I'd recommend going out of your way on foot to see it.

reviews.author: Trypp Adams
reviews.title: Enjoyed on my ride out to the airport from my taxi
reviews.content: As I reflected on my time in Hanoi and Vietnam, I climbed into the cab and pulled the door shut. It seemed fitting that we drove by the Ceramic mural on our way out of town. I was surprised how long the mural remained in view and the scenery went on. It's beautiful, I struggled to take a picture of it, but the memory seemed fitting.

reviews.author: K W T
reviews.title: Unique
reviews.content: Everyone is bound to see this mural as it is a few kilometres long. Very colourful. Very unique. It's a must see either from the bus/taxi or take a scroll along it. I like to start from the 1015-2015 Dragons Picture.

reviews.author: MickeyAZ
reviews.title: Pretty Long
reviews.content: The best way to see it is by a cab or you will just see parts on your travels. Rather unique. You could walk to see it I think there may be a side walk there.It is rather long. Very interesting.I don't remember how many artists worked on the project.

reviews.author: reiziger99
reviews.title: In the book of records
reviews.content: Entering Hanoi from the airport most travellers pass this Mosaic Murel. In impressive and and colorful wall. Few know that this wall is mentioned in the Guinnes Book of Records, being the largest ceramic mosaic in the world. In Hang Da market one can find a a room dedicated to the female artist that is responsible for the design of this wall and many other ceramic mosaics in Hanoi.

reviews.author: B-Fox
reviews.title: Super Beauty / Belly Beast
reviews.content: I don't walk enough in Saigon and I might be wrong, but I believe this is the longest mosaic in the world. Its beautiful and you can walk the entire piece. get a coffee takeaway, turn off and stroll along taking in its ever changing scenery and beautiful colors and constant surprises. A beautiful piece that stretches the length of the city (not really tho?)! Love seeing this piece every time I am in Hanoi.

reviews.author: angie g
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: Really beautiful telling story and history .  It is made to run the full length of very long road so best looked at when a passenger or pillion on bike

reviews.author: Laney98
reviews.title: Amazing Undertaking
reviews.content: This is an amazing piece of work which runs for 5.5 kilometers along a busy main road through the city.   There are sidewalks where the work can be viewed up close.

reviews.author: multi v
reviews.title: A mammoth feat worth seeing
reviews.content: A very long mosaic that took a long time to construct. You are only likely to see a part of it unless you are very dedicated. Very interesting and well done

reviews.author: patli2015
reviews.title: Hanoi Ceramic Mosaic
reviews.content: Hanoi Ceramic Mosaic Mural is a good architectural project, instead of having horrible concrete walls; local mosaics decorate those ones. No need of a special visit you will see the walls when travelling along the Red River going to  West Lake (Tay Ho) or the airport.

reviews.author: Duncan B
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: A Guinness book of records length , I think ( ??), you see it when you pass in the bus or coach on your way to somewhere else, so it's not exactly something you would specifically go to.

reviews.author: hikkaduwa_10
reviews.title: Never bores you
reviews.content: an excellent time spending in the traffic jam which is so usual for Hanoi. Since you're stuck in a different place every time, you're never tired of looking at the mosaics :D

reviews.author: amandajvp86
reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL!
reviews.content: We only saw this from the road twice, it is beautiful, I definitely would have liked to have time to walk along it and see it on more detail.

reviews.author: Anthony S
reviews.title: Long art work
reviews.content: Passed by the mural on our return to the airport and it was quite interesting to see along the roadside. Probably not worth a five kilometre walk to see it all, but from the road in passing it is worthwhile.Didn't know it existed until the guide pointed it out.

reviews.author: Carla A
reviews.title: Beautiful and lovely to see
reviews.content: This mural wall stretches a long way along one of the main roads.  It is so beautiful and has many scenes from within Vietnam and other countries.  Lovely to see!

reviews.author: Miller_KO
reviews.title: Unique and beautiful creation...
reviews.content: Saw this entire mosaic mural on the drive into and out of Hanoi and stretches from Hanoi airport to Hanoi's old town. The mural can only really be seen by a vehicle as the traffic would make it dangerous to attempt to see any other way. The mosaic was created on the flood wall to document Vietnamese history, culture and art using a blend to traditional and modern artistic methods and is claimed to be the longest mosaic mural in Vietnam.

reviews.author: Judyannechan
reviews.title: Unique creation
reviews.content: This is a unique feature in Hanoi.  It is very creative.  What is actually a flood dyke has been covered in ceramic tiles which depict Vietnamese history with some modern art & childrens' art mixed in.  It is lovely to look at it as you drive along the road to and from the airport.  It is not easy to get up close to it on foot though due to traffic conditions.

reviews.author: GulfportOlddiver
reviews.title: Leavy along the river in Hanoi.
reviews.content: Most any travel from the Hanoi airport to Old Town will take you by the longest mosaic mural in the world. If time and traffic will allow you should make a few stops at different sections of the wall as different artist did many sections.

reviews.author: Louise B
reviews.title: Interesting
reviews.content: We first spotted the mural when we were in a taxi, we asked about it and what we could understand its the longest mosaic mural in Vietnam

reviews.author: leisurebug2016
reviews.title: Worth an Up Close Stop
reviews.content: Since the ceramic is on a busy street, it could present a challenge to see the mosaic up close.  We passed it several times by vehicle but could not see the detail.  It wasn't until we were traveling by bike and could ride up to it that we were able to see the detail and truly appreciate the beauty and effort in its creation.

reviews.author: authored
reviews.title: Impressive only if you are walking
reviews.content: Driving by this "longest mosaic in the world" does not do it justice.  It just looks like a pretty flood wall (which it is),  BUT, if you get out of your vehicle and take time to walk along the wall to understand the history of Vietnam being conveyed, it is worth the time.

reviews.author: Tom L
reviews.title: Interesting Mosaic Wall Mural - is many blocks long
reviews.content: Highly detailed and intricate mosaic work. Colorful and in good shape. No need to stop - just drive by in a taxi.

reviews.author: Hoffy85
reviews.title: Astounding
reviews.content: On arrival in Hanoi the driver explained about this mural on the way into town, there were 4 of us in the mini bus & were all astounded by the colours & the length of the mural, Very interesting design & very well done.

reviews.author: Mary Denese H
reviews.title: photograph at your peril
reviews.content: This is a lovely mural for photographing. Not only the wall but the buildings that sit behind the wall. Also interesting to go down into the smaller village areas as you clamber across where the roads intersect the mural wall

reviews.author: C M
reviews.title: amazing work
reviews.content: The mural, seeming to go on forever, is definitely a must see.  The small and amazing part we visited has made it's length a must see on our next trip to Ha Noi and the Old Quarter.

reviews.author: LouJohnson
reviews.title: Impressive
reviews.content: The sheer length of the mural makes it worth seeing. Sadly wandering along its length to see it in detail is almost impossible which is great pity.

reviews.author: Melanie E
reviews.title: Inspiring sight!
reviews.content: I wish I had the opportunity to see this incredible mosaic but only saw it from a moving car. There was 4 km of different ceramic mosaic murals that was on the wall of the dyke system of Hanoi. Something for everyone.

reviews.author: Lauradevlam
reviews.title: Nice wall but impossible to have a good look at it
reviews.content: I really wanted to see this wall, it tells sole interesting stories and the style changes while you walk further. The bad thing is that it runs next to a hanoi-style very busy road, and you only have one meter of place to walk between the cars and the wall. So not much space to examine the drawings and way to much noise to make the complete walk. I am happy I've seen it, because it's interesting to see how this wall loses attention because of the surroundings, as a part of how things work here. But it is not a nice little trip.

reviews.author: Philip M
reviews.title: ok
reviews.content: I passed this long ceramic mural when I was going back to my hotel by taxi.,  You can only really see it from a taxi as it is not possible to walk along the street and see it as it is on a very busy traffic road.  It is not exciting to me but may be appreciated by some.

reviews.author: Joaelk
reviews.title: Amazing Mural
reviews.content: I've never seen anything like it.  What a delight.  Different artists every 20 feet, goes on forever.  What a great work of art.

reviews.author: Clan_K-C
reviews.title: Amazing, varied and lovely
reviews.content: We walked different pieces of the mural, and always looked for new bits when in buses and taxis. Celebrating 1000 years of Hanoi, it incorporates history, symbols and activities of the place. Would love a book or a website talking about it. Incredible variation between the myriad artists. Not necessarily a stop on its own, but worth check out when you are near various bits (I personally love the pieces near the large fruit market, under the bridge)

reviews.author: MrsMc14
reviews.title: Pretty!
reviews.content: We only drove by the mural on our way from/to the airport. Wish we'd had time to walk along it. It's very pretty and unique!

reviews.author: Renaelee
reviews.title: Interesting work
reviews.content: With the crazy traffic there is time to look to your left when entering Hanoi and see the very long ceramic mural that has been created. Although we could not get up close to it while in the car, it looks beautiful. not sure what is it conveying...

reviews.author: BethWallace
reviews.title: Wonderful mosaic
reviews.content: Unfortunately, you really just see this 3 Km long mosaic from a car on your way to the airport.  It would be possible to see it on foot, but you would miss the 'big picture' view of all the mosaic represents from Vietnamese life.  Beautiful!

reviews.author: drj7743
reviews.title: WALK AND LOOK AT IT CLOSE.
reviews.content: This was a highlight of my stay in Hanoi. Celebrating 1000 years of Hanoi as a city.World Heritage site. You must walk the street and have a close look at. The designs are great and the colours bright. To see it all may take you along time as it exceeds 4 kilometres. You will note all the Companies that sponsor the Mosaic Mural. Some areas need repairing. A MUST SEE IN HANOI.

reviews.author: Sarah B
reviews.title: really cool mural
reviews.content: we passed by this mural on the way to Halong bay and it was highly recommended it's beautiful. It's so long you could never miss it.

reviews.author: RodGowrieSmith
reviews.title: Celebrating 1000 years - the world's largest ceramic feature.
reviews.content: Bordering a hectic road (on top of a dike that has protected the cities for years from flooding), the mosiac is not really that much of a site in small sections. But when you consider it is nearly 6 kms long and the fact that it was built to celebrate a 1000 years of Hanoi as a city makes it worth a visit.

reviews.author: Anyse J
reviews.title: I walk there from 2-4 AM and it is so nice then. No traffic
reviews.content: Waling along this mural, one gains an insight into what Vietnamese value and what they also strive to achieve. The colors are generally strong and clear, the materials are so nice to see and how they put them together can be observed, sometimes with awe!Going in the middle of the night, you don;t have to deal with the steady flow of the traffic and you can stroll freely along it. It goes a LONG way, so measure your stamina. If you take your time, it can take hours to see. Or, just pick out what pleased you and enjoy. Living here, I am lucky. When I can't sleep, which is often, you might just see me wandering along this wall and, frankly, being mesmerized by it.Look into part of the heart of the Vietnamese people here. You will feel great joy!

reviews.author: Fred862014
reviews.title: cool
reviews.content: really colorful piece to see! most of the time they will show it to you on the way to Halong!! it's in the guinness i think!

reviews.author: blueoceanvn
reviews.title: Well thought but poorly executed
reviews.content: The project was initiated to celebrate Hanoi's Millenium in 2010. The idea is beautiful and very creative. It would have created something new based on Hanoi's traditional characters if it had been well executed and preserved.In 2015, merely five years later, it became part of a Hanoi that people don't like to see. Parts of the mural were damaged due to trafic accidents, parts were degraded themselves because of poor construction. At nights (or even in daylight), people make it the most expensive public rest room in the world.

reviews.author: Kim N
reviews.title: The Pretty colors along drab street
reviews.content: This mural is supposedly the longest in the worl.  Over 4 km long with different motifs and all are made of tiles.  It's eye catching especially along the dreary drab look of the street.  You can't miss it if you drive to the city center.

reviews.author: Bruce H
reviews.title: So Long and So Beautiful
reviews.content: Wow! was our first impression when we first saw this very long ceramic Mural.  Made to celebrate the millennium of Hanoi it runs for approximately six kilometers and is the world's largest ceramic mosaic mural.  A must see even if only driving past.

reviews.author: Angoz82
reviews.title: What a beautiful sight along an extremely busy road
reviews.content: Certainly adds some colour to your journey from the airport into the city centre. Its so detailed and colourful. Great job.

reviews.author: LaGrange_Professors
reviews.title: Very pretty
reviews.content: The contributions to beauty cannot be overlooked. Amazing on how much time this artwork had to have taken to be completed, but so glad people are committed to public art.

reviews.author: JHNB1
reviews.title: Superb but difficult to see
reviews.content: The more you stay in Hanoi the deeper you look. It's easy to bypass these series of mosaics murals  as the only way you can appreciate them is as a passenger in a car looking right for at least 1.5 km !  Such a pity that there are no publications on this public art work as it needs greater access.

reviews.author: marJ8403TL
reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.content: Ceramic road makes the road scenery along the dyke, which formerly cluttered and unkempt now become more beautiful and romantic

reviews.author: LoveTwinsandTravel
reviews.title: Worth driving by just to see once
reviews.content: I would suggest driving by at night when the lights of the cars and scooters whizzing by really make these gorgeous tile mosaics sparkle!

reviews.author: manucanuck
reviews.title: Don't bother walking along it
reviews.content: You just need to drive along the street to admire the ceramic piece, you won't be able to take great pictures of it as its on the side of a very busy road. I go pass this road everyday as I live at the intercontinental Hanoi west lake, adds a little more special than just a taxi ride into the old quarter!

reviews.author: Mala B
reviews.title: Try to set aside time to walk this mural
reviews.content: We drove by this several times and if we had more time I would have loved to walk past it. Spectacular art!

reviews.author: JMartJr
reviews.title: Yep, that's a mural
reviews.content: Pretty when driving by, not something I'd make a special effort to see, really, but if you can drive by (and you probably will at some point) it is a perfectly nice folk-artsy mural.

reviews.author: 365Weathers
reviews.title: The Art Lives On
reviews.content: Located along the boundary road surrounding the Old Quarter at the opposite end to West Lake in Hanoi. It's quite a mural and something worth seeing as you pass along the busy street. Not easy to photograph or capture in one snap.

reviews.author: Robert B
reviews.title: Impressive
reviews.content: An awful lot of work has gone into this mosaic and it's impressive but it does not seem to be looked after very well, you will see bits of it as you travel around.

reviews.author: Gina H
reviews.title: Worth looking at
reviews.content: If you catch any bus to the Old Quarter the bus station is opposite part of this mural. It is worth spending a few minutes walking along and checking it out. Very large variety/styles of murals done by some very talented people.

reviews.author: GRIMS
reviews.title: Not a bad mural
reviews.content: Saw this from our taxi rides to and from the old quarter and the Sofitel Plaza where we were staying. Quite large and varied and detailed as murals go.

reviews.author: Isabelle
reviews.title: The Icing on the Cake in Hanoi
reviews.content: I love this mural! It's not necessarily something you 'go to see' but something that's lvoely to pass by on the way to other places.

reviews.author: Hanoi R
reviews.title: Celebrating 1000 years!
reviews.content: Hanoi has been around for over a 1000 years. That is a seriously long time. The monument itself is not that impressive until i considered the length. It is kilometres long and each section tells a story. Millions of little ceramic pieces that will last maybe a few centuries at best due to pollution.

reviews.author: bobdonnelly
reviews.title: Monumental
reviews.content: It goes on and on. Quite a civic undertaking. We enjoyed the scale of the project and imagine that it's stories are plentiful even though we could not interpret them.

reviews.author: deloeckerdanny
reviews.title: Street art
reviews.content: I ran into this attraction accidentally on my way to the airport. Even by car the wall seems endless and I'm sure different artists contributed. The wall looks a little bit worn and restoration would be recommended, but I'm afraid it won't come to that.

reviews.author: frazermudcrab
reviews.title: Beautiful Ceramics
reviews.content: The ceramic mural wall runs for several kms. Vivid colours and artistry by very talented artists Best viewed by car, or touring coach.

reviews.author: Annhien1012
reviews.title: Impressive
reviews.content: Hanoi ceramic mosaic mural was created since 2010. It's an impressive idea because the way to Long Bien bridge was more beautiful. Many people come to take photos on this mural but it's not a walking street so it's not convenient if you want to spend more time there.

reviews.author: LCZ
reviews.title: interesting...
reviews.content: Spotted these interesting ceramics as we visited the Blue Angel Foundation which does wonderful work for the teens of Vietnam.

reviews.author: Draghignazzo
reviews.title: Pure art for everyone
reviews.content: Many good things in life are free. This is one example.The only problem about this art masterpiece is the location, its impossible to see it by foot, the best way is by car but for sure you will miss a lot as we did..

reviews.author: bstdflsh
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: A beautiful which runs for a few miles along a main thoroughfare. Bright vivid colors and a testament to the artists talants and efforts.

reviews.author: ReiRamirez
reviews.title: Amazing art
reviews.content: You can't appreciate this just by looking at it. You gotta know the facts, like how long it took to built it, approximately how many tiles and how long is the entire stretch of the mural is.

reviews.author: alyona g
reviews.title: great art
reviews.content: just pity you cannot really enjoy the view - impossible to stop on the highwayit was done for 1000-Hanoi anniversaryit's the longest art in the world!

reviews.author: Tan S
reviews.title: Beautiful Art Along Road Side
reviews.content: Beautiful & Colorful Ceramic Mosaic Mural on busy road side, catching eye & cooldown heat on busy traffic congestion.

reviews.author: Anant
reviews.title: Very cool and trippy art
reviews.content: Scooting along the way you get to see some really cool art. Some of the geometric patterns are trippy as :)

reviews.author: Sergio L
reviews.title: Good to see.
reviews.content: Is just a mosaic that can be seen from any tour that you have had in Hanoi. Interesting seen from inside the bus.

reviews.author: Kalindi D
reviews.title: Good quality
reviews.content: This place has very good quality stuff and different from ols quarter but a little more expensive. The lacquer work is really good.

reviews.author: mushroom001
reviews.title: Exquisite street art
reviews.content: Mosaics! And not normal hand drawn arts. Very well maintained and I prayed that it will never be vandalised. It's just that, but it's a must to see while you're in Old Quarter. Nothing to do except taking pictures and appreciating the art. As I went there by driving along the street in a car, I can only recorded it and taking snapshots.

reviews.author: Veronique1702
reviews.title: very nice but not very good explain where is it
reviews.content: very nice but we found it at the end just before to leavebut it is amazing. I can't do a picture but a lot !

reviews.author: Ramram47
reviews.title: creation artist
reviews.content: this wall paintings create new image of city bare walls into more eyeful attraction and looks marvellous

reviews.author: VNvet2015
reviews.title: Great addition to the city
reviews.content: Done for the 2010 1000-year anniversary of the founding of HaNoi, the mural is a real treat for travelers along the north/south dike road on the east side of the city. Vivid colors and cute designs in the mural make the busy road far more fun to travel, and despite the fact that I have traveled it hundreds of times since 2010, I seem to see new elements often.

reviews.author: Cousins H
reviews.title: Just drive up and down and enjoy
reviews.content: Lon long long mosaic. I love to drive up and down it. My favorite part are the mosaic based on drawing made by kids.

reviews.author: Puppy
reviews.title: A piece of amazing street art
reviews.content: This is the worlds largest mosaic built for Ha Noi's 1000 anniversary A spectacular piece of street art. We saw most of it driving between our hotel and the airport and it can be enjoyed and photographed whilst driving past but it's probably more enjoyable to walk along and appreciate the amazing sight.

reviews.author: CanberraGypsies
reviews.title: Outstanding Artwork
reviews.content: A spectacular artwork. Easily enjoyed whilst driving past but it's more enjoyable to walk along and appreciate the amazing thought and design that has gone into its production. Very well presented in a very important public space.

reviews.author: Heather F
reviews.title: See this
reviews.content: Our hotel organised a cyclo to drive along this wall as I'm a mosaic artist. This is well worth driving along. Cyclo is slow and you are able to really take in this amazing mosaic.

reviews.author: CandiesDelaCruz
reviews.title: Well Kept Mosaic
reviews.content: I come from a country where everyone loves to vandalize walls. I am impressed at the fact that murals are kept intact and maintained. Its a very long art work. Its good to look at for the drive from Hanoi to the airport. Although, I wouldn't recommend stopping by for pictures.

reviews.author: Slipstream222
reviews.title: Hardly a tourist attraction
reviews.content: Public art spanning the main drive from the airport - varied and pretty but not sure your mistaking it for the louvre as an attraction

reviews.author: TerenceTorontoCanada
reviews.title: Good Mosaic on life in the country
reviews.content: Interesting Mosiac, the bus centre is opposite part of the Mosiac and it depicts like and culture in the country. Did not make an attempt to specially view it but saw it several times as our car or bus passed by.

reviews.author: iamarugger
reviews.title: Enjoy the Mural on your way in to Hanoi from the airport
reviews.content: I wouldn't make a trip out to see it but it is a nice view as you drive in to Hanoi from the airport.  It is impressive how long and how much detail went in to the Mural.  I'm a  big fan and always enjoy looking at it on the drive in to the city.

reviews.author: Chris101111
reviews.title: Stunning.
reviews.content: This strip of mosaic wall is around four kilometres long, all different tiles and colours, all hand made, it is truly beautiful.You can see it from the road getting close up in some parts is hard.I highly recommend it to view.

reviews.author: Vnvet68
reviews.title: One of the most interesting pieces of art I have seen.
reviews.content: It stretches for about 5km along a thoroughfare in West Lake. It is quite impressive, especially when viewed from afar. Created to honor Hanoi's 1000 year old history. Nice art.

reviews.author: Eurodog2013
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: Along a very busy road you come to a beautiful mural painstakingly put together by local artists and other professional artist from differnent parts of the world - a tribute to their 1000 year birthday celebration. a true must see in this beautiful city.

reviews.author: JudyO4
reviews.title: Colourful
reviews.content: Hard to see close up but fun to get glimpses of as you pass by in a taxi from the airport or on a cycling tour in the crazy traffic

reviews.author: Christopher
reviews.title: Cool public art
reviews.content: Cool piece of public art which stretches a long way down a busy road in Hanoi. It is a nice mural and you can always find something new which speeding past in a taxi.

reviews.author: Huy P
reviews.title: Humble yet interesting
reviews.content: A tribute to the 1000-year-birthday of Hanoi. Not something that you can watch closely or have hands-on experience, but a catch of the eye while riding through the streets.Nice to enjoy if you're not a driver!Very colorful. It contains some famous tourist spots and Vietnamese folk stories.

reviews.author: cjwlutton
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: Drove past this several times and as the traffic was busy managed to see most of it, shame this is not on the standard city highlights tour

reviews.author: aapg888
reviews.title: Roadside popular art.
reviews.content: It is hard to view this tribute to Hanoi's 1000th year, as road has fast-moving traffic & we could not park in the area.

reviews.author: dinnosaur
reviews.title: Impressive
reviews.content: Saw it from atop Long Bien bridge. It's a long one that looks like it never ends.  Quite awesome and cool street art. You should see it if you're nearby.

reviews.author: Moo1964
reviews.title: Stunning to see
reviews.content: It is in immaculate condition and no one would deface it. It goes on and on. Very beautiful to see. An unexpected suprise.

reviews.author: Ian B
reviews.title: Great, if you like mosaic
reviews.content: beautiful place, that will inspire you to come home and do mosaic for your garden. Clever design. Worth a visit!

reviews.author: Donna RTG
reviews.title: 1010 to 2010
reviews.content: This exquisite Ceramic Mosaic Mural celebrates Hanoi from 1010 to 2010, and as the worlds longest is a fitting tribute to this wonderful city.  Each panel in intricately detailed, in an array of colors and shapes. Over the course of our 5 day visit to the city, I managed to capture no less than 200 great photos of this beautiful work of art.

reviews.author: Rev-D
reviews.title: This wall stretches for 5km
reviews.content: It's a beautiful way for a city to stop graffiti. It's far to beautiful to damage and while it's just a freeway wall it does a lot to make the surroundings more beautiful as you traverse the city or come to or from the airport. It's a major street so you can't miss it.

reviews.author: eoulo
reviews.title: Crumbling - pls repair
reviews.content: This world record wall was gorgeous when it was first finished. On this trip, however, I noticed that many parts of the wall are missing tiles or crumbling and cracking. Def a must-see, but also hoping in a few more years it won't have disappeared.

reviews.author: janice655
reviews.title: A must visit
reviews.content: Brilliant very creative people, it was amazing to walk around and watch what was happening, the staff are so friendly and very interested in what they do, ask also lots of questions of the tourists.

reviews.author: Penny C
reviews.title: Watch out for this beautiful mosaic mural along the main highway
reviews.content: This mosaic is a series of designs along several kilometres depicting all kinds of life in Vietnam. It is simply lovely

reviews.author: Amelia0487
reviews.title: Beautiful!!!
reviews.content: Nice street with lots of history during nearly 5km. The only thing i dislike is that I saw a young man peeing into this street. Freaking out and run away quickly

reviews.author: pquijarro
reviews.title: beautiful!!!
reviews.content: passed by not on purpose but it was amazing to meet this sooo beautiful kilometers long mural, well constructed, colorful, must have taken a lot of work but it was worth!! very nice!

reviews.author: Us2inNI
reviews.title: what a sight
reviews.content: this is really great - goes on for ages - must have taken a ton of work to complete and it worth a half hour of your time to walk along and see it

reviews.author: Olwyn S
reviews.title: Impressive
reviews.content: Only drove past this en route to another attraction but was amazed at the length of this wall and the intricate mosaic designs along its 4 kilometres. It certainly adds some colour to the drabness of the surrounds.

reviews.author: artalmon
reviews.title: Beautiful street Alex Talmon-l'Armée!
reviews.content: This mural and its story is fantastic. Get on a scooter and drive along the mural. If possible, sit on the back of the scooter to be able to take pictures or film the trip!

reviews.author: Carolynn C
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: As a mosaic artist of over a decade the work that has gone into this endless ceramic mosaic along a long road is incredible. Ask the taxi or tuk tuk to drive along it if you do not have time to walk

reviews.author: saman688
reviews.title: great products
reviews.content: It is very nice to see how they produce them an here are different veraiteis . But i do not know the prices are goo for the tourists. Most probably high price for tourists. Try to bargain.

reviews.author: BahaiJim
reviews.title: WOW
reviews.content: A source of national pride that runs forever with no graffiti! Hundreds of different sponsors and themes are represented. Beautiful.

reviews.author: Jaetomk
reviews.title: Super long mosaic
reviews.content: The mosaic is visible along the drive into the city from the airport. It seems to go on for miles and good to look at from taxi. Didn't feel compelled to go back later for a slower look.

reviews.author: Nicola H
reviews.title: Very unusual
reviews.content: Fascinating, well constructed feature. Interesting history portrayed on the wall. Everywhere you go you seem to see this wall.

reviews.author: My-Linh P
reviews.title: Wonderful Idea... Poor maintenance
reviews.content: If you are into art, yes, definitely a must-see. You will see a wonderful collection of murals from kid-painting to famous artists' work, all connected and flow together. The downside of it is that there is no particular theme, some parts are sponsored by big companies (so you probably ended up seeing their logos most likely) Overall, I would recommend ride a bike or take a cab. It's an interesting walk but I don't think it is worth the effort. Some parts are urinated on (naturally by both human and animals) - poor maintenance in general

reviews.author: RSearth
reviews.title: Amazing must see
reviews.content: Its definitely worth going to see this. Its amazing to see such stuff in Asian countries. The colors and magnitude of the work is worth visiting.

reviews.author: MsSpreng
reviews.title: Great Vietnam Wall
reviews.content: It was a great wall, very long but with very impressive mosaic art.  It is also very long so great to see by bike or bus.

reviews.author: sachadad
reviews.title: very long mosaic
reviews.content: we saw this from the bus. longest mural in the world etc. lots of detail of ethnic minorities and countryside. sadly the weather is taking its toll. difficult to make a specific visit as it is on avery busy road

reviews.author: ChiwitKongNakMuay
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.content: So captivating,creative,thought provoking and extremely unique. On 5 October 2010, Guinness World Records adjudicator, Beatriz Fernandez, undertook an official review of the Hanoi ceramic mosaic to confirm its dimensions and ensure the strict guidelines relating to the record had been followed. Ms Fernandez confirmed that at 3,850 linear meters (6,950m²) of the Hanoi Ceramic Mosaic Mural was the world’s largest ceramic mosaic and awarded a Guinness World Records certificate. It is a must see for visitors who appreciate creative art.The mosaic wall is made from ceramic tesserae which are product of Bát Tràng, a village famous for its Bát Tràng porcelain.  The content of the mosaic represents the decorative pattern from different periods in the history of Vietnam: Phùng Nguyên culture; Đông Sơn culture; Lý Dynasty; Trần Dynasty; Lê Dynasty and Nguyễn Dynasty. Also incorporated on the wall are modern art works, paintings of Hanoi and children's drawings. Just walking along the road is a breath of fresh air from the bustling Old Quarters.

reviews.author: G C
reviews.title: Unique roadside artwork with many fascinating themes
reviews.content: The Mosaic Mural of Ha Noi depicts a diversity of interesting themes along its 7 km length, each artistically rendered in delightful fashion... the panels range from simple to complex, and they evoke history, nature, a bit of humor, and even a famous painter (e.g. there is a section that has the bright colors and images from one of van Gogh's works).  The Mural is best enjoyed on foot, but if time is short, a vehicle/taxi offers a good alternative (if you can convince the driver to use the lane closest to the wall... rush hour traffic also helps to increase viewing duration too :).  Enjoy this unique outdoor art exhibit!

reviews.author: JillConnecticut
reviews.title: Artistic addition to the road
reviews.content: Given the fast pace of traffic, you wonder how this was ever completed.  Interesting to see but most people are focused on dodging other cars to really look closely at it.

reviews.author: Bert W
reviews.title: Beautiful road
reviews.content: We walked the ceramic mosaic wall fromTran Nhat Duat to the end at Long Bien Bridge. You really have to walk to appreciate it, get out of the taxi. You have to make some effort because all of the traffic on this busy main road. Also a good place to see some great "tube houses". Have a look at the photos!

reviews.author: Soledad M
reviews.title: Some color to the smog around
reviews.content: Walk around the long avenue Nigh tham and take a look to this also long wall with mosaic and ceramics with different motif. If you are an expert traveler..this wouldnt be so interesting. Lack of maintenance and dirt all the way.

reviews.author: Tej C
reviews.title: Worthy of a visit if you have the time
reviews.content: A nice place to pick up painting made of egg shells. One of the only fine art that is practiced around the world and prevalent in Vietnam. Buy some wonderful collections of painting and also get to see how it is done first hand.

reviews.author: mmlosey1119
reviews.title: Surprise find
reviews.content: I was surprised to see this in the city and on Trip Advisor as I didn't really think of it as something specific to go visit.  It runs along the main road so you sort of take if for granted when you are riding in the cabs or buses.  I didn't actually get out and walk along any of it but viewed it from the vehicles.  It is quite impressive how large it is and how detailed it is.  I like the different scenes and variety that is depicted throughout its length.  It is in the Guinness Book of World Records as the largest ceramic mosaic and was completed in 2010 in celebration of Hanoi's Millennial Anniversary.

reviews.author: apritchy
reviews.title: I dont know why this is on trip advisor
reviews.content: This mural is a beautiful mural but it runs along the main highway so not a place to visit but nice to see from the car.

reviews.author: margaret P
reviews.title: Hanoi central mosaic mural
reviews.content: This exquisite mural runs for 7 kilometers thought the central city. You will see it going around town and just need to pay attention - nothing special needs to be done to visit it. It is extraordinary in its scala as well as its diversity and details.

reviews.author: toobusyvol
reviews.title: Beautiful Surprise
reviews.content: The detail in this mosaic is incredible.  What a lovely gift to travel past this beautiful mural for what seemed several miles.

reviews.author: NamutKwu
reviews.title: A spectacular Roadside mural that Goes on and on..
reviews.content: This is an amazing piece of extended art stretching for a considerable distance along the road to the Westlake area. Possibly one of the largest mosaic mural on earth--beautiful and we're sure it tells a story...

reviews.author: seasidevally
reviews.title: Hard to admire but worth driving along
reviews.content: This mosaic runs for 7 k along a busy roadway to mark the 1000 years of Hanoi. It's in good condition in most places but you need to be in the right lane and get your driver to go slow!

reviews.author: Roser
reviews.title: Unique in the world.
reviews.content: I have never seen such a Ceramic Mosaic like this. Made in 2010 the maintenance is awesome and it's a huge work. Eeverybody should have a look and take photographs.

reviews.author: Zonpwint
reviews.title: Nice mosaic work
reviews.content: Very long ceramic wall near old quarter. we just walked and it never ending. some very nice art creation and flowers. really like it.

reviews.author: ngadang87
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: I love these paiting on the wall, impressive, meaningful and some are really funny :). You should come there in the morning and walk, it's better if you can find a Vietnamese to tell you what the painting means.

reviews.author: yongsun c
reviews.title: Just a look on passing
reviews.content: A long and boring wall beside crowdy road.If you're fortunate, you can find it on your way back to the Noibai airport.

reviews.author: Jill A
reviews.title: Wow!
reviews.content: We drove along this wall today as we departed Hanoi.  It went on for a very long time.  It is a beautiful piece of art.  I cannot imagine the amount of work that went into designing the various themes and laying the intricate tiles.  This should not be missed.  Driving by it in a taxi we had a good vantage point to see the pictures.  The detail and colours are amazing.  I have never seen anything like it before.  So glad we didn't miss this.

reviews.author: MBQ
reviews.title: Beautiful and Interesting
reviews.content: Passed this on our way to the airport, wish we had had more time to really see it.  About 4 miles long and each section beautifully done by a different artist.  At night, the mosaics sparkle.

reviews.author: Linhlinh2014
reviews.title: This is a special road where you can learn Vietnamese historical legend and culture
reviews.content: The pictures, actually the historical stories and culture as well as tradition in Vietnam are described finely on the tiles. This wall is very long.

reviews.author: Lea32_11
reviews.title: worth the walk
reviews.content: An amazing journey of 10km celebrating the 1000th anniversary of the city of Ha Noi, full of fantastic images that speak to the history of this city

reviews.author: Ngoc C
reviews.title: Good act but won't survive long
reviews.content: This was made for Hanoi 1000 years anniversary ( which costs much as well). Disappointedly, they forgot how to keep it live long. Local government and people must give a hand to protect, the quickest

reviews.author: thetwomuskateers
reviews.title: Colourful surprise!
reviews.content: Extremely colourfully decorated 'mosaic wall' lining the route to the airport for more than a mile. Probably best seen from a taxi.

reviews.author: Stephen-O
reviews.title: Siting poor but it is beautiful
reviews.content: It is a shame this mural is where it is. Though it was intended to beautify a dyke wall it is such a success it maybe could have been done in a more accessible space. It is an extremely long tiled mural, illustrating decorative patterns from various times in Vietnamese history as well as childrens' paintings and scenes of Hanoi. It has been beautifully designed and executed. The colour across the mural is striking. Unfortunately, most people who view it, do so from their taxi or car. The locals fly past, its  just "there". For the tourist, its well worth viewing but be very aware of the traffic. The mosaic was started in 2007 to commemorate the Millennial Anniversary of Hanoi in October 2010 and was the result of an architecture competition. The mosaic is  built on a 4km dyke wall and is in the Guinness Book of Records as the world's largest ceramic mosaic.

reviews.author: HarpistSantaFe
reviews.title: Wow
reviews.content: I wish there were more information about this extremely LONG mural.  It is gorgeous and obviously the product of numerous designer.  Perfect exectusion and lovely.

reviews.author: Annette O
reviews.title: Exquisite Public Art!
reviews.content: Driving past this mural made me grateful for traffic jams. The stories of Vietnam's rich history are beautifully rendered with changing styles of tiles and techniques. It was my absolute favorite attraction in a fascinating country.

reviews.author: PreeChee
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: It stretches for ages and every bit is different. I saw it from my cab and really regret not being able to click photos.

reviews.author: Willson_Tang
reviews.title: Beautiful Work of Art
reviews.content: I like these Mosaic that stretch along the street. It is so beautifully created and colourful. It show the heart of the people and the culture. A must to walk along and see these beauty!

reviews.author: HoneycombDreamers
reviews.title: One Thousand Years
reviews.content: A fantastic mural, with very little damage, celebrating one thousand years of Hanoi. The centre uses coloured tiles and the ends of the mural finish in brown and white. The depictions of the animals and plants are beautifully done. Crossing the roads can be hair raising experience and the walk can be a noisy journey. But interesting for those who like art and murals. The images are always changing as you walk, or, drive past. It isn't one repeative design.

reviews.author: FifiCapeTown
reviews.title: Worth driving the entire length in a taxi
reviews.content: The only disappointment is the fact that it is not very accessible....but it is probable that your taxi journey back to the airport will drive the full length so you can see all the different sections. From the taxi I was able to get some ok photos and on the other side of the road in the morning you should get to see barbers with their customers on the side walk/pavement shaving or giving a haircut......but the traffic is manic ...plenty of u turns on the so called dual carriage way and motorbikes and Vespas driving on the wrong side of the road or just cutting across to turn left into oncoming traffic....get your camera ready as that is also worth experiencing.....so unless you are hardcore then better to view everything from the comfort of a cab!

reviews.author: mrbin
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: 2 km of mosaic colored, but on border of noisy street Au Co and thousands of cars and motorcycles that pass all the time, not easy to make nice pictures.

reviews.author: JillClardy
reviews.title: Beautiful and Unique Public Art
reviews.content: Installed on the wall of the dike that separates the city from the river, the ceramic mural is made of tiles manufactured in a nearby pottery village. The content of the mosaic represents the decorative pattern from different periods in the history of Vietnam: Phùng Nguyên culture; Đông Sơn culture; Lý Dynasty; Trần Dynasty; Lê Dynasty and Nguyễn Dynasty. Also incorporated on the wall are modern art works, paintings of Hanoi and children's drawings. The mosaic now holds the Guinness Book of Records for the longest mural in the world. It is quite interesting and colorful and certainly brightens some otherwise drab and shabby areas of the city. I tried to get closer one morning to take pictures, but lost my nerve when trying to cross the congested street. It's best to admire it from inside a car or bus !

reviews.author: Kevin_McL63
reviews.title: colourful
reviews.content: Built to celebrate 1000yrs of Hanoi as the capital of North Vietnam this adds colour and interest along the main thoroughfares in the city

reviews.author: marny1
reviews.title: Mosaic wall looks so impressive
reviews.content: I drove by this mural numerous times.  The problem is it's almost impossible to get close enough to take your time and study it, which is what I wanted to do.  There was a small sidewalk, but, with the  busy road it makes it difficult to get close to..What I was able to see was very impressive.  I hope a book comes out so I can see the whole 5 km

reviews.author: anakie432
reviews.title: amazing work
reviews.content: as a mosaic artist of over a decade the work that has gone into this endless ceramic mosaic along a long road is incredible. ask the taxi or tuk tuk to drive along it if u dont have time to walk it

reviews.author: Ranjan M
reviews.title: Unending mural that just goes on an on
reviews.content: Gave up trying to find the beginning and end of this ceramic mural that is by the roadside and created to celebrate the millenium.  It is colourful and well maintained has creative themes and also is in the Guiness Book of records.

reviews.author: Kid_U_Not58
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.content: Done to celebrate Hanoi's 1,000 year "birthday", this mural is incredible.  It is on the wall of the dyke system, and each section is a work of art.  Some were sponsored by businesses, and each section shows a different way of life in Vietnam.  Some are floral, some are animals, some are scenes - and they are all so well done.  I would have loved to have longer to view them, but we seemed to drive past them and have nowhere to pull up to walk along them.  It entered the Guinness Book of Records as the world's longest pottery mural.  Very impressive!

reviews.author: SCalCanz
reviews.title: Fun to Walk
reviews.content: A great area to view after a walk on the Long Bien Bridge.  Great variety of murals and some outstanding and unique works.

reviews.author: poodlena
reviews.title: Street Art
reviews.content: Positively amazing and not to be missed.  You will see this by car.  It shows the spirit of this city.

reviews.author: VioletQ
reviews.title: Unique Street Art...That's All I Can Say
reviews.content: It appears to be really unique - a sophisticated ceramic mosaic mural on the wall - and can be seen as one of the most iconic landmarks of Hanoi. They say that it is 04km in length and was completed in 2010 to commemorate the city's millennial anniversary. Though it has somehow deteriorated through years due to neglect, I still find it an impressive public work of art.

reviews.author: AnthonyRH
reviews.title: impressive
reviews.content: It is an impresssive stretch of wall murals indeed - done in mosaic. very interesting to look at and certainly took lots of efforts to put it together

reviews.author: Holly_Golightly_13
reviews.title: Four Miles Long
reviews.content: This is crazy!  Four miles of mural - let alone, one of mosaics!  Based on bad map-reading, I dragged my husband along about a mile and a half of it.  It's amazing.  If you decide not to brave the traffic walking along it - be sure to at least drive some of it.  The sheer vastness and variety is truly impressive.

reviews.author: Snehvide1990
reviews.title: Nice but not worth a trip
reviews.content: It is REALLY amazing and pretty - BUT it is not worth going out to as a trip I guess. We saw it when driving away from the cities and had time to really enjoy it from the car windows, but I think a trip there would have been boring - it's great to look at, but that's it :)

reviews.author: Richard G
reviews.title: Great artistry
reviews.content: The quality and quantity of the mosaic mural was amazing.  It seems like it is everywhere.   It would have been nice to see it under construction.  It must have taken a lot of skilled people to achieve it.

reviews.author: LorenzSingapore
reviews.title: Beautiful work of art
reviews.content: You'll pass by here as a start or end of on your way to and from airport, as this being outside the edge of old quarter. Beautifully created, you'll most likely catch fast glimpse of it from your transport. If you can, make a stop and stroll down to snap some photos.

reviews.author: tabukercon
reviews.title: beautiful art work
reviews.content: watching artist works on egg shells broken in the tiniest pieces is wonderful; out come is amazing, so beautiful, if I've not watched how work is done, I will not believed that art of work came from egg shell.  highly recommended.

reviews.author: Viviane H
reviews.title: Amazing work
reviews.content: Along a very busy highway along 4,2 km a colourful mosaic tells the story of Hanoi. It is made of billions of small pieces of shiny ceramic. It is most attractive. The various designs were made by different artists including children. The only problem is that you usually see it while in a car so it goes by very fast.

reviews.author: AussieNobles
reviews.title: Fantastic mosaic wall
reviews.content: What a great initiative for this wonderful city to celebrate its history in 2010 to construct this highly colourful wall, for several kilometres as you drive in towards the central area of Hanoi. Was eye-catching as you observed the numerous art styles. Congrats to the people who thought of this idea AND to all those who constructed it.

reviews.author: CYLau
reviews.title: A visual pleasure
reviews.content: Beautiful mural along a major road.  It was a nice distraction during a long taxi ride.  Not sure I would make a special trip, but well worth asking the taxi to drive by on the way somewhere.

reviews.author: Wendy P
reviews.title: Really neat
reviews.content: You see this out side the old quarter....it stretches for what seems miles and it is really interesting and beautiful...i work of modern art.

reviews.author: alvin f
reviews.title: unexpected treat
reviews.content: Probably not worth a special visit to, but should your journey take you this way be sure to look out for this amazing piece of urban art. It stretches the length of several roads and features a range of interesting designs.

reviews.author: TravellerFromSG2013
reviews.title: Excellent art work
reviews.content: The mural is wonderful.We had a walk along the mural under the sun. The walk was interesting by just seeing the mural.Can try a short walk while walking toward the west lake.

reviews.author: psagar
reviews.title: Loved the long mosaic mural
reviews.content: It is a really long mural along a major road and you can enjoy all the different panels while driving by slowly in your cab.

reviews.author: Martinas B
reviews.title: The longes Mosiac of the world
reviews.content: Colorful and veeery long, its so nice drive motorbike next this long mosaic, long and colorful. An Heaven in the middle of the dusty crazy traffic here

reviews.author: fjp4564
reviews.title: Largest ceramic mural
reviews.content: Visitors to Hanoi should take a walk along the this unique piece of art, on the retaining wall on the main highway.  It represents the many tribes of vietnam and their art and living in glorious colours.Wear a face mask when walking to avoid breathing in the dust off the main road. Truly a remarkable piece of art

reviews.author: Sparkie09
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: supposedly worlds longest mural according to our guide.. never ending  you see it as you drive by, we could not stop to admire it but it is an array of designs and colours.

reviews.author: Dani_brazil_to_the_world
reviews.title: Very neat
reviews.content: I thought it would be a bit cheesy, but I liked how they show a lot of images that evoke the myths and the vietnamese culture.

reviews.author: Estelle M
reviews.title: WOW
reviews.content: We stumbled across this by accident , but if you can get close to it you can admire the hard work. Its very pretty and very very very big!!!

reviews.author: morgana1625
reviews.title: the long walk
reviews.content: this is one of the best murals we have ever seen,wear good walking shoes take your camera and enjoy the scene

reviews.author: AlesBanhC
reviews.title: SO LOOOOONG!
reviews.content: Very long, clorful, beautiful, all along a very long road, you can walk or ride motorbike or drive car and looking at it make you feel so better , you will not feel the boring and annoyng traffic anymore!

reviews.author: Deb N
reviews.title: So much to see, every time you pass.
reviews.content: THis mosaic is a celebration for the 1,000 years of Ha Noi. I love looking at it every time I pass. It is on a busy road and it can be difficult to take photos if you are in a car.But there is always something new to see; something missed last time you travelled by.It is colourful and different parts have been completed by different groups. There is a lot of history encapsulated in this mosaic

reviews.author: Pamela W
reviews.title: Enjoyed it
reviews.content: We walked along part of this wall on our day trip with Hanoi Kids. Walked from Old Quarter to French Quarter then along part of the wall. The mosaics are outstanding - very detailed and show many symbols and places from Vietnam. Although I was convinced I saw the Sydney Opera House in one!  Well worth seeing at least part of it - makes for great photos and something a bit different to do. It's a busy road tho so I wouldn't take young children.

reviews.author: Lefeuilletonkinois
reviews.title: A landmark
reviews.content: If you want to enjoy this wall and remember it for ever, stand on the opposite pavement, wait for the right moment and take photos of bike riders with pointed hats, cart pushers or any kind of strange overloaded vehicle that goes along the dyke. The challenge being not to include cars in the pictures. It will give your photos an amazing background: sunsets, birds flying, giant heads of dragons, just walk and pick and choose. In the morning, there are more colourful street sellers coming from markets behind the wall and sliding along the mural.  Unique!

reviews.author: FireSpitter
reviews.title: Not really a place to "visit"
reviews.content: The mosaic wall is not exactly a place that you would visit as you are able to see it (On your left side) as you are approaching old quarters from Noi Ba airport.

reviews.author: Christina P
reviews.title: great
reviews.content: the long steet full of painting which tell story about hanoians, the culture, people, their lifestyle and history.

reviews.author: Martin N
reviews.title: An unexpected delight.
reviews.content: We didn't know about this mosaic mural in advance and only saw it on our way back to the airport, but it is well worth looking out for if passing, or even a dedicated trip if especially interested.

reviews.author: Jana C
reviews.title: A very long stretch of mozaic
reviews.content: I found this really interesting as this mozaic wall stretches for a long distance, you can see different pictures, elephants, flowers, farm life, much nicer then other "interesting" places in Hanoi!!!

reviews.author: pngocduong1
reviews.title: Beautiful Silk Village Experience
reviews.content: We visited Van Phuc Silk Village during our Hanoi trip,  Our driver recommended that we visit, and we’re so glad he did!It was very interesting to walk around the village and see the variety of silk products. There were so many beautiful silk clothes, scarves, and other items to choose from. We ended up purchasing quite a few pieces for ourselves and as gifts.It was a great experience and a nice opportunity to see something beyond the typical Hanoi attractions. I would definitely recommend stopping by Van Phuc Silk Village if you have time during your Hanoi visit.

reviews.author: Muriel B
reviews.title: Sumptuous clothes for a more than reasonable price
reviews.content: We don't know what to choose because all the clothes are beautiful and inexpensive. A magical place that can even be discovered by taking the metro (1 km 4 from the metro stop).

reviews.author: Dal S
reviews.title: See how silk is made, woven, dyed
reviews.content: Lots of vendors, makers, suppliers with a dizzying array of wares.  From bolts of fabric to finished product.  What a fun place to see weaving to finished product.

reviews.author: Adrian Villanueva
reviews.title: Handicraft Village
reviews.content: I really enjoyed this trip. The itinerary was perfect, hotels were comfortable, and the food was delicious. Thank you for such a memorable experience.

reviews.author: George E
reviews.title: Super great for social media content - but otherwise is mid
reviews.content: I might have come at the wrong time of day or wrong season - but this was mid. We were there midday, midweek.There was very few sight seers there when we went - despite many of the shops being open. There was a relatively pretty pagoda, and several well-painted murals to get a photo in front of. Overall the silk village made for some colourful and fun Instagram content (with all the umbrellas and murals) but did not necessarily provide a super fulfilling experience in itself. Maybe there is an on-season or on-time, but i guess we missed it.Most of the silk shops appeared to carry the same products (they were quite well priced). The main factory we could see into and appeared staffed and busy, but I think you'd want a guide to take you through there rather than showing yourself through.

reviews.author: Ightham1
reviews.title: Really enjoyable look into silk making
reviews.content: We took a Grab from the old quarter, which took 35 minutes. Lots of great shops as well as the sound of the looms producing the silk. The higher end stores were honest about whether an item was 100% silk or a silk linen mix, although they wouldn’t budge on price. We paid cash first our purchases which I think is the preferred route for the shops.

reviews.author: michelle B
reviews.title: WELL WORTH A VISIT
reviews.content: We really enjoyed our visit to Yan Phuc Silk Village.  It is very pretty as you enter under a sea of suspended pastel coloured umbrellas.  We wandered down an alley and into a small factory where we were welcomed by the two workers despite no one speaking the same language.  They indicated for us to come and look at them work, showed us their patterns and were happy for us to photograph...it was fascinating !!  As some have said there is a lot of similarity between the shops but as an experience we found it quite magical.

reviews.author: Mincimoo
reviews.title: Pretty colours but nothing special
reviews.content: I would avoid visiting on a Sunday, some shops closed. A nice experience to walk through but all the shops have similar fabrics. Nothing special and for tourists.

reviews.author: Scott V
reviews.title: FAKE FAKE FAKE
reviews.content: FAKE FAKE FAKE... they should call it "70% Silk Village. And either cotton or polyester blend cuz I don't know Village. Poor quality clothes for dumb tourists. It's all repeat cheap fake Chinese made clothing, some with fake brand names and all the same tags no matter what. It's swap meet and fake market goods made elsewhere. Better off at the markets in old quarter.

reviews.author: Saf Traveler
reviews.title: Greaqt experience, good shopping, great photos to be taken
reviews.content: Well priced silk items outside of the normal tourist areas.So cool to walk around here and just see all the beautiful things on display. If you've come to Vietnam to buy good stuff to take home as gifts and just generally for yourself, then you have to visit here.This is a 1-2 hour experience in a part of the city you may not always see.great photo opportunities

reviews.author: emmajfitzgerald
reviews.title: Umbrella Street is beautiful
reviews.content: We visited the Silk Village to see Umbrella Street, which is stunning. Other than that, there are places to buy silk here. It was a fair way from the centre of Hanoi so we had to get a taxi.

reviews.author: Dave
reviews.title: Good prices if you want clothes/materials
reviews.content: As someone noted, make sure you go to the right van phuc as this is not a unique place name.Accessible by grab (and return). We  got more or less what was wanted with some materials. Was a bit quiet with a few shops shut (time of day I think - mid afternoon). Fairly picturesque with less traffic than main roads and some street decorations. But yeah this is just a shopping trip to get best prices and options, was not looking for a history of silk making or something like that so think it does the trick as long as the shopping is what you want.

reviews.author: 672highf
reviews.title: Just A Shopping Trip
reviews.content: A very disappointing visit to Van Phuc Silk Village. My expectations where to see the production of silk from silk worm to finished product. Unfortunately the only facility for the production of silk was one example of an old working loom and some explanations of the processes by the in house guide.There are many shops/stalls selling silk products but very little of the silk for sale is manufactured in Vietnam and is readily available in any market just about anywhere in Asia. I found nothing that was unique to Vietnam.Much of the product for sale was labelled "Silk Like" and in fact was not pure silk but a blend and/or man made fibre.

reviews.author: Wanderlust3710
reviews.title: Great 1/2 day activity
reviews.content: We took a taxi from the old district to Van Phuc Village and shopped up a storm...  taxi ride was about $6 and takes about 45 mins....  make sure you have the Vietnamese translation for village as there is a Van Phuc street.  Prices tended to drop as we got further in....   not much for cafes but great selection of silk scarves, dresses etc.By going ourselves and not on a tour though, we didn't get to see the manufacturing process which I'm sure would have been cool...   btw most places only accept local currency

reviews.author: Jo-Ann
reviews.title: Beautiful Silk
reviews.content: Stalls and stalls of silk textile and clothes for sale. There are silk accessories for sale as well. If you are a silk lover, you must visit. I was more interested in watching them spin silk thread and weave silk textile. Very interesting. Loved the red silk thread.

reviews.author: leep700
reviews.title: I would skip this
reviews.content: Unless you are in the market for yards of silk I would skip this. It is one lane of shops all with basically the same wares. There is a loom working but I doubt the silks are made there! There were 2 displayed boards of silk worms. It is HOT! No place to sit down. Perhaps the tour was more interesting. We took a grab cab( like Uber) to the village. The silk scarfs and souvenirs are available in the old quarter or at any of the museums for the same price.

reviews.author: Steph B
reviews.title: A real insight into how hand and simple wooden machinery crafts work
reviews.content: I was astounded by how much beautiful cloth could be created by simple wooden looms in a tiny room. So much more wholesome and rewarding than big mechanised machine led operations. The factory owner we visited was really happy with his work.

reviews.author: rssunderwirth
reviews.title: cab driver didn't show us more interesting sights
