U can read  alot of story about the develop of buddhism in vietnam. Vietnam also had a buddhism party in the goverment. I had a very gread experience about Quan Su pagoda.I would recomment this hotel to all the buddhist.

reviews.author: Departure29314954105
reviews.title: Great national park Hanoi near
reviews.content: Great experience the park is clean and it’s beyond my expectation of a national park site with very cheap ticket and good food outside and also fresh air with many different varieties of projectors and trees and plants

reviews.author: Mama
reviews.title: Tourist Destination
reviews.content: this place is completely given to tourism, commercialisation and de-velopment. If you are 20year old guy with your girlfirend on the scooter its a good place to go. For sure its a bad place for wildlife and has nothing to do with conservation. There are some "wild"trials not maintained and generally blocked by fallen trees. If you love nature you will not like this place

reviews.author: Jinsung, Lee
reviews.title: The New Landscape of Vietnam
reviews.content: A tourist destination near Hanoi. The mountain is high and the road is good. The forest is gorgeous and there are various sights around, including folk villages. You can feel the old way of Vietnam.  An old cathedral that collapsed on the hillside.

reviews.author: MichaEu61
reviews.title: Short trip from Hanoi
reviews.content: Reachable by scooter from Hanoi in two hours. Some acceptable accommodation around the national parks. Far from mass tourism, especially during the week when there are no Vietnamese.Scenic beautiful area. Close to the Red River. Two nights are definitely enough. You should definitely take the more than a thousand steps to the two highest peaks to the temples and the pagoda. Great view with clear visibility.

reviews.author: D K W
reviews.title: Disappointing guide. Excellent aftercare by agent
reviews.content: Disappointing tour guide but great aftercare from customer services. Significant refund given after excellent customer service from the agent.Prompt pick up by guide and driver.After 2 hours in the car with the tour ‘guide’ and driver speaking between themselves and very little interaction with us we arrived at a gathering place. The guide said ‘that way walk and that way walk’, then pointed at two different staircases. He said 45 minutes each then we eat lunch. The first steps took us 15 minutes, the second steps took 40 minutes. We were then taken to some church ruins and had less than a minute of ‘information’ to say it’s there because of the french and then asked us if we were religious. When we asked if there was anymore to the trip or if he had any other information he said no. At which point he said ‘we go eat’ but when we said we werent hungry yet he responded saying ‘whatever, you want to go home’.The car ride home was extremely awkward and the guide was even swiping through tinder at one point. On the way back to our hotel the guide said ‘this is close to my home so i am getting out now and the driver will take you the rest of the way’, this left us with a driver that spoke no english. The driver also took a wrong turn, at which point we opted to get out and walk the rest of the way to our hotel.We could have booked a taxi for a lot less money and had the same/better experience. We complained to via tripadvisor and after discussing with the agent and them speaking with the tour guide they agreed to a partial refund. With polite and swift communication I cannot fault the agent.

reviews.author: Gertjan V
reviews.title: Definitely worth it! Good to do at the end of the trip.
reviews.content: We stayed just outside Ba Vi national park to take a taxi into the park in the morning. A nice trip style up but a very good road. Views are beautiful, going to the top is already a party. Arriving at 1000 meters with a van to the starting point of the routes we walked. Nice terrace with good man and then the trip to the Ho Chi Minh temple. More than 1200 steps challenging and doable. Stairs are made of stone and very easy to walk.  We don't see any tourists that's a relief after Hanoi. The pagoda is definitely worth it but the temple is really special. People are. Very open and also like to have a chat. If you're lucky like we are, people will offer you tea.  So relaxed.  Down and still to the upper temple some 950. Again locales who are sacrificing and giving unsolicited explanations. Ticket costs 60,000 VNDTrails to run well, reasonable condition required.No bugs or pests bothered. Very special experience and highlight of our trip. No tourists and super friendly local people.  Beautiful nature and impressive temples and customs. Night in the area gives peace, recommended. Also to do from Hanoi in a day but less relaxed and you experience less of the local people in the area. We did it the penultimate day to be able to easily get to the airport the next day (1.5 hours) and not back to busy Hanoi.

reviews.author: wendy d
reviews.country: Arthur's Pass National Park, New Zealand
reviews.title: Worth a visit
reviews.content: Went as part of a private tour. This is very much a locals location. So we felt honoured to be just a few of the westerners up the mountain. The walk up to Ho Chi Minh is over 1200 evenly sized steps, so although a lot, it is very achievable.The temple and pagoda and views (if the clouds break), are beautiful.abandoned church down the mountain was amazing.Definitely worth a visit. A spectacular day out. One of my highlights of 5 week visit to Vietnam.

reviews.author: karunayes
reviews.title: EXQUISITE EXPERIENCE
reviews.content: Nature is the ultimate luxury. Now, Nature plus eastern hospitality full of authenticity and warmth, in the purest 1930’s Indochina setting full of antiques and fine porcelain, wooden floors, high ceilings, indirect lightning, is the perfect way to land and begin experiencing Asia. Tour facilitators recommend you arrive from the west and spend a few days taking it easy to stabilize your body and adapt. Coming here, 90 min drive from hectic Hanoi was a perfect decision. The highlight of my month in SE Asia. A true experience for the senses. Family oriented, kind to the solo traveler, and highly recommended as a romantic setting.

reviews.author: Wander29593119161
reviews.title: Explore the Spectacular Beauty of Ba Vi National Park - An Ideal Destination for All Tourists
reviews.content: Explore the Spectacular Beauty of Ba Vi National Park - An Ideal Destination for All TouristsWe explore Ba Vi National Park through unique experiences, from natural beauty to recreational activities. Ba Vi National Park, one of the most wonderful natural wonders not only of Hanoi but also of the whole country, always an ideal destination for those who love the peace and beauty of the mountains and forests and want to temporarily get away from the hustle and bustle of the city. With this article, join us to explore Ba Vi National Park through unique experiences, from natural beauty to interesting recreational activities.Ba Vi National Park - a destination not to be missedLocated about 60km west of Hanoi center, Ba Vi National Park is part of the majestic Ba Vi mountain range. Known as the "green lung" of the capital, this national park not only impresses with the wild and majestic beauty of the mountains and forests but also with its biodiversity with many precious species of plants and animals. rare.Ba Vi National Forest - paradise for nature loversBa Vi National Forest is a place to preserve many types of ecosystems, from primary forests to regenerated forests, creating a cool, fresh green space. This is a great opportunity for visitors to explore the richness of the plant and animal world, from ancient trees to unique birds and butterflies.Entrance tickets and ticket pricesThe entrance ticket price to Ba Vi National Park is very affordable, suitable for all ages, ensuring an affordable yet experiential tour. Detailed information on ticket prices and how to purchase tickets can be found on the official website or at ticket sales points at the entrance.Traveling to Ba Vi National Park - an unforgettable experienceTraveling to Ba Vi National Park is not simply about exploring nature, but also an opportunity to participate in suburban activities such as picnics, camping, climbing, and even yoga in the middle of the green forest. There's nothing better than relaxing and re-energizing in the heart of nature.What does Ba Vi National Park have?Ba Vi National Park is not only famous for its mountains and forests but also for historical and cultural sites such as Thuong Temple, Jade Emperor Temple, and eco-tourism areas. Each location has its own mysterious and historical stories, creating a meaningful and educational trip.Note when visitingWhen visiting Ba Vi National Park, visitors need to pay attention to protecting the environment, not throwing trash indiscriminately and respecting the regulations of the conservation area. Please bring drinking water and snacks to ensure your health during your exploration.Why is Ba Vi National Park so interested in by many tourists?Ba Vi National Park is not only an ideal destination for those who love nature, but also a place that preserves many historical and cultural values of the nation. Let this tour become an indispensable part of your travel memories.

reviews.author: Nhà hàng Dung Tiến Ba Vì
reviews.title: Ba Vi National Park is an extremely wonderful vacation destination
reviews.content: I went to Ba Vi National Park, I really like it here, Ba Vi National Park has fresh air, very cool. Many check-in points to take beautiful photos. Especially the majestic and beautiful mountain view of Ba Vi National Park. Take photos with majestic clouds

reviews.author: Aurora princess
reviews.title: It's worth going, everyone
reviews.content: Every year I go to Ba district because of its many landscapes, especially Ba Vi National Park, which is very green and beautiful, suitable for treking and team building. Close to the city center, just over 1 hour to get there.

reviews.author: HMKaren
reviews.title: Beautiful park, check it out!
reviews.content: Huge, beautiful park with a lot of neat stuff to explore. We didn't have a whole lot of time to spend--we climbed up to Bao Thien Tower and (practically next to it) the Ho Chi Mihn Temple. After we came down we checked out the ruins of the French stone church. So all together, we were there for a few hours.The climb up the big hill to the tower and temple involved many, many stairs. But you are in the shade the whole time! Still, if you have mobility issues or you hate stairs, this one might not be for you. But it was really great once you reach the top! There are other people on the path with you, and there are plenty of benches and other places to stop and rest if you want to. I recommend bringing water.The park is full of beautiful flowers. Everything is so lush and green, and you hear constant bird song. For the record, we did NOT use our bug spray, and we had not trouble. No bug bites.The park is a 90 minute drive (60 km) west of Hanoi. We booked a driver with Golden Holiday Travel. He met us in the lobby of our hotel and took us straight there--no difficulty at all. Cost was $75. Admission cost: 60000 VND ($3) per person. I think your driver is free. There is a ticket booth right at the entrance to the park. Our driver stopped---we ran over and bought tickets. Super easy.

reviews.author: K Wang
reviews.title: Good for half-day getaway from Hanoi
reviews.content: The hike to the temple at the top is quite easy. Good for a quick getaway as the air is refreshing. However nothing much special here so if you want to be properly touristy, maybe this is not your best choice.

reviews.author: Tracy Hong
reviews.title: An escape from busy city
reviews.content: Located between Hanoi City & Hoa Binh Province, it's an ideal destination if you want a change of air from busy Hanoi. It's a long col but not too hard even for an amateur bike/ motorbike rider. Just be well noticed about the time when you get down: the sky darkens very quickly with a very thick curtain of fog and totally no light (often happens in winter). Be careful with that.You can have a great view down from the high mountains, see cloud shrouded forest and nice stream on the way, visit Ho Chi Minh Temple on the peak. That's a great feeling of being mixed with nature.If need more advise, you can ask me

reviews.author: GavanFreo
reviews.title: Ideal Day trip.
reviews.content: Just 55km from a Hanoi. The distance from the entrance to the top is about 12 km.... all uphill.  We hiked from the bottom which i only suggest if you are fit. On the way here is beautiful scenery and the ruin of the old church is very special. At the top there are lots of steps to get to a lovely pagoda and the Ho Chi Minh Shrine.

reviews.author: Liz S
reviews.title: Ride a bike to really explore
reviews.content: We rode motorcycles out from the city, there isn't much to see unless you research the trip. We found a really nice coffee shop along the way...Once at Ba Vi we found our homestay and ate lunch. There aren't many restaurants so a motel or homestay gives you food and a clean bathroom. We then spent the afternoon and early evening riding and exploring the national park. There are several points of interest but for us it was the old church. We made it to the temple around 4pm so it was dark coming down the mountain... if you want to do the temple perhaps go there first because it has many steps and you need daylight.I had read several posts that talk about the mist, I have included a photo... I personally think it created a cool atmosphere. On another side of the park is the waterpark and the waterfalls. This is a different enterance to the park.

reviews.author: Pavluna
reviews.title: Nice place in the nature, not far from Hanoi
reviews.content: We visited Bavi National park by car. It took us 1.5 hours from Hanoi. The entrance fee was 60,000VND/person (12 and older) and 20 000VND per car. There was quite a lot of people as it was Sunday, but most were only there for taking some selfies or to have a picnic. We drove to the uppermost parking lot (#7 on the map), where there are 3 possible ways you can go. We decided to go the the french political prison ruins. It was quite tricky to find as even the locals didn't know where it was but if you follow the signs that point to the toilets and continue down some relatively steep stairs you will reach them. On the way back I recommend visiting the Melia resort in the park just for a coffee. It's a bit pricey but beautiful.

reviews.author: Babar
reviews.title: Disappointing Trip
reviews.content: We traveled from Hanoi, and I don't feel the drive up was worth it. Make sure you pay attention when you travel, because it's possible with the rain and clouds, you'll get no views at all. There was some climbing of stairs, at the end of which there was a temple, a view completely obscured by clouds (although I'd seen it before, I'd still say it wasn't worth it), some expensive place to eat average food, an uninteresting pine tree farm that for some reason is marked as an area of interest, and some old church ruins (the most interesting part of the trip, but not worth it).

reviews.author: Maria Ver
reviews.content: Amazing place, park is huge, my tips: go there in the morning because there a long way from center of Hanoi , around 2 hourse by moto ,  evening is perfect time to see a sunset from the cliff

reviews.author: Too Yi
reviews.title: Motorcycle Ride Up To Ba Vi National Park
reviews.content: We were taking a ride up to Sapa from Hanoi and planned to take two days, with a stop in Yen Bai overnight on the first day. Ba Vi is roughly along the way to Yen Bai and is an easy detour to see some nice mountains and scenic places. Google maps brought us to Ba Vi National Park quite easily, without any problems along the way. The whole trip is at most 2 hours out from Hanoi, going at a reasonable pace on a motorcycle. If you don't have any experience on a motorbike, perhaps you may want to think about going up this place. It has hairpins and some reasonable inclines that might throw a new rider off. That being said, the roads are perfectly paved (as compared to some i have had the misfortune of going on) and the inclines are doable even on a bike with less power (125cc). Entrance Fees were VND65,000 per person, but I can't read or speak a word of vietnamese, so if they charged me extra, i have no idea haha. You pay for the tickets at the foot of the park and then travel uphill from there. We didn't have too much time, so we rode up to the Church and the temple. Interestingly, as it was a weekend, there were many young Vietnamese people at the Church's ruins, all having a wonderful day out and bbqing/picnicking around the area. The path to the Church is steeper than anything else there, so be careful if you're new or are riding a really crappy bike. The temple is right on top of the hill, just keep going upwards and you'll reach it.

reviews.author: Saf Traveler
reviews.title: Worth the mission for a day but go to Nimh Binh rather
reviews.content: It's a really nice motorbike ride up to the top but the jungle is so thick in the park that really the only place to stop is at the top parking lot. Otherwise it's steep uphill ride with just nice trees and couple stunning views. Then you walk up the stairs to the Pagoda. Nice walk but that's about it really. Not sure if I missed something but felt like that was all that was on offer.Make Ba Vi a 1 night thing if you want to get out of the city. But for the tourists out there, I'd say don't plan to go here when there are so many others things around that are way better and worth your time. Go to Nimh Binh instead.. honestly trust me.

reviews.author: Eilís K
reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.content: You can drive around this national park on a motorbike (semi automatic was fine) and see some stunning scenery and French ruins. Very few tourists around, we went on a Friday and had the whole place to ourselves.

reviews.author: Oliver S
reviews.title: Daytrip to Bavi
reviews.content: We took the Thang Long highway, that's quite nice. If you have time, there are also some nice pagodas in thach that, on the way. We started going from hanoi around lunchtime by motorbikes and it took us about an hour+, since we did some stops on the way. You gotta pay an entrance fee at the gates of the national park. From take a high res picture of the map, because there are no free maps. We stopped at couple places on the way(some random nice trail, leading to leech infested high grass and the french church)The road was cery good, but have to be careful of not going too fast, it's a mountain road. On top, you can choose between 2 summits or even both, we visited just one summit, since it's a hard climb. Don't remember the the name of it though, but the smaller one. The climb is hard, but doable even for old people. Nice views from the top, although should go before noon, because we were surrounded by cliuds and didn't see that much

reviews.author: David B
reviews.title: Clean mountain air, good sights, ancient French villas
reviews.content: Green and mountainous, clean air and wonderful views over the Red River plains. The overgrown remnants of old French colonial era villas were interesting, including the Melia Resort built on top of some of them. Many steps up to the temples. Part of Ho Chi Minh's remains are said to be entombed here (His main mausoleum is in Hanoi).

reviews.author: vincentloicbenoia
reviews.title: Great for a week end get away from Hanoi
reviews.content: It's best to go by motorbike so you can enjoy the scenery going up. A cute mountain with nice vegetation. The entrance to the park will allow you to go anywhere. Keep your tickets because it is requested to show it at all attractions. The old French church is difficult to find with only a sign on the left side of the road on the way up.The temple at the top is nice and worth stairs. Bring water and snacks for when you reach the top!

reviews.author: yenbaiecotour
reviews.title: So cool jungle trek route
reviews.content: There are many outdoor activities as well as entertainment. I visited there, enjoyed 3-hour trek route in the morning and get panoramic view from Uncle Ho Temple.In the afternoon, I visited nearby waterfall and got freshing swim at the fall.

reviews.author: BobbyNguyen_Vn
reviews.title: Great time in Ba Vi national park
reviews.content: We decided to have weekend tour around Hanoi and choose Ba Vi national park for 2 days. We were hiking thru the top of Ba vi mountain and see the amazing panorama of Hanoi and Da river. I stayed in Melia Ba Vi retreat, one of best five star retreat in Vietnam with peaceful and relaxed time.We hope to come back and relax when I have time in weekend.

reviews.author: Vanessa F
reviews.title: Amazingly good
reviews.content: We were a Group of  6 families with children of all ages from 3 to 13.We all loved it here. It is beautiful, truly stunning location. But be advised: it is quite far from Hanoi Center.The entrance for adults is 150k dong but the children fee is very “ify” so be careful because one family only paid 10000 dong for each child the previous time but this time they wanted to charge them as adults 😲🤔, children under 6 don’t pay. It is easy to see we’re the money goes because the place is well looked after. They made access to the falls much easier with steps and there are several tables and benches around for picnics. They made this area of the park very user friendly but, still difficult to access for a disabled or elderly. The toilets were not very clean at all.At the bottom of several fall they built 2 natural water pools ( one for little ones and one for bigger ones). The bigger one of the 2 has slides, flumes and a wave machine too.Great day outdoors for the entire family.

reviews.author: Taikaivietnam
reviews.title: Beautiful and romantic
reviews.content: I have been here with my closed friends, all of us love this place. I think it's much more better if you enjoy this place with your lover. Just laying down on the grass , chatting with your friend, tasting some beer and snack, enjoy the forest scenery, and riding motor bike along the Bavi national Park is an memorable experience for our team.Sometimes in life you walk over the hapiness but after a long time you had realized what it is.

reviews.author: Ryan G
reviews.title: Great Views & Escape From Heat/Noise of Hanoi
reviews.content: Ba Vi is a short drive from Hanoi. Road takes you mostly all the way up a mountain where there is a picnic area, bathrooms, and more. From that point you can climb the steps to two peaks. One peak takes you to a Confucius Temple. Several hundred steps make the climb. Note that it is very steep but not a long journey. The other peak has a temple dedicated to Ho Chi Minh. Over 1,000 steps but an easier climb. The views from the Ho Chi Minh side are incredible and there are several viewing platforms. Would recommend if wanting something closer than Sa Pa. we especially enjoyed the peace and cooler temperatures given Hanoi was over 100 degrees at the time of our visit.

reviews.author: Chloe_Nguyen83
reviews.title: Interesting trip by motorbike
reviews.content: It take about 1 hour from Hanoi to Ba Vi district and 30 minutes to reach to Ba Vi National Park. It's perfect place for escaping from hustle and bustle of Hanoi for one day. That trip has made me be impressed by the forested slopes of the mountain and spectacular views. However, you should carefully prepare all essential things such as raincoat, water, snacks and rent a good motorbike with $2-$4/ day. You should avoid rainy days to ensure your safety and your partner. Beside, price for a lunch is very expensive so that you should prepare some foods is the best way to both save money and have funny picnic with your team in the top of mountain.

reviews.author: Tony W
reviews.title: Antony
reviews.content: Went out to Ba Vi on Vespas whole group of friends had a great time nice ride  villagers scenery I'm sure there would have been more to see but had limited time ,would recommend a visit if your over in Hanoi Vietnam

reviews.author: Hai Anh Nguyen
reviews.title: Beautiful mysterious jungle
reviews.content: It costed 60,000VND for the entrance fee. Ba Vi national park is about 50km far from Hanoi city center, it is a good place for those who love nature and adventures. You can visit some sightseeings in the park for example: Cactus house, Bao Thien Tower, Thuong Temple, Ngoc Hoa Cave, Churches. Be careful with some small creatures in the jungle, especially during rainy days, the terrestrial leech can jump into your body and sucks blood very fast. Two of them bit me on my neck and my feet. Despite that annoyed cheeky creature, the national park is a worth visiting place.

reviews.author: MarijnHG
reviews.title: DIY bike adventure from Hanoi
reviews.content:
The main attraction here is to walk to the top from the parking at the end of the road into the park and enjoy the views from either one of two temples. The easiest way to get there by bike is to follow the CT 08 for 30km to where the road ends. Follow the curve going right there, on Route 21, and
proceed 26km to the village of Son Tay. There you'll take a hairpin turn on the road towards Khoang Xanh and the entrance to the mountain is 10km further along. This is also the most boring route so on your way back you could opt to go North a bit and follow the river back to Hanoi. This takes more time but is a very enjoyable ride. Having a map (Google) downloaded will pay off.

reviews.author: greg dennis
reviews.title: Mystical Mountain
reviews.content: On my single unplanned day in Hanoi a friend I met there, invited me to Ba Vi national park. It's 50km from Hanoi and not widely publicized. We went by public transport and taxi - total of about $15. Amazing spiritual place. Clean, fresh air and mystical atmosphere. Picnickers, campers, weddings, fountains. Only way to top by motorbike. I was swamped by friendly smiling people as not many tourists go. Steep steps to last bit of top but worth the effort. A full day required but unforgettable. My reward - my friend Khang had never been there before either and I was rapt to do it with him.

reviews.author: Hiếu L
reviews.title: In Love
reviews.content: If you have a short time to HaNoi, and travel with your love, should go to Back mountain (80km from HN center).If you go there, should stay at least 1 nights at Le Mont resort. They have several wood villas and just open to a small number of people so that it’s really quiet there. Not many dishes they can served but I bet that “less is more”.From there u can have a trekking to top of the mountain, It’s fricking but interestingIf u go there at the end of year (dec or Jan), the temperature is abt 2-10 C degree

reviews.author: Lily
reviews.title: Perfect trip
reviews.content: I've been to Ba vi national park twice and would love to come back.The view from the top is amazing as you are touching on sky with clouds.Driving by scooter to the top was good feeling and you have to walk by foot to the top too.It is aslo a good place for picnic with your friends.Recommend to visit on the season of wild sunflower (October and November ).It is so beautiful :)))

reviews.author: shaiannosaurus
reviews.title: Honestly quite disappointing and troublesome to get to
reviews.content: Firstly it is a huge hassle to get to the park unless you pay for an overpriced tour. We took the local bus to get the location, facing many communication issues with regards to what bus to take and where to drop off at. Even from the designated drop off point one still has to cab to reach the entrance. Renting a motorbike seems to be the only way to get to the park as it is extremely high up the mountain. This was another problem as they only have manual bikes and unlicensed people like ourselves struggled. Eventually the man who rented it to us had to ferry us there himself. The attractions themselves require separate hikes to view each of them and so I'd recommend bringing a comfortable hiking bag and wearing proper shoes as well as attire. It was very hot, humid and sticky and this is coming from a Singaporean who is used to this kind of heat and humidity back in my own country. The weather only allowed us to view the waterfall which was the first attraction, but it was frankly disappointing given the fairly long and arduous trek to reach it. The waterfall was not impressive at all and the trail was full of insects which was to be expected but posed a great irritation nevertheless. That being said, if one were to go early and can ride a motorbike, the park is a great place to spend a day, taking your time to get to each attraction and explore as much of the park as possible. There weren't many people and that made for a peaceful visit. Just be prepared for the steep trails!

reviews.author: Irma D
reviews.title: Chillful place
reviews.content: Ba Vi National Park is a peace/chillful place to take a rest from the rushing world of Vietnam. The park is located near to Hanoi. It is a really good adventure to visit this place with motorcycle. If You love hiking and the nature it will be an awesome day for You.

reviews.author: christianmccu
reviews.title: Perfect Day Trip
reviews.content: My friends and I rented motorbikes and drove out from Hanoi - it was the perfect day trip. There aren't many visitors to the park, so it's often hauntingly quiet and if you pay attention you'll see a lot of interesting wildlife. You can drive up to the top of the main mountain and explore some of the paths and trails, there are even a few pagodas at the very top - and the views are amazing. Around Ba Vi itself I'd also recommend stopping in town to try the fresh milk and yogurt.

reviews.author: Calmsloth
reviews.title: Peaceful & deserted trails
reviews.content: My boyfriend and I rented a motorbike from Hanoi and set off for a long weekend exploring Ba Vi. The route was relatively easy and took under two hours, we arrived around 4pm, checked into our hotel (Bach Duong) and went out to get some food. The place seemed deserted with the majority of food stalls empty or closed, perhaps because it was quite chilly and out of season for tourists. Nevertheless, we got some tasty pho and bun cha and enjoyed the peaceful surroundings.We had two days in/around the national park and it was eerily quiet the whole time - definitely a peaceful retreat for anyone wishing to escape the big city for a few days. During our time in the national park we went on three walks - the two peaks (both of which can be completed by anyone of average fitness) and a mystery trail from near the peaks into the forest. This trail was beautiful but also seemed abandoned - there was no one else on the walk and the path grew progressively more hazardous. After walking around two hours (after climbing the two peaks) we were tired and started to wonder when the walk would end - we soon discovered that the end point had been blocked off for construction work. This meant we had to clamber over a ten meter pile of rocks, wood and building materials to get back on the path. Fun; but maybe not to everybodies liking.It was very difficult for us to find food around/inside the national park, so would definitely recommend picking up some snacks in town & making sure you've had a big breakfast before entering the park.

reviews.author: TravelBugFilms
reviews.title: Amazing views - away from the normal tourist attractions
reviews.content: If you love a hike, getting our in nature and beautiful views....definitely make the trip to Ba Vi National Park. We hired a car for the day, found a local student to guide us from Hanoi Free Walking Tours and then headed out to Ba Vi. It's a two hour drive from Hanoi through small towns and roads with water buffalo to traverse, then you get to Ba Vi. We drove the long windy road up the side of the mountain and then started on our hike up to the pagodas. Our guide Thuy took us on lots of sneaky shortcuts climbing through the mountain which was so so much fun. We went up to a small tower style pagoda which was absolutely beautiful. Then we headed up to a temple dedicated to Ho Chi Minh. We didn't see any other tourists, only locals. The custom is to grab some junky food from a small shop on the way and then head up and have a picnic at the top. After the hikes and pagodas we headed to an abandoned, overgrown church which was incredible, we weren't able to stay there long because there was a bride wanting to take her wedding photos!On the way back down we went through flower gardens and then we paid 10,000VND per person to visit an awesome private cactus garden which had us feeling like we were on the film set of breaking bad. If you're sick of tourist traps, touters, tourists and traffic.....Ba Vi is the place for you. A tip: Due to the higher altitude, ba vi is colder than Hanoi so make sure to bring cold weather gear - but you might get hot in the sun or from walking so bring warm weather gear too.

reviews.author: Anyse J
reviews.title: For the handicapped, the steep and uneven walkways and roads are a huge obstacle.
reviews.content: I went to Ba Vi National Park with my flatmate and two of her students who are learning Vietnamese. It was so beautiful: a quick bus ride there and a short taxi ride to the park entrance. The admission is 40,000VND and I was warned about the steepness of the road, much less the off-road places. So, I went up the hill and into the park with the other 3 in a taxi and learned that there was no way for me, with terrible vertigo and balance problems, to walk around there. So, I went back down the hill to the entrance. However, I did take a walk along a road at the bottom of the mountains through Tan Linh Commune around a small, green valley. I took a number of very nice pictures, met a few Vietnamese along the way and enjoyed what I could have access to. It was, for me, disappointing and exhilarating. The houses, the livestock, the patterns of nature and more were new, fresh and resilient. Go there, even with a bit of a disability! It is beautiful, cooler than in Ha Noi (get away from the heat) and the panoramic views are so lovely and enticing.

reviews.author: Chris Koh
reviews.title: Unspoilt attraction
reviews.content: After visiting Hanoi for many years, i was kind of running out of places to visit. The travel agent recommended this less traveled location!It is only just over an hour from the city centre with the new highway. The parks has very few tourists but have quite a fair bit of students visiting in groups taking pictures. The pine forest near the entrance of the park is excellent for photography. The tranquility of the surrounding is what you cannot get in most attractions!A 15 minutes drive up a winding and narrow road will bring you to the foot of a 1000 steps flight of stairs. As it was very foggy, we did not climb up but was told there is a HCM temple up there and on a good day, the view is stunning!

reviews.author: Iryna B
reviews.title: Nice place to visit
reviews.content: Ba Vi National Park is a nice place to visit, especially if you like nature and would like to hike a bit. The area is quite big and you have several options: either to visit waterfalls, old church or hike to the top and visit few temples. The entrance fee is 40 000 (approximately 2 USD). I would suggest going there by bike or motorbike, since hiking to the top can take some time and there is parking for cars and/or motorbikes.

reviews.author: UMap255
reviews.title: Fantastic place for eco travelers
reviews.content: The idea of visiting Mount Ba Vi comes to my mind very fast, and I totally love the trip. It took me half an hour to going up the hills by motorcycle; along the road were wild flowers and large trees. There were several stops where tourists could buy food and rest. Attractions were ancient French colonists' ruins in the woods and beautiful Vietnamese temples on top of mountains. Prices were affordable. Perfect place for eco travelers and people wanting to take a break from the bustling city of Hanoi.

reviews.author: lanletuyet
reviews.title: Perfect for hiking
reviews.content: I was there twice, in summer and winter. It was a drizzling day in the winter of Hanoi and the wood was foggy looking like Alice's wonderland. In summer it would be a bit too hot but its still worth trying. The cactus garden was awesome. Most of the time the gate will be locked but if you re lucky then you'll be able to get in and see the treasure inside :)Bad campers left trash and p**pings in some places so pls beware. There are cleaners but its hard to keep the place all clean and natural without the supportive practices of campers/visitors. Pls dont be like those crappy visitors :(

reviews.author: Yoyo H
reviews.title: great day out of hanoi
reviews.content: we were  tired of hanoi and took a private car+driver for 45$ for the day for a trip to ba vi park. Great  weather up the top, great views and plants

reviews.author: K W T
reviews.title: Cool Air, Beautiful Scenery
reviews.content: Almost 2 hours up to the parking area. A bit of a winding road, make sure you get an experienced driver. But once up there, you'll see that its worth going up. Cool fresh air, beautiful scenery and you can hear the birds chirping. The tour guide mentioned 5000 steps or approximately 1 hours to climb up to the hill top to visit the pagoda and another 1 hour down. After 8-9 minutes, we gave up and went back down!!! And we feel so ashamed we couldn't finish the trip because on the way up, we saw a group of old ladies (maybe 60-70 years old who made it to the top, prayed and came down). Nevertheless, we had some great photo opportunities up on there. On the way down, we pit stop at a hotel (closed during winter) but the restaurant was open. Plenty of photo ops again. Downside to it is that they allow smokers (some Vietnamese group) to smoke inside the restaurant with the windows closed....kinda choking in there (luckily we found a place to sit outside with fresh air!)

reviews.author: Brayden_byn
reviews.title: Outstanding Sightseeing!!!
reviews.content: It's wonderful place for 1 day break to travel around Hanoi by motobike. When standing on the top of Ba Vi moutant, I feel like at Sapa which is so imposing and beautiful sightseeing. High recommend!

reviews.author: Adan c
reviews.title: Ba Vi Trekking Tour!
reviews.content: I had one more outstanding weekend. We had a day very tired because trekking 3 moutant of Ba Vi national park, but it's a amazing. After long climbing with my friend, we drank delicious milk, What's a fantastic feeling. Furthermore, i am heared about Thanh Giong stories by my Vietnamese friends when we drank milk. We spend more hour from Hanoi to Ba Vi by motobike. This place is very suitable for trekking and sightseeing with group friends.

reviews.author: Tri-Jimmy
reviews.title: Weekend break
reviews.content: Great views of the area and a nice way to see some beautiful Vietnamese countryside. Hard to find decent food nearby but we didn't go hungry!

reviews.author: Chu H
reviews.title: Fantastic national park
reviews.content: Ba Vi national Park is located near Hanoi, 60 km far from the city. It's seem to be a good trip with our motorcycles, easy to ride, climb up and walk around  the mountain. Good choice for weekend!

reviews.author: billyroo
reviews.title: Lovely day out away from hustle and bustle of Hanoi
reviews.content: We did a private motorbike trip to Ba Vi National Park. Great fun ride out took about 90 minutes. Beautiful cool air, lovely scenery, great food in the restuarant. We walked up 600 steps to the top to visit Ho Chi Min Temple well worth the climb, had a lovely cup of green tea up the top, made extra special by our two guides Kim and Ken from Funny Travel  Gia Ngu street Hanoi Old quarter.

reviews.author: tuananhhoang
reviews.title: Excellent national park, beautiful nature and environment
reviews.content: I, my wife and some friends love to travel to this attraction and we do it every year. It is simply an excellent national park with amazing trail for driving uphill, beautiful nature and environment. Good for sightseeing, trekking to the sacred Tan Vien temple and Ho Chi Minh temple on top of the mountains.

reviews.author: Jitze B
reviews.title: Great views, cool air.
reviews.content: Today we visited Ba Vi national park which is located some 65 kilometers away from Hanoi. Driving there takes around one hour, not counting driving up the mountain. Entrance fee for a car with two adults and two children is 140.000 vnd, just around 5 euro. The road leading to the main car park next to the top is good with some small parts but nothing scary. Once you make it to the car park you can climb another 200 meters on good rock stairs to get to the top. Admire the temple and the stunning views if it's not too cloudy. The temperature at the top is at least 5 degrees lower than at the entrance of the park which makes it quite refreshing. Recommended for a day trip if you did Ha Long bay and have a day extra when you are in Hanoi.

reviews.author: TallChris51
reviews.title: Enjoy the views
reviews.content: Lovely and under-used national park, with a good mix of scenery and a good road leading up to the summit. Some interesting diversions including ruined church and other buildings. Very atmospheric.  Plan well as there's nothing else around!

reviews.author: BurmeseDays
reviews.title: Hanoi day trips - Ba Vi National Park
reviews.content: Ba Vi National Park is a common day trip from Hanoi, but it seems to be difficult to find much information about it. We hired a driver for the day (~$50 US) and headed there. Trick 1: Get a map when you enter at the base of the mountain …. because there are none up the top. The map shows a couple of walks. The first one you pass, on the way up the hill, to a cave, was ok … cool to be in the jungle, but beyond the cave it got a bit overgrown. On the other side of the road there was another walking track which we attempted to follow … but this was super overgrown and turned into quite a mission. Trick number 2: Wear insect repellent because there are leaches. There are heaps of butterflies though, which is cool. Don't expect to see animals. We did see a couple of birds though. Lonely Planet had suggested there was an orchid garden and a bird garden, I had the ticket lady mark them on the map, but we did not find them - despite lots of looking around. There were plenty of facilities main parking area, mid way up the mountain. A couple of restaurants, accommodation etc…. although the main restaurant waved us away (possibly because there was another function on, possibly because we were not looking to sharp after our bushwalking adventures). Nevertheless, you can get food there.The main attractions seem to be the ruins of the french summer camp - which are pretty cool, and being overgrown by jungle. The tracks here are pretty good. And at the top of the mountain there is a temple dedicated to Ho Chi Minh. Again, the track is good, so easy enough to get there (if you don't mind the 1000+ steps). You'll either be up in the clouds, or have a good view. We had the former.Finally there are some really old and rare pine trees. There is a sign to these off the road on the way up to the HCM temple. These are also worth the walk (up) for nature nerds. The track was getting overgrown when we visited though.

reviews.author: Departure29314954105
reviews.title: Great national park Hanoi near
reviews.content: Great experience the park is clean and it’s beyond my expectation of a national park site with very cheap ticket and good food outside and also fresh air with many different varieties of projectors and trees and plants

reviews.author: Mama
reviews.title: Tourist Destination
reviews.content: this place is completely given to tourism, commercialisation and de-velopment. If you are 20year old guy with your girlfirend on the scooter its a good place to go. For sure its a bad place for wildlife and has nothing to do with conservation. There are some "wild"trials not maintained and generally blocked by fallen trees. If you love nature you will not like this place

reviews.author: Jinsung, Lee
reviews.title: The New Landscape of Vietnam
reviews.content: A tourist destination near Hanoi. The mountain is high and the road is good. The forest is gorgeous and there are various sights around, including folk villages. You can feel the old way of Vietnam.  An old cathedral that collapsed on the hillside.

reviews.author: MichaEu61
reviews.title: Short trip from Hanoi
reviews.content: Reachable by scooter from Hanoi in two hours. Some acceptable accommodation around the national parks. Far from mass tourism, especially during the week when there are no Vietnamese.Scenic beautiful area. Close to the Red River. Two nights are definitely enough. You should definitely take the more than a thousand steps to the two highest peaks to the temples and the pagoda. Great view with clear visibility.

reviews.author: D K W
reviews.title: Disappointing guide. Excellent aftercare by agent
reviews.content: Disappointing tour guide but great aftercare from customer services. Significant refund given after excellent customer service from the agent.Prompt pick up by guide and driver.After 2 hours in the car with the tour ‘guide’ and driver speaking between themselves and very little interaction with us we arrived at a gathering place. The guide said ‘that way walk and that way walk’, then pointed at two different staircases. He said 45 minutes each then we eat lunch. The first steps took us 15 minutes, the second steps took 40 minutes. We were then taken to some church ruins and had less than a minute of ‘information’ to say it’s there because of the french and then asked us if we were religious. When we asked if there was anymore to the trip or if he had any other information he said no. At which point he said ‘we go eat’ but when we said we werent hungry yet he responded saying ‘whatever, you want to go home’.The car ride home was extremely awkward and the guide was even swiping through tinder at one point. On the way back to our hotel the guide said ‘this is close to my home so i am getting out now and the driver will take you the rest of the way’, this left us with a driver that spoke no english. The driver also took a wrong turn, at which point we opted to get out and walk the rest of the way to our hotel.We could have booked a taxi for a lot less money and had the same/better experience. We complained to via tripadvisor and after discussing with the agent and them speaking with the tour guide they agreed to a partial refund. With polite and swift communication I cannot fault the agent.

reviews.author: Gertjan V
reviews.title: Definitely worth it! Good to do at the end of the trip.
reviews.content: We stayed just outside Ba Vi national park to take a taxi into the park in the morning. A nice trip style up but a very good road. Views are beautiful, going to the top is already a party. Arriving at 1000 meters with a van to the starting point of the routes we walked. Nice terrace with good man and then the trip to the Ho Chi Minh temple. More than 1200 steps challenging and doable. Stairs are made of stone and very easy to walk.  We don't see any tourists that's a relief after Hanoi. The pagoda is definitely worth it but the temple is really special. People are. Very open and also like to have a chat. If you're lucky like we are, people will offer you tea.  So relaxed.  Down and still to the upper temple some 950. Again locales who are sacrificing and giving unsolicited explanations. Ticket costs 60,000 VNDTrails to run well, reasonable condition required.No bugs or pests bothered. Very special experience and highlight of our trip. No tourists and super friendly local people.  Beautiful nature and impressive temples and customs. Night in the area gives peace, recommended. Also to do from Hanoi in a day but less relaxed and you experience less of the local people in the area. We did it the penultimate day to be able to easily get to the airport the next day (1.5 hours) and not back to busy Hanoi.

reviews.author: wendy d
reviews.country: Arthur's Pass National Park, New Zealand
reviews.title: Worth a visit
reviews.content: Went as part of a private tour. This is very much a locals location. So we felt honoured to be just a few of the westerners up the mountain. The walk up to Ho Chi Minh is over 1200 evenly sized steps, so although a lot, it is very achievable.The temple and pagoda and views (if the clouds break), are beautiful.abandoned church down the mountain was amazing.Definitely worth a visit. A spectacular day out. One of my highlights of 5 week visit to Vietnam.

reviews.author: karunayes
reviews.title: EXQUISITE EXPERIENCE
reviews.content: Nature is the ultimate luxury. Now, Nature plus eastern hospitality full of authenticity and warmth, in the purest 1930’s Indochina setting full of antiques and fine porcelain, wooden floors, high ceilings, indirect lightning, is the perfect way to land and begin experiencing Asia. Tour facilitators recommend you arrive from the west and spend a few days taking it easy to stabilize your body and adapt. Coming here, 90 min drive from hectic Hanoi was a perfect decision. The highlight of my month in SE Asia. A true experience for the senses. Family oriented, kind to the solo traveler, and highly recommended as a romantic setting.

reviews.author: Wander29593119161
reviews.title: Explore the Spectacular Beauty of Ba Vi National Park - An Ideal Destination for All Tourists
reviews.content: Explore the Spectacular Beauty of Ba Vi National Park - An Ideal Destination for All TouristsWe explore Ba Vi National Park through unique experiences, from natural beauty to recreational activities. Ba Vi National Park, one of the most wonderful natural wonders not only of Hanoi but also of the whole country, always an ideal destination for those who love the peace and beauty of the mountains and forests and want to temporarily get away from the hustle and bustle of the city. With this article, join us to explore Ba Vi National Park through unique experiences, from natural beauty to interesting recreational activities.Ba Vi National Park - a destination not to be missedLocated about 60km west of Hanoi center, Ba Vi National Park is part of the majestic Ba Vi mountain range. Known as the "green lung" of the capital, this national park not only impresses with the wild and majestic beauty of the mountains and forests but also with its biodiversity with many precious species of plants and animals. rare.Ba Vi National Forest - paradise for nature loversBa Vi National Forest is a place to preserve many types of ecosystems, from primary forests to regenerated forests, creating a cool, fresh green space. This is a great opportunity for visitors to explore the richness of the plant and animal world, from ancient trees to unique birds and butterflies.Entrance tickets and ticket pricesThe entrance ticket price to Ba Vi National Park is very affordable, suitable for all ages, ensuring an affordable yet experiential tour. Detailed information on ticket prices and how to purchase tickets can be found on the official website or at ticket sales points at the entrance.Traveling to Ba Vi National Park - an unforgettable experienceTraveling to Ba Vi National Park is not simply about exploring nature, but also an opportunity to participate in suburban activities such as picnics, camping, climbing, and even yoga in the middle of the green forest. There's nothing better than relaxing and re-energizing in the heart of nature.What does Ba Vi National Park have?Ba Vi National Park is not only famous for its mountains and forests but also for historical and cultural sites such as Thuong Temple, Jade Emperor Temple, and eco-tourism areas. Each location has its own mysterious and historical stories, creating a meaningful and educational trip.Note when visitingWhen visiting Ba Vi National Park, visitors need to pay attention to protecting the environment, not throwing trash indiscriminately and respecting the regulations of the conservation area. Please bring drinking water and snacks to ensure your health during your exploration.Why is Ba Vi National Park so interested in by many tourists?Ba Vi National Park is not only an ideal destination for those who love nature, but also a place that preserves many historical and cultural values of the nation. Let this tour become an indispensable part of your travel memories.

reviews.author: Nhà hàng Dung Tiến Ba Vì
reviews.title: Ba Vi National Park is an extremely wonderful vacation destination
reviews.content: I went to Ba Vi National Park, I really like it here, Ba Vi National Park has fresh air, very cool. Many check-in points to take beautiful photos. Especially the majestic and beautiful mountain view of Ba Vi National Park. Take photos with majestic clouds

reviews.author: Aurora princess
reviews.title: It's worth going, everyone
reviews.content: Every year I go to Ba district because of its many landscapes, especially Ba Vi National Park, which is very green and beautiful, suitable for treking and team building. Close to the city center, just over 1 hour to get there.

reviews.author: HMKaren
reviews.title: Beautiful park, check it out!
reviews.content: Huge, beautiful park with a lot of neat stuff to explore. We didn't have a whole lot of time to spend--we climbed up to Bao Thien Tower and (practically next to it) the Ho Chi Mihn Temple. After we came down we checked out the ruins of the French stone church. So all together, we were there for a few hours.The climb up the big hill to the tower and temple involved many, many stairs. But you are in the shade the whole time! Still, if you have mobility issues or you hate stairs, this one might not be for you. But it was really great once you reach the top! There are other people on the path with you, and there are plenty of benches and other places to stop and rest if you want to. I recommend bringing water.The park is full of beautiful flowers. Everything is so lush and green, and you hear constant bird song. For the record, we did NOT use our bug spray, and we had not trouble. No bug bites.The park is a 90 minute drive (60 km) west of Hanoi. We booked a driver with Golden Holiday Travel. He met us in the lobby of our hotel and took us straight there--no difficulty at all. Cost was $75. Admission cost: 60000 VND ($3) per person. I think your driver is free. There is a ticket booth right at the entrance to the park. Our driver stopped---we ran over and bought tickets. Super easy.

reviews.author: K Wang
reviews.title: Good for half-day getaway from Hanoi
reviews.content: The hike to the temple at the top is quite easy. Good for a quick getaway as the air is refreshing. However nothing much special here so if you want to be properly touristy, maybe this is not your best choice.

reviews.author: Tracy Hong
reviews.title: An escape from busy city
reviews.content: Located between Hanoi City & Hoa Binh Province, it's an ideal destination if you want a change of air from busy Hanoi. It's a long col but not too hard even for an amateur bike/ motorbike rider. Just be well noticed about the time when you get down: the sky darkens very quickly with a very thick curtain of fog and totally no light (often happens in winter). Be careful with that.You can have a great view down from the high mountains, see cloud shrouded forest and nice stream on the way, visit Ho Chi Minh Temple on the peak. That's a great feeling of being mixed with nature.If need more advise, you can ask me

reviews.author: GavanFreo
reviews.title: Ideal Day trip.
reviews.content: Just 55km from a Hanoi. The distance from the entrance to the top is about 12 km.... all uphill.  We hiked from the bottom which i only suggest if you are fit. On the way here is beautiful scenery and the ruin of the old church is very special. At the top there are lots of steps to get to a lovely pagoda and the Ho Chi Minh Shrine.

reviews.author: Liz S
reviews.title: Ride a bike to really explore
reviews.content: We rode motorcycles out from the city, there isn't much to see unless you research the trip. We found a really nice coffee shop along the way...Once at Ba Vi we found our homestay and ate lunch. There aren't many restaurants so a motel or homestay gives you food and a clean bathroom. We then spent the afternoon and early evening riding and exploring the national park. There are several points of interest but for us it was the old church. We made it to the temple around 4pm so it was dark coming down the mountain... if you want to do the temple perhaps go there first because it has many steps and you need daylight.I had read several posts that talk about the mist, I have included a photo... I personally think it created a cool atmosphere. On another side of the park is the waterpark and the waterfalls. This is a different enterance to the park.

reviews.author: Pavluna
reviews.title: Nice place in the nature, not far from Hanoi
reviews.content: We visited Bavi National park by car. It took us 1.5 hours from Hanoi. The entrance fee was 60,000VND/person (12 and older) and 20 000VND per car. There was quite a lot of people as it was Sunday, but most were only there for taking some selfies or to have a picnic. We drove to the uppermost parking lot (#7 on the map), where there are 3 possible ways you can go. We decided to go the the french political prison ruins. It was quite tricky to find as even the locals didn't know where it was but if you follow the signs that point to the toilets and continue down some relatively steep stairs you will reach them. On the way back I recommend visiting the Melia resort in the park just for a coffee. It's a bit pricey but beautiful.

reviews.author: Babar
reviews.title: Disappointing Trip
reviews.content: We traveled from Hanoi, and I don't feel the drive up was worth it. Make sure you pay attention when you travel, because it's possible with the rain and clouds, you'll get no views at all. There was some climbing of stairs, at the end of which there was a temple, a view completely obscured by clouds (although I'd seen it before, I'd still say it wasn't worth it), some expensive place to eat average food, an uninteresting pine tree farm that for some reason is marked as an area of interest, and some old church ruins (the most interesting part of the trip, but not worth it).

reviews.author: Maria Ver
reviews.content: Amazing place, park is huge, my tips: go there in the morning because there a long way from center of Hanoi , around 2 hourse by moto ,  evening is perfect time to see a sunset from the cliff

reviews.author: Too Yi
reviews.title: Motorcycle Ride Up To Ba Vi National Park
reviews.content: We were taking a ride up to Sapa from Hanoi and planned to take two days, with a stop in Yen Bai overnight on the first day. Ba Vi is roughly along the way to Yen Bai and is an easy detour to see some nice mountains and scenic places. Google maps brought us to Ba Vi National Park quite easily, without any problems along the way. The whole trip is at most 2 hours out from Hanoi, going at a reasonable pace on a motorcycle. If you don't have any experience on a motorbike, perhaps you may want to think about going up this place. It has hairpins and some reasonable inclines that might throw a new rider off. That being said, the roads are perfectly paved (as compared to some i have had the misfortune of going on) and the inclines are doable even on a bike with less power (125cc). Entrance Fees were VND65,000 per person, but I can't read or speak a word of vietnamese, so if they charged me extra, i have no idea haha. You pay for the tickets at the foot of the park and then travel uphill from there. We didn't have too much time, so we rode up to the Church and the temple. Interestingly, as it was a weekend, there were many young Vietnamese people at the Church's ruins, all having a wonderful day out and bbqing/picnicking around the area. The path to the Church is steeper than anything else there, so be careful if you're new or are riding a really crappy bike. The temple is right on top of the hill, just keep going upwards and you'll reach it.

reviews.author: Saf Traveler
reviews.title: Worth the mission for a day but go to Nimh Binh rather
reviews.content: It's a really nice motorbike ride up to the top but the jungle is so thick in the park that really the only place to stop is at the top parking lot. Otherwise it's steep uphill ride with just nice trees and couple stunning views. Then you walk up the stairs to the Pagoda. Nice walk but that's about it really. Not sure if I missed something but felt like that was all that was on offer.Make Ba Vi a 1 night thing if you want to get out of the city. But for the tourists out there, I'd say don't plan to go here when there are so many others things around that are way better and worth your time. Go to Nimh Binh instead.. honestly trust me.

reviews.author: Eilís K
reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.content: You can drive around this national park on a motorbike (semi automatic was fine) and see some stunning scenery and French ruins. Very few tourists around, we went on a Friday and had the whole place to ourselves.

reviews.author: Oliver S
reviews.title: Daytrip to Bavi
reviews.content: We took the Thang Long highway, that's quite nice. If you have time, there are also some nice pagodas in thach that, on the way. We started going from hanoi around lunchtime by motorbikes and it took us about an hour+, since we did some stops on the way. You gotta pay an entrance fee at the gates of the national park. From take a high res picture of the map, because there are no free maps. We stopped at couple places on the way(some random nice trail, leading to leech infested high grass and the french church)The road was cery good, but have to be careful of not going too fast, it's a mountain road. On top, you can choose between 2 summits or even both, we visited just one summit, since it's a hard climb. Don't remember the the name of it though, but the smaller one. The climb is hard, but doable even for old people. Nice views from the top, although should go before noon, because we were surrounded by cliuds and didn't see that much

reviews.author: David B
reviews.title: Clean mountain air, good sights, ancient French villas
reviews.content: Green and mountainous, clean air and wonderful views over the Red River plains. The overgrown remnants of old French colonial era villas were interesting, including the Melia Resort built on top of some of them. Many steps up to the temples. Part of Ho Chi Minh's remains are said to be entombed here (His main mausoleum is in Hanoi).

reviews.author: vincentloicbenoia
reviews.title: Great for a week end get away from Hanoi
reviews.content: It's best to go by motorbike so you can enjoy the scenery going up. A cute mountain with nice vegetation. The entrance to the park will allow you to go anywhere. Keep your tickets because it is requested to show it at all attractions. The old French church is difficult to find with only a sign on the left side of the road on the way up.The temple at the top is nice and worth stairs. Bring water and snacks for when you reach the top!

reviews.author: yenbaiecotour
reviews.title: So cool jungle trek route
reviews.content: There are many outdoor activities as well as entertainment. I visited there, enjoyed 3-hour trek route in the morning and get panoramic view from Uncle Ho Temple.In the afternoon, I visited nearby waterfall and got freshing swim at the fall.

reviews.author: BobbyNguyen_Vn
reviews.title: Great time in Ba Vi national park
reviews.content: We decided to have weekend tour around Hanoi and choose Ba Vi national park for 2 days. We were hiking thru the top of Ba vi mountain and see the amazing panorama of Hanoi and Da river. I stayed in Melia Ba Vi retreat, one of best five star retreat in Vietnam with peaceful and relaxed time.We hope to come back and relax when I have time in weekend.

reviews.author: Vanessa F
reviews.title: Amazingly good
reviews.content: We were a Group of  6 families with children of all ages from 3 to 13.We all loved it here. It is beautiful, truly stunning location. But be advised: it is quite far from Hanoi Center.The entrance for adults is 150k dong but the children fee is very “ify” so be careful because one family only paid 10000 dong for each child the previous time but this time they wanted to charge them as adults 😲🤔, children under 6 don’t pay. It is easy to see we’re the money goes because the place is well looked after. They made access to the falls much easier with steps and there are several tables and benches around for picnics. They made this area of the park very user friendly but, still difficult to access for a disabled or elderly. The toilets were not very clean at all.At the bottom of several fall they built 2 natural water pools ( one for little ones and one for bigger ones). The bigger one of the 2 has slides, flumes and a wave machine too.Great day outdoors for the entire family.

reviews.author: Taikaivietnam
reviews.title: Beautiful and romantic
reviews.content: I have been here with my closed friends, all of us love this place. I think it's much more better if you enjoy this place with your lover. Just laying down on the grass , chatting with your friend, tasting some beer and snack, enjoy the forest scenery, and riding motor bike along the Bavi national Park is an memorable experience for our team.Sometimes in life you walk over the hapiness but after a long time you had realized what it is.

reviews.author: Ryan G
reviews.title: Great Views & Escape From Heat/Noise of Hanoi
reviews.content: Ba Vi is a short drive from Hanoi. Road takes you mostly all the way up a mountain where there is a picnic area, bathrooms, and more. From that point you can climb the steps to two peaks. One peak takes you to a Confucius Temple. Several hundred steps make the climb. Note that it is very steep but not a long journey. The other peak has a temple dedicated to Ho Chi Minh. Over 1,000 steps but an easier climb. The views from the Ho Chi Minh side are incredible and there are several viewing platforms. Would recommend if wanting something closer than Sa Pa. we especially enjoyed the peace and cooler temperatures given Hanoi was over 100 degrees at the time of our visit.

reviews.author: Chloe_Nguyen83
reviews.title: Interesting trip by motorbike
reviews.content: It take about 1 hour from Hanoi to Ba Vi district and 30 minutes to reach to Ba Vi National Park. It's perfect place for escaping from hustle and bustle of Hanoi for one day. That trip has made me be impressed by the forested slopes of the mountain and spectacular views. However, you should carefully prepare all essential things such as raincoat, water, snacks and rent a good motorbike with $2-$4/ day. You should avoid rainy days to ensure your safety and your partner. Beside, price for a lunch is very expensive so that you should prepare some foods is the best way to both save money and have funny picnic with your team in the top of mountain.

reviews.author: Tony W
reviews.title: Antony
reviews.content: Went out to Ba Vi on Vespas whole group of friends had a great time nice ride  villagers scenery I'm sure there would have been more to see but had limited time ,would recommend a visit if your over in Hanoi Vietnam

reviews.author: Hai Anh Nguyen
reviews.title: Beautiful mysterious jungle
reviews.content: It costed 60,000VND for the entrance fee. Ba Vi national park is about 50km far from Hanoi city center, it is a good place for those who love nature and adventures. You can visit some sightseeings in the park for example: Cactus house, Bao Thien Tower, Thuong Temple, Ngoc Hoa Cave, Churches. Be careful with some small creatures in the jungle, especially during rainy days, the terrestrial leech can jump into your body and sucks blood very fast. Two of them bit me on my neck and my feet. Despite that annoyed cheeky creature, the national park is a worth visiting place.

reviews.author: MarijnHG
reviews.title: DIY bike adventure from Hanoi
reviews.content:
The main attraction here is to walk to the top from the parking at the end of the road into the park and enjoy the views from either one of two temples. The easiest way to get there by bike is to follow the CT 08 for 30km to where the road ends. Follow the curve going right there, on Route 21, and
proceed 26km to the village of Son Tay. There you'll take a hairpin turn on the road towards Khoang Xanh and the entrance to the mountain is 10km further along. This is also the most boring route so on your way back you could opt to go North a bit and follow the river back to Hanoi. This takes more time but is a very enjoyable ride. Having a map (Google) downloaded will pay off.

reviews.author: greg dennis
reviews.title: Mystical Mountain
reviews.content: On my single unplanned day in Hanoi a friend I met there, invited me to Ba Vi national park. It's 50km from Hanoi and not widely publicized. We went by public transport and taxi - total of about $15. Amazing spiritual place. Clean, fresh air and mystical atmosphere. Picnickers, campers, weddings, fountains. Only way to top by motorbike. I was swamped by friendly smiling people as not many tourists go. Steep steps to last bit of top but worth the effort. A full day required but unforgettable. My reward - my friend Khang had never been there before either and I was rapt to do it with him.

reviews.author: Hiếu L
reviews.title: In Love
reviews.content: If you have a short time to HaNoi, and travel with your love, should go to Back mountain (80km from HN center).If you go there, should stay at least 1 nights at Le Mont resort. They have several wood villas and just open to a small number of people so that it’s really quiet there. Not many dishes they can served but I bet that “less is more”.From there u can have a trekking to top of the mountain, It’s fricking but interestingIf u go there at the end of year (dec or Jan), the temperature is abt 2-10 C degree

reviews.author: Lily
reviews.title: Perfect trip
reviews.content: I've been to Ba vi national park twice and would love to come back.The view from the top is amazing as you are touching on sky with clouds.Driving by scooter to the top was good feeling and you have to walk by foot to the top too.It is aslo a good place for picnic with your friends.Recommend to visit on the season of wild sunflower (October and November ).It is so beautiful :)))

reviews.author: shaiannosaurus
reviews.title: Honestly quite disappointing and troublesome to get to
reviews.content: Firstly it is a huge hassle to get to the park unless you pay for an overpriced tour. We took the local bus to get the location, facing many communication issues with regards to what bus to take and where to drop off at. Even from the designated drop off point one still has to cab to reach the entrance. Renting a motorbike seems to be the only way to get to the park as it is extremely high up the mountain. This was another problem as they only have manual bikes and unlicensed people like ourselves struggled. Eventually the man who rented it to us had to ferry us there himself. The attractions themselves require separate hikes to view each of them and so I'd recommend bringing a comfortable hiking bag and wearing proper shoes as well as attire. It was very hot, humid and sticky and this is coming from a Singaporean who is used to this kind of heat and humidity back in my own country. The weather only allowed us to view the waterfall which was the first attraction, but it was frankly disappointing given the fairly long and arduous trek to reach it. The waterfall was not impressive at all and the trail was full of insects which was to be expected but posed a great irritation nevertheless. That being said, if one were to go early and can ride a motorbike, the park is a great place to spend a day, taking your time to get to each attraction and explore as much of the park as possible. There weren't many people and that made for a peaceful visit. Just be prepared for the steep trails!

reviews.author: Irma D
reviews.title: Chillful place
reviews.content: Ba Vi National Park is a peace/chillful place to take a rest from the rushing world of Vietnam. The park is located near to Hanoi. It is a really good adventure to visit this place with motorcycle. If You love hiking and the nature it will be an awesome day for You.

reviews.author: christianmccu
reviews.title: Perfect Day Trip
reviews.content: My friends and I rented motorbikes and drove out from Hanoi - it was the perfect day trip. There aren't many visitors to the park, so it's often hauntingly quiet and if you pay attention you'll see a lot of interesting wildlife. You can drive up to the top of the main mountain and explore some of the paths and trails, there are even a few pagodas at the very top - and the views are amazing. Around Ba Vi itself I'd also recommend stopping in town to try the fresh milk and yogurt.

reviews.author: Calmsloth
reviews.title: Peaceful & deserted trails
reviews.content: My boyfriend and I rented a motorbike from Hanoi and set off for a long weekend exploring Ba Vi. The route was relatively easy and took under two hours, we arrived around 4pm, checked into our hotel (Bach Duong) and went out to get some food. The place seemed deserted with the majority of food stalls empty or closed, perhaps because it was quite chilly and out of season for tourists. Nevertheless, we got some tasty pho and bun cha and enjoyed the peaceful surroundings.We had two days in/around the national park and it was eerily quiet the whole time - definitely a peaceful retreat for anyone wishing to escape the big city for a few days. During our time in the national park we went on three walks - the two peaks (both of which can be completed by anyone of average fitness) and a mystery trail from near the peaks into the forest. This trail was beautiful but also seemed abandoned - there was no one else on the walk and the path grew progressively more hazardous. After walking around two hours (after climbing the two peaks) we were tired and started to wonder when the walk would end - we soon discovered that the end point had been blocked off for construction work. This meant we had to clamber over a ten meter pile of rocks, wood and building materials to get back on the path. Fun; but maybe not to everybodies liking.It was very difficult for us to find food around/inside the national park, so would definitely recommend picking up some snacks in town & making sure you've had a big breakfast before entering the park.

reviews.author: TravelBugFilms
reviews.title: Amazing views - away from the normal tourist attractions
reviews.content: If you love a hike, getting our in nature and beautiful views....definitely make the trip to Ba Vi National Park. We hired a car for the day, found a local student to guide us from Hanoi Free Walking Tours and then headed out to Ba Vi. It's a two hour drive from Hanoi through small towns and roads with water buffalo to traverse, then you get to Ba Vi. We drove the long windy road up the side of the mountain and then started on our hike up to the pagodas. Our guide Thuy took us on lots of sneaky shortcuts climbing through the mountain which was so so much fun. We went up to a small tower style pagoda which was absolutely beautiful. Then we headed up to a temple dedicated to Ho Chi Minh. We didn't see any other tourists, only locals. The custom is to grab some junky food from a small shop on the way and then head up and have a picnic at the top. After the hikes and pagodas we headed to an abandoned, overgrown church which was incredible, we weren't able to stay there long because there was a bride wanting to take her wedding photos!On the way back down we went through flower gardens and then we paid 10,000VND per person to visit an awesome private cactus garden which had us feeling like we were on the film set of breaking bad. If you're sick of tourist traps, touters, tourists and traffic.....Ba Vi is the place for you. A tip: Due to the higher altitude, ba vi is colder than Hanoi so make sure to bring cold weather gear - but you might get hot in the sun or from walking so bring warm weather gear too.

reviews.author: Anyse J
reviews.title: For the handicapped, the steep and uneven walkways and roads are a huge obstacle.
reviews.content: I went to Ba Vi National Park with my flatmate and two of her students who are learning Vietnamese. It was so beautiful: a quick bus ride there and a short taxi ride to the park entrance. The admission is 40,000VND and I was warned about the steepness of the road, much less the off-road places. So, I went up the hill and into the park with the other 3 in a taxi and learned that there was no way for me, with terrible vertigo and balance problems, to walk around there. So, I went back down the hill to the entrance. However, I did take a walk along a road at the bottom of the mountains through Tan Linh Commune around a small, green valley. I took a number of very nice pictures, met a few Vietnamese along the way and enjoyed what I could have access to. It was, for me, disappointing and exhilarating. The houses, the livestock, the patterns of nature and more were new, fresh and resilient. Go there, even with a bit of a disability! It is beautiful, cooler than in Ha Noi (get away from the heat) and the panoramic views are so lovely and enticing.

reviews.author: Chris Koh
reviews.title: Unspoilt attraction
reviews.content: After visiting Hanoi for many years, i was kind of running out of places to visit. The travel agent recommended this less traveled location!It is only just over an hour from the city centre with the new highway. The parks has very few tourists but have quite a fair bit of students visiting in groups taking pictures. The pine forest near the entrance of the park is excellent for photography. The tranquility of the surrounding is what you cannot get in most attractions!A 15 minutes drive up a winding and narrow road will bring you to the foot of a 1000 steps flight of stairs. As it was very foggy, we did not climb up but was told there is a HCM temple up there and on a good day, the view is stunning!

reviews.author: Iryna B
reviews.title: Nice place to visit
reviews.content: Ba Vi National Park is a nice place to visit, especially if you like nature and would like to hike a bit. The area is quite big and you have several options: either to visit waterfalls, old church or hike to the top and visit few temples. The entrance fee is 40 000 (approximately 2 USD). I would suggest going there by bike or motorbike, since hiking to the top can take some time and there is parking for cars and/or motorbikes.

reviews.author: UMap255
reviews.title: Fantastic place for eco travelers
reviews.content: The idea of visiting Mount Ba Vi comes to my mind very fast, and I totally love the trip. It took me half an hour to going up the hills by motorcycle; along the road were wild flowers and large trees. There were several stops where tourists could buy food and rest. Attractions were ancient French colonists' ruins in the woods and beautiful Vietnamese temples on top of mountains. Prices were affordable. Perfect place for eco travelers and people wanting to take a break from the bustling city of Hanoi.

reviews.author: lanletuyet
reviews.title: Perfect for hiking
