I would recommend that (if you don't speak Vietnamese).The seats were short on knee-room for a tall audience member; grab an edge seat if you are tall.The show lasts 45 minutes - shorter than I had expected but perhaps the right time to give you a good sense of the art without straining the patience of some members of your group.A small orchestra with traditional instruments and singers sit to the sides of the pool and provide the audio for the show.The theater is right at the NE edge of the central Hoan Kiem lake - with plenty of good spots to get a bite or drink before or after the show.I'm glad I included an evening show as part of a two-day visit to Hanoi.

reviews.author: bebeThionville
reviews.title: Cultural
reviews.content: I didn’t see much becausethan people with their phones 🙄🙄arms up but the little I could see was very interesting Bravo the puppeteers who work during the show in the water and without forgetting their colleagues perfect coordination ~~~the puppet show on the water and a centuries-long tradition the peasants living in the rice fields during the dinastie L’yis linked to the seasons, to the life of fields and rice fields, to invoke rain...  9 February 26

reviews.author: MrBoggen
reviews.title: No ordinary theatre
reviews.content: Sounds a bit like that when you hear about it but they are fantastic, both those who are in the water and those who play instruments. Don't regret going there

reviews.author: Stephanie
reviews.title: Bof bof
reviews.content: This show, although carried by high-quality puppets, seems today exclusively calibrated for a passing public. The performance lasts 45 minutes and is entirely in Vietnamese, making the plot particularly difficult for the uninitiated to follow. If the technique is there, the overall experience remains disappointing: the show does not quite manage to justify the detour. Even for children (6 and 9 years old), enthusiasm remained very mixed, because they could not really immerse themselves in history.

reviews.author: Andy Wilson
reviews.title: Great puppet water puppet show.
reviews.content: Very good, and expertly delivered

reviews.author: Louise C
reviews.title: A must do when in Hanoi
reviews.content: Worth experiencing this unique water puppet theatre helps you embrace the culture. The show itself is not very long but the Vietnamese performers are excellent , good value.

reviews.author: Ari V
reviews.title: Tall people be ware
reviews.content: The Thang Long Water Puppet Show was a unique and colorful cultural experience, with live traditional music and beautifully crafted puppets performing over water. The stories were easy to follow and gave a glimpse into Vietnamese folklore and village life.If you are tall, make sure to pick seats in the front rows or on the sides — the legroom in the middle rows is quite tight and you may feel cramped during the performance.

reviews.author: Thành Khôi
reviews.title: One in a Lifetime experience
reviews.content: One in a Lifetime experiences. And it's worth every single penny. Whenever you have an opportunity to visit Hanoi, you must go to this theatre, and immerse yourself in the suburbs of Vietnam

reviews.author: Jon A
reviews.title: Fantastic experience, well worth it
reviews.content: Absolutely worth going to see. I’m a professional musician, so honestly didn’t know what to expect and whether I would enjoy - but was naive as it was a wonderful experience. 9 live musicians who were all very talented, and provided a beautiful accompaniment to the highly skilled puppet work. It felt very artistically focused, and the storytelling was strong and easy to follow even without understanding the Vietnamese lyrics or narration. Perfect length, about an hour, which kept us entertained and engaged. The theatre and ticketing was well organised - we emailed a few weeks in advance to book seats and these ready for us when we arrived. Would recommend booking in some capacity - directly worked very well, but you can do Get Your Guide etc if you prefer that. Tickets were sold out for our showing when we arrived, so don’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Ευαγγελος Κ
reviews.title: Bravo!!!!
reviews.content: Fantastic experience.It's worth seeing is something unique with music shock you feel everything from Vietnam!!!

reviews.author: Megan
reviews.title: Must see if in Hanoi, wonderful artistry and uniquely beautiful
reviews.content: Wonderful unique experience specific to the area. Excellent musicians and puppet artists- truly unique and one of a kind

reviews.author: Funlovinfella
reviews.title: I’ve had a better night in bed with a toothache!
reviews.content: First off, this is not my thing, especially as I’m not three years old. I’m guessing that a hundred years ago this would be considered high tech but it wasn’t as good as a Thunderbirds episode. Some confusion with others with their tickets but we had no problems. If you like puppets, you’ll enjoy this, it’s a bit of a stretch for 50 minutes. My wife loved it but that being said she’s been with me for 45 years!

reviews.author: Janet K
reviews.title: Get the audio guide and enjoy the fun
reviews.content: Esau to get tickets on the door. Great view, the show was funny and, with the English audio guide which you buy there, informative and entertaining.

reviews.author: Mads H
reviews.title: Great evening in the teather
reviews.content: Had a wonderful experience with our four year old daughter. Even the show is in Vietnamese I was great fun and full of humor

reviews.author: ELIZABETH D
reviews.title: Excellent Cultural Experience in Hanoi
reviews.content: Excellent experience and important to see this entertainment  tradition that explains the themes of Vietnam’s culture.  Please support  the musician and puppeteer artists that maintain the unique identity that is Vietnam.  The audio guides are important for non Vietnamese speakers.  I appreciated the seating efforts made by my ticket handler.

reviews.author: itsjustausername
reviews.title: Worth a visit
reviews.content: Okay so the puppet show is really quite good, it’s fun, and it was great to see the musicians on the stage. The puppeteers must be busy with all the action going on. We took our son and it was a great experience. In terms of picking up the tickets - this is disorganised. The tickets are not available electronically so you must pick them up at the venue. The person who delivered our tickets had no uniform so we had no way of knowing who to look for. We called the number and received a prompt call back receiving our tickets, so we got there in the end!

reviews.author: 749David
reviews.title: Traditional Vietnamese Water Puppet show - a cultural highlight for us.
reviews.content: It takes an hour and is a magical Cultural show. Don't go thinking Disney or Broadway, this is a distinctly Vietnamese cultural, traditional show featuring Water Puppets. The theatre is clean and the seats are very comfortable. We thought it a great experience and I would recommend to everyone, but particularly those with young kids.

reviews.author: caroleen78
reviews.title: A puppet show on the water
reviews.content: Various paintings follow one another in this water puppet show retracing episodes of Vietnamese life. Each painting refers to a story of daily life, mythology where fire dragons mix with peasants Musicians and singers accompany this show It's lovely.

reviews.author: Dialla K
reviews.title: A cute show, must see.
reviews.content: definetly worth seeing, its very well done and very cute. Make sure you take a portable translator as its all in the local language.

reviews.author: Srinivas B
reviews.title: Excellent . No words to write the skill of behind screen artists. Amazing . I took help of local guide to save time
reviews.content: Students are maintaining.They need to grow their behaviour with tourist.They asked me come out for their calculation of people versus tickets. It was irritating

reviews.author: iPodsolnuh
reviews.title: Vietnamese folklore. Main thing
reviews.content: Full immersion in Vietnamese traditional culture. Excellent performance by puppeteers and musicians. The stories of village life and local folklore are well understood. The audio guide is well made, which is very helpful in understanding the plot and does not interfere with the viewing. A visit is mandatory. Bright experiences guaranteed!

reviews.author: Jitka59
reviews.title: Unconventional theater performance
reviews.content: A nice, unconventional theater experience. The show runs for 50 minutes, which is more than enough, anything longer would feel too long.It’s also suitable for children.

reviews.author: 景司 足
reviews.title: Children can enjoy it too!
reviews.content: The attendant went out of his way to wait for me with an envelope containing my ticket.The show was also very nice, and the content was enjoyable for elementary school children.There is a paid audio guide, but it is difficult to understand and the content is slightly difficult, so I don't think children need it.

reviews.author: Rarah
reviews.title: Hard to see!
reviews.content: There is no audio guide included with the ticket price, I was also sat in G16 (everywhere else sold out) and could hardly see a thing! 50 minutes is a long time to watch puppets you can only just see but can’t understand. Good puppetry skills though. Disappointed as expected it to be better.

reviews.author: Nick M
reviews.title: Worth seeing the water puppet show once at least
reviews.content: The show was entertaining, and certainly worth attending - once.There were funny parts in the show and it was well done. Not quite sure I understood the story, but the actors driving the puppets did well, as did the singers and band at the sides of the show.

reviews.author: Albertina Sol
reviews.title: A must-see water puppet spectacle
reviews.content: A stunning venue and captivating show—excellent music, expressive puppetry, and great acoustics. Book early; it’s popular and seats are limited!

reviews.author: Ralph Goodson
reviews.title: Good fun
reviews.content: A good way to spend an hour. The live music, played on local instruments add to the experience. We are sure they have repeated the performance thousands of times but they still played with great enthusiasm.

reviews.author: John W
reviews.title: Amazing Show ….
reviews.content: I didn’t think this would appeal to me but I was wrong .. the show was amazing and the puppet operators so talented. So glad that I went along for the show and yes I would recommend it to anyone visiting Hanoi.

reviews.author: KLO
reviews.title: Great in theory - definitely get language headset
reviews.content: I thought the concept of water theatre and Vietnam folklore would be really interesting/ entertaining, but as someone who doesn't understand Vietnamese it lost the entertainment factor after 10 mins. I thought my ticket my tickets included headsets for English but didn't and didn't feel like spending more for it. I appreciate the music & art for sure, don't get me wrong, just hard to not understand & 50 mins is a long time to watch puppets. Maybe some other reviews will say they had their language headset and found it better.

reviews.author: Durga M
reviews.title: Cultural feast
reviews.content: What a show language might be a barrier we did not realise they were also providing audio translators, but it is worth the watch.This is my second time and I would say it is completely worth your time.They have sincerely made efforts to conserve their culture.Highly recommend

reviews.author: jw6969
reviews.title: Unique!
reviews.content: We’d been recommended to go and see this, so we did. Tickets are inexpensive. It is a unique concept - really quite unlike anything we’d seen in theatre before. There is a great deal of skill used by the puppeteers. There is a small band playing the music and singers. They are telling a story. It is roughly possible to get the gist of it. It doesn’t last long (under an hour I think). Probably wouldn’t bother again, but glad we’ve seen it.

reviews.author: Cheston Jean
reviews.title: Vibrant puppets, timeless vietnamese tunes
reviews.content: It was a delight to see and hear traditional Vietnamese instruments and singing. The setting is vibrantly colorful, and the puppets are captivating and thoroughly entertaining. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Leonie
reviews.title: Lovely show
reviews.content: This was a really enjoyable show and I recommend getting the audio guide to understand the story unless you speak Vietnamese.

reviews.author: Flutebabe44
reviews.title: Unique performing arts experience!
reviews.content: I don’t mind that I spent double the vip ticket price for this if purchased through the theater directly. There was no long time so perhaps I didn’t need to purchase through this venue but it was easier than having cash to pay in person. The water puppet show was fantastic! Truly unique experience and I’m so glad I went. Would 1000% see it again!

reviews.author: Bernadette F
reviews.title: Nice.
reviews.content: It's a sight to see once, but that's nice On the other hand the sound is too loud, I could not hear the sound in French of the audio guide

reviews.author: Shirley S
reviews.title: A hour of Vietnamese entertainment
reviews.content: This was recommended to us and for an alternative and quirky Vietnamese experience , this fitted the billperfectly. Would recommend sitting as near to front as possible and we didn’t realize that you good get an audio,  but if you’re new to Vietnam , it might be worth it. We just sat back and enjoyed the live music , singing and expertly choreographed and synchronized puppet show which lasted less than an hour.

reviews.author: Karen C
reviews.title: On my bucket list, steeped in history, don't miss the translation on the large screen above & to the side of the stage!!
reviews.content: We did book this through a online company which was quite cheap at AUS $22.15 PP for VIP seats in the front row.  When we got to the theatre our tickets had the price of them of 200,000 dong (roughly AUS $11.61 pp). You could chance it and buy them at the theatre but if they are sold out you will miss out.  We tried to catch a Grab for 4 but were unable to get anyone to accept the fare and we ended up walking through the street market back to our hotel.The puppet show was good but very repetitious and the guys both fell asleep.  The music was good and the instruments unusual to us.  It was on my bucket list and I think you need to go to make up your own mind about the show as it is steeped in history and some of the puppeteers are generations from the same family.  I missed the subtitles on the screen above the stage so I obviously was watching what was happening in front of me.  There may have been more of a story line if I had noticed them but I didn't!!!

reviews.author: Kassia
reviews.title: A cultural gem: music, puppets & magic!
reviews.content: It beautifully showcases Vietnamese tradition and culture—especially through the enchanting sounds of traditional instruments and the mesmerizing water puppets dancing across the stage. The musicians and puppeteers are truly masterful! Absolutely worth a visit!

reviews.author: fredetfranck34
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: A very nice show, real music players and singers, great staging of the country. We have a super pleasant time. We really recommend this show.

reviews.author: Kat S
reviews.title: Unique cultural experience
reviews.content: Performance was fun, unique and cultural.Redeeming the tickets would have been better with clearer instructions - you need to wait to the left of the main ticket window on ticket window side of the barrier near the stairs and will receive tickets from someone who will come out and meet you not long before performance.

reviews.author: Ric G
reviews.title: Puppets, splashes, and giggles galore!
reviews.content: Our family was utterly charmed! The colorful puppets danced on water to folk tales and music. Short, sweet, and totally kid-friendly. Don’t miss the laughter in the front row!

reviews.author: John M
reviews.title: A fantastic experience.
reviews.content: A fantastic experience, not expensive and very enjoyable. If you would want leg room, book in advance and book the front row. It is all in vietnamese that adds to the experience. The singers and musicians are amazing! A must when you are in Hanoi.

reviews.author: philip w
reviews.title: Water puppets Hanoi November 2025
reviews.content: We went there and this is a different experience. This is a few stories played out with puppets on the water and is an authentic Vietnamese night out.Worth a visit.

reviews.author: Francisco Q
reviews.title: A great glimpse into traditional Hanoi
reviews.content: I understand  that it was one of the must see attractions  of Hanoi and it didn't  disappoint. It was a great show with, what  I imagine traditional instruments  and story. The teacher was the first of its kind in Hanoi.I highly  recommend getting the audioguide for translation and to have a better  context  of the show in general.

reviews.author: Adriana M
reviews.title: Vietnam's unique theater
reviews.content: This was a great experience, the show is entertaining, it shows Vietnam's history in a unique way. Front row tickets are worth it and if you can you should ask for the audio-translator. Keep in mind it is cash only.

reviews.author: Bhat P T
reviews.title: Worth witnessing when in Vietnam
reviews.content: Very beautifully choroegraphed show. Excellant team work. I have seen many puppet shows in my ciuntry India. But nowhere water puppet show. Enjoyed thoriughlyKeep up your tradition

reviews.author: SkunkFu07
reviews.title: Unique and entertaining
reviews.content: A very unique and entertaining experience. 50 minutes of story telling, with music and a Vietnamese narration, well worth a visit.

reviews.author: cmtran7393
reviews.title: Fun unique experience
reviews.content: Pretty cheap price for a 50’ culture show.To be honest I’m Vietnamese but I barely understood what they were singing 😅. I think the sound system had some echo it was hard to follow. Also high pitched opera voices added to the difficulty. But the highlight was they were playing all the traditional instruments in sync!The show mostly consisted of short scenes depicting daily life in villages predominantly of rice field culture. People used to fish, swim, play, plow the fields with buffaloes, herding ducks and looted by hungry fox, racing boats, telling lores to each other…However I agree with some comments here that there’s no consistent storyline throughout. Short scenes just told a quick fun snapshot of what the life used to be in the past along with the mythology about Hoan Kiem Lake. Then at the end magical creatures representative of the Vietnamese culture  dancing : Dragon, Turtle, Phoenix and Lion/Tiger. That’s why the show seemed fragmented and random.I admire the hard work and talent of the artisans and musicians. They work very hard behind the scene im telling you!Overall it was a fun and silly show 🥳. I think this was a no bs show as the scenes were very fast paced and lively. I went when I was in primary school and now revisited. I give it 8 out of 10. It was quite enjoyable and unique of Vietnamese communal and agricultural culture.P/S: after that you can walk to the nearby street food and try the papaya salad with beef jerky and some fresh spring rolls 😋 you won’t regret !

reviews.author: Deborah D
reviews.title: Watching a show
reviews.content: Was really good and could even follow it in Vietnamese! £5 for both of us and got tickets in the morning for the afternoon show no problem

reviews.author: rama1
reviews.title: Performers are so talented
reviews.content: Great unique experience. Enough variety to keep you entertained. Performers are super talented and only around eight appeared at end.  Seems like scores making it work when you are watching.

reviews.author: Deborah L
reviews.title: Beautiful experience
reviews.content: Just worth seeing. Great atmosphere and beautifully lovingly designed. You disappear into another world. The only drawback, legroom for Europeans is a bit difficult, but absolutely endurable for the duration

reviews.author: SkunkFu07
reviews.title: Entertaining experience
reviews.content: Very entertaining performance. Unusual, something you won't see every day. Good value for money. Great insight into the culture of this beautiful country.

reviews.author: Tneh Kiat
reviews.title: Fabulous Puppet Show
reviews.content: It was such a great experience to enjoy the water puppet show with traditional Vietnamese music played by a group of artists wearing local costumes. Whoever would like to know more about rural Vietnamese culture must come here for this show!

reviews.author: Chris_AU
reviews.title: Fun inexpensive activity, worth checking out
reviews.content: I read a few reviews saying too long etc, but as a family of four we had a great time watching it and felt the duration was spot on.Get VIP tickets for best view,  no need for translation just look at your program guide, there’s not really talking so no idea what the audio guide would even tell you. Simple stories to follow.Booster cushions for kids was great. Overall very easy. I booked tickets via trip.com for convenience and just collected the day before when walking around that area (it’s via a 3rd party agency), don’t think it was much markup and lot cheaper than GetYourGuide and Klook

reviews.author: MBB
reviews.title: Exciting cultural elements
reviews.content: A great cultural feature with roots in Vietnamese culture. Talented artists. Missing the opportunity to buy drinks and those who come too late to show start should be denied admission as these interrupted the experience for those who were timely.

reviews.author: Charlie A
reviews.title: Would recommend
reviews.content: Great show- only complaint is the seating isn’t tiered enough so you are constantly having to look around other peoples heads

reviews.author: Loc
reviews.title: Awesome Show.
reviews.content: What a performance.  To see traditional Vietnamese water Puppetry.  Really really good and worth every cent.  Seated in the 2nd row and got to be up front with the singers, and band members.

reviews.author: Sumit
reviews.title: A Must-See in Hanoi: Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre
reviews.content: I had a fantastic time at the Thang Long Water Puppet Show — truly a cultural highlight and a must-visit in Hanoi!Although there isn’t an official online ticket booking system, you can reserve your seats by emailing them at marketingthanglongwpt@gmail.com. They’ll confirm your reservation, but note that seat numbers aren’t assigned in advance. You can either collect your tickets in person if you're arriving early, or request your hotel to pick them up for you — both options work smoothly.There are multiple daily shows, each offering a magical performance with great artistry and music. I highly recommend renting the pre-recorded audio translator at the entrance (available at a extra cost) to fully appreciate the stories being told.A unique and memorable experience — don’t miss it!

reviews.author: 168RoyH
reviews.title: A Unique Cultural Experience in Hanoi
reviews.content: This was my second visit to the Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre — my first one was years ago, back when Google Reviews didn’t even exist yet 🤪.The theatre is conveniently located right in front of Hoan Kiem Lake, in the heart of Hanoi’s Old Quarter. I purchased my ticket a day in advance via Klook, which was hassle-free. Redemption was simple — just pick up the physical ticket at the Klook counter right in front of the theatre.The performance itself is highly entertaining, showcasing Vietnam’s traditional water puppet art. It’s fascinating to watch how the puppeteers skillfully control the puppets in such a unique way while standing in the water behind the stage. Truly impressive and deserves a big applause.💡 Pro tip: Get the audio guide (with just a small extra fee). It really helps you understand the storyline and background of each act, making the experience even more meaningful.Overall, a must-see cultural show when in Hanoi — entertaining, authentic, and memorable.

reviews.author: Katie Martin
reviews.title: So much fun!
reviews.content: This was so so much fun, and a MUST DO if you are in Hanoi! It was super fun to watch and also very funny, it also had traditional music and was overall an amazing experience!

reviews.author: Jo S
reviews.title: Traditional Vietnamese Art
reviews.content: This is a must see in Hanoi. Yes it's kitsch but that's the point. Buy the translation if you really want to know what's going on but it's actually more fun without it.

reviews.author: MC C
reviews.title: Great cultural experience
reviews.content: I like the option to get a translation of the show in English. The show was a great cultural experience to learn about the history of thr Vietnamese people. I booked my ticket the day of and was easy to attend day of.

reviews.author: I&M
reviews.title: Don’t miss this!
reviews.content: A must-see if you are truly interested in local culture. The scenes were colourful, humorous, and non-stop action. I chose not to use the audio phones as I wanted to hear the show in the original language. Next time I want to use audio as I think it would be interesting to get an even clearer picture of this fascinating aspect of local Vietnamese culture. The hour passed too quickly for me.

reviews.author: K_PopPop
reviews.title: Thang Long Water Puppet Show - Hanoi
reviews.content: A beautiful, unique and entertaining cultural show. Definitely suitable for all ages, you’ll be smiling throughout. Truly talented puppeteers and musicians, a high recommendation.

reviews.author: virginia L
reviews.title: Designed for all Ages
reviews.content: A great show for the whole family of 3 adults and 2 children 1 and 3 years old.We had front row seats which made it even better.  The story and music gave an informative look into traditional Vietnamese history and culture.

reviews.author: Masela Fadjar Pratiwi
reviews.title: Must-See Cultural Performance
reviews.content: Had a wonderful experience at Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre! 🎭✨ It was my first time visiting, and the show was a fantastic way to learn more about Vietnamese culture. The performance was entertaining, well-executed, and full of traditional charm. Highly recommend for anyone visiting Hanoi.

reviews.author: stephano974
reviews.title: To see!
reviews.content: Original and surprising show for us tourists. It is to be seen as a family for the pleasure of young and old. It lasts less than an hour.

reviews.author: Annalise B
reviews.title: A charming slice of Vietnamese tradition
reviews.content: Such a fun hour! The show is a delightful spectacle of folklore and history. We didn't understand the words, but the storytelling through puppetry was universal.

reviews.author: Jeny L
reviews.title: Must do in Hanoi!!
reviews.content: We bought the VIP tickets through Get Your Guide .com  and got the 5th row from the front. My 8 yr old son was glued to the show..great for children and adults alike.

reviews.author: Anne N
reviews.title: Beautiful discovery
reviews.content: We had a great time. The paintings follow one another with humor and poetry. All accompanied by music and songs.

reviews.author: Rebecca Charles-Myers
reviews.title: A must do in Hanoi
reviews.content: A beautiful show which is a must do activity in Hanoi! Highly recommend you purchase the audio guide to help understand the show. Tickets do sell out so make sure you purchase the day before. The only downside is that staff do not monitor the crowd when watching the show. We had people constantly talking next to us and then someone filming the whole show using a large recording device (which was balancing on my chair).

reviews.author: Hà T
reviews.title: Great Customer Service!
reviews.content: Asia Travel Legend impressed me with their prompt responses and clear communication. Booking tickets online was simple, and their team made sure everything went smoothly at the venue. It was such a pleasant experience.

reviews.author: Thiên H
reviews.title: Smooth Experience from Start to Finish
reviews.content: I booked the water puppet show tickets through Asia Travel Legend and everything was seamless. The staff was helpful and polite, and we received our tickets quickly. When we arrived at the theater, everything was ready. I highly recommend this service!

reviews.author: Trung Hiếu N
reviews.title: Simple, Fast, No Stress
reviews.content: What I liked most was how fast and easy it was to get tickets through Asia Travel Legend. I didn’t have to queue or worry about anything. The team took care of it all and we enjoyed a beautiful show.

reviews.author: Sherpa36937028700
reviews.title: Fantastic Way to See a Cultural Show
reviews.content: Buying tickets online with Asia Travel Legend made our trip much easier. Everything was ready when we got to the water puppet theater. The show was lovely and the service was top-notch. Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Navigate22224729840
reviews.title: Highly Efficient and Trustworthy
reviews.content: I wasn’t sure about booking online at first, but Asia Travel Legend proved to be reliable. The whole process was quick, and the tickets were waiting for us when we arrived. The staff at the theater was welcoming too. Will use again!

reviews.author: Heather H
reviews.title: Water puppet show
reviews.content: This was included as part of our trip to Ha Long Bay.  Probably not something we would have chosen to do but it was interesting. If the puppet/marionette stories had been told in English instead of being sung in Vietnamese I reckon it would have been more engaging.It broke up the long bus journey from Ha Long Bay to Hanoi.

reviews.author: MickaelG
reviews.title: Puppets
reviews.content: Beautiful representation that deserves a small explanatory rating to accompany the story, in several languages for tourists (almost all spectators). The show itself is entertaining!

reviews.author: Nilesh P
reviews.title: DO THIS! WORTH IT
reviews.content: Easy to get ticketsQuick checkin. Dont recommend getting there too early. You have to wait til five minutes before showtime before they let you in.Prompt and quick with seating.Gave cushioned seats for kids so they can see everything . This was a really kind gesture as they came around and gave it to our kids . Thank you.What a show ! Being in Vietnamese didn’t matter as you get the gist of it all with the guide. Really an amazing feat with music and water and puppets . They allow photography and videos which will be great to share with family back home!Thank you!

reviews.author: cristoph2010
reviews.title: Very entertaining
reviews.content: The music, song, and water puppetry are all very entertaining. I'd strongly recommend watching it. The scenes include the daily lives of villagers and how someone could ascend to a position of influence, which is celebrated by the villagers.

reviews.author: lilybt
reviews.title: Advance ticket purchase is recommended
reviews.content: It is located on the shores of Hoan Kiem Lake, the most prestigious and large-scale facility of several floating puppet theaters in Hanoi. We get information about long lines to buy tickets and pre-purchase them via OTA (kNanchala). It is an advantage to be able to book with a specific performance time, and with so many tourists lining up at the ticket booth on the day, it is a great choice for those who want to put their itinerary together. However, it’s better to understand that you need to visit a local agent about five minutes away from the theater to exchange paper tickets, and that the price is somewhat higher than buying at a ticket booth, whether it’s a commission for the agent. The ticket types are divided into three levels, near-middle and far, toward the stage (or rather, the pool), and the near price is more than twice as much as the far price, but the feeling is so realistic that the doll splashes when diving into the water like a 'sand coat,' and as I said, it costs about 1,300 yen in Japanese currency, so I recommend purchasing the top-of-the-line ticket.The play is a legend of the founding of Vietnam, but you don't have to have an understanding of the language to enjoy it to some extent, and you can kind of understand the story. I felt it was quite a good entertainment.

reviews.author: Esmee S
reviews.title: 50 minutes of puppets playing in water with music on the background
reviews.content: We started the puppet show with open minds, since we hadn’t seen a professional puppet show before. According to the reviews we bought the cheapest seats and could see and hear everything clearly. We didn’t buy the audioguide. Watching puppets and hearing Vietnamese music is nice at first, but 50 minutes is a very long time. It got so boring that some people even fell asleep. Some scenes were impressive, but most of them were just looking at puppets playing in water with music on the background.

reviews.author: Rachel H
reviews.title: Great way to experience a traditional Vietnamese performance
reviews.content: We weren’t sure what to expect but were pleasantly surprised. We booked the cheapest seats from an external website in advance and were quite far back but still had a good view. Aisle seats recommended for taller people as legroom is minimal. Music was wonderful, great to see the traditional instruments and just such a different performance to anything we’ve seen before. Would recommend whilst in the city.

reviews.author: Swatti Agrawall
reviews.title: Water puppet show
reviews.content: Nice show about the Vietnam culture. Please book tickets in advance as the show generally is sold out. We booked front seats and here is a pro tip if you are going with children, please try to book the front rows. However, I felt this too long. It should be reduced to half the amount of time as slowly, it’s boring.

reviews.author: Creeping_Death_LA
reviews.title: Colorful water display
reviews.content: There are several showings throughout the day and evening. If you are in the area buy a ticket in advance or have your hotel desk agent book a space for you. Your name will be listed on their ticket box sheet and you can pay when you get there. The show is very interesting to see and the live music and singing performers are fun to watch.

reviews.author: Avalon
reviews.title: A bit too long for me
reviews.content: I enjoyed the first 10 minutes of the show but I think 20 to 25 minutes would have been the perfect length of time for me.  As the show went on, I felt like it got really repetitive (didn’t help that I couldn’t understand the storyline).  By the time the show ended, I couldn’t wait to get out. The upside is it was nice to be exposed to this aspect of Vietnamese culture.  However, I would say if you’re someone who’s not normally into cultural shows when you travel that you should probably give this one a miss.  I think you will be bored.

reviews.author: George L
reviews.title: Hanoi Water puppet show
reviews.content: We booked middle seats four rows from the front, for the 3PM show. Tickets were not expensive, just couple of US$.  Location of our seats were great, but the space for your knees was very tight, you have to get up and turn sideways for people to get past you to their seats. These seats were not designed for big or tall people. Didn't know what to expect from the show, we didnt get the audio guide but was able to get the general gist of the story. We found the puppets, live music and singing quite entertaining. The whole show lasted less than an hour. After the show you are allowed to take photos at the water stage. They also have many of the puppet characters and creatures in the main foyer area, you can take photos with them after the show.

reviews.author: Gerri Henry
reviews.title: Outstanding & authentic show
reviews.content: The performance was outstanding, delivered by a highly skilled and authentic ensemble. It served as a most enjoyable evening engagement.

reviews.author: Jane
reviews.title: Hanoi Thang Long water Puppet theatre
reviews.content: Such a great experience. Take a break from the beautiful craziness of Hanoi to really enjoy this performance. A beautiful experience and truly moving at the end. Incredibly talented puppeteers, musicians and singers.

reviews.author: Laura B
reviews.title: You don't need to understand Vietnamese to enjoy the show
reviews.content: Watch this early in your trip to get a good understanding of Vietnamese culture.  Stories like the turtle of Sword Lake really tie in well with the historical story of Hanoi.  Counter to what some recommend, I thought it was fine to get the VIP seating if you can (I got a deluxe seat per recommendation on Klook), they are all on the same level of incline, the views are fine and the ones in the front are better.

reviews.author: Marielle D
reviews.title: The Whimsical Water Puppet Show
reviews.content: I recently attended a traditional Vietnamese water puppet show and was impressed by the artistry and cultural richness on display. The performance itself was captivating, with vibrant puppets, live music, and a unique storytelling style that beautifully showcased Vietnam’s heritage.However, my overall experience was less enjoyable due to the seating arrangement—I had chosen a row that didn’t offer a great view, which made it difficult to fully appreciate the performance. Additionally, the presence of noisy and standing children throughout the show made it hard to concentrate and fully immerse myself in the experience.Despite these challenges, I still recognize the talent and tradition behind the show, and I’d recommend it to others—with the advice to choose seats carefully for a better view and more enjoyable experience.

reviews.author: mohzan h
reviews.title: Traditional water puppet show
reviews.content: A must visit / attend the show when you are in Hanoi. Most hotels can book a ticket for you . 3 or 4 Shows daily in the evenings, about 45 minutes showtime.Ticket cost vnd200, vnd150, vnd100The puppeteers use bamboo poles to manuever the puppets on the water.Some added humour. Audio available in your language for understanding. Quite enjoyable.

reviews.author: John P
reviews.title: Master Puppeteers Work Magic Suspended on Water
reviews.content: Water puppets are a deep cultural tradition in Hanoi, so we went not knowing exactly what to expect.  Originally performed in a river with a stage like a Punch and Judy show, we enjoyed it inside of a theater with a large pool where the master puppeteers worked their magic to the accompaniment of live musicians performing on traditional instruments.  The show is a series of sequential folk stories that are easy to follow and delightful as well - with a few surprises, too - in this show without intermissions/intervals.  This is well worth every minute to witness these traditional folk performances.

reviews.author: Adrian G
reviews.title: Wonderful show
reviews.content: This is a delightful traditional performance that showcases the unique art of water puppetry. I highly recommend taking advantage of the audio guide, as it provides valuable insights and helps you understand the nuances of the entire show. Additionally, booking seats in the front rows will enhance your experience, allowing you to enjoy the intricate details of the puppetry and the captivating storytelling up close. It's a wonderful way to immerse yourself in this cultural experience!

reviews.author: Patricia P
reviews.title: Loved it! Get the audio guide too.
reviews.content: Loved the show! Got tickets in advance so it was sitting in my Apple Wallet. Also got the audio guide as the whole thing is in Vietnamese. I got an English guide. Not sure how many other languages they have.  Very interesting culturally and musically. Some very interesting instruments. I thought it was well worth the  VIP ticket to be close and minimize the heads in the way. Very entertaining.

reviews.author: Leah C
reviews.title: Book direct from the venue
reviews.content: The show was great. I didn’t really understand what was going on but that’s part of the joy. It only goes for an hour. Don’t book through TripAdvisor. They’ll likely delete this review but it was a $h!tshow at the  venue. We were told that because we didn’t book tickets direct through the venue we would have to wait. We bought VIP tickets. We ended up with the best seats but the show started 5 minutes before we walked in

reviews.author: Britteny Oak
reviews.title: Good show
reviews.content: I think it will be a good experience, but I'm unsure about Vietnam afterwards. I can enjoy the culture, but I might get bored since I don't understand the language. There are three seat price levels, but the affordable back seats are fine if you don't mind.

reviews.author: Rdh2316
reviews.title: Not recommended
reviews.content: Booked tickets for 410pm show online. When we arrived we’re told they had to push us to next show as they oversold the show we had bought tickets for, even though there were still a lot of people in line buying their tickets. Then the show was just boring. Spent the time looking for restaurants for dinner. Do not recommend.

reviews.author: George G
reviews.title: Great show, rude audience (talking and on their phones)
reviews.content: Really interesting show that is worth watching, beautiful instruments and entertaining puppeteering. However, the announcers of the show should insist people not talk and turn their phones off. I had adults all around me talking and being on their phones throughout the entire show. Their own children had more manners and respect than them who told their parents to put their phones down. The older man in front of me had his flash go off one multiple occasions and the couple to the left of me wouldn’t stop fidgeting, talking and being on her phone with full brightness. The lack of manners and respect for the performers is disappointing to say the least.

reviews.author: Sandra
reviews.title: Funny and handsome done
reviews.content: Great fun! We hadn't taken a translator, but still wqs to follow it somewhat if you have already walked through the city in front of the theater. Very lively with music and singing.

reviews.author: lettgang
reviews.title: A Vietnamese experience!
reviews.content: We arrived around half an hour before the show to buy tickets on the door… box office was slow and asked us to wait to one side whilst she checked availability. Only she ‘forgot’ we were waiting and give better tickets to people who were way behind us in the queue! Eventually got in just after it started to back row seats! Show was in Vietnamese & was ‘just ok’ as didn’t understand it! ( Teenage son fell asleep!) Still, it was a cheap experience in Hanoi we wanted to do!

reviews.author: James A
reviews.title: Far better than expected
reviews.content: I was persuaded to see the water puppets by the staff at my hotel and I am very grateful for their recommendation. The puppet style is quite different than anything I’ve seen before. The imagery and music are both excellent but I would also highly recommend the translated audio which offers contexts and heightened my enjoyment.

reviews.author: Gopi
reviews.title: Water Puppet
reviews.content: The Thang Long Water Puppet Show in Hanoi is a captivating cultural experience that offers a unique glimpse into Vietnam's traditional art. Performed on a water stage, the show features intricately designed wooden puppets that dance, swim, and interact, all controlled by skilled puppeteers hidden behind a screen. The performance is accompanied by live traditional music, enhancing the vibrant atmosphere. The stories, often based on Vietnamese folklore, provide both entertainment and insight into the country's rich history and culture. Ideal for all ages, this show is a must-see for anyone visiting Hanoi, offering a memorable blend of artistry and tradition.

reviews.author: fionakyrkou
reviews.title: Water theatre puppet show
reviews.content: A different experience, wasn't sure what we were going to see. The show was a bit long and drawn out for me. Puppets were very good but the show did have a lot of the same. There is only so much you can do with a puppet on the end of a pole.The music is loud.All of the performers are very good at what they do.

reviews.author: raetrip
reviews.title: Artistic cultural experience, brief but fun
reviews.content: A very cool cultural experience in the heart of Hanoi. Expert puppeteers enact simple activities from rural Vietnamese life, such as fishing and duck herding.Live music helps to enhance the experience. Totally family friendly.

reviews.author: SookeRebecca_K
reviews.title: Must see while in Ha Noi
reviews.content: The orchestra was phenomenal. I would advise that you get the audio translation for another 50,000 VND, otherwise you will not understand the story, as it is all in Vietnamese.  The puppetry was fascinating. An hour long performance was perfect as it was hot and stuffy in the theater.

reviews.author: Anne S
reviews.title: An unusual experience worth seeing
reviews.content: We came here as part of a Scenic Cruises tour. As part of our tour front row seats were included. We had never seen anything like this before and it was very helpful that they had high level screens with an English explanation of the different stories. After the show we had a "backstage pass" which meant we could see how it worked and met a couple of the puppeteers. Really enjoyed this unusual experience.

reviews.author: Curious56604451762
reviews.title: Magic and tradition in motion
reviews.content: A unique experience that reflects Vietnamese culture. The colorful puppets move nimbly on the water, accompanied by traditional enveloping music. The theatre is often crowded and the seats a bit cramped, but it is absolutely worth seeing at least once!

reviews.author: Megan B
reviews.title: Unique and Entertaining Experience: Hanoi Water Puppet Show
reviews.content: The Hanoi Water Puppet Show is a must-see cultural experience when visiting the city. It is a traditional Vietnamese art form that combines puppetry, live music, and storytelling, all performed over water. The show is about an hour long and takes place in a charming theater with comfortable seating and a good view from almost anywhere.The puppets are beautifully crafted, and the skilled puppeteers control them from behind a screen, making them glide, dance, and interact on the water. The stories are based on Vietnamese folklore, legends, and rural life, giving a fascinating glimpse into the country’s traditions. Even if you do not understand Vietnamese, the expressive movements of the puppets and the live music make it easy to follow along.The live traditional music, played with authentic Vietnamese instruments, adds to the immersive experience. The musicians perform on the side of the stage, creating a rich atmospheric soundtrack to the show.Tickets are reasonably priced, and it is best to book in advance as the show is popular, especially in the evenings. It is a great experience for all ages, entertaining, cultural, and something you will not find anywhere else. If you are in Hanoi, the water puppet show is definitely worth checking out.

reviews.author: mion369
reviews.title: Night out in Hanoi
reviews.content: A special experience: dolls on the water depicting all kinds of situations. Unfortunately, the dialogues are in Vietnamese, so you miss some of the story. But the show itself is attractive. The performance is accompanied by an orchestra with two female singers who sing in the typical Chinese way with high wailing voices. A real Vietnamese experience!

reviews.author: Nhi N
reviews.title: Tickets are very fast, beautiful seats, very good staff love4ever
reviews.content: Everyone should buy tickets online. When you come, you don't need to queue. I watched everyone in line but wanted to faint

reviews.author: Phil R
reviews.title: Just Enjoyable
reviews.content: This was part of a tour with a dinner cruise to follow meaning we did not get to see the entire show.Enjoyed it all, the loud music, 'special' effects, and action.  Especially enjoyed the duck farmers arguing about caring for their ducks.You don't need high tech and internet for enjoyment

reviews.author: Lynne J
reviews.title: Fine but not a necessary experience
reviews.content: The music is very sharp in its pitch so we found it hard to listen to.  The entry was so rushed we didn't know we could get earphones that would have translated the story.

reviews.author: cliff_taylor
reviews.title: Worth a visit, need to focus to follow the story in Vietnamese.
reviews.content: Got tickets on the day, our 5pm performance got cancelled but we managed to go at a later time, about 8pm I think. A fun experience, all in Vietnamese of course, but we were able to sort of follow the story, I think?  It’s a Hanoi thing to do, glad we did it, laughed a lot at probably the wrong time and for the wrong reasons, music was live and good to listen to their instruments, Recommended.

reviews.author: Whissely
reviews.title: Water, Water Everywhere
reviews.content: A traditional activity when in Hanoi.  Different and interesting though it was impossible to follow any type of storyline.  The live music accompanying the show was excellent. Can't go wrong with this, tickets are very affordable and there are many showing every day. It's probably best to buy a day ahead because some showings do fill up.

reviews.author: CJ
reviews.title: Beautiful, talented and skilled storytellers
reviews.content: I really enjoyed the show and got the English audio which is an extra 50,000VD (in addition to your ticket price).I got the cheap tickets and was towards the back aisle in the middle. I was still able to see the show and enjoy it.Beautiful production and very talented Việt musicians and singers. I really enjoyed the music and singing and the puppetry was amazing. The show is around 45minutes long and there are 16 different stories that weaved into the performance. The stories are brief snapshots of things that are important to Vietnamese people and cover things like day to day life like farming and education, key historical events like the story of Ho Kiếm and the lake, to unicorns, dragons and phoenixes. The master puppeteers are skilled and you can tell that they have had to spend years mastering it. I definitely recommend coming to this show if you are not familiar with the culture and history.

reviews.author: NickGi
reviews.title: If you have the time a must do in Hà Nội !!
reviews.content: I have seen some nice performances and this one was very one we will remember. Book in advance if possible (at least 2 days) to get the best seats at the front. Wonderful live music played on traditional instruments and lovely singing with the water puppets make this truly a special experience. Last about 35 minutes and children will also enjoy the show.

reviews.author: Jocelyn R
reviews.title: Good time, break tradi - appreciated culture
reviews.content: A good moment of visual and sound poetry, live music and translated songs is a plus!!! We advise you to take the audio guide that allows you to define the main lines of the story ... remember to book ahead directly on site;-)

reviews.author: Lub2 spin
reviews.title: Light hearted entertainment for all ages
reviews.content: Really enjoyed the show. And the music, I was fascinated with their instruments. A wonderful experience for most ages.

reviews.author: alessandra_biondi3
reviews.title: Recognized as a National Heritage Site by UNESCO
reviews.content: Nice theatrical entertainment recognized heritage by UNESCO. It scenically depicts episodes of rural life in the rice fields. There are a dozen scenes, the most beautiful is the dance of dragons breathing fire, cute that of children playing in the water, even duck hunting, the most auspicious scene is that of the four celestial animals. The puppets are skillfully moved by horizontal tie rods hidden under the water.

reviews.author: OnAir38937315268
reviews.title: Fun Show, Great Visuals.
reviews.content: Fun, creative show, you get an interesting view of Vietnamese culture. It's all in Vietnamese, so it's hard to follow. Just enjoy the impressive visual effects. Shows are around 50 minutes.

reviews.author: Cosmo550
reviews.title: Easy to follow show in Vietnamese
reviews.content: Fun show, all in Vietnamese but for each section an English description is given on the screen beside the stage, could follow the show easily. Amazing musicians

reviews.author: S&O
reviews.title: Traditionell in Hanoi
reviews.content: We were in the afternoon performance. Very well attended. Interesting and definitely a little different. Relaxed and relaxing atmosphere.

reviews.author: sophiegrace24
reviews.title: Great Cultural Experience in Hanoi
reviews.content: What a fantastic cultural experience while staying in Hanoi. We booked the tickets through Get Your Guide and the pickup process from an office round the corner from the theatre was super easy.The live musicians and performers during the show were incredible.I would highly recommend getting the audio guide for some context on the stories being portrayed as this was really interesting

reviews.author: Clive and Clair... B
reviews.title: Wonderful Show 🎪
reviews.content: We had an evening in Hanoi, so we decided to book tickets 🎟️ for the Water Puppet Theatre. On arrival we also hired the audio guide so we could follow what was going on in English. Overall a unique cultural experience which was thoroughly enjoyable. It lasts slightly less than an hour and is excellent value for money..

reviews.author: MTAA
reviews.title: Unique experience
reviews.content: Fun experience at the puppet show. Provides interesting insight into Vietnamese culture through this unique artform.

reviews.author: Keelyimps
reviews.title: Very clever and very good.
reviews.content: As good as I thought. So cleverly done by the puppeteers. The traditional Vietnamese music was also lovely to hear played on instruments I hadn’t heard before and the singing was very unusual. I really liked this and would recommend anyone to go.

reviews.author: Christina W
reviews.title: Beyond Boring
reviews.content: The only people at the show were on vacation tours, because no one else would ever go to see this show. I'm convinced that the tour companies and the puppet people have reached some deal to fill the seats. I wish that I could get my 90 minutes back. The truth is, I spend the time clearing out my email account.

reviews.author: Heather S
reviews.title: Book early to get tickets!
reviews.content: When we arrived in the morning, we were lucky to get seats for the last showing at 9.15pm.  There are around 5 showings a day starting at 3pm and we decided to go for the VIP seats at the front for 200k Dong.  You don’t need an audio guide in my opinion.  The show only lasted around 50 minutes and it was lovely to see the clever use of music and puppetry.  A must see in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Deano1967
reviews.title: Traditional Vietnamese culture
reviews.content: I wasn't sure about going to see the water puppet show, thinking it wouldn't be my kind of thing but am happy to say I was totally wrong.The live music is played by very accomplished musicians who create a wonderful atmosphere for the supremely skilled puppeteers. The tale of legends and history contains humour, drama and pyrotechnics, narrated in Vietnamese with an audio guide available for those who wish to follow the story.Totally recommended and make sure you go for the more expensive tickets towards the front of the theatre.

reviews.author: jwg2
reviews.title: Management should provide guidelines for phone etiquette during the show
reviews.content: The water puppet show was very good and I'm glad we saw it. However, the experience was badly marred by a young mother in front of us who had a phone on a selfie-stick that she held up over her head to video the show. Many others in the audience also held their phones over their heads, which partially blocked the view of audience members behind them. The disrespectful use of phones was so distracting and annoying that I considered asking for my entrance fee to be refunded, but I did not do that. I think the theater management should provide brief guidelines at the beginning of each show asking the audience to respect the other audience members by not raising their phones above their heads.

reviews.author: Liliane M
reviews.title: IT'S WORTH IT TO GET AN IDEA BUT NOTHING MORE
reviews.content: Before you start if you want to see the show and be able to take pictures I recommend buying front row tickets because further back it is difficult because many people start recording and it is really annoying.The show lasted about 40 minutes. On both sides of the stage are musicians with their instruments, and singers.I personally found the scenarios very childish and a little repetitive.The puppet management is done with a stick that goes from side to side and sinks into the water.It is respectable the effort made to preserve the tradition but it did not finish convincing me.

reviews.author: Inger B
reviews.title: Magical moments on water
reviews.content: The show was a mesmerizing blend of tradition and artistry. As the puppets danced on the water, we were transported to a world of legends and folklore. The music was enchanting, and the skill of the puppeteers was incredible. We laughed, we cheered, and we were completely captivated. It was a unique experience that brought us closer together, sharing in the wonder of Vietnamese culture.

reviews.author: Shinester888
reviews.title: A great show!
reviews.content: We dropped in to check out the show. This was fun with historical flavour. Sure, it was not in English; however it did not matter! Weboth enjoined the show and musical backing! The seats towards the front are 200kVD. up the is 100k, and middle 150k. It was fun!

reviews.author: Alexandra N
reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.content: A funny cute experience that's not like anything I've seen before. Easy to interpret what is going on, don't think you need to pay extra for the audio guide. Not too long. Very entertaining. Nice to hear and see traditional Vietnamese craft and music.

reviews.author: Tegan C
reviews.title: Water Puppet Show with children
reviews.content: The puppet show is roughly an hour long - we choose not to have audio translation devices and we're easily able to follow along with the story and enjoy the show. If you have children, make sure you grab the seat booster as you walk in yo take your seats.

reviews.author: Otto S
reviews.title: Good visit if you have free time in Hanoi!
reviews.content: Puppet show in the water. It tells the story of Vietnamese, from its ancestral beginning to traditions of Vietnamese society.I really liked that all the melodies were live and the work quite professional.We didn’t have it in mind to visit but we ended up going and left satisfied I recommend 100%, pay the $2 audio guide since the work is in Vietnamese and without audio guide, nothing is understood.We saw how many people were leaving because they didn't know what was happening. Recommended but also not essential

reviews.author: Sussanne P
reviews.title: Enjoyable and worth a visit for the experience
reviews.content: Worth going , great little show , Seating uncomfortable especially if you have someone tall sitting in front of you .  very hot inside the theater also. Take a fan !Enjoyable overall for the price

reviews.author: Ashwini Marathe
reviews.title: Don't forget the audio guide!!
reviews.content: You need to book these tickets in advance as they get sold off quickly. Also we forgot to book our ticket with the English audio guide. In hindsight, I think it would have elevated our experience as the kids got restless since they couldn't understand anything. Anyways, the management needs to make a note that we  had booked deluxe seats but we were made to sit in the standard section. Their ground staff needs to be better trained. The actual show was about the different aspects of life in the ancient times. The puppets were awesome and kudos to the artists. Definitely a must watch but with an audio guide!

reviews.author: Gareth H
reviews.title: Skip the show tickets via Agoda
reviews.content: The show was fun, the puppetry is very cool even if we couldn't quite follow all of the stories (it is lots of small fables rather than one continuous story). However, getting in was an issue. We booked "skip the line" tickets through Agoda but when we arrived (15 mins early as per the email) there was no-one to give us a ticket and a long queue to buy a new ticket. The show had already sold out for multiple days by this point. Eventually someone came out to take names but there were so many of us from Agoda, Viagogo, etc that they did not have anywhere near enough tickets and the show began before anyone got in. I was one of the lucky few to only miss ~10 mins of the show, others were turned away for different shows, some on different days. Very stressful experience and really coloured our enjoyment of the evening. I would recommend to only buy paper tickets via the box office well in advance of the show. Definitely avoid any skip the queue tickets as you will likely have to skip the show.

reviews.author: Dan H
reviews.title: Traditional Vietnamese entertainment
reviews.content: We went to the theatre, we booked on the day.    This is a popular attraction, so suggest that you book early or in advance.This show is performed excellently and accompanied with live traditional music and spoken in Vietnamese. There is translation devices available but we didn't hire these and   the show was able to be followed.The show lasts about 50 mins and the theatre is very comfortable.Toilets on site and there is a little shop next door where you can get drinks from at reasonable prices and take in the venue.

reviews.author: Brett W
reviews.title: Rude tourists
reviews.content: The actual show was good, very informative and very enjoyable and the music was amazing, however the tourist with a serious lack of theatre etiquette (I’ve never seen anything like it; constant picture taking, constant loud talking and overall a few tourists ruined the experience and were very rude to everyone else in theatre) If the theatre could crack down on these individuals then r would become a 5 star experience.

reviews.author: Sandeep B
reviews.title: Give it a miss.
reviews.content: Took the VIP tickets for 3 (including a child) only for the people in the front 3 rows have their mobiles in full brightness recording and blocking our view. Even after telling them it's disturbing us, no effect. No ushers to stop them, no announcement to tell not to record. When complained to the staff, they said it's not their issue. I am sure that you can see the whole show of 30 mins in YouTube.

reviews.author: Shailesh S
reviews.title: Waste of time
reviews.content: The entire show was in Vietnamese and we didn't understand anything. Half the people leave the theatre mid-way. We had gone there with 2 toddlers and they didn't enjoy it all.

reviews.author: Mafalda N
reviews.title: Sympathetic show
reviews.content: A friendly show for a tourist audience. A few explanations about how the scenes unfolded would have been nice.

reviews.author: Hany G
reviews.title: Enchanting show with vitnamese language!
reviews.content: I tried to book the tickets thru the website but I had no luck, so for order for me to secure the tickets I booked skip the line ones. The tickets were way expensive than the actual ones.I had to wait in a long line to collect the tickets , and when I got the the window . The person at the window called for someone standing by the tickets to hand me the tickets.The good thing about the tickets are being more expensive than the regular tickets that we sat in the 2nd row and we had a good view.We loved the music and the show but I wished that we could had understood the storyline.There is an audio guide that helps you if you want to follow the storyline. The show is about 50 minutes. If you are late, you still can get in.

reviews.author: Giorgos-Rodos
reviews.title: Worth a visit even if you don’t understand the language
reviews.content: It's something you don't see in Greece, plus the live music and the professionalism of those who participate in the show, but the language is only in Vietnamese, without the possibility of subtitling. It is worth visiting, you can buy water puppets at a relatively good price.

reviews.author: Mary M
reviews.title: Would be better if filming was banned.
reviews.content: It was interesting and a good way to pass an hour. It would be better if they stopped people filming. I had two people in front of me with their phones up all the time. It spoilt the whole experience, and I was missing much of what was happening on stage. What little I did see looked good.

reviews.author: 5kidsBrisbane
reviews.title: Poorly organized
reviews.content: I really enjoyed the puppets and the musicians were amazing.  What gave it 3 stars is that even 15 minutes into the performance people are still being let into the theatre . We actually had a whole tour group come in 10 minutes in and had to file past everyone to the back of the theatre.  They were talking the whole way to the back and some kept trying to sit in the front row and were redirected back up stairs.  Another family came 15 minutes in to the second row and kept swapping seats with each other.  The man in front of me couldn’t fit into the seat properly and spent the whole performance frantically waving his phone in the air trying to take video or crouched over the seat in front.  There were no staff in the theatre to stop anything.  It was chaos.  Was it a good performance! Not sure as I could only see a quarter of it.

reviews.author: Wander65765109162
reviews.title: Nice and memorable experience
reviews.content: A fantastic performance. The story was fun and the atmosphere was good with live music. A very nice experience as warmly recommended.

reviews.author: Jim B
reviews.title: Charming Theatre Experience
reviews.content: Unique and delightful theatre experience - the puppets themselves were quite spectacular and the musical accompaniment was brilliant. Would highly recommend this to travellers to Hanoi

reviews.author: christine s
reviews.title: Traditional puppet show,but on water.
reviews.content: This is a water puppet show in a theatre,very popular and useually packed,in a seated theatre,so pre book and come early,The show is in17 acts,and flows along quickly,telling a story bypuppets controlled by artists under water.A superb traditional puppet show,for the youngand older,for families,with story elling entertainment.Skillfully displayed,good family entertainment.

reviews.author: Philip H
reviews.title: Sit back and be entertained
reviews.content: Very entertaining and colour full. Takes about one hour - like going to a panto. Don’t bother with the audio extract just sit back and be extertained

reviews.author: Spencer M
reviews.title: Absolutely amazing
reviews.content: Absolutely loved this show ! It’s a must see when visiting Hanoi. The venue is small and there isn’t a bad seat in the whole place.

reviews.author: Shoshanna C
reviews.title: Traditional entertainment with mixed feelings
reviews.content: We weren't quite sure what to expect, but this unique Vietnamese art form certainly surprised us! The live music and skilled puppeteers made the performance engaging, though we struggled to follow the storylines. Get there early for better seats - we had some view obstruction from the middle rows.

reviews.author: Sharmini_Violet
reviews.title: A good cultural and artistic show not to be missed!!
reviews.content: I like shows and this was something I was really looking forward to. I find this show very artistically and culturally facinating. Truly respect how they did it. The musicians are also great, good touch with the traditional musical instruments. Would recommend this show for sure!

reviews.author: Alberto G
reviews.title: Very good!
reviews.content: Puppet theater in the water - something practically unique in the world. Quick sessions in a comfortable environment. A very interesting experience. Although the story is told in local language to understand something.

reviews.author: BTS1972
reviews.title: Unique facet of Vietnamese culture
reviews.content: The theatre offers the most famous show of water puppets, a unique Vietnamese art style declared a Word Cultural Heritage Site. While we didn't understand the short stories presented to us as they are in Vietnamese, the puppetry was great. If you have the opportunity, visit this show once.

reviews.author: Puff Ce
reviews.title: A magical evening of art and laughter
reviews.content: The vibrant puppetry and enchanting music made us laugh and cheer. Sharing this unique cultural experience was a joy, with each scene drawing us into a world of folklore. We left with smiles, our hearts warmed by the magic of the evening.

reviews.author: saragio15
reviews.title: A Really Good Show!
reviews.content: We stumbled onto the puppet theatre whilst walking to the lake.We arrived at 15.50 and the next show was at 16.10 so just in time.Managed to get tickets for the middle zone at 150,000 VND each.We got a very good view of the show which was accompanied by lovely music and very skilful puppetry work which told a story.The performers wore beautiful traditional costumes.The show lasts 50 minutes, it is well worth the money and strongly recommend seeing if you are in Hanoi. There are several shows each day.

reviews.author: marabout54
reviews.title: Traditional Vietnamese show
reviews.content: Puppet show on the water, which is not on the lake of the restored sword, but simply in a theater located near the lake.Traditional show, but for us really original and surprising and really worth it. An excellent 40 minute experience.Hats off to puppeteers, musicians and singers

reviews.author: A333
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.content: We were lucky enough to be in the 2nd row so had a fantastic view. Although it’s hard to understand the story it was beautiful to watch. The music was great and is definitely something to go and see in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Marieke S
reviews.title: Very strange...
reviews.content: It really has to be your thing. We thought it was very special, not sure what we were looking at. It's pretty well made.

reviews.author: Daria C
reviews.title: A magical evening with traditional Vietnamese doll art
reviews.content: The water puppet show was simply enchanting! The combination of traditional music and the skillful puppet movements has completely captivated us. Especially the dragon scene was breathtaking. An absolute must in Hanoi!

reviews.author: Cord Bury
reviews.title: A mesmerizing evening of tradition
reviews.content: We were captivated by the vibrant puppets dancing on water, telling stories of Vietnamese culture. The music was enchanting, transporting us to another world. Sharing this experience together was magical, and we found ourselves laughing and gasping in delight.

reviews.author: Yasmin
reviews.title: Traditional Vietnamese Art
reviews.content: Despite not understanding the Vietnamese language, the music and skilled puppetry told beautiful stories. The theater was comfortably air-conditioned, and getting front-row seats made the experience even more magical for us. Worth every dong!

reviews.author: Ana K
reviews.title: Different day with my kid at the Water Puppet Theatre
reviews.content: We spent a great day with the family at the Water Puppet Theatre. The show was so different to what we are used to, my kid was intrigued until the end.

reviews.author: Janet K
reviews.title: Go see the Water Puppets! No regrets
reviews.content: I've never seen anything like it.  I enjoyed every moment.  And we only paid $24.00 USD for two people.  You will not regret this entertainment while in Saigon!!!!

reviews.author: Beric D
reviews.title: Enjoyable experience
reviews.content: Good show. All in Vietnamese, but didn’t really matter as the puppet show was enjoyable and in places amusing. Learned afterwards there was an audio translation available

reviews.author: Ightham1
reviews.title: A must do visit
reviews.content: We had just arrived in Hanoi, jet lagged and hot. We managed to buy good seats 10 minutes before the start of the 3 pm show. Bought water from the store next door. Nice air con. We also bought the audio headsets but these did not add much in my view. Nice show with love singers and instrumentals. Lasts about an hour.

reviews.author: Mavis W
reviews.title: Our great holiday
reviews.content: Stunning very unusual show Worth seeing very colorful and musical all rhe puppets in water on rods but you don't see this until the end when the puppeteers come from behind the curtains

reviews.author: GaryandCarolInOz
reviews.title: Good show when in Hanoi
reviews.content: Well worth a visit if in Hanoi.Very talented in the way it is presented and done.Book the vip tickets , they are with the extra few dollars, I think they were only 200d approx 12.5 aud.

reviews.author: Dr Kulkarni Mohina S
reviews.title: The most ancient history in hanoi..the unique water puppet show
reviews.content: This musical puppet show is a must visit in hanoi.It is based around 17 short narratives and beautiful narrative..music..artefacts..colours on water..it was my maiden experience. All characters depicted take you back to childhood..teen and later moments as memories...just wonderful. We got tickets easily

reviews.author: Geoffrey M
reviews.title: Worth seeing
reviews.content: if you have never seen water puppets before then this is definitely worth going.   We had to pick up the tickets a little distance from the theatre that seemed a little odd so you must allow at least 20 minutes to do this and get veto the theatre. The show works like clockwork and is very professional. You can see everything from the middle seats so i am not sure if the more expensive front rows are worth it. Worth doing but wouldn't have been upset if i missed it.

reviews.author: Andrea
reviews.title: Experience to do
reviews.content: Experience to do if you are in Hanoi for several days. The puppet show is well structured, the puppeteers and musicians are very good. It is better to have in hand the list with the titles of the various episodes otherwise you risk not understanding anything (they give it to the ticket office). The show lasts about an hour.You do not need to purchase tickets in advance.

reviews.author: Stephanie M
reviews.title: Unique experience
reviews.content: We opted to get our tickets ahead of time, making the process very easy as we only needed to turn up 5 minutes before the starting time and find our seats. We opted not to get the audio guide (an additional cost) and still enjoyed watching the show and listening to the musical instruments. Although this was an interesting show to watch due to how technically difficult it is to put on a puppet show like this, we don’t think it would be everyone’s cup of tea as it can be repetitive and hard to follow.

reviews.author: Adama
reviews.title: it's a splashing good time for anyone
reviews.content: The skilled puppeteers had us giggling like kids with their clever antics. This traditional Vietnamese art form is a must-see, with its spectacular display of colorful puppets dancing on water. We were mesmerized by the show's energy and creativity.

reviews.author: Marcel K
reviews.title: SCAM You pay double here.
reviews.content: It’s a SCAM. You pay double here and have to go to the counter nevertheless. Better buy your tickets in the theatre. If you buy them directly in the theatre you even can choose your seats.

reviews.author: Helen V
reviews.title: Magical and captivating performance
reviews.content: We highly recommend this performance. It was creative, had depth of character and the puppeteers and musicians were brilliant.

reviews.author: Tojo E
reviews.title: Worthwhile Cultural Experience/Visit
reviews.content: For anyone curious about Vietnam's culture, this is a worthwhile experience for any traveller.  The live music, with traditional singing and instruments makes the overall experience unique and well worth a visit for travellers.  Regarding tickets, it makes most sense to purchase ticket from the ticket office in front of the puppet show building at the original prices that their website also indicates (especially if one stays in the Old Quarter).  Some websites and options here on Trip Advisor offered tickets at much higher rates.I was able to get a ticket for a later show on the same day.  The specific seat and row can be chosen and is indicated on the ticket.  They say this is the only show that runs throughout the year.  The queue was not long at the ticket office but one or two earlier shows were fully booked.  So, flexibility within or across a day gives more options.  It was also nice to see that the most of the audience were thoughtful about not interrupting the view of others behind by taking continuous photos during the show.  There was separate guidance about not recording the show.Audio guides were available.  I didn't feel that one was necessary and probably that made it easier for me to engage deeper with the performance.  The show timeframe of around 50 minutes seemed about right.Overall, a worthwhile visit and experience.

reviews.author: Pier5
reviews.title: Dreams of a puppet
reviews.content: It will be a show let's say (for tourists), but it still remains pleasant and the puppeteers show great professionalism and the musicians and singers complete this show in an excellent way. The puppets appear and disappear in the water with lightness and amazement, tell stories, children smile, even if for us not knowing the language and culture may seem boring, but then in the end a round of applause is made for everyone, you will like it and Happy Travel

reviews.author: Fabrizio C
reviews.title: an incredible show.
reviews.content: I really liked the Water puppet show . i liked the music , the musicians , the peoples who where handling the puppets in the water, i am sure it is an hard work to entertainthe spectators ,so many times every day . So, i want to say thank you !

reviews.author: Fulvio D
reviews.title: A must try!!
reviews.content: We wanted to try this experience as it is typical of the city of hanoi and we came out ecstatic.We thought it was a simple puppet show but the show is really beautiful!

reviews.author: Marc Cozzolino
reviews.title: Wonderful moment at the water puppet show
reviews.content: The live music played was so lovely paired with the water puppet show skillfully manipulated was such a nice experience. We really enjoyed this moment even if rude people were speaking loudly during the show don’t hesitate to tell them to S the F up so they don’t ruin this wonderful show

reviews.author: Christian L
reviews.title: Perfect for families with Kids - Good and charming Entertainment with Live Music
reviews.content: Really Nice Show with Good, Authentic Live Music in a charming Theatre. I felt very good entertained and because of the length is it also perfect for kids.

reviews.author: iftkhar a
reviews.title: A lovely sight!
reviews.content: We were fascinated by the Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre! The vibrant colors, unique puppet movements and traditional music created a truly magical atmosphere. A unique and unmissable experience in Hanoi!

reviews.author: Antonia
