reviews.title: Unique experience
reviews.content: The water puppet show was one of a kind and very entertaining. It was very interesting to experience traditional vietnamese music and see the colourful play. The cheapest tickets (100.000 dong) are for the top rows, which offer a great view - no need to buy a VIP ticket. The theater itself is kind of run down.

reviews.author: Bauerin
reviews.title: Kurzweilig
reviews.content: We spontaneously went to the water puppets / theater for the 4 pm performance and also did not have to queue at the box office.In the theatre itself, it is a bit musty, but certainly also due to the humidity of the water pool.The piece itself was entertaining, the accompanying music was live.We had the cheapest tickets for 100,000 dong and could see everything perfectly. For the price I can really recommend a visit.

reviews.author: kate
reviews.title: A captivating spectacle
reviews.content: The Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre offers a unique and unforgettable experience. We were captivated by the artistry and skill of the puppeteers. The performance was both entertaining and culturally enriching, making it a must-see for any visitor to Hanoi.

reviews.author: Mrs.H2141
reviews.title: Cultural Experience not to be missed in Vietnam
reviews.content: Not to be missed when visiting Hanoi. There’s a wonderful history of water puppetry in Vietnam. We were mesmerized the entire time! The traditional musicians played traditional instruments and the singers shared beautiful songs. We’re still trying to figure out how the puppeteers did it all! Most of us in my group only spoke English, but it really did not matter. They provided cushions for my little ones to prop up. The room is well air-conditioned and the ushers are all very helpful. My only suggestion is for the establishment to announce a reminder to audience members to be mindful of cell phone usage. I had a man next to me have a FaceTime conversation with his entire family 🤦🏻‍♀️.

reviews.author: GoPlaces45489730921
reviews.title: You should see it at least once!
reviews.content: It was very interesting to see a floating puppet show for the first time. I wonder how they move it. It was hard to buy tickets, but the staff were very kind.

reviews.author: Hiphopfun
reviews.title: Water Puppet
reviews.content: We attended this through a group booking and were seated about 8 rows from the front.The puppeteers are brilliant and it was really enjoyable.What wasn’t enjoyable was the people trying to take photos and film.They should ban cameras whilst there is a performance

reviews.author: Karen N
reviews.title: Awesome show
reviews.content: So worth seeing the show. Definitely get the translation device as it explains all the stories into your language and you will better understand what you are watching.

reviews.author: Chey S
reviews.title: Something different and well worth the visit
reviews.content: Ok, so there are a lot of mixed reviews on this place.  But there is a reason that it’s been operating for so so long.  It’s a great show, yes the theatre is old, but it’s clean.It’s not something you would do over and over again, but it deserves to be on the list of great things to do in Hanoi.  I’d recommend one of the afternoon shows, you get some reprieve from the heat and by the time you exit cars are being exited from the old quarter.The show is funny and entertaining, the puppeteers and musicians are skilled artists.  We didn’t use the language translation and still throughly enjoyed the show.It was wonderful to see something that is still done my people and not CGI.

reviews.author: Geeta
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.content: A must show to watch as it depicts the life of Vietnamese people...however they should explain in english as tourist from all over the world come to see this marvellous show..

reviews.author: crskumar
reviews.title: Unique water puppet show
reviews.content: We booked vip tickets and got front row seats for the show. It was a nice show. We went a little late and did not know there was translation headphones available so couldn't enjoy the show as much.

reviews.author: Aditya M
reviews.title: Interesting experience
reviews.content: This was on my list of things to do in Hanoi. Definitely worth to check it out. We got the audio translation device that cost us around 100,000 VND which I think makes it easier to follow what’s happening.  Try to buy the tickets at the venue a bit earlier if possible to get the front row seats.

reviews.author: dougs007
reviews.title: Interesting experience
reviews.content: The theatre is conveniently located in the old quarter right in front of the lake. We didn’t pay extra for the audio guide like some others have suggested. Though I couldn’t follow the story too well, I think it’s optional. Do try buying the tickets early to get better seats. Would recommend the front section which of course would cost the most. Roughly USD8/VND200k. Especially during summer, it is a good alternative to escape from the heat and humidity.  Part of the Vietnamese heritage.

reviews.author: Talfranky
reviews.title: Worth seeing, just buy tickets at venue
reviews.content: We just walked in and purchased our tickets then and there, we were in the front row which was good and not cramped, the show itself is well worth seeing, even though we didn’t know the story line you can pretty much make most of it out, its very clever how these puppets are manoeuvred and the live traditional music throughout is lovely, 50 minutes is a bit too long and we noticed many people leaving half way through, definitely worth seeing on your visit to Vietnam.

reviews.author: tinkle_24
reviews.title: Not to be missed. Highly recommended!
reviews.content: A truly amazing sight to behold. Never heard of water puppetry before. Absolutely dexterous arms to control large size puppets using poles that went underwater. Coordination was stunning.

reviews.author: LET GO LEASH • Alecia
reviews.title: Immersive experience of traditional culture! So fun!
reviews.content: This was so enjoyable! The theater was very clean and air conditioned. I would suggest getting your tickets a day early and getting a spot near the front so you can see well and don't have to wait in the line before the show. The traditional music and singing was so enjoyable as well as watching the puppets.I paid extra and got the audioguide and I would not suggest it. The themes and plots of each story and simple. I would suggest sitting back and just experiencing the show. This would be great activity for families!Also, be mindful you can't bring food or drink in. I had just bought an iced coffee and to throw it out

reviews.author: Edward B
reviews.title: Wonderful show ruined by rude people
reviews.content: The show would be fantastic if not for the very rude audience members. We had to leave the first show we had tickets for due to a family of about 7 seated in the front row. They wouldn't stay seated, talked non-stop, and ruined the show for anyone seated around them.We left and had to argue with the staff for over 15 minutes to either get tickets for a later show or get a refund. At least 3 staff told us this was impossible until I threatened a bad review. Finally, someone who appeared to be in charge changed us to a later show.About 5 minutes a man and his young child moved to the row in front of us and proceeded to talk through the entire performance. The music and puppetry are amazing. The rude audience members and the staff who allow the rude behavior, make this less than a great experience. If you are going to go, ensure you get front row seats so no one with bad makers can disrupt  the show for you.If you go to the show, don't be one of those peoplenwhonruin the shpuw for everyone else because you don't know how to behave in a public place.

reviews.author: billybean
reviews.title: So So
reviews.content: Having read the reviews I thought this was very much a must do in Hanoi. I was mistaken. It really is hyped up. The performance is ok however not at all as good as the show in Hoi An Memories Park. (Doesn't even really rate up there). Its a bit like a more lively punch and judy show. I would recommend getting seats near the front if you go and just enjoy the puppets. Not sure you really need the audio translation which we got as I don't think it added that much. Ok to while away an evening however there are a lot more interesting things to see.

reviews.author: Grace
reviews.title: Good fun!
reviews.content: The show was great, my partner and I really enjoyed it. It presented a story about Vietnamese culture in a fun way which is enjoyable for everyone.

reviews.author: ryu0803
reviews.title: Interesting
reviews.content: This is a very popular activity in Hanoi and we enjoyed it. The live music and singing were captivating and the puppet performance on the water was truly unique and interesting. The theatre was clean and well air conditioned, providing a comfortable setting.We rented the audio guide,but I would not recommend it. The guide did not provide full translations, and only gave brief explanations about each act. The sound quality was also poor, as the loud music made it difficult to hear the commentary. The story was simple, so it was easy to just sit back and enjoy the show, even without understanding Vietnamese.The only downside was the lack of restroom inside the theatre. There was a toilet available outside, it was guarded by an attendant who charged a fee to use it. This totally downgraded the otherwise lovely experience.

reviews.author: Passenger16996982476
reviews.title: Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre
reviews.content: A delighted show for kids. This is the first time watching puppet show on a small water stage. Tradditional music and funny story teller. Recommend!

reviews.author: Liz Luu Spence
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.content: Amazing show in Hanoi ,Vietnam. Staffs were nice, helpful. The puppets were so cute and sweet movement. The perfect combination

reviews.author: Kris
reviews.title: To add this into your itinerary if this is your first time visit Hanoi
reviews.content: For tourist, can add this into your schedule if this is your first time visit Hanoi. Just that ticket counter not that friendly. Hence minus one star for unpleasant service served by ticket counter staff.

reviews.author: Kshire A
reviews.title: Marvelous show which cannot miss
reviews.content: 15th May had enjoyed Water Puppet show which was most beautiful and unique show which we had never seen before.  The idea and execution was marvelous and beyond imagination though story telling was in Vietnamese language but it was understand to everyone they can provide microphone if you need to listen in your language which cost Rs 150 and Hindi  English language were added in microphone.  Do not miss this show if you visit in Hanoi

reviews.author: Katrina P
reviews.title: Good show
reviews.content: Reasonably priced. If you're short, try and get a ticket in the front row because the seating is on a shallow tier. Very colorful, very clever and live music.

reviews.author: beribache
reviews.title: Very nice show
reviews.content: A wonderful culture and a must-see when in Hanoi. We really enjoyed it and the audio guide was a good addition for $2.Worth a visit.

reviews.author: Eric C
reviews.title: Gorgeous ! Not to be missed 🤩
reviews.content: Magnificent show with singers and musicians on stage.It's an extraordinary spectacle.A word of advice, the audio guide is useless.

reviews.author: Mark P
reviews.title: Worthwhile entertainment
reviews.content: Excellent puppetry skills in an entertaining format. A Hanoi speciality not to be missed. The musicians added to the overall performance. You don’t need to speak Vietnamese to enjoy the show.

reviews.author: Nga H
reviews.title: It is necessary to innovate ways of doing things so that foreign visitors can fully understand the beauty of water puppetry
reviews.content: I brought a foreign friend to see the show. The professional quality of the performance is good, but one drawback is that most of the audience are international guests, but there are no introductions or subtitles in English to explain to guests the content and meaning of each scene. . For Vietnamese people, we are very familiar with the scenes and characters in the show, but for foreigners, it is like playing a buffalo guitar. The content of each scene should be briefly introduced on the program brochure, at least in English. This is very simple and I don't understand why they haven't been able to do it all these years.

reviews.author: Milla
reviews.title: Way cooler than it sounds!
reviews.content: Okay,  we admit it – "water puppet theatre" didn't exactly scream romance. But Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre was a blast! The puppeteers were incredibly skilled, the puppets were super colorful, and the whole experience was surprisingly hilarious. A fun, quirky date night activity if you want something totally different in Hanoi!

reviews.author: Dominik F
reviews.title: Great show, undisciplined people
reviews.content: The performance itself is great. It is unique and interesting. We really enjoyed it. But it should absolutely be forbidden to use cameras during the show. Dozens of people were filming non stop which is disturbing if you sit behind them.

reviews.author: George Severin
reviews.title: A cultural evening in Hanoi
reviews.content: The Thang Long Water Puppet Theater is located at 57B P. Đinh Tiên Hoàng Street, northeast of Hoan Kiem Lake, so it is easy to reach on foot from Hanoi's Old Town. The water puppet theater is a Vietnamese tradition. The performance lasts about 1 hour. A beautiful stage set with musicians who accompany the show musically and colorful puppets that tell stories from everyday Vietnamese life in the water made me feel like a little boy! The theater was (mostly) fully booked with tourists, including many families with small children. You don't have to speak Vietnamese to understand the stories. The scenes are designed so that you can understand what they are about. And all of this for less than €10.00 admission per person. A cultural evening in Hanoi!

reviews.author: JGMcG
reviews.title: A lovely little insight into Vietnamese culture
reviews.content: We really enjoyed our visit to the water puppet show. It was cute and a great insight into Vietnamese culture. Definitely recommend the audio guide so you have some idea what's going on as it is slightly random.

reviews.author: Christoph J
reviews.title: Nice cultural trip
reviews.content: Very nice performanceBut it is recommended to get an audio system for 100,000 dongIt is more fun with the translation

reviews.author: Vilda
reviews.title: Very nice!
reviews.content: I did not understand a word, but I liked it very much either way! I would definitely go again if I am back in hanoi! Also very kid friendly!

reviews.author: Martyn Rapps
reviews.title: Super show
reviews.content: I was unsure that  we would be able to get tickets as our bus from Sapa was on a Friday evening & I wanted the 17.20 time slot.Swan from Bella Rosa hotel kindly booked our tickets in advance so they were waiting for us at check-in.Our room at the Bella Rosa & travel was only a 4 min walk from the theatre ( 5 secs  if we  jumped 😆😆)

reviews.author: suejim126@yahoo.co.uk
reviews.title: Brilliant and unique show
reviews.content: It was a wonderful 45-minute show. It's not something we would normally go to, but I'm so glad we did. It is worth paying the small price to get the audio guide, as it explains the basis behind the story the puppets act out. The music and puppets were fantastic, making it a unique experience.

reviews.author: sullnan
reviews.title: A great show
reviews.content: Very interesting to see all of the puppet being moved in the water. You don't need to understand Vietnamese to enjoy the show. A truly authentic and exciting experience.

reviews.author: Valigessa
reviews.title: Worth seeing, but without exaggerated expectations
reviews.content: It is a traditional show and as such deserves to be seen.The stories told through music, singing and dialogues belong to Vietnamese rural life: naturally the language is the local one, but the development is still intuitive.For my attention span a little too long (50 minutes).

reviews.author: dianedinky
reviews.title: I guess it's just me, but disappointing!
reviews.content: The group I was in seemed to love this, the locals around me loved it and the children smiled throughout.  But it wasn't for me.We had no translator so could just about follow the story but missed all the little jokes and song lyrics that may have entertained which meant it had to be a purely visual experience.  And I wasn't impressed.Call me a numpty but I found the puppetry to be a bit simplistic and repetitive with the same few actions throughout.  There was certainly no wow moment, just overly long and boring.I spent time watching the female singers on the right of the stage and they seemed more intent on chatting and giggling with each other - but maybe that was part of the story?!!I guess I am more of a stringed puppet sort of a gal.  The water variety seemed to have limited movements.

reviews.author: F M
reviews.title: A good show showcasing traditional arts
reviews.content: This is such a blast! Firstly Book ticket early especially on weekends and get there early due to queue and especially if you want translation which we missed because we got there on time. Once inside it was 50 minutes of singing, music and puppetry and a wonderful display of traditional artistry - even though I couldn't understand  I followed the story and had a lovely time.

reviews.author: Hernando C
reviews.title: Confusing storyline and meh puppets
reviews.content: We left the Thang Long Water Puppet Show more confused than entertained. The storyline was hard to follow, and the puppets looked a bit worn out. Maybe good for little kids, but a disappointment for adults seeking a deeper cultural experience.

reviews.author: Sinnan
reviews.title: Thang Long Water Puppet Show
reviews.content: We were mesmerized by the Thang Long Water Puppet Show! The intricate puppets and skilled puppeteers brought Vietnamese myths and legends to life. Sitting side-by-side, we marveled at the artistry and learned a bit about Vietnamese culture.

reviews.author: Don
reviews.title: Do try it if you never experience before
reviews.content: Agreed that if you have never watched any water puppet show, you should try this out. There are many timings to choose from. If you dont want to queue, you can buy via Klook. Found out it is cheaper to buy at the counter. The counter lady will explain nicely to you where are the good seats. Do rent the translator for a small fee so that you can better enjoy and understand the show which is in Vietnamese. The seats are pretty tight so please have the courtesy to stand up for others to walk past you. I saw a couple simply didnt move at all and the other couples have great difficulty moving in. It will be great if they can rebuild the seats. Many ppl just lift up their phones & start taking photos & videos, blocking the ppl behind. Kind of irritating. Nevertheless, it is highly recommended.

reviews.author: The Highland Foody
reviews.title: Security Guard extorting tourists
reviews.content: The show is worth seeing but be very careful of the security guard who is extorting tourists of money to use the toilet. He is not always there but mindful!

reviews.author: LastMinuteLarry
reviews.title: Go and enjoy the puppet show!
reviews.content: If you have never seen a water puppet show, then for the small cost you should go.  The show is made up of several short traditional stories, which you may not understand fully, but nevertheless it is entertaining.  At the time of our visit, it appeared that tickets could only be purchased at the theatre box office and online tickets may not always be accepted - please check before purchase.  The show is less than one hour and most seats have a good view.

reviews.author: arpitam
reviews.title: Unique experience
reviews.content: This is the first time we are watching water puppet show. A unique experience to watch the traditional art form become live. Though the play is in Vietnamese, the story is quite comprehensible and comes live with melodious songs and vibrant music. Even in this digital world, it is wonderful to see the artists continue their traditional culture and maintain the legacy of puppetry to the next generations. A must watch if you are in Hanoi.

reviews.author: JBertero
reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.content: Amazing live performance! We liked the show very much, and I recommend it to everyone visiting Hanoi. It’s a nice getaway from the chaos.

reviews.author: Chris318i
reviews.title: Great play
reviews.content: My wife, three sons (10 months, 3 and 6 years old) and I visited the Thang Long Water Puppet Theater spontaneously and luckily we also got tickets. The play was really entertaining for the kids and us. We enjoyed the show and could definitely recommend it.

reviews.author: Vatsala S
reviews.title: Fabulous show
reviews.content: Amazing puppet show with good folk music and  folk art of creating drama with puppets in water. Dragons spitting fire is spectacular. Funny little moments throughout.

reviews.author: Tony D
reviews.title: Unique experience and a must see if in Hanoi
reviews.content: A unique experience and highly recommended. You can buy your ticket at the theatre, though I would recommend booking in advance (at least a day in advance). The show was around an hour and was very entertaining. As well as admiring the puppeteers skills you can enjoy a local traditional Vietnamese orchestra. I would highly recommend going to the theatres web site before you go so that you understand what each act is about. Information can be found at the bottom of the page "Booking Tickets". Here is the current list of acts:1. Tễu – The iconic character of Water PuppetryChú Tễu ("chú" means uncle, man, boy or Mr. in Vietnamese) is a recurrent and the most notable character in water puppetry. Tễu means "laugh" in ancient Vietnamese. He is a jester who provides witty comments on political and social realities, especially officials' corruption. His appearance is of a smiling boy who often wears nothing but a simple loincloth, sometimes accompanied by a simple open vest.2. Dragon dance, phoenix danceThe Dragon is considered the ancestor and also the mascot with an important position in the folk culture beliefs of Vietnamese people. The Phoenix is the mascot of Vietnamese folk beliefs, often living in pairs, the male is Phuong and the female is Loan. The dance of the ‘Loan Phuong’ couple is a symbol of fidelity in married life.3. Buffalo riding and playing the fluteDescribing the peaceful life of Vietnamese countryside, the flute's sound reminded the love of expatriate for the country.4. Agriculture, rice plantingThe daily work of Vietnamese farmers: plowing, slapping water, harvesting... That image of hardworking farmers in the field shows the spirit of ardent Vietnamese farmers.5. Frog fishingTelling a humorous story about a farmer's fishing trip, fishing for frogs is both a livelihood and a pastime for farmers in their leisure time.6. Chasing the FoxThis is the story of an old farmer couple who struggle to chase away a sly fox to protect their ducks.7. FishingFlock of fishes swimming flexibly in the water; A couple of fishermen sit on a small boat, a farmer is shoveling shrimp; A mischievous guy who teases a girl is a vibrant picture of the daily life of Vietnamese farmers. …

reviews.author: Wonder A
reviews.title: Amazing Water Puppet Show at Thang Long
reviews.content: It was our first time watching the Water Puppet Show at Thang Long. We were amazed that the water puppetry was performed in a pool of water with the water surface being the stage. Apparently it is a unique art which originated i the delta of the Red river in the 10th century.

reviews.author: Hergenröther M
reviews.title: A fascinating show!
reviews.content: We spontaneously decided to visit the Thang Long water puppet theater and loved it! The colorful puppets, the traditional music and the exciting stories enchanted us. The puppeteers are true artists and it was fascinating to watch. A really entertaining and unique experience that we can recommend to every visitor to Hanoi!

reviews.author: Voyageur
reviews.title: Very nice in 50 minutes
reviews.content: It's quite fun and entertaining for adults and children, remember to book, anytime in the world9 live musicians

reviews.author: Hakim H
reviews.title: Splashy storytelling you absolutely won't understand
reviews.content: Amazingly skilled. They danced, fought, and one even looked like it was breathing fire  (or maybe just sneezing? Hard to tell underwater). The musicians were rocking out, the puppeteers were soaked, and the audience was laughing and cheering.  Even without knowing the stories, the craftsmanship and the sheer energy was contagious. We felt like kids again, completely drawn into the spectacle.

reviews.author: Cecilie J
reviews.title: DON’T BOOK TICKETS ONLINE
reviews.content: Very bad experience. We booked online, so we didn’t have to stand in line for tickets, but when we came to the place, they didn’t know what to do with online tickets. We were many people there with the online tickets just waiting and waiting for nothing really. It resultet in us waiting in 20 minutes after the show startet and when we finally got in, we couldn’t even choose our own seats.

reviews.author: 蘇偉倫
reviews.title: Interesting traditional art
reviews.content: We loved the Thang Long Water Puppet Theater show! The water puppet show combines traditional musical instruments, colorful stage effects and legendary stories. It is really charming. The puppet masters are highly skilled and control the puppets so lifelike that we can't take our eyes off them.The performance atmosphere was joyful and lively, and special effects such as splashing water were unexpected, bringing many surprises. Although I don’t understand Vietnamese, I am already enjoying it just by looking at the scenes and the actors’ vivid expressions. Thang Long Water Puppet Theater provides a unique and fun experience for couples on dates, highly recommended! It is recommended to book tickets in advance, especially if you want to sit in the front row.

reviews.author: alasdair
reviews.title: A good visit
reviews.content: A fun experience, I don’t feel it was worth buying the audio guide (we didn’t buy it) as the experience was good in itself. The only negative was the process of buying tickets being disorganised.

reviews.author: Mariana Vieira
reviews.title: Great entertainment options in Hanoi, I recommend it!
reviews.content: The show is all in Viatnamita, but it's really cool, you don't even need a translation to understand, the show itself is beautiful, you'll be fascinated looking at the water and imagining how they do that, and the music and everything is very beautiful! It's cheap, but always buy in advance and arrive early

reviews.author: Giuseppe z
reviews.title: Cute
reviews.content: Cute nothing much. It was included in the tour and we did it. It is still a piece of Vietnamese tradition but a little long.

reviews.author: Freedom51332995290
reviews.title: Thought it was awesome!
reviews.content: Not really knowing what to expect, I was blow away by everything, the little theatre was beautiful, the show was excellent, funny, serious, and the performers were outstanding, I loved every second. Highly recommend seeing it.

reviews.author: Alessandro S
reviews.title: Beautiful show
reviews.content: I didn't think he was so handsome and charming. beautiful show and great mastery of the musical group that accompanied the performance. The artists are returning from a world tour which led them to perform in 70 countries. The show takes place 365 days a year

reviews.author: A S
reviews.title: Water puppet show
reviews.content: This is a unique experience to see a water puppet show. Villages used to give water puppet shows to visiting dignitaries to express grievances so an individual didn’t loose their head!

reviews.author: Carolina E
reviews.title: Interesting!
reviews.content: The show is interesting. Very different. But the theater itself is horrible. There is little difference in height between the rows and it is very difficult to see the show the further back you are. I recommend getting it right in front.

reviews.author: Dee Lindgren
reviews.title: A breathtaking traditional spectacle in Hanoi
reviews.content: The show, both fun and traditional, amazed us. The performances were not only entertaining, but also a fascinating window into Vietnamese culture. For couples looking for an exciting evening in Hanoi, this theater is a must-see.

reviews.author: Adam
reviews.title: Awesome show
reviews.content: Awesome experience, well oiled operation.If you want the show in your language, they have audio for that.I went for the real show, and really enjoyed it.For the price it is outstanding

reviews.author: Julia S
reviews.title: An hour well spent. Would recommend
reviews.content: An interesting and unique hour watching water puppets. Not really sure of the story as didn’t have the earphones but it was entertaining once the fool in front put her phone down that she was videoing from.

reviews.author: madtat
reviews.title: Water puppets Hanoi
reviews.content: First time seeing anything like this. The important message to get across is the puppeteers were excellent; an incredible job standing behind a curtain out of sight and extending these very long control poles under the waters surface. At times you could see the poles but just as often they were well below the waters surface. Show was 45-50 minutes under puppets were accompanied by musicians from start to finish. I considered the music just as important as the puppets and gave the musicians equal attention. They were talented on traditional “ancient” wood instruments and the females had beautiful vocals. It was unfortunate that some of the musicians appeared bored and unhappy during the performance. After seeing their schedule I can understand; several shows a day, seven days a week must be trying on them. That aside it was a very entertaining performance for children and adults. The audience gave a well deserved standing ovation as the puppeteers revealed themselves at the end. I look at this as sort of a lost art that should be appreciated by every generation, young & old. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: lallatotal
reviews.title: Experience worth the trip to Vietnam
reviews.content: The puppet show is one of the experiences in Vietnam that is worth the trip. The artists are truly extraordinary, they enchant and captivate with their incredible ability to move puppets from under the water with long wooden sticks, animating stories that narrate the rural and cultural reality of the country. Also very good are the musicians and singers, who, with talent and big smiles, play truly curious ancient instruments. An unmissable show, top marks.

reviews.author: Ramon Guerrero
reviews.title: Very good site
reviews.content: An incredible place, the lines go fast, the ushers efficient, everything very well organized. And the interesting show, very good music…

reviews.author: elleeliza
reviews.title: An evening theatre trip to see the water puppets show
reviews.content: We bought central audience tickets (150k each) and we had no problem seeing the show.I would say audio description in your language (which is an additional 50k) is essential as it adds so much more context to the Vietnamese folk tales being acted out by the puppets.The music from the orchestra was fantastic and in particular the singers looked like they were having a great time being part of the show.The puppets were colourful, fun and skilfully controlled; I would recommend anyone visiting Hanoi take an afternoon or evening out to go see the water puppet show.

reviews.author: Angeles Echevarria
reviews.title: CURIOUS AND DIFFERENT SHOW
reviews.content: In which they recreate Vietnamese customs and legendsAt the end, those who carry the puppets in the water come outThere is also live music and singingThe place is very old and it is better to arrive on time to find your seat.

reviews.author: Amy P
reviews.title: Great show
reviews.content: Great show! Got tickets from Trip Advisor. Great seats! I suggest getting the translation device, it will help you understand how the puppet show came into existence.

reviews.author: Max H
reviews.title: Mind Blowing
reviews.content: You know the kind of movies that are so bad that they’re kinda good? This was that kind of experience - and I don’t mean the performers themselves, they were spectacular and this show is most definitely worth coming to. However, if you happen to be seated next to the coughing, talking, flash picture taking group we were, then you may want to skip it unless you’d like a prescribed does of bronchitis. Every 10 seconds there was a deep cough attack from the girl and her sister in front of us, the kind that envelopes you fully and comes from the depths of hell. Their mom would occasionally tap them and loudly tell them about some joke she heard the other day (I can only assume, they were speaking Russian) only to be interrupted by more coughing. The only thing more distracting than their coughing was the constant video taping with flash on. -1/10 seat, 10/10 puppets.

reviews.author: Wazeer
reviews.title: Good but needs organization
reviews.content: I found it extremely interesting how they use the puppets. The show itself is amazing, but it needs to be more organized. It gets extremely busy, and the lady at the counter doesn't give proper information. Booking in advance is necessary. Also, the majority of people coming to see the show are foreigners and tourists, so why isn't it in English? Yes, you can rent those speakers that explain, but come on, 95% of viewers are tourists; English would work a lot better. So, a little disappointed. Also, they have such huge crowds coming in, but the bathroom situation is terrible.

reviews.author: Claire Moreau
reviews.title: Fantastic show
reviews.content: A very unique and charming puppet show that everyone coming to Vietnam must experience. Yes, it's touristy but it's definitely something most people will enjoy. The show lasts about an hour and at 200,000vnd a ticket (for the “expensive” seats), it is well worth the entry price.

reviews.author: James Smith
reviews.title: A magical evening
reviews.content: We had a blast watching the fun, skilled performances at the Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre. The traditional art form was enchanting, and we were amazed at the puppeteers' talents. The show was a delightful mix of humor, music, and Vietnamese culture. A must-see for couples looking for a unique and entertaining experience in Hanoi!

reviews.author: ruggero52
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: A show not to be missed if you stop in Hanoi even for just a few hours. You are amazed and amazed to see those splendid puppets twirling on the surface of the water accompanied by no less talented musicians and singers. A more unique than rare show. Live show.

reviews.author: Angie H
reviews.title: Worth the cultural experience but not excellent
reviews.content: Beautiful colorful puppets, skilled puppetry and musicians telling some historical and folklore stories... So it's cultural and educational, but after 30 minutes was kind of bored. The audio guide explanation in English was key, as was buying tickets ahead of time. Worth it but won't blow your socks off.

reviews.author: Maggiemum2
reviews.title: Very Entertaining
reviews.content: A brilliant show by the puppeteers and musicians provides a most entertaining way to spend an hour in Hanoi.Great for kids - big and small.

reviews.author: MTMHampshire
reviews.title: Worth doing but get audio guide
reviews.content: It is a traditional art form so worth doing I think. For us one thing reducing the score was us not understanding the stories - get the audio guide. It is clever and obviously takes skill. The show is less than an hour so not too long.

reviews.author: LaNyonsaise
reviews.title: Absolutely charming.
reviews.content: Firstly, buy your tickets in advance as our chosen times were sold out for the two days we were in Hanoi. We queued at the box office where the booking system is a paper based seating plan so I’m not sure how that fits with online tickets. The show was absolutely delightful and highly professional with around 10 singers and musicians. The 8-10 puppeteers are only revealed at the end and are very skilful. My only complaint is that the management allowed latecomers to take their seats after the performance had started and there was insufficient space to give them access without inconvenience to those who were punctual and blocking the view of those seated.

reviews.author: Scott K
reviews.title: Save your money and find something more fun to do.
reviews.content: While it probably takes some skill to operate puppets on water from behind a screen, the end result is a boring production. Traditional live music quickly becomes annoying. Fortunately, the show is short. I wish I could say I am glad we  experienced it, but I can't.

reviews.author: Maria O
reviews.title: Beautiful Art Form That Illustrates Vietnamese Culture and Legends
reviews.content: Great glimpse into a beautiful art form.  Inexpensive, can buy tickets online or at the theater.  Fun to learn about water puppetry and watch the puppeteers at work.  Puppet show was preceded by beautiful Vietnamese music by the live band and singers.  Performers emerge from behind the curtain at the end of the show.  Nice area around the theater near the water for a post-theater walk.

reviews.author: tenset
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: It was really amazing to witness how traditions were reflected to today.Interesting stories though in Viet only. We entered the theater with some reservations and exited fascinated.Harmony of movements with each other and especially with the music was shocking. All participated in this show should be whole heartedly congratulated.

reviews.author: Germaine L
reviews.title: Delightful puppet and live music performance; audio translation not a must
reviews.content: There is an option to purchase an audio translation guide for the performance, however I felt it is not necessary because it is a very visual performance. Recommended to sit closer to the stage to really appreciate the details in the puppet and musician performances.

reviews.author: Lori M
reviews.title: can I give this 6 stars?
reviews.content: we didn't expect much but both LOVED the show! the characters and vignettes were so charming. couldn't understand a word but didn't need to. the live musicians were perfect. buy tickets in advance because it sells out - we didn't and could only get seats near the back. we could still see ok but it would have been better in the front. loved it so much I would have seen it again if we had time.

reviews.author: Albert Miller Jr
reviews.title: Great Performance!!
reviews.content: Awesome show! The music, the puppeteers. A must see while in Hanoi. I’d recommend upgrading your seats to the first class seating rows just so that you’re comfortable during the show, as the seats are a bit narrow without much leg room.

reviews.author: Adrian R
reviews.title: Unusual and absorbing
reviews.content: The live music created quite an atmosphere, and the puppetry was absorbing and occasionally amusing even though I hadn’t bothered getting an audio guide and didn’t know what was going on.  It lasted for around an hour, maybe a bit less, which was perfect.  I think it’s worth getting the VIP seats at the front: we did, and our view was excellent, but I’m not sure I’d have enjoyed it so much from further back.  Like quite a lot of things we did in Vietnam, I’d have given it 4 stars in most places but the good value for money here makes it 5.

reviews.author: ron12345100
reviews.title: Great show
reviews.content: Great show . Amazing skill to create something so unique. Something I am glad I went to see.Fun for any age whether you are 9 or 99 this show will put a smile on your face.Skilled performers

reviews.author: AlbaAlba
reviews.title: Best experience in Hanoi so far 🩷
reviews.content: This was truly a great experience. So far from anything we know in the west. This needs to be visited. We saw the whole show in Vietnamese, which is what I can recommend. You will definitely get the best experience and don’t worry it is very illustrative. Do it 🩷

reviews.author: kohechin
reviews.title: Traditional Crafts
reviews.content: I guess opinions will differ depending on whether you can understand the language and whether you find the puppet show interesting. However, I honestly don't think it's "very good". I thought it was "average" as a traditional craft. The live music and singing is like Cirque du Soleil, which I think is amazing.

reviews.author: Noah
reviews.title: Unique experience
reviews.content: My family decided to watch the Water Puppet show in Hanoi - a clever and enjoyable experience for a night out. The show lasted an hour, perfect duration in my opinion, especially when you have kids with short attention spans 🤣. The puppetry was so unique, I had never seen anything like it! The voice actors and musicians were amazing, in fact I would almost go to the show just for the music alone!! The puppet theatre is quite cute and even offers headphones for translations of the show in a number of languages (though you do have to pay for these). I would definitely recommend checking this out next time you’re in Hanoi.

reviews.author: mayccm2018
reviews.title: Good show
reviews.content: Through admired water puppet, we could recognize more Vietnamese culture and history.   The play only lasted for around 50 minutes.  The puppeteers were very professional and talented.  The live music also fully matched the performance.

reviews.author: Patricia B
reviews.title: A wonderful experience
reviews.content: An unexpectedly wonderful experience with live music and song. Fascinating puppetry but get front seats.

reviews.author: Victoria C
reviews.title: A must see
reviews.content: Absolutely beautiful . Loved the orchestra and so many different little scenes. It was engaging throughout and highly recommended

reviews.author: Dan Sullivan
reviews.title: Fun hour out for £3 each
reviews.content: Really enjoyed the show. Couldn’t understand a word of it without the audio guide but the puppets are fun and is accompanied by music. Really cheap and is on at various times through the day. Would recommend a visit. Chairs don’t offer much legroom!

reviews.author: JAMES F
reviews.title: GREAT SHOW RIP OFF SHOP ON PREMISES - FRONT SEATS VERY IMPORTANT
reviews.content: i went there today 5 January 2024This was my experience1--- please dont not bother buying the medium level or back seats you wont see anything .when you ask the lady at the counter she will say to you na its ok you can buy the middle ones you can still see but i can assure you wont be able to so dont waste your money if you cant get the front row wait and book for the day when you can get the front ones. when we asked the lady at the counter she goes the back level the cheaper seats you will be ok to see no she is completely wrong you wont have  a good experience2--- only buy the front row seats in the middle not the corner ones either no good .3---- we had to wait 3 days to get the front row seats as all were booked out so you need to book few days in advance if you want the front seat .4---- great show5--- now this is the reason why i gave it a one staras soon as the show finished we walked outthere is a shop just outside the exit door selling the wood made puppetswe bought the big one which was 250000 we paid for itwalked downstairs and the next shop right next to the hall was selling the same exact puppets for 90000 so that was a bit disappointing to see that we have spent for front row tickets and giving you business and then you wanna shaft people by overcharging them when next door they are selling the same thing so cheap so that left a bad taste knowing the fact that you just got ripped off like bad 90000 --250000 huge difference .So yeah go watch the show but dont buy anything from the shop right outside the shop BEWARE .

reviews.author: Shruti Pramod Reddy
reviews.title: Unique
reviews.content: Saw this water puppet theatre on Dec-20,2023 night. Helpful staff aided to find our seats, the rows are alphabetized. Our seats were in the back and hence could get good view to video as much as possible. Didn't purchase headphones for English translation but picked up the booklet detailing the 17 acts.

reviews.author: Nicky G
reviews.title: Well worth booking!
reviews.content: It was so well done! The sho tells stories of rural Vietnam accompanied by musicians. Really magical.

reviews.author: Chongma1950
reviews.title: Water show hoankuem thangoinmm
reviews.content: We are Malay guests to hanoi on New year time. This will be our last days here, the show we took for 150k/ person was so cool and new to us, vietnam culture was shown realistic way and very skillfully by actors behind the screen. What a Nice evening outing with family and friends, the theater is a bit small though. But i know its high season in Vietnam. Will introduce to others for sure

reviews.author: Bobbi S
reviews.title: Enjoy The Show!
reviews.content: We enjoyed this well-done, very cute & colorful show, depicting part of Viet Nam's aqua-history. Get your tickets& arrive early & try to find the opportunity to be allowed inside ahead of most of the line because this is a very popular show both for locals & foreigners (prices differ depending upon where you are from). Outside is VERY crowded but, once inside, the audience is quite respectful. It is a good show & the puppets are beautiful. Also, read the paper program for the show to learn the history being depicted & how the puppets are manipulated through & from under the water. The musicians, playing traditional Vietnamese instruments are also very, very good.

reviews.author: Mumma&Co
reviews.title: Something different
reviews.content: It was a good laugh & almost surprisingly very enjoyable! We didn't pay extra for the headphones to translate it & glad we didn't.  Wanted the cheapest seats but they'd sold out. A very good show.

reviews.author: jaaaack
reviews.title: Simultaneous English translation would help hugely
reviews.content: Baffled for almost all of the 50 mins. Suspect a couple of the puppets let loose some absolute zingers during the performance but they went over my head and the rest of the (mostly western) audience by some distance.

reviews.author: nnyd
reviews.title: Enjoyable performance
reviews.content: A must go experience. Lively and enjoyable performance. Totally enjoy even without getting the audio for translation.

reviews.author: Getaway302348
reviews.title: Enjoyable puppet show - must do!
reviews.content: Excellent choreography and coordination from 10 people (behind the scene) in maneuvering the puppets, accompany by a small team of  musicians and singers in Vietmese. Suitable for all ages.

reviews.author: Bela B
reviews.title: E-Ticket does not work
reviews.content: The show was good, but there was a problem with accepting the e-tickets. Apparently they don't know what they offer in English.

reviews.author: Anna N
reviews.title: Just skip.
reviews.content: I really don’t understand the exceptional review.First of all, leg room is like when u sit on an economy flight unless you sit on the 1st row. I am short but I feel like I can barely move already.The show itself was nothing impressive. Most of the time I felt like it’s just people shouting at me.

reviews.author: Beng Huat K
reviews.title: Boring show, skip it!
reviews.content: We decided to see the water puppet show when we were in Hanoi last week, mainly because we read good reviews about it. The seating was cramped with little leg room, show was repetitive and boring, conducted almost entirely in Vietnamese. Audio translation is available for extra charge. Thankfully the show is short, about 45 minutes duration and relatively cheap at 100,000 dong for the cheapest ticket. In conclusion, skip the show unless you do not know what else to do!

reviews.author: Filiz Baltacı
reviews.title: The puppet show is nice, but the local tunes and music are more impressive.
reviews.content: You spend 45 minutes in a stylish place where puppets are played in the pool in the pool between the balconies, where melodies reflecting Vietnamese culture are sung, a respite for tourist groups in the tiring part of the city.

reviews.author: khaled Youssef
reviews.title: Very kind
reviews.content: A pretty little theater with an original show of this art of water puppetry born in Hanoi 10 centuries ago. Live music with excellent musicians. 50 minutes of color and a little return to childhood. Very kind. Several performances per day, the last at 9:00 p.m.

reviews.author: Lisa N
reviews.title: Water Puppet fun
reviews.content: Hilarious! Came at the end of a long day and we almost skipped it! So glad we didn’t, 50 minutes of laughter. Very clever and fun! UK health ans safety elves would have a field day!  Dont look at the pix, they won’t donit justice and will spoil it!

reviews.author: MeganRoberts
reviews.title: Great show. Get tickets in advance and try for close to stage
reviews.content: Great show. We were in 2nd row. Worth the extra (minor) cost. Be sure to get tickets in advance. There is a long line for tickets at the door

reviews.author: Henk v
reviews.title: Top Security Staff SERVICE
reviews.content: This Thang Long water Puppet in Hanoi was a delightfull Show, amazing realy. We were with a group from Holland. My wife Nidhi forgot her camera she discovered a few days later. Our great Vietnamese guide contacted the theather Sercurity Staf Service. They found the Canon camera and send it to our next hotel in Hoi An! Amazing, Thank you Staff service !

reviews.author: jack j
reviews.title: favorite show
reviews.content: it is a very impressive traditional performance. Actors control puppets on the water stage, singers and musicians perform live on both sides. We advise you to rent an audio guide if you want to understand the content of the performance. It is a summary of the story. It's quite cheap at only 50000 VND or about 2.5 USD for each

reviews.author: willden
reviews.title: Cultural
reviews.content: Very good show with beautiful music. Very clever puppeteers. Spent a very pleasant afternoon and it was an enjoyable experience.

reviews.author: Ranmini Manaram... K
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.content: It was amazing and we were glad that we made the decision to go to see it. Took lots of photos and videos

reviews.author: Discover12758395996
reviews.title: VIP first class?
reviews.content: I appreciate that they found this at the ticket counter,but even though I booked VIP first class, it was Type 3 (back row): 100,000 VND.There was someone sitting in the seat in front of me, so I couldn't see very well.

reviews.author: ATM_Liverpool
reviews.title: Nothing to write home about but nice to experience for a little culture
reviews.content: This was a lovely event to go to whilst in Hanoi to experience some Vietnamese culture. It’s a basic but popular theatre and a short show which is very cleverly performed with water puppets telling stories of culture. We got a headset to explain the stories but in all honesty that probably wasn’t needed as you can generally make out what’s happening. Nice music and singers very authentic on the side of the water stage throughout. Worth going to in order to say that you have done it and to experience but I wouldn’t say it was a massive hit and something I’ll remember - I think you could easily get bored if it went on any longer but given that it’s about 45 minutes it’s cheap and an experience!

reviews.author: Departure29707611437
reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.content: Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre is a must when in Hanoi. it's near the lake, the program is very special and interesting. Having the live band and vocal singers on each side of the water stage.You can also rent audio to understand what the play is all about for 50000 each. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: javatieger
reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.content: Highly recommended! An extraordinary experience. The story is very simple and suitable for children, not a complicated plot, so you can do without an audio guide. But that is also the disadvantage - it could be longer and more exciting. So it is more of a show for tourists than a real (water) theater.

reviews.author: svb
reviews.title: Water puppet show
reviews.content: The spectacle is worth seeing. Every night in Hanoi, the water puppet show is performed at the Thang Long Puppets Theatre. On both sides of the stage the musicians with their instruments and the singers and narrators. In the center, a lake on which different stories are developed with puppets that have the peculiarity of not being moved by strings but by an underwater system. A beautiful, entertaining and, above all, curious spectacle of color and sound that is worth seeing and enjoying and which I recommend to all those who visit Hanoi.

reviews.author: Fernsie
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.content: During our stay in Hanoi my husband & I had a private guide who organised front row tickets for us at at the Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre.The puppet show was very entertaining and the music and the singers were excellent. Our experience here was further enhanced by a private visit backstage to meet the artists and have a demonstration of how things actually worked. I don't think we truly appreciated the skill involved in putting on such a show until we actually saw behind the scenes.

reviews.author: Justine C
reviews.title: Unique HANOI experience
reviews.content: Thank you for this sound, light and puppet show ☺️ another magnificent experience that will have touched us all 🙏

reviews.author: wintercolleen
reviews.title: The history is good
reviews.content: I liked the look of the gift shop and the face mask outside. The show needs more water dragons and buffalo. The seat are a bit uncomfortable but it’s a bit of a quick show

reviews.author: Jodie Shannon
reviews.title: A must see
reviews.content: This show is delivered in Vietnamese and I absolutely loved it. The atmosphere was amazing! The show is very cleverly done and it is beautiful to watch. The live instrumental and vocals left me in awe. If you are in Hanoi this is a must.

reviews.author: AleViBar
reviews.title: Original and unique
reviews.content: We went on the day of arrival in Hanoi, the entrance costs (first rows 200,000 Dong / middle rows 150,000 dong / and the last 100,000 Vietnamese dong)It is a pleasant, different and original show, there is a live instrument concert and it lasts about an hour.It's worth it to live the experience

reviews.author: kim tae h
reviews.title: We are so lucky because we booked water puppet, Vietnamese buffet and cyclo from bc family tour
reviews.content: We are so lucky because we booked water puppet, Vietnamese buffet and cyclo from bc family tour. They have the best support. I will tell my friends about you. Thank you !

reviews.author: HIROYUKI SHIMIZU
reviews.title: Vietnamese folk tales
reviews.content: I booked the tickets from Japan. It was a VIP ticket, so I was in the middle of the third row from the front. The seats were slightly offset from front to back, so it was comfortable and the people in front were not blocked from seeing. I followed the show by reading the Japanese pamphlet. The live music matched well with the puppet show, which was great. I thought the technique of moving the puppets while their lower bodies were submerged in water was amazing.

reviews.author: Black_Father
reviews.title: Nice family-friendly show
reviews.content: Nice family-friendly puppet theater in a slightly different way. The stage floor for the puppets is a pool, which provides both challenges and opportunities compared to Western puppet theatre. Make sure to rent an audiophone to have the different stories explained, then you get a lot more out of the show. The accompanying music is performed by talented musicians but is markedly different from Western music.Impressive and entertaining for all ages, highly recommended!

reviews.author: Peter K
reviews.title: An insight into Vietnamese culture
reviews.content: Excellent & affordable way to learn a bit more about Vietnamese culture and this ancient performance. 👏

reviews.author: Thomas K
reviews.title: Fascinating puppetry art
reviews.content: A truly worthwhile performance of great puppetry with live music. A definite recommendation for Hanoi! But be careful: it's best to buy the tickets yourself at the theater (you can also buy them in advance). Third-party providers like Agoda and Co. charge a whopping 100% surcharge on the ticket and there are no advantages to this option!

reviews.author: Gaby W
reviews.title: Tradition is living
reviews.content: If you visit Vietnam you must visitthe water puppet theater in Hanoi.It is such a great show, the musicians, the music, the actors are really artists in what they are doing. I would go a second time. And I am very happy that this tradition lives on. It is amazing and heart touching!

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.title: Great show!
reviews.content: Really fun show with some brilliant puppetry.Even though we did not speak Vietnamese it still was not difficult to understand what the story was.

reviews.author: Daniel
reviews.title: Great show, expensive tickets (and a suggestion on how to save on those)
reviews.content: Beautiful show! Although in Vietnamese, it was still very entertaining and is definitely a must-see in Hanoi. My only concern is the price tickets - they were x3 more expensive than buying at the theatre itself. Keep in mind that when buying from the theatre tickets normally run out on the day of the show, so if you want to save some bucks you should probably buy the tickets in advance. The tickets on trip advisor are much more expensive per se, but most likely can be booked on the same day of the show.

reviews.author: Art S
reviews.title: a new experience
reviews.content: Sow ticket prices vary by location. There are quite a few showtimes. During the performance, live music is played, performers sing. At that time, various dolls move in the water according to the story. This is a new and unprecedented experience.

reviews.author: Susan C
reviews.title: Vietnamese folk stories
reviews.content: Since the last time I visited in 2019 the number of shows has been reduced and the first one available was at around 4:15pm. It wasn't open Independence Day. There are three prices based on the distance your seat is from the stage and they show you a diagram of the seats available so you can choose when you pay. It was fairly full so we got middle seats in the middle section. Further forward is better. Cash only. The show is still 50 minutes in length though the seven vignettes had some differences to my last visit. It's a worthwhile different experience to see this unique Vietnamese art form retelling folk stories.

reviews.author: waterlogged23
reviews.title: A MUST when in Hanoi
reviews.content: Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre is a must when in Hanoi.   Easy to get to when in the Old Quarter, near the lake.  The show is inexpensive and recommend that you pay the little extra for a front row seat, although I think all of the seats get a good view.  It is entertaining and is about an hour long.  There are a few shows a day.  You can purchase tickets ahead of time (box office open all day) or get tickets at the last minute (if available).  There are cushions for kids, to lift them up on the seats, so that they can view the show better.Having the live band and vocal singers/speakers on each side of the water stage is fabulous.  You can also purchase audio to understand what the play is all about.  We thoroughly enjoyed the Water Puppet Show and highly recommend it.

reviews.author: Mathew M
reviews.title: A Must Visit in Hanoi
reviews.content: Thang Long water puppet show is a must see when in Hanoi.The building is adjacent to the Lake and is an easy walk from the Old Quarter.There are 2 or 3 shows a day and the price is very reasonable.You can choose your seats with seats at the front slightly more expensive.The show goes for around 50 mins and you can get an audio guide through your phone.

reviews.author: S J
reviews.title: Traditional theatre
reviews.content: It's an interesting and unique stage show. The water puppets were amazing and performed very well, the music and singing were great. Highly recommend renting the Audio Guide. 50,000 VND per person. it helps me understand the story.

reviews.author: Michelle L
reviews.title: Water puppets!
reviews.content: So fun and beautiful art and music, the colors and sound was so cool and the theater had great AC which was nice!

reviews.author: KC1001234
reviews.title: Wish they would ban mobiles in the performance!!
reviews.content: The performance is great, only disturbed by the friken use of videos and cameras through performance. I don't know when those videos will ever be shown to anyone.... Moan over.  Tickets range from 100dong to 200kdong if you buy from ticket office... I purchased a vip ticket about 10 mins before the 5.20show on Sunday and got row E which was fine.... Is the audio guide worth it +50kdong. Yes and no...  Not knowing anything about it it was...But if you have this synopsis it probably isnt. The play is about a narrator ( first character you see) explaining the 4 mystical beasts that play a part in Vietnam history. The turtle the unicorn (weird unicorn) the dragon and another one ( I can't remember) the stories are invidual but link to get her because of that and are meant to be short folk tales that are told ether funny or with a meaning for the kids. There are two stories which need further explanation 1 involves the first ruler of Vietnam returning a sword to the golden turtle ( like king Arthur style) the other is one that explains that clever viet kids could potentially be picked on by by king/emperor to become part of their court.   They don't really link together other than the mythical being thing but it's very interesting how certain bits are done and enjoyable to watch... Its the right length at an hour and the vip tickets are largely worth it so you don't have to watch it via someone else's phone, 🤬.... live in the moment pls just take photos at the beginning and end of show.

reviews.author: Κλωνη
reviews.title: Puppets in the water
reviews.content: Very original. Puppets in the water. I watched a show around 2 hours in Vietnamese. I didn't understand a word but it was worth it. The case was taken out of context. The lighting, the musicians, all the actors of the show were very good.

reviews.author: KartikSharma2612
reviews.title: Must to do in Hanoi….
reviews.content: Must watch you are in Hanoi…… amazing presentation and music, really loved the wholesome experience of art culture and music

reviews.author: Michael S
reviews.title: Unique bit of theatre
reviews.content: It is an interesting and unique theatrical performance.  I can see it might not appeal to everyone, but I enjoyed it, and it did have the benefit of being air conditioned, so that was a plus.

reviews.author: Steve P
reviews.title: Cultural enlightenment
reviews.content: A very traditional theatre, interesting to see if not a little odd.  Water puppetry is clearly a big thing in Vietnam quite hard to translate to a Western culture

reviews.author: Bob H
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: The water puppets were amazing and very well performed the music and sing was beautiful. Highly recommend for all ages to see , book a front row seat if you can, you can get better photos and videos

reviews.author: Dana R
reviews.title: Beautiful!!!
reviews.content: The puppet show was magical and a must see for everyone. It was a feast fir the eyes! The location of the theatre is right in the centre of the Old Quarter and easy to get to

reviews.author: EPHtravels
reviews.title: Glad we went, really enjoyed
reviews.content: Really amazing show to see and it didn't matter that we didn't know the stories or legends the puppets are showing. Still captivating to watch each short story to music. Really glad we went.

reviews.author: Francesca B
reviews.title: so beautiful
reviews.content: it was so entertaining and the music was beautiful. we really enjoyed the actual puppet show! the puppets were stunning and the different stories were so cool! We didn’t get the audio guide but we didn’t regret it because we were able to follow the stories well. We sat near the back but we still had a really good view The only thing we didn’t enjoy was there was a group of men behind us speaking loudly the whole time including taking a phone call, it could be nice if before the performance a reminder to be quiet or at least talk softly but I understand this is not in the control of the puppet show. overall a lovely time and we really enjoyed it!

reviews.author: CLS
reviews.title: Interesting experience
reviews.content: A very interesting and lively show.We didn't understand anything but it was definitely worth going.I would recommend front row seats if you are not tall.

reviews.author: Arjun K
reviews.title: A Skilled, Enchanting, and Uniquely Colorful Puppet Show!" - Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre Hanoi
reviews.content: I recently had the pleasure of attending a show at Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre Hanoi and it was an absolute delight! The puppeteers were incredibly skilled, creating an enchanting performance that was both unique and colorful. I found myself laughing out loud at the antics of the puppets, and I can honestly say that it was one of the most enjoyable experiences I've ever had! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: stacy558
reviews.title: Unique and Fun Performance
reviews.content: This is a wonderful experience. The water puppetry is incredibly well done and so unique. We were fortunate that we had been to the country-side first and then were able to better appreciate how much the puppets/skits really capture certain parts of life in Vietnam.  I wish the theatre would say people cannot film/photograph the performances because sometimes people hold their phones up and it can block your view a bit. But it was a minor annoyance and should not keep you for seeing this performance. Loved that the audience was a mix of all ages and not just families - kids' show.

reviews.author: B K
reviews.title: Interesting, cute and beautiful but lengthy
reviews.content: The puppet show is a nice cultural show.We took the first category tickets ( row ABCDE) for better view. (200K VND per ticket)If you want the best rows like A & B, I would suggest book in advance. We booked the same day ( noon 12 pm) for last show of 6.30 pm and got row E even though the price slab is same for ABCDE rows.Our hotel had helped book the tickets on phone. We were told to reach by 6 pm , pay directly and pick the tickets. For the entry they told to report by 6.20pm. The show began on time 6.30 pm.Apart from the introduction , the show is in Vietnamese. They have an option of audio notes outside the theatre as I could see some people buying it.There are artists playing traditional musical instruments dressed in traditional finery and it was a pleasure to see them perform.The puppets are beautiful, the show is interesting and a good experience but we found it a tad lengthy at 1 hour.So we were enjoying it a lot in first half hour then the interest dwindled away. Perhaps, had we understood all the dialogues  and the humour in the play, we might have remained invested.But over all, I would recommend it.The shows happen only 3 pm onwards and there are about 4-5 shows everyday.

reviews.author: Mike J
reviews.title: Interesting experience
reviews.content: We really enjoyed the show at this unique Water Puppet Theatre which is centrally situated near Hoan Kiem Lake in Hanoi’s Old Quarter. The skill of the puppeteers is quite remarkable. If you can afford it go for the most expensive seats at the front for the best view.

reviews.author: Cynthia B
reviews.title: Meh
reviews.content: It was difficult to see, and there was no pint in getting a headset because I couldn’t hear. Maybe something printed that gave an overview of the stories. It was ok, but not worth the time or money.

reviews.author: G_Olchen
reviews.title: Nice show for a fair price
reviews.content: The whole setup (stage and puppets) looks very cute and well maintained. The interplay of the puppet theatre and the musical background is great! It is truly impressive how they manage some of the complex movements and choreographies with these rather simple looking puppets.For a price of 100.000 to 200.000 (depending on the seat) it's a fair price for a 50 min show. The theatre is also A/C'd so it's a good place to recover from the heat.

reviews.author: Dhireandar
reviews.title: The enchanting professionalism of Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre
reviews.content: The professional and skilled performers bring the stories of Vietnamese folklore to life in a way that will captivate and delight you. The traditional music and sound effects, combined with the colorful puppets, create an atmosphere that can't be found anywhere else. The show is a must-see for anyone visiting Hanoi and is sure to leave you with a lasting impression of the city. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Eve Osredna
reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.content: Overrated, at least for anyone over the age of 12. If you don’t speak Vietnamese you have no idea what’s going on, there is an audio guide that gives a super short summary but you are left out of all of the dialogue that happens.

reviews.author: Hedthree G
reviews.title: Vietnamese culture in a bite-size snack
reviews.content: This is a CULTURAL experience.  There's lot of history to Vietnamese Water Puppets.  Definitely pay for the English translation explanation headset of what you're seeing.  It helps.  For the Internet generation, I don't know if this is entertainment.  We enjoyed the show.    It's not long, less than an hour.  The puppeteers end the show by showing themselves.Getting tickets online proved nearly impossible.  Since the theater is right on Hoan Kiem Lake, we just stopped in earlier in the day and snapped up prime seats.  The theater isn't large, but the experience is priced in Dong, so why sit 40 rows back?

reviews.author: Han M
reviews.title: Puppet visit
reviews.content: Great experience, would recommend to anyone visiting Hanoi. Singing & puppetry was excellent and really nice way to spend an evening.

reviews.author: Kristen L
reviews.title: Fun and interesting experience!
reviews.content: We really enjoyed this. Ticket experience is a little clunky but the show itself is very entertaining with great performers. Unique and fun thing to do near old quarter. (And nice to have sitting break in the a/c!)

reviews.author: Mike W
reviews.title: Fantastic cultural experience
reviews.content: Fantastic colourful and very clever show. The stage (water pool) is quite low down so would recommend a seat near the front. The musicians and narrators are set higher up in each wing.  The only thing I has an issue with is that (apparently) you are allowed to take photos and video. I had to ask the person in front of me to put her phone down because it was obscuring my view, and looking around the theatre the there were plenty of other phones raised.

reviews.author: Arkodeb
reviews.title: Must Visit in Hanoi
reviews.content: Great family show. Kids would enjoy especially. Must visit. Would recommend that seats be booked in advance. Usually sell out shows.

reviews.author: HeroRamo89
reviews.title: good experience when coming to Hanoi
reviews.content: Experience a unique art performance for the first time. this is a performance of traditional Vietnamese art. I rented an audio Guide service and it helped me understand the content of the show. I think it is useful for you. Thank you to the artists who contributed to the show

reviews.author: Jacqueline O
reviews.title: A joyful experience to remember
reviews.content: Great experience, looked around the theatre and children and adults were all just as enthralled. Absolutely fine that it wasn't in English, it was still great fun to watch and work out what was going on. Highly recommend visiting for anyone in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Lauren R
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.content: Went here with no idea what to expect and was pleasantly surprised! It was a fantastic experience, something completely unique! We didn't pay extra for the audio guide and still enjoyed it. The musicians and puppeteers are very talented.

reviews.author: Etain Ho
reviews.title: Good entertainment after a day of walking in city Hanoi
reviews.content: The show was easy to understand and interesting. Just that some of the puppets were pretty worn out and had a lot of black spots.

reviews.author: Andrew Y
reviews.title: Nice show.
reviews.content: Nice puppet show. I have seen this before but I went to see it again. Vietnam cultural performance at a nice location.

reviews.author: Casey T
reviews.title: Unique experience
reviews.content: Great experience.  Although the audio guide (I got mine in English) doesn't give a lot of details, it is actually really nice to hear the basis of each story.  It does not translate all the words as they sing, but I enjoyed that because then I could take in all the sounds/music without trying to also hear the audio guide.  I would recommend doing early in your trip, as it provides some insight into some of the local stories, for example about the turtles at the nearby lake.

reviews.author: Nathaniel B
reviews.title: excellent for three generations visit
reviews.content: three generations of my family loved the 45 minute show even though none of us understand vietnamese. puppets great and music great. very traditional art form. go

reviews.author: Weng Khiang O
reviews.title: Puppet
reviews.content: It was ok for me. Got the audio guide for +50k. Audio gave short introduction of every chapter. Not full translation. Unique experience. Have not seen a water puppet show before.

reviews.author: Alec K
reviews.title: A experience when coming to Hanoi
reviews.content: A special performance show, the theater is located next to the lake, one of the most famous tourist attractions in Hanoi. I recommend renting a audio guide because it is very useful for the performance.

reviews.author: Julissa
reviews.title: Lots of fun :))
reviews.content: We had a wonderful time watching the Thang Long Water Puppet show in Hanoi. It was a captivating performance of traditional legends and historical tales, with colorful puppets, live music and amazing water effects. The puppeteers were very skilled and expressive, and the theater was cozy and comfortable. I highly recommend this show to anyone who wants to experience a unique and ancient art form of Vietnam.

reviews.author: Ros T
reviews.title: Enjoyable Show
reviews.content: My friend and I were very excited about seeing theThang Long Water Puppet Theatre as most travel sites list it as a "must see" in Hanoi.  We enjoyed the show but didn't consider it a "must see".  The musicians and puppeteers are very talented.  We particularly enjoyed seeing the musicians weave their magic up close.We didn’t purchase an audio guide so didn't really understand the story which did detract a little from the experience.  The theatre is quite small  - we would recommend purchasing VIP seating which is only fractionally more exepensive than the very reasonable regular ticket price.  It covers seating in the first few rows which provides a good view of the musicians and water puppets.

reviews.author: Aliyu
reviews.title: Experience Vietnamese culture
reviews.content: This is not your typical puppet show. The puppets are controlled by skilled puppeteers who hide behind a bamboo screen and make the puppets dance on the water. The show features colorful scenes from Vietnamese folklore, history and everyday life, accompanied by live music and singing. You'll be amazed by the creativity and craftsmanship of the puppets and the puppeteers. The show is suitable for all ages and lasts about an hour. Don't miss this opportunity to see a traditional art form that has been preserved for centuries.

reviews.author: Scott W
reviews.title: Water Puppet Theatre
reviews.content: The puppets were very good, and the touches of humour made the experience memorable. An inexpensive hour or so and time well spent.

reviews.author: Dji
reviews.title: Creativity and skill of the puppeteers
reviews.content: They made the puppets dance, sing, fight, and even breathe fire on the water surface. The stories were based on traditional legends and historical tales, but they also had some humorous twists and surprises. The music and sound effects were also very impressive and added to the atmosphere. The show lasted for about an hour and it was well worth the $10 ticket. I highly recommend this show to anyone who wants to experience a unique and fun cultural performance in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Rechkemmer
reviews.title: Traditional culture with modern entertainment
reviews.content: The puppets are crafted with incredible craftsmanship and the performances are engaging and entertaining. Watching a show here is a fun and educational experience that every visitor should take part in. The puppeteers are highly skilled and bring the stories to life with their skillful manipulation of the puppets. The music and sound effects add to the atmosphere and make the show even more enjoyable. An unforgettable experience that will leave you with a lasting impression of the traditional culture and art of Vietnam.

reviews.author: India11
reviews.title: Delightful show
reviews.content: Delightful show, not very long, suitable for all ages. Fascinating how they perform the puppets. Good to get the audio guide if you do not speak Vietnamese.

reviews.author: David H
reviews.title: Entertaining Show
reviews.content: Entertaining water puppet show. Comfortable seats only issue was it was a bit of a log jam to get in to the theatre. We enjoyed the show

reviews.author: Craig R
reviews.title: Vietnam Holiday 2023
reviews.content: The show is performed in waist deep water, and it follows a history of Vietnam folk law A great show that is very well done. It is all spoken in Vietnamese so if you want to follow the story line you can get translation headsets before you enter.

reviews.author: Zoe K
reviews.title: A good cultural experience
reviews.content: We were on the fence about doing this but super glad we ended up seeing it. The show ran on time and was funny and cute. Would recommend getting the audio guide if you don’t speak Vietnamese, it was good value at 50k VND.  Well done to the performers for preserving such an old art form

reviews.author: Omjeet K
reviews.title: Good for kids
reviews.content: Nice place to visit with Kids to learn about the culture of Vietnam. We did not understand the language though but the music was soothing.

reviews.author: Jack
reviews.title: The show was great!
