reviews.content: The show was great. I recommend buying tickets at the box office as it will be cheaper to book online. I used the audio guide because the program in the program uses Vietnamese. Ticket price for v.i.p is 200000 VND and audioguide is 50000 VND

reviews.author: kirsty m
reviews.title: Hanoi Puppet Show
reviews.content: This was the strangest and most interesting thing I’ve ever seen. I wish I used the head set to translate the signing in English, however it was still enjoyable. The entrance and exit was quick. Book early because it seems to be a crowd favourite. The sound was great. It’s difficult to see if you’re small / short with larger people sitting front! I advise get the front rows for better views. Lots of people using phones and taking photos which was expected.

reviews.author: Jackson P
reviews.title: Love the puppets
reviews.content: What a fun experience this was for our family. We went with no expectations and we’re really impressed. The music and puppets are mesmerising. Fun family entertainment.

reviews.author: beba2023
reviews.title: Vietnam - A country of unique culture
reviews.content: We stayed in Rex Hotel, Old Quarter. The hotel was very nice. We were given fresh towels every day. The staff were kind and ready to assist at all times. My issue was very basic breakfast which never changed during our lengthy stay. The area is very groty so be prepared for that. Nevertheless we were walking distance to the lake and the weekend night market which was great to explore. Be careful when buying anything as the prices are inflated for us tourists and most of products are fake. The food was another issue for us. We love Vietnamese food and we're looking forward to some great Vietnamese food like bahn mi and pho which we love here in Australia but what we found there was very different and not as good. It was cheap though. If you want to eat something better like a Korean street food be prepared to spend at least A$40.00 for two people. The fun about this dinner was that you cook it yourself but be prepared to be splashed with oil all over. It was an interesting experience though sitting on the little 'kids' chairs in the middle of the bussing street.  Other street food that we wanted to try is food at the markets and it was simple and very affordable. We've flown to Phu Quock Island for a few days and stayed at Camia Resort which was clean. The resort has a lovely grounds and it's on the beach front but be prepared for a bit of uphill walk to get around the place.  The breakfast was ok but the food in their restaurant was very basic and expensive for what it was. We wanted to venture out into the town to have some lovely sea food we read about before getting there but never experienced it as my partner got food poisoning before leaving Hanoi. We were so careful to drink bottled water only and brush our teeth with boiled water. We were careful with what we ate as well. The sandy beaches have sand flies. I got bitten and it wasn't a pleasant experience. So overall experience including the river tour which was A$210.00 for two and Hanoi street food tour A$90.00 for two isn't something I would recommend. You can do all that on your own and it will cost you less. Everyone expects to be tipped as well. I come from the country where that's not the custom so it was very confronting and confusing as to how much to tipp and sometimes we were asked for more money which I thought it was bad. Overall it was a good trip which we wanted to go on for a very long time. It was an eye opener for us that's for sure. The saddest fact was to see a lot of wealth amongst the poverty as there are so many people there struggling to just survive. This review is based on what I've seen and what I've experienced so don't take it the wrong way. It's meant to give you my true and honest experience I've had in Vietnam.

reviews.author: Megan D
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.content: This is a MUST! It was an amazing performance. Beautiful stories, puppetry, traditional music and singing

reviews.author: Sherre M
reviews.title: Naptime
reviews.content: This show was very boring.  Most of the audience were napping.  Even the musicians looked so unenthusiastic.  We couldn't follow the storylike since there was no translation for us.It was just a cool place to rest our feet for a long 50 minutes.

reviews.author: Siwarit
reviews.title: Wonderful dancing puppet show in water
reviews.content: This is amazing show. Dancing puppets in the water. I think this is only one place in the world you can see. But the ticket is sold-out quickly, espectially Friday - Sunday. It is recommended to book at the earliest at ticket counter in front of the theater.

reviews.author: TravelBrianCO
reviews.title: Wowzers
reviews.content: Absolutely amazing show.  The music and puppets were entertaining and well done. They definitely sell out most shows so I suggest getting tickets online ahead of time (only a few dollars more expensive). They start exactly on time so be there a few minutes early.  Get the VIP tickets so you get the front few rows.  Great representation of Vietnamese culture and arts.

reviews.author: Lee A
reviews.title: Amazing show
reviews.content: Amazing show with live music, fire and water puppet. It's really a special and unique traditional performance. The show will last for 50mins and the ticket fee is from 100,000cnd to 200,00 vnd. I highly recommend with the audio guide. You will be surprised by the way the artists control the puppet. We love it and it's really an unforgetable experience

reviews.author: ZackBklyn
reviews.title: Interesting experience but with some reservations
reviews.content: Even if you have reserved tickets you wait in a chaotic line outside the theater before the show to pay and be assigned seats. The live music from the singers and musicians on either side of the water tank was excellent, and the water puppets were fun and unique. However, the story is a little thin for the hour-long runtime, and the audience at our particular performance was incredibly rude, with several members holding up phones in front of our line of sight recording the entire show. I also wish we learned more at the theater about how the puppets were created and operated!

reviews.author: Silas E
reviews.title: 50mins well spent; maybe get audio guide?
reviews.content: 50 Minutes worth spending. Good show for a fair price. With the live music, fire, and water a great atmosphere emerges. I didn’t get the audio guide so don't know if there is a story to it. I‘d recommend to maybe getting it?

reviews.author: Nashes_5
reviews.title: Don't believe the hype - it's rubbish
reviews.content: We were so surprised at how poor this was when it was recommended universally by everyone we knew that had visited Hanoi and comes up endlessly on 'must-do' lists. Maybe it's just us!!   You and hundreds of other tourists have to wait in a lifeless atrium with toilets with no paper, you are shown in to a dirty theatre with food on the floor and stained seats. The orchestra and singers arrive and your ears are subject to an assault of Vietnamese singing which would have been fine if only they hadn’t been using mics and a PA . It's simply too loud! The voices were probably lovely but spoiled by the amplification.  The scene is set with a large paddling pool stage upon which various small puppets appear and chase each other around, with occasional splashing, a fire breathing dragon and a women puppet with a bare chest.  So that's meant to be funny in any language. After 5 minutes you’re bored. After 45 you’re desperate but it ends at 50 and you’re hurried out through the gift shop pretty quick.  I"m sorry but I truly don't get it.

reviews.author: KTP310
reviews.title: Unique experience, not to be missed
reviews.content: We thoroughly enjoyed the unique and very unusual water puppet theatre show. The theatre is lovely (all seats are good, we went for the middle seats and enjoyed the slightly elevated position). The puppeteers are incredibly skilful and the musicians really bring the show to life. Buy tickets direct from the box office (it’s cheaper), and it’s advisable to buy the day before, or at least in the morning, as shows seem to sell out.

reviews.author: Jab Jakub
reviews.title: Good experience!
reviews.content: The show was interesting with music, singing and performance. What a superb show! It's great to see how the artistry control all the puppets under the water. The ticket is $5 and it's worth to see!

reviews.author: Sydney S
reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.content: All of the shorts stories were great and it was so cool to see how they could control all of the puppets in such a creative way! The live music was also wonderful! We used the headsets that explained what was happening in English, which was very helpful!

reviews.author: mrc0516
reviews.title: Definitely a "must-do!"
reviews.content: I've seen water puppet shows in YouTube, but the in-person experience is wonderful! The music, singing, and the artistry are superb!

reviews.author: DLTT2015
reviews.title: Great to see while in Hanoi!
reviews.content: We visited on a Thursday night. We didn’t book in advance but queued and got a ticked to the next showing. I would recommend buying a ticket about 1.5 hour latest in advance.The tickets ranged between 100-200 VND (£4-8) we booked to sit in the middle section for 150 VND. I couldn’t see easily so decide to move to an empty seat further back. I would recommend either sitting right at the front or booking nearer the back. This was a 50 minute show made up for 17 short folk / traditional stories. We got an audio guide. This help describe each short story and what was happening. I would recommend this to learn about the history / stories however I think it would be just as enjoyable with out.The live music was also great.

reviews.author: Alex H
reviews.title: Brilliant evening activity in Hanoi
reviews.content: This was our second visit to a water puppet show after visiting the one in Ho Chi Minh 3 years ago. Once again we really enjoyed it and some of the scenes provide a great laugh. The puppeteers are so talented, and the people who play the instruments and do the talking are also seriously good.The play only lasts for around 45 minutes, and the cheapest seats are 100,000 (which is what we paid) and the most expensive seats are 200,000. The view isn’t hugely different but I’d have no hesitation paying for the more expensive seats as it’s worth it!

reviews.author: Brynos
reviews.title: A wonderful treat in Hanoi
reviews.content: An original an authentic experience of original Vietnamese water puppetry.This is an experience not to be missed while in Vietnam. You will be thoroughly entertained by this show.

reviews.author: Dara S
reviews.title: Amazing show
reviews.content: A wonderful experience and incredible show. We recommend getting the audio translation headset--really helped us to understand what was happening. The only unfortunate bit was the volume of audience members taking photos and video with flash and/or entirely blocking the view of people behind them. I suspect that they would do this regardless of the rules, but would have appreciated a no flash photo and no video policy. It was hugely disruptive to an experience that would otherwise be quite immersive. Another thing to note is that there are pyrotechnics early on. These are really great, but if you have breathing difficulty, may be problematic. The smoke hung in the air throughout. That said, incredible performance, great value, essential experience.

reviews.author: ASL
reviews.title: A must see!
reviews.content: A tremendous show! This is a must see with fantastic live musicians and singers, along with hugely talented water puppeteers. Every one of our party of five loved the show and we’d definitely recommend it.

reviews.author: Preeti P
reviews.title: Interesting and lovely experience
reviews.content: was able to get last minute tickets due to some cancellations for this surprisingly fully booked show. And it was totally worth it..We didnt understand the stories too much since we were late and didnt have time for the audio guides but I think the skill, the talent of the puppeteers and musicians more than made up for it.

reviews.author: Ryan
reviews.title: 100 recommend!
reviews.content: Really great show, very talented individuals performing that being the puppeteers or musicians. I would definitely recommend getting to headphones to explain each part so you can learn more about the Vietnamese culture and stories. Slightly annoyed everyone in front of me was filming too so ruined the experience slightly as I couldn’t see at times, a ban on phones/cameras would be good whilst the show is on.

reviews.author: Olivia H
reviews.title: Really enjoyable show!
reviews.content: Small but immersive. A great show! Lively and fun. Definitely worth a visit if you’re at all interested in Vietnamese culture. Good value too.

reviews.author: bleakinleeds
reviews.title: One of the best attractions I have seen
reviews.content: Having travelled and seen many shows and attractions this is one of the best I’ve seen. Culturally significant and a privilege to see. It’s about the right length (50 mins) and entertaining for all ages. We booked online two days in advance for 3rd row seats. Ignore the bad reviews - some people just can’t be pleased.

reviews.author: Pam L
reviews.title: Good for smaller kids
reviews.content: We came in just as the show was going to start, so we were not able to buy the ticket for the audio guide.  As the show was in vietnamese language, we were not able to understand/enjoy.  This type of show is also probably meant for smaller kids.

reviews.author: Jay A
reviews.title: Good cultural experience
reviews.content: Very interesting show. Tickets not available on line. Recommend to buy them at on site box office 2or3 days ahead, so that you get easy availability for front row seats ($8)  If you dont care about front row, then some tickets will probably be available just minutes before the show. At the theater, pick up the audio guide in your language so that you follow the plot for about $2 extra.

reviews.author: Traveling Ammonite
reviews.title: 1*, would not recommend to ANYONE
reviews.content: I'm sure the water puppets are lovely and the maneuvering is skillful, but we couldn't see anything at ALL because everyone in the audience busted out their cell phones and started recording, blocking everyone's view from behind. I did not pay to see people's cell phones in front of my face. If they weren't filming, they were talking loudly.As a result, the performers and singers did not seem excited or at all enthusiastic to be there. This may not be a reflection of their talent, but of organization and management. PLEASE ban recording!! I would not recommend this show to ANYONE.If you are asked if you want to see a puppet show, even as part of a city tour, just RUN. It is a waste of time and you will just be baffled by human behavior.

reviews.author: Madhavi
reviews.title: Interesting experience!
reviews.content: The water puppet show is a good experience for both children and adults. All musicians and puppeteers gave a very good performance and it was clear that it was planned with a lot of effort and passion:)

reviews.author: Jeff P
reviews.title: This is a must for visitors of all ages
reviews.content: This is a must for visitors of all ages. The water puppets are unique. The puppets are operated by a team of about ten who stand in waist-deep water behind a screen. The puppets are controlled from under the water.Their movements and choreography are very impressive. They are accompanied by a small orchestra and singers (in Vietnamese).Audio translation devices are available for a small charge—recommended. Even without translations, you can get the general idea of the play and the humor. The show is a little less than an hour.

reviews.author: sandra xu
reviews.title: Interesting show
reviews.content: The water puppet show was good but the audio guide was not so useful. Interesting show to entertain the kids. Lasts for 50mins. Get tickets at the counter at a cheaper cost

reviews.author: Anna May V
reviews.title: Fascinating and Entertaining
reviews.content: You don't need to understand a word, it is a fascinating show, just the right length (under an hour), very entertaining.The talents of this show are incredible - from the musicians to the actors and singers, to the puppet masters who submerge their bodies everyday in order to bring delight to their audience.Reading about it you might be skeptical about booking - I thought I would fall asleep straight away, but I was hooked by the curiosity of how they were performing with the puppets - the moves were seamless and choreography spot on. Worth your VND and time to catch this show, and grab a pre- or post-show snack with the many stalls near the theater.

reviews.author: TBAus
reviews.title: Fascinating show
reviews.content: The water puppet show is a great spectacle that is worth experiencing. The puppets are beautiful and the supporting music ensemble is fantastic. The theatre itself is a little cramped.We bought tickets before the show at the ticket both at the theatre entrance. This is the cheapest option. Worth a visit!

reviews.author: Arjun Nath
reviews.title: Its a good one time watch.
reviews.content: You can go if you haven’t seen such a concept before cause it is quite different than typical puppet shows. The show is also a good insight to Vietnamese tradition.

reviews.author: William
reviews.title: A place you can't miss when coming to Hanoi
reviews.content: After three years, I had the opportunity to come to Hanoi. I visited again the puppet theater next to Hoan Kiem lake. Evening was very impressed and enjoyed the art of water puppetry here. It shows the over-destroying life of Vietnam through puppets. I recommend using the audio interpreter device sold on the 2nd floor, it helps you understand this special performance. I recommend you to visit this place once when you come to Hanoi

reviews.author: EdM
reviews.title: Brilliant, don’t miss
reviews.content: This was fantastic. We had considered booking in advance, but just turned up and easily booked some of the cheaper tickets.View was great, we passed up the chance for English headset. There was some dialogue but mostly it was slapstick so no translation required.A unique experience you’d be a fool to miss

reviews.author: Ajay R
reviews.title: Great show, no pre-book needed
reviews.content: Great show, there is a programme available in English so you can kind of follow it. Recommend to buy at the ticket office. There are three tiers of tickets available, cheapest is 100.000 VND.Show lasts just under an hour.

reviews.author: amanda_r_t
reviews.title: What a cute experience!
reviews.content: We really enjoyed the water puppet show - what a unique thing to see! The show is just under and hour and is in a cute little theatre.  I reserved seats via email a month in advance which meant we ended up with the front row - so cool! Worth taking the time to do.

reviews.author: AlwaysTurnLeft
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.content: Really enjoyed the water puppet show. Performance was much, much better than expected and very enjoyable. Didn’t get the audio guide but each part of the show had a different theme so although we didn’t understand the story it was great. We bought tickets 2 days in advance from the box office and got 200k dong tickets in the second row. Would advise being in the first few rows if you can get tickets as you’d be quite a way back if you were right at the back of the theatre considering the puppets are quite small. Definitely a must do experience in Hanoi

reviews.author: dianne c
reviews.title: interesting and unique but
reviews.content: Okay show. Interesting, although I did not understand a single thing. Subtitles would have been useful. It seemed to be a story that has comedy but not too good that it could have been understood even without language. I think they have an audio guide but not sure if that would have been very helpful. It was a unique puppet show that's for sure.

reviews.author: Rajat1212
reviews.title: Different experiece
reviews.content: Buy tickets there and then.. go 1 hour before the show, as there is a lake nearby and shapes too.. lunch or dinner places in walking distance..Under water puppet show is one of its kind.. you will be left amazed on how they are doing it..

reviews.author: Karen S
reviews.title: Delightful
reviews.content: So unique!  My only regret is that I didn't rent the Eglish translation device so I could listen to the commentary.  Even without it, it was funny.  The musicians and singers who accompanied the performance were an added cultural bonus.

reviews.author: portlyvulture
reviews.title: A puppet show not just for children
reviews.content: A wonderful and traditional Vietnamese experience. At first sight this may seem like a childrens show but the night we attended there were very few children present. Although not necessary we did hire translation devices which explained the history behind the stories. Great musicians and puppet operators. Great value for money and not to be missed when in Hanoi.

reviews.author: jacky t
reviews.title: very good
reviews.content: The performance is very wonderful and meaningful, the ticket price at the theater is from 100000 to 200000VND. The language of the show is Vietnamese. there is device translation service and you have to pay for it. The show is a combination of musical instruments and puppets

reviews.author: TonyFun
reviews.title: An art performance you can't miss when coming to Hanoi
reviews.content: this is my 2nd time to Hanoi and also my 2nd time watching water puppet show.  The artists manipulated the puppets very skillfully.  Fortunately, this time I rented a language interpreter to understand this special performance.  I highly recommend renting this device.

reviews.author: Meagantravels
reviews.title: Entertaining cultural show
reviews.content: Interesting and sweet but 50 minutes is more than enough. Please arrive early - people were still arriving ten minutes into the show and, as the rows are narrow, seated audience members were having to get out of the row to let the latecomers through. It was very distracting. Perhaps theatre staff could stop people entering after the show has started? If people were warned of this at the time they bought the tickets, then it could be enforced when people arrive late.

reviews.author: Multi C
reviews.title: Beautiful theatre
reviews.content: I visited vietnam circa 2008 attended the water puppet theatre and enjoyed it very much. I do love theatre the first thing I saw was at a birthday trip and I had puppets. My dad gifted me a dragon puppet and a boat which I used in my different theatrical like teaching with languages & yoga type teaching. Also wanted to use in other things. Sadly my daughter who is an extreme Christian stole my dragon and boat including all my furniture etc very upset I then lost the house as well

reviews.author: Stacy K
reviews.title: Highlight
reviews.content: I really loved this. Not only was it air conditioned and the seats were comfy, but the show was magical. Puppets performed in a small indoor lagoon and were accompanied by live musicians.

reviews.author: jay123452017
reviews.title: Dull
reviews.content: Not sure what all the fuss is about? The theatre is a tourist trap which pulls in load after load of hapless travellers. The show is a series of short disconnected stories which does not make much sense on their own or as a whole. Yes, it is impressive how the puppeteers manoeuvre their puppets through the water, but once you get over that the show gets quite boring.

reviews.author: Mjay
reviews.title: Surprisingly VERY GOOD!
reviews.content: This was actually really fun & awesome to see, and then to see how many people it took to pull it all off! Amazing work to all the staff, would highly recommend this to everyone!!

reviews.author: Iago
reviews.title: Great cultural experience
reviews.content: Loved the Thang Long puppet show. The story and singing lines was simple to follow and also didnt call for a translated version to listen also. We'd a bit of tough watching and also the boy of mine was not able to find out through the heads of various other audience members. To stay away from this I suggest obtaining a seat in the front side of the theatre. Purchase of tickets was easy I went by 2 hours prior to the show and also bought in the theatre. A great deal less expensive in this manner and then performing it online or even because of tour business and additionally you can choose the seats of yours. Enjoy.

reviews.author: Craig E
reviews.title: Very different and enjoyable
reviews.content: I must admit that I have never seen anything like the water puppet show before. You get given ear phones at the start so that it’s translated into your language. Some of the stories the puppets tell are really interesting and fun. The live band alongside the show are also very good.

reviews.author: Johnnie
reviews.title: Need to enjoy!
reviews.content: It's a Must go to and observe this particular water puppet show! This particular theater is simply across the lake. There five shows time every day. You are able to purchase a ticket in the theater.

reviews.author: Stephine
reviews.title: Cultural experience
reviews.content: Very first time seeing such a show provided in this manner. Great to look at just once. Go there and also buy the tickets of yours early. Its more affordable in case you purchase the tickets there straight rather than reserving online. The translation can be obtained for 30,000 vnd. English translations have been hard to comprehend.

reviews.author: Torie Vany
reviews.title: Quite entertaining
reviews.content: I was a bit of doubtful when I booked but happy I did. It was the best pleasurable part of the trip of mine to Hanoi. I didn't recognize the number of performers have been associated with the show until the part and just how the musicians helped the puppeteers. The musicians had been entertainment that is excellent by themselves. I wish I'd spent on the audio guide though to find a clear understanding of the show.

reviews.author: RG02
reviews.title: A bit ‘kitsch’, but a good show
reviews.content: We hadn’t visited a Water Puppet Theatre elsewhere on our trip through Vietnam as the reviews of this show pointed to it being the best. We booked the previous evening and had seats in the second row, luckily no one sat in front of us and we had an uninterrupted view of the action. The musicians came out first and played a couple of numbers on their historic instruments, quite atmospheric. The show commenced and we did not know what to expect but were entranced by the puppets seemingly floating on the water. It’s not a long show, 40/45 minutes, no time to get bored. At the end the puppeteers came forward to much deserved applause. A quite different experience, we enjoyed it.

reviews.author: Brian H
reviews.title: A good way to spend an hour
reviews.content: After a very heavy fall of rain had changed our plans we went to see the Thang Long Water Puppets. Sitting on the second row we had a great view of what was happening. The music and especially the singing was amazing and the puppets themselves were spectacular. There were 17 short 'tales' concerning myth and history in Hanoi. This was an excellent way to spend an hour.

reviews.author: GrahamP19gv
reviews.title: An unusual experience
reviews.content: Well worth the visit. This was quite a spectacle with the puppets being much more animated than we expected. The narrators and musicians were very good. A very entertaining experience.

reviews.author: Martin S
reviews.title: Amazing and Unique Water Puppets Show
reviews.content: The Water Puppets show is a must see for anyone visiting Hanoi. It's a very old craft that is a unique part of Vietnamese culture. We were part of a group that was treated to a special presentation after the show when the performers actually revealed how the puppets are operated. It is a very special evening that the entire family can enjoy.

reviews.author: ireddi2018
reviews.title: Very enjoyable
reviews.content: Reasonable price. We got good tickets on the door (This was March 2020). I would recommend the audio device (cost extra) to fully understand what is going on.Last about 1hr 30mins

reviews.author: Kentishtraveler
reviews.title: Unique and entertaining show
reviews.content: We got tickets for the 8pm show, and had seats in row I mid-range price. Great show, funny and entertaining. Only spolied a bit by people in front of us moving around and chatting and hampering our view, and people taking video/photos...should be banned.

reviews.author: Greg B
reviews.title: Stunning show well worth the visit
reviews.content: visited the theatre totally on speck and was amazed at the talent on show and the story line.An hours show that fascinates with the puppetry magic.Well worth the time and effort

reviews.author: kingvikramaditya
reviews.title: The Imperial Citadel of Thang Long
reviews.content: Situated inside the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Imperial Citadel of Thang Long in Hanoi, it offers water puppet shows to visitors highlighting the cultural richness of Vietnam 🇻🇳

reviews.author: Kathrin R
reviews.title: Nice show but a little long
reviews.content: I can say I really enjoyed the first 30 minuets of the show but it gets a little repetitive after a while. Since this is something very unique and special for Vietnam I would still recommend going there. The theatre has nice and comfortable seats und is fully air conditioned. So you can rest, recharge and cool down from the heat outside. There are also toilets available. The shows sell out quickly so make sure you arrive on time. The cheaper seats are just as good as the more expensive ones but you have to up some stairs. Very unique experience.

reviews.author: Adrian F
reviews.title: A must see experience when in Vietnam
reviews.content: Wonderful show which left myself and my wife amazed how the water puppets are skilfully controlled. Lovely little theatre and photographs are allowed during the performance provided the flash is turned off. A unique ‘must-see’ experience and definitely one of the highlights of our stay in Hanoi.

reviews.author: jimmy692
reviews.title: Unique and interesting
reviews.content: This is definitely a unique experience and well worth the visit. It was difficult to follow the story as it’s not in English, but they provide translators on earphones.  The children were a bit nonplussed but still found it fascinating, and we adults really enjoyed it. A must-see if you’re in Hanoi to see some local culture.

reviews.author: TerryH
reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.content: Well known water puppet show. However air conditioned theatre gave audience a chance to nod off as not at all interesting to watch. So disappointing.

reviews.author: BAZANG
reviews.title: Must See Show
reviews.content: This is a great show that lasts about an hourReservations can be made and it only holds 200 people .Shows start from 3pm and there are 3 shows almost every day. Tickets  range from  200d up to 300d you choose your price level from a seating plan. Best to pay extra and sit near the front as the puppets are not very big People were  taking photos  etc although  it is not permitted.,but not enforced

reviews.author: Bec Arnold
reviews.title: Well done show!
reviews.content: We attended tonight and the show was great. We'd probably recommend paying for the audio as we didn't really know what was happening but it was good to watch the puppets. The theatre is very clean and beautiful. Only issue we found was the seats are quite small and squishy so my partner who is 6"1 was pretty uncomfortable. The seating is scattered but we had a fair bit of trouble seeing some of the show due to it being behind the people's heads in front of us. If we did it again we would aim for the front or 2nd row. The music was wonderful and the whole thing is very clever. Would recommend!

reviews.author: flighttime
reviews.title: Hanoi water puppet show~ just ok
reviews.content: The puppet show is original to the rice farmers of ancient Vietnam. Done during rice harvest to entertain the children who were there to help with harvest. The emperor saw a show and decided it was an art that needed to be shared. Only done in the north. The show only lasted one hour, music all live and this was the most interesting part of the show. Instruments very different with different sounds. All spoken in Vietnamese so I got none of the story. Some were easy to figure out. My husband and I did not find the show enjoyable. The leg room is tight room coolish. Not a thing I would recommend but many in our group liked it.

reviews.author: Edios
reviews.title: And hour show
reviews.content: Interesting music and show, better not to miss it while in Ha noi, you can buy your ticket out door by credit card, so dont have to wait in line

reviews.author: Mr-Poisson
reviews.title: Disappointing - poor view
reviews.content: We didnt really get the hang of this!! Partly because we had a really poor view. the seats were not well inclined. Do have a look. Its not very expensive. If I were going again.....I would get a front seat view.

reviews.author: robyn b
reviews.title: Water puppet show
reviews.content: Very traditional and colourful. Quite loud at times and in Vietnamese but only ran for 45 minutes. Not my thing but l could appreciate the skill of the puppeteers and musicians.

reviews.author: David
reviews.title: Exceeded expectations
reviews.content: We got this as a freebie as part of our travel package and if it had not been for my partner I would not have gone. So we arrived 2 days before our tickets date and the very helpful staff changed this to the next performance with no quibbles or hassle - thanks. Went straight in and saw one of the most amusing and interesting live shows I have seen for years. Still not sure how they do it particularly cross overs. It is meant to be historical reenactments and I can see that but it was also like basic storytelling in the old 'Thunderbirds' style (if you remember that). Live music accompaniment was really varied, traditional and interesting. You can get an audio thingy if you want the official narrative but if you have already had a city tour you will know what the stories are about anyway. Only lasts about an hour, with 10 sub-stories, and really worthwhile. There were a couple of smaller children there  who were mesmerised but this might not apply to all. Recommended visit. I have not laughed so much for ages but suspect this is not necessarily the intended response!

reviews.author: BTG
reviews.title: Must see in Hanoi!
reviews.content: Beautiful show! The tickets are incredibly cheap for the amazing performance you get. This is a must see if you're in Vietnam!

reviews.author: richard
reviews.title: Water Theatre
reviews.content: There are 2 sites doing water theatre dhows we went tonthe Thang. It was great and took so much video i filled my camera chip. The musicians sit at the sides of the stage  7 in total with 2 lady singers. Thoroughly enjoyed the traditional show and the rime, some 45 mins passed v quickly. Wouls recommend this theatre.

reviews.author: Riley021
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.content: Really enjoyed the show - very entertaining and storytelling of vietnam history def worth a visit .we were recommended to ho to the smaller theatre and it was lovely

reviews.author: Nphan14
reviews.title: A culture thing so don’t expect too much
reviews.content: Although it’s quite popular it was difficult to understand.  The culture and story behind the show was never truly explained.  I had to look it up online to really understand some parts of it.  I’m Vietnamese-America but they spoke too fast so I didn’t get anything.  It does have a cultural aspect to it so it was interesting.  If you aren’t interested in those things than I would skip this show.  If you are than I would suggest buying the front seats.  The stage is low and a tall person can easily block your view.

reviews.author: Virginia
reviews.title: Puppet show in the water
reviews.content: An exceptional experience. We actually bought the tickets in the same theater that is facing the lake.The show is very beautiful with live singers and musicians. The puppets in the water are typical of Vietnam. Recommended for adults and children.

reviews.author: Jillian F
reviews.title: Really worth a visit
reviews.content: Fascinating. The show is funny, not too long and very cleverly put together. The musicians, singers, narrators and puppeteers are all very good. Unique cultural experience

reviews.author: ElenaArg
reviews.title: A must do
reviews.content: One of the most interesting theatrical plays we have ever watch, quite unique. There are 15 short folk stories of 2-3 minutes that you will follow much better if you buy the audio guide with 30,000 VND. The live music and the songs were also very good.

reviews.author: kiwivegan
reviews.title: Great entertainment
reviews.content: What an interesting show, the puppets are fun, the music is so interesting and a great way to experience traditional Vietnamese culture

reviews.author: Wanderer
reviews.title: Traditional show
reviews.content: Nice show, an ancien art to be preserved.Dragons playing with a ball is quite fun to watch.Seats range from 100.000 to 200.000 VND depending on row location. Credit cards accepted, then you need to exchange your receipt at the ticket window. First show at 16:10.

reviews.author: Liz H
reviews.title: Good to see
reviews.content: Interesting to see and masterfully done, but unfortunately visited this at the end of a long day of visiting many sites in Hanoi, so actually almost fell asleep. It might have held my attention if there had been an English translation in the performance, although appreciate this is being very selfish.  Music and singing were amazing and puppetry quite unique.

reviews.author: DoctorDerm1
reviews.title: Enjoyable music!
reviews.content: The novelty of the puppets on the water quickly wore off. The dialogue was not in English so I could not appreciate all that was going on. I did really enjoy the music and hearing the unusual live instruments. This is like the changing of the guard in London... it is iconic of Hanoi however no need to go back and see it again.

reviews.author: mandyCalifornia
reviews.title: Fun, historic, traditional
reviews.content: Love this. wow! Traditional live music and instruments adds to the uniqueness of puppets managed in the water by a well choreographed group of puppeteers. Rare experience not to be missed.

reviews.author: Chun Hua
reviews.title: Boring show.....
reviews.content: Nothing great to shout about. Huge theater, large crowd, but boring show. Maybe it was due to me not able to understand the language....

reviews.author: nadiak97
reviews.title: Highly recommend!
reviews.content: >Unique and creative show-very well executed >Audio translation was not required >Would suggest paying a bit more and sitting upfront for a better view >Around 54 minutes

reviews.author: Tanja
reviews.title: Quite nice, but not necessarily a "must-see"
reviews.content: So I thought it was nice to have seen this Vietnamese peculiarity. But it is not a must see for me now at any cost. So in a small window of opportunity as a couple can be dispensed with. With children, however, certainly a nice experience. We got there way too early. 5 min before the start would have been sufficient, there were max 50 guests...

reviews.author: Amanda C
reviews.title: Music is the only enjoyable bit
reviews.content: There are series of puppet enactments narrated, naturally in Vietnamese, I got the gist of what was going on.When the first puppet presented I thought ‘I hope this gets better ‘ it didn’t!The music played on traditional instruments was by far the best bit and I started to nod off.The puppetry is of a low standard- when they’re supposed to be dancing to the music they’re hopelessly out of sinc.I have no idea why it’s so highly ratedSorry not recommended at all

reviews.author: Chris_JNP
reviews.title: Nice place to see a traditional water puppet show
reviews.content: Very interesting, nice to see how they do the water puppets, would not be to everyone’s taste but worth a visit

reviews.author: scrapnyak
reviews.title: No translation
reviews.content: I was looking forward to this show, however at was all in Vietnamese and I found it difficult to follow. The artists were good, but I felt the story was lost on me. I wouldn’t do this again.

reviews.author: Alexandra L
reviews.title: Very fun tradition
reviews.content: This was a really fun activity. We have seen other water puppet shows but this one in Hoi An was the best. Our tickets gave us front row seats. The stories the puppets told were all in Vietnamese but easy to follow. The puppets were beautiful. If you’ve never been to a water puppet show, this would be a great one to visit.

reviews.author: coady2
reviews.title: Great bit of culture
reviews.content: What a wonderful way to spend 1 hour to see this amazing puppetry water show. A must when visiting Vietnam

reviews.author: dancethrulife
reviews.title: Fun Show!
reviews.content: We weren’t sure about this, but it ended up being a really neat cultural experience!  You can go to the ticket window anytime in the afternoon (I suggest doing so and securing your seats).  The live music and vocals were beautiful.  The puppeteers did a great job of story-telling and sharing their culture through their craft.  The show is just under an hour, so it’s not a huge time commitment if you are concerned about peeling yourself away from the beautiful outdoors.  Easy to find right by the Lake.

reviews.author: Helena
reviews.title: A must see
reviews.content: Really fun to see whilst in Hanoi. We just bought the 100,000VND tickets (cheapest ones) and this was perfectly fine. All the same seats, just further back.

reviews.author: Boon Fui T
reviews.title: Good experience
reviews.content: Quite a good activity, bought the audio pack, but music and speaker's sound was loud, cant hear it properly. It will be good if can have some sort of change, maybe change earpiece.

reviews.author: EricTheRed16
reviews.title: Worth the visit
reviews.content: Take the time to visit this show it is well worth it. We just walked off the street bought our tickets and enjoyed the wonderful show!

reviews.author: StevePettit
reviews.title: Anniversary Trip
reviews.content: Excellent show just under an hour and well worth a visit.  Can buy a translation booklet but best way is to just enjoy show (as you will miss things if you are constantly reading from book)

reviews.author: NorthStar282899
reviews.title: A bit touristy
reviews.content: Good fun but very much set up for the tourists. Almost an hour for the show. Gets a bit boring after a while.

reviews.author: Carol B
reviews.title: Enjoyed the music
reviews.content: We enjoyed the music and the puppet show. The performance was rather spoilt by the staff letting in people for the performance up to 10 minutes after the start of the show. This was very distracting.

reviews.author: Van Der Nam
reviews.title: Wonderfull game
reviews.content: That's traditional game long time ago. The first time I have seen before. Of course we high recommend for everyone

reviews.author: Gina
reviews.title: Really something else.
reviews.content: This is the most special show I have ever seen in my trips. I was touched by the simplicity and creative representation of Vietnamese everyday life. Art, tradition, spirituality and amazing live music.

reviews.author: killerdwarf
reviews.title: Really entertaining show
reviews.content: I really enjoyed my hour here. Paid for the 200000VND ticket and got the front row middle seat for the best view.Great musicians and singers accompany the show and it's very colourful and entertaining.A must do when in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Michele-Louise R
reviews.title: Colorful cultural cornerstone
reviews.content: Pretty to watch although I did not understand the specifics. Loved the music especially the single string instrument. Important performance art destination In Hanoi and not at all expensive.

reviews.author: dylanddd33
reviews.title: One of the dullest performances I’ve ever watched
reviews.content: I respect the uniqueness of this art form, however the short stories were incredibly boring and really lacked any plot at all. also the English translation headset was not worth it at all. The woman’s English accent was very hard to understand and it rarely translated any of the dialogue. It would just sometimes say some historical facts briefly. I would have walked out of there had it not been for the fact that the seats were so close together.

reviews.author: ydnaT1
reviews.title: Hanoi's best show
reviews.content: I went to see the show as intrigued more than anything but came out overjoyed. It was utterly brilliant with master puppetry and music mixed with Vietnamese culture and humor.  I will definitely go again next time in Hanoi and cant reccomend highly enough.

reviews.author: SupratimPal
reviews.title: Puppet Delight
reviews.content: Would say a must-see if you are in Hanoi. In a 45-minute show by this folk theatre group, we were simply mesmerised!

reviews.author: Lisa_Blake
reviews.title: A little bit of something different!
reviews.content: We had second row seats and enjoyed this quirky show. It’s an hour you should definitely spend because you’ll not likely see anything like it again! It was fun .

reviews.author: K&M rates plates
reviews.title: Not the best show
reviews.content: Hmmmmm it’s not the best show. It is an authentic Vietnamese show and I guess it’s worth doing if you want to experience the Vietnamese culture. We had a audio guide which helped explain things a little bit, but still a bit strange. Puppets were really impressive and operated well, especially seeing as they was in water.

reviews.author: SteveByfleet
reviews.title: Much better than we expected
reviews.content: Maybe it is a bit touristy but we enjoyed the 45 minute show very much. We were surprised how many puppeteers and musicians were involved, and as best as we could tell, no animals were injured in the making of the presentation. Good honest fun

reviews.author: James F
reviews.title: A Most Disappointing Expereince
reviews.content: We arrived at the venue and were met with a sign starting that the performance was cancelled.  My granddaughter was very disappointed. We did not receive any advance notification or email.  There was no ticket office on site. There was no offer to re-book.I have requested a full refund from the venue and from Trip Advisor.  Neither has responded.  I will never book another event through Trip Advisor.

reviews.author: David
reviews.title: Great light hearted fun
reviews.content: We had a lovely evening at the water puppet show and it was very entertaining. It was light hearted and amusing.Would recommend. Only negative I am 6 foot 4 so found the seats a bit cramped.

reviews.author: Jim0
reviews.title: The best I have seen in Vietnam
reviews.content: We bought out tickets but thought the show was in several hours.  They were very helpful and gave us earlier Tickets.  The live music was great.  5 or six musians and two singers.  12 pupeteers.  I have seen several in HoiAn and Saigon.  This was by far the best.  Only problem is many steps for my crutches.

reviews.author: Laura N
reviews.title: Fun
reviews.content: Good time. Lasted 50min. Got tickets an hour before on the counter and there wasn't many left. Credit card ok, but have to buy the tickets from a machine.

reviews.author: hartplatt
reviews.title: Good demonstration of traditional story telling
reviews.content: It was a rainy afternoon and we thought we’d give the water puppet show a look to dry off.It was very interesting to hear the legends and see the imagery cleverly portrayed with the water puppets. Fire dragons breathed smoke under water and flames from fireworks - the theatre did get quite smoky!Tales were accompanied by traditional instrumental music and singing. It was a little hard to understand the English translation at some points but overall we enjoyed it and it was good value for money.

reviews.author: Missnurse
reviews.title: Enjoyable hour
reviews.content: We were told mixed reviews about this place and told to go for a laugh. We enjoyed it but won’t  brag about the performance back home, it was something different but nothing special. Nice to sit down for a hour and get away from the hustle of the busy city Hanoi is.

reviews.author: Kevin H
reviews.title: Great show
reviews.content: We went to the show while in Hanoi, and found it very good ,very entertaining  funny and a reasonable price the musicians and puppet masters clearly enjoyed their jobs

reviews.author: Nomadic Dr
reviews.title: Interesting Water puppet
reviews.content: Another touristy place to visit and it's ok to visit for the first time. You need a good seat to be able to enjoy the show. Seats are pre-assigned, so buy your tickets early to get the right place.

reviews.author: Sophie M
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: We were 4 adults and a 1.5 year old and we loved the show. We paid extra to sit in row D and had a great view. My son was captivated by the show and sat the entire time.

reviews.author: Charlotte
reviews.title: Great show and skills! Had to look at the show through multiple peoples phones!!
reviews.content: The show was so entertaining! I opted not to go for the translation and it was easy to follow. The skills of the puppeteers and the singers/band are really incredible. But all said and done there was unfortunately too too many other guests with their phones high in the air trying to film it. The show was only half full when I was there so I tried to move seats to avoid but kept getting blocked by another screen. Please ban the use of recording equipment for this show and allow everyone to enjoy!!

reviews.author: Enecece
reviews.title: Very nice to watch
reviews.content: This was unexpected. It is a proper theater and the music really makes the puppets and the story turn into something magical. It’s one hour long and can be listened with translator earphones. Although I watched the performance in Vietnamese, the images are self explanatory. However, if you don’t want to miss any detail, I suggest that you pick the translator.

reviews.author: MJBucks
reviews.title: More entertaining than I imagined
reviews.content: We booked last minute for the performance and had seats on the third row, which although good still meant you suffered from heads in the way as despite the seating being tiered all the 'action' takes place low down where the floor of a conventional stage would be so I would definitely recommend booking front row seats. Despite the bobbing heads we still really enjoyed the performance and the music from the musicians was probably worth it in it's own right, the language barrier on the narration certainly didn't detract from our enjoyment and the puppetry was very good. Definitely worth a visit if you're in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Feenixwest
reviews.title: Delightful
reviews.content: Well done visual and auditory experience. I don’t know which I liked better—it was all wonderful. The appeal is definitely for foreigners who filled the auditorium. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Mark B
reviews.title: Interesting show
reviews.content: We were able to buy tickets at the venue for a show the same day. Show lasts about one hour. Is a unique experience. Entertaining and at times quite funny. Wait for the appearance of the water rat :-). Would certainly recommend to visit if in Hanoi.

reviews.author: julia b
reviews.title: One of the highlights of Hanoi
reviews.content: This show is really amazing!  One of my favourite parts of my trip. The show begins with an introduction into the instruments used to create the different sounds for the show, which are truly unique in every way. i enjoyed the mingling of the puppets dancing to the music, the different stories each chapter played out and the fireworks added a finesse to the story telling. This show is definitely worth seeing and if you can book your seats in advance, do so, as then you can be in the first few rows as it really does make for a great show!

reviews.author: Alan R
reviews.title: Very interesting show
reviews.content: The show was interesting and very entertaining. It was a quick performance no longer than an hour. The most expensive price for the ticket was 200k dong or a little less than $9 per person. The lowest price was 100k dong. All of the ticket levels will give you a great view of the show. The reason I did not give this show 5 stars was because of the audio guides! This was a major mistake on my part in purchasing the audio guide, you cannot hear the information over the show and the information was lacking and uninformative. Skip it and just watch the show in the native language.

reviews.author: Denise J
reviews.title: Artistry
reviews.content: We went 3 nights ago. The live music and sound effects made the visuals so much better. Small theater. You can choose from 150/200/300 vnd seats. 200 seats were just fine for us. You can choose seats from an digital kiosk with a card or pay at a cashier's window

reviews.author: junarnnn
reviews.title: Cultural experience
reviews.content: First time seeing such a show presented in this way. Good to watch just once. Go there and buy your tickets early. It’s cheaper if you buy the tickets there directly instead of booking online. Translation available for 30,000 vnd. The English translations was difficult to understand.

reviews.author: Kate
reviews.title: Cute hour in Hanoi
reviews.content: Very cute hour spent in the puppet theatre. Will say that we were in second row and even the one row in front was slightly annoying so try and get front row. Lasts for 50 mins. Toilets are downstairs and shared with a cafe, but if you show your ticket you get in free. They are not nice, stink a lot but do the job! Would recommend.

reviews.author: deviina
reviews.title: Exciting!
reviews.content: Fun show, very interesting. But tbh didnt really understand the main storyline as my seat was towards the back and couldn't see much. However, the music is nice and the idea of a water puppet show is unique !

reviews.author: Nate
reviews.title: Fun experience
reviews.content: The show was a nice way to spend an afternoon. We arrived early to pre-purchase our seats then went for a walk and local lunch. It’s worth the small fee for the audio translation. My only feedback is try to sit center away from the speakers as it’s loud and can be difficult to hear the audio earpiece

reviews.author: Anshika Maheshwari
reviews.title: Good experience
reviews.content: The show takes you through the history of Vietnam. Everything is so well done, you hardly realise that the artists are just puppets.

reviews.author: wolvoUk
reviews.title: Very enjoyable
reviews.content: This was great, lasted about an hour and told a variety of stories from Vietnamese folklore. You can have the stories translated into your own language but we didn't bother and it did not detract from our enjoyment.

reviews.author: Robin M
reviews.title: String me along, sort of!
reviews.content: Lively, fun, different, well worth a visit!!! Great live music, great singing and amazing g fire breathing water dragons!

reviews.author: Edy P
reviews.title: Must watch!
reviews.content: Is a Must attend and watch this water puppet show! This theater is just across the lake. There 5 shows time daily. You can buy the ticket at the theater.

reviews.author: TheBuffys
reviews.title: TIME I'LL NEVER GET BACK! DREADFUL
reviews.content: Complete waste of time. Very poor performance. Its part of the Vietnamese culture they could afford to loose! It is quite cheap but 3 people behind us had their kids - 4 or 5 years old - on their laps kicking our seats & talking throughout. The musicians are good but loose the 2nd rate puppets!

reviews.author: j1mt
reviews.title: Charming theater experience
reviews.content: Great show of puppet virtuosity in a beautiful old theater.Great for kids and elders alike.Beatific music by live orchestra with viet Nam instruments

reviews.author: Emilie G
reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.content: I absolutely loved the water pupper show! It's definitely a must-see if you are in Hanoi. I loved the show, the puppets, the music and singing. I enjoyed it without a guide and headset. We paid 150k vnd to be in the middle but regret we did not pay to be closer to the front. If you are small, definitely a better option. It takes slightly less than an hour and they start on time. Best to book a few days before.

reviews.author: David M
reviews.title: A truckload of laughs ...
reviews.content: My partner and I have always enjoyed Vietnamese water puppet shows, having attended touring shows when they came to our town. Therefore, we were never going to not attend the Thang Long Theatre when we were in Hanoi.And it was a hoot. The theatre itself was both opulent (maybe a little tired) and intimate. The accompanying orchestration was another visual delight. And the puppet show itself was clever and funny, even if we didn't always understand the storyline. And all at a ridiculously cheap ticket price. Perhaps we are just big kids at heart, but watching something like this brings a smile to the face and a lifting of the soul. Strongly recommended.

reviews.author: Janette P
reviews.title: Traditional Vietnam Experience
reviews.content: This was quite a unique experience and fun to watch... yes, a little bizarre but with the amazing accompanying live musicians it was a thoroughly enjoyable show.

reviews.author: halfling17
reviews.title: Chill Cultural Experience
reviews.content: I was a little skeptical at first (not so into puppets), but my spouse was keen, so we went. The theater is quite small, which affords a good view of both the puppets and the musicians. The day we went, we could have wished for a slightly better audio mix so we could hear all the different instrumental parts (we are music nerds), but overall it was a very pleasant experience for both ears and eyes.

reviews.author: AdventurRoo
reviews.title: Super bizarre but entertaining
reviews.content: The tickets are only like 5 Dollars, so certainly not much. The show is very musical so an Audi guide is not really necessary. Just make up your own stories. It was just very enjoyable to watch all the puppets in the water and listening to the traditional Vietnamese music. Highly recommended, especially it will be one of those bizarre experiences you will talk about for the rest of your life

reviews.author: zarniwoop
reviews.title: Excellent Experience
reviews.content: A very traditional and cultural experience and really entertaining show. Quaint little theatre where wonderful musicians and puppeteers work a delightful magic.

reviews.author: GRLUK
reviews.title: Great start to our holiday
reviews.content: We had only just arrived in Vietnam with Audley Travel and were being dropped off at the Apricot Hotel when the guide mentioned the water puppet show across the road.  We were tired but as it was only thirty metres away it seemed like an easy way to sample local culture on day one.And it really was a unique experience, something we had never heard of let alone seen. Clever, funny, different and well priced, what more could you want from a tourist attraction. Do try not and take along the inner child in you to have the best time.

reviews.author: Maria M
reviews.title: Very positive one hour show
reviews.content: Water puppet show is something very different and typical for Viet Nam. I really recommend to visit it. We didn’t buy ticket in advance. You can do it at the entrance just before the show. It is an open air theatre, so during winter bring a jacket. There is not specific seat number, so for those who would like to get central close to the stage seat I recommend to come 15-20 min earlier.

reviews.author: Aliya
reviews.title: Kids enjoyed the show so much
reviews.content: We have visited the show with 2 kids (3 and 6 years old). And we are happy that we made it. The show is around 40-60 min and consists of 2-5 min little shows. Children were excited and interested to see different characters. We have pre-booked the tickets in advance through hotel and got places on the first row. Please note that it is good to bring mosquito repellent😊

reviews.author: Ann O
reviews.title: Thang Long Water Puppet Show
reviews.content: We bought our tickets in advance. The only problem with that is that we had to go to a nearby hotel to actually pick them up ... a bit inconvenient. The puppet show was darling! It was the perfect amount of time and very enjoyable.

reviews.author: Jo S
reviews.title: Water puppet theater.
reviews.content: Nice experience, handsome and definitely worth seeing. The screening is only in Vietnamese and are all short scenes about Vietnamese culture and history.

reviews.author: Nick C
reviews.title: Ancient and Unique, a part of Vietnamese culture
reviews.content: we purchased our tickets early as the que is long and ofeten sold out. we go seats toward the front to get a better view. I was worth it. The puppeta are operated by invisible teal behind a curtain and the color and deatail is amazing. Well worth the ticket price it goes for one hour. The show is acompanied by musicians playing old traditional songs as the puppets act out legends of the old history of the region which goes back thousands of years.

reviews.author: DAN
reviews.title: Wonderful cultural experience
reviews.content: Loved the Thang Long puppet show. The singing and story lines was easy to follow and didn’t require a translated version to listen too.  We had a little difficult seeing and my son was unable to see over the heads of other audience members. To avoid this I recommend getting a seat in the front of the theatre.  Purchase of tickets was easy- I went by two hours before the show and purchased at the theatre. A lot cheaper this way then doing it online or through tour company and you also can select your seats. Enjoy 😊

reviews.author: Danya F
reviews.title: Very Enjoyable Show
reviews.content: We sat in the second row center and were able to get a few good photos of the amazing water puppet show.  We didn't get the audio headphones so I can't comment on that.  However, the show is easy to follow so I don't feel it is necessary to pay extra for the English commentary.  I would just say go and enjoy!  Each vignette is very short.  I would suggest having your hotel book you the best possible seats in the theater as soon as you know what evening you want to go.  It was nice to be so close!

reviews.author: Dona_Nils
reviews.title: Amazing show
reviews.content: We were a little doubtful about this theatre but glad that we decided to see it. Very special and interesting tradition. We liked the music. The show is fun!

reviews.author: indotravellers
reviews.title: Wonderful Art - whether tourist oriented or not
reviews.content: This was an hour happily spent. The music was excellent (especially the dan bau), and the puppets eloquent in the way the best puppets might be. I feel a bit sad for the reviewers who feel this should be updated - why? Or that there aren't any locals here. Sit back and enjoy it for what it is - gentle fun. And enjoy it now, before someone convinces the performers they need a few CGI.

reviews.author: Ed N
reviews.title: Skip it
reviews.content: I understand that it has cultural significance, but it is a low end Disney experience.  Puppets...in the water...with music. Pass.

reviews.author: TinaQ
reviews.title: Delightful
reviews.content: We were taken here as a part of an event programme. I did not know what to expect, but I enjoyed myself. Even though we only knew the names of the acts as per brochure, the whole hour flew by fast and was both entertaining and amusing. We laughed a lot. Lovely live music, charming performance, I was glad I came.

reviews.author: Airsnroo123
reviews.title: Great show
reviews.content: This is funny, lovely, amazing and a must go show. It helps you to understand a. little about Vietnamese culture.

reviews.author: ellinghamfamily
reviews.title: So cheap for an hour of fun
reviews.content: They made it funny and no need to hire the translator it wasnt very much help tbh. Great to watch and the music was enjoyable too

reviews.author: GraytreeofStAndrews
reviews.title: Puppet show
reviews.content: The show, music and experience was very good.  The extra paid for translation was not always accurate and could have been paused to speak after the puppeteer.  Some audience not very nice holding phones up to record show and blocking sight lines to the show.

reviews.author: gamahoz
reviews.title: Charming performance
reviews.content: Whilst undoubtedly touristy, this is a charming, unique performance symbolising the history of the Lake of the Restored Sword.  The puppetry is wonderful, and very funny at times.  The musicianship and singing is great.  We purchased a headset providing a limited English commentary (the performance is in Vietnamese).  It is a lovely way to pass some time and enjoy a performance you would never experience outside of Vietnam.

reviews.author: Coully11
reviews.title: Water Puppet show Hanoi
reviews.content: Lovely show well done.Puppets are amazing.Musicians are fantastic.Fully recommend.You should see this if you are able to.

reviews.author: Bob C
reviews.title: Delightful
reviews.content: Ingenious and delightful show. Don't miss it. Musicians were very professional. The puppets often hilarious.

reviews.author: dekalbill
reviews.title: Music, Art and History
reviews.content: Enjoyed the performance of traditional music, singing, costumes and artistically presented puppets.  It may seem touristy, but the story telling in the water puppet show was delightful. My guide had told me many stories related to the lake history and some were depicted in this program. Well worth your time.

reviews.author: Cotti Theresa
reviews.title: Puppetry magic
reviews.content: INCREDIBLE! The show was marvelous and transported me to another world. It was so great to have some English narration to help understand Vietnamese culture better. This is fantastic for all ages alike and had a lot of "woah" moments in the crowd. The performances were very enticing and the puppets were displayed beautifully. I would highly recommend this and if I had another night in Hoi An I would see it again. Compliments to the artists and organizers!FYI: you can preorder your tickets and get seats in the first row but the outdoor theater is small enough that you can see the stage vividly- even when up the back so this shouldn't be a issue. Preordering is ideal though because the show can fill up quickly. I had to book 3 days in advance as the shows had been sold out (and I can understand why- it's fantastic!).

reviews.author: Traian C
reviews.title: Great performance
reviews.content: We enjoyed the performance. It is a must do in Hanoi and I would definitely recommend anyone to attend the show.

reviews.author: Venkatesh
reviews.title: Best show in Hanoi
reviews.content: Nice show in all means hots off to the group.totaly flawless,very fine matters were focused with perfection.we were at third row 3to8

reviews.author: MaryNML
reviews.title: Great perfomance!
reviews.content: Great image of their culture. Great voices and instruments. Nice experience. They even had puppets dragon boat races!!!

reviews.author: Raffaele M
reviews.title: Water Play
reviews.content: A must-see event in Hanoi to witness a unique Vietnamese art form. Well organised and performed with live traditional music on either side of the performing pond. The performance communicates the traditional stories so well your attention is held throughout the performance.

reviews.author: Xcuse
reviews.title: Impressive show - live singers and musicians as well as water puppetry.
reviews.content: Impressive show - live singers and musicians as well as water puppetry. Better than any other water puppets show we saw. Didn’t get the translation option...didn’t need it. Stories are quite visual and following along was no problem. The singers were fantastic as were the musicians on historical Vietnamese instruments.

reviews.author: Amarjyoti H
reviews.title: Best of the lot
reviews.content: The show is a view into the daily workings of the vietnamese in rural setting with nicely scripted puppetry and lot of hilarious moments

reviews.author: Ketu
reviews.title: Superb
reviews.content: We ahhed and ummed about this experience and am I glad we went for a show. Even though we didn't understand the language, the acts were so great that you could pick up on the gist of the story. The musicians were delightful and the effects breathtaking.

reviews.author: Sheila A
reviews.title: Loved this show
reviews.content: This is a really fun 40 minutes, if you love tradition puppet shows. Which I do. Well worth it. We didn’t get the audio guide, action self explanatory.

reviews.author: Sarah M
reviews.title: Good show
reviews.content: The show was good and amusing. You could see a bit into the "life" of vietnam. It was also amusing for our children 5.7. 45 min are enough but completely aura

reviews.author: Caitlyn M
reviews.title: Interesting Cultural Experience
reviews.content: Very cool, I really enjoyed this show. The puppets are just so unique. Price is very reasonable. Definitely worth a visit

reviews.author: Julian M
reviews.title: Stunning !
reviews.content: When my wife suggested we go to this water puppet show I was less than enthusiastic- really not my thing ! However it was superb. Atmospheric, funny and hugely entertaining the level of skill shown by both the puppeteers and musicians was incredible. Without doubt one of the highlights of our Vietnam tour.

reviews.author: Young Zeezy
reviews.title: Fantastic Show, Y'all Are Nuts for Saying it's Too Long
reviews.content: I'm ADHD as can be and thought this show was the perfect length. I have no idea how people couldn't sit through 50 minutes of it. It was funny and entertaining (even though it was in Vietnamese and no one can know for sure what the plot was, it was not important). The puppets were beautifully made, and the music fantastic. The musicians were very talented and the instruments like nothing I've seen before. My friend and I are in our early 30s and we both were very glad we went, and thought it was definitely great for any age. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ryan C
reviews.title: Hoi An show
reviews.content: It was an easy process, and a great show!  I think this is a great alternative to other shows in the bigger cities and has their own local twist.

reviews.author: Ania54B
reviews.title: Fantastic experience, worth every dong
reviews.content: Absolutely loved everything about the show: music, commentary, singing, puppets,  sets, artistic vision and skills of puppeteers. I wished the performance could go on and on.

reviews.author: ljoyer
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.content: This was a highlight of our Hanoi visit. Loved the live music-the unfamiliar instruments brought the famous Star Wars bar scene to mind!  We opted to skip the audio Translators and just watch.We sat in the third row and the view was pretty good. Obviously front row would’ve been best.

reviews.author: Sue M
reviews.title: Entertaining
reviews.content: What a novel way to do a puppet show.  It was amusing and very entertaining. Worth seeing just because it"s different.

reviews.author: Allen B
reviews.title: Nice Slice of Culture - but ask for Front Row if Tall
reviews.content: We were told this was a must see, and it was an enjoyable 3/4 hour. The room was packed and pretty hot and we were in the second row which was uncomfortable for me as I'm fairly tall (wife was just fine). The long rows and entry only from side made seating a bit of a trial and some patience required with lots of standing up and sittingdown unless you are all together in a large group.The show itself was enjoyable - skilled muisicians, singers and puppeteers. Some of the nuances wnet over our heads and what we thought was a guide was a set of postcards when we were seated - so we winged it :)Not the hilight of Hanoi - but a nice slice of history/culture.

reviews.author: Kristian
reviews.title: Theater
reviews.content: Good. Buy first row tickets if you have long legs :) And the audio-guide does not translate the dialog, it only tells you about the themes of the sketches, so concider this before buying.

reviews.author: Inspire601754
reviews.title: Good for about 15 min
reviews.content: Great experience to see just once, good music and really cool. After about 15-20 min you are ready to be done.

reviews.author: 828sharmila
reviews.title: wonderful experience
reviews.content: An unique traditional water puppet show which worth a visit. we had beautiful seats in the front - 2nd row , and we enjoyed every minute . This will be entertaining for both young and senior members - a good family outing

reviews.author: Sandy B
reviews.title: We booked good seats
reviews.content: Great show for around 45 minutes, you can get a audio for your language but we did it just as is. Has some lovely surprising moments but overall just a delight to watch. Don't expect big thrills but enjoy the culture and wonderful music

reviews.author: bulldoghoff
reviews.title: A unique cultural and entertaining experience
reviews.content: A fun traditional puppet show that you may not see elsewhere. It was funny and entertaining. Suitable for young and old. And the theater is pretty cool as well.

reviews.author: KirstSurrey_UK
reviews.title: Worth a visit!
reviews.content: Beautiful, fun, traditional! Lovely show and well worth a visit. Beautiful traditional music. The puppets are beautiful and the puppeteers and musicians make the whole thing so much fun and really come to life!

reviews.author: Paddy F
reviews.title: Puppet show
reviews.content: It really depends what your into with this. It's fun and quirky but not really my own cup of tea. 5 pounds to enter lasted about 45 mins. Different to anything at home so still worth a visit

reviews.author: Kitkattrek
reviews.title: Delightful!
reviews.content: This is a beautiful experience away from the bustle of Hanoi!The music is exquisite and masterfully performed by live musicians and the puppets themselves are both beautiful and delightful. Although its entirely in Vietnamese - so it won't always be clear what's going on - there is a leaflet provided with scene title names in English & there's more musical accompaniment than dialogue anyway.Sometimes funny, sometimes almost moving, this is a lovely and authentic slice of traditional Vietnamese culture and art.The only downside is the audience, who were so noisy it was sometimes hard to hear the gorgeous music.Get seats up front for the best experience!

reviews.author: 126sylwia
reviews.title: Nice entertainment
reviews.content: Worth to see. Beautiful music and the whole performance. Funny stories played on the water by the puppets.

reviews.author: Darion
reviews.title: Just so bizarre....
reviews.content: It’s so weird. Fun to do, but it’s very silly and in Vietnamese so we didn’t get much out of it. The music is beautiful and live, the acting is pretty ... funny. It’s short so if you wanna experience bizarre, try it!

reviews.author: Stephen C
reviews.title: Very entertaining
reviews.content: I was a little doubtful when I booked but glad I did. It was the most enjoyable part of my trip to Hanoi. I did not realise how many performers were involved in the show until the part and how the musicians helped the puppeteers. The musicians were great entertainment on their own. I wish I had paid for the audio guide though to get a better understanding of the show.

reviews.author: Jo M
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.content: We called in on the off-chance of getting 2 tickets for the evening of New Years Day and were lucky! We paid 200k dong (about £6.50 each) for one of the front rows. There are several shows a day (info on website but couldn’t see a way to book online).Very easy boxoffice arrangement. Small cafe but we didn’t partake.Lovely show, we particularly appreciated the music played on traditional instruments.All the singing/narrative is in Vietnamese but we could understand the stories.We were very impressed by the technical ability of the puppeteers who come out at the end to take a well-deserved bow.

reviews.author: sasaw409
reviews.title: Must See
reviews.content: I think everyone should see this traditional water puppet show when you are visiting Hanoi. The show was attractive but there was no translation to help us understand what they are singing and telling.The show was about 45 minutes long, I actually felt asleep due to the repetition but my son and my husband really enjoyed it.

reviews.author: PicklesMilk
reviews.title: Great!
reviews.content: Great cultural experience, nice to chill out and watch for 45 min. Definitely recommend! (Skip the line gets you a front row seat apparently.)

reviews.author: Rahul K
reviews.title: lovely show dont buy tickets from viator
reviews.content: lovely show must watch. nice puppet show in the water with livr vietnamese music. u can take any seat the view is clear as each row of seats is appropriately raised. cant understand the language as they singing in vietnamese language but was a great show.pls buy direct from the theater not from viator as in viator u need to pick up the tickets from a hotel which is 500m away or their guy comes to drop tickets but u need to wait till the last minute for him to come and viator charges much more than ticket at theater.lovely show must watch

reviews.author: Paul C
reviews.title: Surprisingly interesting, funny and educational!
reviews.content: We visited the puppet theatre with our 2 year old son to attend the 3pm showing. The show is approx 45 minutes long and has a water puppet feature accompanied by music and singing. It’s not normally my cup of tea, but we all really enjoyed it. Even our 2 year old who started off by saying he was scared and wanted to leave, eventually loved it and walked about it all afternoon and evening!The standard seats are comfortable and spacious, and the view is generally fine (unless you have someone in front of you trying to video the show - luckily we didn’t, but noticed others that did!). The price is reasonable, and the theatre is indoors and so not weather dependant.  Would definitely recommend taking the time to see this show during a visit to Hanoi.

reviews.author: Yael
reviews.title: AMAZING experience
reviews.content: Beautiful beautiful beautiful!Had no expectation but was overwhelmed by how beautiful this experience was. The musicians, the puppets, the effects. (You don’t need transportation earphones in my opinion).

reviews.author: Damian D
reviews.title: Fun show
reviews.content: Our kids are 15 through 21 and we wondered how they would enjoy this. Well, they had a good goggle whilst watching this show. Nicely put together and the bonus of booking through TripAdvisor gave us great reserved seats. Whilst the dialogue is in Vietnamese, the program and sections between each act are in English so we understood everything. Very clever and well worth it for the cheap price.

reviews.author: steverichhudd
