reviews.title: Magical
reviews.content: We went here on 31st Dec, 21:15 showing, to escape the crowds in the street for a little while.The show was magical. It's all in Vietnamese and you can purchase an audio guide, but we decided to do without and just watch the play unfold We had the 10k each seats, in the middle of row M. The seats where fine, we had a decent view of the water stage and felt we missed nothing. If you are tall, then try for one of the front 200k seats as leg room isn't the best.The show lasted 50-60mins and we loved it. To be honest we had no idea what was going on, but the puppets, the energy and the live music made it feel like a very special NYE for us.We would give the show 5 stars, but marked down a star due to the theatre itself. Firstly, please implement a no phone policy!! Having the glare of screens and people holding their phones in your eyeline to record sections of the show is incredibly distracting. Secondly, stop admitting late comers. 15/20 minutes into the performance and you are still showing people to their seats. Again, this was incredibly distracting and took away from the performance on stage.This is a theatre and no other theatre I've been to would allow the above. Please don't cheapen your fantastic show by continuing the above. Cherish your magical production!

reviews.author: Susan C
reviews.title: Unique cultural show
reviews.content: Bright, colourful and only 50 minutes long, this is a fun and different cultural attraction in Hanoi. The various puppet stories retell Vietnamese folk tales and legends and is accompanied by live Vietnamese singers and musicians.There are three seating pricing options - towards the front, the middle and back. We chose seats near the front of the middle section as we felt that was much the same as seats at the back of the front section. Seats are comfortable. Photography appeared to be allowed and some tourists were inconsiderate and blocked other people’s viewing. We paid extra for the audio guide which provides a very brief explanation for each story then is silent till the next scene where it will automatically re-start. It is not an exact translation of the Vietnamese dialogue which is much longer. That confused us for a while and we wasted time fiddling with it till we worked out what was happening.We had been prepared to book a few days ahead but were quite lucky and able to book the 3 o’clock session at the theatre itself just a couple of hours beforehand. The later 4:10 session looked busier and, I think, the three even later evening sessions might have been difficult to get tickets too.

reviews.author: Srinivas G
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.content: A wonderful 50 minutes of time well spent by witnessing an art followed decades ago. Must see. Please book at least one day in advance to avoid disappointment

reviews.author: sankhasubhra s
reviews.title: Nice show !!
reviews.content: A nice show for family with a duration of 45 minutes. Multiple shows happen every day. We bought Advanced tickets which was helpful to avoid the long queue.

reviews.author: Jessie L
reviews.title: Very enjoyable puppet show.
reviews.content: A really good show. Accompanied by live music and a nice atmosphere. Suitable for all ages and languages. Not too long but nice to sit and have a rest during the entertainment.

reviews.author: EU family in HK
reviews.title: Good performance, hectic surrounding...
reviews.content: The show is good, the audioguide is  helpful. But, we did not know, that the guide only said a few words at the beginning than nothing for ages, even though on stage there was a lot of talking. We kept trying to fix our machines. Then finally in the middle of the show it started explaining at the beginning of every scene. It could have been better if they tell you before what to expect from the guide.  Also, latecomers are let in even to the middle of the front rows, which is quite disturbing for everyone else, especially that the view is not brilliant from the rows further away. We were 15 minutes into the performance, and people still arrived.

reviews.author: JamesBond89
reviews.title: Fantastic Show, Felt like a kid on Christmas Day
reviews.content: This is not to be missed. Wonderful and magical. The show had me smiling from beginning to end. Something so special in a crazy busy world.

reviews.author: Deborah S
reviews.title: Entertaining piece of local culture
reviews.content: The Water Puppet Theatre tradition appears to have evolved from workers entertaining themselves in the Rice Paddies.  The show lasts about 50 minutes and tickets were only about £5 each at current exchange rates, so it's worth going to.  You can also get an audio guide for a little extra, which gives some commentary to explain what is going on, although I still think you could probably enjoy it without.There are several traditional singers and musicians and we see at the end that there are ten puppeteers in the water!  They way they manipulate the puppets is really extremely good and I was thoroughly entertained.  I think 50 minutes was probably about the right length for this show.There are several performances a day, so you should be able to find one that suits you.I was slightly bemused by one party trying to pay in Euros!  The Vietnamese currency is the Dong!  There were also an enormous number of late comers!  The majority were 5-10 minutes after the start, but there were people still coming in after 30 minutes - for a 50 minute show?!  This was rather distracting.  Personally, I'd make late-comers wait until a suitable break in the performance and not let them disrupt the enjoyment of others who had the courtesy to arrive on time.  I'd also be tempted to have a cut off and not admit anyone after the first 10 minutes!There were also a number of people taking photos/videos - it seems no one can just watch something and enjoy it any more!  Final shout out to the girl in-front of us with the attention span of a gnat who was browsing Tripadvisor reviews during the performance.... it would be nice if you could learn some manners or just stay at home!

reviews.author: Rahul S
reviews.title: Lively Puppet show
reviews.content: Must go in HanoiVery lively and a different one very well coordinated don't forget to reach on time, they start sharp on timeworth to take first row.. worth the moneykids enjoy

reviews.author: adiwsusanto
reviews.title: A must at least once
reviews.content: While you may miss some of the back & forth chatting in Viet you can still figure out the plot. The music & "chanting" (as i dont understand Viet) still a nice sound to hear. Just imagine it like cirque de Soleil background music.

reviews.author: mrsmalibu
reviews.title: Lovey
reviews.content: This is a wonderful show completely encompassing Vietnamese culture. I thoroughly enjoyed all the different scenes the puppets in the water portrayed. It was colorful and energetic. The musicians were fantastic I loved hearing the Vietnamese sounds and instruments. I highly recommend the show a must see.

reviews.author: Alan W
reviews.title: Ok for children
reviews.content: This is a 10 minute novelty act which strains to maintain adult interest for an hour.  Uncomfortable cramped seating (no leg room) and audience members who cannot stop talking, manage their children or using their phone only add to a desire to leave early.  The live music is the highlight. There are better ways to enjoy your vacation.

reviews.author: kurtkrausse2016
reviews.title: Water puppet theatre
reviews.content: Not much leg room. Show about 50 minutes. Kept allowing late arrivals 15 minutes into shOw- BIG distraction. First 15 minutes were most enjoyable after which it was kinda dull and I was thankful it only lasted as long as it did. A bit overpriced but still glad we experienced it

reviews.author: Jay “flower” child
reviews.title: This was interesting!!
reviews.content: I’m rating it 3 stars because it surely was an interesting culturally unique experience. I learned a lot about the Vietnamese culture, the show was cheap (deluxe tickets for 200k VND), it’s a beautiful theatre and a convenient location in old quarter. The water puppets were beautiful and there is so much attention to detail.Although it was a good 1 hour spent, in no means is it a highlight of my trip. It is all done in Vietnamese and I did opt for the English audio guide (30k extra....) which did not help much... it was a little disappointing because it just gives you a 1 sentence overview every 10 minutes of the play. Not details as to actually what you’re seeing.Save your money and don’t get the audio guide, but just enjoy the visuals and music.

reviews.author: Michelle C
reviews.title: Fun show, live music.
reviews.content: We enjoyed the Water Puppet Show! You can rent a headset with different translations explaining the show and storylines, which is recommended - the people sitting next to us did not get the headsets, and had no idea what was going on.Great puppetry, skillful musicians and cute set. You can take photos and videos. Tickets are available for purchase at the theatre itself - no need to purchase too far ahead. We went to a 3pm show, and there were many open seats (though we did visit in November, which may be a quieter time for tourists). My husband was not a huge fan of the experience, but it was a unique, well put together performance, and I thoroughly enjoyed it!

reviews.author: Shirley O
reviews.title: Boring Show
reviews.content: Went for the Thang Long Water Puppet Show as it seems to be one of the "must see" activity from majority of the reviews I read.  My family and I were super disappointed with the show.  It was so boring until my kids asked me how long more to go?  This is one of the worst experience I had. Not recommended.

reviews.author: Jason C
reviews.title: Cute Water Puppet Show
reviews.content: Really enjoyed this show more than I thought I would. Located around the old quarter I booked my tickets through Viator and picked them up from a nearby hotel 15 minutes before the show. The Theatre itself is very nice and the show itself is amazing. We didn't have the English audio translation but enjoyed the show anyway and marvelled at the artistry of the puppets. The show goes on for about 40-50 minutes which is the perfect length of time and enjoyed the traditional music that went along with the show. A must do in Hanoi

reviews.author: Amar K
reviews.title: Puppets and Live Music in a Traditional Cultural Show
reviews.content: This is my second time seeing this show. Colourful puppets, skilfully manipulated under water, with very nice live folk music. Great way to spend an hour before dinner. The show lasts 50 minutes and tickets are inexpensive (~ $10 or less). There are 4 to 5 shows daily.  Something to note for those of the CGI /computer graphics video generation. This is pretty humble village stuff. Nothing Disney or Circque du Soleil about it. Just highly skilled traditional puppeteers and musicians sharing their art.

reviews.author: TomLaw
reviews.title: Great water puppet show with live music
reviews.content: Famous water puppet show. A must see. Lots of puppet action accompanied by live musicians. Inexpensive and a you can take photos during the show. Buy lunch nearby and hit the early show 3 PM. It lasts an hour and you can still do the walk around Hoan Kiem lake before the nearby night market starts.

reviews.author: Swamini W
reviews.title: Vietnamese folk music and arts experience
reviews.content: Water puppet show is one hour long. It's a very beautiful representation of old Vietnamese culture with water puppet. It's definitely experience to have.

reviews.author: Cheah
reviews.title: Than Long Water Puppet Show
reviews.content: The show was good. We were impressed with the 2 female Singers who not only sang but also played a variety of string instruments.

reviews.author: lindy g
reviews.title: Not for all kids
reviews.content: This show really does depict the way of life in country Vietnam and it’s interesting. But most of the older kids weren’t interested and a few people walked out. It’s def not a must see. Some people will enjoy it and some won’t. The music wasn’t particularly pleasing to the ear

reviews.author: Traveller376
reviews.title: Highly entertaining
reviews.content: The water puppet show was definitely one of the highlights of Hanoi. This is an art form that goes back a 1000 years and tells short stories primarily about rural life. It is easy to follow the story lines. The stories are very entertaining, the puppets themselves are beautiful and it was nice to see the puppeteers at the end of the show. If possible, get seats in the front row to avoid sitting behind tourists who are recording the show and obstructing the view.

reviews.author: Courtney
reviews.title: Okay
reviews.content: This is a traditional “must see” item when in Hanoi. The show is okay. It’s puppets but in the water. The voice audio is pre recorded and very minimal. Some of the explanations are clearly overly simplified. If you like puppets go but don’t expect any major theatrical surprises.

reviews.author: Judy D
reviews.title: So clever
reviews.content: Never seen underwater puppeteers before....well, not quite under water. The music is evocative of the Vietnamese life, along with the stories or rural living, history, nature and geography - absolutely captivating.

reviews.author: Lisa K
reviews.title: Worth a watch
reviews.content: Definitely worth watching, not a long performance but we all enjoyed it. Music was good and the fireworks

reviews.author: quavec
reviews.title: Interesting show with nice music
reviews.content: A good exposure to the Vietnamese culture and music. Interesting water puppet show even though one might not know the language. Worth a visit if there is time.

reviews.author: Hydrogen
reviews.title: A must see when in Hanoi
reviews.content: Thoroughly enjoyed myself with the water puppets. A must see when in Hanoi. It’s a true cultural immersion. Book tickets in advance to avoid disappointment. 45 mins was just nice. The wow factor erodes fairly quickly and one (especially the young ones) can get bored quickly.

reviews.author: Durga M
reviews.title: Taste of Vietnamese Culture
reviews.content: We visited the last show of the puppet. The show started with an Vietnamese song.Though language was a barrier the show was an unique show in itself. It showcased the culture of the country. You could see the effort each on was putting in and the enthusiasm shows their passion.A must watch worth VND 200000

reviews.author: Debra S
reviews.title: Great thing to do with kids
reviews.content: We’ve seen this a few time over the years but this was the first with kids. They loved it! Found it really funny loved the colour and music.

reviews.author: Vera
reviews.title: Recommended!
reviews.content: This was very nice, both for children and adults! We enjoyed it very much even without the audio guide.

reviews.author: Anjana
reviews.title: Unique
reviews.content: It was a totally unique experience and wonderful water puppet show one of its kind. Only thing is there should be an English transaction so that one could relate more. Congrats to each one for the handwork put in to put up the show

reviews.author: Philip B
reviews.title: For tourists
reviews.content: An interesting experience but not everything was working. As a tourist I suppose you should go to see the performances as it is cultural. Some of the puppeteers were really good.

reviews.author: Raymond O
reviews.title: A unique puppet show.
reviews.content: We arrived slightly early but people were already there in line. Our show sold out. This is an art form being preserved by this group. Originally performed in a lake, I believe, this is an indoor event performed in a water filled pool. The action was entertaining with the puppeteers hidden behind a curtain and waist deep in the water. It is accompanied by music played with traditional instruments which was also intriguing.My favorite scene was the dragons romping in the water and breathing fire when they surfaced. Really well done.Only deficit is that Some scenes involve a narrative which naturally is in Vietnamese but overall the scenes are easy to understand.

reviews.author: Eola
reviews.title: Nice show
reviews.content: Absolutely worth seeing this show with traditional instruments and puppets. Nice theatre with A/C. Centrally located by lake and old quarter.

reviews.author: bluehive
reviews.title: Very Overrated and Avoidable
reviews.content: We watched an evening show and after ten minutes, I wished of leaving. We opted for the middle rows with a price of 150 VND per person. The show started on time and the overall stage looked good. There were two major problems:1. The complete performance was in the local language.2. The audio translator was not included in the ticket. You pay an extra 30 VND. It was almost useless as well. The performances were planned as short stories. After watching two of them, it’s boring. Next, the gap between seat rows was so narrow that you have to breath out to allow someone to move.My experience was not so good.

reviews.author: Dave Lim
reviews.title: A Vietnam cultural art form worth preserving and watching
reviews.content: I arrived about 30 minutes before the show at 520pm on a Sunday and the tickets were almost sold out although there was not much of a queue at the counter. I bought the 200,000 VND ticket and was pleasantly surprised that I was allocated a seat right at the first row close to the middle and had a good view of the performance.English audio guides (devices with earpieces) are available for an additional charge but I think it was not necessary to get them as you would want to listen to the live singing and music from the performers instead of the device.The performance was entertaining to watch and one does not have to know Vietnamese to know the gist of the performance/story. The puppets were well-synchronized with the music and I was amazed by the special effects that the puppets could perform e.g. breathing fire and smoke. It is really a Vietnamese art form worth preserving.

reviews.author: S.A.
reviews.title: Good show but should ban videography
reviews.content: Really enjoyed my first water puppet show. I did not get the audio guide but still thought it was cute and funny. Arrived 30 mins before show and purchased tickets there. The theater is nice. Unfortunately the audience was not very well behaved. A lot of talking noise and people videoing and photographing the entire show with their phones/cameras in the air was disruptive. While I like to Instagram as much as the next guy, I suggest that they ban photography.

reviews.author: Gloworm28
reviews.title: Great show but VIP overpriced
reviews.content: Paid premium for VIP tickets for elders and children’s comfort. However double-the-entrance-fees does not translate to VIP services by Asia Travel Legend. Other guests were seated in our 2nd and 3rd row seats - spent them getting them to move. No audio guides! Enjoyment of the excellent performance put up by professsional puppeteers was hence dampened.

reviews.author: Ev_kka
reviews.title: Nice relax after long day
reviews.content: It was just fun to go there after long fay of walking and for an hour  just watch the puppets. The show is beautiful, last 50 minutes. You can buy tickets in the theatre - there are screens before the theatre, you can choose seats, pay by card. We bought it like one hour before the show and we had 4th row.Be surr to buy audio guide, you will know, what is happening.

reviews.author: John W
reviews.title: Clever but baffling.
reviews.content: Interesting but baffling, not knowing the stories. The musical accompaniment is pleasant to listen to, the puppetry obviously expert and it's an absorbing spectacle that for me at fifty minutes ran too long. I saw water puppet performances advertised too at the HCM mausoleum complex and the imperial citadel, possibly cheaper alternatives.

reviews.author: M+B
reviews.title: What a great night.
reviews.content: We choose the late show, 20:00, and we’re not disappointed one bit. While it was in Vietnamese the plot is easy to follow and the folklore and stories can easily be researched with minimal effort on google; I.e. the turtle and sword story. Would recommend for all ages! Sorry can’t post any photos but it was so great I didn’t want to miss a thing.

reviews.author: Mary C B
reviews.title: Worth while but don’t get the audio guide
reviews.content: Highlight for me at least we’re the musicians. Large variety of traditional instruments and songs.The audio guide is a waste of time though, does very little to give an additional info other than point out the obvious in a wordy way. Stick to the simple guide that comes with the tickets.To reiterate what others said buy the tickets close to the front. We were fifth row but would almost have liked to be closest. We booked that morning and they were the closest seats (off to the side) that were available.  Large bus tours had the first four rows booked out (who knows how long in advance ) Worth while visit non the less.

reviews.author: Tiffany McM
reviews.title: Fun show!
reviews.content: An enjoyable puppet show with great music. Fun for all ages. My husband and I had great seats near the middle front and bought the tickets in the morning on the same day as the show. Worth the visit!

reviews.author: Tracey P
reviews.title: Great show
reviews.content: awesome, just the right length. My 7 year old was cracking up. Dont worry about buying the tickets from tripadvisor though, did not guarantee us better seats even though we paid  for a  better class. Buy In the mornIng for an afternoon show and enjoy.

reviews.author: fritellaria
reviews.title: Great for all
reviews.content: A very sweet hour.  Tickets at the  box office are 200,000 dong for front seats.  Children loved it.  I booked a day in advance.

reviews.author: libbys249
reviews.title: A bit of fun
reviews.content: This was part of our city tour.  It was at 5.30 pm and lasted an hour. We enjoyed the music played by musicians on traditional instruments. The puppets were beautiful and cleverly moved by rods from behind.

reviews.author: Leerenae
reviews.title: It entertained the kids
reviews.content: Went with a 9yo and 12.5yo. The 9yo enjoyed it. The 12.5 was occupied. My husband and I could have given it a miss upon reflection for the price. There are some ear pieces which give you a brief overview of each section in English, however there is talking in Vietnamese for the story that Is not translated - but the story lines are pretty self explanatory. Little leg room If you are tall. Traditional puppets and music. Worth doing once in your life. Don’t get sucked into the “second level” tickets with post cards. There is no second level and all the views are Basically the same

reviews.author: Rod D
reviews.title: Great fun and real Vietnam
reviews.content: An excellent fun little activity that would is great for kids and adults alike. It gave a real feel that I was watching something traditional that has been going on in some form for 100s of years.

reviews.author: BnMadven
reviews.title: Fantastic Folk Art
reviews.content: All of our guidebooks mentioned checking out water puppet theater while in Hanoi as it's a traditional northern Vietnamese folk art.  Thang Long Water Puppet is the most well known in Hanoi and we opted to check them out during one of our free touring days.  If you plan to see a show that day, get to the box office early to secure your tickets as shows will see out.  We got to the box office around noon and got tickets for a 17:20 show that evening.  Our seats were 4 rows from the stage and to the side at 150000 VND per ticket and afforded excellent views of the stage.  The auditorium is modern with comfortable seating.  We were glad to have gotten our seats as they gave us a closer view of the stage and the puppets than had we gotten cheaper tickets for further back.  Singers who double as musicians were on balconies to the side of the stage in traditional Vietnamese clothing.  The puppeteers are hidden from view behind bamboo screens as they manipulate various characters, quite intricately.  There are no simultaneous translations of the tales and vignettes being enacted so if you can read a translation beforehand, you'll have a better sense of understanding what's going on, though you get the gist of what the scenes are.  And there is much to be said in simply enjoying what you see and hear.  Some of the scenes were quite impressive with pyrotechnics and fog effects.  Those sitting further back might have their views blocked by people up front taking pictures or videoing.  All in all, it was a wonderful way to experience such beautiful folk art.

reviews.author: Caslys
reviews.title: Entertaining
reviews.content: It was quite entertaining. About 45 to 50Mins. was an eye opener for my children. But the young one was restless after about 30 mins.

reviews.author: Robert J
reviews.title: Favorite thing we have done in all of Vietnam.
reviews.content: The show was fantastic for young and old. Beautiful and creative, to include fantastic live music. 2 days in Cat ba was great, to include a boat trip in Halong Bay. However,  the puppet show was better imho. Don't miss this show!

reviews.author: Dickson O
reviews.title: My girlfriend kept praising me for a making a good choice
reviews.content: I didn't regret at all coming to this show and my girlfriend kept praising that I made a good choice :DFirst of all. the show is good and way better than my expectations. Initially, the reason I gave this a try is because there wasn't really much to do in Hanoi anyways and there are a lot of good reviews about this place. Not at all did I expect that the show would be so good and funny. And now, this place has become one of my main recommendations to any friends visiting Hanoi.Things to note when you visit this place:1. Take the very first row if possible (Especially if you're tall). The seats in the theater are actually very close to each other and there are very little leg space except for the first row (I sat in the 2nd row and my knees were basically touching the first row seat)2. Go for the VIP seats, you will get to see much better and clearer at the front rows. We were contemplating whether to take the 6th row which is the middle tier seat but still close to the stage in order to save money but in the end we took the 2nd row. I can only say no regrets for sure.3.The show is in vietnamese language so I would recommend for you to take the english translating headphones so you can understand the story

reviews.author: traverseinfinity
reviews.title: Thought it would be better
reviews.content: Ex pat here and definitely amazing but 100% recommend. Our irenerary was screwed by the weather and this totally saved us from having a terrible experience

reviews.author: illona8
reviews.title: Great show - a must see
reviews.content: Although the show is not in English it was easy to follow.  The puppetry was great,  the music and singing very nice.

reviews.author: Janhavi B
reviews.title: Review
reviews.content: A must see puppet show for adult people of all ages. Live music and very good show. It's best to choose the seat close to the stage.

reviews.author: Serena
reviews.title: Nice way to spend an hour
reviews.content: Not seen anything like this before. A nice little theater. Very good live Vietnamese instruments and singers. I think the water puppets would be enjoyed as much by children as adults.

reviews.author: Mohan K
reviews.title: Enjoyable Experiance
reviews.content: Fantastic water puppet show for all ages. One need not know the meaning of the songs that accompanies the puppet show and still enjoy the melodious voice.  Really worth spending one's evening while in Hanoi.

reviews.author: fsuah75
reviews.title: Entertainment when travelling with children
reviews.content: If travelling with children then this is a great place to get them entertain and start off with Vietnamese culture.  We pay additional 30,000 VND for the audio and it was totally worth it

reviews.author: Kennie
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.content: They begin with an excellent standard Vietnamese music show. Performers are great. They display numerous standard, religious and folklore sorts puppet which mirrors straight to the Vietnamese religion, traditions, along with neighborhood life. It's among the greatest historic and common puppet show of Asia also the world.

reviews.author: A2W
reviews.title: Leisure
reviews.content: It would be great if there are subtitles of the show. Music and singing was melodious but don't understand a word.

reviews.author: Michaela B
reviews.title: Delightful entertainment worth a visit
reviews.content: Visited as we walked past and saw the ticket office - booked for later in the evening ( there  are lots of showings) tickets were in the middle 150,000 each and we’re good seats. Worth getting the translation so you can understand a little of the history. Beautiful craft and amazing talent  not posting lots of pictures just go and see it !!

reviews.author: Sherif R
reviews.title: Nice show , worth to see.
reviews.content: Went to the 3 pm show but booked an hour earlier  , was not that crowded no lines and  lots of seats to book .Very organized place and people there are so friendly .When the show started was almost full .The show it self is a few tales from imperial era .It’s so interesting and rich .With the help of electronic narrator u will follow the story ( I recommend u get that ).The idea of the water stage is interesting and the performance is great .The area around the theater is full of tourist activities there are lots of shops and big lake with nice scenery.I would highly recommend go there by lunch time and have a coffe on the roof one of the buildings around the lake .

reviews.author: Daisy314
reviews.title: Greet show
reviews.content: Our family love the showIf you travel with children, choose the 200, 000 vnd to get the seat near stage. It lasts for 45’ and suitable for the kids.

reviews.author: AceTravelerguy
reviews.title: Great One hour of traditional Vietnamese music and art
reviews.content: We heard this show was something that should be on our list for a first time visit to Vietnam. The puppet show tickets range from $3 USD to $8 USD depending on how close you want to sit. Honestly, this theater is not too big so any seat has good views of the stage. We chose the first rows since it was our first time. The show is full of traditional live music performed by many talented musicians and puppeteers. The scenes depict old legends and traditional folk tales complete with pyrotechnics and stage art. It's worth checking out for an hour especially if you like art, music, and if you are looking for an indoor activity with air conditioning in the hot seasons.

reviews.author: Tonie B
reviews.title: Very entertaining
reviews.content: One of the must do at least once activities in Vietnam is to visit a Water Puppet Theater. There are a number of them all over but we decided to visit this one as it was only a short walk from our hotel and across the road from Hoan Kiem lake in the old quarter of Hanoi. The show was very good and the skill levels of the puppeteers unbelievable.Well worth it and highly recommended.

reviews.author: NMKhoi
reviews.title: Good cultural show
reviews.content: Good way to spend 1 hour to watch one type of Vietnamese traditional art performance. Highly recommend for those who want to discover more about Vietnamese culture.

reviews.author: Regine
reviews.title: Water puppet Show
reviews.content: That was fun and I’d recommend this show! Very colorful and lively, great experience. Use some mosquito protection,

reviews.author: NaimahCallachand
reviews.title: Enjoyable afternoon!
reviews.content: We absolutely loved the puppet show!  150000 VD for a good seat was very reasonable. The show lasts for an hour. You can get audio guides but we didn’t think it was necessary - was just fab to hear the music and see the show. Really spectacular thing to see while in Hanoi - and great for any age!

reviews.author: Lisa
reviews.title: Must see cultural show - super value
reviews.content: Very entertaining and cute show. Definitely worth it.  Old school instruments and live singers. Don’t buy tickets online / they are half price at box office. We bought at box office front row tix an hour for the show and only paid $8.50 USD or 200,000 vnd.  The online apps were selling this ticket level for double what we paid.

reviews.author: CurlerBill
reviews.title: Wonderful show!
reviews.content: We thoroughly enjoyed the water puppets. The music was great, the puppets were amazing in detail, and it was incredible to see how the puppets were animated in the water. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Laura C
reviews.title: Great show
reviews.content: We watched a 45 minute show and had a great time. The live traditional music was really enjoyable and the puppetry was funny.The show is entirely in Vietnamese, but an automatic audio guide is available for a small charge. The information is minimal but gives you the gist of the show.Definitely worth a watch.

reviews.author: Roz B
reviews.title: Traditional musical instruments, Folk Tales and legends of the river dwelling people.
reviews.content: i was not sure what to expect,but i loved it... the show is about 60minutes and started with a musical piece played by the orchestra on traditional musical instruments. The mono string instrument (dan bau) was haunting. several legends are told through the puppetry which is performed on the stage which is a pool. the dialogue is contributed by the orchestra. Yes it is all in Vietnamese but there are translating earpieces available. Very ancient form of puppetry, it was just wonderful.. No CGI or special effects, Get your tickets early, box office opens at 8am. there are 4 or so shows during the day. i would recommend the premium seats which are still quite cheap, if you book online you pay a higher price..We were in Hanoi for a week prior to the show so knew a bit about the legends told, i think having that knowledge was a bonus because we had a feel for the place.. Highly recommended if you want to experience traditional Vietnamese culture.

reviews.author: MLG
reviews.title: Unique and Delightcul
reviews.content: A real treasure for sure.  I enjoyed every moment.  The story telling through the puppets was wonderful as was the music.  Great value.

reviews.author: MikeLimTravel
reviews.title: Interesting
reviews.content: The puppet show is one of those obligatory things people go see in Vietnam. It’s not expensive. It’s different from probably anything you’ve every seen. So why not right?The bad:My biggest knocks on the show is just that I didn’t know what the heck is going on in the storyline. The second is, the seating was set up all wrong, if you have a tall person seating in front of you, you’ll have a tough time viewing. Totally bad seating. The good:The show is creative. The people performing using the puppets as well as those on the sideline singing are very talented. Verdict: If you have an hour to kill, check it out. Try to get a front row seat. It’s a decent show.

reviews.author: CWW190763
reviews.title: A little Weird But Great Fun!
reviews.content: was a bit skeptical about this ahead of time, but actually, it was an hour well spent - good fun and appealing to all age groups.  We paid for the English audio guide which was useful as we could then appreciate that most of the scenes we were watching told the history and stories we had heard about on our Hanoi city tour.  Both the live musical accompaniment and the puppet show itself were very professionally and skillfully performed, and whilst the whole thing was perhaps a little cheesy, it was also very amusing in parts and entertaining.  Glad we went.

reviews.author: Cucachella
reviews.title: Fun for Everyone
reviews.content: I was told to see the Water Puppet Show during my Hanoi visit, I had not heard of it but investigated it and thought it looked kind of cheesy but decided to see it especially after seeing replicas of the puppets at a gift shop at The Temple of Literature. Our hotel was able to secure tickets and got a small puppet replica as a gift, it was also very close to our hotel. We got there just after starting time, they were quite punctual.  The show was very entertaining, even without the translation headsets. The live music that accompanied the show was very good and the puppetry was also quite good. There was a lot of action with dragons and fire. We were not sure what was going on but still enjoyed it. It was only after sitting in our seats, I kept hearing what sounded like a radio on low, only then did I realize that some were wearing headsets for translation. Since we arrived after starting time, I guess we were not offered this option. The show was less than an hour, so definitely worth it! All ages will enjoy as it was not geared to children alone. I would only recommend getting there ahead of time and ask for the headsets so you can follow the story, we still laughed but not sure at what. I still have no idea how they worked the puppets under water, truly an art! M

reviews.author: Star1310
reviews.title: Skillful
reviews.content: We eagerly lined up to purchase our tickets for the Water Puppet show in the evening but was disappointed to learn there were no tickets left. Luckily we got seats the next day. The show is very popular so would recommend to get in early or buy online.The show is colorful and requires one to be quite skillful to operate the puppets from behind a backdrop curtain. The story is depicted through the live Vietnamese music team and singers. Quite enjoyable even though we could not understand the language.

reviews.author: bartewillems
reviews.title: Water puppet show is a must see in Hanoi
reviews.content: Nice show with professional performers. Typical Vietnamese, easy to reserve in advance at the counter.

reviews.author: bobnrobyn
reviews.title: What fun
reviews.content: Just a short walk from our hotel (Golden Lotus , excellent) We were very much looking forward to the puppet show and not disappointed . What fun , we used the English translation head phones , the stories were easy to follow . Very funny and some times a bit naughty look at village life and traditions . Must do when in Hanoi .

reviews.author: lindseyayk
reviews.title: Well worth a visit
reviews.content: We visited here during our trip and found that the first show was 3pm on the day we turned up.  There are ticket machines at the theatre were you can see what’s available and the price.  It appeared to be booking up so we bought out tickets in advance and returned.  We paid for the cheapest as to be honest we were not sure we would like it and all the seats are good view. We both enjoyed it as it’s really simple funny entertainment lasting about 45 mins.  There are a lot of people taking photos and this is ok as long as no flash but can get a bit annoying if someone is constantly filming in front of you.

reviews.author: Kathleen P
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: This puppet show was really good.  It is very clever and well worth going to see.  My husband thought it was very good too and he couldn’t stop talking about it.  A must see in Hanoi

reviews.author: docsteffen2017
reviews.title: Don’t miss it
reviews.content: It is a must to visit this authentic theater. You need to book in advance. The show lasts for one hour and explains the whole history of Hanoi (please be prepared). The music is a bit hard to tolerate but overall a great experience!

reviews.author: AusAnnaclaire
reviews.title: Wonderful break from the madness of Hanoi
reviews.content: Right next to the Hoan Kiem Lake, I’m so pleased I found this gem while on a day out walking around central Hanoi. So much fun! I went to the 3pm show, got to the theatre at about 2.30pm and selected my ticket. Both the audience & the orchestra seem to really enjoy it! Pay the extra (only a dollar or two more) for the front rows to avoid the tour groups who got the back rows.

reviews.author: Carney G
reviews.title: Nice show
reviews.content: I enjoyed the show. It's a component of Vietnamese folklore dating to the 11th century. It's simply under one hour long and participates in scenes from rural lifestyles, like fishing or maybe the grain harvest, dances of the legend and fire-spitting dragons of the Returned Sword that has a link with the Hoan Kiem Lake simply opposite of the theater.The location was crowded with trip groups, arrived early and purchase a ticket just for the first ranking so you have the very best view. The differences in cost between the ranks are extremely tiny.

reviews.author: barbara b
reviews.title: Fun fun fn
reviews.content: Just a most delightful hour’s introduction to some Vietnamese culture. Beautifully played and sung music - puppets handled skillfully.

reviews.author: Hatfield B
reviews.title: Nice show
reviews.content: I enjoyed the show. It's a component of Vietnamese folklore dating to the 11th century. It's simply under one hour long and participates in scenes from rural lifestyles, like fishing or maybe the grain harvest, dances of the legend and fire-spitting dragons of the Returned Sword that has a link with the Hoan Kiem Lake simply opposite of the theater.The location was crowded with trip groups, arrived early and purchase a ticket just for the first ranking so you have the very best view. The differences in cost between the ranks are extremely tiny.

reviews.author: julieday12
reviews.title: Well recommend
reviews.content: What a wonderful fun show for all ages. The show went on for about 45min. Defnitely pay that little extra for front row  seats in the middle. Well worth it. The water puppet theatre is easy to get to in the centre of the old quarter by the turtle lake

reviews.author: DanDan999
reviews.title: Local show widely watched
reviews.content: So this is quite clever to watch although I didn’t understand a word the skills were good to see! It’s about 50 minutes like based in a theatre.

reviews.author: SuperMario
reviews.title: A glimpse to Vietnam's history and culture
reviews.content: I never saw something like this before. National live "orchestra" with singers on sides and unique puppet performance in the center of the stage. Worth visiting, if you are interested in history and culture.

reviews.author: Ian Skelton
reviews.title: No comprendes no problem
reviews.content: We walked into the water puppet show on a whim one night in Hanoi. Just got the standard ticket with no translation and it was awesome. Our first and only (so far) water puppet show but it was really cool! I would highly recommend for everyone all ages.

reviews.author: Vivek G
reviews.title: Unique experience
reviews.content: The show is in Vietnamese so reach a little early and take your audio guide which has translation Services . Otherwise sit and enjoy a unique show depicting the best of Local culture

reviews.author: Nickolaus Mardoll
reviews.title: Love it!!
reviews.content: Fun for old and young, simple entertainment with music that is life. purchasing tickets at the home is really simple along with a great deal less expensive than purchasing them on the web just where you will spend 3 times the actual ticket price.

reviews.author: Pedro Meconi
reviews.title: A lovely theater showing a bit of Vietnamese history
reviews.content: We weren't sure what you should expect but were keen to see such a distinctive perspective of Vietnamese culture.The legend actually being acted out was interesting, simple to watch and great fun.

reviews.author: Drucill
reviews.title: Enjoyable show
reviews.content: The art and water puppets of puppetry, go again for many centuries.And also the abilities of the puppeteer is simply fantastic to look at in this little, old theatre.Enjoy

reviews.author: Noel D
reviews.title: An amazing show
reviews.content: A highly recommended show to attend. Very captivating, slightly ruined by ignorant people photographing and videoing the performance. I would implore the theatre to more crackdown on those ruining the experience for others.

reviews.author: Melania B
reviews.title: A truly wonderful cultural experience
reviews.content: Show that is great. I actually appreciated the live musicians and a lot appreciated the puppeteers. The costumes and puppets were spectacular. And most within the water! Definitely a thing to find out when visiting Vietnam.

reviews.author: Andrew C
reviews.title: Worth a visit
reviews.content: I was quite skeptical at first. It's not really my cup of tea but some of the sketches were quite well done and funny. I would highly recommend anyone attending to get the audio so you can understand the plays

reviews.author: S123
reviews.title: Enjoyable hour
reviews.content: A lovely trip to hear some music and puppets. We didn't get the translation audio guide as we wanted to enjoy the music. If you pick up a programme it is easy to follow. The only downside is the tourists who prefer to film and take pictures rather than enjoy the performance. Due to that I would recommend trying to get the the front to avoid having to watch the performance though someone else's phone.

reviews.author: Rohit D
reviews.title: Looks amazing
reviews.content: Really nice venue, picturesque fromThe outside and staff were really friendly. I’d recommend this to families with kids

reviews.author: Malisane
reviews.title: Nice show to enjoy
reviews.content: Extremely adorable. Beautiful traditional music with a number of countryside scenes with decorative water puppets! The music was good with some different instruments being used.

reviews.author: JimboOz
reviews.title: More in the show than a mere performance
reviews.content: It wasn't until after the puppet show that we began to learn some of the legends and foundation myths of Vietnam that are portrayed in the 18 sequences of the show.  So my advice to people researching their upcoming trip to Vietnam would be to do some homework about the legends, so you can appreciate the water puppet show more.A great sense of humour is shown by the puppeteers in the movements of the puppets, especially about life in the villages -- children playing, men fishing etc.  And incredible skill.  Enjoy!

reviews.author: Abdur Rahman
reviews.title: Nice show to enjoy but it must be in different languages without extra charge.
reviews.content: Located at the Central Point of the main tourist hub. They starts with nice traditional Vietnamese music show. Performers are really nice. They show many traditional, religious and folklore type puppet which reflects directly to the Vietnamese religion, traditions and local life. It is one of the greatest ancient and traditional puppet show of the Asia as well as the world. But it would be more enjoyable if they arrange multi langual show without asking extra charge.

reviews.author: hnnhbdrzc
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.content: Had absolutely no idea what to expect from this show but booked tickets as it came highly recommended.We opted for VIP tickets with delivery to hotel as you need to have a paper copy of your ticket. We booked 24hours in advance and the tickets arrived on time to the hotel reception.The show itself was fantastic. It is all conducted in Vietnamese but audio translations are available. We chose not to get the translation and still thoroughly enjoyed it. It is very cleverly done and actually quite comical in places. The music is all live on the night too!

reviews.author: tubbies74
reviews.title: ' a truly wonderful cultural experience '
reviews.content: Water puppets and the art of puppetry, go back many centuries..And the skills of the puppeteer is just wonderful to watch in this small, old theatre..Young and old will enjoy the make believe story and marvel at how the coordination of both puppeteer and the musicians , who play old vietnamese instruments flow along so nicely..This type of show is not like any ' puppet on the beach' show that you once saw as a child in many holiday destinations in the UK..But, just as that particular part of our cultural history is still kept alive back home, this wonderful, colourful and vibrant show will give you a real understanding of an age old tradition here in Hanoi..We have seen similar shows in other parts of Vietnam..This is the best we have watch..This is something that if you are a family group, a couple, young or old, is so worth seeing. One point to add here..Hotels are , it seems, given good rates for guest to see the shows..I hate to say this, but see hotel price before buying..If you're offered 'VIP' seating, that generally means the first say, 4 0r 5 rows that are at front of show..But, trust me, the venue isnt that big so you will see it all no problem.. Usual gift shop  is available aswell after the show..Enjoy

reviews.author: Manos Mitikas
reviews.title: Unique experience!
reviews.content: It was an amazing experience and I totally recommend it to everyone who wants to see a aspect of Vietnamese heritage.

reviews.author: Mus
reviews.title: Colourful
reviews.content: The Puppet show is by the lake where all the action is. Before the show, we had a tasty apple tart and a coffee, then we went to our numbered seats. We payed more by sitting near the front which was well worth it. We would recommend it if you have children. It was very colourful and professionally performed. The performance began by an exceptional harpist - it was very atmospheric. We agree with a previous post on this site, that the show lacked a story line to bring it all together. It’s just a sequence of cameos. This was a shame as there is so much potential here.

reviews.author: AnggaBS
reviews.title: Love it!!
reviews.content: This is a must see attraction in Vietnam. The traditional puppet show with a beautiful and funny storyline. You will learn some of their cultures through music and performance. I am not a big fans of traditional show, but this one is different!!Ps: They dont have any English translation but you will understand, no worries!

reviews.author: Sils55
reviews.title: Unique and great fun !
reviews.content: We were not sure what to expect but were keen to experience such a unique view of Vietnamese culture.We were staying in Hanoi quite near the theatre and called in to buy our tickets.The legend being acted out was fascinating, easy to follow and great fun.It was a unique experience and a highlight of our thoroughly enjoyable stay in Hanoi.The ticket price was good value.

reviews.author: Hana S
reviews.title: Thang Long Water Puppet Theater
reviews.content: An interesting performance with water puppets. Short stories from the Vietnamese culture. I've never seen anything like this before.

reviews.author: Monika O
reviews.title: Magic experience!!!
reviews.content: The spectacle takes you on a journey to an ancient Asian water theater. Full of colors, lights, fantastic costumes and beautiful, old style tales with very contemporary conclusions. Also, a great lesson of Vietnamese culture and history.

reviews.author: rissa e
reviews.title: Amazing Puppet Show
reviews.content: The puppet show is very entertaining and presented Vietnam culture in a nutshell!They just need to explain more on how to avail the other languages

reviews.author: Leffy
reviews.title: go
reviews.content: worth seeing. good taste of local culture. i wouldnt bother with the audio translation machines. you will understand without.

reviews.author: Jordy T
reviews.title: Not something for me. I had a hard time to stay awake.
reviews.content: I booked tickets via my hotel and bought the Super VIP tickets. I had seats on row 2 right at the front.What was really nice was the Water Puppet Doll which was included in the ticket. The tickets were also delivered at the hotel, for me to pick-up at the concierge.For me the show was a bit boring. Maybe I’m not the right audience’s. But I do respect the hard work and effort of the musicians and the puppet masters.

reviews.author: Robert2835
reviews.title: Nice show
reviews.content: Great show.  Really liked the live musicians and very much appreciated the puppeteers.  The 50 minute show was divided into 4-6 skits, all accompanied by music and described in the program.   They ranged from funny to lots of pageantry.   The puppets and costumes were beautiful.   And all in water!  Definitely something to see when visiting Vietnam.

reviews.author: Saf Traveler
reviews.title: Do see it but you will be a little bored (Tips in the review)
reviews.content: It's unique and interesting experience because you've likely not seen a puppet show done in this way. Certainly a few cute and funny moments and honestly do go see it. You'll walk away with a story to tell but it's not going to blow your socks off.Tips:This is 1 of the best of it's kind in the world, so go to this specific show.I sat at the very back and could see and hear the stage fine. I'd say this is true from any angle and level. They also had booster seats for short kids.Go to the theatre and get tickets. Online didn't let me choose where I sat and I definitely would have chosen different seats. Just easy to get them whilst you're on a mission through the old quarter.Go in the evening when the crowd is larger. The crowd made it less boring and felt more like a show. An empty theatre would be torture.Do it before dinner, as a full stomach may contribute to you falling asleep, as did so many of the audience.they offer headphones for translating to your language. I would say not to necessary. There is hardly any speaking and mostly a visual experience. However, at a few points in the show you would have to guess what was going on. Majority of the audience did not take the translating headphones.enjoy

reviews.author: AnnieLouDean
reviews.title: Unusual
reviews.content: This is probably best if you have children or are a child!  The theatre was full and we had great seats. To be honest the music was not to our taste either, but it was interesting.

reviews.author: Pratima
reviews.title: The best water puppet show I have visited
reviews.content: This is a must see if you are in Hanoi ! Really well done! They have audio guides as well in different languages.

reviews.author: RobandJoPerth
reviews.title: Delightful
reviews.content: What a wonderful show, magical and entertaining. We had never experienced anything lime this before. We did not utilise the translation service but this did not detract from the show for us.

reviews.author: James T
reviews.title: Enchanting Water Puppet show
reviews.content: Exciting show that lasted 50 min with lots of action on the water.Could be improved if they:-1. Hv a live screen at the sides with subtitles in English at least.2. Incorporate some technology to interact puppets with digital screen instead of using old bamboo partitions.

reviews.author: Shedboy
reviews.title: Fantastic show
reviews.content: What an amazing show. Never seen anything like this before. The whole performance of the musicians and the puppeteers was first class and so entertaining.

reviews.author: Nelly D
reviews.title: Good break
reviews.content: Good break with the kids while visiting the ethnology museum...but nothing to rave about really!My 6 year old seemed entertained. Show is about 15-20min.

reviews.author: Gillian T
reviews.title: entertaining for the family
reviews.content: Had a rather enjoyable 1 hour at this place near the Old Town. However audio was in Vietnamese, so wasn't able to understand, unless you pay for a translator set. Best seats are the ones right in the front, which cost about 200 Dong, worth to visit for the whole family with kids.

reviews.author: Erichobbs007
reviews.title: Fun and unique
reviews.content: This show was fun and you will never see this in any other country.  Very skillful puppetry,  we loved the dragons. Not your usual cultural rip off show. One for all ages.

reviews.author: Agnes B
reviews.title: Is a must see but is quite boring
reviews.content: Tickets is 150000vdn, SGd9, If you have time can see their tradition water puppets show. 50mins. But a little boring

reviews.author: Hghtouy
reviews.title: Great way to spend evening
reviews.content: Performance is reasonably priced and great way of spending evening. It was much more professional than we anticipated. Although we do not speak vietnamese we really enjoyed all the singing and story telling. Grab a front seats if possible.

reviews.author: Raymondale
reviews.title: Funny
reviews.content: Watched water puppet show in HCM few years ago,last year November,when visited Hanoi,went to watch it again.although the stories quite the same,but very funny,got entertained,after the show,bought a DVD and a small puppet.the show not long,so suitable for kids,i recommended it to those who loves culture,it is one of the must-sees in Hanoi.

reviews.author: Sara
reviews.title: Last stop
reviews.content: This was the last thing we had on our itinerary. Preordered the tickets online and we had to pick it up at some hotel - not the actual location of the show. The show itself was okay, it was a nice and quick introduction to the Vietnamese culture. Glad to have seen it just one time.I didn't like that they were still letting people inside when the show has already started. We were seated by the door so that was a bummer. The first 20 minutes of the show was interrupted by all these people who needs to make friends with the clock.

reviews.author: Matt
reviews.title: Better than expected
reviews.content: What they do with the puppets is amazing! Worth a look. We arrived just 15 mins before the show started and all the cheap tickets were exhausted (100k) but we were able to book the front row for 200k each

reviews.author: Marcia V
reviews.title: Cute and cultural
reviews.content: Very cute. They have been performing this show since 1969. It is inspired by the life of the farmers on northern Vietnam who used to do these puppets shows during the floods that happened in their farms. Very nice and affordable. Many show times! 50 minutes long.

reviews.author: Nicola R
reviews.title: Charming
reviews.content: This was an absolutely lovely experience full of unexpected charm. We paid extra for front row seats and an audio translation and it was well worth it as we followed the folklore stories. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: AgnesBlanche2014
reviews.title: Very sweet show
reviews.content: Beautiful traditional music with a series of countryside scenes with colorful water puppets! A must to see while in Hanoi. Not really need for translation earphones Already saw it few years ago and can see it again

reviews.author: Ian H
reviews.title: Amazing show Front Row Seats!
reviews.content: A really great Show to see, for me the people on the sidelines doing all the voices and noises of the show is the best. I also really enjoyed the Japanese instruments being played amazing sounds!

reviews.author: Deb
reviews.title: Water Puppets
reviews.content: What an amazing experience. Absolutely loved it. Such great entertainment and skill. Highly recommed. They had earphones so the show could be

reviews.author: priya a
reviews.title: Wonderful show
reviews.content: I paid 200,000 VND for a front row seat. It was totally worth it. The theater was beautiful, the singers and the musicians were very talented and the entire show kept us intrigued. The show was very colorful, funny and extremely enjoyable.

reviews.author: Wayne H
reviews.title: Sightseeing
reviews.content: Even though it was not in English, we could understand the basic storyline and were very entertained. The music was very different to western style but haunting and melodic. A great experience.

reviews.author: Jack T
reviews.title: Beautiful show
reviews.content: We were mesmerized the entire time! The musicians are so talented, and the puppeteering is intricate and entertaining. Highly recommend; this may be our favorite part of our trip.No need for an audio guide in our opinion. The show consists of short stories with simple content that is very clear from the tone of the music and the acting.Please don’t take pictures during the show. The experience in the middle rows is pretty bad because of rude travelers with their phones.

reviews.author: Ferran
reviews.title: The nicest show in the city
reviews.content: Traditional live music with a colored puppies show over the water!Just remember to take the audio guide, because all the show is in vietnamese.

reviews.author: LozzieLoz
reviews.title: Entertaining
reviews.content: Very talented musicians, I was particularly impressed by the lady playing a string instrument I was unsure of the name of. The puppet show itself was entertaining and comedic too. Would be great for families, though we enjoyed it as a young couple for a relaxed night out after dinner too.

reviews.author: pjpennekett
reviews.title: An interesting evening
reviews.content: We paid more for tickets at the front, which was definitely worthwhile. We also paid for audio guides, but to be honest, they didn’t really add much. There was a brief explanation of what the set piece was about, but no translation of the dialogue that took place. The show was certainly an experience. The puppeteers were very skilful and the live music was excellent. There were several instruments that I’ve never seen before. The highlight for me was the scene with lots of jumping fish which was amazing.

reviews.author: Nishanth
reviews.title: Good show if you understand
reviews.content: This show is good if it's translated to other language. Probably would be helpful if you buy Audio guide here. At least should watch it once.

reviews.author: Bahareh M
reviews.title: Nice show!
reviews.content: You should see this type of show in Vietnam. Its specific for this country and history. That was combination of local music, legend and puppet water show.

reviews.author: Sharon T
reviews.title: Sharon - york uk
reviews.content: This was an amazing experience, the traditional musicians and singers were so skilful and of course the puppeteers did magical thingsI paid for the translation earpiece but took it out almost immediately because it detracted from the show- you really don’t need to speak the language to understand what is happening I agree with previous comments some of the audience had their phones out constantly taking photos but that was my only complaint. My husband and enjoyed it so much we went twice

reviews.author: 513SChang
reviews.title: Ms Sophia
reviews.content: Great show to get to know Vietnamese culture.  Music was great.  However we had to pay extra charge for renting the translator device.  With show targeting at tourists and 90% of audiences are foreigners who don’t understand Vietnamese, it is recommended that these devices be provided and included in the cost.

reviews.author: Robyn F
reviews.title: Very impressed
reviews.content: Great value for money. We didn’t get audio and managed to keep track of what was happening. Great music, puppets and stories.

reviews.author: vickizig
reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.content: Our tour company booked us for a show. It’s interesting and unique, but there are challenges with the show. Seating is not well tiered, so even though we were in about the sixth row, we could hardly see anything. If you get one big head in front of you, you’re out of luck to see anything. Also, given it’s a family event, there are many kids there, and we had one baby screaming throughout the show.   Many people say this is a must, but it’s skippable.

reviews.author: liz c
reviews.title: Interesting show
reviews.content: We were glad to see the traditional water puppet show. Show lasts for 50 minutes. Note that we watched another show during another tour and the story line is exactly the same so no need to do if you can avoid.

reviews.author: Kat
reviews.title: Put down your phones!
reviews.content: The show was amazing. So clever, and visually stunning. About 45-50 mins long and you don’t really need to know Vietnamese to get what’s going on. The only problem was the tourists who spent the whole show with their phones on and in the air. If I went again I’d sit in the front row just so I could see the show firsthand rather than through the screens of everyone else’s phones!!

reviews.author: Piyush Shah
reviews.title: Water puppet show - Boring
reviews.content: It was quite boring. It was completely in Vietnamese and it’s very cultural so foreigners find it very boring

reviews.author: Jeff L
reviews.title: Great show
reviews.content: Had a great time with the show. The performers made the puppets come to life and very unique show. Won't be able to experience this show in other places!

reviews.author: Jason S
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.content: Was a little unsure about this and not really sure what to expect however this will be a great shame if your in Hanoi and don’t go and see thisReally enjoyed this even without the English language translation

reviews.author: Robert
reviews.title: Review
reviews.content: I use to watch water puppet when i was 3 years old. It truly excellent experience. Every time i watch water puppet, it remind me about childhood. When you visit to Viet Nam, you should watch water puppet. You will not regret.

reviews.author: Eitan R
reviews.title: Sorry not my type
reviews.content: The place is very nice and the show is very big, but for 1 hour it’s to long,.And rent the transliteration because u will not understand a word.Maybe the mistake was that I came to it at noon and I was tired already.At least the have good ac

reviews.author: SydneyJai
reviews.title: Exotic show
reviews.content: Really enjoyed the showCan understand the Vietnamese culture and tradition Lucky to get a ticketNice coordination with music, sound, lightingFully packedOverall an enjoyable show8/10 imo

reviews.author: David F
reviews.title: Not very exciting...
reviews.content: I wanted to like it, because it should be a unique cultural experience, but I think something has been lost in its conversion to a tourist attraction. The puppetry is impressive but the motions were repetitive, the storyline was nonexistent, the translations were scant (even with the audio translation device) and we found ourselves drifting to sleep more than once during the show. It's too bad because the musicians and puppeteers are individually all very talented, but it didn't seem like their skills were being put to good use in this show. Maybe it's for kids? But kids would be confused by the lack of a story I think. Maybe the concept of many small skits needs some reworking. Perhaps it's an experience best enjoyed by others, but it wasn't for us.

reviews.author: Mantat
reviews.title: Average
reviews.content: The show was quite average to be honest. We watched the Sunday 3pm show and had second row seats for VND200000 a piece. The good thing was that our youngest daughter (5yo) was allowed free entrance but she didn't have her own seat, had to sit on a lap. Some parts were funny, other parts boring. It is impressive how they do it but not for an entire hour.

reviews.author: SamT
reviews.title: Very different experience to other puppets
reviews.content: Highly recommended. The puppeteers are very skilled and the puppets ares high quality.  Instead of strings they use bamboo sticks submerged in water to move the puppets.

reviews.author: Ald
reviews.title: Water Puppet Theatre
reviews.content: The show was funny with several stories being told by the puppeteers with the sound track being provided by talented musicians on the sides of the stage. It lasted about and hour. There were story headsets available in different languages but we didn’t use them so can’t say if they were good or not/worth the money.

reviews.author: Steve W
reviews.title: Interesting taste of Vietnamese culture
reviews.content: The Thang Long Puppet Theater was a fun little taste of Vietnamese culture.  The Puppet show lasted about an hour. The theater was very full, yet comfortably air conditioned. We did not get the audio translation, but the show was still enjoyable. The kids did wish they knew what was being said at times.

reviews.author: Josie W
reviews.title: Water Puppet Show
reviews.content: This puppet show is all in Vietnamese so a little hard to follow. However the music was enchanting and the puppets very colourful and entertaining. Unfortunately it was freezing due to air con too high, so a little hard to enjoy completely.

reviews.author: Ash Mehta
reviews.title: Must do when in Hanoi
reviews.content: We booked this show ticket in afternoon show.Brilliant work with team performance in water.Good story line and very colorful puppets.Music for foreign travelers bit loud as Audio guide does not translate vocal music.Very Interesting concept.Highly recommend.Buy front seats for better view, as stage and water pool is very low.Not great view for kids if tall guys are in the front row.Pay bit extra.Enjoy this memorable show.

reviews.author: Dayton Jody
reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.content: It’s very new experience. I walked around the lake and came to buy the ticket. Have a lot of choices for seat with difference price. I booked the vip seat with $10/ person. The show with music was fantastic. This was the first time I saw that. I will come back and see again.

reviews.author: Rach F
reviews.title: Engaging - nice cultural escape
reviews.content: Grabbed tickets for the 5:15pm show - all our 3 children enjoyed the 45-50min show. Great skills and engaging way to share stories of culture. Was a bonus to then enjoy a lovely stroll along the lake after the show - easy outing.

reviews.author: LeeCSydney
reviews.title: Great cultural show
reviews.content: Well worth it and great value for money. We bought online and paid extra, but we hot seats in the seco d row. Story in Vietnamese but still able to understand. Very entertaining. Great for all ages.

reviews.author: MarjofromBrissie
reviews.title: Amusing
reviews.content: They have four performance every afternoon/evening and usually sell out. Our hotel had obtained excellent tickets for us in the second row. We weren’t sure what to expect but were greatly amused by the many short “acts” performed in a large artificial pool of water by puppeteers standing thigh deep in water.

reviews.author: Travelbug291
reviews.title: Very Clever
reviews.content: Many folklore stories are played out using water puppets. It defies description how they manouvre the many puppets of multiple description, and varying sizes, in and out of position while doing it all under water! A definite theme of humour throughout. Loved the 'jumping fish'. Well worth seeing. A very Unique experience.

reviews.author: @owennon
reviews.title: Beware of Phones
reviews.content: Definitely worth seeing if you’re in town. Unique in its presentation, the music was well performed and the acts clearly loved putting on this performance. The only hindrance of our experience was that we watched most of the show through other people’s phones while they were filming. We can appreciate that people want to capture the moment, but our view of the stage was unclear due to other people as the venue is small. Had to ask three separate people to lower their phones due to obstruction. A suggestion would be that the theatre could limit the use of phones during the show. Failing this, make a point early on as the show lasts less than an hour.

reviews.author: Johan Zarn
reviews.title: A Must-try
reviews.content: The first time I've watched an amazing puppet show like that. A local friend introduced it to me and you will never regret to watch it.

reviews.author: masongal
reviews.title: Great show - where to sit?
reviews.content: This is a FUN and very CUTE touristic show and something we have never seen before.  Highly recommend!  We purchased our tickets at the walk up automated ticket counter the same day as the show (even on a Saturday night). Super easy and we’re able to get good seats in the 3rd row. I would recommend seating up front (first 10 rows) or you might miss the pretty details on the puppets.

reviews.author: tclm1971
reviews.title: Our 2 yo daughter loved it !
reviews.content: We travelled with our young daughter and were worried of the show may be too long , or too scarey- we should not have been concerned.From start to end she clapped her hands and did arm movements mimicking the puppets. This is a great family friendly  attraction. We had VIP second row tickets which I think was well worth the few extra dollars. Just a few doors down there is the most amazing egg coffee - if you go on the weekend the lake are is closed to traffic which really highlighted the experience for our family.

reviews.author: Philip H
reviews.title: Holiday trip the water theatre is a great place to visit And they have translators for you
reviews.content: Great place to visit the puppet theatre is brill and the music is tranquil  and they have translators to help you

reviews.author: happy tourism vietnam🇻🇳😊🙂
reviews.title: Watching
reviews.content: Price to watch water puppet is 150,000vnd / 1 person.This is the oldest form of water puppet in Vietnam.  And very famous in the art form of Vietnam.  Most visitors to Hanoi want to see once.  Water Puppet.

reviews.author: Kendo
reviews.title: Good for my trip
reviews.content: I had time visit here ago 10 year but i didn't know clearly parts in watter puppet show .today I visit this theatre and buy audio guide it is a great way to understand this show. I think the people should rent audio guide to enjoin this show because it is too cheaper less than 1.5 usd.

reviews.author: murrbren
reviews.title: Go to see- if never seen puppet theatre before
reviews.content: we decided to go as we have never seen puppet theatre before, so a new experience. It is easy to buy tickets yourselves without going through an agent. Just turn up and buy. The theatre has tiered seats plenty of room and comfortable. The audio didn't tell us much. Its is not very long about 50 minutes, with Vietnamese music also being played. All the actors come out at the end which we thought was great. To be recommended especially if you have never been to puppet theatre before.

reviews.author: Ryo
reviews.title: May Not Cater to Contemporary People
reviews.content: Look. It’s a puppet theatre. Not everyone’s cup of tea for entertainment, and I don’t even think modern kids will be charmed by it, seeing that engaging entertainment is literally at their fingertips. But if traditional performance art tickles your fancy, this is silly fun.Personally, I think it’s pretty ingenious to do puppetry on top of water. Vietnam’s antiquity heavily revolves on water, such as the sword turtle of Hoan Kiem and the staple farm crop: the rice. Technically speaking, the water hides the strings, so it actually feels like the dolls are dancing around by themselves.If there’s something bad to say about it, I’d say that the show felt a little lacking in meat. The episodic sketches don’t really tie in to a grand narrative, so it feels a tad bit shallow. Maybe that was why it felt so short. 50 minutes just whizzed by and everything was over by the time you start getting into it.The most exciting part was the pyrotechnics and water effects, but it was used so sparingly. I wish they could do more with them.But the staff at the theatre were super supportive of those with mobility issues. Venue is not accessible at all.Anyways, decent time filler if you’ve depleted everything else you want to do in Hanoi. Otherwise, just skip it.

reviews.author: Josh
reviews.title: Water Puppet
reviews.content: It’s a one-hour show. Enjoyed watching the musicians play their very own local instruments. I find it hypnotic.The speaking and singing parts of the show are rendered in Vietnamese. We got by thru context clues. For better appreciation, I suggest that you read the pamphlets/guide outside the theater door beforehand. Otherwise, you can pay an additional fee for audio guide.Each ticket comes with a free set of postcards.

reviews.author: Jasmine D
reviews.title: Puppet show
reviews.content: Beatiful show. A must watch when in hanoi. Ticket rates ( vietnam currency) 100000, 150000, 200000. It is in old quarter close to the lake.

reviews.author: juvinsee
reviews.title: Interesting cultural activity
reviews.content: We bought tickets not knowing what to expect. TripAdvisor reviews suggested that it wasn't a must to get an audio guide so we went without. The entire show is an hour long and conducted entirely in Vietnamese but you can also get the gist of the story through the movements, music and sounds from the show. Absolutely fascinating to see how well they control the puppets, showcasing various types of animals/people/actions!

reviews.author: Rl17349
reviews.title: Interesting
reviews.content: Show was entertaining. Very old school. It was in Vietnam language so I couldn't follow too much what was happening, but it was cool to watch and quite cheap, so worth the hour :)

reviews.author: Lara
reviews.title: Pleasant evening activity
reviews.content: We enjoyed the show. It was a nice addition to our evening despite being annoyed by people filming and taking pictures and therefore blocking the view all the time. Would recommend.

reviews.author: A.
reviews.title: True taste of Vietnamese water puppetry
reviews.content: We thoroughly enjoyed the show at the water puppet theatre. It was funny, impressive and a bit strange. Definitely worth a visit.

reviews.author: sherylb531
reviews.title: Water puppet show
reviews.content: We were given these tickets to go to the show.  Probably a show designed for children   Only lasted for an hour thank goodness. I guess it was quite cleverly done but not my cup of tea

reviews.author: Hilla B
reviews.title: A Viet Nam Traditional
reviews.content: Water puppets shows are a Viet Nam traditional that the whole family can enjoy.  The show we saw consisted of traditional musical instruments and a narrator telling story that includes dancing dragons, frog catching, a fox chasing a duck, jumping fish and a regatta.  The show is fast paced with fifteen different scenes used to tell the story.  The puppets colorful and tell a fast pace show with fifteen different scenes.  The show can be enjoyed by children and children.

reviews.author: Emily H
reviews.title: Quirky
reviews.content: The puppets were really cleverly put together and it was a good way to experience something different to any form of theatre I've seen before. The show  is quite short to get big crowds of tourists in and out quickly.

reviews.author: Bonnie
reviews.title: Good show for my tour!
reviews.content: I stay here for a hour and enjoin in watter puppet show. It is a good show with music and you sould rent a audio guide, it help you understand more this show. It is cheaper for rent. Thank for a good show. You sound come to here when visit Viet Nam

reviews.author: Yvonne S
reviews.title: Fanulous
reviews.content: What a great way to spend the evening.The singing and the musical talent of these artists was outstanding, the tale gives the audience a history of old folklore, the earphones handed out were of little benefit, but for the small price was ok.  Well worth the effort, no flash photography but you were able to take photos and videos, you are provided with a little package of postcards as a souvenir.

reviews.author: Tracy A
reviews.title: Wow
