reviews.content: We loved this. It's not very expensive and so different. We didn't get audio guides and just got the gist of what was going on, maybe we should of. It was great to see the different musical instruments used. The puppets were so colourful and it only lasts about 50 mins

reviews.author: Alejandra LAG
reviews.title: Funny traditional experience
reviews.content: It is one of the most talked about experiences. The duration of the show allows for the viewers to grasp the stories on Vietnamese folk tales, but no too long as to become overkill.  Totally worth the time and ticket price.Nice drinks in the hotel across the street too!

reviews.author: Meg
reviews.title: A good show
reviews.content: I went to this show as it had been recommended to me and I had a few hours to kill before my flight home. It was worth a visit, all of the seating is tiered so I don't think you gain much by sitting at the front. I chose not to get an audio guide and even though I didn't know what was going on it was still a good experience. The Vietnamese music is cool and the puppets are amazing, I still don't know how it works. Worth a visit if you have some time to fill.

reviews.author: mick2019
reviews.title: Entertainment at a good price
reviews.content: We went and saw the puppet show on a Sunday night. We managed to get tier 3 seats (100,000 dong) to the show starting in 20 minutes. Based on previous reviews we didn’t bother with the higher priced front row seats, however I regret that decision. My partner is shorter than me and commented after the show she could only see around half of the actual performance. If you are tall it shouldn’t be a problem but if there is any tall people in front of you it could be an issue. Yes the seats are raised the further back you go but as the puppets are in the water you need to look quiet low to the ground. The one thing that prevented me giving this review 5 stars is the fact that photos/videos are allowed to be taken during the performance. We had 2 people in front of us taking photos and recording video for the majority of the show with no regards for the people behind them. It was extremely distracting, obstructed my view and took away from the experience. The seats are decent size and the room is air conditioned so you will feel comfortable in there. If you want a cheap experience the cheaper seats should do the trick but if you want to be immersed in the show without worrying about people blocking your view then I recommend booking ahead to get front row seats.

reviews.author: Mark H
reviews.title: Interesting show
reviews.content: Was not quite sure what to expect as this was an outing from a tour guide. The theatre was quite well done, the narrative to be expected was fully in Vietnamese but was still quite enjoyable. You are allowed to bring water in only, there is a corner store right beside the theatre that is much less expensive than the theatre itself. It was an enjoyable night.

reviews.author: pslovetravel
reviews.title: Hanoi Water Puppet Show
reviews.content: A Special experience in Hanoi. First time watch for Water puppet show. They are professional and can feel their efforts on the show. But, we not understand Vietnamese language, so we really only can 'see'. there is English introduction before start very part of the show (about 10+ show in 50mins). Have some show there are dialogue in Vietnamese in between the show.. no subtitles for us.. so we can't understand. By the way, from the performer actions, it funny and interesting.This is unique show, you should experience it if you in Hanoi. Not sure is it need to book in advance, but for us, our tour guide help to book it in advance.The ticket price is VND200k.

reviews.author: Neurospicy traveller
reviews.title: Must see show!
reviews.content: Me and my partner came to see the water puppet theatre show and it was brilliant!!! We bought audio guides which just explain briefly what each section is about. There was so much joy in that room kids laughing. Parents getting involved and it was just a really pleasant positive hour! You wouldn’t have known you were in the middle of the street market chaos when you walk into this little beautiful theatre. Book tickets there at the door they are much cheaper than ‘skip the line’ because you don’t actually skip the line... you have to go in and wait for someone to print the tickets whilst everyone goes on upstairs haha!! It was brilliant tho I’d go a second time if we had time!

reviews.author: AWCostless
reviews.title: A must see
reviews.content: Absolutely loved this show, so cleverly done, even if you can’t follow the story it’s a must see when visiting Hanoi

reviews.author: Euan
reviews.title: Ok but not great
reviews.content: Can’t say I’d recommend this from an English-speaking perspective, just because you can’t really understand the songs. It’s entertaining to some degree, as they are skilled with what they do, but the novelty wore off for me after 10/15 mins. We didn’t get the audio guide which may have helped. It was also annoying that you could hear the murmuring from other people’s audio guides.

reviews.author: lindaO3337XH
reviews.title: Loved this
reviews.content: Didn't know what to expect so was pleasantly surprised.  Fascinating show, didn't know how this would work.  Very clever.  Even though there was no English spoken in the performance, it was not necessary.  Amust see for young and old.

reviews.author: 539R
reviews.title: Fun show!
reviews.content: What a fun experience. Yes it’s a touristy. But there is nothing like it. Loved the show! Even tho I don’t speak Vietnamese, I could follow the plot well enough.  I do recommend paying a few dollars extra to sit near the front.

reviews.author: doctorfoxtrot
reviews.title: Grasp of their cultural skill and talent
reviews.content: Located at the Old Quarter part of Hanoi. It is a must to watch this play to see how talented the Vietnamese people are , particularly in cultural arts.  Some may have mixed reactions once they have watched the play . But I am impressed by their collective and individual efforts.

reviews.author: Maxim_Lee
reviews.title: Great show.
reviews.content: Great interesting show. Kids enjoyed it. Forget about renting the translation device though. Even though the show is in Vietnamese, you can literally figure it out yourself. The translation device only introduces the segment in a few sentences.

reviews.author: Hamed Dad Al Balushi
reviews.title: Great Experience of Vietnamese Culture, History & Music
reviews.content: Enjoyed the show very much. The music is magical and the show tells you a lot about Vietnamese culture & history. This is a must do when in Hanoi Old Quarter. The prices are also very reasonable but I advise you to buy your tickets at least a day before because it always full.

reviews.author: True Vietnam - Gorgeous Local Experience
reviews.title: Great place for entertainment
reviews.content: Sometimes, I come there for enjoying the puppet performance. The puppet performers put their half body into the water, behind the curtains and perform according to music or story. It is very particular and must-try activity if you travel Hanoi

reviews.author: naniita
reviews.title: Great show to understand vietnamese culture
reviews.content: Great show. Dont bother getting the translation. If you understand art, you will understand the play

reviews.author: William
reviews.title: A good show with audio guide!
reviews.content: I have a good time to watch, it help me know about history of VietNam. I had buy audio guide, it is a good way to understand watter pupper show. I will visit here for next time. Thank you

reviews.author: Febe N
reviews.title: Funny
reviews.content: We didn't understand what they were saying,but the show was really funny. There are not much conversations, just a lot of music. We had a good time visiting the waterpuppetshow!

reviews.author: Mada949
reviews.title: Not sure why this is a highlight
reviews.content: It’s a cool puppet show in the water and the skills of the puppeteers is impressive, but all in all it’s somewhat boring. I don’t have kids though. I am sure kids would love it!

reviews.author: John E
reviews.title: Unique Show for Tourist
reviews.content: This is one of the "Sites to See" in Hanoi and close to Old Quarter. Interesting music and water show with puppets in the water doing dancing. One of a kind you will not see anywhere else. Recommended.

reviews.author: Michelle B
reviews.title: A lovely theater and a fantastic show
reviews.content: Buy your tickets early to get a front-row seat, it's worth it! The musicians and vocalists accompanying the show are absolutely wonderful - I would have loved to have heard more from them alone. Despite being presented entirely in Vietnamese, the puppets, music, and narratives are all so expressive that it's very easy to follow along and just to get caught up in the short stories being presented. The theatre was marvelously air-conditioned and comfortable. Attendants very thoughtfully provided booster seats for children, without audience members having to ask, which was really lovely to see. We purchased the VIP ticket with a souvenir (a packet of postcards with beautiful photos of the show) for 200K. It was well worth it for our front-row center seating and to support all of the artists involved.

reviews.author: foodie2430
reviews.title: Weird
reviews.content: It was weirdly entertaining. Quite interesting. It is all in Vietnamese. Very skillful puppeteers. **

reviews.author: GBs2cworth
reviews.title: Quite unique, definitely worth the visit
reviews.content: Water puppetry seems an odd art form, but we both really enjoyed thisThe live music and singing, traditional of course, were intriguing, engaging and unlike anything we have heard before.We bought tickets in the morning ( either the 200 or the 150 tickets would be fine ), and enjoyed an air conditioned break from the Hanoi heat.Show was about 40-50 minutes long, which felt a good length of time.

reviews.author: KiranJ1303
reviews.title: Was ok
reviews.content: Couldnt understand what was going on hence making it difficult to understand what was going on. Otherwise was pleasant to just sit down n see puppets dancing n lighting

reviews.author: Luke and Krissy S
reviews.title: Cultural experience
reviews.content: Worth going to once. Puppeteers were very clever accompanied by good traditional music and singing.Show 45minutes long, which was long enough.Something you only see once so worth a look.

reviews.author: Vinayak
reviews.title: Very well done but needs description of stories in foreign languages also
reviews.content: Overall a very good experience but it can be better with some description of the stories in other languages also for the non-Vietnamese travelers. The artists controlling the puppets from behind did a very good job and we loved the performances by the musicians.Get a ticket in advance because seats can fill up fast and the ticket window gets pretty crowded in the evening.Tip: Get a seat in the first three or four rows from the stage for good views of the small puppets!

reviews.author: DaisyM777
reviews.title: People shouldn’t be allowed to use their phones during the show
reviews.content: The show was interesting, orchestra and singers were great BUT I can’t say that I enjoyed it fully.We set in the row H - seats in the middle.Seats are very low and people were filming and taking pictures(with the flash on) all the time that it wasn’t possible to see the show properly if half of the people in front of you have their phones practically in front of your eyes.We bought audio translation which we used for like a 10 seconds because it was completely useless.

reviews.author: Travelswithaniphone
reviews.title: Must-do Hanoi experience!
reviews.content: A real Cultural highlight of Hanoi, combining the traditional form of water puppetry, folklore and the chance to see classical Vietnamese musical instruments being played. The performance is in Vietnamese, however English audio is also available. That said, we chose to listen and watch without the audio and it was still hugely enjoyable.  The show is 50 mins long and the seats are reasonably priced according to their location. There are several shows in the afternoon and evening and we walked in at mid-day, bought tickets for a 4pm performance on the same day, wandered to a restaurant nearby for a leisurely lunch then returned later for the show.  There is a modern coffee bar in the foyer, so you can arrive early and try e.g. a Vietnamese egg coffee while you wait, although do order in good time- we found it extremely busy just before the show and our order almost didn’t arrive in time.

reviews.author: Anirudh B
reviews.title: Clture of Vietnam
reviews.content: The Local Cultural is displayed adequately but still needs improvement in the feild of translation and proper conveyance of whatever is being said.

reviews.author: cunninghamgary27
reviews.title: A great fun family friendly Event
reviews.content: Had a day spare with nothing planned and a storm was predicated, made the decision to visit the theatre and was not disappointed this was a wonderful event for everyone to attend.

reviews.author: Finn
reviews.title: Vietnam's Culture
reviews.content: The puppet show is entirely conducted in Vietnamese. For a place that is visited mostly by tourists, I cannot phantom why there is no translation or whatnot to ease confusion. The instruments and music are lovely and it would definitely be better if there was some sort of explanation to the local culture!Some parts of the show are quite straightforward—we see little puppets playing and catching fishes in the river, these portray how Vietnamese grow up and make a living. Other parts are lost to cultural differences and as I said, it would be better with subtitles on a screen or something.The seats are leveraged like in a movie theatre but they are not high enough. Most of the times you will see cameras and heads so I suggest getting the front seats for a better view. You do not have to pre-order tickets, just go there early and buy the tickets for a later timing.Actually, on the way out of the theatre, I saw a sign that read "audio guides coming soon". Hopefully the visitors visiting after this really have an audio guide!

reviews.author: Fabien M
reviews.title: A must see
reviews.content: You will spend a couple of usd (4 per person) and attend to a 50 min lovely show. Please be sure to select a good front seat when buying the ticket.

reviews.author: Jupiter81
reviews.title: Beautiful !
reviews.content: It is a very beautiful show which combines tradition with modernity. Nice Vietnamese folklore elements (including the skillful movements of the puppets in the water) with modern techniches of sound and light. Everything is magical. Highly recommended, particularly if you are with children. They will never forget.

reviews.author: chris s
reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.content: Excellent water show. Really amazing performance. Cost of entry ok. Ideal for families. Located in the French Qtr. Very central.

reviews.author: bruce h
reviews.title: Painful
reviews.content: This is a case where the magic of the puppet show was lost between cultures. Positioned as a must see...however...I’d suggest must not see.

reviews.author: Gunjit B
reviews.title: Great hour of entertainment- well worth doing
reviews.content: We were a little tired and jet lagged but this is worth an hour of your time. Talented musicians playing traditional instruments and live singers provide the backdrop to the water puppet show which-  in one hour depicts many aspects of traditional Vietnamese life. My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed it... but one of the kids did fall asleep!

reviews.author: Andydjp
reviews.title: Traditional show
reviews.content: The show depicts local culture and is well presented. The theatre is comfortable and air conditioned.The show lasts just under an hour and for us was an unusual experience that we enjoyed - but probably wouldnt do again.

reviews.author: Chandrashekar Naik
reviews.title: Not bad
reviews.content: This show was just average, we didn’t like much and there was no such factors.I would say would be good for kids.This show indicates Vietnamese culture, traditions and life style.

reviews.author: Road34133281252
reviews.title: Good show
reviews.content: The show is everyhour, we get the 8.00 pm, very exciting and very good show, but since the show is in local language, we have difficulties to understand the whole stories

reviews.author: poorboydancing
reviews.title: Brilliant puppet show with traditional music.
reviews.content: I was unsure about this, but the 45 minute show was outstanding. Although it is all in vietnamese (obviously) it was easy to understand what was going on. It was funny and, at times, quite spectacular. It is well worth paying the small amount extra to get a seat in the front rows.

reviews.author: Delaram A
reviews.title: Water Puppet SHow Hanoi
reviews.content: If you are going to Hanoi dont miss this show. One of the best show to understand the history of Vietnam. We loved it.

reviews.author: Alma Malik
reviews.title: Hanoi vacation
reviews.content: A must watch  show which can give you a hint of the Vitnamese culture. I hope they start it in English too

reviews.author: pkw
reviews.title: Well worth seeing
reviews.content: We were given tickets to this performance as a gift from our tor operator so we had not done too much research on it - our expectations were exceeded and it was a very good show out on by very talented people.Well worth spending 45 minutes to see this show

reviews.author: Ahmed E
reviews.title: Nice show
reviews.content: A good show that can give you a hint of the Vitnamese culture. I wished there were more music and if the show was in English.

reviews.author: 80Georgia
reviews.title: Highlight of Hanoi
reviews.content: Wasn’t sure what to expect but thoroughly enjoyed the show. Very creative and unlike anything else I had seen I would highly recommend people to watch the show. Tickets are priced from 100VND and Even these seats are a great view as the theatre is fairly small. The show was packed so remember to buy your tickets in advance from the kiosk outside, in the morning of the show is likely early enough and it shows around 3x day.

reviews.author: Kurt R
reviews.title: A wonderful cultural entertainment
reviews.content: The Water Puppet Theater is a unique cultural experience. You can buy tickets online, or from a kiosk at the theater. I highly recommend it, skilled musicians play traditional instruments and a series of vignettes are played using amazing puppets in the pool of water, puppeteers are concealed behind a curtain. Quite amazing and entertaining. One particular annoyance, a few people seem compelled to hold up their cellphones and try and video the performance, as the seating is like that in a movie theater they block other peoples view and their screens are very disruptive. Go anyway but be prepared for some audience members that are very rude.

reviews.author: Mark H
reviews.title: Good but a bit overrated
reviews.content: After all I read before our trip to Hanoi the puppet theater was a must . I was expecting something sensational and in the end it was good but I wasn’t overwhelmed. The puppeteers operate the puppets while standing mid body in water behind a screen . The puppets are incredibly well synchronized accompanied by local musicians and traditional musical instruments . For $10 in the back cheap seats we got our moneys worth for the hour show . In the end it is puppets on water acting our scenes to music and that is what you get . Maybe understanding Vietnamese would have helped .

reviews.author: Richard L
reviews.title: Nice!
reviews.content: Something nice to do with kids. The show takes about 45 minutes and is nice to watch. My five year old daughter was enjoying it the most! She liked it a lot, even-though she could not understand the Vietnamese story teller... All in all money well spent

reviews.author: rearcardoor
reviews.title: Water Puppet Show with 3 kids
reviews.content: We didn’t really know what to expect when we booked this and it ended up being quite an interesting evening.  The music was performed live and they used really interesting traditional instruments.  The introduction was in English but the performance was all in Vietnamese, as you would expect.  It’s very quaint and something totally different from a typical puppet show.  Our kids enjoyed it.  The tickets are more expensive the closer to the front that you are sitting.  Get your hotel to book the tickets for you before you get there although when we went, there were empty seats.  It is right near Hoan Kiem lake and the night market so a great place to spend a whole evening as the show only lasts about 45 minutes.

reviews.author: TomandSian
reviews.title: Must visit.
reviews.content: Just go. It's 100k vnd for a seat and you get brilliant music, a cultural immersion and demonstration of real artistry.

reviews.author: KrAjay
reviews.title: A Vietnamese experience
reviews.content: The show depicts typical Vietnamese culture with music and water puppetry. A bit too long and got bored due to the duration. Would have been better if it was shorter.

reviews.author: Jasmine S
reviews.title: Could have been better...
reviews.content: The show itself was good, the music was live and extremely authentic however I would reccomend the following• clue yourself up on the history and myths of Vietnam or get an audio head set (otherwise you wont have a clue what is going on)• pay for the highest ticket to ensure better seating as there is only a small slope and you're more likely to get a taller person in front of you (should only cost you around 300k+ for an adult)There is also no regulations around taking photos/videos which can ruin the experience for youThey also allow people to turn up late or half way through the show, which is nice but not ideal when half the row has to get up and spoil it for everyone else behind• book in advance especially on the weekendsTake those in mind and you'll have a much better time than I did but otherwise was worth the experience if you're in Hanoi or passing through

reviews.author: DunstanOsaka
reviews.title: Amazing show
reviews.content: Don’t miss out on this if you are in Hanoi. Amazing for the whole family! The water puppets for sale in their shop are also very well made and very affordable. The kids were excited to buy one to remember the experience. A great souvenir.

reviews.author: Psunk
reviews.title: A great show but definately lacking
reviews.content: Maybe the title is a bit harsh or punishing but I think it is important to have such critical review to lower down the expectation of future-visitors especially the non-vietnamese speaking person (well you guessed it, I'm one of them). There is absolutely no english translation at all for the audience to really appreciate the story of the show. The show however is entertaining in terms of the local music. To be honest I only like the music piece that they performed in the beginning as the show opening. Overall? It is still worth it as an experience to be kept as a memories. If you are planning to go just buy the cheapest ticket (100k viet dong) and choose the seat closest to the stage. The expensive ticket which cost about 200k viet dong is definitely not worth it for such water puppet show. I really hope the theatre will improve and take a leap of faith in improving their show for an international audience.

reviews.author: navi1usa
reviews.title: Pleasant surprise
reviews.content: Thought if would be for kids - but very entertaining for adults. It isA unique experience and the puppeteers make it look easy.

reviews.author: Lily
reviews.title: More than just a puppet show!
reviews.content: Wow! We really enjoyed this! We didn’t have high expectations but really enjoyed the 50 mins! We read a number of reviews in which people were complaining the show was all in Vietnamese... not a problem at all as there are lots of short stories which are so easy to follow. It would also be odd if it was delivered in English?! The music was brilliant and really fascinating. We got our ticket on the door - 100,000 each so make sure you don’t overpay! Also we had no problem in one of the back rows!

reviews.author: Inspire370797
reviews.title: humorous
reviews.content: I wanted to get a behind-the-scenes look at how such complex movements can be made on water. Unlike Bunraku, it was humorous, cheerful and seemed to be the art of the common people born from the lives of the peasants and made me smile. I also enjoyed Vietnamese music. You don't have to understand the language to enjoy it.

reviews.author: Christine S
reviews.title: Worth visiting if you have time
reviews.content: I booked tickets through Trip Advisor/Viator before I left Australia.  Wished I hadn’t as you can buy at the theatre for half the price.  I paid AUS$48 for two first class VIP tickets.  The same tickets are only worth approximately AUS$24 if you buy at the theatre.  Just get there a bit early to buy.  The show itself was in Vietnamese so sometimes you don’t have a clue what it is about but it is definitely worth going to for the experience.

reviews.author: Kelly W
reviews.title: Amazing Show!
reviews.content: This is a great experience if you are in Hanoi! The show is about 45 minutes and is a special part of Vietnamese culture.

reviews.author: Hemanth R
reviews.title: Water Puppet show
reviews.content: Must watch show while you are either in Hanoi or in Saigon. Same shows. Need to go and book in advance for the show since it gets filled up fast due to tourist crowd.

reviews.author: JCBeISA
reviews.title: Worth seeing it
reviews.content: Very interesting show, unique in Asia. Worth seeing it when in Hanoi in the evening even without children

reviews.author: Steve W
reviews.title: Highly entertaining and totally unique.
reviews.content: The water puppets are an amazing sight and show a unique and fascinating talent set.No wonder it was a sold out show when I was there.The stage of water and the musicians in the raised platforms present traditional stories in Vietnamese, but that's no problem as the tales are visually universal.I was very surprised to see the number of puppeteers at the end of the show as it looked far easier from the seats, like all good shows do.

reviews.author: Amy T
reviews.title: Great way to spend a rainy hour
reviews.content: Like everyone else, we did not understand the story... but that didn't really matter, it's just fun to watch. The vignettes were beautiful and the music was impressive.

reviews.author: ciarancw
reviews.title: Pure joy from start to finish
reviews.content: We went to this show as a family, children 11, 10 and 8.  We all loved the simplicity of the story, beauty of the puppets, the lighthearted but expressive dancing, combined with the most exquisite musical and singing accompaniment.  This is theatre at its purest and most beautiful.  I was not looking forward to going, thinking it was going to be just a tick box exercise of something that be given a chance whilst in Vietnam.  I was very wrong and am happy to admit that it not only exceeded all expectations, it will leave a long lasting memory as a highlight of an outstanding holiday for us all.

reviews.author: Zindabaad
reviews.title: Something Different
reviews.content: Great to see a cultural show with a twist. Puppet show on water. Good experience and story telling. Show is in Vietnamese so can be a bit difficult to follow.  Good all round experience.  Kids will enjoy.

reviews.author: Leo A
reviews.title: Fun but won’t blow your mind
reviews.content: It’s different. You won’t understand a word and stories. Nicole coordinations puppets and music. It’s ok...

reviews.author: Aaron Cowan
reviews.title: No idea what was going on, but it was fun.
reviews.content: I went in to the show with very little idea of what to expect and had a pretty good time. Probably some research on my part would have helped the situation and given me more of a clue as to what was going onThe whole show was in Vietnamese, so if you don’t speak it then you’ll just have to sit back and let it wash over you. Some beautiful puppets and some stunning puppetry work in water left the kids delighted. We came with my father-in-law who is mostly wheelchair bound and the staff were amazingly helpful. There’s no specific wheelchair access so they picked him up in the chair and lugged him gently all the way. He thought it was hilarious. He did have to shuffle a little way to his seat thoughA good time out in Hanoi with the kids

reviews.author: Rutelio
reviews.title: A piece of story...
reviews.content: I was surprised by the music, the effects and the stories. The show is an evidence about how the ancient tradition could face the modern age.

reviews.author: Lislotte1983
reviews.title: Amazing show
reviews.content: Sit there and feel like a child. Good show, fun, action and good singers. See the tradition of Vietnam in 45 amazing minutes.

reviews.author: petap472018
reviews.title: Entertainment. Plus.
reviews.content: The. entire show was exceptional. Although the show was narated in Vietnamese we could follow the story. It is suitable for every age

reviews.author: Sevyn
reviews.title: Something different
reviews.content: Take this in while you’re in Hanoi.  I’ve never seen anything like it.  The live musicians and actors in full view were charming and the cute puppet show zipped right along.  For $10 we had 2nd row seats, quite a value.

reviews.author: Shanna K
reviews.title: Great show
reviews.content: It was raining in Hanoi and it was a great way to spend the evening. Waiting to see the show you can get a good latte. The band and voices of the puppets was well done. Bravo!! A must see

reviews.author: steadfast90
reviews.title: Different
reviews.content: An interesting puppet show on water accompanied by traditional music to tell the story just a shame we were unaware of the storyline! Also rudely disturbed by some rather ignorant people in the row behind who spoke the whole way through the show.

reviews.author: TK_Hung
reviews.title: Best seat - second row next to the aisle
reviews.content: The show lasts for around 50 minutes and is entertaining. Best seats would be second row next to the aisle. Don’t take the 1st row, as you may get wet!Reminder, be on time, as the show is popular and starts timely.

reviews.author: Zoé
reviews.title: Great show
reviews.content: This was such a lovely show and well worth the money.  It lasts an hour long and we could have gone again.  Great fun and the kids loved it.

reviews.author: Kark
reviews.title: Traditional Exploring
reviews.content: Love this place to explore about old tradition..They are creating a music with old instruments which will be loved by anyone...so awest

reviews.author: Amelie
reviews.title: Water muppets show with live music
reviews.content: Lovely and charming, I especially enjoyed the live musicians.It is worth it to choose a sit close to the stage. We bought our tickets directly in the theatre in the afternoon before the show, paid 200'000d per seat and sat in the first row.

reviews.author: Lena
reviews.title: Interesting
reviews.content: I was very unsure about what to expect at this show. It was somewhat boring at one stage, but still very interesting. I enjoyed seeing the puppets. Great tourist-type activity

reviews.author: rowdyfox
reviews.title: OMG I LOVED IT!
reviews.content: Go see this with your kids or your grandma! It’s amazing. Very little clue what was going on but great entertainment for all. The show was on Vietnamese but all the scenes are bite sized and you kinda get the jist. It only lasts about an hour so even younger kids could handle it. Defo worth a visit and tickets are cheap.

reviews.author: Happy
reviews.title: Traditional show
reviews.content: Every show is every story about Vietnam in the past. It could be a story about childhood or legend etc. You must pay if you want to take a photo inside.

reviews.author: TassieLoopyLou
reviews.title: Lovely suprise
reviews.content: Delightful show, very entertaining and extremely clever and funny, suitable  for all ages. 17 different short performances. Easy location to find and only 100,000dong to enter.

reviews.author: Rachel K
reviews.title: Just got to go ...
reviews.content: It’s the oddest thing I’ve ever been to but well worth it just for the experience! I have no idea what was going on but was great to see some unique instruments supported by some sensational singers!!

reviews.author: ariane123
reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.content: I honestly thought this was going to be hokey - you know the kind of thing, set up for tourists but with no soul. I was completely wrong. We had a great time here and really enjoyed the atmosphere as well as the puppetry and the music (and songs). I would heartily recommend it. Although we are a family with kids in their 20's we think it would be fine for young kids provided they can cope with the dark and a bit of what I think you'd call 'mild peril'.

reviews.author: Samantha P
reviews.title: A traditional performance in Ha Noi
reviews.content: I can totally appreciate that this would not be for everyone, but must admit that I absolutely loved the water puppet show. The show itself is only about 45 minutes in length, which (for me) was perfect. The performance follows traditional content that tells the story of the life of Vietnamese farmers and fisherman, historical legends and daily life, including children. The music is wonderful with lots of different instruments present and visible on stage. This is a great activity for families, couples, groups or a solo traveller and allows you to escape the heat for a bit in the afternoon.

reviews.author: OlafJ8531
reviews.title: Delightful and different
reviews.content: Make the time to see this show for something completely different: an old art form, brilliantly displayed by the group here and accompanied by very talented musicians. Runs for about 45 mins and costs just 200 Dong. Well worthwhile.

reviews.author: Romulus
reviews.title: Ha Noi jids attraction
reviews.content: The puppet show is indeed unique.  There are several short stories, all action takes place in a water pool.  The puppeteers are very good, there is also a live band and narators. The show is a nice mix of traditional music and stories.My kid loved the show!It is also a nice way to take break while visiting the Old Quarter.

reviews.author: RaphaelTravel
reviews.title: Locally nice!
reviews.content: Just a nice 45 mins with traditional music. The puppet, water and light makes everything very entertaining. Although one advice, select front seat

reviews.author: kat
reviews.title: Really beautiful
reviews.content: This was recommended to us by a lot of people for our trip in Hanoi and it was great. We went to the office earlier that day and were able to purchase tickets for the same afternoon. The show was really beautiful and despite not knowing what they were singing, you could still follow the stories they were telling with the puppets. I highly recommend this!!

reviews.author: NGems
reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.content: It's obviously a bit touristy but the practice of water puppetry is quite historic and we thought the show was very entertaining. The songs are all in Vietnamese, using traditional instruments but the narration was in English which helps to set the scene for each section. It was really beautiful and world's away from a Punch and Judy!

reviews.author: Mark F
reviews.title: Puppets: Hanoi way better than Ho Chi Minh City
reviews.content: I had the pleasure of seeing both within a week of each other. We were planning to see these specific  Hanoi puppets here based on Fodor’s recommendations. But travels sometimes lead you off schedule, so since we were in HoChi Minh with some time, we decided to see the show there first, in case we couldn’t in Hanoi. We enjoyed the show in HCM; first time seeing water puppets. Pros: entertaining, six live musicians. Cons: theatre too hot, music gratingly loud and unbalanced amplification. Then we saw the Hanoi show:  head and shoulders better in every way! Pros: entertaining certainly-almost the exact “plot”/“vignettes” as the HMC show. But there were more puppets, and more puppeteers (10 vs. 6). There were more musicians—nine live musicians, including three female singers, with a huge variety of instruments. The music was amplified and balanced correctly. The theatre climate was more comfortable. There were more ushers to help seat you.Bottom line: no comparison; given the choice, the only best choice is to see the Thang Long show in Hanoi! Tip: If you sit in the rear half of the rows, you will find people recording with their phones distracting. It is worth every bit to pay to sit in the front third of the seats, you won’t regret it!

reviews.author: dhrNorthYorkshire
reviews.title: Enchanting
reviews.content: Great value 200k/ticket show.  A traditional art form that was highly entertaining and impressive.It tells the folk stories of Vietnam through puppetry, that’s unusual because it is all done on water.  The show lasts about 50 minutes and the time flew by - worth visiting!

reviews.author: Stuart W
reviews.title: A lovely insight into Vietnamese culture
reviews.content: Whilst a puppet theatre might sound like it is for kids, this is definitely for a wider audience.The puppets costumes wew vivid and the story lines explored the local culture and legends with a fair degree of humour. We'll worth a visit.

reviews.author: Andy R
reviews.title: Great especially on a rainy day
reviews.content: Lovely show, with interesting puppetry and traditional music. Packed house enjoyed the 50 minute show. Even our wriggling two year old made it through the entire show, the dragons and swimming puppets kept her enthralled

reviews.author: Lauren Schillaci Hill
reviews.title: Unique Experience
reviews.content: This was a great place to experience this unique art form. The show was traditional but entertaining. It went for about 45 minutes, so a great option for young kids. Good air conditioning and good prices. We bought our tickets the day before at the box office.

reviews.author: Jason
reviews.title: Hanoi's fantastic Water Puppets
reviews.content: Well our first day in Hanoi went very well. We arrived at the airport at 5am went strait to the hotel and had a short nap before venturing out. The hotel gave us a map and directio ns toHoan Kiem Lake and off we went. Walking through the streets of Old Hanoi was a delight, followed by a walk around the lake. Then as we were looking for something to do to keep us awake to get over the jet lag we remembered reading about the water puppets. After asking a few people where the theatre was (there are several but we ended up at the Than Long Theatre) we booked tickets. When we returned just before the show we were shown to our seats and the performance began. The traditional Vietnamese music that accompanied the show was beautiful (the musicians were all excellent)  and the show started with a lovely piece of traditional music. The puppet show itself was absolutely fantastic, there were water bufffalo's, dragons breathing fire and squirting water, dancing fish, a pair of phoenix's, dragon boat races plus so much more. The show went of for nearly an hour and all four of us (2 adults and 2 children) were riveted throughout the performance. This is a must see (we will be going back to see the show again before we leave).

reviews.author: EmmaD9081
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.content: Make sure you get a middle seat as the viewing is not great on the edges. The show is very clever and a wonderful experience! Although we didn’t understand a word of the language, the puppets, lighting, music and atmosphere is fabulous!

reviews.author: GeorgieB
reviews.title: Enjoyable
reviews.content: The show was good, very enjoyable to learn more about the traditions. Well priced for an hours show which is long enough. Having an audience of worldwide nationalities comes with difficulties, I know the theatre can’t control who buys tickets, however, the lady in front of us stood up to watch the show completely ruining our view and the staff did not help. Like I say maybe this is me expecting staff to act like they would in the UK where she would have been told to sit or removed from the show. So it is not a fault but be prepared for a very relaxed theatre etiquette with mobile phones used throughout.

reviews.author: Sofia
reviews.title: Must experience!
reviews.content: This was such a fun experience! Although some of the narration and talking was in Vietnamese, you can still appreciate the skits and the art itself. The music was also really impressive. I would highly recommend this for a fun night. I do however suggest paying a little extra for the front row tickets. I got the middle tickets and my view wasn’t great. It’s worth the extra money.

reviews.author: Alex L
reviews.title: Great
reviews.content: Great experience- it didn’t matter that we didn’t speak Vietnamese as it was still highly entertaining

reviews.author: Samantha E
reviews.title: Enjoyable show
reviews.content: Despite the number of tourists, this snow felt authentic. The dialog is on Vietnamese but the stories are easy enough to follow and are very funny in parts. The band and singers are incredible. The only downside are the audience, which the theatre has little control over, filming and photographing the performance instead of appreciating it fully.We would recommend booking directly as it is much cheaper than booking through any company.

reviews.author: RSChandra
reviews.title: Incredibly skilful and enchanting show
reviews.content: To be honest, I wasn’t expecting to be that enthralled by the show but just went along to see what all the fuss was about. I was hooked from the beginning!! The theatre is beautiful and the music captivating. There was a solo on a one-stringed instrument that was hauntingly beautiful and unbelievably soulful. I can’t even begin to understand how talented you would need to be to get all those pitches and timbres from one string.There was a short introduction in English and a leaflet that had a single sentence description of each episode of the show. Other than that it was all in Vietnamese but it really didn’t matter.The puppets were beautifully, vibrant and colourful but the real art was in the puppetry. The movements were graceful, smooth and a joy to watch - they were controlled horizontally so must have been incredibly difficult to do.The whole show is under an hour and very good value for money.

reviews.author: Moso06
reviews.title: Not for us but.....
reviews.content: We thought this would be a real treat for our 8 year old. But she was unimpressed. She loves music but just never took to this show. It's lots of short stories told through song and puppetry. Some people will no doubt love it. Just not for us.

reviews.author: Courtney
reviews.title: A must see!
reviews.content: We were a bit hesitant to go because we read many reviews and knew that the show was only in Vietnamese. There were a few times that we wish we could have understood however the show was fun and enjoyable. The music and singing was beautiful, we laughed a bit and were glad we went!

reviews.author: Hafidz Alattas
reviews.title: Great show with affordable price
reviews.content: Almost 2 hour show telling folklores of the country. Incredible skills and colorful displays. Enjoyed the show and a must for first timers. Pick the one in front of the lake. Unfortunately, no english interpretation so we just tried to understand the plot from how the dolls were played. Much better to provide english translation so guests could understand more.

reviews.author: Karen B
reviews.title: Fun show.- worth time and 10$
reviews.content: Went to this when we have a little extra time.  I wasn’t sure if I wanted to spend my limited time in a show but it was barely an hour long.  Fun show and worth seeing.

reviews.author: Atle B
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: This was a new and great experience. As Norwegian we did not understand much of  the story, but the show was great. The puppets was colorful and vivid.

reviews.author: NN C
reviews.title: Great night - different but good
reviews.content: This is the second time i have visited a water puppet theatre and both nights were almost identical even though the other was in Saigon.  Definitely recommended for something a little different to do.  It may all be in Vietnamese but I don't think that matters.

reviews.author: Mario&Sandy
reviews.title: The art of water puppets
reviews.content: The title says it all. A short history of Hanoi and it’s farmers shown in the form of water puppets. I thoroughly enjoyed the music more than I did the actual water puppets. A good way to get out of the hustle and bustle and enjoy an hour or so of the Vietnamese arts.

reviews.author: Paul S
reviews.title: Hanoi Highlight
reviews.content: The puppet show was entertaining. I attended as part of a organized tour of Vietnam. Privileged to have a go at operating the water puppets and talk to the puppeteers after the show. Recommended visiting Hanoi.

reviews.author: Sujani
reviews.title: A must see show
reviews.content: Absolutely loved the puppet show. The creativity behind the whole show is truly remarkable. I loved all the different characters and how colourful & vibrant the story was. Highly recommend it!

reviews.author: Christine A
reviews.title: Unexpectedly great
reviews.content: I had no idea what to expect, but since this was a recommended activity with kids (mine are 7 and 10) we decided to check it out.  It was excellent!  We all loved it.  The music was outstanding and so interesting.  The puppets were beautiful and the stories and movements were fun.  We paid a little extra to get seats in the front row and I'd recommend that for those with small kids.  Definitely recommended for kids, but also for adults. As others have said, there's no English translation which was a little disappointing because I wanted to know more about what was being said, but it was still very enjoyable even if we couldn't understand the words.  And as others have mentioned, they start right on time, so don't be late!

reviews.author: Connor A
reviews.title: Totally worth it
reviews.content: Loved it.  It’s weird, but great! Definitely worth the $5 entrance fee.  Hanoi Old Quarter Hostel helped set us up with tickets, very convenient.

reviews.author: maartenrouge
reviews.title: Great tradition
reviews.content: Go with ur kids. Nice Vietnam style in old quarter. Book ahead. Cost theater. 50 minutes show. My kids loved it.

reviews.author: ChioNovoa
reviews.title: Holidays
reviews.content: Show was very entertaining and worth the money paid. Is a musical show with 17 different stories to present with puppets on water.

reviews.author: Claudia H
reviews.title: A unique theatre experience
reviews.content: We didn‘t really know what to expect when we bought the tickets, but the complimentary post-cards are a nice gesture. The actors and actresses really gave their best to provide a unique experience for all of us. The show was worth it and I‘d recommend paying a visit when you stay in Hanoi since it‘s also easy to reach by foot.

reviews.author: AnnaBella0112
reviews.title: Amazing place ! Must - visit
reviews.content: if you have a chance to visit Hanoi, I have some suggetion for you.1. You should visit this place 2. You should try Pho 3. You should buy some souvenir because it's very nice

reviews.author: Nik Shazanna
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.content: The water puppet theatre was amazing!! You don’t have to know Vietnamese to understand the performance. I was constantly in awe throughout the whole hour of the performance. The puppet masters, singers, music instrument players were fantastic! This is one of the must-see for anyone who visits Hanoi.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.title: Very pity no English
reviews.content: I come with my foreign friends, for me was very boring, but I know it’s very Hanoi performance, so you could visit it too. My advice to the theatre, that you should make English translation!!! Maybe with running text. Because, the performance 50% is voice and 50 % puppet

reviews.author: kingsguard
reviews.title: Good choreography but....
reviews.content: The show is about 45 minutes and they start the show on time so don't be late. The choreography was excellent. The musicians were in harmony. There is a simple leaflet about the program but it offers little information about the going-ons.

reviews.author: Mette R
reviews.title: Different and fun
reviews.content: Not a must-see, but a fun break from the street-life right in the old quarter areas. Great performers, fun show.

reviews.author: Hans H
reviews.title: Very nice show
reviews.content: Beautiful show that is very well executed. You don't understand anything that they say but you get a hint of the storyline from the puppets. People were laughing and smiling for most of the show.We took the 17.20 show and it was packed. I recommend that you buy tickets earlier in the day so you can get good seats at the front. They are only 200.000 VND a piece.

reviews.author: JoyceToTheWorld
reviews.title: Interesting and fun to watch
reviews.content: What I like: The visuals, variety of puppets used, the story (which I sort of know prior to my trip), the cleanliness of the auditorium, approachable staff (I went solo and one of them gamely took my pictures), got some freebiesWhat I don't like: It's not that I dont like but more of I wish they'd improve on something. The show is in Vietnamese and I did not understand a single thing, especially the first part. I wish they could find a way to make the foreigners understand what is happening in the show

reviews.author: Sophie T
reviews.title: Must see for culture lovers
reviews.content: If you came to Vietnam for cultural experiences, you will enjoy this - interesting and beautiful music and puppetry. The performance is like a series of scenes rather than a story, so you don't need to understand the Vietnamese narration to follow it. I think hearing the local language adds to the authenticity. It seems that some people reviewing this would prefer some more thrilling entertainment and require English explanations - perhaps they would prefer to stay at home and watch a blockbuster, it would at least be a lot cheaper than travelling to Vietnam!The shows sell out, we arrived 15 minutes before the 5.20pm and it was full, so bought tickets for the 6.30pm instead. The seats are tiered and spaced so you can get quite a good view from the cheapest seat (see photo). On the right on the way in to the theatre are leaflets which give a very simple description of each scene (e.g. Dragon dance).

reviews.author: Troy K
reviews.title: Fun and interesting
reviews.content: It's only 50 minutes long but we'll worth it. Especially with young kids. Very skillful performers both behind the puppets and performing musicians and singers. Didn't quite follow the story if there was one but I don't think that that mattered at all. Such a clever culture and a great way to create entertainment. The theatre was well air conditioned so it was a great break from the heat. Best to is to sit add close add you can. The seat rows are a on a flat incline so there's not a lot of elevation between rows.

reviews.author: Jason W
reviews.title: What a great way to tell the Hanoi Story!
reviews.content: If you’re in Hanoi, Vietnam, you must visit the Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre to catch one of the Water Puppet shows.  It was absolutely entertaining and brings us a tour of the Hanoi story including the flooding for the Rice Paddy, etc.  Note that the story is narrated in Vietnamese.  Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Travelbug0082
reviews.title: If only they have English subtitles
reviews.content: The music was nice, the stage colourful but we did not understand the story as its all sung in Vietnamese. It is surprising that this show is meant for tourists and yet there are no English subtitles provided so that we can better appreciate the performance.

reviews.author: Cassiday M
reviews.title: Authentic and Traditional
reviews.content: Tickets are 100,000 or 200,000 VND at the door. Don't spend any more! It was enjoyable, and we liked the Vietnamese music.

reviews.author: cmartins79
reviews.title: Cultural and somewhat funny
reviews.content: It's a good cultural show, as it shows how the Vietnamese used to play with the puppets during the floods. I could easily give a better rating if there was an international version of the show, there are lots of dialogues, with a room full of tourists looking at the puppets without understanding a word, and to me, nowadays, It's hard to accept - even if the actors speak Vietnamese, the spectators should have any translation device. In the end, what could have been a good cultural event, telling a bit of Vietnam story was just beautiful puppets jumping in the water with good music.

reviews.author: denimw
reviews.title: Loved it.
reviews.content: I saw this 10 years ago and didn’t think I’d bother seeing it again. My 7 year old wanted to so we went and both enjoyed it. Even though it’s in Vietnamese it was very funny.

reviews.author: NicNac
reviews.title: Water Puppets
reviews.content: Knowing this show was a complete tourist trap we ventured in anyway on recommendation by our 12 year old daughter. Well that is 45minutes of our lives we will never get back, but memorable holiday experience to say the least. Staff were lovely in seating us, it’s air conditioned and the seats are somewhat comfortable. Beware the entire show is sung in Vietnamese, so we had no idea what the story was. But basically, village dude swims around, tries to catch a fish, a cat tries to eat him and he then drowns his friend! The best part of the show was when the lead wooden water puppet accidentally smashes his head into a wall (big mistake).

reviews.author: eva
reviews.title: Traditional and Beautiful
reviews.content: Highly recommend, the story is great and the music + artistry is a great representation of Vietnamese culture!

reviews.author: Yodda Y
reviews.title: Was a fun thing to do
reviews.content: We read the reviews about this.  Some say good some say not.  It was a good way to start a night.  Air conditioning-a good cultural play with water puppets, it’s pretty funny at times and all the actors and musicians are very proud of what they do.  Liked it a lot.

reviews.author: adventuresofkaymay
reviews.title: Wondeful show
reviews.content: Came here for the 4pm show and boy it was busy, they are not wrong when they say to prebook or get in early. Tickets range from 100k dong to 200k dong depending on where you sit. The show was well done and the musicians and performers did a fantastic job.Myself and my 4yo daughter thoroughly enjoyed the show.

reviews.author: engineer2207
reviews.title: Must watch show once in a lifetime
reviews.content: Vietnamese story done in vietnamese language in puppet show. The only difference is they are doing it in water. Thats make us wonder how they did it. Felt boring till the fire 🔥 dragon comes and after that are all history. Must watch show once in a lifetime.Get 200.000 VND ticket to get better view. They will say kids ticket is free, but if you need seat for your kid, buy ticket extra for them because they will make kids sit on yr lap even there is other seats empty.

reviews.author: Donald W
reviews.title: Great show
reviews.content: Great performance!  Told great story using water puppet and most enjoyable.  Musicians were excellent and enter.

reviews.author: Nerijus P
reviews.title: It was amazing
reviews.content: Great show. Rich of history with nice bits of humour. Professional artists and musicians. Love it. My little daugter liked it so much.

reviews.author: Bourke family
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.content: We took our kids (12 and 9 years) to watch the water puppets last night and we all absolutely loved it! It didn't matter that we couldn't understand the language. The music, colours, characters, fire and smoke kept us all enthralled. The show was the perfect length for us and we can not recommend highly enough. We paid 200,000 dong each for the best seats and an extra 20,000 to be able to take photos. The leg room in the seats are a bit tight so try to get seats in the front row by booking ahead of you can. A must do in Hanoi!

reviews.author: Siobhain32
reviews.title: Great show
reviews.content: We LOVED this. Everything about it will make you smile. The music. The singing. The puppets are phenomenal- wait till you see the fire breathing dragons! Do it. You’ll love it

reviews.author: Robyn S
reviews.title: High quality cultural experience
reviews.content: I had never heard of water puppet theatre until I watched a video on our way to Vietnam on Vietnamese airlines.The traditional music and storytelling and the puppets all worked together so that the storyline’s were easy to follow, without understanding the language.We all enjoyed the performance and the humour and appreciated this entertaining art form.

reviews.author: Ervina
reviews.title: Excellent show
reviews.content: We watched 2nd show at 16:10pm.  When we arrived, a staff showed us to a counter inside and before buying tickets he showed us the seating plan and recommended the best seats.  Wonderful 1-hour experience with live musical instruments performance and singers in Vietnamese.  No screen with subtitle though.After the show ended, there was a large crowd and 2 tour groups arrived.  If traveling on your own best to come for 1st or 2nd show.It’s cheaper to buy ticket directly at the theatre than some online promo that offers delivery to hotel.  During our session, theatre was only 1/3 full.Highly recommended if you need something entertaining that does not take too much time.

reviews.author: samparsons
reviews.title: Something Quite Traditional
reviews.content: A lovely little story all done in Vietnamese with traditional songs, musical instruments and some quite impressive puppets. It was Ok for the price as you know it is going to support local artist, and only lasted an hour and a half maximum. There are various showings throughout the afternoon so do pop in if you have some time.

reviews.author: Steve W
reviews.title: Superb traditional experience.
reviews.content: This is a must see when you are in Hanoi. We thoroughly enjoyed this. It is an inexpensive treat. A show of traditional stories performed by puppets on and in water, accompanied by live music and songs. It is beautifully presented in an old theatre, and despite not totally understanding it all, it was a brilliant experience.

reviews.author: Lee C
reviews.title: Confused
reviews.content: Before I had even reached Hanoi I had heard that one of the things you have to do is see a traditional water puppet show - I can’t remember the cost of the ticket but I do remember that it wasn’t expensive so it is 100% worth doing.It lasts about 45 minutes and visually is incredible - the only downside I can note and the reason I didn’t give a score of 5 is because I didn’t have a clue what was going on - obviously as expected all the narration was in Vietnamese but as a big tourist attraction maybe give the viewer something like a programme of pamphlet which outlines the “plot” - if this was available I certainly didn’t see it and believe me I looked. However you do get a free DVD as you leave so you can relive the experience over and over again.

reviews.author: Natalia B
reviews.title: Different show
reviews.content: It is a very different show we've ever seen. You can enjoy a typical show with live music. We really enjoy it!!

reviews.author: Wishbone
reviews.title: Very sweet puppet show
reviews.content: This is a sweet show and certainly worth coming to whilst in Hanoi! I sat in the front row and was worried I might get splashed but nope! All good :)

reviews.author: Tripped_Ted
reviews.title: Nice to see
reviews.content: Absolutely lovely to see and if visiting Hanoi then it’s a must see. They really should ban people from using phones as at times it felt like a bit of a phone light show :(

reviews.author: PhilippaIsabelle
reviews.title: Great fun.
reviews.content: We attended the 16.10 showing (there are a few throughout the day, mostly late afternoon and evening) and there are three price categories depending on how close to the front you sit. We paid 200,000 Vietnamese Dong to sit on the front row and I’m glad we did. The puppets are quite small and the theatre quite large so I’d imagine it might be hard to see from the back. The show started promptly on time and was extremely entertaining. We weren’t really sure what to expect but we had quite a few laugh out loud moments. The story is told in Vietnamese (I’m assuming) however even though we didn’t understand the speech and singing, you don’t need a translator for physical comedy! There was an American family sat near us and they had two young girls, one of which was laughing and pointing and seemed to follow the whole thing so please don’t be put off with not knowing the language. It lasted about 50-60 minutes; the seats were comfy and the theatre was comfortably cool. It was neither  too loud (we were sat right by the speakers and were not blown away as it were) nor too dark in the theatre and so enjoyable. It was nice to experience ancient Vietnamese culture and I would definitely recommend for all.

reviews.author: N_i_b_a_r
reviews.title: Good show
reviews.content: They should do a bigger waiting area on the 1st floor. We were sweating badly as about nearly a hundred people waiting for the next show to start are standing around. There isnt a proper line nor anyone manning the crowd. We just waited for the current show to end and then present our ticket to go up the stairs to 2nd flr. Please note prams and other big items like balloons are not permitted to enter the theatre so you will have to place them outside the door bef entering. Comfortable seats and air conditioned.

reviews.author: RosanneNYC
reviews.title: Enjoyable!
reviews.content: We enjoyed this more than we expected to! Talented puppeteers and musicians. The “VIP” tickets were worth it in the first few rows.

reviews.author: sanil
reviews.title: Puppets
reviews.content: Interesting show but we had no idea what was happening as the narration was all in Vietnamese.the kids got bored in about 3 minutes

reviews.author: Sambrownz
reviews.title: Crazy puppets!
reviews.content: Enjoyable way to spend an hour, fun show with lots going on and would be great for kids. The story is in Vietnamese but it’s physical theatre so easy to follow. It’s a small theatre so don’t need to pay more for front 3 rows, it also has aircon!

reviews.author: Kazuko H
reviews.title: Such amazing live music and comical puppets
reviews.content: Worth a try! I didn’t expect much but turned out one of the best thing to see in Vietnam! Very entertaining considering the price of ticket for best seats were 200,000vnd which is nothing! Highly recommend it :)

reviews.author: Farah A
reviews.title: Fascinating
reviews.content: Not sure I followed it all but it was beautiful. I later realised it was about the lake. Truly a craft and art form. I loved the musicians. Quite pricy by local standards.

reviews.author: Chopper
reviews.title: Uniquely entertaining!
reviews.content: We all enjoyed the water puppets. Was something new for all of us. Was not too long not too short. Would recommend it as you will not come across it in many other places.

reviews.author: Sue P
reviews.title: Great show
reviews.content: The show is expertly done as they tell the story of life in Vietnam . It is funny in spots and the puppets are beautifully  constructed, with colour and joints that allow real looking movements.The show goes for about 50 minutes and all seats have a good view of the water stage. View was blocked sometimes with people in row in front leaning forward to record  on their phone?😳😳You are given a set of postcards with some depictions of the scenes and small explanations of what the scene is about. Might have been nice to have a bit more explanation but then sometimes you just need to enjoy something for what it is. The singers and musicians are also beautiful in their costumes and the unusual instruments they play. Well worth a visit.

reviews.author: Mustard_72
reviews.title: Gorgeous little theatre
reviews.content: Very entertaining! Thoroughly enjoyed this water puppet show. The setting and costumes are so colourful. Very affordable too

reviews.author: Jodie Shannon
reviews.title: A must see
reviews.content: Despite the entire show being in Vietnamese I absolutely loved it. The atmosphere was amazing! The show is very cleverly done and it is beautiful to watch. The live instrumental and vocals left me in awe. If you are in Hanoi this is a must.

reviews.author: Maz
reviews.title: Loved this must see cultural performance.
reviews.content: Wow, incredibly talented puppeteers, singers and musicians. You really feel emmersed into the wonderful Vietnamese culture.

reviews.author: Timo P
reviews.title: Great show with pedantic actors and musicians
reviews.content: First of all, i recommend this show for everyone. It’s visual, funny and directed very strictly. Sound is amplified and the lights are working very well. Theatre itself is comfortable with cooling fans and nice seats. The only big minus has nothing to do with the theatre but us audience. The cameras with flashes and cellphone screens holded overhead are not only blocking the view but also disturbing the overall experience. And there were lot of them and all the time. Why go to the theatre if you’re going to watch all of the scenes through a camera/cellphone screen? Can you do it in a theatre back home? I bet you don’t. So, i highly recommend to buy the first row seats and pay 50K extra to be unreachable of the screens for everyone who really wants to enjoy the act.

reviews.author: Rosco1943
reviews.title: Cute but overly long.
reviews.content: We were disappointed with this show. The music was repetitive, the singing was not melodic and the show was difficulty to follow. There were some cute parts to the show but they were too few.

reviews.author: Lady_T_99
reviews.title: Very good but hard to understand
reviews.content: Definitely an interesting experience! Can be hard to understand what's going on as it's (obviously) all in Vietnamese, but you can gather the storylines. A fun show

reviews.author: Smashcbe
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: We purchased tickets from the counter. You have to pay in VND. Amazing show by puppeteers, music band and singers. We do not understand the language but entertainment doesn’t need one. It is a riot of colors and lights all through the show. Definitely recommend. It’s just around the lake.

reviews.author: DrDavidAUS
reviews.title: Delightful water puppet theatre in Hanoi
reviews.content: This was a lovely place to visit. A theatre full of atmosphere, traditional Vietnamese music being played and the amazing water puppet show. Such skilful puppeteers and lots of fun. Kids would certainly love it. The shoe is 45 minutes in duration and there are 5 shows a day.

reviews.author: milesnmeals
reviews.title: Its overrated but a very different thing
reviews.content: Only meant for kidsFor us it became BoringNot very expensive so it was ok for an experience.Take second section seats for better view. Or arrive early to take first row

reviews.author: 27Lali
reviews.title: Good at the start but soon got boaring
reviews.content: This puppet show was interesting at the very start but soon got very boaring. The theatre itself was ok. Some people fell asleep during the show.

reviews.author: boydogbr
reviews.title: Must watch
reviews.content: Must watch in Hanoi. Amazing show put up by both the musicians, singers and puppeteers. Ask your hotel to pre-purchase the front row tickets for you. Well worth the 200,000 VND per ticket for front row seats.Note that there was a flight of stairs to the 2nd floor where the theatre was located though. No lifts were available.Toilet system was extremely messy, with the lady only collecting money from some people, while letting others walk in just like that.

reviews.author: Bhavya M
reviews.title: Nice show!
reviews.content: This was a lovely experience - great music and visuals. Comfortable seating and well organised. The show is in Vietnamese so not everyone will follow - but the visuals are entertaining by themselves. We bought tickets at the venue (a bit cheaper than the online price). Would recommend if you have some free time in Hanoi, especially for travellers with children

reviews.author: Korapin R
reviews.title: Not to be missed
reviews.content: Go there before time to buy tickets and make sure you are on the front row. Its a decent show with perfect amount of time as it ends right before it gets boring. I love the music and all performers.

reviews.author: Tina O
reviews.title: Wonderful show
reviews.content: Loved this show, so sweet. Everyone works so hard from the puppeteers to the lovely singers and talented musicians. 45 minute show that all the family would love.

reviews.author: Sam Yates
reviews.title: Surreal experience
reviews.content: Very surreal experience and while it's inspired by Vietnamese culture because there's no English translation of the singing it can come off as very comical when it probably shouldn't... The management of the puppets is very well done and the supporting musicians are talented. Give it a miss if you're tight on time, probably better if you have small children.

reviews.author: WorldTravelManTerry
reviews.title: A Goog Thing to see
reviews.content: A good thing to do to get a feel of Vietnam culture. The location is good, the place is modern, clean and the service people were greart

reviews.author: MartaMolFer
reviews.title: Traditional point of view
reviews.content: It was great to see this show! The only thing is that there is no translation into English. Anyway, you can understand the main things and to know more about their rural traditions. We recommend it!!

reviews.author: R M
reviews.title: Very Good
reviews.content: I've been before to this event but my husband wanted to go. Still a delightful time and a fun way to learn more about Vietnamese culture. Will bring out your inner child. Arrive early please; I could tell the latecomers disappointed the singers a little (and deservedly so).

reviews.author: EThompson
reviews.title: Entertaining
reviews.content: I visited the water puppet theatre with my parents when they visited Hanoi. I really enjoyed the atmosphere and the care that the actors put into creating their roles. The musicians were also very talented. They clearly put in a lot of effort! I would recommend this to people who want to see more of Vietnam’s culture when they visit Hanoi.

reviews.author: Robert P
reviews.title: Very interesting and good fun excursion
reviews.content: Great fun entertainment. Although no translations for the commentary, we managed to get the gist of the story.The puppetry skills are first-rate, and the singers and musicians excellent.We really enjoyed it - very good value.

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.title: Fabulous!
reviews.content: We sat on the 3rd row back in the middle and had an excellent view. The show was really interesting, although all the talking is in Vietnamese you still have a good idea of the story of Vietnamese history they are portraying through the use of the puppets. The music was also lovely, they are very talented. The show is about an hour in total, definitely worth the money!

reviews.author: Tonya057
reviews.title: Worth your money
reviews.content: Buy tickets directly at the theatre, no need to get the most expensive ones, theatre is very nice set and we were able to hear and see all the action from middle priced seats. This was different kind of show we have never seen before and we enjoyed it a lot. Doesn’t really need to understand Vietnamese to be able to follow the stories presented. Recommended highly!

reviews.author: Martine H
reviews.title: Don't bother
reviews.content: Good for kids. Uncomfortable seats for tall people. The show itself will not leave an indelible memory, thanks God for the musicians and vocals!

reviews.author: scowy68
reviews.title: Tradition
reviews.content: simply has to be done for a wonderful Vietnamese cultural experience that dates back to the 11th century. The puppets are also accompanied by an orchestra playing traditional Vietnamese music depicting folk tales. A very unique e experience but one well worth doing. I bought my tickets one day in advance due to the theatre being closed for a day. The evening showing I went to was full so might be an idea to purchase  tickets in advance. I did notice a souvenir shop and a cage as well.

reviews.author: FisherLiu
reviews.title: Great Experience at Thang Long Water Puppet Theater
reviews.content: Be on time. The show starts with a short introduction in English and the rest of the show is in Vietnamese. But if you read the introduction of the show before entering the theater you can understand the story line easily. The lively music, song and the puppet play is great experience. Especially if you happen to know that a team of  performers behind the scene are standing in the waist deep water to perform the puppet movements and great acts. Enjoyed it thoroughly.

reviews.author: Chandrani R
reviews.title: Unique Concept
reviews.content: Watched water puppet show for the first time and really liked the concept because unlike the normal puppet show, the strings here are not visible. A number of shows are held throughout the day and you can choose your time slot according to your convenience. The only drawback is the use of Vietnamese language for narration....!!

reviews.author: Factsnotfiction62
reviews.title: Great fun
reviews.content: We loved this! Very traditional and authentic. Tickets were about £7pp, each performance lasts for 50 minutes and there were several performances each day.Based near Hoen Kiem Lake so easy to find. Great restaurant on site too.Performance itself was fun to watch even for teenagers, would definitely recommend

reviews.author: kiyo1412
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: Despite not understanding the language the whole performance was amazing. The river really represents Hanoi. With fishes and little ducklings. A must see if you are at Hanoi, suitable for all ages and you can just go for the cheapest ticket as the view is very clear from the back too.

reviews.author: Davina T
reviews.title: Front row seats
reviews.content: We went earlier in the day to purchase tickets and were therefore able to buy seats in the centre front row.   Very sweet  performance but with the music, dim lighting, comfy seats and an extremely long flight, both my husband and I fell asleep.  Glad we went but think I probably enjoyed it more than he did!We were lad to sit after a hectic day and good room temperature.  Of course neither of us had any clue what was ping on but it didn’t really matter.

reviews.author: hem0116
reviews.title: Interesting!!
reviews.content: Apart of our city tour.  Part of Vietnam culture. Musicians were very talented with indigenous instruments The 12 puppet montages became a little repetitive; enjoyed by the children in the audience

reviews.author: AngNZ
reviews.title: Lots of fun
reviews.content: Such an awesome experience. The musicians and the puppeteers were very talented. Small audience and just the right length of time - 60 mins. Air conditioned room and they even had booster seats for the kids so they could see over the top of the adults. A must see cultural event, just get your tickets when you get there as they are dirt cheap and really easy to aquire.

reviews.author: haplo89
reviews.title: Beautiful but confusing
reviews.content: The puppet theatre is a great place to experience an old Vietnam tradition. The puppet theatre is accompanied by good musicians. It is however quite confusing to follow if you don't speak Vietnamese.

reviews.author: Sophie R
reviews.title: Must See Cultural Experience
reviews.content: This show is a must see if you are spending any time in the area. Tickets are very easy to book, just go to the box office out front where you can see the times and seats available. If you’re early there are plenty of places to eat or grab a drink close by. I am 20 and went with my mother and we both enjoyed the show thoroughly, it is like nothing we have seen before while reminding us of Punch and Judy! We really recommend this for everyone of all ages!

reviews.author: galwayboy129
reviews.title: Kids loved it
reviews.content: Highly recommended for kids and adults, we all had fun, Fun place, kids loved it, a huge effort to make the production, instruments i had never seen before.Late may 19.

reviews.author: Nick
reviews.title: Fantastic! Surpassed my expectations highly!
reviews.content: Fantastic show. If I'm honest, I didn't expect much and thought I would be bored, and how wrong was I? I loved the traditional live Vietnamese music which was performed by a small orchestra at each side of the water stage. The puppeteers have mastered their art, it was fantastic. The show is narrated in Vietnamese, but you can get the idea if you know some of the local history. If you don't know the local history, just appreciating the puppetry and music would be enough too!We sat on row C, paying 200,000d per seat and had a good view. I feel that the seats further baknwould have been just as good.  Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: marcjwm
reviews.title: Don’t miss this!
reviews.content: So fun and great presentation with live performance of traditional Vietnamese instruments. Must do and see!

reviews.author: Kathryn Jean
reviews.title: Brilliant art form, no idea what was going on!
reviews.content: Worth paying for just to see the puppets and how they puppeteer, which is an artform dating back a thousand years, and to see the beautiful live music. But this is all in Vietnamese, so I was completely lost when it came to the storyline. Don't pay extra for front or middle, we had row M and could see perfectly fine as the theatre is very small!

reviews.author: Paula L
reviews.title: Wonderful must do in Ha Noi
reviews.content: Beautiful building and all seats are amazing.  Very well produced.  Sad that they allow attendees to video tape the show which is distracting but that is only complaint about attendees not the show.

reviews.author: nataisha19
reviews.title: Interesting but...
reviews.content: Attended recently as thought it was a ‘must do’ whilst in Vietnam/Hanoi. It was interesting but the story is not overly easy to follow. The puppeteers were talented but if the theatre wasn’t air conditioned we may have left early. Not a huge cost so not worried about that but don’t stress if you don’t make it here, especially if you have limited time.

reviews.author: ggfield
reviews.title: Authentic Vietnam experience
reviews.content: This is one of the things that fall in the category of "when in Rome ". The show is well done, and you can tell the crew lives doing it. Please if you go, plan to stay the whole time. I found it so disrespectful people leaving in the middle of the show. It's their culture, respect it.

reviews.author: Hemant01
reviews.title: A Unique Show of Puppets in Water !!
