reviews.content: Nice place to visit in North Vietnam. However it is crowded after Lunar New year. You can combine with Bai Dinh Pagoda

reviews.author: fal3
reviews.title: Worthy of its heritage status!
reviews.content: Highly recommend this over the Tam Coc boat tour. The driver is pleasant but speaks little English.Went on route 3. The scenery is stunning regardless of weather. Our tour was during highly overcast skies.Extremely clean toilets. The stops and infrastructure felt a bit “Disney land” like and fake, but not to the extent that is common with most of Vietnam’s touristy areas.Lacking a decent gift shop. One exists but it contains the generic things you see everywhere.

reviews.author: MatthewTheCoder
reviews.title: Trang An river boat tour
reviews.content: We went there as part of a day tour to Ninh Binh. In my tour, 3 places were visited, Hoa Lu, Trang An and Hang Mua. Trang An is must go because of the beautiful sites. The Trang An is a boat ride along a river. The boat ride is about 2 hours and rowed by a boat operator. The boat ride goes through a number caves accessible only by the boats. Some of these caves have very low ceiling and it is best to watch out for your heads! When the boat emerges out from the caves, the scenery changes from a dark cave to a bright open sight of surrounding hills. Very magnificent sight. Trang An is an UNESCO World Heritage site.Do consider tipping the boat rower. It is a 2hr boat ride means this guy or woman will be rowing for a good 2 hours to carry a small boat with 5 pax (4 tourist + 1 rower).

reviews.author: Hanzhe
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.content: The scenery was amazing and much impressive than what I was expecting. The boat tour is a must if visiting the area. Each boat is for 4 people

reviews.author: Chandra M
reviews.title: Magical
reviews.content: Did the Trang An Ecotourism Complex Tour #1 (nine caves and three spiritual places, i.e. temples)It was one of the most exhilarating experiences I've ever had, passing through these caves sometimes with only 3 feet (1 m) between the water line and the ceiling of the caves. The longest ones take the boatman 2-3 minutes to navigate. Absolutely fantastic experience, even the intermittent rain couldn't spoil this amazing adventure

reviews.author: Leannie
reviews.title: Fantastic scenery on the boat trip
reviews.content: We came here and paid for a 3 hour boat trip. It was a bit strange at the payment counter as the staff were charging people for a full boat of 4 people even if they were only 2, we got round this by just paying at the same time as another couple but didn't even end up getting the same boat as them. We chose route 3 and joined a Dutch couple also wanting this route, it was a sat morning and there was no waiting round. The trip is a good mix of sitting in the boat but then getting out to explore temples and stretch your legs etcThe boats start off comfy but are rather uncomfortable by the end, they need some cushioning for sure. The woman who for the rowing are amazing, they work so hard rowing the boats full of people for nearly 3 hours

reviews.author: Face_The_Elements
reviews.title: Beautiful views but bring a cushion!
reviews.content: This is is a beautiful area to visit by boat. When you jump on the boat to take a ride, be sure to bring your own soft seat or a cushion. The three hour tour can hurt your butt as the boat seats are fairly hard. Our boat captain paddled hard and fast and was able to manoeuvre through the caves with ease. Stunning views and worth the trip.

reviews.author: Penabur09
reviews.title: Nice Day Trip from Hanoi
reviews.content: So so beautiful view with amazing boat trip through the tunnel caves. Naturally shaped mountains with temples on top . It is worth visiting for a day trip from Hanoi

reviews.author: Bontenee
reviews.title: Boat trip was incredible
reviews.content: Boat trip in Trang An is very interesting. The local people are very nice.Scenery is so beautiful.We had a great trip. Taking boat trip and visit Hoa Lu temple. Net time i will stay overnight there.Vietnam Escape Tours organized this trip for us and Tony Jaa - the organizer was helpful.Will visit again

reviews.author: Alu-Poo
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: There are lots of tourists here, but there is a reason: It's beautiful! And once you are in the boat it does not feel so crowded anymore. We went in the middle of the day, there were less people at that time. When coming back we saw many more people starting the tour. There are three routes to choose from and we chose the one with many caves. The landscape is amazing and going through those caves by boat was a very special experience. We also saw some birds on the way. There is a minimum of 3 people per boat, so we had to wait for another couple before our boat took off. The boat stopped 3 times at temples where we had to wait around. I did not like those stops that much, they were too long. The temples are all newly built ones. But you can gaze at the landscape while waiting. We did  also the boat rides at Tam Coc and Van Long, but Trang An was the nicest one. This review is for the boat ride and not some tour operator.

reviews.author: margaux
reviews.title: Amazing Ninh Binh
reviews.content: It was amazing trip in ninh binh. The scenery is so beautiful that no words can describe it. You will be sitting on a small boat to visit the cave and the surrounding scenery. This is one of my best experiences.

reviews.author: heinzhuynh
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: we were lucky as It stopped raining right after we arrived. Took 02 hrs rowboat round trip and enjoyed the scenery to go through 03 grottoes.the man who oared the boat for us was nice and friendly. left some tip on him at the end.recommend this complex

reviews.author: Raahul Prashanth
reviews.title: Trang an boat tour
reviews.content: This is one of the craziest boat rides I have ever done and I need to appreciate the staff for paddling us three continuous hours through the tour.Chose the route one with 9 caves and 4 temples. My very first time to go through caves In a paddleboat and this experience is insane and the place is insanely beautiful throughout. Never miss this boat ride because it's not a regular one.

reviews.author: steelo132
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: Well worth the cost and time. Enjoyed a very relaxing boat ride through amazing landscapes with many stops along the way. Very busy on weekends but we went during the week, much more peaceful. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Changlin
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: This place is seriously heaven on Earth! It is definitely not expensive, given that the boat tour takes 3 hours and the scenery is breathtaking throughout! We visited in October and took route 1. Going through the caves was great, the guide was super friendly, and the place is INSANELY beautiful. Would visit again in a heartbeat!

reviews.author: Justnitid
reviews.title: A piece of Heaven in a corner of the earth!
reviews.content: An ethereally beautiful place. Waterways forming a maze among limestone hills. At times mysterious, at times serene. As you explore the realm by boat, you will pass through limestone caves and tiny islands with pagodas. To call it, ‘Ha Long Bay on land’ is to insult both places.A visit to North Vietnam is incomplete if you don’t experience Tráng An.The place is very efficiently managed. The ticketing is hassle-free - you need to choose from 3 route options which are well described in the brochures available. The boats carry four people and if you are a couple, you will have to share the boat. Excellent detail towards safety and the boatmen and women are extremely professional. They don’t expect, or ask for, tips. The ride duration is between 2-3 hours. Don’t carry heavy backpacks and ensure you have enough drinking water.Once you are done with your ride you can head towards the parking lot where there is a nondescript restaurant. They serve an excellent bun bò and other typical dishes.

reviews.author: Rios B
reviews.title: Ha long bay on land
reviews.content: It's as ha lengthy bay on farm land, you are able to discover numerous limestone caves, mountains, but many fascinating is you are able to go to skull island. If the King Kong: Skull Island crew finished filming in Vietnam, they left and cleaned up all of the scene setting.but the government of Vietnam restored the filming location to attract tourists.you is able to observe locals use several aboriginal like costumes, you are able to shoot pictures with them. Of the journey, you sat on a boat to find out close to woman, the boatman, or the place is skilled, you are able to attempt to row the boat, though it's hard.after the trip, you are able to tip the boatman or maybe woman.you is able to go to a temple on the island, and there are several shops on the island. In case you go to Hanoi, suggest you to join Trang An grottoes tour, usually the tour provided Chua Bai Dinh.

reviews.author: Danna
reviews.title: The most effective riverboat trip near Ninh Bihn
reviews.content: This's the very best option for a bamboo skulled boat. The boat requires a maximum of four individuals.There's a decision of 3 routes, in the opinion of mine, route one is the very best option. As it is a world heritage site it's adequately managed without problems from hawkers. The individuals skulling are excellent and it is completely up for you whether you tip or perhaps not. You get away from the boat to go to different travel and also temples through 3 cavesExperience that is great, one never to be missed.

reviews.author: Voyagearoundtheworld
reviews.title: Glad we were here!
reviews.content: We had our own boat and an english speaking guide and overall there was very littel activity and no crowds at all as amid the corona crisis tourism was exceptionally low. The big crowds, long queues and the chaotic atmosphere on normal days would be a big downside here.The boat trip brings you to a beatifully shaped landscape with charming waterways and grottoes. You can visit beautiful temples and while on the boat you enjoy the special and beautiful scenery. When you are in the area this is a must see place.

reviews.author: Erl
reviews.title: Fabulous. Very best of the three boat trips I did in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: I did three of the boat tours in Ninh Binh. This was my personal favorite. Tam Coc was a little hectic with visitors with great scenery. Van Long was a bit of disappointing being much smaller with no actual caves to venture through.

reviews.author: Francois
reviews.title: One of the greatest things we did in Vietnam
reviews.content: This was among the very best moments of the journey of ours. While there are plenty of visitors here this mysterious boat ride with several of the most incredible scenery we've viewed was really a journey highlight. You will find three routes you are able to shoot, everything aproximatelly 2.5 3 hours. The routes help you move through mountains/caves and also by temples. It was unlike and magical anything we've accomplished. We did route two.Boats need to take four therefore in case you've under four in the party of yours, FYI you will not be in the boat alone.We endorse this to other.

reviews.author: Brittani
reviews.title: Amazing landscape
reviews.content: Huge mountains, clean and excellent services and beautiful river.I like how they don't utilize electric powered boats here. The drive was fresh and fantastic. The organic landscape here's amazing. The caves are very tiny and minimal compare to other caves in Vietnam and you've to be cautious when crossing on the boat.Among the best places to visit Ninh Binh Viet Nam.

reviews.author: RG02
reviews.title: A choice of routes
reviews.content: If you don’t have much time this is the boat ride to do! They offer a choice of three different routes, all at the same price, we chose Route 3. As we wanted the boat to ourselves we paid for a third ticket, as our guide had told us to do. The ticket desk said we had to buy all 4 tickets but our guide was there to insist that we only needed 3, a point worth noting! Our route took us through three caves and visits to three temples over about three hours.  The first cave is the longest, over 1000 metres, and the most interesting of the three. The weather was dull and a little gloomy but this provided a different look to the varied rock formations, I am sure it’s quite different on a sunny day. However we had a good trip despite the weather. Our lovely lady rower was polite and gave us a little information, with her limited English, as we went around. We were not hassled for a tip gave one anyway, which was obviously appreciated.

reviews.author: Sela C
reviews.title: Probably the most marvelous scenery!
reviews.content: This particular place's beauty actually took the breath of mine away! I enjoyed every second of the visit of ours. It is a total must do in case you check out the Ninh Binh area! You won't regret it!

reviews.author: Kathrine S
reviews.title: Worth a visit
reviews.content: We're five such as two teenagers and one elderly. Tickets had been readily accessible, no waiting and at exactly the same price a decision of three routes. We should route two as well as the scenes were gorgeous. The boatwomen were empathetic and friendly towards the mom of mine and lent her an additional scarf and jacket. It absolutely was a 3 hour ride therefore may be exhausting primarily in hot climates although caves and temples were fantastic. The mother of mine managed to handle with assistance getting on and away from the boat at every stop. There's secure paid parking readily available opposite the venue very practical. Almost all in everything a must do while in Ninh Binh. We skipped the temples, pagodas, churches and simply received an easy cycle ride on the boat center and again and also soaked in the picturesque landscape.

reviews.author: Stanley Akett
reviews.title: Incredible boat tour
reviews.content: Trang An is loaded with scenery that is gorgeous and caves. We did Route two and enjoyed it. I wouldnt do any more as the car seats become very uncomfortable & its extremely hot. We had been rather satisfied with the driver of ours until he demanded a tip and told us just how much he wanted, declining to draw the smaller sized notes we'd. Shame he created us complete the feedback forms BEFORE this. Regardless of the rude ending to the expertise of ours, I'd nonetheless endorse this as the location is simply stunning.

reviews.author: Augustin Mintoff
reviews.title: Should see
reviews.content: This's such a lovely location that they filmed the Kong film here. Several of the grottoes want you to duck the head of yours as the boat of yours floats throughout the opening. It is a fantastic few hours taking a boat down the river. The limestone cliffs are rich with foliage.

reviews.author: Jessalin Parish
reviews.title: Peaceful, beautiful and mesmerizing
reviews.content: Precisely what an excellent trip to the Trang An Grottoes. We spent on a two hour guided boat tour (200k dong a person).We went from a selection of the grottoes and stopped off at the pagoda.It was great as well as the Vietnamese males & females that row the boats are friendly as well as kind.A must see if in the Ninh Binh region.

reviews.author: Damian Rickertsen
reviews.title: A lovely must-see
reviews.content: Precisely what a lovely sight! You shouldn't miss it in case you're going to the dried out Halong Bay. We had taken the number one itinerary, the lengthiest route and then enjoyed it a great deal for nearly 2 hours. We visited it in the conclusion of the morning/lunchtime and also got lucky as it had been pretty quiet, with no great groups.

reviews.author: Explorer
reviews.title: Very good experience...
reviews.content: The boat ride was good. Get and cap or hat. It can be very hot on sunny day. the travel is quite long. be prepared to be on boat almost 45min to 1hrs depending to your route. But the travel journey thru the caves and bay were amazing. Must experience the view.

reviews.author: Cary L
reviews.title: overrated and not without a bit of hassle
reviews.content: We went to Tam Coc for a day out and lunch and as part of the tour we were booked onto a row boat tour that takes you through rice paddies and caves and into a small lagoon.  I have to say...not worth the time.   First, I felt a bit guilty because we had this older woman who was doing all the work to haul me and Mary up the canals and it was hard work and hot.  I kept thinking that I should be doing the rowing since I was easily twice her size and definitely outweighed her by a good 100 pounds.  She was tiny!   In any case, Mary just told me to sit still and enjoy the scenery.  It was beautiful scenery but admittedly if you've seen one rice field you've seen them all.  The mountains were incredible and this area is called Ha Long Bay Inland as they have the same kind of rock formations that you see shooting up out of the bay.   It is quite beautiful.   The caves were amazing but unfortunately it all went south when we hit the lagoon.  There you get hustled to buy trinkets and we said no and then on the way back you get hassled to give a tip.  I did just to get off the boat.  90 minutes of wasted time. Beautiful scenery but completely spoiled by the hustle and the hassle.  If you go to Tam Coc...skip this little adventure.

reviews.author: fcavalenzuelag
reviews.title: Must do
reviews.content: We took the tour where you cross 3 caves. As we were 5, we went in two separated boats. The weather that day was a little rain (showers) and fog. Best way to see it. Basically you imagine that in any moment King Kong will appear. You must give a tip to the boat owners.

reviews.author: silvergeck0
reviews.title: Serenity and fun together
reviews.content: Route 1 was incredible, we shared a boat with a German lady and an American gentleman and they suggested that we take turns at sitting in the front. This was a great idea and when our canoe captain offered us an opportunity to row with her we all gladly assisted, as it was part of the fun.  The scenery was spectacular, however it would have been nice to be given a little more information about the history of each pagoda we stopped at. Would definitely do this again and highly recommend getting there early. As we were finishing our ride 100’s of people were arriving in busses.

reviews.author: Beth
reviews.title: So much better than Tam Coc
reviews.content: We visited here instead of Tam Coc due to some awful reviews about being scammed at Tam Coc and I didnt want the stress! Instead Trang An was AMAZING!3 hour boat trip where you can help row if you would like, 3 options for our route. We opted for route 1 where you see the most. We visited 9 caves where you row through them and 3 temples where you get the chance to get out of the boat and look around and have a walk. Our guide was very sweet, reminding us to mind our heads when the caves ceiling was low. So peaceful and beautiful. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: H Mack
reviews.title: Beautiful landscape
reviews.content: We had a great time on our boat trip and shared our boat with another couple which was fine with us. The scenery was beautiful and we weren’t rushed at any of the stop off points. We went on a cloudy day and at times it was a bit drizzly, but the cooler weather made it enjoyable and also meant that it was much quieter. We arrived at about 14:30 and walked straight through, though from the length of the queue system and the number of empty boats we could tell that in the warmer weather it could get very busy.

reviews.author: coco928
reviews.title: Travel Tip- Go early!
reviews.content: This was my favorite thing we did on our trip. Our boat driver was funny and although he did not speak English well communication didn’t seem to be an issue. My suggestion is to go right when the boat tours start and be the first on the water. It was peaceful and serene until a ton of other boats killed the silence and atmosphere.

reviews.author: Aaronse503
reviews.title: Beautiful Trang An was Unforgettable!
reviews.content: I loved Trang An and going on the boat ride on a river through mountains and caves. It was beautiful and a better boat ride than Tam Coc in my opinion (more pretty too). It was one of the top 10 things to do in Vietnam in my opinion

reviews.author: Barbara W
reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.content: We chose the 9 caves boat, our lady was great, taking us through the caves, reminding us to keep head down at times, then out into landscapes which were beautiful. It was so peaceful, thoroughly enjoyed the experience.

reviews.author: walkerpayne
reviews.title: Great morning out
reviews.content: We travelled from tam coc here and so glad we did Much less touristy !When you get to the boats you have a choice of 3 routes we chose 3 I think this is the most peaceful and scenic 250000 vdg per person worth every penny Going through the caves was amazing make sure you duck !You stop at temples etc and they were fabulous Help the lady row it’s hard work for 3 hours Take water and sunscreen Every stop has little vendors and they are not pushy at all 4 in a boat is fine get the front seat !When you get back grab a taxi opposite metered and cheap Stalls you can look around tooGreat trip out would recommend

reviews.author: Felix
reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.content: Amazing place. They have 2 options for tourist, please choose what stop at the small island. We will come back!!

reviews.author: Escape Sails Halong
reviews.title: Trang An - A peaceful place to visit
reviews.content: Trang An boat trip is amazing. The local people who rowed the boat are very friendly and they smiled all the time with us.this trip is longer than Tam Coc Cave. There are more local people doing this tour as it is less famous than Tam Coc but that is great to do the boat trip in Trang an.

reviews.author: Jacky R
reviews.title: Great scenary
reviews.content: Great boat trip with interesting temples and lovely scenary. If you want to help with the rowing you can and this is great fun. I did trip 1.

reviews.author: Ben
reviews.title: Better than Tam Coc
reviews.content: Compared to Tam Coc - Tràng An has nicer/friendlier boat rowers, better scenery, it’s less busy and you get to boat for longer.

reviews.author: Alan
reviews.title: Boat tour was great
reviews.content: We took the tour with the least number of caves and more temples. This was a good choice as there's not much to see when you enter the cave in a boat, its dark and you cant get any good photos.The service is excellent, nobody asks you to buy things and nobody asks for a tip.They drop you off at the temples and you get 15min each to explore, it was quite nice.

reviews.author: swissgirl_7
reviews.title: Our highlight of our Vietnam trip
reviews.content: After much research as we were staying in Tam Coc, we decided to do the boat trip in Trang An. Tam Coc seems a bit problematic with rowers trying to scam you, although the regulations cite no foot rowing, they’re all rowing with their feet and it just seemed less stressful to opt for Trang An.So glad we did that. It seems much more organised, prices clearly indicated, and a very professional rower who knew exactly when to tell us to move, either to avoid the rocks hitting our heads or to balance the boat.We paid VD250’000 per person for a 4 person boat and with hindsight I think we should have paid for 4 and had the boat for the 2 of us as we had two burly young men in front who blocked the view a fair bit and didn’t offer to switch at any point during the 3 hours.We took tour no 1 which included 9 caves and 3 pagodas. We started around 9am and there were not very many boats on the river which made it feel more special, although part of that may be due to less tourists in general because of Coronavirus. It was a magical tour, the scenery is stunning, the caves are wonderful and the last pagoda was beautiful. I thought 3 hours might be too long, but it was a perfect length. Our rower encouraged us to row a bit too which was fun.We gave a generous tip before docking at the end as a token of our appreciation of our rowers hard job and expert rowing. I highly recommend this tour. However it might be challenging for people with reduced mobility or small children as getting on and off the boats can feel quite tricky at times.

reviews.author: chris s
reviews.title: Very crowded
reviews.content: There are so much people, you have to wait pretty much to buy the tickets and then to get on the boat. The boats go through the caves on contact. Actually the landscape would be really nice but since there is the whole river full of boats that isnt so enjoyable...They also want parking fee for bicycles. I dont get the bloggers that post 2019 that ninh binh is off the tourist route. Tam coc, trang an and the area was one of the most touristic locations i saw in vietnam. So the prices are high, friendlyness is low. Anyway its a unique landscape, but wouldnt recommend tonspend more than 1 day, its enough to do a trang An tour, go to the mua view point and the pagoda in tam coc.

reviews.author: Sarah Luong
reviews.title: Halong Bay on land is true
reviews.content: More beautiful than I thought. I bought a ticket to sit on a bamboo boat and visit along the river for 3 hours. A boat is for 4 people, but I bought 4 tickets because I wanted to be more comfortable (200k/ticket). The river flows gently, the water is clear, the caves have sparkling stalactites, many small rocky mountains like Ha Long Bay. Along the way I was able to stop and visit temples of historic heroes. The boat lady was a local who was extremely likable, friendly, and enthusiastic when she told us ancient legends. Because I went in the afternoon, I was watching the sunset and my boyfriend took good photos of me. I really enjoyed that trip.

reviews.author: luv2travelNV
reviews.title: Such fun!
reviews.content: Inexpensive and fun way to explore the waterways! A group of 4 of us did around 2-2 1/2 hours with a guide.  She did not speak a bit of English but we managed just fine.

reviews.author: Madmonk_13
reviews.title: Spectacular Karst Formations Up a Lazy River
reviews.content: After buying your entrance tickets, you get in a small boat rowed by a hard-working Vietnamese lady and glide down the river surrounded by spectacular karst formations that tower on either side.  You can choose a cruise of 2 1/2 hours or 3 hours.  2 1/2 seemed fine.  You glide in and out, through some caves, around islands.  There are birds and blooming lotuses and the sound of the oars in the river.  It is extremely calm and almost mesmerizing!  The landscape is a bit like Halong Bay but much more low key because there are fewer people.  If you get a chance to do this, do it.

reviews.author: Emilie G
reviews.title: A beautiful must-see
reviews.content: What a beautiful site! You should not miss it if you are visiting the dry Halong Bay. We took the number 1 itinerary, the longest route and enjoyed it a lot during almost two hours. We visited it at the end of the morning/lunch time and got lucky as it was fairly quiet, without big groups.

reviews.author: lovisaduvander
reviews.title: Wow spectacular
reviews.content: Wow this place definitely was one of my favourites! So when you get there you buy the tickets just in front before you go in, unfortunately you have to share boat so it’s 3-4 people in it but if you want to spend extra money you can buy the boat but then you have to buy 4 tickets.. but we had an awesome experience! You pay the same to see 4 caves as you do to see 9 caves! Of course we saw 9 and it was amazing! There is so many different once, some we didn’t even see cause it was hidden caves and some that you had to lay down in the boat cause they where so small! Amazing experience and definitely worth doing! Top activity in Ninh Binh!

reviews.author: Cameron Y
reviews.title: Beautiful. Best of the 3 boat rides I did in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: I did 3 of the boat tours in Ninh Binh. This was my favourite. Tam Coc was a bit busy with tourists with good scenery.  Van Long was a little disappointing being a lot shorter without real caves to venture through. Trang An was quieter with our boat being alone for most of the trip.  It was rare that we saw another boat.  There was no one trying to sell us anything.  No hard sell from other boats like Tam Coc.I did the route 1 option where we went thru many caverns and got to stop in old temples nestled away in the mountains. The whole trip took 3 hrs and I marveled at our rower's fitness.  She was a lovely lady and very friendly.  Thank you kind lady for being the perfect host.Please do not be stingy with the tip.  My companions tipped her 25000 VND(just over USD1) for the 2 of them.  I tipped her VND100,000 which was probably a bit high but I feel good service should be rewarded.

reviews.author: Treepalm
reviews.title: One of the Most Beautiful Places on This Planet
reviews.content: Recently did this tour with our family over Christmas. We seemed to have gotten lucky with the weather as was actually sunny for a good part of the boat ride. Scenery just SPECTACULAR. This is a MUST SEE imo for anyone who loves experiencing the beauty of nature. My only "regret" is we arrived at the place just before 10am after having hiked up Mua Cave beforehand (should have done opposite). It was a Sunday and during busy holiday season and although there was no actual line up to get onto a boat, there were already at that time a significant number of boats all around us (with all of us having to wear orange life jackets) which kind of took away from a bit of the pristine and natural feeling of this area and experience. I found this place so beautiful in fact that if I was to return again I would do it once in the early morning and then again before sunset!

reviews.author: JoAnne R
reviews.title: Definitely worth a visit!
reviews.content: Peaceful boat cruise on small sampans through a number of caves. Gorgeous setting and professional service. UNESCO site since 2014. Definitely worth a visit!

reviews.author: schvanc
reviews.title: Low season
reviews.content: Beautiful sceneries and no people! We were here at 9:00 am and we were almost alone in the "port". We took route n. 3 and were completely satisfied. The first 1km long cave was spectacular. Than few sanctuaries with surrounding beautiful gardens. The best benefit was the absence of crowds!

reviews.author: dekalbill
reviews.title: Fabulous landscape views
reviews.content: Excellent experience calmly enjoying the stunning natural views of mountains, caves and gentle water.  Yes, there are crowds of tourists, but you'll find plenty of boats and efficient service.  Boat paddlers are experienced.  Even in cloudy weather, the experience is amazing.

reviews.author: Lyly
reviews.title: Stunning landscape
reviews.content: Huge mountains, clean and beautifull river and good services. I love the way they do not use electric boats here.  The trip was fanstatic and fresh. The natural landscape here is incredible. The caves are so small and low compare to other caves in Vietnam and you have to be carefull when crossing on boat.One of the best place to go in Ninh Binh Viet Nam

reviews.author: theresabryson65
reviews.title: Boat trip
reviews.content: Excellent and efficient service. The views were lovely and significant time to stop and look at the scenery.

reviews.author: Vanessa
reviews.title: Highly recommend the boat tour!
reviews.content: I would highly recommend visiting Trang An and supporting someone who rows a boat. We took route 3 and it was spectacular!We were lucky enough to be traveling with someone who speaks Vietnamese, so we were able to speak to our pilot, Pham Thi Det. - she had been rowing for 11 years already and isn't sure when she'll stop- there are 2 500 boats at Trang An, each with one rower. The rowers take one trip and then wait until their turn comes again. Durning the busy season, this is 2-3 days while during the low season it could be 5-6 days. This is incredible to imagine because they only get paid when they paddle. - she told us about before the park was developed for tourists. Before some of the caves were widened and boats that only held two people could fit. When they used to light the caves with candles.- she also pointed out the areas where they filmed parts of King KongI would highly recommend this tour and trying your best to speak to the person rowing the boat, they can be friendly, knowledgable and generous people.

reviews.author: KianKhiang
reviews.title: One of the best Vietnam Attraction
reviews.content: Amazing scenery and fully recommended. It took us 2hrs to complete the journey. Safety jacket was provided and compulsory to wear.

reviews.author: Richard Kay
reviews.title: A highlight of Vietnam
reviews.content: The trip here was fantastic. We went on new years day, it was pretty quiet at 11am and often we couldn't see any other boats on our trip. The scenery is stunning, the guide was lovely. Absolutely worth going here (especially ahead of Hang Mua which was pretty unenjoyable). I recommend over the boat ride at Tam Coc. Everything is professional here, no scams and very relaxing!

reviews.author: James K
reviews.title: The best river boat trip near Ninh Bihn
reviews.content: This is the best choice for a bamboo skulled boat. The boat takes a maximum of 4 people There is a choice of three routes, in my opinion route 1 is the best choice. As it's a world heritage site it is properly controlled with no hassles from hawkers. The people skulling are great and it's entirely up to you whether you tip or not. You get off the boat to visit various temples and travel through three caves Great experience,one not to be missed.

reviews.author: sandra s
reviews.title: Trang anh route 3
reviews.content: We chose route 3 with the longest cave cos we didn’t like visiting Temples. There were 3 of us so we had to buy 4 tickets at 200,000 each. The lady rower was very hardworking and steady. She could only say ‘hello sit down’ or ‘hello head down’ (sometimes she’s confused and uses sit down for head down), boat here, boat there (pickup later). I enjoyed trang anh more than Halong. With the row boats it’s really serene and more well preserved. The longest cave was fantastic. Our rower was excellent. We wondered how she could see when we were blocking her view sitting in front of her. Even with Low tide, we had to bend down quite Low not to get bumped. Luckily it wasn’t crowded when we went that day. Just before reaching the port again, she docked nearby and gave us a feedback form. She gestured for us to put all 5 for ‘excellent’ when at first we put 3 for her communication. And she asked not to write anything in the suggestion box. We obliged her willingly. We joked that she would just leave us at that embankment if we didn’t oblige her 😆. During disembarking she didn’t ask for a tip, but we gave her. When we looked back to say goodbye, she was smiling. Hardworking lady must be rushing to do the next run. I did see the couple in another boat get asked for a tip.

reviews.author: Rajalakshmy M
reviews.title: Surreal experience in December
reviews.content: Visited Trang An on December 21st. The weather was a bit foggy due to rains the previous day. reached around 7:30 Am as we were staying very close by. The crowds were yet to arrive. Parked our motorbike quickly, bought tickets and were soon at the boat place. Took route one that has 9 caves and few beautiful temples. The boat driver was very good. The place is very beautiful and is very well maintained. Recommendation is to reach before the crowd comes to have a very peaceful experience. The whole route takes 3 hours But definitely worth the time

reviews.author: hweeying
reviews.title: Awesome scene
reviews.content: Very beautiful place. We love this more than Halong Bay. Our tour route is number 3. The boat ride 90 min. I think it is enough for us. Visited on Dec 2019.

reviews.author: Nathan-and-Joe
reviews.title: One of the best things we did in Vietnam
reviews.content: This was one of the best moments of our trip. While there are a lot of tourists here this magical boat ride through some of the most beautiful scenery we have seen was a trip highlight. There are 3 routes you can take, all about 2.5-3 hours. The routes take you through mountains / caves and by temples. It was magical and unlike anything we have done. We did route 2. Boats must take 4 so if you have fewer than 4 in your party, FYI you won’t be in the boat alone.We highly recommend this to all.

reviews.author: Neisha Sen
reviews.title: Trang An Boatride
reviews.content: We are 5 including 2 teens and 1 elderly. Tickets were easily available, no waiting and at the same cost a choice of 3 routes. We should route 2 and the scenes were magnificant. The boatwomen was friendly and empathetic towards my mother and lent her an extra jacket and scarf. It was a 3 hour ride so can be tiring especially in warm climates but the caves and temples were terrific. My mom was able to manage with help getting on and off the boat at each stop. There is secure paid parking available opposite the venue so convenient. All in all a must do while in Ninh Binh. We skipped the temples, pagodas, churches and just had a leisurely cycle ride to the boat center and back and soaked in the picturesque landscape.

reviews.author: iamnewanda
reviews.title: Ha Long Bay on land
reviews.content: The combination of magnificent scenery and temples made for an unforgettable experience. Unlike Tam Coc, Trang An is operated by a single company. This provides for a controlled experience. We had heard some unpleasant experiences from Tam Coc with people being harassed for money by their rowers. While there are 3 prescribed routes, our guide negotiated with the rower to take us on a blended route that gave us access to the longest cave (1km) and the the highlights of the other routes. It took 2.5 hours in total. Take sunscreen, a brolly and water for your boat ride.

reviews.author: Claire
reviews.title: A must-see
reviews.content: As far as I’m concerned, this place beats Halong Bay in its beauty. It is a compact version of the Halong Bay. Three routes are offered as a rower guides the boat through your itinerary of choice. We took the longest, about two hours, which was well worth it. The caves are fascinating. Nature was at its best, with water fowl chirping, fish swirling around our boat, and trees majestically rising above us. The star of the show were the caves, however. All different, and all exotic.

reviews.author: DedreTrip
reviews.title: Fantastic cave experience
reviews.content: The river cruise with a dedicated Vietnamese rower was worth every penny.  Route 3 takes you through 3 Caves, one of which is 1000m long and to various pagodas.

reviews.author: Durga M
reviews.title: Caves caves and Mountains
reviews.content: Wow is what comes out even while I am writing the review.What a beautiful country is Vietnam and you realise only when you are here.We did the Trang An boat trip which took is to various caves 4 to be  precise following route 3.The route is scenic the caves are Narrow however your Rower is well aware and Manoeuvres well.It’s a 1 hour and 45 minutes trip also would suggest tipping the rower

reviews.author: Josephine Magda... M
reviews.title: Paradise like no other
reviews.content: We were so impressed with the beauty and tranquility of this place. It is a series of waterways that meander through valleys and limestone caves. Words cannot describe how beautiful this place is. The boat ride takes around 2 hours and each boat is rowed by a local, mostly ladies, which makes it very unique. It is professionally run so you do not have to worry about being hassled by anyone.

reviews.author: Discover321277
reviews.title: Great nature experience
reviews.content: This is more impressive than all the photos can tell. You’ll take a boat trip through some caves and visit some temples on the way. All the time surrounded by magnificent nature: mountains, flora and a bit of fauna (mostly ducks). We had a private boat on route. Worth paying double as the boats are small. Take water, sunscreen, umbrella, etc. some toilets on the way.

reviews.author: Ben N
reviews.title: Halong bay on land.
reviews.content: We did both tour 1 & 2 over the span of two days, and 2 is definitely shorter in distance and much more beautiful. Option 1 has more caves and a lot less crowded. Overall, an amazing place.

reviews.author: switchedoff
reviews.title: Beautiful, peaceful and non commercial.
reviews.content: Perfect 3 hour tour 1, 9 caves and 4 temples and breathtaking scenery.  Wonderful peaceful tour.  We got out and walked to the temples, some stairs involved, and we helped paddle a bit as well.  No attempts to rip us off and smiling lady rower.  Perfect 3 hours.

reviews.author: Rico
reviews.title: Stay longer & go to them all
reviews.content: We wanted to tell people to stay longer, and visit all the incredibly unique sites! That’s what we did! We based out of Ninh Binh and went to all of them. We stayed 5 nights. Depending on the weather we chose the order in which we visited each place. Trang An was first up, we went early, on a Tuesday morning. There were no lines and we had the place almost completely to ourselves. It was a glorious blue-sky-sunny day perfect for taking pictures. We were there for 4 hours. There is a lot to see and some of the stops took time to go up-and-down the steps. I lost count of how many caves we went through but they are definitely the highlight to an already excellent rowboat tour. The place is huge and they have more than one route. We highly recommend this activity!

reviews.author: zaawaaz
reviews.title: Took route 3 - finished ard 2hrs
reviews.content: Route 3 has the 1km longest Cave which was a good experience. Boater cannot speak English and no guide available. Wld be good if in future there could be automated audio recordings that will auto play and inform foreign visitors of the unique sightings while we are on the boat. Clean and good experience. However the boat paddler passed me a feedback form and gestured me to tick her all 5 stars in the last 30mins of the tour - I felt compelled to, in case she might throw me off the boat ;PFor those keen on King Kong movie trail - here's also no more Skull Island tour, please take note.Otherwise, I do recommend the trip, the longest cave was a nice feeling, almost surreal in a movie especially if it's all quiet and no other tourists around talking too loudly :P

reviews.author: Bob T
reviews.title: The Grottos and Boats were Exceptional
reviews.content: What a beautiful place. We did this on our first full day in the Ninh Binh area. Best to go in the morning and not on weekend. It is so lovely when not overcrowded and this is a very popular place for both foreigners (us) and Vietnamese.

reviews.author: jf002
reviews.title: Come here instead of Tam Coc
reviews.content: Stunningly beautiful.  Enjoyable water trip.  I recommend route #1, but they all are good.  Try to beat the crowds and come early or late.

reviews.author: Grant E
reviews.title: Better than Halong bay!
reviews.content: 200000 vid per person, 4 to a row boat paddled by a local worker woman, Do help paddle if you are able. A long tour which was just perfect.3 hours, beautiful scenery, three routes to choose from all good but we took number three as had 3 caves two being the longest, one was one kilometre long, the other 500 metres and the last 150 metres,Very busy in high season so go early in the morning before the tour buses arrive. We were there yesterday December 5 2019 no waiting, no crowd. A must from Ninh binh, far better than the tour from Tam Coc take the one from Trang An in Binh Ninh.

reviews.author: Jaime
reviews.title: Trang An grootes
reviews.content: A very nice 2.5 hours made in the morning. We took route number 3. We were lucky enough to not see many people and enjoy the route. The landscapes views are astonishing. I would repeat.

reviews.author: Cotesaroundtheworld
reviews.title: Nice half day activity
reviews.content: Tour by boat around the river and passing by caves and temples.The price is 200k and you can choose between 3 different circuits.The boat carry 4 people and the duration is around 2,5hours .Nice activity to do while you are in Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: Mathieu R
reviews.title: Our favorite activity un Ninh Binh
reviews.content: Yes the Trang An Grottoes are quite crowded (like everything in Vietnam), but it is still a must-do activity. Maybe we were lucky, but once we got started, we didn't feel like there were that much people. The fact that the place to explore is really big might also be why we didn't feel squeezed.We took route 3 due to recommandations by people on TripAdvisor and we're glad we did! There were less people on it and the 1 km-long cave was very impressive.

reviews.author: Bene M
reviews.title: Nice trip by boat
reviews.content: You can choose between 3 different routes by the boat tour, so its different caves.The lake is very clean and the caves amazing! We also visited some pagodas and important places for praying for buddism people.Its really worth the money.I visited in early morning, so you can hide from the sun, because the boats have no roof!

reviews.author: CurlerBill
reviews.title: Wonderful sampan ride along the river and through the tunnels and grottoes
reviews.content: We thoroughly enjoyed the trip along the river and through the tunnels (9) and grottoes. The tunnels are often quite low and you need to duck to get through. One of our group felt claustrophobic but made it through without incident. The scenery is well worth the visit.

reviews.author: Diane C
reviews.title: STUNNING
reviews.content: A must see in Nimh Binh. We loved rowing through here. It is just breathtaking. A highlight of our trip

reviews.author: Joslin123
reviews.title: Trang An Boat Ride
reviews.content: Very peaceful and serene. Excellent rowing skills of the boat rower at manoevreing through the caves, some caves are narrow and low, we had to duck our heads down. This is a total contrast to the chaotic and noisy side of Vietnam. Worth a visit.

reviews.author: Jac Teo
reviews.title: Amazing....a must see
reviews.content: We took a 9km boat ride through 10 temples and 10 caves. The caves were amazing and the scenery absolutely breath-taking. Go early to avoid the crowds and get a far more serene feel throughout your ride.Even helped the boatwoman do some rowing. These amazing people earn 200,000 dong per ride and most days they only get one ride. Most of them also do this as a side income. Its not easy work rowing a boatload of people for 9km, so please do tip them generously.

reviews.author: Stephen G
reviews.title: Absolutely a stunning place!
reviews.content: Wow beautiful caves, clean glass water, so relaxing mountain area. Boat riders are friendly and hardworking, don't forget to give them some small tip per trip (50,000 - 100,000 vnd) They would be so happy because they have few trips per week only. It is indeed the World Nature Heritages. Highly recommend to visit Trang An!

reviews.author: Nitin H
reviews.title: Fun boating experience
reviews.content: There are tons of reviews so I will keep it short. We chose trang an over Tam coc because of negative reviews. Trang an is great. Choose any route as they all are beautiful. There is no favourite. Entry fee is 200000 VND for adults and 100000 VND for children. They don't enforce height restrictions for kids strictly. All workers are polite. You should at least tip 50000VND at the end of your trip even though they don't really ask. Enjoy.

reviews.author: Mawebb
reviews.title: Great boat ride
reviews.content: This was a great boat trip. The boat lady was a lot of fun, and even though she did not speak english we were able to communicate and have a few jokes with her. We had 3 big guys in the boat, and it was very windy, so we picked up the oars and helped out, I think this made it more fun.The scenery was spectacular and I feel this was a lot better than Tam Coc.We were never asked to buy anything extra or tip anyone, but after paddling us around for over 2 hours we were very happy to provide a tip for her.Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Jon N
reviews.title: Beautiful scenery
reviews.content: Arrived 12 noon and took the route 3 boat ride. Boat ride fee 200k VND each. Boarded the boat 1215pm and ended 245pm, visiting 3 caves (1km long, 400m, and 150m), and 3 Temples. After finishing the last temple, we were handed a survey form. Although the boat lady did not ask for any tips, we still tip her 100k VND for her hard work.

reviews.author: Jam14
reviews.title: great experience
reviews.content: i and my wife were intertesed in with the place. we had sit on the boat and look everythings at Trangan. many high moutains and amazing tones. we are really relax with trip.

reviews.author: Harin Fernando
reviews.title: 2 Hour Boat Tour. Amazing
reviews.content: There are a few routes. Some with stopovers at small temples on islands along the way. Great boat journey with a dedicated rower. On the way help them a bit by rowing a few strokes to assist them. The scenery is breathtaking and serene. Give a tip to the rower if you feel it - no pressure. Take a hat and toilet breaks after two hours....

reviews.author: LienTP
reviews.title: A beautiful tourist destination and should come Ninh Binh
reviews.content: Sitting on boats in the river, watching the beautiful natural scenery is great. The mountain layer with fresh air, the cave system is 400-1000m long completely natural. Good service.It is recommended to visit in the summer and autumn when there are lotus and ripe rice

reviews.author: EuroMark
reviews.title: Welcome to King Kong kingdom
reviews.content: Now I understand why they choose this location filming the movie "King Kong Skull Island"Just imagine yourself on an expedition trip 200 years ago, sit back relax and enjoy every second.Vietnam has a good reputation for it's kindness and hospitality so if you come to this place it might be the perfect moment by "shutting up" and pay back your gratitude by tipping the rowers.For me it was an amazing unforgettable 2 hours rowing trip. You can row, be rowed or both. For me, I choose not to row, just to make the trip last longer.Don't forget to enjoy the moment while taking the pictures.Thank you rowing mama!!!Ps: my rowing mama really had fun, but you should see her face after the tip. Worth every "đong"

reviews.author: Omid k
reviews.title: Wonderful place
reviews.content: If you go to ninh binh i highly recommend to go trang an grottoes ,,, wonderful place with beautiful temple

reviews.author: Eve
reviews.title: Tranquillity at its best
reviews.content: A beautiful ride with breathtaking scenery of the mountains and limestone caves. Nature lover or not, the ride felt like going through a movie set. We were lucky to go in the off season and earlier in the morning so the waters were generally quiet which made the experience even better.Your boat man or lady will drop you off at certain locations throughout the 3 hour ride to explore the temples or landscape. Make sure to bring water and wear sunscreen even if it's cloudy. Restrooms are also available at each drop off point.

reviews.author: Emily T
reviews.title: A Must do
reviews.content: We chose to travel a little furthur to Trang An instead of Tam Coc, after reading reviews about people pestering you at Tam Coc for money. We went early morning for 7:45am/8am. Was still quite quiet not many people. Had to wait for 2 other people to make up a boat of 4. We chose route 3. Beautiful scenery, we couldn’t stop saying wow as we went round every corner. The views didn’t get boring. Bring something to sit on as boats are quite hard. Also if you are a toilet phobe like myself, no need to worry. Clean toilets with paper and handwash throughout the stops.

reviews.author: kyotox
reviews.title: Totally impresive, well organised
reviews.content: Very well organised boat trip. We chose route 3 and saw the 1km long cave. Oh what an experience... go by sunset.

reviews.author: Travel Moto
reviews.title: Amazing boat trip
reviews.content: I come here with my parents. We sit on the boat and explore to the caves. So amazing beautiful mountain and green river. Excellent

reviews.author: Morffydd
reviews.title: Just beautiful
reviews.content: A great experience. We were not pressured for tips. Feel free to help paddle, if you want. The many caves and temples were beautiful and very peaceful.

reviews.author: MaximeLecl
reviews.title: Peaceful and splendid boat ride!
reviews.content: We took route 1 and it was really scenic!The 3-hour journey might seem long at first but it's broken down with the visits of temples and viewings of caves whilst on the boat. As a result, time flew by.Go early to beat the crowds!We showed up at 8.30am on a Wednesday and we waited only 3 minutes to find another person to fill the boat (boat only goes when 3 or 4 people are onboard).Lots of boats were already departing before that time!I would also potentially avoid weekends as locals might be coming as well.Weather was perfect, take sunscreen or long sleeves, hat or umbrella to protect you!Last point, the rower was extremly quiet (we did not speak Vietnamese and he did not speak English).We avoided a boat ride in Tam Coc because of the feedback we read about it.

reviews.author: Melanie B
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: Well worth a visit! We had a family of 5, thought kids might get a bit bored as got told it would take about 2.5-3 hours and the day was warm but they really enjoyed it. Our boat rower was fantastic and we raced past a lot of boats and was finished in about 2 hours but really didn’t feel like that long. Scenery is so pretty, it was a relaxing afternoon. There were extra oars in the boat so the kids had fun having a go.  The caves were amazing, some parts are low so we all had to duck. We visited skull island where they filmed King Kong. We tipped our rower at the end as he did such a great job.Kids thoroughly enjoyed it and said they would go again. Kids are 10, 9 and 7.

reviews.author: Raymondale
reviews.title: Ha long bay on land
reviews.content: It is like ha long bay on land,you can see many limestone caves,mountains,but most interesting is you can visit skull island.When the King Kong: Skull Island crew finished filming in Vietnam, they left and cleaned up all the scene-setting.but the government of Vietnam restored the filming location to attract tourists.you can see locals wear some aboriginal-like costumes,you can take photos with them.during the trip,you sat on a  boat to see around the place,the boatman or woman is skillful,you can try to row the boat,but it is hard.after the trip,you can tip the boatman or woman.you can visit a temple on the island,and there are some shops on the island.if you visit Hanoi, recommend you to join Trang An grottoes tour,normally the tour included Chua Bai Dinh.

reviews.author: Cory
reviews.title: Go early, take route three
reviews.content: Highlight of our trip! Super special. Two pieces of advice: Get there early. We got there at 830am on a Friday in the off season and there were already some (loud) tour groups arriving. We avoided the crowds but I bet it’s magical and even more peaceful if you can get there right at opening. Take route 3! The May Cave (1000M long!) is a breathtaking experience, and it seems like less people take that route — we were completely alone for much of the route and definitely in the cave. We had to sit on the floor of our boat to make it through the low ceiling passageways but that made it all the more adventurous and magical. (Claustrophobes beware, though!)

reviews.author: Jolly traveler
reviews.title: Explore the caves
reviews.content: I thoroughly enjoyed and highly recommend this 3 hour boat ride. There are no scams here. You buy your ticket at the entrance and then go to your boat. If you are solo, find 3 other individuals because they take 4 persons per boat. You can select any of the 3 routes but whichever you choose it is an amazing journey with the caves and cliffs.

reviews.author: Hol
reviews.title: Grotto Tour
reviews.content: This is a must when visiting this area. Our accommodation was far closer to Tam Coc River tours but I read a few bad reviews some mentioning getting scammed by the rower. We made the trip up to Trang An instead which is well worth it. This clearly a professional well organised location. The trip was amazing and we seen some beautiful sites. We choose route 2. At first we thought 2 - 3hrs was a long time to be on a boat but the time flew in. We stopped at many of the beautiful temples which all had clean toilets on site. It wasn't too over crowded either but maybe we got lucky and visited during a quieter time.

reviews.author: extravelagent
reviews.title: Super enjoyable!
reviews.content: This activity is truly the "Halong Bay" on land and to be honest, I enjoyed the grottoes more than the overnight cruise at Halong. I think it's because you get really up close and personal at Trang An. We came by motorbike and it's not the most clearly marked (and not in English) so it took us a while. But once we got there everything was fine. We parked the motorbike (you need to pay 50K) but at least someone is watching it. We walked across the street to the ticket office (200K per person) and we took route 1. We didn't have to wait very long (they require 4 to a boat) and we waited about 3 minutes. The boat ride was beautiful and while our rower didn't speak any English; just the scenry alobe was breathtaking. We did about 4 temples and 9 caves (keep your head down) and it took about 2.5 hours. No, we didn't stop for the snack scam (lime at Tam Coc) nor did the rower ask for a tip (but we tipped her anyways at the end since it's hard work on her part especially navigating inside the caves). Yes, Trang An is much more expensive than Tam Coc but there are no scams, the ride is peaceful and a whole lot less crowded (a 3 minute wait for a boat?!!!) Unheard of. We felt very fortunate for our whole experience there that day. Trang An seems to have to keep a standard as it is now a UNECO heritage mixed use site (and hopefully not the kiss of death tourist wise) and even the rower had to give us a survey to fill out at the end. It was truly the highlight of Nihn Bin! PS on your way home stop for the BBQ goat on the side of the road. You can't miss it!

reviews.author: Morgen R
reviews.title: Extremely interesting
reviews.content: This was a great trip along with the boat paddlers were not as pushy and there was absolutely no sellers trying to market some other water or products. This particular drive has aproximatelly 10 caves that you move through. There are many camera individuals though we turned away whenever they came near and were obtaining the idea. We've been lucky since it had been an overcast morning as well as just 20 6 degrees as quite enjoyable. In case it is sunny you are going to need an umbrella along with excellent suntan cream. An amazing experience as well as additionally a great deal more bang for the dollar compared to a Halong Bay trip. In case you've to choose, go towards the grottoes. We've accomplished both as well as this is unquestionably the smartest choice.

reviews.author: Prince_Brand999
reviews.title: Beautiful scenary
reviews.content: Amazing sights of the river and surrounding crasts, very cheap also for a e hour boat ride in a small boat. If you want the best experience, go earlier in the morning when there is less people

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.content: Busy location. Getting assigned to a boat was a bit of a bustle, no one was quite sure what to do or when to board. Boat operator was very nice, no English so no dialogue, but did her best to point us towards temples or to duck in caves. :)  No pressure for sales, which was a big plus.  Allowed us to really relax and enjoy the beautiful location.

reviews.author: thechris83
reviews.title: beautful but so crowded !
reviews.content: Very beautiful place ! Unfortunately, i had to go during national holiday and it was over crowded. had to wait around 1 hour due to traffic jam at the entrance of one of the cave.otherwise, a very nice experience.King kong island is just ok, nothing excpetionnal.

reviews.author: Alex P
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: About 1 hour trip along the lake/chanel in the mountins area. Ask your guide tips about how to interact with the small boatdriver or sellers. A small tip is expected but some of them ask more, don’t pay.

reviews.author: ruthey
reviews.title: Lovely morning
reviews.content: Despite the amount of tourists that go here it was a nice experience. There are three boat trips to choose from. Well organized . The authorities are trying to curtail the demands for tips and hawking that apparently is endemic in tam coc boat ride and other tourists we met complained about . I can say the lady who rowed our boat  in Trang an was lovely and didn’t behave at all in that manner. It is hard work so we did tip of our own volition.

reviews.author: Xavier Agostino
reviews.title: A memorable 3 hours
reviews.content: Trang An boat ride is incredible. I recommend preferencing this ride over Tam Coc. This one is professional and presents as a lot more legitimate. You do not have to worry about the potential for things to go wrong.  The drivers are all friendly.  There is no pressure to tip or be hassled half way through. The caves are incredible. Also the driver takes regular stops which allows you the chance to get off the boat,  stretch your legs and take some nice photos.

reviews.author: Natalie Forster
reviews.title: Breathtaking and unforgettable experience!
reviews.content: Wow. Just wow. The Trang An boat tour was amazing. There were 3 routes to choose from, with different caves and pagodas to visit. We chose route 1 as it was  recommended  by our driver and it included the most caves (9) which was a lifesaver during the hot weather. All routes, however are all beautiful and the route you chose depends on how much time you have and your preferences. Our rower was very friendly and we gave her a tip at the end because they only get one ride every few days and are paid very little. There were also extra paddles which were very fun to use, especially for my sister (9 yrs old). There were several stops along the way which was had bathrooms and refreshments, along with steps up the mountains with amazing views, which also gave the rowers a chance to rest. Make sure you bring a hat and sunscreen because the sun is very strong. Trang An is definitely not to be missed when going to Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: JUPANDMUP
reviews.title: NOT TO BE MISSED
reviews.content: Fantastic 2.5 hour paddle through the countryside.  This is highly recommended and well worthwhile.  Always felt very safe in the boat.

reviews.author: Amy D
reviews.title: Breathtaking views -- in and out of the caves.
reviews.content: We didn't know what to expect from this -- the bellman from our Hanoi hotel said it was where he was from and beautiful. It's indescribably pretty. Our day was overcast, and I think that made it even prettier.

reviews.author: Darren
reviews.title: What an amazingly beautiful place!
reviews.content: Although it was quite busy, even midweek on a rainy day, it was awesome to see and experience the caves and temples. We did tour 1 with 9 caves and really enjoyed our trip. It was magical indeed!

reviews.author: Nmac55
reviews.title: Enjoyable
reviews.content: Went with a group of cyclists, spent 2-3 hrs here. Very interesting boat ride thru the caves and pagodas, too bad we could not speak Vietnamese or that our boat rower could not speak any English,

reviews.author: happytwanderer
reviews.title: Must see
reviews.content: This is such a beautiful area that they filmed the Kong movie here. Some of the grottoes require you to duck your head as your boat floats through the opening. It's a wonderful couple of hours taking a boat down the river. The limestone cliffs are lush with foliage.

reviews.author: Nadine
reviews.title: superb
reviews.content: Trang An is very beautiful. people friendly, very nice. I went to visit Trang An in a sunny day. I thought that it would be a hot trip but not. It's amazing. I had an umbrella and hat when I stayed on boat. The water was very clean. you can see the plant under the water. So crazy but I didn't find it in anywhere. I will come back again

reviews.author: 4tuataras
reviews.title: Amazing scenery
reviews.content: Our family of 4 (2adults, 2x 15 year olds) did the Trang An grotto tour.After reading reviews, we decided on this, rather than Tam Coc tour (where we were actually staying), and were very glad. As previous reviewers of this attraction have said, it is the inland version of Halong bay. Tam Coc goes through the rice fields, however the rice had recently been harvested, and we felt that Trang An offered better scenery. Rowing past the karst peaks, through the caves/grottos and to the temples was quite surreal. As previous reviewers have mentioned, you have the choice of 3 routes- with different numbers of caves and temples. Route 1: 9 caves, 3 templesRoute 2: 4 caves, 3 templesRoute 3: 3 caves (longest cave out of 3 choices- 1km long), and Kong island.All are 200,000 and take around 3hrs.We chose route 1, as not really interested in Kong Island. Temples were interesting- esp 2nd one which you have to walk up stairs, then down to temple- repeating it to get back to boat. We helped to row, but it wasn’t expected. Take lots of water, hats, sunblock and a few snacks (you can buy ice cream etc at the temple sites). You must wear life jackets- and along the journey is an official who checks!Are given a feedback form to fill in prior to returning to ensure you’re not hassled for tips etc. We did however give our wee woman rower a tip (unsolicited) after ticking ‘no’ on the form for ‘were you asked for a tip’. She did a great job maneuvering us through the grottoes.We worth it!

reviews.author: danis
reviews.title: Fantasic landcape
reviews.content: Seating on the sampp arround 3 hours was paddle by local man,you will see amazing air and landcape.No words enough to say about it.Over wonderful

reviews.author: tclm1971
reviews.title: A lovely day on the water
reviews.content: We took our 2 yo daughter on this trip - it was wonderful. The woman rower was so talented. We loved the caves- we only alighted the boat at a couple of temples as our daughter fell asleep so we just ‘ kept on rowing’A lovely way to spend a few hours in this region Highly recommended

reviews.author: Jan.parker523NY
reviews.title: between nature
reviews.content: This is a stroll between nature, the small boat will take you slowly through caves, valleys and temples. The space is peaceful and pleasant

reviews.author: Andy_James142
reviews.title: Simply Amazing
reviews.content: I'll make it short, this is a "must see". Take Route 1 which is the longest (3 hours in all) - all 3 routes are the same price. My wife was worried about going into caves but ended up quite relaxed. Only 4 passengers per boat, plus local rower.

reviews.author: ExplorerGabor
reviews.title: Relaxing paddle with great scenery
reviews.content: We did Tour 1 which included 9 caves and 3 temples.  It took us just over 2.5hrs though we were rowing along with our boatman.  Many other boats we saw, the guests weren’t rowing so it may have taken them longer.  The boat easily fits 4 plus the boatman and we had to wear life vests.  It is very hot and hats are recommended plus an umbrella if you have one.  The temples are small though nice and cool.  These stops have toilets and stands selling cold drinks and snacks.  Some caves are not very high and we needed to almost lay down to get through.  We arrived at 9am and it was not busy.  When returning at 1130am a lot of boats were going out.  Cost is VND200,000 pp for anyone over 1m tall.  No kids prices though cheaper if they are under 1m tall.   There were no hawkers and we weren’t hassled for a tip though we did give him one.

reviews.author: Ramesh
reviews.title: Best trips I had in trang an gro
reviews.content: We had  spent here every minute every hour  it was incredible moments In has my life and view and excitement and we are done  here botting    totally enjoyed so we are recommend

reviews.author: Shari R
reviews.title: A stunning river trip
reviews.content: This was a spectacular experience. We had a lady row us through the grottoes for 1-1/2 hours—using her feet to paddle the boat! The scenery was breathtaking! It is one of our most loved excursions. We booked through Tonkin Travel (not to be confused with Tonkin-Travel or Vietnam Tonkin Travel. Those are newer companies trying to build their business on the reputation of Tonkin Travel.)

reviews.author: Chris and Suzy
reviews.title: Trang An row boat 3hr circuit
reviews.content: As part of our motorcycle day ride, we took the row boat ride. It truly was amazing to be gently and skilfully (by a very senior woman) rowed through the natural tunnels with all kinds rocky overhead. Out on the open water the old girl encourages the men to help with the rowing. You might get told off a bit for rocking the boat, bad rowing, ducking your head, and if you don’t want to wear a life jacket! So be good.Apply sunscreen more than I did. 🥵

reviews.author: Ela D
reviews.title: Nice Trip
reviews.content: Really enjoyed this boat tour! A lovely peaceful journey with little stop offs along the way to see some temples. We took the long route (route 1, 3 hours) where you are able to see 9 caves. Some of them are pretty narrow but if you aren’t claustrophobic they are pretty awesome to go through! Beautiful place with great views. and beautiful nature. Definitely worth going. The price is 200000 for each person and on one boot there are always four people.

reviews.author: happy tourism vietnam🇻🇳😊🙂
reviews.title: Trang An
reviews.content: Pristine relic area.  You sit on a boat to visit the caves.There are 3 routes to choose from.The fare for each route is 200,000vnd / 1 ticket / 1 adult.You need to wear a hat or umbrella when sitting on a boat

reviews.author: Smiley Jane
reviews.title: Absolutely beautiful!
reviews.content: We booked the Trang An boat tour which went through the caves. There are 3 tour options. I'd highly recommend going through the caves in the boat, it was a beautiful ride. Our trip took about 2.5 hours and a lovely Vietnamese lady rowed us around the river (passengers have the option to paddle as well but not required). She sang softly as she rowed which was really sweet. She did not speak English but we all communicated well during the trip.My husband and I shared the boat with our guide and we also saw boats with 4 passengers and a guide. You won't be the only boat on the river but there were many times when we couldn't see any other boats. On the second half of the journey we  were near about 5 other boats. Everyone was friendly and waved between the boats.The river does not have strong currents so the boat moves at a leisurely pace. The water is clear and you can see the bottom quite easily. Lots of lily/lotus plants. The limestone hills are in dramatic contrast to the river. Have your camera ready, spectacular views abound! Don't worry if the weather is foggy, you can still see a lot even with the mist (adds great atmosphere).The caves were surreal and very low! Lots of places where we were warned to lower our heads. The longer caves have lighting so you can see when you need to duck.I'd highly recommend this tour!

reviews.author: Thomestifanos
reviews.title: Great way to see an amazing Place
reviews.content: Great way to experience this fantastic place. With the choices of 3 different routes this was 3 hours well spent and a must if you are in Nin Binh!A plus was that we went in September (low season) because there are probably LONG waiting times otherwise, we got to go 2 in a bout instead of 4 and that made the trip even better.

reviews.author: Prabodha Daulagala
reviews.title: Nature So Pretty
reviews.content: Sometimes nature can surprise you on how beautiful it can really be. Trang An was such a place and i was mesmerized by the boat taking us slowly around. Since the boats are paddled and they do not allow any water activity such as swimming, the place looks so clean and the water is crystal clear you can see everything clearly below the water. This place took us to another work and I loved the calmness of the entire boat ride. Would definitely recommend

reviews.author: Nathan S
reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.content: This boat tour is incredible.  We chose route 3 and it was so beautiful, peaceful and serene. Highly recommend

reviews.author: DaisyM777
reviews.title: Breathtaking views!
reviews.content: Despite the problems we previously had with our tour operator we enjoyed every minute of Trang An boat ride!Our boat lady was so lovely and we enjoyed rowing the boat with her.Views are so beautiful, I can’t find the words ...Thankfully our boat trip was completely hustle  free. Next time in Vietnam we will definitely visit Trang An again!Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Smokedodger
reviews.title: Heaven
reviews.content: Forget Tam Coc. No stress just the most relaxing beautiful places I’ve ever seen. No hassle or pestering here.

reviews.author: DerriQ
reviews.title: The most beautiful scenery!
reviews.content: This places beauty literally took my breath away! I loved every minute of our visit.  Its an absolute must do if you visit Ninh Binh area! You will not regret it!

reviews.author: Wendywoo2013
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.content: One of the highlights of the tour of Vietnam. A must do. Two and a half hours trip which was amazing.

reviews.author: s0phieg118
reviews.title: Beautiful scenery and exciting cave experience
reviews.content: My boyfriend and I thoroughly enjoyed this trip and we’re very glad we travelled to Trang An instead of the more touristy Tam Coc (where we were staying). The tour was an amazing experience rowing through caves where we were asked to duck by our guide! We travelling in a small boat with another couple and were able to paddle along to help our guide if desired. They were discretely lit yet allow good enough visibility, and there were several opportunities to get out of the boat to visit temples (so make sure you dress appropriately for this). We’d highly recommend this experience!

reviews.author: MexicoSaran
reviews.title: Very very beautiful
reviews.content: Wonderful experience. I am SARAVANAN from Chennai India. Very nice place and very cheap to have this nature

reviews.author: Emmeira
reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.content: These are very beautiful grottoes, you can have a ride on a boat and enjoy the relaxing and quiet atmosphere.

reviews.author: Simon
reviews.title: Unique natural experience in Vietnam!
reviews.content: I traveled Vietnam from North to South and this is definitely one of my favorite places; immerse in nature, a unique experience.

reviews.author: Travelling_Guy38
reviews.title: Better than Tam Coc
reviews.content: Much more relaxing than Tam Coc with friendly boat people. Very scenic. Recommend over Tam Coc. Boat takes around 2 hours. Very hot so take protection and water.

reviews.author: Rebecca R
reviews.title: Popular but worth it
reviews.content: This is the most popular boat ride in the area with hundreds of boats on the water however if you go on route one there are many places where you don’t see anyone and it’s very tranquil. Don’t let the crowds put you off!

reviews.author: sophie d
reviews.title: Hot
reviews.content: There are 3 options to choose the way you want, each one is a 3 hours trip!!! I choose the first one which is 9 caves and 3 temples. Rolling in this little boats in caves is lots of fun. The stops at the temples is good to move a bit  to refresh ourselves and to visit new places. The way is amazing, so beautiful. It is very recommanded.

reviews.author: Graeme R
reviews.title: Out of this world!
reviews.content: This is a must do if you are in or around the area. Travel back to a Jurassic type time period on the tranquil waters of these mountains. It is definitely very touristy but you shouldn’t let that put you off for it is worth it. Couple of tips... take a small something to sit on as these boats are not designed for comfort and depending on the route you choose you are on them for a while.... and an umbrella helped us with heat as well. Other than that I can highly recommend.

reviews.author: Yellowhummingbird
reviews.title: Amazing landscaoe
reviews.content: We took a boat ride no 3 . There are different tours 1,2,3. It is very calming as there are no motorboats. The river winds around fantastic rock formations and there are many caves the boat goes through. One of them we had to sit low down in the boat as not to hit our heads. We also stopped at scull island where the filmed King Kong. This trip was fabulous .

reviews.author: Martina S
reviews.title: Geat experience
reviews.content: At least some atraction with a little bit of organization. The boat rides always took abour 3 hours and it must have been exhausting for the rovers. With the ticket we got flyer about boat rides and you can choose from 3 routes. Its definitely worth the money and you clearly can see the exact price for everyone. No scams.

reviews.author: bramdevree
reviews.title: We did 3 boat tours, this one is by far the best.
reviews.content: This is the only boat tour where they don't beg for a tip or force you to buy things. Best view of all, better than Tam Coc. Stunning caves, fairy tale valleys.

reviews.author: J3nnE
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: Cost is 200k dong pp. 3 routes to choose from. We choose route 2 and were put with another couple in our boat. Absolutely stunning scenery along the way which can't be captured on film. Some moments going through the caves require you to sit on the bottom of the boat. You can choose to help row the boat the the guide or relax. Few spots along the way to stop off and take photos and see the temples and kong island. At the end of the tour our guide had us fill out a form.. one of the questions was 'did you guide ask for a tip' at that moment the guide had not asked... when we arrived at the end she then asked! Beautiful 3 hours cruising around.

reviews.author: chrischong770
reviews.title: A must visit
reviews.content: Trang An tourist site is very well worth a visit. Scenery is beautiful like Halong bay. Do the boat trip along the river was amazing!

reviews.author: Corey T
reviews.title: Authentic Ninh Binh
reviews.content: Very good trip.... Great view of Kong Island.  Very much like Ha Long Bay but close up and personalized.

reviews.author: George Potter
reviews.title: Wonderful place
reviews.content: Having visited a few countries in south east Asia I must say this is one of the most beautiful landscapes I’ve ever seen. Worth visiting. There are packs including other visits on the same day which were average but this is a must see. Wonderful

reviews.author: nidkirm
reviews.title: Lovely but don’t go when it’s super hot!
reviews.content: I really would have enjoyed this tour if I didn’t choose to go during one of the hottest days of the year! Was melting the whole time, but it was quite beautiful nevertheless.

reviews.author: Miroslav Š
reviews.title: Super nice rowing boat trip
