reviews.content: We took a tour 3. You get around through several caves, a temple, and King Kong Skull Island - the shooting site of the movie.

reviews.author: Garry A
reviews.title: very peaceful
reviews.content: trang an boat trip is very peaceful , no noise at all apart from people talking on the other boats , the trip is 200,000 per person dong around 9$, a few choices short , medium and long trip but all the same price , longest they said was 3 and half to 4 hours so i chose the medium which was 3 hours and to be honest that was long enough , get a pretty numb bum stitting on the hard seats although you stop a couple times to stretch your legs , you go through 4 caves which makes the trip interesting

reviews.author: behzrings
reviews.title: Great activity for the whole family
reviews.content: Took boat trip number 1 with 9 caves which we enjoyed a lot. Bring cold water or buy at the three temples you visit on the trip. We were in two different boats, because they only fit four. But the two boats sailed together which was nice

reviews.author: Irish_Food_Dude
reviews.title: Amazing Caves
reviews.content: We did this tour with 3 small kids (3, 5 & 8) and they loved it. The tour lasted 3 hours, thankfully we had cloud cover as there is a lot of open river without shade so bring lots of water & hats!We took route #1 on advice from our guide, it went through 9 caves ranging from 100m to 400m long each and there were 3-4 stops at Pagodas along the way.Our boat rower Bic had fantastic skill manoeuvring through low caves. Scenery was breathtaking - very similar to Halong Bay.We paid 700k VND for entry - 200k per adult & 100k per child (supposed to be under 1m) & tipped 100k VND, great way to spend a half day.PS. A word of advice, when visiting Trinh Temple, you climb around 200 steep steps up to a viewing point & then the same down again on the far side to see the actual temple (basically an alter) - the only way back to your boat is THE SAME WAY so be prepared to climb back up and down again, we didn’t know this so the kids were struggling along with all of the other visitors!!

reviews.author: Greg P
reviews.title: Amazing scenery but guide very aggressive
reviews.content: This was an incredible boat ride and the scenery was stunning. Definitely a must do.However I would suggest they pay their guides more and/or post guidance on a recommended tip. Our boat guide started aggressively accosting me for a tip 10 minutes before the tour had finished. I handed her a large bill and asked for change which she refused to give. It was an awkward end to a great trip unfortunately.

reviews.author: danelfoxer
reviews.title: Great tour
reviews.content: We enjoyed our trip as a part of our package tour, we booked this tour at last minute but our travel agent still arranged as private, it is great sight with sailing boat tour, great grottoes and lunch included,too. It might take you about 2 hours from Hanoi and definitely worth for a full day trip.

reviews.author: EvieBe
reviews.title: Amazing place
reviews.content: We took a boat trip and it was beautiful. We didn’t have any problem with parking or vendors. Our rower-lady was nice although she didn’t really speak English. Great place to visit with kids.  Go early in the morning to avoid the crowd.

reviews.author: Steph E
reviews.title: Beautiful Natural Scenery, boating through caves. visiting temples and relaxing
reviews.content: We got there early to avoid the crowds and midday heat. We took the 3rd tour, the one that goes through the 1km cave and where you see the movie set. The tour takes about 2.5-3 hours. While you have someone rowing the boat you also have the option to join in paddling which we chose to do and it was a lot of fun. It's really unique and the beautiful natural scenery is remarkable. The water is calm and although there are a lot of boats on the water it doesn't take the magic out of the place. Boating through the caves was really neat and you had to duck down in places as there were lower spots in the caves. The temples were lovely and the movie set was neat but we hadn't seen the movie so it didn't mean much to us. Would highly recommend:)

reviews.author: Jenni B
reviews.title: Amazibg
reviews.content: Absolutely amazing place.Beautiful and stunning. Did route 1 - the best, 9 caves in total which were brill. No boat vendors hassling you to buy things and the lady on the boat did not ask or hassle for a tip. Unlike Tam Coc.  Would recommend in a heartbeat over Tam Coc.

reviews.author: Jun David
reviews.title: Great Experience and Awesome Views
reviews.content: The Trang-An Grottoes tour we took and booked from our hotel.Just the experience in going under the cave in a small rowing boat is a great experience. Please look out as some the cave is very low enough to hit your heads. You will be warned though by your boat rower.It is 2 1/2 hours of rowing so any help to row the boat will give a smile to the lady rowing the boat. During the tour, you get off somewhere to Kong Island where they have the location shooting. They have a boat and some native houses they use in the shooting. The place have awesome view with lots of limestone rock formation.I recommend this tour. Great experience and awesome views.

reviews.author: ViktoriaGerzeny
reviews.title: Truly beautiful experience!
reviews.content: We travelled by a scooter we rented from our resort. One of the most beautiful and authentic place in Vietnam. It absolutley worth a visit and we glad we did not just signed up from one of the one day bus trip from Hanoi. We stayed in Tam Coc for 2 nights and we took our time and visited a couple of places in the area.

reviews.author: Chandrani R
reviews.title: The BEST of our Vietnam trip !!!
reviews.content: The boat ride of almost 3 hours was really amazing. We took the route 1 which had more than a dozen caves and the experience was just excellent. The lady rowing the boat was very sweet and nice, though the mode of communication was sign language. The beautiful landscape and the awesome journey will forever remain in our heart.

reviews.author: Malisane
reviews.title: Best Waterfalls in SE Asia!
reviews.content: the beautiful place you must find out. The limestone mountains rise out of the planet and also make this different earth from Ninh Binh. Peaceful and lovely. Full of roosters, chickens, mountain goats, pigs, countless white-colored ducks! These innovative caves are cute. You're planning to check out approximately eight caves which are unadulterated & great. We are feeling this is of all the best stuff we did in Vietnam

reviews.author: Lotuspearl
reviews.title: Beautiful, well organized
reviews.content: Would recommed this anyday over Tam Coc. It has interesting stops, professionally organized, no scamsters around and beautiful location

reviews.author: Davina T
reviews.title: The best tour on our trip so far.
reviews.content: You are given 3 route options and we chose option 1.  This visited the most caves and the other two visited a film set which we weren’t really interested in.  There were just the two of us on the boat with the driver as we waited for 5 minutes and no one else showed up for this route so we Were happy to be sent off on our own.  Rowing through the caves were amazing as you wouldn’t expect them to go on that far (300 m the longest) and you have to duck low in many places to avoid banging your head.So peaceful and beautiful.

reviews.author: Ian N
reviews.title: Excellent visit.
reviews.content: Stunning scenery. Very reasonable price. 200,000 VD at the time of writing. You spend roughly 3 hours going along the river visiting caves and temples. Make sure to bring a hat and extra sun cream to top up due to it being a long tour. We didn’t run into many mosquitos but given it’s fairly calm waters I brought my repellent just in case. A faultless tour overall.

reviews.author: Factsnotfiction62
reviews.title: Well worth a visit
reviews.content: We chose the Trang An boat ride rather than Tam Coc as Trang An is much less commercialised.You have a choice of three routes, each lasts three hours. We were taken through underwater caves and we stopped three times on small islands with pagados and temples (there were also toilets and opportunity to buy drinks/ice creams on one of the stops).The scenery is stunning and the boat ride tranquil. We didn’t enjoy the indigenous village stop. All seemed a bit contrived and out of keeping with the rest of the boat tour.Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: BeirutPop
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.content: We spent a whole morning at Trang An and have nothing but good things to talk about. The boat driver tirelessly rowed for three hours (with resting periods in specified locations) and we went inside 9 of the 48 grottoes, a breathtaking experience indeed. The small boats were equipped with umbrellas and free water bottles. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Zuzka Trojka
reviews.title: really nice tour!!
reviews.content: Really nice place and nice cave and palaces during your tour. The staff is nice and they wont to tell you about tip.But for them is OK. Tour takes 3 hours.

reviews.author: Cathee
reviews.title: Wonderful trip
reviews.content: We purchased entrance tickets and started the unforgettable journey of ours. It was an obvious, bright day. We have been fortunate because there were not many visitors there, therefore we sort of had the location all for ourselves. The water was still, its color was various shades of green and blue. Some little ducks have been swimming. The Vietnamese girl who paddled the boat did not speak English, &amp; she was too small. It was difficult to think that she actually has all of the power to row the boat for three hours, moving in and out the great caves in the scorching heat. It was really most romantic spot we have been to in Vietnam. The entire place was very peaceful, so the splendor was breathtaking. I do not know whether it is only me, but perhaps the air smelled a bit sweet. Nevertheless, there would have been a Vietnamese guy that eventually approached us when we had been on the boat. He was following the boat of ours with the own small boat of his and he was very busy taking the photos of ours. He was not a risk, he was simply selling us the photographs which he took. He was very persuasive, though we insisted we did not wish to get those photos. After some time, he left us alone and also provided us one image anyway. Too bad it was not all that great, so we did not keep it. Anyhow, this particular location is a must see when you are going to Vietnam. Attempt asking your guide or hotel to discover once the location is not chock-full visitors because however gorgeous an area is, a package of visitors will wreck it, particularly for being extremely loud. Getting suntan is attractive, but sunburn or maybe skin cancer is clearly not cool. Oh, and do not forget to tip the person that takes you on that fantastic journey.

reviews.author: Sakuraplatz
reviews.title: Absolutely a must
reviews.content: This is absolutely a must when you visit Ninh Binh. Really amazing experience.A friend of mine and I stayed nearby and visited here twice by  bicycle. When you are approaching from Ninh Binh or Tam Coc, the boat dock is on the left-hand side, while the parking lot is on the opposite side of the road. When we visited for the first time, the ticket office was on the same side as the parking lot, but next day it was on the same side as the boat dock. It seems that either of them is open depending the expected number of visitors. There is a signboard showing the direction to the ticket office.On the first day, we arrived here around 3PM, so there was no queue. We took Route 3. The rower, a Vietnamese lady, was very friendly and taught us what to see from the boat. The scenery was absolutely stunning. The water was clean, so we were able to see water plants on the bottom. We went through three caves. The first one was as long as 1000m! We saw beautiful stalactite in the cave but needed to bend forward here and there because it was so narrow. Her skill to maneuver the boat through such caves was really amazing.The boat trip was extremely enjoyable, so next day we visited again at 10AM. This time we took Route 1. There were no crowds but there were gray clouds. We had a thunderstorm 10 minutes after we rode on the boat. The rower, another Vietnamese lady, kindly lent her umbrella to a lady with whom we shared the boat. I put an umbrella on and thought that I would get soaking wet, but fortunately the rain stopped soon. The scenery of Karst peaks with clouds on the top of them reminded me of Chinese ink-wash painting. Tranquil, serene and peaceful. It was worth visiting twice.The rowers were kind and well-trained. They didn’t ask for tipping at all, but we did to show our gratitude to their hard work.Definitely a gem. Don’t miss it!

reviews.author: KONING55
reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.content: Took the boat ride with 3 other people. Option 2. I think it's the best option since most people take option 1 so that route gets kinda crowded even in the low-season. Best is to go in the early morning when the tour buses haven't arrived yet. So stay in Tam Coc or Ninh Binh so you can be here within 30 minutes. The route itself is very relaxing, just watching the scenery. You can also help peddling but your journey will end quicker. Also saw Skull Island from the King Kong movie. Looks nothing like the movie set anymore, but it's a fine addition to the tour.Just beware of who you are getting in with in the boat. If you want a relaxing ride, take quiet people with you.

reviews.author: Elsa C. L.
reviews.title: Trang An blows away Tam Coc
reviews.content: Mr. Kimi gave the itinerary and information that we are likely to have one bus change or two.The historical significance of Bai Dinh is interesting.  The long corridor which was recently built is a pleasant exercise walking up to the temple on top of the hill.  Buddha’s students on each side total 500+.  The stories about Kuan Yin’s forty -two arms and hundreds of eyes to help and watch over many believers at a time strengthens faith.  So is that of the 18-year old Buddha who died and whose cremation resulted into 64,000+ colorful stones which signified his good deeds and soul advancement attained.  I am not certain if the Buddha whose heart could not get burned is the same as the one whose ashes had beautiful stones.Trang Anh is natural, more picturesque, romantic, has no trash such as plastic bags and bottles, has clear waters where fishes swimming are visible.  It has several caves, two with low stalactites, three long ones and/or narrow passages with lights to prevent accidents.  Tam Coc’s water is murky and has many litter.  We passed a bridge with advertisements and an area with bungalows that both take away from communing with nature. Note:  There is no litter in Trang An because the locals care to clean up (see picture attached).My recommendations are: Sightsee in Ha Long Bay and in Trang An. These are the two natural wonders of Vietnam or near Hanoi, in my view.What Tam Coc has that Trang An does not have are rice plants.  While I am biased to verdant rice fields, I can skip Tam Coc having experienced the natural beauty of Trang An. I wish that the boat rower in Trang An with a boom box discontinues the noise that he makes in such a serene environment.  It ruins the peace.  Our ride to Bai Dinh from Hanoi was a bit over two hours.  Toilets are clean.   Lunch had offerings for different preferences although not as good as the lunch on the Ha Long Bay boat.

reviews.author: Mogz
reviews.title: Worth it
reviews.content: Do this. It was great. But go early for less people.We chose 'Ride Option 1'9 Caves and 9 Pagodas - 3hrs (took us about 3hrs40mins as we photo ed and explored a bit more than other groups)It was pretty magic and it was even slightly raining. Our lady guide was friendly and not pushy and took her time letting us explore when and where we wanted to at the stops.Well worth the bicycle trip out to do it. Parking for bikes across the road.

reviews.author: Motorbike Rental
reviews.title: Amazingg
reviews.content: My colleagues and I have come here. It is wonderful because of the majestic rock mountains and the poetic river. It feels like watching the King Kong 5D movie

reviews.author: Wyndham
reviews.title: A beautiful experience
reviews.content: Way that is great to find out the caves by a sampan. You are able to assist the boatman row the boat too. Quite an adventure. We did not match some annoying boatmen though our guide warned us never to buy something when on the boat since it may get a little rocky. Time that is good to visit in the winter therefore even if the sun's heat is out, you will not feel hot. At the conclusion of the boat ride, you can do with a bit of tipping.

reviews.author: Bill Rogers
reviews.title: The most amazing place
reviews.content: This is so much more than Halong Bay. So clean and more scenic.Halong Bay is 8 stars,  this is 11 stars.So beautiful. A must for every bucket list.Can't wait to come back next year to do it all over again.

reviews.author: Florian
reviews.title: Trang An is great choice
reviews.content: Choice that is great to obtain Halong in the area as they call it. We spend three hours over a little boat and we enjoyed it! Really beautiful and place that is quiet. At the conclusion of the trip of ours in Vietnam, we went to real Halong bay too though we did not love it almost as Trang An. Maybe due to the climate and we'd just 1 day for Halong bay though it was not well worth it. So we endorse Trang An in case you will have to determine in case going below or perhaps to Halong for 1 day.

reviews.author: traveljunkiecris
reviews.title: Best way to see the cliffs
reviews.content: Worth every penny and minute! The boat ride through the grottoes and caves of Trang An is easily one of the best things you can do in Vietnam. Cost is 200,000 dong per person and there are 3 routes to choose from. We did route 1 - which included 6 caves and 3 pagodas. Route 1 was amazing and definitely wish I had more time to see the others.

reviews.author: Nicolai
reviews.title: Impressive
reviews.content: Really impressive nature. Definitely worth the way and the entrance. Recommend a boat trip through the caves

reviews.author: Varun_723
reviews.title: Worth A Visit
reviews.content: My Wife and I had a nice time visiting Trang An Grottoes. Each adult ticket cost 200,000 dong, the entire ride lasts about 3 hours, and there are 3 different routes to choose from. Based on what our local guide told us, Trang An is definitely better than the Tam Coc boat ride, with the latter being full of vendors forcing you to buy souvenirs or snacks. In Trang An, when you buy your ticket and board your boat, it's just you and the rower. It's usually 4 people to a boat, so unless you choose to buy 4 tickets, you're probably going to be sharing with 2 others. Each of the routes have designated stops where you'll be given anywhere from 5 to 20 minutes depending on what there is to see, which is good since sitting down on the hard seats can be painful after a while.The most interesting part of the ride are the tunnels where you may need to duck down in certain parts. Personally I felt the temples started to look pretty similar but the tunnels were something different. The entire experience in Trang An was very peaceful and relaxing. Getting on and off the boat can be tricky especially if you're tall, so stay low for better balance.

reviews.author: Zingle
reviews.title: Lovely, but beware of the heat
reviews.content: It sounds idyllic to be rowed gently down a small river, surrounded by karst mountains, and it certainly is beautiful, but I found I'd had enough after a couple of hours. Although we went quite early, arriving at 10am, it was very hot, so do take an umbrella. There is respite from the sun in the caves, but the novelty of staying low to avoid the roof quickly wears off. This boat ride is very popular, so arrive early to beat the crowds.

reviews.author: Hannah Proud
reviews.title: Absolutely stunning.
reviews.content: Even on a grey day, this boat tour is absolutely amazing. Easily one of the most beautiful places I've ever been. The tour is about 3 hours, we chose to do route 3 (3 caves & 3 temples) but you can choose other routes that stop off at more temples and caves. (These routes are outlined at the ticket office on arrival.)The places we stopped at were epic though. One of the caves was around a 1km long and we had to duck our heads down so much to get through - was awesome. I was also mega impressed with our lady who rowed us along, she was basically non stop for 3 hours (and we must have been heavy!) and she was insanely good at steering and manoeuvring through the caves. Hats off to her!

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.title: Insanely busy!!
reviews.content: Great sights...worth the visit if you can handle the crowds. It was a Vietnamese public holiday when we went and it was ridiculously busy! There would have been nearly 1000 boats out!

reviews.author: Melanie M
reviews.title: Trang An Grottoes tour wins!
reviews.content: If you are deciding whether to tour Tam Coc or Trang An, I would advise you to tour Trang An.  It's a very well organised boat system, all ticketed so transparent pricing, no-one seeking to sell us anything/take photos/ask for tips.  The kids enjoyed the trips through the caves and seeking Kong Skull Island. The scenery is incredible, an amazing day out.  The kids also enjoyed picking up the paddles to race against other boats!!

reviews.author: Rage185
reviews.title: Stunning Sites
reviews.content: This tour is close to 3 hours long but went by way too quickly. The views are spectacular and when you mix in the caves and many stops to pagodas it makes for unmatched beauty.

reviews.author: matt66London
reviews.title: What no one tells you. This natural wonder is man made.
reviews.content: The karst peaks are inland and have remained so for millennia, but the boat ride. Ah that is different.The water course you go around is a man made theme park style attraction. Soulless and mechanical. They dug the trenches around the peaks, filled it with water, cut a few caves through and behold you have a theme park. Destroyed nature Feel satisfied?

reviews.author: laura c
reviews.title: Just go
reviews.content: So lovely. Made friends with our guide. We are going back to Ninh bing just to see herExpensive for the day but I’dF you get into the spirit of things, it’s fine

reviews.author: suzieslapcabbage
reviews.title: Stunning scenery
reviews.content: We went fairly early, about 9am and upon the advise of our guide chose option 1. The boats usually wait for 4 before heading off but when we arrived there was a solo traveller from Germany waiting, whom we joined and luckily we were sent on our merry way with only 3 in the boat. The first part of the trip was with many boats but after a stop at a temple we basically had the rest of the trip by ourselves. It was beautiful,very scenic, tranquil, awe filled at every corner. The caves, mountains and calm waters were absolutely stunningly. We viewed many birds, lillies, fish, a wedding photo shoot. There was no pressure to tip (although we did) or to buy anything. A totally enjoyable and highly recommended activity in this truly beautiful part of Vietnam.

reviews.author: Joanna P
reviews.title: Fun boat ride
reviews.content: Best thing was going through the 1 km long low ceiling caveVery hot with life jackets which are compulsory

reviews.author: Bulbul
reviews.title: A true gem of Vietnam
reviews.content: The best mode to get here is by train, preferably the one that departs from Hanoi at 6 in the morning. By reaching Ninh Binh, you will be able to avoid the tourist crowd that comes by bus or taxi from Hanoi. They generally reach by 11 am. From Ninh Binh, the last train departs at 16:51.One tip here – Go and book your tickets to and from Ninh Binh from Hanoi railway station as soon as you enter the city. The ticket price is 110000 VND per person. Do not book tickets from your hotel. They will charge a hefty commission. Also, please note that the tickets cannot be booked online using any other card but a card registered by a bank in Vietnam.Once you reach Ninh Binh station, book a taxi for the whole day till your train time which should not cost more than 600000 VND.  You can also choose to rent bike from the station for about 150000 per day. However, taxi is comfortable and feasible if you are more than 2.Go to Trang An first straight from the station. The ticket counter is across the main entrance. The ticket cost is fixed at 200000 VND. There are total 3 routes to choose from, go for route 2 as it is more balanced with the number of caves and temples it includes.Trang An, also a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is pure and untouched. I personally loved Trang An more than Halong Bay. Ask your boat rower to just stop rowing for a few minutes in between to experience the peace. You will be in a different world. Trang An is less touristy than Tam Coc which is a big advantage.

reviews.author: Ruth D
reviews.title: Beautiful scenery, very interesting
reviews.content: This was a really interesting place, and the lady who rowed our boat was very nice and friendly.  It's amazing how hard working these boat people are, taking you through the maze of caves and water in a wooden boat rowed manually.  The caves were very interesting, and there are several stops to tour temples, etc.

reviews.author: Dje35
reviews.title: A wonderful ride
reviews.content: An absolute-must tranquil river boat ride meandering through the breathtaking surroundings of “Halong Bay on land”. CAUTION: avoid the Hanoï day-tour crowds by going early or late. Overnighting nearby, we (3 families with 7 kids) opted for a late 4pm start and were all by ourselves for a very peaceful and magical experience.

reviews.author: Tieu Cam
reviews.title: Must go place
reviews.content: I really really like this place. An unforgettable experience. Remember to bring water n an umbrella/hat w u, it is really hot when we r on the boat

reviews.author: rz7692
reviews.title: We loved it
reviews.content: Went with a friend from my hostel and we loved it. Easy walk from Easy Tiger. First you buy a ticket and then you go board a boat. We found 2 other nice tourists to join us. The boat is comfortable with 4 but definitely possible to squish 5-6 if you try. We chose route 1. We thought the caves were very cool, less impressed by the temples. Some of the caves are super low and you have to duck to go under. We wanted to finish the tour on the quicker side so we all helped row. It took us about 2 hrs and 15 minutes.

reviews.author: chutotoro
reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.content: My favourite of my Hanoi trip! I would say it was better than Halong Bay. We took a small wooden boat with an operator who will row the boat. The whole journey took us up to 2 hours. The scenery was nothing short of stunning. Along the way, we were treated to serene lush green scenary and emerald waters. We rode through a few caves, some so low that we had to duck our heads. Each passenger also had a roe to row the boat. We also had fun competing and interacting with neighbouring passengers. There were 2 stops along the way that passengers can embark if you wish to. One of them led to the filming set for the movie King Kong. I would you at least stop at one so that the boat operator can take a break. It was a lovely experience, I would highly recommend tourists not to miss this!

reviews.author: Shimnik
reviews.title: Boat ride
reviews.content: I had a day trip from Hanoi to Ninh Binh province and one of the activities during this tour was the boat ride. We took a boat with a roar in Tam Coc. Overall it was 1.5 hour ride through a few lime stone caves. Do not expect tranquility, there are many people, who take this tour. The landscape are similar to Halong bay but instead of sea you have rice fields and a river.

reviews.author: Emelye W
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: This place is amazing. We went early in the morning which was definitely the right decision as we only saw two other boats whilst we were going around. When we were coming back there were tons of boats leaving. We went for route one. Views are amazing and the caves are really great to go through. Highly recommend, great way to spend a morning

reviews.author: Tracy P
reviews.title: Leisure boat trip to see Vietnam old temples
reviews.content: Join the local day tour to Trang An including boat trip and cycling. You can spend a day there. Boat trip is quite leisure and the beautiful riverside scenery is beautiful but looks like Guilin. There are some old temples along the riverside. My guide is not honest and the tour package is a fixed price with all expenses inclusive. But he cheats us to pay the entrance fee again.  Better look clear the terms of day tour package before pay and alert.

reviews.author: Anna A
reviews.title: Beautiful day!
reviews.content: This was a morning well spent, it was a peaceful boat ride through the grottoes and temples. Plenty of opportunities to stop and walk around at the temples and learn more about the history and culture. The scenery on the boat ride was beautiful, and the grottoes were incredible to see!

reviews.author: alohabic
reviews.title: beautiful
reviews.content: we all enjoyed this relaxing beautiful boat ride, we really love the few times we got to get off the boat and walked around, the view is stunning, the weather was perfect in April, the only bad thing was there were so many boats but that is the price we had to pay for such a beautiful experience, so anyone who goes here expect a lot of people!!!It is definitely worth the wait.

reviews.author: binonatrip
reviews.title: Beautiful scenery while being rowed around this area
reviews.content: I had never heard of the film Kong:Skull Island before going on this trip. We spent a very pleasant hour being rowed around this very scenic location before having time to land and walk about seeing the reconstructions of the film areas.

reviews.author: daesquiv
reviews.title: Simple amazing
reviews.content: Definitely one of the highlight of Vietnam. Some say it is the inland Halong Bay...we actually skipped Halong bay to spend more time in Ninh Binh and many people said it was a smart move. This place can appear a bit touristy and crowded but honestly once you get in the boat you will all be rowing in different directions so really there is not that many people. We were getting off the boat in places where there were literally just a few more couples walking around.You can choose between different caves to go to, although you don't get to choose which ones...you can go to 3, 5 or 9 caves(route 1)...we took the 9 caves route and it was perfect. I have to say at some point it felt a bit confined but once you got the hang of it, it was really great.If you are a couple, chances are you will share your boat with another couple, not like in Tam Coc where you can have a boat just for you but it's quite okDon't miss this!!

reviews.author: Albywon
reviews.title: Beautiful Caves
reviews.content: We took a rowboat from Tam Coc Harbour through the Grottos, the trip takes about an hour. There are lots of very pushy ladies at the far point after the grottos trying to sell drinks, food and various wares but as long as you stand your ground (so as to speak) they soon move on. We didn't let them ruin our enjoyment of the trip.

reviews.author: D.Rocha
reviews.title: Absolutely breathtaking!
reviews.content: We arrived on foot from Tam Coc around 4 pm. There was no line to buy tickets. We are a family of 5 so we had a boat all to ourselves. We chose tour nr. 3 (out of recommendation from the guy checking the tickets just before getting on the boat) and we believe we did the best choice. We have visited many caves during our trip around the world but this grotto under the huge limestone cliff with al those stalactites was just breathtaking and unique. We did not take the boat tour in Tam Coc but we walked along the lake instead. We toured Halong and L. Ha bays and Thrand An is definitely worth it especially taking into consideration the price!

reviews.author: Suzies927
reviews.title: Highlight of our trip!
reviews.content: On advice from our hotel, we headed to the grottos at 2pm, allowing us to finish the 3 hour ride with time to cycle home before dark. There was no queue at all and we got a boat for just the 3 of us.The scenery is just gorgeous and I must say, the only waterway I have seen in Vietnam with no rubbish at all!Although our rower spoke no English, she was kind and happy and was able to communicate what to do and where to go.I was worried that our 6 year old might get bored in 3 hours but she loved it as much as we did. Really worth the trip!

reviews.author: Novilia Sjafri B
reviews.title: Trang An boat cruise.
reviews.content: Beautiful landscape of limestone. Excited to pass through the caves. Profesional boat ladies. Beautiful pagoda on the island. But the stairs to the kingkong film area, were not convenient, no handle of the stairs,difficult for a person with leg or knee problem. Also for ederly.

reviews.author: ZBH88
reviews.title: Visit over halong
reviews.content: We visited the grottos after a visit to halong bay and were in awe of its beauty and lack of rubbish unlike that of halong bay. We had a very lengthy kayak ride of tranquillity for many a while to the set of the kong skull island set and many a small temple. There were life jackets provided for adults and children. The entrance fee was 200000.

reviews.author: AnniK0210
reviews.title: One of the highlights of our trip
reviews.content: Beautiful. We went in the morning when it wasn't so crowded yet. That also meant it was cloudier. That was good for no sunburn but not so good for photos ;)We did the boat ride number 2 and it was great to ride through those caves. Some stops where we got of weren't so great. The lady who was rowing always tried to tell us stuff but we just couldn't communicate with each other very well.

reviews.author: Kaylene S
reviews.title: Absolutely Stunning!
reviews.content: Trang An was absolutely Amazing!! We visited in February and it was a gorgeous day with very few tourists which made for a most peaceful and serene day for us. This place is just stunning with the beautiful scenery and amazing caves. Our guide was very patient and accommodating as we explored the islands. Most boats take four people, but if you pay for three spots, you can have a private tour for the two of you. We felt the cost of approximately $8 per person for 3 hours of exploring this amazing place was worth every cent and more. Trang An rivals Ha Long Bay for the most beautiful scenery in Vietnam and is Much less commercialized. We would go back again in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: Gary T
reviews.title: Beautiful, recommended over Tam Coc
reviews.content: We did both Trang An and Tam Coc during our stay in Ninh Binh.  Having done two routes (1 and 2) in Trang An, I can’t see any reason why anyone would choose Tam Coc over either of those routes.  We did not have any problems with aggressive peddlers in Tam Coc (just people on boats asking us to buy stuff, like photographs or snacks).  Yes, someone did try to get us to buy something for our boat driver, but we said ‘no’ (3 times) and she went away.  Although we did buy some mangoes from her for a dollar.  We said no to the photo lady, but when she told us it would be one dollar per photo, we decided to pose for a photo and see how it came out.  Considering what you pay at amusement parks and other attractions, a dollar didn’t seem so bad, and we got a great photo of our family that we couldn’t have gotten otherwise.  But even with this pleasant experience in Tam Coc, the scenery and experience simply can’t compare to Trang An.  In Trang An, we had route 1 pretty much all to ourselves (done at 8:30 am on a weekday), although we shared route 2 with a fair number of Vietnamese tourists (8:30 am on a Saturday).  It seems local tourists come on weekends, and route 3 was the most crowded route.  But when compared to Tam Coc, which we did during a Friday evening, even the most crowded points in Trang An weren’t so bad.  Tam Coc felt like a lazy river, with one boat after another all in a line.  If Trang An weren’t right in the same area, I’d happily endorse Tam Coc.  Tam Coc is beautiful, and we didn’t find the peddlers too bad, but if you only have one place to visit, Trang An is much better.  There are more caves, the scenery is just as good, and you can get out of the boat a few times to see temples and other sites of significance.  Overall, it’s just a much better experience.On the tipping and other ways that people are trying to make money, my advice is just go in with 10 dollars worth of Vietnamese money, and view it as the cost of enjoying your day.  Like I said, the photos cost a dollar.  A bag of fresh sliced mangoes cost a dollar (and was delicious).  A ‘good’ tip is four dollars.  A very nice tip is eight dollars.  If they give you a survey asking whether you were asked for a tip, check ‘no,’ and give them a tip when you return the survey, so you don’t have the awkward post-survey tip request.  Don’t let a few dollars ruin your day.  If you are lucky enough to be able to afford to be generous, be generous.

reviews.author: Lya_amar
reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.content: Amazing place to connect your soul with nature..:) Lovely place but go there early in the morning or late evening to avoid harsh weather.. Boat ride is cheaper than Tam Coc but expensive than Van Long.. The scenery is great :)

reviews.author: johnnyGreasby
reviews.title: DIY from tam coc
reviews.content: Jumped a green (metered cab), worked out 120000VD (about £5). Got there early is 9am, no queues, paid for ticket at ticket office across road passed all hawker shops (got no hassle from them). Opted for route 1 as advised by several staff, awesome trip with details available on other reviews.Tried to tip the rower but she forcibly refused, think her boss may have been looking, actually made me feel worse than not tipping!Anyway, would well recommend & am going back tomorrow to do route 2 or 3(Jumped on the Tam Coc one later last night, nice trip, but 1.5 hours compared to 3 and rower pretty much demanded a tip)

reviews.author: Adrienne A
reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.content: We chose route three. Floating under the grotto was so much fun. You don't need a tour guide just get a taxi from your hotel and it's easy to get a ticket on your own.

reviews.author: Adam
reviews.title: Best part of the trip
reviews.content: I can't express how beautiful this boat ride was. The park costs 200K VND for an adult over 1 meter tall, then the boat ride is free. There are three routes with varying degrees of caves, route 2 and 3 take you past the Kong Island filming site (which in retrospect probably shouldn't influence your route choice to be honest). You go through secluded little coves, see temples, and in caves. I absolutely loved it. It takes 2-3 hours, 4-6 people per boat so if you're solo you'll be paired with someone else. There are a few toilets on the route at stopping points. I'd wear a hat or sunscreen if it's sunny out. Of note, try and avoid on the weekend if possible as it gets CRAZY busy. I went at 11am on a Friday and it was reasonable, i drove past at 9am on Sunday and the line was absurd.

reviews.author: discodivaboogie
reviews.title: Great trip
reviews.content: What a lovely peaceful way to spend 3 hours, being rowed down the waterways between the limestone mountains.I chose Trang An over Tam Coc as I was put off due to all the reviews about being hassled for tips. And it was the right thing to do. Our lady never asked for a tip and there was no one trying to force sell anything along the way.You get your tickets 200.000 VND pp from the car park (you have to pay 15.000 VND to park your motorbike) and then go across to the river and wait to be put in one of the boats depending on which trip you choose. We went in march at 14.30 so it wasn’t very busy which was great but it was cloudy but warm (visibility was OK ) Then you stop at a few temples along the way, where you get out to stretch your legs, through some caves and then a stop at skull island. There are toilets at every stop but have to pay to use them. There is also snacks along the way that you can buy.It’s definately worth doing, the tranquility and views are beautiful. And if you do it slightly later in the day once all the day tours have gone you’ll have it practically to yourself.

reviews.author: VietSense Travel
reviews.title: Lovely boat trip and stunning view!
reviews.content: We visited in Sep when the weather was quite idea with clear sky & sunshine. There are 3 routes for your boat trip but we decided to take the medium route #2 as our kids wanted to visit the Kong Island. The boat took us up to the Trinh temple (south end of the Quy Hau cave), went west and made a wide loop, then went back through Hanh Cung Vu Lam and the Kong Island before reaching the boat dock. We all enjoyed the trip in spite of the hoards of tourists which made the boat went very slowly sometimes. :)

reviews.author: marthaemi
reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.content: This is a very lovely day trip to take from Hanoi.  There are three routes to choose from, we choose #3, and it was perfect.  The grottoes are really the spectacular.  I heard it can get very busy.  We were there during the week and didn't have any issues but our tour guide told us that it can get so busy that they stop selling tickets.  We did stop at Skull Island which was fun to see.  Restroom and snacks at all the stops, which was nice.  It was also nice to have an opportunity to get off the boat to stretch our legs, which was a bonus!

reviews.author: poppy500NZ
reviews.title: Make sure you visit
reviews.content: Buy tickets at the booth past all stalls ( on the rhs of the road- opposite side of the road to the water). You queue then are seated to the side until there are enough doing the tour you want to take We were in boat 818- take note of your number so you remember your boat when you hop out at the templesWe were told our 2 hr trip would have no stops but it did. I’m glad we didn’t do a longer trip as it would get boring It’s a pretty place that’s awe inspiring for the feat of building in these remote locations but a tourist trap- a steady stream of boats moves before you You have to wear a life jacket in the boat If it’s hot ensure you have your skin covered or an umbrella Toilets cost $2k to use, there are shops selling ice cream etc at some of the temples Great experience except the boat lady asking for tips after you have completed the questionnaire which questions exactly that

reviews.author: BriCharJaLay
reviews.title: Aggressive boat rower, tried to shorten route.
reviews.content: We visited on a Sunday, so we were prepared for the hoards of tourists. We were assertive with getting onto a boat and were not forced to wait until the boat was full. We selected the 1st route, which included 9 caves and 3 temples. Our rower bypassed the 1st temple, claiming it was part of the 3rd route. At the 2nd temple, she insisted we take 15 minutes, but you have to climb some pretty steep steps to get to the site, so it's not a 15 minute stop! We vowed to take our time at the next temple but found it underwhelming and at ground level, so no point there. Finally, she began to head back and I realized she had cut our tour short (we saw all 9 caves and they were spectacular!). We pointed to our map and insisted on being taken to the 1st temple she'd skipped. She again claimed she didn't go there ("không đi!"), but I called the hotline # posted in the boat and talked to a staff person. The rower started yelling angrily at the staff person, at us, and then to other nearby rowers!! She did eventually take us to our 3rd temple, but what a hassle. Finally, she stupidly gave us the feedback sheet then insisted we give the completed form back to her. It says right on the sheet not to (there's also a question about whether a rower has shortened your ride). She got VERY aggressive and started lunging at both me and my husband, insisting we give her the paper. We started rowing frantically back to the wharf because she would not let up.  Eventually,  we got to shore, stood up to get off... AND SHE STARTED rowing away, again shouting at us to return the paper (there is a box you're supposed to drop it in). We had two small children with us and they were nearly knocked into the water.  I walked straight to the staff area and reported the rower again. Such an awful experience. Loved the scenery and tranquility, but wow, what was that about?

reviews.author: Kim Le
reviews.title: Kong fliming location
reviews.content: Enjoy a great landscape with moutain and water in a small boat makes u fee relax and thanks for Mother Nature. This place was set for Kong fliming location. One boat can be carried for 6 people and the ticket is 200.000 VND/person. A must see.

reviews.author: Loc N
reviews.title: Beautiful boat ride
reviews.content: Despite the adverse weather (one of the heaviest rainfalls day in March?) we enjoyed the boat ride No #1 very much. Hopefully will have chance to revisit Trang An to try Boat ride No#3 + No#2. One big regret: at the end of the boat ride, the rains came pouring down heavy, everyone were fast to jump off the boat, ( ourselves included ) thus we forget to tip the boat lady 2 x 20.000 vnd for her fantastic effort. Please forgive us. Next time, we'll tip before the boat ride finish.

reviews.author: Bob_Reviews_NL
reviews.title: Awesome, well worth your coin
reviews.content: Visited the Trang An Grottoes on a Friday morning. After reading reviews, we made sure to go bright and early, which worked out great, we had no waiting time at all and also at the various stops it was not crowded. Simple summary, must visit when in the area! It’s truly breathtakingly beautiful nature! The caves are great and exciting, make sure to duck your head! For 200.000d per pax this was great value for money. We did tour #1 and it took us around 2.5hours.

reviews.author: Elly
reviews.title: Come here early in the morning
reviews.content: If you dint want to stand in line be crushed by hoards of tourists (that are prone to pushing and such) you should come here as soon as they open and avoid the weekend (many locals come here, they push too). Anyway, it was great. The least interesting part was the Kong Island thing but the rest was great. We chose option three and enjoyed the ride through the 1 km grotto the most. The scenery is amazing and you should come here if you are in the neighborhood.

reviews.author: boscobobbie
reviews.title: Lovely mysterious, start early
reviews.content: Many many boats and boaters, gets extremely crowded later in the day. We were lucky to go on a misty day real early, no waiting, but I sure wouldn't want to see those amusement-park metal queues filled with would-be boaters. Must be a three hour wait at capacity! Tour 3 goes through the really long cave. Be prepared to duck down.

reviews.author: Stephenie T
reviews.title: Boat ride under the Mountains
reviews.content: Picturesque boat ride through the stunning Ninh Binh landscape.  This place gets busy, but we were able to get some calm waters since we arrived before 9AM.  Here's how it goes: You get the opportunity to pick from 3 different routes.  Once we select the route you want you get placed on a boat with at least 4 people total.  We were lucky enough to be paired with a nice couple that was very willing switch each stop so we could take turns at the front of the boat.  Once you set off you're taken through a number of caves and 1-3 different stops that are mostly temples (one route has a film set from King Kong).  The whole trip takes about 3 hours, but you're not on the boat for the entire time.It was an enjoyable morning and I definitely recommend it when in the area, but get there before the tour busses.

reviews.author: nikkiMojacar_Spain
reviews.title: stunning scenery ! and great staff
reviews.content: stunning caves , we were so lucky the sun was shinning and we had great company join us and a fantastic lady rower , it was just perfect !..it wasnt too busy ( january ) we felt like we had the river to ourselves ..a magical day i would repeat !

reviews.author: JosephAndrew_Lim
reviews.title: picture tells a thousand words
reviews.content: Magnificent view. Definitely MUST do this World Culture & Heritage Site.Go in the early morning at 5.30 am  to avoid the crowd. You will see bee line at the ticket counter and then  while waiting for the boat.Ticket at VND20,000 and there are 3 routes to choose.Each route is about 3 hours.Route 1- 9 caves & 3 spiritual placesRoute 2- 4 caves & 3 spiritual places (Most preferred)Route 3- 3 caves & 3 spiritual placesGet ready your camera and enjoy the ride.

reviews.author: Keiron R
reviews.title: Awesome experience away from the crowds
reviews.content: My wife and I caught the morning train to Ninh Binh and apron arrival easily grabbed a taxi to the Grottoes for around $4 AU. Ninh Binh is a large rural town with plentiful options for eating, transport and accommodation. On arrival we purchased our tickets to our choice of boat ride ( 3 options) all of them are equally beautiful. The boat ride is peaceful and very enjoyable. There are many Grottoes and mountainous casts along the way ( approx 3hrs in total) after that we had lunch then was feted across to Hang Mua scenic point which is amazing ( you can also grab a taxi for around $3 AU) the walk and caves are beautiful and another boat option at Tam Croc if you’d like another outlook and experience. The walk back to Ninh Binh via Phuc Son is awesome... ( beautiful village atmosphere with rice paddies and rural living)... you can also do the taxi again if the walk isn’t your thing. We had an amazing day out but would recommend the cooler season ( November- March).

reviews.author: planetawdrodze
reviews.title: Unique
reviews.content: This is incredible amazing! We had to wait in a very long queue but it was worth it. Cruise is very interesting, calm, and nice. Totally recommend to see trang an grottoes!

reviews.author: Sam E
reviews.title: Well worth it
reviews.content: We did Trang An Grottoes boat ride, Route No. 3.  We were advised by our hotel Manager that routes 2 and 3 had the most spectacular caves.  So we chose no. 3, as most people seem to do no. 2.  I have a brochure and it says that Route 1 is 3 hours long and goes through 9 caves and 3 spiritual places.  Route 2 is 3 hours long and goes through 4 caves and 3 spiritual places and the Kong film set.  Route 3 is 3 hours long and goes through 3 caves and 3 spiritual places and the Kong film set.  We were there late afternoon and during the week so did not have to queue up, so jumped on board straight away.  We voluntarily picked up the oars and assisted the woman the whole time.  That was part of the fun and we had fun trying to overtake the other boats too.  One of the caves we went through was 1km long - amazing.  The caves were very interesting to go through and the scenery on the trip was really beautiful.  The only thing I was disappointed about was that we didn't row through rice fields on this route 3.  I don't know if the other routes go through rice fields.  Due to this we also did the Tam Coc boat ride to experience this.  I have to say the Tam Coc boat ride, in my view, is not a patch on the scenery of Trang An, nor are the caves anywhere near as wonderful.  Also the Tam Coc one goes back through the same caves, whereas all the Trang An boat trips do not.  I should also point out that my other half is claustrophobic and I was a little concerned about this.  Only at one point did he feel a little unnerved about an upcoming part of the cave being quite low, but as we got close to the area, it opened up and so he was absolutely fine with it.  Our rowing lady was great and she did not ask for a tip, but we gave her one just prior to arriving back at the dock.

reviews.author: Bryanvdk1
reviews.title: Gorgeous views, peaceful tour
reviews.content: Props to the woman who was rowing our boat...she went all out for 3 hours taking us to amazing religious sites and through gorgeous caves.

reviews.author: Nancy A
reviews.title: Relaxing ride
reviews.content: This was a very relacing boat ride with wonderful views of the limestone formations as well as the 1000m cave.  If any fault can be found it is that it might have gotten a little too long with too many stops at temples. The "Skull Island" movie set from King Kong movie was a fun and unexpected surprise.  Also keep in mind that Saturdays you will find it to be quite crowded with local Vietnamese so that made the lines a bit long. Overall it us worth the few hours to relax and take in the beauty of the environment.

reviews.author: Nicolas
reviews.title: Great mountain, lovely boat trip, perfect relax
reviews.content: Great mountain, lovely boat trip, perfect relax and sleep at hoalu eco homestay with swimming pool and dring at Eco mountain bars

reviews.author: Lee A D
reviews.title: Graceful row through amazing nature and history
reviews.content: We had an overcast cool day today perfect for a peaceful boat ride through otherworldly geological formations dotted with lovely temples.  Although there were a lot of people on the river, it did not feel overwhelming or crazy.  Most of the other visitors appeared to be from Vietnam who laughed and enjoyed themselves but who also honored the spiritual nature of the surroundings.  We opted for the second option that included 4 caves and 3 temples, and were happy with our choice.  Our oarsman spoke almost no English but it did not matter.  The beauty and uniqueness of the setting is hard to describe.  We feel this is a must see place if you are in North Vietnam.

reviews.author: Davise3
reviews.title: Visit Trang An complex stay at Hoalu Eco Homestay
reviews.content: The best choice Trang An boat tour, this pleace so nice then visit MUA cave, Hoalu Ancient Capital . Best than Tamcoc

reviews.author: freddy
reviews.title: Nice boat trip
reviews.content: The best choice Trang An boat tour, Tam Coc, Hang Mua in Ninh Binh. One of best stay at Hoalu  Eco Homestay

reviews.author: limedex
reviews.title: Well worth the price and time
reviews.content: Lovely journey across the grottoes for a good price. Highly recommended. There are 3 routes to choose from, make sure you know which one you wanted to see, and most of them will take you to a shorter route so they won't have to paddle for long.

reviews.author: Eduarda
reviews.title: Must see in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: We have been there on Monday, February, around 11.30 and did not have to wait at all. The river was not too busy as I imagined and the landscape and caves is something I have never seen before. It was cloudy but it has an atmosphere anyway. Our rower gave us paddles but we were not forced to paddle actually - I feel it is just for fun and you do not have to do it. We loved the place and nature a lot! The rower did not ask for tip but we gave her 50k (two people). I do not understand this discussion about tipping rowers - if she is perfect, does not ask for tip and two dolars makes her happy, why not? In other countries people usually tip much more for less work.

reviews.author: Mark V
reviews.title: Its a tourist armada but worth every minute
reviews.content: On the day I was there the crowds are enormous and the wait maybe 30-45 minutes but once in the water in your own boat (no more than 4 people) the beauty of the area takes over and even though there are hundreds of boats in the water it is quiet and majestic.  You enter the cave portion single file and keep your head down.  There is no sense of being rushed allowing you to take in every magnificent image.

reviews.author: Jonas M
reviews.title: This is why you come to Tam Coc for
reviews.content: You pay for the entry and for the boat, this together with MANY many others. That being said, it’s really a unique piece of nature that can best be seen from the water. Really special how the women row the boats, by their feet. (Come a while after closing time to find a very willing lady to make the trip at half the price, and only a few returning people. Unique, but you do come back in the dark)

reviews.author: Roxanne L
reviews.title: Quite a queue but great scenic boat ride
reviews.content: Go really early or after lunch? There are a huge amount of tour groups at the queue that snakes on n on.we queued for about 40min. But overall the view is worth it.We took route 3 with the low ceiling caves where u need to lower ur heads else u get a bad bump.Went on a foggy n cold day that made the hills looks mystical. Awesome view. The longest cave system is on route 3. And some stops for the buddist temple. As well as a visit to kong island.No need to tip the boat lady. There r paddles on the boat that we can use to row abit faster 🤣 had a small rowing competition w other boat near by.Took appox 2hr. Just on the route.

reviews.author: Sarad
reviews.title: TRANG AN
reviews.content: It is amazing but I suggest you to reach Trang An during the early morning when it is not crowded. You will enjoy calm, silence and nature sounds. And don’t forget to check the weather: prefer sunny days to enjoy shiny colours.

reviews.author: Mike H
reviews.title: Stunning Tourist Machine
reviews.content: All the photos are true though don't come during high season because there will be WAY too many people queuing in a metal maze that makes Disneyland look like the corner store. Recommend route 2 for a less hectic experience.

reviews.author: Caryn Jen
reviews.title: Nice but You Have to Help Row The Boat!
reviews.content: We tried Trang An instead of Tam Coc boat tour because I read online that Tam Coc has lot of scam. Parking is across the road (VND15,000), take the ticket and pay when you exit. Upon arrival there is 3 boat tour to choose (Tour A, B and C). We choose B because it covers Skull Island and caves. I can't exactly explain what are the routes but C takes the longest and A doesn't cover Skull island.Can't remember the entrance ticket is between VND100,000-200,000/pax depending on which route you choose. After paying for the ticket walk over to the dock, you can't miss it because a horde of people there waiting to board the boat.It's super chaotic, tell the guy/lady that looks like they are in charge which route you choose because they put people who chose the same route in the same boat. and they will only leave with 4 people. I don't see 6 when i was there, max was 4.Shortly after departure, the boat lady pointed to the oars, and asked us to help her row =.= This is probably the most unrelaxing boat tour i ever took because i finish it feeling tired. All 4 of us helped to row but of course the 2 people behind us occasionally rowed and even if they did it was like doing nothing. We tried asking her things like how long is the tour or where is she taking us but she just smiles.Anyways fast forward we arrive at Kong Island, it's not really exciting but just nice to have a few shots here and there but that's it. The boat lady was waiting at the end of the Skull Island set, so make sure you remember your boat number. She passed us a survey form for us to fill about our comments/what we think about the tour. In that form there is a question, did the boatman/lady ask for a tip, i circled no because at that time she didn't ask for any. VERY SMART INDEED! At the end of the tour when we arrived, she suddenly is able to speak english and ask for a tip but we ignored her, her face immediately turned sour and is no longer smiling. I'm not tipping because we did not have a relaxing boat ride and we had to row with her almost the entire tour which was about 2 hours long. See what I mean by smart because it is true that when you fill up the survey she didn't ask for tip, she ask for it after you fill up the form. So fill up the form at the end of the trip so you can give an accurate review.

reviews.author: su5ie96
reviews.title: 4 stars
reviews.content: Really enjoyed the boat trip, only given 4 stars instead of 5 because at the end he asked for a tip. We were going to tip anyway but thought it was a bit cheeky.

reviews.author: Kassa
reviews.title: beautiful but touristy
reviews.content: exceptionally beautiful scenery, but many tourists.  KIng Kong set was a bit of a joke, but didnt matter as we didnt go for that!  Amazing to paddle the boat through the caves, but watch your head!

reviews.author: Willaim S
reviews.title: Avoid Avoid Avoid.
reviews.content: February is a no go for this attraction, unless you like 2 plus hours in a disorderly que then a squashed wait while you are herded across the road and gates closes behind you on the connecting bridge. This is then a bun fight to get a boat with 6 people and join the other hundreds of boats on the river. This is not the idilic leisure cruise you think it will be. Tooooo many people and boats. Even if you arrive at 8.30am. Sad but its just too popular.

reviews.author: pink00flamingo
reviews.title: Good option when it's sunny
reviews.content: This was part of a tour I had arranged and I was really looking forward to it.  There are 3 river tour options depending on what you want to see.  They all take between 2-3 hours and cost the same.  I would recommend using the loo before hand and stocking up on water and snacks.  The ladies that row you about are not allowed to ask for tips but as this is really hard work for them I would suggest that you do tip - but before you get back to the pier in case the money you give gets taken off of them.

reviews.author: smallasapeanut
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.content: We did this as part of a day trip excursion...so everything was arranged for us.  That said, it appeared that it would have been very easy to find the Grotto area as it was well sign posted.  Boats are "overly" plentiful...thankfully for us it was not very busy on our day....I would hate to be there if all the boats were out!  So it would be very easy to always get a boat.  It appears you need to take the boat with 4 people (incl of oneself) this was my only criticism as for us we were sat behind the other couple which does impair ones forward view somewhat.  Perhaps if you are on your own you would be able to negotiate over this and no doubt pay more....but its so cheap so it would be worth it!The tour lasted just over 2 hours....You have the option to be dropped at a "skull island" which was used as a film set in a King Kong film where the remnants of this are still evident....in my mind i don't think this part was at all necessary and detracts from the sheer natural beauty of its surroundings. You are peacefully rowed by the single effort of a small yet seemingly powerful woman through the awesome scenery and through caves (be warned you do "need" to duck right down in some) there is something to see at all times.Very highly recommended

reviews.author: Jalal Iqbal
reviews.title: exploring by boat
reviews.content: these caves and places are amazing. and going there with a nice and cool boat ride made these places even better. felt like in a smaller ha long bay. i spent like 2 hours here and loved it much.

reviews.author: Faithforever98
reviews.title: Great boat trip
reviews.content: There are three routes you choose, despite being in the correct lineup for route 1, and being asked 2 ce which route.  We ended up on a route 3 Sampan, to be honest, it was very very busy with têt.  Our boat had four passengers and it was glorious, through caves and to pagodas, also route three takes you to King Kong movie set.  We heard the gvmnt had tried to discourage tipping so there’s a questionnaire.  Haha, we filled out the questionnaire and got asked for tips, after we handed the completed as ‘no’. ‘Did your baoatman ask for tips.’ Very crafty.haha.  3 hours great trip.

reviews.author: JSRees
reviews.title: Halong Bay on land.
reviews.content: we really enjoyed this tour. We had just visited Halong bay and felt this was very similar but at a much cheaper price (and smaller boat of course). Its well organised. parking is 15000 and tickets are 200000 each. Choose which route you want to do and off you go. Rowers should not hassle you for a tip. scenery is stunning and it was fun going through the various caves. Its obviously a tourist attraction so can get busy but we arrived at 10am exactly and there weren't many others on the water (this was during tet so maybe that had an impact). if youre unable to see Halong bay then visit this site, or if you just want to view a beautiful part of vietnam then again visit this place. Hopefully you will not be disappointed and enjoy it as much as we did.

reviews.author: youbloodytourist
reviews.title: Incredible experience!
reviews.content: Had a great experience in Trang An. This is definitely the most 'commercial' of the boat activities (the others being Van Long and Tam Coc) - but it's also the most interesting. Temples to stop off during the trip, 9 caves to go through (some over 300 metres long), it's a great way to spend 3 hours.

reviews.author: Zeni S
reviews.title: Ninh Binh is absolutely, one of the best places to visit in the world. We visited it in February 2018.
reviews.content: Gorgeous trip and one of my most memorable trips.  It is a wonderful place to be de-stress and let the world go by.

reviews.author: Michaelbel
reviews.title: Great
reviews.content: Fantastic experience. Very touristy but very good. You get rowed around a fantastic place by a middle aged woman

reviews.author: Raena Reddy
reviews.title: TranAn grottes fabulous afternoon
reviews.content: So after reading all the scary reviews of boat people and hawkers asking for money, being unhappy and threatening the cusyomer....after much trepidition ...we decided to do TrangAn. I must say that the govt or park officials have moved in and rectified the whole scene.  We were 6 of us. They gave us 2 boats of 3pax each. I wish it were two pax so that the lady rower didn't have to work so hard. Anyway there was no haggling or asking for a tip. In fact I was given a feedback form on the boat asking me to rate the trip, to state whether I was asked for a tip and whether the lady had shortened the trip in any way. Well the answer was no on all counts.ni fact we had a fabulous time racing the other boat. Each boat or sampan comes with extra oars - so you can row too....and I think that was half the fun!! The route 1 is the way to go. We toured all 9 caves. And it was amazing. I am told there is not much difference in the tamcoc caves and these and that intact TrangAn has the best caves. It was a tough call for the lack of time to choose between Halong and Ninh Binh...and I am so happy I chose ninh Binh. The place was empty. There were just two other boats out. It was so quiet. There were no luxury liners sitting the place with 100s of tourists. The main part of the ride was the interlacing of the treks and pagodas that made this trip culturally so far superior that I didn't regret not going to HaLong. In fact some of the islands have UNESCO ratings and are SIMPLY AWESOME!!! I wish we could have spent more time there. Being Tet we had the entire place to ourselves!! However the downside of Tet was that the car companies charged me more....bit WORTH IT!!! Imagine having the place all to yourself!!!?

reviews.author: BethyB
reviews.title: Amazing sceneey
reviews.content: Very cool few hours boating around. Caves can be a bit claustrophobic - one of them was 1km long & low ceilings

reviews.author: borhancikgu
reviews.title: A hidden gem in Haoi
reviews.content: I visited Trang An Grottoes on a day when Hanoi was blanketed in thick pollution. Surprisingly the air here was clean and not a sign of pollution. This is where the movie 'Kong' was shot but it has more than the location of the shooting. Take a boat ride and it is amazing. Only experiencing the ride will tell you the beauty of this place. You pass caves, limestone cliffs scattered all over and the beauty is just feast to the eyes. There are 3 routes available for the boat trip and depends on your taste. I took the 2nd route which took me to the location of the shooting og Kong. There is nothing much here called skull island but it is worth seeing the locals here. Don't miss this gem if you are to visit Hanoi.

reviews.author: Judie O
reviews.title: Gentle paddle
reviews.content: Charming afternoon amidst beautiful scenery. Quiet time of year so not that many other boats. My husband was very overexcited by film set of Kong Skull Island. Cheery lady rower who asked for a tip without actually asking!

reviews.author: Marie C
reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.content: What an amazing place. So calm and beautiful we did route 2 and we were happy with our choice. Going through the caves is brilliant and the boat driver made us laugh with "head down! Head down!" You really do have to duck down!! We had the boat to ourself as we were the only people doing that route at the time but other people were 4 to a boat. I was nervous getting on and off the boat but she made it easier by 'parking up' sideways and onto the steps and holding my hand to get out. She didn't ask for a tip but we gave her 20k at th end. One of the highlights of our month in vietnam.

reviews.author: Dave B
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.content: The day before we did the boat tour in Tam Coc, DON'T do that one, what a scam! Trang An tour was just amazing, beautiful scenery, very quiet, beautiful stops (temples) and through the caves. We did tour 2 and which lasted 2,5-3 hours. Just wonderful!

reviews.author: winsern
reviews.title: Beautiful day
reviews.content: Lovely weather (20c) for day tour out of the city. About 2 hours away from Hanoi, Trang An (長安) is a nice and peaceful getaway from the hustle and bustle of Hanoi. Wasn't a fan of Kong Island movie set though

reviews.author: Oren A
reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.content: The boat tour was nice but it’s very touristy. Do not expect to be there alone. It was not very crowded when we were there as it was very cold and cloudy, but we had a group of yelling Chinese around us at all times, which was quite annoying.We opted for tour nr 3. The caves were nice, the temples were okay and the last part, which is where they shot the King Kong movie is a waste of time.The area is very beautiful in terms of nature and the boat ride is pleasant. Our boatman was friendly and smiled all the time.We did have a bad experience at the motorbike parking area though. They charge an outrageous 15.000 dong for motorbike parking, but okay, this is Vietnam. When we came back to the motorbike after the tour I realized I didn’t have the key. I must have left it in the ignition I thought. I asked the guy there if he had found the key in my ignition and started looking through a bunch of lost/forgotten keys in his desk’s drawer. We found the key (it’s obvious he’d taken it) and then he demanded we pay him 10 USD to get the key back. Only after I threatened to call the police he gave me the key. It’s quite unbelievable the scams they come up with in this country and unfortunately too many people fall for them and pay, which is why they keep on doing it. So what were the 15.000 dong for if not for him to take care of the bike?!

reviews.author: Richlen
reviews.title: Go and you won’t be dissapointed
reviews.content: Came here as a part of my Ninh Binh tour. Was unsure to choose Thrang An over Tam Coc at the beginning. Lucky I made the right choice. This place is out of this world, so beautiful, the water is kept very clean, very serene. We got route 2 from the tour, but I actuality prefer route 1 as is longer route and you will be passing more caves. We did tip the boat lady even though she didnt ask for a tip. Rowing 4 ppl in that boat for 2.5 hrs is a hard job, I think she deserves the tip. The Kong movie set is a bit weird to me, but the shrines are beautiful and worth a look. But the setting is breathtaking. I went there in mid january during low season, the sky was cloudy so lucky for me it wasn’t a hot day and not many tourists!! Be prepared to pay 2000vnd to use the toilet.

reviews.author: sjamesd19
reviews.title: Must do experience
reviews.content: Definitely earns its label of a UNESCO World Heritage Site. You might have to do some of the paddling but it is well worth it haha. I was a little spoiled on my trip to Vietnam. Having seen so much natural beauty before I visited Trang An, but this still felt magical.

reviews.author: CamTVoyage78
reviews.title: Mountains of the Vietnam
reviews.content: Mother nature's is incredible, mountains of the Southeast. Boat traveling through the mountains is like being in the new King Kong movie which is where this place is filmed. The view is amazing especially going through the 1000 m cave inside the mountains. It's worth the entrance fee.

reviews.author: Song_Chuang
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: Take a boat trip to go along the river & enjoy amazing scenery of limestone karts...that's an amazing experience!

reviews.author: Rohan12d
reviews.title: Trang An - Boat ride
reviews.content: A must visit place if you plan to visit Ninh Binh. The location is great, surrounded with some spectacular views. It has most of the amenities. (Be prepared to spend 2000VND for using the toilets) There are shops and a restaurant if you are hungry. Be prepared to spend around 2hrs for the boat ride. They take you to different spots where you can hop off and explore the place. There are 3 routes to chose from. We went with route 2 which seems like the most favoured route.

reviews.author: OB
reviews.title: Beautiful sites, go early in the morning
reviews.content: Beautiful site and interesting boat rides (number 2 is the best!). It is very popular, so go early in the day to avoid the crowd. The restaurant on site is not great (very slow service and so so fare).

reviews.author: pomodorini
reviews.title: Amazing amazingg
reviews.content: The cold didn't stop us from getting this boat ride which was nothing short of amazing. We went in the morning where there were tourists but it wasn't too crowded. We chose route 2 which was a mix of temples and caves. The whole experience was magical, going through the grottoes was amazing. Our boat man skilfully navigated through the the nooks and crannies. It was peaceful, tranquil and the sights were just amazing. would highly recommend even if there are lotsa tourists, definitely an unforgettable experience.

reviews.author: mark
reviews.title: Best sight in Trang An
reviews.content: Probably the best and most impressive attraction/sight in Trang An I’ve seen. Beautiful scenery and tour albeit the horde of tourists. Did seem like a tourist trap but wasn’t bad. We booked a driver from our hotel in tam coc to visit the grottoes. Did not need any ticket reservation. Whole process and your packages was easy to follow and experience.

reviews.author: Matt M
reviews.title: Magical boat tour!
reviews.content: A wonderful experience - thoroughly enjoyable! You will not forget this trip!  Take lots of photos! ************+*********+*+++++++

reviews.author: roger1250
reviews.title: Amazing place.
reviews.content: Don't miss this.  Its a highlight of any trip to this region.  One tip, as a couple, go in the mid afternoon as there are less people and a higher chance of  not having to share a boat.  We did Line 1 which is the longer tour and is recommended as fewer take this one and you are more likely to have this terrific tour to yourself.

reviews.author: postscript65
reviews.title: Marvellous scenery and peace
reviews.content: Arrive early to avoid the masses - there are 2000 possible craft. We toured route 2 which takes about two hours with a few stops. Kong Skull Island is a favourite because of King Kong but we enjoyed the furthest place with temples and walks.Ducking through the smaller grottoes is fun but can be low - so watch your head!Our oarsman was very skilled and we helped him paddle.We were a little late for the birds but they are around in the dense undergrowth with small animals which have escaped the hunters.Very well kept; excellent facilities - just skip past the old crones at the toilets!

reviews.author: Laura S
reviews.title: Route 3 boat tour
reviews.content: Spectacular visit! In our opinion this spot beats Ha Long bay. Gorgeous views and fun trips through caves. We were able to get on and off the boats to explore pagodas and temples. Well worth the trip to Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: Holiday-lah
reviews.title: I would rate this 6 stars
reviews.content: This is the must see in Tam Coc, Ninh Binh. The view and scenery is so spectacular that I couldn’t imagine such a thing actually exist on earth... it is beyond ordinary!I would not spoil your trip here by revealing everything. Just go! You have 3 routes to choose from...we went on route 2. Totally worth the money!

reviews.author: matamatablondie
reviews.title: Spectacular and peaceful
reviews.content: Amazing scenery, temples and culture. Many stops to appreciate the culture and tranquility of Vietnam. Cabes were amazing. Fantastic guides.

reviews.author: Christine L
reviews.title: Worth the time spent
reviews.content: Worth every minutes spent on the water! Were recommended to take tour#2 by a local (3 tours available).3-hour row-boat ride as we chose to spent more time at multiple temples and/or historical sites-great history lessons for the 2 teen boys:)).Weather was perfect- clear and bright sky, slightly cool as we started out early in the day. Recommending you bring hat, sunblock or umbrella if starting out later in the day or hotter months.In awe of the pristine and beautiful Mother Nature, riding thru the grottos/caves. Highly Recommended.

reviews.author: Jim_atl
reviews.title: Beautiful and Unique
reviews.content: I took this boat trip as part of a day trip from Hanoi.  Four of us sat in a small boat and were paddled around by a woman for two hours.  The weather was excellent and the scenery was impressive.  We went into caves and went through limestone rocks.  More than halfway home we stopped on an island where a recent King Kong movie was filmed.  The only downside to this tour was sitting in a small boat for two hours.  But it was worth it.

reviews.author: Adrian Lee
reviews.title: Beautiful scenic landscape and caves
reviews.content: Did route 3. Very skilful and pleasant lady rower.   Lake is beautiful and clean. Spot a idiot smoking  while been rowed thru the lake. Beautiful caves. Beware of Low cave ceiling. Was totally blown away this tour. 200k/pax, 4pax/boat, 3 routes to choose from. Very organise and clean place. Must do while in Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: Lulu_Dee3
reviews.title: Fantastic! I'm claustrophobic and I didn't freak out
reviews.content: I was a little hesitant about doing this boat trip as I knew that with any of the three options we would have to go through caves (the grottoes) and I am not the biggest fan of small, dark places particularly when they're full of water.However, I'm so, so, so glad that we did this as it was so beautiful and not scary at all.We choose route number 2, which included 4 grottoes, 3 pagodas & the King Kong movie set. The whole journey with our guide was fantastic and he was very kind and lovely.
