reviews.content: It was a unique experience visiting there with my family. The boat trip along the river and under the several caves was very breathtaking and really recommend all to try this out. This place is a little bit far away from Hanoi but should not be missed. One of the highlights was stopping at kong island (where Kong movie was made) and we had a chance to see the movie set which was exciting and they still had the tribes that they used during the movie was made. Really worth to visit.

reviews.author: BlackiesGirl
reviews.title: One of the best tour in Hanoi and our holiday
reviews.content: We arrived around 9am before the large crowds as suggested by our Tour Guide Tuan. He was not wrong by the time we arrived back to the dock it was overly crowded. We took the 2 hour 30 minutes tour in the tiny row boats, rowed by a wonderful local lady, if you like you can assist in the rowing I am not sure if this helps or hinders her with the steering!!!. There are over 1,000 of these tiny boats in operation there, not all out at the same time though. Just rowing up towards the caves we felt like we were in a mini Halong Bay with the landscape looking very similar, absolutely incredible scenery. The multiple caves that we went inside were up to around 350m long and they were just lovely, you need to watch your head in some and remember to duck inside the caves. The whole place is worth the drive from Hanoi to see it, I am so glad our tour company Insider Journeys put this on our tour whilst we were in Hanoi. A great day out.

reviews.author: marie_ashworth
reviews.title: Amazing Eco System
reviews.content: Visited the Trang An Eco Complex ...an outdoor geological museum, with numerous caves, mountains, valley water, trees and historic relics.A great morning out cruising the lake system by a small row boat to explore this amazing habitat.We spent 2.5 hours out with our guide who waited patiently as we explored some of the stops on the way. The grotto systems under the limestone mountains were awesome.You really had to duck down low in areas so you didn't bump your head ... But that was part of the adventure. What I enjoyed most was once you came to the end of the grotto the light danced in front of you creating a magical picture.Nature .... A very lucky day for us, very few tourists. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Kevin S
reviews.title: Boat ride with a difference
reviews.content: We both really enjoyed the boat tour but were thankful we got there at 8am as it was already getting busy. I would also recommend taking one of the shorter routes (2 or 3) as this was still 3 hours which I felt was long enough. The scenery was spectacular as we were paddled through 3 caves and visited 3 temples along the way. Getting there is a bit tricky as the area is very rural- we took a taxi which was only about £6 from Ninh Binh but you can hire a moped if you're feeling brave!

reviews.author: Vivien C
reviews.title: Trang An Grottos - amazing
reviews.content: Went on a Monday.   Hotel advised not to go on the weekend as out would be very busy.   Lots of people but not overly crowded and no line ups.   Caves were amazing.   Loved it.

reviews.author: tonytD9568SZ
reviews.title: Lots of fun rowing thru the caves
reviews.content: There are 3 different trips you can take see pic. IF you have the time route 3 is the longest and suggested by our Ninh Binh guide to take this route. Glad we did very magical if you can put blinders on to all the boat loads of people at the starting point. Once you're out it's not so bad.You'll go thru the Grottos and can stop to hike up to to temples and overlooks ( maybe at one time but overgrown now) but still worth the effort.

reviews.author: Yue Ling
reviews.title: Magical caves
reviews.content: It was truly a must visit to the Trang An Boat Tour!We arrived pretty late for the tour (About 4pm) and were arranged with the locals for the boat tour.The moment we enter the caves we all went "wow", truly magical feeling!There were a total of 9 caves and 3 stops along the way to the local Temples.Would advice to go for the tour in the early morning rather than late evening because the locals will spent much time visiting the Temples and we end up rounding off the tour half an hour late (We were the last boat returning and our motorbikes almost got confiscated!).Evening/Night can be quite cold so get a jacket if ure not cold tolerant.Amazing ride!

reviews.author: Jack87machel
reviews.title: Splendid landscapes
reviews.content: This spot was so nice with natural and wonderful views.  We took a boat and go around this place,  discover some caves.  And we both said that it was so awesome. Giving us a feeling of calmness and peace.

reviews.author: exquisitektc
reviews.title: Gorgeous and Worth the Time
reviews.content: We arrived bright and early to hop aboard first thing in the morning before the lines of tourists. In short, this place is absolutely worth the time. I do not have a photo of the map but we went with the second route and just so happen to either be ahead or behind boats all the time. Always perfect timing.The caves are really neat. The grottos are unbelievable. Just absolutely gorgeous scenery.The only downside was the young local crowd--screaming and yelling and acting like college kids on a field trip to a brewery or what. Other than that, truly a world heritage not to be missed.We clocked out at about 2.5 hours and that was nearly rushing. Could have easily spent three hours.

reviews.author: bluemarvin
reviews.title: Fantastic Scenery
reviews.content: Incredible scenery - waterways wending their way between cliffs and through caves (some very low). Lovely way to spend a few hours + some stops to see temples and climb to viewpoints. Boats usually 'manned' by women - OK if a little tricky to get in and out of - we were happy to help with the rowing - but not compulsory. Probably best to avoid peak times/days - we got there 8am on a Tuesday - no queues at all.

reviews.author: Chris R
reviews.title: Sour experience
reviews.content: Visited on a Sunday, extremely busy. Unorganized lines, people with no manners, people cutting lines and shoving. There’s tons of police/security authority but are useless in preventing a massive stampede or orderly conduct. Getting a boat is more of a freak show, you need to be aggressive or you’ll be waiting hours to finally get into a boat. There are 3 routes you can choose from but It was difficult to determine if you were on the right route as there is no one to assist you or speak English for that matter. Our boat driver was pretty bad, lazy rower, she crashed twice into 2 other boats, rowed towards rocks inside the caves (boat 863). Aside from all this disappointment, scenery is quite beautiful. Although, does not compare to the limestone mountains in the Philippines or Thailand. Go after 3pm to avoid the vast amount of tour buses and be prepared to come across very rude locals.

reviews.author: Andre P
reviews.title: Worst experience on trip so far in South East Asia
reviews.content: Unorganized, rude local people and rude and un-pleasant lady rower(Boat # 836). I been traveling for 1 month now, and this is the only downfall of my trip so far. I think it has to do more with very un-pleasant lady rower, she cheated us and didn’t let us go and see King Kong Island, but she let the local Vietnamese go and experience it. That was the main reason why I went to do the boat tour in Trang An. Also the lady rower was lazy and made me and my friend do all the work while she smirked. Also be careful, my head almost got cut off in the caves because the lady rower(836) could not navigate the boat properly, and she was running it in to the sharp rocks formation angrily trying to run us over, not to mention she crashed into 2 other boats. She didn’t speak english but I over heard her laughing at us and I felt she was making fun of me and my friend. The boat number was 863, please don’t get on this boat. Also hopefully management can read this and she can be reprimanded.The caves and limestone rocks are not as impressive as El Nido, Philippines. This place is overrated. Westerners and tourists need to go to Palawan and see the real thing. The scenery is still nice, but just not comparable to other places in this world that is alot more quiet, relaxing, and beautiful.

reviews.author: House Steed
reviews.title: Just do it!!!
reviews.content: - We arrived at 8h30 and there were lots of people already but the lines and boats filled up quickly. No waiting! - Tickets were 200 000 VND per person (February 2018)- Our lady rower was friendly and spoke to us via the Vietnamese couple sharing the boat with us- The karstic mountains are breathtaking upclose. The caves are low and dim so watch your head- Best part is that it is unspoilt and not polluted with plastic crap- The King Kong movie set is fun to take pics at ( you can see the boat and the village of the aborigines and actual extras that acted in the movie posing as aborigines)- We helped the rower paddle with the extra ores on board- life jacket was provided and tip was not mandatory but we gave 100 000 VND because the 3 hour experience was perfect. - Prepare to pay to use the toilets at the temples though...2000VND- We got some awesome pix and at times it got incredibly quiet on the river. Overall we had a blast of a time. Worth the travel

reviews.author: L_K1509
reviews.title: Beautiful scenery
reviews.content: My husband and I did the tour which went to 9 caves over two hours. We did route one. To start with the site was extremely busy due to Tet, but luckily even though the queue was long it moved very quickly. When we first got onto the water it was very busy with many other boats. However after about 15 mins the boats disperse and it becomes much quieter. We had no interest in the King Kong island and our lady rower asked us and so we avoided it. Some of the caves have very low head room so you need to duck. For two hours she rowed through the caves. The scenery is beautiful and relaxing, apart from a numb bum!We were happy to give a tip to our lady rower. At the end of the boat trip there are shops and toilets, the toilets are 4,000 dong. Very cheap but worth having change.

reviews.author: Karishma S
reviews.title: Amazing boat trip
reviews.content: We've been in Vietnam for over 3 weeks now and must say this is probably one of the best things we've done so far. We took route 2. The views are spectacular, so peaceful and serene. We first went to ticket counter before 10 am thinking we'll miss all the big tour groups but we were terribly wrong.  Being tet holiday the line up was massive. They said we'd have to wait about 3 hours. We skipped this and went around Tam Coc in our scooter instead and went back at 3 PM. It was basically empty then, also it was much clearer and not hazy. We shared the ride with two other visitors.  The views are really magical, beautiful caves, temples....I read some people complaining about not getting to go on just the two but I'm sorry this isn't a private boat specially when hundreds of people are waiting to get on for hours. Anyways my tips are go later but not too late that it gets dark when you come back, umbrella or poncho may come  in handy, take lots of pics.

reviews.author: sebsonamission
reviews.title: Wonderful, a must do!
reviews.content: Beautifully relaxing with an amazing backdrop. Slowly rowed down a river through mountain caves... extremely low ceiling, stalactites hanging down with low lit roof creating a lovely atmosphere. You stop off a few times to see temples. Lots of waking up and down mountain's to secluded locations. You might even see kingfishers on route!

reviews.author: Terry Kay
reviews.title: ONE OF THE MOST PEACEFUL PLACES EVER!!!
reviews.content: It was absolutely gorgeous being there that time with the friends. My friend and I took a boat for 4 of us and it was a fun and relaxing time on the river. This looks like the second Ha Long Bay honestly, nice weather, green irelands,...We did through 4 big and long caves and one of them was  not high enough for 1.75m tall so we had to lay down on the boat and kept manking some great photos, videos,...LolDefinitely should go to this when you have a plan in Vietnam, middle of Vietnam especially 🇻🇳🇻🇳🇻🇳

reviews.author: cameronanzo
reviews.title: Surprising Spot
reviews.content: This was really amazing place, I wasn't expecting the UNESCO heritage site to be so well maintained in comparison to Halong Bay with so much rubbish. This place was very pristine. While going down the River from the boat, you can spot some of the mangrove birds, the scenary of the limestone cliffs is also very enjoyable. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Ishimiagi
reviews.title: Wow wow wow!!
reviews.content: This is a must when you visit the area! We had a lovely trip with a helpful lady that was always smiling. The grottos are breathtaking! The only downside here is that you have to be four people to a boat, so you may be placed with people who are noisy or inconsiderate.

reviews.author: Ami7878
reviews.title: ancient times splendor
reviews.content: Terrific sailing trip. The boat woman is very skilled and polite. The view is unbelievable and the quietness on the water, inside the caves and between the mountains is making you the happiest man in the world.

reviews.author: InaMann
reviews.title: Great outdoor activity with the whole family
reviews.content: At first I was really sceptical, as I was travelling with 2 small children (age 2.5 yo and 4.5 yo). The thought of being on a small sampan for 2 hours with my active boys seems scary. But we "gamble" and had so much fun together. My boys enjoyed the cave visits, as well as the Skull Island stop. We however opted for the shortest route and time possible (approx 2 hours including 1 stop at Skull Island). Honestly, reading 2 hours seems super long but doing it doesnt feel that long. Before you know it the tour is over. We paid VND800K/ boat; and happily tips USD15/ boat as these boatman really provide a good service and it would be only 1 row per every 2-3 days for them due to the huge number of boats on site.

reviews.author: Carol P
reviews.title: Breathtaking !
reviews.content: My 20 year old son and I were amazed by the beauty and calmness of this area. BTW we went in the morning, less tourists. Our rower didnt speak english but he smiled a lot and had us fill out a satisfaction form at the end of the trip. Also there were no vendors pushing us to buy souvenirs which was lovely. On other canoe rides in the area that seems to be a big problem. We loved it so much, I d go back a second time.

reviews.author: Simonfss
reviews.title: Pleasant ride
reviews.content: Our lady rower was passionate about showing us the grottoes as well as giving us lots of fun. She stopped us at the island where you could see Kong skull island where the King Kong movie was made. It was quite a walk to the other side of the island where she picked us up and we thought we were getting lost. Maybe a few more signs on the island would help. A very pleasant trip!

reviews.author: ctmlondon
reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.content: This was a most amazing trip.  A ride in a small rowing boat. expertly rowed by local women (mostly) who otherwise work on their farms.  The limestone karst scenery was truly beautiful and gliding through a number of caves was also a great experience.  I wasn't too lucky with the weather which was completely overcast and grey.  With blue sky it would have been an even more stunning experience. Tip: it gets very busy with locals on Sundays.

reviews.author: laia
reviews.title: Most beautiful region!
reviews.content: unexpected and extraordinary visit. for us was a MUST. so amazing, calm and enjoyable environment. Spend at least 2 days around

reviews.author: 93Stleew
reviews.title: Beautiful lanscapes
reviews.content: Trang An Grottoes was so outstanding and picturesque. We visited some caves, and it was so incredible. The atmosphere was quiet and relaxing. Must go in Vietnam

reviews.author: drg1923
reviews.title: Do this one instead of toc poc
reviews.content: Visited in Feb and it was perfect. A lot better than the other caves . Not so touristic and it was quiet so you can enjoy it all without that many loud Asian tourists ... you know which ones I mean.Might seem a bit pricey for vietnam at 200k but worth a lot more to be honest. Oh and no annoying sellers or photographs and the lady's rowing don't try to guilt you into leaving a tip nor do they ask for snacks.

reviews.author: Beesy1950
reviews.title: A must visit - great boat trip
reviews.content: Four to a boat and you are rowed along in tranquil peace for about 2 hours, going through about 8 caves - some you have to lay almost flat to get under.The women who row are so strong and give their arms a rest by rowing with their feet.There is no pressure to tip but I would recommend giving a tip.

reviews.author: RamboRazor
reviews.title: An Incredible Boat Ride
reviews.content: An Amazing Beautiful place  Trang An in VietNam. This place is very famous for its scenic beauty, boot ride ans temples. The boot ride is an enjoyable journey of almost 2 hours in the river where you will have mountains in your way but there are natural  tunnels under those mountains to cross them. But mind it, the ceiling of tunnels might be really low that you shall have to lie down in the boat to save yourself hitting them and sitting in boat might give you injury. Dont worry the staaf is very sweet helpful and guides you all the way along the ride and wont let you get hurt but will make you enjoy more with them. You can help the rower during the ride to row the boat so that they can just save their energy and you get a good experience of rowing. This place also offers food and there are temples as well on the way. Do not miss to tip ur rower...its actually a great task to row whole 2 hours. This place is easily accessible, I went there from Hanoi. You can take a bus ride or take a tour guide/agent to help you. Enjoy

reviews.author: MichalaPulisova
reviews.title: Must see
reviews.content: This place is absolutely amazing, The best what I have seen during traveling in Vietnam. I visited this place on February so not a lot of tourist around, so we could enjoy beautiful and peaceful nature. You can also take a spare oar and help rowing, which in our case end up in the small competition with other boats in the end of the tour. We visited 3 caves and the Kong skull island. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Chulanga
reviews.title: Just Incredible !!!
reviews.content: It is simply incredible. We visited atleast 3 caves and the views are magnificent. Highly recommend this if you like to see beautiful sceneries.

reviews.author: bmkutok
reviews.title: They Call the Grottoes, Ha Long Bay on Land
reviews.content: A visit to the Trang An Grottoes was part of of our private tour through Vietnam, Lao and Cambodia.  The drive down from Hanoi was pretty the further south we traveled.  The Grottoes, however, were amazing.  Much of the area you boat through were once rice patties that the government permanently flooded and made necessary alterations to some of the caves.  Former farmers, who are mostly women, row the boats and now have permanent employment all year long.  For almost 2 hours you pass silently through caves and around towering cliffs covered with dense forests.  Each turn of the bend unveils another majestic sight.They even used some of the sights for the new King Kong movie.  You can visit the sights as part of the tour if you wish. Having visited Ha Long Bay, in my view, Trang An Grottoes are like Ha Long Bay on land.  It was a wonderful experience.

reviews.author: FeliceAndJack C
reviews.title: A disappointing experience, despite the beauty of the area
reviews.content: Sadly, this was one of the low points of almost four weeks in Vietnam and Cambodia - even though it was one of the most beautiful places.  It was a very frustrating experience.  I think partly it’s luck of the draw in terms of what boat you end up on, but also I think things there could be better organized.  Visitors have a choice of two different tours. My husband, daughter and I LOVE caves and are totally uninterested in the Kong: Skull Island movie.  So we paid for the tour that included 9 or so caves, *not* the one that included fewer caves and the Kong movie set. After you pay, there’s not a line to get in for one tour as opposed to the other - people are there to lead you to a boat.  After we had been on our journey for awhile, the woman rowing our boat (who spoke no English) pointed in two different directions but we didn’t understand why.  She then held up one and then two fingers, but we didn't understand what she was asking.  We finally realized she was asking which tour we wanted. She asked us “Kong Island?” and we emphatically said NO and shook our heads no.  We ended up going through several caves and the last of a couple of stops was Kong Island.  We couldn’t believe it.  We said “No, no, NO Kong Island” but she insisted we get out.  (BTW, at no point is it explained at the beginning when we bought our tickets or when we were on the boat that we’d be dropped off in several places and were supposed to meet our boat on the other side of the island. We were just supposed to figure it out.  Odd.)  So, there we were - unwilling visitors on Kong Island.  It had been raining and the path was slippery and muddy. There was no choice - we had to cross the small island.  Up stairs and down stairs. Through the movie set area, complete with people in costume near huts who would pose for a photo.  Exactly the sort of thing we were not interested in, so we just kept trudging along the muddy path. We were pretty cranky by then. Later, near the end of the tour, we were given a survey to fill out.  It very clearly said at the top to hand it in once you were off the boat.  I filled it out and put it in my bag, and the woman rowing the boat motioned for me to give it to her.  I pointed in the direction of the end of the tour, which we were nearing, but she was upset and insisted I give it to her.  Also, after the first stop, she stopped giving us the life jackets to put back on.  It was strange. We looked around and all the people on the other boats were still wearing life jackets.  All of these little things made for an unpleasant time. And we were unhappy we didn’t get to see all of the other caves. So, is the tour worth doing?  Yes, it’s stunningly beautiful.  Just don’t have high expectations that you will get the tour you chose and paid for… if that’s okay with you, go for it!  A little effort for better organization and clearer communication would go a long way here (certainly it wouldn’t be hard to be given a small piece of paper with a number on it when you pay for the tour, that could be given to the person rowing the boat, or have two separate lines to get in before boarding the boat, depending on which tour you paid for). In contrast, by the way, we had a wonderful experience the previous day on the Tam Coc boat tour (despite at one point, people aggressively trying to sell us snacks, drinks and souvenirs), with a really nice person rowing our boat.

reviews.author: Marla R
reviews.title: We traveled by boat along the river. Only were able to see 2 of the 3 caves. Also can see where Kong Skull Island filmed
reviews.content: It is so beautiful and serene here. They have boats with rowers who take you through the river and caves. You have to see it to believe that places like this exist!

reviews.author: Bianca C
reviews.title: Best trip in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: This has got to be the best daytrip you can do while in Ninh Binh. Me and my husband took our hotel bicycles and cycle to Trang An for the tour. The ticket is not as expensive as the one for Tam Coc and the boat ride is very much worth it. You go on through the river and under several caves and you stop along several little temples on the way. It can take the a whole morning for the long tour, but surely it's worth it. It's just you and the sound of silence.

reviews.author: teleab
reviews.title: Interesting tour. Quite rude and unfriendly.
reviews.content: We arrived at Trang an around lunchtime. We were very much looking forward to this trip after narrowing down all the local boat tours to this one. Unfortunately for us we arrived right when a big tour group arrived and were pared with a small family. We asked if we could just wait and go as a 2, we were told no and repeatedly pulled and pushed through the crowds to a boat with Mum, Dad and little girl. We headed out first which, I think, was lucky. However moments into the trip the girl started crying, which I understand. However the parents gave the girl a phone with a game that continually made beeps and jingles. It was very annoying. They could have put it on silent. I understand too that these people were doing this just as part of a bigger tour. However for us we chose this and wanted a peaceful experience in such a serine place. After we got over this and tried to enjoy our trip anyway. We firstly stopped at a temple to walk around. The family bought popcorn and ice cream. You can only imagine. Ice cream not eaten and popcorn everywhere. The family could also converse with our boat lady so we seemed to be just ignored or pushed and prodded when she needed to tell us something. This is a pretty big tourist attraction and I think they should know at least a few English words to tell us to move left or right or how to duck in the caves etc or even be able to tell you that they are dropping you off to then later pick you up around the corner. Quite confusing. Also it would have been nice to know some history of the clay urns in the caves etc. We were rowed through caves and to other temples where they can rest and vendors can try sell you snacks, drinks and the usual plastic trinkets. As I got back in the boat I stepped near the life jacket sitting in the front (where you enter the boat) the lady abruptly said NO NO NO. I didn’t understand what she was saying no for so I got back off. She moved the life jacket angrily and pointed for me to sit down. This was a bit rude. We were on the boat for about 2hours and my partner was getting a sore bum so he tried to sit on a spare life jacket and again we got NO NO NO. I’m not sure how special these life jackets are but seriously, come on. Also don’t try touch the rock in the caves you get the same reaction. We were going very slow and just wanted to feel the smooth rock. Strange lady. The scenery was lovely and the boat trip nice. I just think we were unlucky with our boat. Half way through the rest of the tour group caught up so the pictures were hard without a number of other boats in them. It wasn’t a busy day and there were, what seemed like, hundreds of unused boats there so I can’t imagine it on a busy day. On our way back we saw several boats with 2 and 3 People in them so were even more annoyed that we were not allowed. The boat lady gave a sheet for feedback straight to the other family who filled everything in as good and great, we were instructed (by pointing) to fill in the “other comments” section. Where we gave feed back on speaking basic English and possibly supplying some cushions. The lady then passed it back to the family for translation and they laughed. I found it quite rude and made us feel very uncomfortable and out of place. So overall we did not have a good experience. I can’t say I would t recommend cause like I said I think we were just unlucky with the boat we got.

reviews.author: hansche07
reviews.title: Through the water caves and enter into another world
reviews.content: This is the lake version of Halong Bay, or perhaps Guiling, China. Beautiful limestone caves, wonderful boat rides through these caves and enter into a different world. if the mist decides to descend upon you, you will have a beautiful picturesque world of islands. Do tip the boat ladies well as the boat journey is about 2.5hrs and they may only have 1 or 2 trips in the winter months.

reviews.author: adib1190 .
reviews.title: Very beautiful place
reviews.content: Since we stayed only for a couple of days in Hanoi, i had to choose between Halong bay, tam coc and trang an. We picked the latter and the choice is something I will not regret. The system of caves and connecting water bodies was so beautiful and serene. The sheer limestone mounds and hills rising steeply from the water are a sight to behold. Called Halong bay on land...it is closer to Hanoi and most tours cover the ba dinh pagoda on the same tour. This way, one can cover nature and culture in a single day.

reviews.author: BobsWorth1
reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.content: Well worth the 200000VND/£6 entry fee. Parking across the street from the main entrance costs 10000VND/30p for bicycles and there are a number of shops and cafes located there too. As many others have said, Route 1 looks the best option with the nine caves. You also visit four temples, which are perfectly fine, but look like they’ve just been built for tourists. Route 1 tour lasts near enough three hours. Probably best to arrive before 9am before the bus loads of tourists rock up. Definitely one of the best places I have ever visited.

reviews.author: Where Is The World
reviews.title: Incredible, even the 2nd time
reviews.content: We visited here 5 years ago and liked it so much we insisted the friends we were travelling with to do it again with us. It was a very quiet day in January when we visited. There were very few other people visiting the grottoes while we were there. I can see, in peak season, that it could become very very busy. That opinion is based on the queue setups and sheer number of little green boats floating at the entrance. It’s a fun way to spend a few hours: zipping with your little boat through all the tight cave waterways. We stopped at the far end for a break and there was a lady singing the worst Vietnamese karaoke I’ve ever heard. I had to walk away so I didn’t have to hear it any more.

reviews.author: Lost_Duck
reviews.title: Splendid
reviews.content: This is the tour of Ninh Binh you are looking for.Tour 1.The tour last 3 hours, and take you through 9 caves and far within the beautiful landscape.Along the tour, you also stop at a few of the temples. Even if you seen temples enough already, thise are places to behold (besides, gives your guide a well deserved rest from rowing).The service is nice and friendly, and they won't push you for money (tips, fotos, gifts, etc.)... wich is the very reason I recommend you leave a nice tip for your hard working guide.Tip: Leave early, before 11am.That is before most tours arrive, and you have a good chance to sail the river "alone".

reviews.author: Nolan P
reviews.title: Little touristy but worth it
reviews.content: Little pricy and touristy, but I hear it's less touristy than the other boat tours around. An experience unlike any other. It's touristy for a reason

reviews.author: Michael C
reviews.title: a fabulous river cruise that surpass Halong bay cruise
reviews.content: A wonderful 2 hours river cruise going into caves and scenic views all the way. Avoid Tam Coc and come here instead, the water is cleaner, better views, better caves and more friendly environment without people harassing you for overpriced pictures, buying food and drinks and tips for boat rower

reviews.author: Chow T
reviews.title: Natural
reviews.content: This is the most beautiful place I have ever visited in Vietnam. This place is so natural and peace. The water is clear and you can see the reflection of the cave clearly.

reviews.author: Shi
reviews.title: Wonderful, not to be missed!
reviews.content: We did this tour on a rather misty day with more or less non stop drizzling throughout. The tour cost 200,000 VND and we opted to do the longer ride, visiting 9 caves with some short stops at temples. Having done the Tam Coc boat excursion previously, I found the Trang An boat ride to be so much better. The scenery is stunning, the rides through the cave, especially the first one (think it was 320 metres), was an experience in itself. The scenery and the ride is essentially what you pay for as there is no commentary from the rower apart from a few words gesturing us to look at certain views. I cannot begin to explain the beauty of the nature, if you are in the area, don't miss it, definitely the highlight of my stay in Viernam so far.

reviews.author: Luzdreamer
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.content: this its one of the most amazing things u can do around the area, not many tourists, but vietnamese... super worth it, number 1, or route number 2. i ended up doing both ! ;)

reviews.author: Cristina V
reviews.title: Not to be missed.
reviews.content: It is expensive. 200 thousand dong per person. It is worth it, though. Completely. I would reccomend!

reviews.author: DaveDColeman
reviews.title: Trang An vs Tam Coc Boat Excursions
reviews.content: If you are pressed for time in Ninh Binh and are considering a choice between the Trang An and Tam Coc boat excursions, I hope this information is helpful.  Firstly, it's possible to do both trips in a day.  I'd recommend doing Tam Coc first as there are significant differences in the experience.  The Tam Coc trip costs VND 150,000 and is well worth doing, but the hard-nosed hawking and angling for tips towards the end of the ride marred the experience considerably.  By contrast, the 3-hour ride around Trang An cost VND 200,000 and was far nicer.  There were fewer boats, better caves, and no hard-sell at all.  We weren't asked for a tip, but tipped our lady anyway for her remarkable effort.  It was an altogether better excursion than Tam Coc, and I wish we'd done Tam Coc first and Trang An second as we'd have ended the day on a much higher note.

reviews.author: jaypep1
reviews.title: Worth a Visit
reviews.content: This is not a tour as the boat driver doesn't tell you anything. There are 2 boat rides to choose from, both costing 200,000₫. Feb.2018. Route 2 is the shorter boat ride taking about an hour and consists of 4 caves/grottoes and a couple of Temples. I chose Route 1, the longer boat ride taking about 3 hours and consisting of 9 caves/grottoes and 4 Temples. Cave/grotto no.7 is the only one you don't go through. The boat driver drops you near the entrance and you walk to the other side where you get picked up again. The scenery is stunning and I'm glad I did the longer boat ride. No one trying to sell you stuff on the water or asking to take your photo as at Tam Coc This was MUCH MUCH better than the Tam Coc Boat Ride. I've kept the best photos for myself.

reviews.author: Raphael
reviews.title: Enchanting visit
reviews.content: Visited Trang An as part of a day tour around Ninh Binh. What an enchanting experience that was! Went there on a very misty day which I thought would partially spoil the scenery. Boy was I wrong. This made for a very special boat ride, bordering on mystical. Landscape is sensational and caves are impressive. In particular, the 1st cave in the long route was something else, stunning and spooky. 2 options for you: a long 3h route with 9 caves and a couple of stops for temples or a 2h route with 4 caves and a stop by where Kong Skull Island was shot. Both seem to cost the same. The boat lady we had was kind.On a final note, Trang An seems to be more regulated than Tam Coc as we didn't experience aggressive selling tactics on boat. Our boat lady didn't ask for a tip, they seem to be prohibited from asking. It is of course ok and recommended to give one though.

reviews.author: WBl
reviews.title: Well worth the money
reviews.content: We went by scooter 15000dong to park across the road . Wonderful scenery even though it rained . Route 1 took 2.5 hours and we really enjoyed it .

reviews.author: Eileen G
reviews.title: Gorgeous place!
reviews.content: There were two options for the boat tour - longer one with Kong island (the filming site of Skull Island) and a shorter one (I'm assuming without the island?). We chose the longer one. The boat ride itself was very beautiful with amazing views. On the island, there was an area with people dressed as indigenous people who you can pose with for pictures (but they ask for a tip). We really wish we would've gone during none-peak hours. We went around 11am and there were a lot of people there and the boat ride was too noisy for us, which distracted from the serenity of the surroundings. The person rowing our boat also kept making loud conversations with other rowers. The other staff members were great - we lost one of our belongings on the boat and the staff were extremely helpful and patient in helping us retrieve it!

reviews.author: Sundoll2013
reviews.title: Nature in most pristine form
reviews.content: I planned to go to this place after comparing it extensively with Tam Coc where I had been on previous visit , and never regretted it . It was just amazing and large dose of raw nature.In rowing boat, out in the water for almost 2-3 hours is just fantastic.You pass through seven grottoes and each one very amazing and different.The lady rowing the boat was so sweet and asked for some help in rowing off and on , it is mammoth voyage to row a boat for such a long time with 4 persons aboard.The landscape is so pleasant and romantic,full of greenery,mangroves and hillocks.Must do when in Hanoi, it is pleasant 90 min drive by Cab, to boat station.Well organised and clean boat jetty.

reviews.author: srkahodgson
reviews.title: Amazing Boat Ride with Spectacular Scenery
reviews.content: Loved this boat ride. We arrived early, just after 9am so it was very quiet before the tours from Hanoi arrived. The scenery is incredible, as the boat slowly makes its way through some impressively long and low caves and around the mountains. Take a torch to get the best out of the caves, as they are dark. We enjoyed that the guide (boat rower) just rowed the boat without trying to make forced conversation. It was much more professional and peaceful than the tours in Tam Coc. This tour was one of the highlights of our trip. The only downside is that the boats seats don't have backrests, making it a bit uncomfortable on your back for 2 hours. It was getting busier at about 11am when we finished the tour. The guide also didn't give the impression that she wanted a tip either, as experienced in the Tam Coc rice fields. We tipped her because she let us enjoy the experience, not trying to make it about her.

reviews.author: thai hoc n
reviews.title: Wonder in lanscape
reviews.content: Hi guys. Trang An is my home town, if you come here and take trips by bike or motor, you'll discover lots of places and visit people in local. I will invite you to visit my home.!!

reviews.author: nataliesX5076KR
reviews.title: Amazing and professional
reviews.content: We went out to Trang an and omg it was amazing. Professionally run. Only negative is that after paying they still wanted to charge us to use the bathroom. We just ignored it and thought it was a fat cheek!

reviews.author: Sh286
reviews.title: Amazing trip
reviews.content: Absolutely stunning scenery, with a fun boat ride through the grottoes. We were given time to explore some of the islands and there was no pressure at all to tip (although we did anyway because the ride was amazing). Best activity we did during a two week trip in Vietnam!

reviews.author: 168rosalbac
reviews.title: Perfect place for cave lovers
reviews.content: You may visit nine caves sitting in a small boat. Not very comfortable but not too bad. Be careful at your head. Landscape impressive. You may admire secret lakes surrounded by the hills when you go out a cave. The tour takes three hours , so may be nice to stretch your legs visiting a small temple on the top of the hill. Rosalba

reviews.author: kelsey e
reviews.title: Must do in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: We absolutely loved our Grotto boat ride. We missed the sign which explained both options so picked the long ride, which ended up being around 3 hours. We went through 10 different caves, went around 10 am when the water lilies were blooming which was beautiful. The whole ride is serene and such an amazing experience! We rented scooters and it was very easy to find, there were not too many tourist when we went, but could see during busy season more tourists could take away from experience. There were temples to see, one involved a lot of stairs. guide did not speak much English so some of stops we did not get much direction but was fun exploring and overall an amazing experience. This is a must do if travelling to Ninh Binh!!

reviews.author: Loes V
reviews.title: Must see
reviews.content: We didn't expect much of this, and thought 200vnd was expensive for a boat tour.. but it was totally worth it and we wouldn't have wanted to miss it! Please make sure to tip your driver, they aren't allowed to ask for tips but we talked to a Vietnamese couple and they translated for us the ladies who steer the boat only make 5 million vnd a month, working 6 days a week, 9 hours a day.

reviews.author: Julian v
reviews.title: Grotto Boat Ride
reviews.content: Amazingly beautiful landscape and cool temples along the way. The boat ride is a bit of a tourist trap (I almost felt like I was boarding a theme park ride). I would recommend the short route as opposed to the long route (We took long. This sounds silly, but it's kind of difficult to be in awe of the beautiful landscape for 3 hours). Try to skip the dumb King Kong set. They sort of make you do all the stops (the temples along the way and the skull island set), but I'm sure you can try to skip. They are really leaning into the fact that skull island was filmed there, but it makes the whole experience even more theme-parkey.

reviews.author: huil_k
reviews.title: Enjoyable 2.5 hours boat ride
reviews.content: The Trang An boat ride is a cool experience we would recommend for all visiting Nin Binh province. It's about a 45min motorbike journey from Tam Coc if you use the freeway. We visited 9 caves through this boat ride. We were told that the Trang An boat ride is well regulated and doesn't have the touting which occurs more commonly in other areas eg. Tam Coc, and we found this to be so. There are local diners around 2km away from the Trang An boat ride entrance so you don't have to wander far to get some grub.

reviews.author: linderlou6
reviews.title: Loved our Boat Trip through the grottoes
reviews.content: This was our first experience in Vietnam. While it is clearly a tourist operation, once we were away from the dock we saw very few other boats along the route. We chose the long tour and it was well worth it! We loved the stops along the way and the grottoes were amazing.  Side note, my 9 year old son left his backpack near the ticket booth and it was too late to return once we realized it, but at one of the stops with the help of an English speaking angel, we contacted the the dock and they spent several minutes searching for and locating the backpack and kept it safe for us until we returned.  It was a great way to begin our trip!

reviews.author: kyra_ha23
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.content: Absolutely loved Trang An! So beautiful, definitely worth the money for the 2hr boat ride. Our guide didn't speak English but she could row like a champ, and maneuver us through the caves so well it was pretty amazing. It was a great way to spend the morning. Get there around 8.30-9 to beat the Hanoi tour buses.

reviews.author: nooge19
reviews.title: Brilliant!
reviews.content: Cycled to the Trang An Grottoes from Ninh Binh which was a nice 30min ride on very flat ground. We decided to visit Trang An instead of Tam Coc as we had read lots of terrible reviews. We arrived at 11.30am and it was pretty empty and didn't feel very touristy. We did route 1 with 9 caves which we would recommend. The lady rowing our boat was lovely and friendly and didn't ask for a tip or hassle us. The ride lasted 2.5 hours and we had some nice stops to walk around a get a drink. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Jenna B
reviews.title: Lovely boat ride
reviews.content: We chose the route 1 boat ride (with more caves and temples) and it took around 2.5 hours. We saw mountains, temples, and caves. You actually go all the way through the low caves in the boat so you must be able to bend over/duck. It was a unique experience. If you want to see all the temples you must be able to walk 10 minutes up and down steps. There are nice places near the boats to wait and rest if you decide not to walk. Our boat driver didn’t speak English and was not friendly. She yelled at us and pulled on us to move a few times. Considering this is definitely a tourist attraction, a couple of vocabulary words to communicate directions to the tourists would go a long way and make the experience much more pleasant.

reviews.author: mikelambertmike
reviews.title: Amazing journey
reviews.content: I couldn’t recommend the river trip through Trang An enough. The rowing is immaculate and the water pristine. The caves are so fabulous with stalactites hanging everywhere that you have to duck down as you pass. Really peaceful glorious afternoon spent here

reviews.author: Andreea M
reviews.title: A must do experience in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: We took the long tour (approx 3 hours) with the woman rower. Amazing experience, the landscape is stunning and the ability of the rower to get us through he narrow caves was incredible! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: kenny078
reviews.title: Excellent boat ride
reviews.content: It was an excellent boat ride. I am surprised that it is not as crowded as some photos here and it is very relaxing. There is lots to see and can be rather romantic. It is scenic and relaxing.

reviews.author: Lee M
reviews.title: Relaxing and also breathtaking.
reviews.content: I chose the long boat ride and I was not let down. It 2.5 - 3 hours long and we ventured into about 5 or 6 caves. Inbetween those caves were stunning landscapes that I have only seen in movies. It was nice to just sit and watch views go by.

reviews.author: yptay
reviews.title: very clean, better than Halong bay I feel
reviews.content: This was really surprising, I wasn't expecting the UNESCO heritage site to be so well maintained (compared to Halong Bay, there were too much floating rubbish). This was very pristine. While going down the Ngo Dong River, you can spot some of the mangrove birds, the scenary of the limestone cliffs is also very enjoyable.

reviews.author: kayldtm
reviews.title: Worth our day !
reviews.content: We took the rowing boat trip through Trang An complex, we went through 9 caves and the place where they shoot the new king kong movie. It took around 2 hours in the beautiful landscape. Even there are some parts made by human still worth the visit. Bring some money with you, even if you dont buy anything but it make sense that give the rower some tip for the long ride.Highly recommended !

reviews.author: stcyaudry
reviews.title: Must experience!
reviews.content: My family and I went here on a tour after going to a pagoda (forgot the name). It's basically you get on a boat which can accommodate four people and a local will row the boat for you. It's a two hour boat trip and you'll get to experience the beautiful waters, the amazing views; mountains, limestone caves. It amazes me how the locals were so skillful in rowing the boat especially when we went through the cave with a lot of turns. We took had the opportunity to experience the movie set where they filmed Kong : Skull Island which was premiered in 2017. It was a down to earth experience.

reviews.author: BeHappy2015
reviews.title: An absolute must see !!!!
reviews.content: This place is amazing.  Ten times better than Halong Bay.  The tranquility and serenity of the place is an absolute must see.  The view is breathtaking.  We were in Halong Bay yesterday and had a day to kill before flying out of Hanoi.  Ninh Binh is just 95 km from Hanoi and is about 1,2-2 hour  car ride (cost 800,000VD one way).  Entrance is 200,000VD per person. Included in the entrance fee is a 3 hour boat ride.  Let me just say, it’s as close to paradise (if you love nature) as you can get.  There are 9 amazing caves and temples during the route.  The boat operator was amazing.  He showed us different things along the trail and took us to many beautiful scenery.  We went in January and it was misty and drizzling but it didn’t dampen the mood nor the picture taking. I can’t imagine this place when the sun shines.  The intensity of nature would burst.  It is highly recommended  for everyone.  If you only have one day and have to decide on Halong Bay or Trang An, pick the latter.  You won’t regret it.   I promise you. Did I mention that this is a UNESCO spot?

reviews.author: Emma402018
reviews.title: Beautiful grottoes and landscapes .
reviews.content: It is very beautiful nature caves far away from busy city where you can forget all worries about your tire urban life.

reviews.author: jewel838c
reviews.title: Beautiful Scenery on Route 2
reviews.content: We did the Route 2 which visited 4 caves and the Skull island.  Our guide told us that Route 2 had better natural scenery and was less "man made." Although Skull Island was man made and gimmicky ;) We arrived around 930am and it was relatively quiet.  By the time we were half way through there were many boats.   I think Route 2 was fine. Although you visit less caves after a few it becomes "same same but different"  and sitting on the hard seat of the boat for 2.5 hours was just enough. We gave a 100000 dong tip and our boat lady was happy (Most reviews say 30000-50000 dong is ok, but we didn't have small change).  I don't know if it is too much or too little - but there was 3 adults,1 kid and the boat lady - it is hard work to row for so long.

reviews.author: Ellyas Bangun
reviews.title: A must visit !!!
reviews.content: We went here and try to take the 2 hours boat trip along the river.We going to the place that very beautiful with all the hills along the trip.We also go to king kong island where the movie king kong took place !It was amazing.Literally a must visit.We gone through almost 9 caves and the place is peace, water is crystal clear, the weather is good, and the tour guide is amazing and give detail of the place. Not in a good english but an understandable english.

reviews.author: DickP
reviews.title: Grottoes
reviews.content: A must see!! Do the long trip ie. route 1. Includes 9 caves and amazing scenery. Very relaxing boating trip. Stopped at a few temples. Unesco certified site. For the more energetic some step climbing to get better views

reviews.author: jandjs000
reviews.title: Peaceful and serene
reviews.content: We spent nearly 2 hours on the water visiting all 8 caves and the temples. This is a very special place, serene and relaxing.  The boats are small, 4 passages at max, rowed by a local.  It was wintery overcast day when we went so there were not to many people around but I imagine this attraction would get quite busy in summer. Took some great photos - the calm waters and green hills in the background make it easy. Some of the caves can get quite narrow as you go through them by boat so be prepared to duck and weave.  Try to visit all the temples as well (you will have to let the local rowing your boat know you want to stop at the temples).

reviews.author: blueesmrs
reviews.title: Beautiful scenery
reviews.content: We were lucky, it wasn't busy on dec 28th so sometimes there were NO boats in front of us. We did tour 2 which brings you to the set of skull island, to be hobest it takes from the scenery and is VERY  fake 😁 esp the indigenous village not sure what that is about, pointless if u ask me. I don't think I would do the skull island tour again but I loved the area and really enjoyed the paddling so we got to pass out other boats so we weren't in a queue 😁

reviews.author: Raaj1976
reviews.title: Lifetime experience
reviews.content: Wonderful... Nature is wonderful and Vietnam has preserved this awesome place well. We enjoyed the boat ride and went through nine caves in two hours. Must visit.

reviews.author: joshua b
reviews.title: Great tour
reviews.content: The boats are amazing, as are the mountains, caves, water and temples.  It costs 200000 VND but well worth it, this is a special place.  It's about a ten minute drive from Tam Coc.  Make sure you tip your boat captain.

reviews.author: Just_the_Wanderer
reviews.title: A different experience
reviews.content: this is basically a touristic activity, where you get in a boat and somebody takes you through the different caves rowing, you will see outstanding nature, but depending on your "driver" you won't have too much time to see the different stops, I recommend you to reserve at least three hours for this. We started around 16:00 and it was already dark when we were returning. Most of the times you will be asked to help rowing, you don't have to, but it will be a funny experience as well.It's the main attractions of this zone, so you don't want to miss it.

reviews.author: StanleyandPandora
reviews.title: Beautiful scenery! Should not miss...
reviews.content: Visited Trang An with my family and did the bamboo boat ride. It was so peaceful and the scenery was so beautiful. I agree with other reviewers' comments on the scenery is even better than Halong Bay. The Kong area and Skull Island were interesting reminding us about the movie.The bamboo boat ride was amazing. You have options to do a short (1.5 hr) or a long (3.5 hrs) route at the same entrance ticket price which was wonderful. My family did the 2 hrs route and went through 4 caves.The Trang An Grottoes is one that should not be missed if you visit Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: Destination72138
reviews.title: Hidden Beauty
reviews.content: Amazing views of limestones on the lake. Entrance was 200k dong/person. Bike parking is available on site for 15k dong. We had the option of a short or long boat ride. We took the long ride which was about 3hrs along the lake and through at least 6 limestone caves which were impressively beautiful. Be prepared to duck along some of these low caves! The lady rowing the boat was sincere and friendly although she did not speak any English. At the end of the ride, she did not outrightly ask for tips which we gave even more because of that. Highly recommend this when you’re in Tam Coc.

reviews.author: Tuaelisa
reviews.title: One of best experiences in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: Definitely recommended! It's a peaceful experience to tour around the grottoes. The best time to go is early in the morning, to avoid the crowds.

reviews.author: Nolin
reviews.title: A little piece of paradise
reviews.content: We chose route 1 which took approximately 4 hours, passing through 9 caves and stopping at 3 temples. The views are magical and the river is clean and peaceful.  The hidden temples gave you a glimpse of the Vietnamese culture and religion. The lady that accompanied us was friendly and polite and did not hassle us for any tips. Much of the nature around the river appears to be untouched by human activity and offers a serene trip with beautiful scenery. I would definitely recommend a visit for anyone interested in a bamboo boat ride in the Ninh Binh area.

reviews.author: Mayank Agarwal
reviews.title: Must Visit, Highlight of our Trip
reviews.content: Trang An Scenic Landscape Complex is located at Ninh Bình, its famous for its boat cave tours. There are two boat routes, we took the smaller ones, it seemed the less popular one as we were the only one on our route, this only made the experience more mystic. The picturesque landscape and patches without human touch do feel like we have stepped into a prehistoric time. The pin drop silence and calm tranquillity with the amazing landscape make it’s an amazing experience.  The narrow caves were also stunning, there was area were the ceiling of the caves were literally touching the boat, we had to really lay low. We visited the Vu Lam Royal Step Over Place, a base of hermitage and the place where Tran Dynasty first set up base at Ninh Binh. Its right next to the shooting location of the famous Hollywood movie Kong: Skull Island, few of the props from the movie is still here as a tourist attraction.  It’s also a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its spectacular landscape of limestone karst peaks & archaeological traces of human activity over a continuous period of more than 30,000 years.

reviews.author: Courtney
reviews.title: Breathtaking Beautiful
reviews.content: Wow, this place was absolutely incredible and is a definite don't miss. We went around 1:15 pm and there weren't too many tourists which I think gave us a better experience. The pictures don't do it's justice. One of the best tours I've ever done. Don't miss out.

reviews.author: wildfirejc
reviews.title: Amazing Landscape spoilt at the end by boat rower poking for tips
reviews.content: We shared a boat with a couple from Holland. We all enjoyed ourselves. The first part was marred by a couple of boats full of Vietnamese tourists who were intent on having a shouting match among themselves. So the peaceful and tranquil was broken. But upon our urging and by some manipulation whenever we stopped on an island to view the sites, we managed to let them get ahead and thereafter w did have the most wonderfully quiet ride among the spectacular scenery. We were given a piece of feedback slip to fill at the end of the journey and one of the questions was: Did the boat rower ask for tips - Yes or No. At that point, we put "No" but the moment we handed it back to her, she then started going on about it - in Vietnamese - which at first we thought she meant, she is happy not to ask for tips - but then she kept poking me in the ribs and pointing to the tips question - which we in the end gathered that despite that, she wanted and expected tips. We gave her 20K and I think the Dutch couple gave her the same or maybe 10K. She was upset because when we left, all her smiles and friendliness evaporated.

reviews.author: Ha V
reviews.title: Not to miss when you're considering Hanoi region
reviews.content: I'll just let the photos speak for themselves. After a couple of busy days in the old quarter of Hanoi, I wanted to have some peace, tranquility and natural surrounding. We chose to skip Halong bay because the area around Ninh Binh offered more options. And it does!  After visiting an old rare temple like cathedral, we came to Trang an. The whole experience was unique. Not to be skipped when you're around Hanoi!

reviews.author: inkkie7 .
reviews.title: Leisurely ride
reviews.content: It was rather nice to row through the caves but gets repetitive after a while. So i think 2h is better than the 3h ride. Rower didnt ask for tip but we gave her $150k dong anyway coz there were 5 of us & i am sure it must be q tiring for her. They cant choose which passengers they get to ferry around.

reviews.author: Jennylu91cy
reviews.title: Nice trip in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: This place was very lovely with stunning scenery. People were very friendly and funny. I also visited the temples nearby. And it was great. Recommendable!

reviews.author: Brandi S
reviews.title: Full of unique natural beauty!
reviews.content: My boyfriend and I went around noon on a Friday and had a great time. It cost 200,000 VND each and we shared a boat with two other people. We took tour one, which took us through some really awesome caves-- some of the ceilings are quite low, so be prepared to duck! The tour stops at a few small temples as well as a rest stop with drinks and souvenirs halfway through. Although the guide didn't speak any English, she was very nice, and we tipped her an additional 15k.Although there's a restaurant connected to the visitor center, we opted for banh mi at a stand across the street next to the car park. In total, we spent about three hours here and really enjoyed it.

reviews.author: Lim C
reviews.title: Best Place to visit in Vietnam
reviews.content: It is totally natural and far from the hustle and bustle city .The panaromic scenery is simply fascinating .Row the sampan over the mystery water caves is so exciting . We stopped at an island , which we can pray in the temples there and took photo with the recent King Kong set .We can take photos with the indigenous people appears in King Kong too. I would like to visit this place again in future !!

reviews.author: Ask-the-cat
reviews.title: Must see in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: Even though it is a little touristy it is a must see around here. I would recommend tour one as you really get to see interesting caves. The women rowing for such a long time are amazing how they manoeuvre the boats. Excellent. A little annoying in this area are all the bike parking fees and the way they behave around this like policemen.

reviews.author: Utterchaos
reviews.title: Picturesque tour
reviews.content: This is a very attractive place to tour as the scenery is fantastic, but it can be oversubscribed in busy periods as there are literally hundreds of the little boats lined up ready to go. The delightful and friendly ladies work incredibly hard rowing around the waterways - I noticed ours changed to rowing with her feet part of the way! It is recommended to tip them at the end of the tour. There are a number of interesting stops along the way at various temples and royal hideouts. The King Kong set is worth a miss - the actors in the ‘native village’ are clearly bored and even resentful if you do not have photos taken with them. Part of the entertainment is seeing the young couples having very staged destination wedding photos taken throughout the Everglades style landscape.

reviews.author: David G
reviews.title: Great boat ride
reviews.content: While this place can get very busy, it is definitely worth going. If you can avoid the crowds and it will be amazing. Amazing scenery, you can also visit a few temples on the riverbanks. I wish there were better signs or directions from someone. The boat lady didn’t speak any English and dropped us at a dock but the temple was on the other side of the cliff and we didn’t know what to expect. I am unsure if they are allowed to ask for tips, they will. Nevertheless we felt bad for the woman after 2 hours of back-breaking rowing so we gave her something extra.

reviews.author: hoshibara
reviews.title: Clean water and very nice views
reviews.content: I appreciate their cleanliness,. Views are very nice and fantastic. Only need to take care your head when your boat pass through under the grottoes.

reviews.author: J Card
reviews.title: Completely amazing
reviews.content: Best tour we did in Ninh bihn! Beautiful landscapes and very nice rowers. No tips or pesky boat stores like the other boat tours

reviews.author: kyy0te
reviews.title: Touristy but fun boat tour
reviews.content: You have to marvel at the women rowing these boats up and down the river and through the caves. A great way to spend an afternoon.

reviews.author: Takeru Okabe
reviews.title: Marvelous!
reviews.content: Its my first time I visited such a very nice place. Little bit far from Hanoi but if you go to Hanoi you should go to Trang An!

reviews.author: Jake S
reviews.title: Eerie
reviews.content: Went in the afternoon just after heavy rain, meant no other tourists were there and the entire area was surrounded by fog and extremely quiet. By far one of the best sights seen in Vietnam, arguably as impressive as Ha Long bay!

reviews.author: Jesse F
reviews.title: A magical place
reviews.content: The reflection on the water from the surrounding landscape is something to behold. We were so impressed by this boat ride as we had done Tam Coc the day before and left devastated after the scams that seemed to be running there, which ruined our experience. Our rower was lovely and we helped with the rowing throughout the ride. We went through many grottos that are a real must see. If we had our time again, we would just do this one.

reviews.author: Luca C
reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.content: Trang An Grottoes are one of the best thing to see in Vietnam.We reached Trang An from Tam Coc by scooter.We sailed on a flat river, between exciting grottoes and enjoying an amazing landscape.We went there on the late afternoon, in order to avoid all the organized tours and to enjoy a beautiful sunset!Don't miss it !!!

reviews.author: Celia T
reviews.title: Amazing views and caving fun
reviews.content: A must do if your in Tam coc or Ninh Binh. Breathtaking views, relaxing on the boat, crazy fun going through tiny caves in the boat. A highlight for Vietnam!!Unfortunately the staff were a little pushy with the feedback survey in the middle of the trip then rude and aggressive once we gave them a good reviewSuggest you fill it out at the very end to give an honest reflection. They also don't speak a word of English, and left my friend who can't walk without crutches at the temple. Luckily we got a lift with other lady back to our orinigal rower. - WTF moment.

reviews.author: MichelleChoongKhoo
reviews.title: lovely and tranquil, deserving its Unesco Heritage Site Award
reviews.content: I truly love the landscape here. In my opinion, it was even more majestic than Halong Bay.The boatwoman, the tranquil water, the caves, the greenery was just awesome.Overall, very well kept and pristine.The only thing that spoilt the natural landscape for us was what was left on Skull Island; the props and the people still dressing up as in the movie King Kong, that makes no sense whatever!Other than that, do go if you have time.We had to kill time before catching the Chapa Express Train at 10pm to Sapa, so 8am starting out from Hanoi we even had time to visit Hoa Lu Citadel and completing the Trang An Grottos before finishing by 6pm, have dinner at the transit hotel with time to spare to catch our train on time!Good day trip!

reviews.author: HWKhor
reviews.title: Nice boat tour
reviews.content: We spent 2-hour boat trip with the shorter route as they have a longer route which takes approx 3hours. Regardless of what route you're taking, the price is the same and the view is breathtaking. Watch out your head when you're in the caves! Awesome tour.

reviews.author: emilylhr
reviews.title: Beautiful in early morning
reviews.content: Had a beautiful boat ride with 4 caves and the King Kong movie set. Scenery is amazing and our boat rower was lovely although very limited English. As we were leaving there were a huge number of boats setting out so definitely recommend going early in the morning (boats begin around 7:30am)

reviews.author: Damian J
reviews.title: Definitely worth seeing
reviews.content: We took route 1 which is longer one and with more caves. Boats are for 4 people so if you are not that size, you will have to wait for others. You can also buy 4 tickets and have boat for your own. Caves are really cool especially the first one which is the longest. When we were there, water was at high level and we had to lay down in our boat.Best to visit in the morning to avoid crowds.Our boat lady was nice and she didn't want any tip at the end.

reviews.author: MarijnHG
reviews.title: Beautiful views
reviews.content: There are two routes to choose from. Virtually everybody does the nine caves so if you want a more quiet trip take the nr 2. There are 2 stops for walking. Recommended.

reviews.author: varun c
reviews.title: Great Scenery and an amazing experience!
reviews.content: Amazing 2-3 hours spent here. Make sure you either bring a cap/hat or buy one here and a water bottle with you when going on the boat ride. There will be 2 options - Route 1 & Route 2. Route 1 will have more caves and Route 2 will have caves+Kong Skull Island. The sets are still work in progress but you should definitely go on Route 2 for both the scenic view and the Skull Island Set. Overall an amazing experience and you should definitely try it out when visiting Vietnam.

reviews.author: Vicky C
reviews.title: Take Route 1 for caves and temples
reviews.content: Relaxing 2 hours of seeing nature up close with caves and temples. Clear waters. Great weather in November and friendly boat rower.

reviews.author: PhuongNhung78
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.content: Arrival here on a rainny day.However, there are some amazing thing that you can experience.Caves are mysterious.Especially, you can visit the Skull island movie set.The 2 hour boat trip is not enough to explore  this heritage.

reviews.author: TerryTeo
reviews.title: Excellent 2-3 hours of boat ride. Definitely worth it!
reviews.content: We arrived after 1pm and the crowds were noticeably less during the afternoon and weekday. We hired 1 boat for 4 people and had great 2-3 hours immersing ourselves with the surrounding nature, multiple grottoes and also navigating through few caves. Definitely worth the trip and the money. Truly very well organized place that I would give them 5-star.

reviews.author: Linh
reviews.title: Stunning place
reviews.content: If you have been in Tam Coc then heading to Trang An, you will prefer this place, so amazing temples and stunning caves. Yes, very quiet and you can hear the voice of animals in the mountains. Route 1 is 9 caves and 3 temples, it takes 3hours. The rower is so friendly, she is 73 years old and she told us the history of temples and explaining the name of caves. Lovely trip. We 3people sometimes row and excited experience. Then we tipped her at the end even though she did not ask for that. If you have more time, just cycling around Trang An then heading to Hoa Lu, it was beautiful.

reviews.author: Sancho D
reviews.title: Amazing landscapes, calm and great experience
reviews.content: Great time on the river and its caves!It's about 20 mins driving from Tam Coc, any hotel can book a driver or a cab for you. Two different tours, we went for the one that goes through 9 caves.We started at 12:00, good timing while most of the groups are having their lunches, there was very few people all along. Should probably be good also early in the evening or late in the afternoon (around 15PM, before night falls at 17:30). Tour is 200 KD, plus 30 KD as tip for the rower. Better have small change if you want to use toilets (2000 D each time, at the starting site or in the temples along the way).Our tour lasted nearly 3h, we've been through amazing and quiet landscapes, 9 tiny caves below estraordinary rocks with heavy jungle, stoped at a couple of beautiful temples.We were 4 people on the boat, they can take up to 5. The driver was great, she didn't hit any rock into the caves, they're quite used to those.Great feeling of calm, into those incredible vietnamese famous rocks, jungle, nenuphars, moorhens...

reviews.author: Nghia Tran
reviews.title: A PERFECT COMBINATION TRIP OF SIGHTSEEING, TEMPLES AND KING KONG ISLAND!
reviews.content: Compared to other destinations in Ninh Binh, I highly recommend this one to any visitors looking for something worth to pay a visit for. Stand out from all famous attractions, this place offer you a good mix of everything which can show you about the country’s fame: its nature and its culture.The thing that impressed me is: there is no beggar, no lady trying to sell you souvenir and the rower totally don’t have any attitude toward asking for tip like Tam Coc or other places!If you’re looking for a nice attraction here, it’s absolutely perfect for that!

reviews.author: Erica B
reviews.title: Best mix of caves and temples
reviews.content: If you want the all in one tour- this is it! Route 1 is 9 caves and 9 temples and takes about 2.5 hours. Route 2 is 4 and 4 and takes 2 hours. They are the same price. We helped our guide row at most times and tipped her at the end even though she didn't ask for one. It's a clean, well run business park and well worth the 200k dong. A must do! Go at 2pm and avoid all the crowds and sun!!

reviews.author: Rico
reviews.title: Recomended
reviews.content: Place was easy to find, bike and car parking available. Boat ride will cost you 200.000 for a adult but it is worth it. Guides don’t speak any English maybe if you lucky the speak a few words. The tried to get everybody to do route number 2 because that is a shorter one. You can also do number 1 for the same price. The said rout 2 will take about 2 hours but we where back in 1 hour next time I would properly go with route 1.

reviews.author: friendlyfaced
reviews.title: No effort at all
reviews.content: This was worth the time to take the 3 hour tour.  Our guide/boatman spoke little English but it was unnessessary because it spoke for itself. The natural waterways were almost pristine with magnificent limestone outcrops, many of which had caves.  They left us speechless at times! There where a couple if stops along the way to buy coffee, food or mementoes but it was very low pressure. We found some companions in other boats friendly whilst others didn't want to communicate but that was ok because it was soo, sooo peaceful. It is a must see for the traveller to Vietnam even better than the much reverred Halong Bay!

reviews.author: Wayne B
reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.content: One of our reasons for visiting Ninh Bing was to go to Trang An after having seen a brief video of the area.Trang An not only met our expectations but exceeded them.It is a great way to relax and enjoy the spectacular scenery. You get to spend between 2 and 3 hours on the water viewing the amazing rock formations, going through a series of caves and just relaxing.The cost for the boat trip is only 200000 dong per person and the boats take 4 passengers. There were 3 of us and we wanted a private boat so we paid a total of 800000.The rowers are almost always female and it amazed us how they can keep rowing for 2 and a bit hours. We would have been exhausted in under 10 minutes. We gave our person a tip.We can highly recommend Trang An.

reviews.author: zardoz07
reviews.title: As my wife said "Holly Smokes"
reviews.content: I was a wee but cynical not knowing what to expect but what a fabulous place! Was busy when we went but not too busy. Amazing scenery and the grottos were amazing places. We thought we might miss out on our daily steps but no we got them in alright!.our bamboo lady was very pleasant and being kiwis we assisted her with a will and overtook several boats with her saying "beep beep" as we overtook and laughing. All in all a memorable 3 hours and a highlight of the trip and no we were not on an organised trip. On scooters and bought tickets there. Very easy. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: parkersinportland
reviews.title: Must see!
reviews.content: Incredibly beautiful! A must do when in Ninh Binh. Don't bother paying for a guided tour, you can easily buy tickets upon arrival (200,000 VDN/person).

reviews.author: Hieu H
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: Trang An interesting tour by boat through 12 caves about 5 km long. 5 km boat ride is not long, but visitors will experience the feeling of thrill when the boat enters the deep pit, admire the strange shapes on the cave. So magical.

reviews.author: Valentina F
reviews.title: Definitely go here! Breathtaking views and a mini workout
reviews.content: Trang An was worth the trip! We did the bamboo boat tour, Route 2, which took us through several caves and temples. We loved how peaceful the area was and the limestone karst formations were breathtaking. No one tried to scam us or make us buy stuff! We even got to help our bamboo lady out with the rowing.Pictured: jars inside one of the caves.

reviews.author: Tourist740458
reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.content: Visit early in the morning to beat the other tourists. Be prepared to pay for bathroom usage and help the guide row the boat.

reviews.author: Joseph Vu
reviews.title: This should be nominated as one of the World’ Wonders
reviews.content: To me, I must call Trang An Grottos a Wonder!It takes about 1 hour 30 minutes from Hanoi by car. The express ways allows up to 120km/h (80mph) so the distance (90km) seems to be shortened.There are options: hiring the whole boat for your group of maximum 8 people, or joining others for the boat trip and you only have to pay for your own ticket. The whole tour may take you up to 3 to 4 hours to visit the whole system. I was overwhelmed with the pure beauty of the scene, a combination of the natural river, the rocky mountains all along both the banks. The feet of the mountains are filled with the velvet green of the paddy rice fields, or filled with the magical golden view of the rice when the harvest time to come! This is very much alike the Ha Long Bay-in-Land! It did not seem to have taken me 4 hours for the bout trip, it was like only a blink!In short, it is totally worthy and a must-visit place to go to, in this God’s Full of Blessings Land - Ninh Binh!

reviews.author: Thang N
reviews.title: Amazing rowing boat trip - peaceful area
reviews.content: That is great rowing boat trip, that you can go though 9 caves and enjoy the sightseeing of the World Heritage site of Culture and Nature. This place should be a must see destination if you travel to Nothern Vietnam.

reviews.author: Oleks
reviews.title: Number one attraction in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: Well organized Clean neat facilities Beautiful landscapes, grottos and nature around Ticket is 200kDong and you can choose long or short ride. If you have time, definitely take the long one. It’s ~3h, 7 different grottos, 3 step outs with walking to temples.New safety vests, offered immediately.Warned when to duck for low ceilings.Feedback form.No tips asked or souvenirs pushed - thus tips given 😊

reviews.author: Matthew K
reviews.title: Fun Boat Ride!
reviews.content: This boat ride was a lot of fun!  The scenery was beautiful, and you even boat through some very long caves.  Our rower did ask one of us to help her paddle part of the time, but she was nice and it was a fun boat ride.

reviews.author: semo m
reviews.title: Very very nice tour
reviews.content: Take the tour and boom the tickets yourself because it's very expensive if you book with hotels or agency, just go and buy the tickets and you will have a great tour.

reviews.author: VidyaSalian
reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.content: This is really easy to reach. Rent a motorbike or cycle according to your hotel's location and go on your own. No need to take a day tour for this place. Directly reach the place and get your tickets. There's ample space for parking too.

reviews.author: James L
reviews.title: Best of Ninh Binh
reviews.content: If you have to choose between Trang An and Tam Coc, go for the former. It’s less touristy, more magnificent and much more peaceful throughout the ride. We didn’t have anyone trying to sell us food and drinks, and our boat rower didn’t ask us for a tip. We gladly gave one for her good service, though!Get ready to duck down for the limestone caves. Go early (around 9am) before it’s hot and crowded. Bring your camera and sunscreen. You’ll need them.

reviews.author: Iris L.Y
reviews.title: Serene
reviews.content: Some quiet time away from busy, scooter-filled Hanoi. This place is such a scenic landscape where youll hear only the sound of the paddle against the water. A calming experience worth the trip.Not sure about the tipping policy for boatmen but ours was more than happy to receive 50,000 vnd from me and my husband.

reviews.author: Dave B
reviews.title: I recommend
