It's really wonderful when you come to the Top and look around, great landscape! You should bring with you some water bottle, when you are tired, just pause for 10 minutes to recover your health. Remember bring a camera so you can take the great Photos there! You should go in the early morning as the weather will be cooler. That is such a great place to visit!

reviews.author: Peter P
reviews.title: Morning workout
reviews.content: Just wondering why almost everyone in each review says to go at the end of the afternoon... when it's the warmest of the day... We went before breakfast, were there at 7:00, had nearly clear blue skies, and saw 9 other persons the entire walk up and down. Took us 10-15 minutes to go up.

reviews.author: Adria
reviews.title: Tamcoc view from above
reviews.content: About 500 things and you appear bad on Tam Coc. It provides you with an entirely different point of view, complimentary to open from water level. The other side of the mountain is populated by grain paddies, unfortunately in November nothing was developing there.

reviews.author: Jan-Olof O
reviews.title: 500 steps to the top but worh it!
reviews.content: I did go for the view point and the view over Tam Coc It´s 500 steps to walk so this view point is best seen in the late afternoon or early morning! I did visit in late afternoon. I hoped for good pictures of Tam Coc. I did receive great pictures of Tam Coc but it´s not the view you can see on pictures at different hotels or restaurants in Ninh Binh! These pictures are taken somewhere else! Please note the view point has two different viewpoints, which also gives you two different views of the landscape! On top of the highest view point is a dragon sculpture not easily seen from the viewing platform. You need to climb a little bit higher to see the dragon sculpture. However from the valleys in Tam Coc the dragon sculpture up on the view point in the mountain is easily seen.

reviews.author: WIN WIN TRAVEL - VIETNAM
reviews.title: Stuning view from Lying Dragon Top
reviews.content: We contacted to Win Win Travel in order to ask them to organize a nice trip to Ninh Binh, they ended with Mua Cave itinerary, all i have to say is awesome, relaxing itinerary, great service and excellent tour guide, He to mus to the top of the Mua cave. Stunning view from top of mountain. I took a lots of great photo. Thanks Win Win Travel

reviews.author: Stanis Cataldo
reviews.title: Best view, beware of scammers!
reviews.content: Really worth the hike, even in the humid and hot temperatures of May, the view is just breathtaking! Other reviews have mentioned this but the ticket INCLUDES PARKING INSIDE! There will be a lot of parking lot scammers claiming and almost forcing you to park before entering. Refuse at all costs, and if they insist you can threaten to call the police and they’ll leave you alone. We paid 10,000 dong each because we thought it was mandatory only to find out as soon as we entered that there is shaded parking inside. The group right after us parked for free after arguing. Don’t let this deter you from visiting, probably the highlight of our trip to Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: hanoivespatours
reviews.title: best place to see over view of Ninh binh
reviews.content: if you want to see over view of ninh binh. call halong on land you should  come here. visit mua cave with beautifull nature. and nice villages and also take you to visit mua cave and from mua cave you cab climb ti the top of the mountain to see great view and taje beautifull picture

reviews.author: Kirsty C
reviews.title: Mua cafes and hike
reviews.content: MUA Caves and 'Dragon Mountain'... Both brilliant. Loved the hike to the top of dragon mountain even though it was 38 degrees!I got so many cool photos on the mountain too. There are done amazing views along the way! Also, there's a relatively new area of the Cave, only discovered 6 months ago. There's a gorgeous lagoon at the end of it with crystal clear water. Really beautiful!I booked this in conjunction with other activities with Vic Travel and can't recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Wags1963
reviews.title: Beutiful
reviews.content: A great visit to Mua Caves. I stayed at the base so walked up the hill without having to travel there.  The views from the op are awesome and whilst there is about 500 steps, if you take it slowly you can make it in about 10 minutes.

reviews.author: Sally M
reviews.title: Not as difficult as it's made out to be
reviews.content: Awesome views, and not a bad climb up. Give yourself time to enjoy the panoramic viewpoint from the two summits, and try to be there for sunset if you can. Definitely a must-do if you're in the area.

reviews.author: wonda
reviews.title: panoramic view from the top
reviews.content: The ladder is extremely long, though it is well worth the climb. The landscape is quite beautiful, therefore this place is the hobby of the photographer. From above, you can see Tam Coc on just one side, and many limestone and rice fields mountains on the other person. There's a really good lake on the courtyard: place that is great for a picnic or even sightseeing break. Though the cave isn't really worth mentioning, this location is interesting!

reviews.author: Lovingourlife1965
reviews.title: Amazing place!
reviews.content: Unbelievable sights and panoramas. This is a ‘must do’ when in the Ninh Binh area. The views are breathtaking and are well worth the climb. Avoid the midday heat though. We went early morning and it was still very hot. As others have said, parking is free at the Eco Lodge. Just keep going until you get to the end of the road. Avoid people trying to lure you into their ‘unofficial’ car parks.

reviews.author: gustav265
reviews.title: A must do!
reviews.content: To keep it short: the price of 100k is not much, you have a very beautiful stroll to the bottom of the stairs, the stairclimb itself was fun and challenging and the views are absolutely breathtaking. It is the perfect add-on to one of the boat trips, since combined you get a look through and over the rocks of Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: juned baig
reviews.title: Dragon cliff Adventure
reviews.content: Getting top this mountain , its tough one has to climb 500 steps and main thrill comes when u club from top to dragon statue, its very challenging and awesome feel when u reach top .

reviews.author: Mariagrazia B
reviews.title: Relaxing place to visit Ninh Binh area
reviews.content: We stayed at Mua Caves 1 night at the end of April.It is a relaxing place from where you can easily reach both Tam Coc and Trang An. Moreover, staying here, you can visit Mua Cave gor free. You can  climb the almost 500 steps up to the top of the mountain an enjoy the spectacular view of Tam Coc whenever is more convenient for you.We recommend this place for nature lovers and those who prefer to stay out of crowdy places.Please consider that at night this place is really quiet and there is just tre restsurant of the hotel.

reviews.author: Suzy H
reviews.title: Dragon mountain!!! Caves a bonus
reviews.content: The view from the top was breathtaking- and totally worth the climb.  There is a vendor selling drinks halfway up so you don’t have to carry your own water :p. We went at the start of the day before the crowds and made it to the top in half an hour despite being of moderate fitness.  If I can climb it anyone can - and you should.  Hanging with the dragon at the top was my ultimate Vietnam experience and beats out Trang an / Tam Coc. The caves were ok but nothing on the amazing view.  Worth every penny of the entrance fee in my opinion.

reviews.author: ymaliah
reviews.title: Free parking after the ticket booth
reviews.content: The view is beautiful and really worth the hike up.Parking is included with the entry fee; ignore the people just outside the ticket booth agressively attempting to wave you into their paid (10k) parking lot. The free parking right after the entrance gate to the site is a very safe place, I forgot my motorbike's key in the switch and they safely kept it for me at the ticket office.

reviews.author: MARK S
reviews.title: Walk to the lookout at sunset
reviews.content: The caves are not much, but the lookout at the top of the 500 or so steps is well worth the effort, especially at sunset.

reviews.author: Helen N
reviews.title: Breathtaking views
reviews.content: You may want to quit climbing but keep going, it’s so worth it! We biked there from our Chez Loan Hotel. It wasn’t that far from Tam Coc area at all, plus you get to see nothing but rice paddies on the way there and we were lucky enough to see a local walking her herd of goats. Beware about parking if you’re on a bicycle, a man will try to block you and force you to pay for parking but thank god for TripAdvisor we knew better. He started blowing his whistle too. Hahah. Just bike to the gate and it’s free!

reviews.author: Gillia
reviews.title: Amazing views. Don’t pay for parking
reviews.content: We cycled from Tam Coc having gone to the grotto in the early morning. At the grotto there's official parking that is clear as a result of the number of space and people. There's an official system to make sure security and you've to pay. However as you use Mua caves along the narrow street males are blowing you off on the edge to park and also ask you for for it. We'd been warned this's a scam as there's a lot of parking that is free behind the ticket office. One particular male stood in roadway with the arms of his away to block us.. We came to no damage so do not take any notice simply drive through and park at no cost.

reviews.author: Cannon
reviews.title: Cave itself was rubbish but the climb was the main attraction
reviews.content: I believe many folks will have missed it (it is located left out of the lake with a little spring). Nevertheless, the climb on the hill was extremely pleasant. Supposedly there are 500 things but we believed there were more. The complete ecolodge area was enjoyable to see. A thing to be aware, admission is 100k dong. On how to the lodge there have been a few individuals attempting to prevent us to park. We kept moving until the previous parking location correctly outside the gate. Others say that it ought to be parking that is free inside the gate though we had been literally stopped by the last auto parking attendant outside of the gate. The ticket office person seemed to suggest that we must park outside. Therefore unsure who was right. Overall, experience that is pleasant but definitely expensive. Would recommend if you've excess money but you would not miss very much in case you did not go.

reviews.author: Puckett Coffey
reviews.title: 500 stairs but very worth
reviews.content: The overview is just breathtaking.. is my next visit here in tam coc as well as this second period only amazing... you've paying entry down before entering the place. But then if you going up the steps, you need to select the left side. As soon as you are going to have the option of going left or maybe right.. both of the ideas after are amazing. Just the left side is I believe better.. have a glimpse.

reviews.author: Rocha
reviews.title: SCAMMERS
reviews.content: Great views as additional reviews below have stated, although intense parking scammers at the entry ruined it. The cave is aproximatelly ten minute motorbike drive from Tam Coc main, poorly signed.These men became very verbally and also physically intense, threatening us with knives, scissors, and rocks. They acquired rocks, and also they had been cutting electric cables with massive scissors like a "subtle" threat.Apparently the totally free parking is just for guests and cars of the hotel. She'd little English and informed us to park outdoors and stroll in. She was "sorry" with regard to their behaviour whenever we complained...We chose to not chance it as we'd read reviews that scooters have been ruined when parked on the street before the turn from. We refused paying the $1, plus simply handed more than $1 dong after all of the commotion. They have been pleased. We feel $1.5 would be adequate. Just hand it through and leave.When we remaining, we experienced vacationers that had parked on the street inside perspective of the ticket scammers. They had been refused entry by the scammers, that actually blocked them from getting into by having a chain on the stick. They were only permitted to enter whether they parked the scooters of theirs in the parking lot of theirs.The perspective from up leading was amazing, but simply take care with the parking scammers because they become really aggressive. Karma becomes them!

reviews.author: Kday77
reviews.title: 500 Steps Worth the View!
reviews.content: PARKING TIP (IMPORTANT!!! READ FIRST): the parking is free for motorbikes/bicycles (and even cars I believe) right after the gate entrance. There will be people that look like legitimate employees who stop you at the end before you even reach the entrance/ticket booth of Mua Caves and wave you to park and will charge you. I even read a review that parking was free but still got tricked because the people literally BLOCK the street with their bodies and wave you into the parking lot and then charge you. Ok, on to the review of Mua Caves: We went closer to sunset time and the trek up was pretty tiring for me but the view at the top by the dragon (left at the fork half way up) was incredible! There is also a fork to the right that I did not have the energy to go explore but it is just a different viewpoint of Ninh Binh. The fork that leads you to the dragon looks down in between the limestone mountains where a river runs between rice paddies--I read on another review that it might be Tam Coc?Wear comfortable shoes! I noticed there were a lot of people going up in sandals--I was wearing tennis shoes and I had a hard time. Also, if you plan to climb around the rocks on the top by the dragon, you should really consider tennis shoes. I was ballsy enough to climb the boulders around the dragon but did not make it up to the jaggedy rocks where the dragon actually lies--it was too scary!As for the "Mua Caves", I must've overlooked them because I did not actually see them. I read from other reviews that they were very small. I guess I was expecting some large caves you have to canoe into and that was why I was confused at why it was called Mua Caves until I went back to read the reviews... haha. Makes sense.Add this to your itinerary! Don't go to Tam Coc, rather choose Trang An instead. Read my other reviews for more details.

reviews.author: Hannah K
reviews.title: Just wow
reviews.content: Easily my fave thing in Ninh Binh, the views both ways are jaw dropping and I promise it’s not as high as it looks, we were up and down within an hour - soooo worth fighting the humidity for, although duller/cooler days recommended, and it takes short enough time you could time it with sunset and not lose light as you come down.

reviews.author: Kaylasoltys
reviews.title: Must do!
reviews.content: The steps are unusual sizes and shapes though I saw both kids and 65+ year olds done.The cave itself features a spring inside and could be a pleasant help from the heat during a warm day.

reviews.author: Niko
reviews.title: Beautiful views!!!
reviews.content: 100k to get in, skip the people flagging you down for parking and park at the last one, pay 10k to park your motorbike. The cave is not so amazing but the hike up the top to view tamcoc is amazing! Hopefully you get a clear day but even with clouds and grey skies it’s beautiful!

reviews.author: jco631
reviews.title: Very nice, don't pay the parking
reviews.content: Very nice place. If you are coming with bike or motorbike, do not pay the parking, it is free inside. Note that I saw a lot of dramatic reviews on the parking topic, the people try to make you park and pay their parking are not agressive at all, they just trying and if you just say no and continue your way there is no problem at all.

reviews.author: יערה ד
reviews.title: Worth the terrible steps
reviews.content: So many steps, not very nice to climb when it's hot and the humidity is high, but it is still worth it.Bring a big cold bottle of water with you.The view is amazing!!!!! Don't pass it!

reviews.author: Adamparker26
reviews.title: great view from above
reviews.content: We cycled to mua cave in the afernoon right after the short visit of hoalu ancient capital. It was great there with terrific scenery. I love cycling so that it worth to visit hang mua and take some photos from above.

reviews.author: ChillaxVermont
reviews.title: A must see!
reviews.content: If you're in the Tam Coc area, don't miss Hang Mua. As others have written, the cave isn't the main attraction here. Climb the 500 steep but manageable steps to the top and enjoy the incredible 360-degree view. When you're done, reward yourself with fresh coconut water by the river.

reviews.author: Harriet D
reviews.title: Incredible biews
reviews.content: A great walk and incredible views from the top. No need for serious fitness clothes if you have a moderate level of fitness. Make sure you stop and have a coffee, a great experience. Getting a good photo with the dragon is difficult, you would need someone to take it for you - I couldn’t workout a good spot to get a complete picture of the dragon in the background. Go on a ‘clear’ day, otherwise you won’t have much view. It had been wet the morning we went but it wasn’t too slippery, it was actually nicer to go when it was cooler.

reviews.author: JaimeW
reviews.title: Worth all the energy - amazing views!!
reviews.content: We were really hesitant to take our 7 & 9 year old children to this but glad we did it. After 400-500 steps, we had sweeping views of both the city but also the grotto.Try not to do this during peak heat times as the steps are steep and there will be lots of heavy breathing!

reviews.author: Tashasmith94
reviews.title: Stunning views
reviews.content: we are not very fit at all but we managed to climb in about 20 minutes with a few stops to catch our breath! Defo worth it for the views they are beautiful!

reviews.author: Marissa H
reviews.title: Stunning views, great workout
reviews.content: First of all, THERE IS NO PARKING FEE. When you drive into the road towards the “cave”, ignore people beckoning you to park with them and drive your bike, motorbike, car, whatever, all the way to the eco lodge, where you buy the tickets. They offer free parking. This climb is incredibly fun. It isn’t very challenging, but make sure to wear comfortable shoes and bring water. They’ve got toilets at the bottom, but also toilets and a little shop halfway up. The views are beautiful, it’s picture perfect. 100% worth the 100,000 Dong entrance fee. We went when it was raining and we still loved it.

reviews.author: Grobs2711
reviews.title: A truly magnificent spectacle
reviews.content: Mua Caves is very close to Tam Coc so easily accessible. the 500 steps to the top of the mountain are quite steep and uneven so caution is required. I would also suggest plenty of sunscreen and water - there is a small shop half way where you can grab a drink. The climb is well worth it as the view is spectacular.

reviews.author: lol_hargs
reviews.title: Most beautiful view - the climb is worthwhile!
reviews.content: A must-do activity nearby Tam Coc and Ninh Binh. Easily accessible and a breathtaking view! The stairs are quite tiring but it is most definitely worth the sweat!

reviews.author: Megan E
reviews.title: Must see in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: The mua caves and peak are a must see when visiting Ninh Binh. The view from the top is absolutely breath taking. The hike up the steps takes around 15 stopping a few times to catch your breath. Once you get to the top it’s so so worth it. Very cheap to enter and my favourite part about Ninh Binh !!!

reviews.author: Nicholas L
reviews.title: Up up and away!
reviews.content: It’s not that difficult to get to the top. Just take one step at a time. But if you aren’t that physically fit, you may be too tired to enjoy the spectacular and unique view.Reaching the top of the stairs was an achievement for me. Being afraid of height, I did not have the guts to step on the rocks just to take a photo of the dragon head. Without doing so, you cannot see the dragon because it’s blocked by a vertical rock.

reviews.author: Jay V
reviews.title: You must visit Mua Caves
reviews.content: In my opinion Ninh Binh is the most magical place in Vietnam. Only 2.5hrs away from Hanoi it is worth a visit even if for only a day tour. The Mua Caves are definitely the main attraction in Ninh Binh. The climb is relatively easy and short with unbelievable views.

reviews.author: jbazza150
reviews.title: Great views, watch out for parking scams!
reviews.content: Very beautiful and worth a stop!Drive past all the people hassling you for parking — it’s a scam. Drive until the road ends, some of the parking guys were a bit aggressive and even whistled us to stop but they aren’t legit!  Parking is free through the gates by the ticket office.

reviews.author: patrykpielorz
reviews.title: Perfekt spot for sunset
reviews.content: We went there to watch the sunset and took a few snacks with us. The way upstairs was a bit of work but the view totally worth it. When you see a big dragon sculpture you reached the top! Of course this is not a secret place but if you go up early enough there is much space to have a picknick and watch the sun going down.

reviews.author: Alice B
reviews.title: Scenic
reviews.content: Worth the trek up the steps - great view. Don't pay for parking (even if they are quite forceful with their whistles!) - it's free inside the gate.

reviews.author: Iris A
reviews.title: Great views on the busy cliff top
reviews.content: We skipped the caves and choose instead to climb up the steps, I went up both on the dragon cliff an the smaller cliff opposite. There are quite a few tourists up here so it's no easy to get a photo in, also this location is popular with local wedding photography crews. The climb up is not easy but if you take it slow it's manageable. As we got to the place near sunset the clifftops (including the dragon) was too busy to go up to, from below it looked a bit unsafe as well: no barriers or steady platform to stand on was visible, only jagged rock. We went over to the smaller cliff with the little white tower on it, another great location to take photos. Looks like the place gets really busy around sunset.

reviews.author: Deerson
reviews.title: An Absolute Must!
reviews.content: The cave is interesting, but the climb and the views from atop the nearly-500 stairs, are the most gorgeous you can imagine. Worth climbing even if you have to rest a lot along the way - everyone does. About halfway up there’s even a small cafe selling drinks, ice cream, etc. with a few chairs.

reviews.author: Canadapicklelover
reviews.title: Amazing views!
reviews.content: My sister and I completed the hike this morning and were a bit concerned as there were several reviews talking about the men stopping them, shouting at bikers, trying to make them park etc. What we did was go early, at 830am, and there was only one group of men and we just biked around them when they came out into the middle of the road. There were 5 or so parking areas though so I can see how past reviews said there were several people yelling at bikers to stop and pay. We drove right up to the gates and didn’t have to pay for parking and there was room behind the main gates. We also were there before all the tourists came and before it got too hot (although it was still sweaty after the stairs!) so we were able to get some great photos. I’d recommend the earlier the better. Enjoy, the views are breathtaking!!

reviews.author: Travel Blogger Jared
reviews.title: Favorite stop in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: Loved it. Bring sneakers to hike in Amazing views.   Iconic Vietnam. Children and older hikers also made it to the top.  Sunset was beautiful. There's a cafe halfway up!Do not miss.

reviews.author: Tris R
reviews.title: Climb up to the top and along the dragon to the end.
reviews.content: Climb up. See the amazing view at dusk. Caves are awful. Don't bother. Steep entry fee unless staying at the ecolodge (also overpriced imho). Worth a look

reviews.author: David M
reviews.title: amazing view
reviews.content: We went there by bike and climbed up to the top. It was amazing view, totally natural, rice paddies with stream, so romantic

reviews.author: Sherpa645888
reviews.title: One of a few nice things to do in Tam Coc
reviews.content: One of many good things to see in Tam Coc. We cycled there (around 5km) which give some nice views of the rice paddies. Be sure to cycle up to the main entrance and don’t pay for parking at the many restaurants along the way (avoid the guy with the arm band and whistle - A for effort though). It’s 100k to get in ground a are attractive and the wall up no too bad. Views at the top very nice but can get a bit crowded with tourist angling for the best photo op. The steps fork near the end, take the left hand for views of the river and if you only have time/energy for one climb.

reviews.author: JuliaDollar
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: Very beautiful. The climb up looked hard but ended up being a short climb and the views at the top were amazing! Would definitely recommend going there.

reviews.author: Diane C
reviews.title: Beathtaking view
reviews.content: Hang Mua, Ninh BinhHang Mua has its meaning as "dancing cave" because this site was previously considered as the place where Tran king used to come to enjoy dancing & singing shows performed in this cave.At the moment, Hang Mua has been developed as an eco-tourism complex with Hang Mua resort. Hang Mua is constructed following the model of "miniature Great Wall in China with nearly 500 steps up to mountains to conquer. It is a hard trek up with many of its uneven limestone steps (especially at the top point) but worth our conquering efforts for impressive panoramic view of Tam Coc, Trang An & Ninh Binh city when we reach the top point of Mua Mountain for wonderful panoramic photos of golden rice fields & limestone mountains.How I wish we can stay overnight at this beautiful resort site.

reviews.author: javi_jaj
reviews.title: The view at the top!
reviews.content: The Mua Cavez were quite "simple" nothing amazing or outstanding you can give it a 1 min or 2 and yore done but the main attraction there is going to the top, specially before sunset. The view is one the most beautiful things you will ever see, breathtaking, is the perfect image that i had in my head when someone mention vietnam, take your time enjoy everything and is totally worth it.

reviews.author: thatonetraveller
reviews.title: Cave itself was rubbish but the climb was the main attraction
reviews.content: As the title says, the Mua cave itself was nothing impressive. I assume most people  would have missed it (it’s located left from the lake with some spring). However, the climb to the hill was very enjoyable. Supposedly there are 500 steps but we thought there were more. Nice idea to have a rest area with cafe in the middle although as expected, things were slightly overpriced (I guess they have to carry the stock up the hill!) The cave is actually situated and maintained by the “mua cave ecolodge” which has a hotel onsite. The entire ecolodge area was pleasant to visit. One point to note, admission is 100k dong. We felt it was overpriced considering what you get (albeit the impressive panoramic view of area). We understand that creating the steps in first place would have been difficult but still 100k for a climb was too much. Only criticism is the parking. On the way to the lodge there were several people trying to stop us to park. We kept going until the last parking area right outside the gate. We haggled the parking from 15k to 10k. Other people say that it should be free parking inside the gate but we were literally stopped by the last parking attendant outside the gate. The ticket office lady seemed to say that we should park outside. So not sure who was right. Overall, pleasant experience but definitely overpriced. Would recommend if you have excess money but you wouldn’t miss much if you didn’t go.

reviews.author: Chene-Taljaard
reviews.title: Great view at the top
reviews.content: Caves are not really special looking but go to the top of the mountain. It's 100 000 dong to enter and you have to climb steep steeps but the view is great. If you have a bike, ignore the very aggressive men who look "official" and tell you to park in one of the parking spaces on the right. They charge for something which you don't need to pay for. Just drive pass them into the gate where you will park for free and get your tickets.

reviews.author: JulianeRiedel
reviews.title: Amazing view from the top of the mountain
reviews.content: We didn't go to the caves but on top of the mountain To reach the staircase leading up to the mountain with the lying dragon you have to walk through the ecolodge. There's a small entrance fee. When you come by bike man will annoyingly whistle to signal you to park your bike at their plot and charge you 10.000 dong. Ignore them (even if they will get rude and shout at you) and park right infront of the entrance, maybe even inside. They still will charge you though.

reviews.author: KieuNhung
reviews.title: The best place in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: I have booked the luxury tour in Tony’s tour . And I had a great experience with my friends in Tam Coc . Especially is Mua cave . It is extremely beautiful.

reviews.author: ERDFirefighter
reviews.title: Wow, nothing more to say
reviews.content: The views up here are spectacular, yes there are about 500 steps but lots of places to stop to take in the beautiful views. Not many people there which is also a bonus. And if you park in the second last parking lot it's 10,000 rather than 15000 for parking, that is for motorcycles.

reviews.author: Parakeet6
reviews.title: Amazing views
reviews.content: Road our bikes over to Mua Caves from our hotel in Tam Coc.  Easy rides and lots to see.  Watch out for the guys trying to "sell" bike parking on way into caves.  There is somewhere to park just behind the ticket booth which costs nothing :)Climb up to the top lookouts is slow and steady and a little bit uneven underfoot - you need a reasonable level of fitness and confidence.  But it is definitely worth it!

reviews.author: Daoni Nguyen
reviews.title: Just breath taking!
reviews.content: Climbing here is fun and the views gets more and more splendid as you go up. A large panorama, and view down the river of Tam Coc with all the boats. Ideal image of the “eternal Asia”!

reviews.author: Jonathan J
reviews.title: Stunningly Beautiful View
reviews.content: My experience of the Mua Caves was absolutely brilliant. As one enters, you can have a meal at the restaurant located below the mountain (their food is really good.) When you decide to venture to and up the mountain you are greeted with beautiful natural features, idols and eventually many steps. It is a really great walk and I can not express how glad I am I visited. If you like beautiful natural scenery and walking, this is for you.

reviews.author: nsyn1
reviews.title: great cave
reviews.content: after a long path up, we got to mua cave, so much beautiful stalagmites and stalactites, we could make so many photo down to the valley.

reviews.author: Waseem Ahmed
reviews.title: Good but expensive..
reviews.content: View is so awesome.. you will walk and hike and even do the rock climbing.. however it is bit expensive for hiking and walking..

reviews.author: George F
reviews.title: Wow
reviews.content: Amazing views from the top, one hell of a climb though, a nice little lady selling beers and water about a third of the way up, sadly as with most places in Vietnam there was trash left by inconsiderate tourists.

reviews.author: FarinaGermany
reviews.title: Worth the effort
reviews.content: It took us around 20minutes to get up the 500+ stairs because it is just so exhausting. But once you made it you get rewarded with a spectacular view!The cave itself is a little bit hidden, and you wouldn't miss a lot if you don't find it. Entrance fee is 100.000đ.

reviews.author: Jessica R
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: Such a beautiful site that offers an amazing view on Tam Coc river. Getting up to the top is not that long but be careful some areas may be dangerous especially when it is crowded.Watch out as well for the parking - do not park your motorbike or bicycle at the first "parking" where some guys will hail at you. Wait for the very very last parking just in front of the entrance where you will pay the real price. FYI we paid 8.000 dongs for two bicycles.

reviews.author: Jude-trang
reviews.title: Worth the 500 step climb
reviews.content: Amazing views.it looks like a long way up when you get there but it’s not too bad,definitely worth it.100k/$4 entrance...well somebody had to build the steps.Little tea/coffee/drinks shop half way up, and numerous bigger spots with food at the bottom.10k-15k parkour scooter, saw 1 guy drive back and forth saying to them “that guy back there charge 10k”...I hope his 20 cent saving went to good use.Pay the damn fee, what can you get for 60 cent back home?

reviews.author: Devrah
reviews.title: 500 steps to the top
reviews.content: We went there by bike, during the trip to the location, we passed the rice field area and the view was amazing. We have to climb 500 steps to go up and worth it to do. On the other side there is also a path to the top with a bit different landscape

reviews.author: varun_mukthi
reviews.title: Great views
reviews.content: Not sure why these are called caves since there are hardly any noteworthy caves in this area. The main attraction is the 500 step climb to the top of the summit to the temple from where you get panoramic views of the delta which is breath-taking. Well worth the climb and can definitely recommend it.

reviews.author: Holly M
reviews.title: Vacation in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: Went and explored the caves after climbing to the top of the mountain to touch the Dragon.  Caves were interesting with a crystal clear pond in one cave and several small huts positioned around the main cave.  Area is located with a resort which is clean and beautiful.

reviews.author: kathyal1
reviews.title: Nice view, but expensive
reviews.content: The view is very nice, but 100K for the entrance it’s too much ! Fortunately I didn't pay the fake parking !

reviews.author: exquisitektc
reviews.title: Lying Dragon Hike Found Here
reviews.content: Mua Caves is the starting point to climb the 500 steps to the top of the mountain to see (1) the best view of Ninh Binh and (2) Lying Dragon statue.Of all the things we did, this hike/crawl to the top is what we would recommend most. The view offers a fantastic perspective of the general size and terrain of NB. Though the guides say 500 steps, the steps are not evenly spaced or measured so it probably comes out to 1000 regular size stair-steps.Our guide drove us to the starting point, located outside the Hang Múa Ecolodge so we did not experience the locals trying to rip us off for parking.Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Maria-Victoria S
reviews.title: A great daytrip - leave enough time
reviews.content: We rented motorbikes from Ninh Binh and drove a short distance through charming countryside complete with water buffalos.The climb to Flying Dragon was just challenging enough. Definitely a trip most people can manage although it's a climb of about 500 steps straight up give or take. The views are spectacular so best to do it when the weather is clear. We didn't manage the caves because we came late in the day. I recommend arrival before noon to make sure you have time to visit all the charming places this area has to offer before dark. The uncertainty of course is driving countryside roads after dark. Many motorbikes don't have working headlights and there are no street lights. So my recommendation is to drive back well before sunset.There is a restaurant on site that serves nice meals but of course it is outside the price range of most backpackers.

reviews.author: Catherine
reviews.title: Must do!
reviews.content: One of the main reasons I came to Ninh Binh was to hike up the Ngoa Long mountain above the caves- well worth the 463 steps as the view was phenomenal! We were lucky that it wasn’t drizzling like the day before so had clear views back across Tam Coc. The steps themselves are odd shapes and sizes but I saw both children and 65+ year olds complete. The cave itself has a spring inside and would be a nice relief from the heat on a hot day. It isn’t as nicely maintained as one would hope, but hopefully that is improved.

reviews.author: AnneB39
reviews.title: Amazing views. Don’t pay for parking
reviews.content: No one can deny the effort to walk to the top is worth it for the views. We cycled from Tam Coc having been to the grotto in the morning. At the grotto there is official parking which is understandable due to the number of people and space. There is an official system to ensure security and you have to pay. However as you approach Mua caves along the narrow road men are directing you off to the side to park and charge you for it. We had been warned this is a scam as there is plenty of free parking behind the ticket office. One man stood in the road with his arms out to block us but we just rode around him. We came to no harm so don’t take any notice just ride through and park for free.

reviews.author: Karishma S
reviews.title: Good views
reviews.content: Steep stairs but not too bad to climb. Good views from the top. Stairs are a bit uneven and slippery when wet.  I'd recommend a comfortable footwear.

reviews.author: fridai630
reviews.title: Super aggressive men in front of the Mua Caves
reviews.content: We we're going to visit Mua Caves 19.2.18, but turned away after meeting the very aggressive scammers with parking. We were with bicycles that dont have a lock, so it would be ok for us to pay something. We wanted to go to see the Mua Caves ticket prices before leaving the bicycles, but there were three really angry men with sticks who didn't let us to go in with our bicycles (cause the parking is free inside the gate). They behaved so threatening, that we decided to ride away. As a tourist I dont tolerate any violence behavior and these men really ruin the whole place. I dont mind if I dont see the cave at all, cause no way I will pay for a person who acts like that. This place is a shame for Ninh Binh and Vietnam! Just don't go there to ruin your day.

reviews.author: Sebastien S
reviews.title: Worth the hike
reviews.content: Good little hike up in the stairs leading to a beautiful panoramic view of Tam Coc. Caves over there were nothing special at all. I don’t feel the caves are a must-see in Tam Coc but if you have time, definitely a good place to spend 1.5-2h

reviews.author: Ivana J
reviews.title: Nice view over Tam Coc
reviews.content: 486 steps for great view to Tam Coc. Even slower walkers will manage it there and back in 30 minutes. Worth visit

reviews.author: Carol P
reviews.title: Wow !
reviews.content: Let s say you got to have good legs to walk up those rocky stairs ! Good thing the view is awesome after 500 steps. We arrived by scooter and had to pay someone to park whereas I read that it was free parking. So I dont know if it s changed or if I got ripped off.

reviews.author: laia
reviews.title: Amazing!!
reviews.content: we read it in the guide, but we didn't hear it from people. It's really beautiful, both the ride till there, the monument and the views from the top. if you like cycling, this area is simply amazing. quiete and lovely views, cycling surrounded by rice fields and the real vietnam!

reviews.author: Bianca C
reviews.title: Worth a visit
reviews.content: If you are in a reasonable physical shape I totally recommend a visit to the Mua Caves. The stairs to the top are very difficult to climb but the view when you get to the top is amazing. Definately worth some time for a visit.

reviews.author: teleab
reviews.title: Must see in Ninh Binh 🙂
reviews.content: This is a truely hidden gem. Such a beautiful and tranquil place. The walk is lovely and views are spectacular. Caves are ok. Nothing on phong Nha :) The stairs are worth the effort. It’s not as bad as you think. We loved it up there, quite a few people as it was close to sunset but still it was amazing. We stayed up there for quite a while. A couple were getting wedding pics up there. So beautiful :)

reviews.author: Nirit1
reviews.title: Beautiful scenery
reviews.content: This is a truly magnificent place. You need to climb a few hundred steps but the view from the top is definitely worth it!In January and early February the rice in not planted yet so the fields are still muddy or filled with water yet it is still very beautiful. I can only imagine how it looks on a sunny day with bright green fields...

reviews.author: Tony L
reviews.title: Beautiful landscape but be warned about scooter parking
reviews.content: We stay inside Mua Cave Ecolodge so we don't have to park our motorbike where all those angry scammers with whistles try to catch preys. Apart from parking issue (I have no idea why Mua Cave let those men ruin tourist's first impression about it), I have great experience climbing up to the top. I always like a good view from anything;s peak so this is worth it.

reviews.author: Tiffany L
reviews.title: WARNING: ANGRY SCAMMERS RUIN IT WITH ROCKS AND BLADES!
reviews.content: Great views as other reviews below have said, but the aggressive parking scammers at the entrance ruined it. The cave is about 10 minute scooter ride from Tam Coc central, poorly signed.We had read reviews prior about free parking through the Hotel gates in the resort car park, and we intended to just zoom through past the parking scammers (approximately 4-5 guys).When we got there, this was impossible as they blow whistles at you, physically grab your scooter, and prevent you from entering. These guys became very verbally and physically aggressive, threatening us with rocks, scissors, and knives. They picked up rocks, and they were cutting electrical cables with massive scissors as a “subtle” threat. We walked in to the ticket counter to enquire about the parking, however the lady behind the counter was in on the scam too. Apparently the free parking is only for cars and guests of the hotel. She had minimal English and told us to park outside and walk in. She was “sorry” for their behaviour when we complained...We decided to not risk it as we had read reviews that scooters were ruined when parked down the road before the turn off. We refused to pay the $15k viet dong, and just handed over $10k dong after all the commotion. They were happy. We think $5k would suffice. Just hand it over and leave. Or, send one person up to the ticket office and then when the guys have moved away zoom through the gates to the free parking.When we left, we encountered tourists who had parked down the road within view of the ticket scammers. They were refused entry by the scammers, who physically blocked them from entering by holding a chain on a stick. They were only allowed to enter if they parked their scooters in their parking lot. The view from up top was amazing, but just be careful with the parking scammers as they become very aggressive. Take your chances and dismiss the threats and go through if you want as not sure that they would assault you in broad daylight in front of lots of people over 15k dong. Karma will get them!

reviews.author: Guide699234
reviews.title: Worth the climb!
reviews.content: Caves were alright, the climb to the top was challenging but incredible views when you get to the top!

reviews.author: Rod H
reviews.title: WARNING! !!
reviews.content: A warning to all who ride a moterbike to Hang Mua! !!When I got there they wanted 15,000 VND to park my scooter,  I said no way and drove up the road about 100m and parked outside a house. .. When I came back I could not turn the key and all locals that tried could not. .. I called the Homestay where I was staying and rented the bike from and he looked inside the key whole and saw something inside. .. He called someone who took it apart and found a  4cm nail inside. .. A lady came out and said 2 people yesterday had the same done to them. .. If you don't wanna pay the rip off  15,000 VND,  park up before you see the entrance. ..

reviews.author: jessicaembrey
reviews.title: The view is worth it
reviews.content: The 500 steep stairs may seem intimidating but the walk is absolutely worth the view. The caves are nothing special but the Lying Dragon mountain absolutely is! You definitely don’t need to do a tour for this place, just take it at your own pace.

reviews.author: Shi
reviews.title: 500 stairs and some very steep steps but worth it on a clear day
reviews.content: As luck would have it, we ended up doing the Mua Cave as part of the tour on the one day during our that it drizzled throughout. This did impact the views from the top but we still enjoyed the climb a lot, the stairs at the top are very steep, so if you have particularly sensitive knees, do take your time. There was a wedding photo shoot happening halfway to the top, this was nice to witness. The views, even on a cloudy day was quite wonderful, the rice fields far and wide. If I recall right it cost 100,000 dongs to enter and there is ample room for parking outside the main entrance. On a good, clear day, certainly recommend the visit. We are glad we did it, despite the grey skies.

reviews.author: MakiRF
reviews.title: love it
reviews.content: we went by bicycles there. It is really easy to find, the entrance is around 4 usd, but it is worth it. Not that many stairs, around 500 but going up on 40 degrees makes it more difficult. The view is breathtaking. You can see the entire region with its rice fields, river and rocks. Very very nice place. One of my favorite in Vietnam!

reviews.author: Luzdreamer
reviews.title: Ok, but not the best around the region
reviews.content: Nice to get to the top of the mountain and see the views, thats about it. the caves are nothing spectacular

reviews.author: sanu
reviews.title: Memorable morning climb with great view
reviews.content: We climbed in early morning around 6:30am, day was cloudy but still had a great view of Ninh Binh area. Climb is around 30-40mins, quite comfortable. Steps are quite steep towards the top of mountain. Recommended to do in Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: DurstDan
reviews.title: 500 stairs but very worth
reviews.content: The overview is just breathtaking.. is my second visit here in tam coc and also this second time just amazing... you have to pay entrance down before entering the area. But then when you climbing up the steps, you should choose the left side. Once you will have the choice of going left or right.. both of the views after are amazing. Just the left side is in my opinion better.. have a look.

reviews.author: Nibha G
reviews.title: Beautiful hike and lovely scenery - Terrible hawkers in front of ticket booth.
reviews.content: Let me begin by saying that it's a beautiful hike and to finally get to the top with the amazing view. It is definitely worth every deep breath you had to take getting there.We didn't bother at all with the caves. Now the average review I gave was because of the hawkers in the front who charge you 15K VND for parking. There's free parking inside but they don't let you through and act all official. When I told two women that they could park for free at the ticket booth, the hawkers got aggressive at started screaming at my boyfriend and me. I even told them kindly that I had paid and everyone has a right to make their own choice. They threatened that if I told anyone else we'd have a problem with them. Such idiots. But it's how they make money so I find it extremely unprofessional of the tourist administration to let them camp out and rip their paying customers off! Either you make it an official parking where everyone has to pay or CLEARLY state at the entrance that there's free parking inside. It's one sign and doesn't take much effort. I felt scammed by the lady at the ticket booth and the aggressive parking spot coordinators.

reviews.author: srkahodgson
reviews.title: Truly Spectacular Panoramic Views
reviews.content: Entry to the Mua Caves is not well sign posted. Despite having to walk up hundreds of steps, this is worth it. For the elderly or unfit, the walk may be challenging, being steep in places with varying sizes of steps. It is still enjoyable though. The 360 degree views once at the top are simply mind blowing. Some of the most spectacular scenery you will see, overlooking the Tam Coc rice fields and the valley. This must be done. A genuine highlight of Vietnam.

reviews.author: Gabriel O
reviews.title: Where my life changed.
reviews.content: This was my first stop in Vietnam where my life changed. I sold everything I owned to make this trip happen. My car, hoise, furniture. Everything. I did Ha Long Bay before the walk up this mountain, but this was better in my opinion. So good I went back. The 'caves' arent the true attraction here. Its the top of the mountain. Bring water, your camera, and your drone if you have one. 9

reviews.author: Fiona M
reviews.title: Hike rather than caves
reviews.content: Beautiful views at topCave is small and not the main attractionWe cycled out by bike from tam coc only took 30mins max

reviews.author: Kristie J
reviews.title: Walk itself was phenomenal
reviews.content: One of the highlights of my trip. Steep stairs (15-20mins walk to the top- with photo stops!). The Caves were impressive!Best way to get there is by bike or scooter.

reviews.author: Jennifer M
reviews.title: Special place!
reviews.content: We stayed here for nights and we loved it. The room is simple comfortable and clean.The staff was great and beyond helpful! They really made our stay 100 x better. The food was great and the breakfast was way more than expected. The Pho was maybe the best we had all trip. The location is gorgeous. It's a little out of the way but worth it! I would stay here again in a heartbeat!

reviews.author: Terri F
reviews.title: What a view 😲
reviews.content: 500 and something steps but wow is it worth it. Breathtaking views and it was so quiet. The pictures speak a thousand words.

reviews.author: Daniel Lee
reviews.title: Great stay, superb view, avoid restaurant
reviews.content: The resort is in the best position to explore the natural beauty of the area. The resort actually butts up to the National park itself. The views are amazing as shown in the picture below !!!!The rooms are warm, with strong WIFI, the bedding sumptuous , the bathrooms clean and not smelly. The rooms and ground are to a 3 star standard The staff at the reception where great and organised everything for us and were only to helpfulThe only draw back was the restaurant. The service was poor. It took 20 mins to make an omelette, when myself and my wife where the only ones in the restaurant  and when it arrive it was COVERED in grease. The portions where small as well. In truth though restaurant was a small drawback,  the views and the room itself more than compensated for it.

reviews.author: Loes V
reviews.title: Amazing view!
reviews.content: The cave itself is not worthy to visit, the view though is worth the climb! Try to park your scooter/bike inside the facility and not at one of the parking lots in front of the gate/fences surrounding the lot. Inside the gate it's free of charge and your bike/scooter won't be broken.

reviews.author: Jan D
reviews.title: Nice climb worth the effort!
reviews.content: Great view over the mountains, not that many tourists if you are lucky. If you stay in Ninh Binh, take a scooter or a bike, the roads are in good condition and there isn’t much traffic either. It takes probably about 20min from Ninh Binh if you take your time and go through some of the small local streets and through the bike paths through the rice fields.

reviews.author: linderlou6
reviews.title: Great walk with phenomenal views
reviews.content: This was our last activity in Ninh Binh/Tam Coc before heading out and it was great way to end our time there. We didn't stop to see the caves, but the view from the top is wonderful. We were slightly afraid of the walk, but we are a pretty active bunch and it wasn't bad at all. I wish we had more time to spend there. Also, this was the last stop for the most recent season of Amazing Race, my kids loved that they actually got to be some where that seemed so remote when watching the show!

reviews.author: mikelambertmike
reviews.title: The climb is better than the caves
reviews.content: A nice climb up a mountain with great views (if it’s not too cloudy) and a couple of caves underneath. The caves are fabulous compared to anything I’ve seen elsewhere in the world, but there are lots more impressive around this area

reviews.author: Philipp S
reviews.title: Nice view and perfect start for a daytrip in Ninh Binh region
reviews.content: We had a trip with 2 scooters and started at the Mua Caves. Long way up but worth it because of the nice view.

reviews.author: Emma402018
reviews.title: surprising panorama view from of mountain ,
reviews.content: This was amazing place to come for great pictures.All most of the most beautiful view can be see from here.I definitely recommend for any traveler.

reviews.author: Ellyas Bangun
reviews.title: AMAZING !!
reviews.content: So, at first me and my friend think that this is just ordinary caves with few temples below.But we walk up until the last temple and we saw that there is someone just coming from the top which literally there is a sign for not climb up.We try ti climb up, (i know its against the sign) but we just curious about it. After climb about 100m up we see good view from top. It was breathtaking!!!And suddenly someone called us from another side which more higher that where we are. We think that its a cop!! (Crap we got caught)But !! It was a local who asked us to climb more to see more beautiful view.And its true. It was like all the effort to climb got paid off !!! I don’t recommend people to try against the sign and climb up but this place is totally worth it to see from the very top.

reviews.author: totfoster
reviews.title: Expensive for what it is but nice view from the top
reviews.content: We climbed up after paying 100k dong each including the kids, the best thins was seeing four brides teetering on the edge whilst having their wedding photos taken in their white dresses which is a popular thing to do at this location. The views are good but not mindblowing.

reviews.author: jungpark
reviews.title: Breathtaking!
reviews.content: This place is a must go. But, please mind that it is not accessible by walking, unless you like to walk long distances. So, your best bet is to ride a scooter taxi, ride your rented scooter, or ride your bike to here. If you visit Ninh Binh, I would strongly recommend visiting here.

reviews.author: blueesmrs
reviews.title: Some view alright!
reviews.content: Did the climb, enjoyed it, views beautiful even on a cloudy ded afternoon, a definite if you are in the area. As others said go right up and through the gate to park moped or bikes then the parking is free.

reviews.author: Just_the_Wanderer
reviews.title: Wrong name for a good place
reviews.content: This place is inside a complex where you can visit some caves and climb the mountains through some hundreds of steps. The caves are not the big deal, however going to the mountain is much better. From there you have a great view of the surrounding area which will let you with the mouth open. If you are lucky you will see some wild goat running through the mountains.

reviews.author: Tuaelisa
reviews.title: Gorgeous views
reviews.content: The views from the top are absolutely amazing and well worth the climb! As in most places in Vietnam, there aren't good signs to the place so finding it can be a bit tricky. You have to enter a hotel area to get to the viewing place. Don't leave your scooter outside the hotel gate; there are people trying to scam you into doing that but just drive past them.

reviews.author: Courtney
reviews.title: Super cool views
reviews.content: As others have stated, the caves here aren't anything special. What is special are the incredible views atop the 500 stairs. You can see the rice fields on one side and the river where the tam coc boat tours go through on the other. We went around 11 am and there weren't too many people around. I'd give yourself an hour or two to mess around, get some good photos, rest on your way up and soak in the scenery. You must pay to park your bike and then pay for the entrance but it's worth every penny. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Cathleen D
reviews.title: Incredible - must do in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: Highlight of Ninh Binh!! Long climb up but totally worth it - great photo ops and wow what an amazing view. Ticket entry is 100000 VND pp. A must do if you’re in the area!!

reviews.author: inkkie7 .
reviews.title: Fun climb!
reviews.content: I was surprised my 4 yr old daughter enjoyed climbing up & down the hill without complaining of tiredness. Even young men were stopping for breath. It was rather fun & challenging to climb especially for a housewife like me but the view on top was awesome. We even saw couples taking wedding photos on top. Hats off to the bride for climbing up in her pouffy bridal gown! 👰🏻

reviews.author: Mayank Agarwal
reviews.title: Beautiful Views, Awesome Picture opportunity, Hikes Gives Sense of Self Accomplishment
reviews.content: The cave itself is rubbish, you visit for the views from the peak above which require a good hike. If you don’t like hiking/climbing, it’s better to skip the site. The climb of about 500 steps is paved but very steep in the end. Normally people do it in 15 minutes, we ourselves must have taken 30 to 40 minutes (well I am obese).  Felt it’s totally worth it for the amazing unobstructed views of Tom Coc on one side and the rural village view on the other side. It’s advisable to carry a bottle of water as there are no refreshment points on the way up. Entry Fees is 100,000 VND.The climb starts from Mua Caves Ecolodge, a great option for people to stay over as I am sure the views would be more enchanting at sunrise or sunset. There is a cafeteria at the start of the climb beside a pond, got hammocks and a garden style setup.

reviews.author: Sander B
reviews.title: Great view - must go
reviews.content: Great view, must go! There a lot of steps to The top, but The view is very rewarding. All around Great experience.

reviews.author: Ellie200809
reviews.title: 500 steps 👍
reviews.content: You must pass the 500 steps to climb to the top of the mountain . stand from above you can see the panoramic view of the city of Ninh Binh , Ngo Dong River to the small boat into Tam COC .This is an attractive destination you should not miss.You should go to the rice harvest season in Ninh Binh to watch the scenery of rice fields.

reviews.author: richmond144
reviews.title: Not a cave at all--but better!
reviews.content: Mua Caves is not a cave. It's a collection of karsts (the mountainous landforms you see in the pictures). A visit to Mua Caves involves a rather steep hike up stone steps where you will be rewarded with refreshing breezes and amazing views overlooking the karsts, rice paddies, and Ninh Binh. Don't miss this scenic trek!At the bottom of the hike, there are two large swings overlooking the rice fields and a short fairly level path that walks around a pond. If some members of your party aren't up for the climb, there is a lovely area for them to enjoy near the bottom.

reviews.author: Utterchaos
reviews.title: Ordinary caves
reviews.content: The caves are really nothing to see, but the climb up the Lying Dragon path is worthwhile for the view. This is included if you are staying at the Ecolodge. Be aware that if you are older or you are carrying an injury that parts of the steps are quite uneven and could present a challenge. There are quite a few places to stop and rest on the way up. Recommend first thing in the morning or late afternoon for this activity.

reviews.author: Ashton Tessier
reviews.title: More like Mua Hike...
reviews.content: Not sure why the spot is called Mua Caves. The caves were a disappointment, especially after they charge 100,000 dong per person to enter, however there is a spectacular view after a little bit of a climb up the mountain. The view from the top was gorgeous. I wouldn't put this at the top of my must do's, but it was still nice to see!!

reviews.author: tlord2017
reviews.title: Well worth the climb
reviews.content: How often do you go somewhere on a staff recommendation only to meet people who have come to this one place as an item on their bucket list. The trip up and down (the steps are SERIOUS climbing) was great and the chats with people from around the world was fun. strenuous but fun.

reviews.author: TravelWanderlust90
reviews.title: A high high steps to reach the Lying Dragon!!
reviews.content: Travelled with my friends to Mua Caves, I have no idea to go in Trang An but followed my friends. *Mua Cave is not a CAVE* which I dont know why they call it a CAVE???!Instead is a-at-least 5-600 step stair to the top. OK, you are able to observe the spectacular peaceful view of Trang An, but the steps are tighter and steeper when you nearly reach the top peak without any handrail which is terrified.Another point : they charge 100,000 VND for entrance fee that is ridiculously high compares to Vietnam living expenses. All of my friends complained about it.For those who are afraid of the height - this is not an ideal place!!!

reviews.author: hayleyniad
reviews.title: Nice views
reviews.content: We came expecting to see a cave, which may have been our fault for not reading the reviews first.  The views from the top were very pretty but if you are doing other climbing activities in the area you’re likely to see similar views.  Also, I applaud those reviewers who have called this an easy 15 minute hike - I am in reasonably good shape and found this to be a very challenging number of steep steps to handle!

reviews.author: kyy0te
reviews.title: Not the caves, but the steps to the Lying Dragon
reviews.content: The caves were unimpressive unless we missed something, but climbing the steps up the mountain was definitely worth it.

reviews.author: Jesse F
reviews.title: Excellent views one hell of a walk
reviews.content: Apparently this is about 500 steps upwards and im still feeling every one of them, but the view was worth it. Great photo opportunities on the way back.

reviews.author: BillyGre
reviews.title: Great view
reviews.content: We paid 10$ for tickets and spent around 1 hour to visit the cave. It took 15 minutes to climb up and we saw wonderful view from the top. However, the cave was quite small and not special like caves in Halong Bay. In general, a must see in Ninh Binh!

reviews.author: Sofía GG :)
reviews.title: BREATHTAKING
reviews.content: Definitely worth it! My favourite attraction in North Vietnam. The scenery is just amazing. I recommend going in the afternoon and staying at the top to see the sunset!!

reviews.author: Sancho D
reviews.title: Beautiful 360 view on top
reviews.content: Easy to get there biking from Tam Coc center (8 km), 100k for a ticket + 5k for each bike you park. Pretty site from entry up to the steps, and once you climbed all of the 450 steps (not too hard, just do as many stops as you need), really nice view with rice fields and Ninh Bing plain on one side, river and Vietnamese typical rocks on the other side.

reviews.author: Rachel B
reviews.title: Mua cave - a must see! Great view point!
reviews.content: Regular tourist tours from Hanoi don’t come to this look out pint but it is worth the trip. 580 stairs and you will find a great view around you... We took a private tour of the area just to get here. Don’t miss it

reviews.author: HWKhor
reviews.title: Short hike with a scenic view
reviews.content: It's a short hike up the cave and along the way you can catch great views! Recommended activity. Fresh air and nice top view looking down from the top of the cave.

reviews.author: Damian J
reviews.title: Incredible view
reviews.content: We went there at the morning and it was uncrowded and quiet. There are many parkings outside the lodge. It's a quite requirement to get to the top especially in hot and high humidity. Additional impediment is that steps are different heigh and some of them are really high. It definitely worth climbing the stairs to see view from the top.

reviews.author: cecillie m
reviews.title: beautiful view!
reviews.content: A short climb to a beautiful view of Ninh Binh! We stayed in Mua Cave Ecolodge so our climb here is free. They said it looked best before harvest time. But it still look amazing when we gt there. They open at 7am-5pm

reviews.author: TerryTeo
reviews.title: My highlight in Ninh Binh!
reviews.content: I came here and hiked up around 4pm. There were considerable of crowd as everyone was trying to catch the spectacular sunset over the Tam Coc rice field from the top. The hike up took around 20 minutes. The flight of stairs could be challenging but not impossible. The sunset view was mind-blowing and please get the sunset timing right when you visit. I saw 2 men started the ascend when everyone was descending and I would have thought they missed the sunset, unless they were staying there for couple of days. Please be vigilant of the safety around this area - as I personally think this area would not meet many international safety standards for visit. There were no proper signage, railing and fencing at the top. Just be extra cautious.

reviews.author: Rico
reviews.title: Nice view
reviews.content: The clime is worth is and gives you a really nice view of the city. Not sure about the cave there was water in there and could no go in there. The clime to the top was around 25 - 30 minutes for me. The price is 100.000 for a adult which is a little high for what you get I think.

reviews.author: Wayne B
reviews.title: Great view
reviews.content: We didn't bother going to Mua Cave as we really wanted to climb to the top of Mua Hill.The stairs are a bit uneven but the effort of climbing the 450 steps is worthwhile.Even though the day we went was overcast we still had a great view of the surrounding countryside.There are several places where you can stop and rest and take photos.

reviews.author: Titran
reviews.title: A must see in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: It is worth climbing 500 steps to be on the top. The whole Tam Coc landscape is revealed and this should be a must visit apart from Tam Coc and Trang An boat tours.

reviews.author: ndglamr
reviews.title: Great view!
reviews.content: This is a hidden gem! The climb to the top was fantastic and not impossible. My wife and I did it with our daughter (two years old). You get a fantastic view of the area, and on the ground it is a great place to walk a round and just get a break from busy tourist attractions.

reviews.author: Valentina F
reviews.title: Challenging hike up to Mua Caves
reviews.content: This cave complex was my favorite part of our Vietnam trek - easily the best views. The hike up to the top of the cave complex was extremely welcome after several days of lazing around on our Ha Long Bay cruise. I’ll let the photos speak for themselves!

reviews.author: Ondřej K
reviews.title: Price is bit inadequate
reviews.content: The cave is not really the reason to go there. The view is not bad (probably depends on season) but after visiting north of Vietnam nothing special. 100.000 VND for entrance is ok if it’s the only peak you visit in Vietnam, otherwise i would think twice whether to go there.

reviews.author: lidkaa
reviews.title: Very nice place but be careful...
reviews.content: ... if you go there by motorbike or bike. There are people that will try to stop you on the way there to leave bike/motorbike on their parking for 5K. There is a free parking lot behind the gate.The caves are nothing special but the view from the top of the Lying Dragon Mountain is really nice :)

reviews.author: BVL69
reviews.title: We climbed to the temples above Mua Cave ; the view was stunning, even on a cloudy misty day.
reviews.content: The cave was small and not very interesting. However the climb to the temples above the cave was really worthwhile with stunning views over to Ninh Binh and on the other side over the river system that boats row along. We did a boat trip the next day from Trang An; we thoroughly enjoyed it even in light rain - we passed through low caves and stopped at a temple.

reviews.author: James L
reviews.title: Worth the climb
reviews.content: Go for the sunset view. The panoramic view of the landscape and river below was breathtaking. It’s totally worth the 100k price of entry and the nearly 500 steps up. It’s not that difficult. We saw young children at the peak.

reviews.author: JunJie4
reviews.title: Really cool view from the top
reviews.content: The view up above is just amazing. After the 500 steps, if you're feeling adventurous, please do climb up to the dragon. I waited for the sunset on the dragon and it was beautiful.

reviews.title: Amazing views!
reviews.content: A long long walk up many steps but the views are absolutely worth the struggle! 100,000 vnd entry fee. Roughly £4, worth every penny. Area is clean and plenty of parking space for scooters and motorbikes.

reviews.author: MarSca
reviews.title: Nice view from up there
reviews.content: The stairs are very steep. A decent physical condition is recommended, cause the steps can be as high as 40/50 cm. It took us 45 minutes up and down with numerous breaks for pictures.The view from up there is really nice

reviews.author: Emma W
reviews.title: Excellent views but expensive
reviews.content: Having cycled to Trang An we stopped at Mua Caves on our way back to the homestay. We climbed the hill to the dragon and the views were amazing. But for the entry fee this was an expensive view as the cave was not worth the visit.

reviews.author: Nhi H
reviews.title: Very nice view
reviews.content: After climbing a lot of stairs and being exhausted, you will enjoy a very nice view from above of Mua Cave Not bad for spending time

reviews.author: Thomas v
reviews.title: Mua "cave" / staircase +view
reviews.content: The cave is not worth mentioning. instead you should just do the stairs that start at the "cave". Once you reach the top you'll get a terrific view on the rice fields and surrounding area. (at most touristic stops there will be parking incl "security" which will ask a small fee for "securing" your bike or scooter... Don't know if they are legit so sometimes we paid them, sometimes we didn't...)

reviews.author: emilita13
reviews.title: Trip with Indochina Junk
reviews.content: We took a day trip from Hanoi to Ninh Binh with Indochina Junk.  They picked us up from our hotel and drove us back at the end of the day. We had bikes ready and waiting with our guide.  We biked around 30kms and hiked up Mua Cave. It was spectacular!! It's not busy or touristy -- and the view is worth the climb up.

reviews.author: Luca C
reviews.title: Every effort's repaid
reviews.content: 500 steps under the burning Vietnamese Sun could be very hard to face for someone.Actually, it's not easy as a walk on the beach during the spring season, but I swear that the view on the top repays from every effort.I absolutely suggest not to miss it ( and to spend at least 2 days in the wonderful Ninh Binh )

reviews.author: Minh Châu P
reviews.title: Amazing view
reviews.content: Should go in April since it offers the view of the golden rice field. Otherwise weather in Oct is really comfortable for travelling

reviews.author: Sonnycolin
reviews.title: Awesome viewpoint
reviews.content: Hike for about 10 min to the top. My gf found the high steps pretty challenging but doable. The view is amazing. Tip: If you are up for it, go climb a bit onto the rocks, Some pretty cool photo spots are there to be found.

reviews.author: Yannis L
reviews.title: Must come!
reviews.content: The entrance fee is 100,00 Đồng. To get to the TOP you have to climb 500 steps up the hill. But once u are up there, the view is totally worth it! Not only u get to see the city view, u also get to see the stunning nature landscape. Highly recommended to anyone who wish to see the landscapes

reviews.author: cannga1
reviews.title: Stunning - Ninh Binh is not complete without this view from top. ;-)
reviews.content: Although Mua Cave is at ground level, as part of the visit you would climb to the mountain top right above Mua Cave (a short climb on stairs). From here, you get a rare and spectacular view of the limestone mountains and river from ABOVE (as opposed to view from the boat). The view from top gives a much better appreciation of the stunning beauty of the area IMHO.Especially if you are into photography, make sure to add Mua Cave to the itinerary.

reviews.author: Elmer S
reviews.title: Tripled the entry price!
reviews.content: Great view from the top (after a long climb, try to do this in the early morning or late afternoon) but the entry fee is way too high. They more than tripled it compared to our 2016 Lonely Planet: from 30k to 100k dong per person.  Parking is free though, skip the hawkers in front of the entrance, there's a parking spot for your (motor) bike just beyond the gate.

reviews.author: mena s
reviews.title: Amazing View
reviews.content: Unfortunately the caves were flooded and we had to take a boat to get to the entrace. But the scenery is just breathteaking

reviews.author: Daan A
reviews.title: Have you ever seen the rain?
reviews.content: Caves were flooded when we got there. However, climbing the chairs in the torrential rain storm during a tropical storm while the road were flooded was truly epic. Bucketlist. Authentic. Propper millenial stuff ;-).

reviews.author: Hang Ng
reviews.title: Stunning sunset!
reviews.content: It might be a bit slippery climbing up, so get ready with a proper shoes. The view will worth your effort! they said ticket is a bit pricey but let's forget it. The view will worth you more than it

reviews.author: Kevin O
reviews.title: Epic views
reviews.content: This is a must see, King Kong filmed here, you sort of feel when your at the top, he is going to jump out at you.

reviews.author: David O
reviews.title: Panoramic view of Tam Coc
reviews.content: I rented a local bicycle and find my way through the local village, grave yards, rice fields, mud tracks and finally arrived at Hang Mua.Entrance fee is 100,000.00 Dong. Walk right in passing the eco-lodges along the stone footpath and up a constructed stone stair case up Hang Mua.Once reaching the top , the view is fabulous, overlooking the rice fields below and the river on the other.

reviews.author: Risha D
reviews.content: if there's one thing you are planning on doing in Tam Coc, let it be this one. you'll leave speechless! make sure you have a lot of water beforehand. :)

reviews.author: Chua K
reviews.title: Early morning or late afternoon visit will be good, a good 1 hour climb
reviews.content: Hugely popular with day trippers, combining Mua Cave with Hoa Lu temple and the boat ride.  Avoid weekends. Scenic view at the top, looking over the limestone karst hills and rivers. We cycled here from Tam Coc town, a pleasant morning cycle. Verdict: just ok for 100,000 VND entry fee. Guilin in China views are more dramatic.

reviews.author: Paul M
reviews.title: Worth the climb
reviews.content: A nice bike ride from Tam Coc town centre. On arrival we looked for somewhere to park our bikes. Don't be fooled by the guy who tells you to park in front of his shop, he'll expect you to pay and we found out afterwards that we could have parked in an area where we bought a ticket! After you get your ticket you follow the path towards the caves. There are a few caves here, one will lead to a café where you can get yourself a cold drink before or after you climb. Another small cave is full of ankle deep water which leads to  a dead end, this cave is at the bottom of the stairs you'll climb to the top.The stair climb is pretty moderate, we climbed at 1200 so it was stupid hot and we found It a struggle. As you climb you will begin to see amazing views. They get better as you climb higher and higher so I'd recommend just getting to the top before you start taking you pictures. There are two peaks here, which we were not aware of. They are both worth climbing.

reviews.author: Kaylee05
reviews.title: Breath-taking sunset
reviews.content: We stay near Tam Coc and then take a bicycle to Hang Mua. It's so peaceful and beautiful along the way to Hang Mua. You can witness the local farmer working in the rice fields.  I think the best time to go Hang Mua is afternoon, you climb to the top and admire the golden rice fields and catch the scarce moment of the sunset here.

reviews.author: andrew-jerusalem
reviews.title: Nice view but was it worth the climb?
reviews.content: We cycled to the mua cave from tam coc which is about 7 km and the ride itself was nice. The cave is nothing special, what you really go for is the view from the top of the hill. But 300 plus steps in 32c heat and 100% humidity is not fun. Would only recommend if you are coming in a cooler part of the year

reviews.author: HongvanLe1
reviews.title: Great View to the field
reviews.content: Better go the in the after noon. Standing on chop you could see the rice field in sunset moments. Awesome.

reviews.author: Tomtomba
reviews.title: Breathtaking views
reviews.content: We didnt see much of the cave itself (tiger cave), but spent a large amount of time at the top of the hill until the sun set. Amazing views, quiet, and very peacefull spot.Defintely a must see here in Ninh Binh!Useful info:Bike and motorbike parking for 5,000 vnd100,000 vnd charge at the gate

reviews.author: Neta P
reviews.title: Cold waters, good views
reviews.content: Came here with 4,5 year olds. The cave is small only if you don't go in the water. Bring a suite and go in. There is a submerged walkway and lights and you can go quite deep into the mountain. Kids were happy to climb the steps. Bring lots of water and large hats / umbrella. Save the cave for last for a refreshing swim after the hot climb.

reviews.author: Katarina B
reviews.title: Nice views
reviews.content: Some quite nice views of the surrounding countryside, although you also get views of sprawling Ninh Binh city. I got there at about 930 on a Sunday in September, so it was quite busy and it got really hot quite fast. There's not much shade, so bring a hat and/or umbrella, and plenty of water (or you can buy cold drinks at the bottom of the stairs for 20,000 dong). While it's not very high, it is a fairly steep climb with quite tall steps. Quite a few visitors were blasting k-pop from portable speakers as they climbed so it wasn't the most tranquil experience - perhaps would be more ideal to go on a weekday when it's likely a bit quieter? Overall, it was a nice sightseeing attraction - but I would have enjoyed it much more if I'd arrived at opening time (7am) instead of later in the morning.

reviews.author: Giles C
reviews.title: The caves were disappointing but the views were AMAZING!!
