So I just had a wonderful day with the guide Ducivan through Ultimate Hanoi Adventures which organized a guided private tour for me. And Van Long nature reserve was our choice. By the 2 hour drive from Hanoi (85 km far from Hanoi). Upon arrival, we spent a 1.5 hour boat ride, here I got to catch many birds and rare monkeys and got stunning views of landscape and rural life. Along with a river, water was so clear that it looks like a mirror reflecting mountains, grottoes and the sky and then we cycle around Keng Ga village before enjoying the hot spring bath here. This Van Long nature reserve is completely untouched. It was fun and great.

reviews.author: Merlouis
reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.content: Was rowed along for a two hour trip up this lake to see the beautiful limestone hills. Very relaxing. Had to deal with a photographer and hawkers selling snacks and souvenirs but did not detract too much. Paddled mostly by using their feet which was fascinating in itself. Very busy - perhaps too many tourists.

reviews.author: Simon317
reviews.title: Not a must!!!!!!!!!
reviews.content: If you plan to visit Halong Bay a visit to Van Long nature reserve is not needed. Nice Limestone formations and caves but this does not justify the trip from Hanoi.

reviews.author: onemoreholiday
reviews.title: This was special
reviews.content: This was one of the best experiences in our two weeks in Vietnam.  The wetlands are viewed by a two hour row in small boats the local people do the rowing deciding their time between this tourist activity and farming you are taken at a leisurely pace through the wetlands stoping occasionally to see the wildlife - mainly long tailed monkeys the vegetation is interspersed with vertical rock formations reminiscent of How Long bay and at one point you go into a low (but not too low) cave tunnel.  The best thing is that unlike How Long bay this place is not over run with tourists so you can enjoy the peace and tranquillity of the place.Well worth discovering before enforce everyone else does.

reviews.author: Nadnerb2
reviews.title: Touristy
reviews.content: By far too many boats on the water. Cheesy touristy. There must be at least 200 boats on the waterway.

reviews.author: Bart N
reviews.title: Serene and beautiful
reviews.content: This place is a bit further away from Tam coc than the other boat tour places. Which makes it much better in my opinion since there won't be hundreds of tourists waiting in line to get into a boat. Its about a 17 km drive on a motorbike using the highway (really boring) The entrance fee is much lower. We payed 100k in total for 2 people including the boat (excl the tip ofcourse) We had a lovely lady rowing us through these beautiful waters. She spoke little english but was full enthousiasme and made every effort to make it a great boat trip (stopped when she saw me raise the camera to make a picture etc) Because of this and her keen eye sight we spend about 2 hours on the boat and had the place to our selves after the other boats had over taken us. Coming back to her keen eye sight we saw about 8 of the monkeys, even though the other groups had missed them :) really awesome. We ofc took a few pictures with er at the end and gave her a 100k tip for her great efforts/ service. Highly recommend going to this place if you're like me and don't want to be in a group of 40 other tourists.

reviews.author: worldtraveler189
reviews.title: Peaceful, quiet, beautiful
reviews.content: Beautiful!  Such a break from the craziness of Vietnam.  Amazing boat ride into nature.  Many birds, a chance to see some VERY rare monkeys, lots of water life.  I recommend a bike along the dyke for many views before or after.  We rented bikes at the Emeralda resort (we were guests).  Really nice.

reviews.author: shirleymtravels
reviews.title: Delacour’s langur
reviews.content: This was the second boat trip we did in the Ninh Binh area. It is difficult to decide which one was the best they were quite different and both spectacular.There were just the two of us in the boat on this trip.It is a much quieter trip than the Trang An trip.The scenery is again breathtaking.Highlight of the trip was we stopped and saw a group of the endangered Delacour’s langurs. It really was amazing.

reviews.author: narolmya
reviews.title: Less tourists than the other sightseeing in Ninh Bình
reviews.content: This is 1 of 2 place where the movie "Skull" filmed in Vietnam! Van Long Reserve possede a stunningly beautiful sight that it seems unreal! Less tourist, cheap fee, friendly people, I would love to come back here.

reviews.author: TonyTiger19
reviews.title: nice ride
reviews.content: Enjoyed teh hour spend riding and taking pictures. I would reccomend and nice cave to travel trought.

reviews.author: OSAFDIE
reviews.title: Serenitiy and Surprise
reviews.content: This is a great tour of two hours in which you go through various caves and come out in various water gardens. Try and go when there are no tourists to experience it the most.

reviews.author: Widdy
reviews.title: A slow raft ride through beautiful scenery.
reviews.content: Large limestone karsts jutting out of the calm murky waters. You can pay a small fee to be takes through the karsts on a small raft paddled by a local woman. If the water level is good you will pass through a cave in the karts, and if you are extremely luck, you may even spot a group of one of the worlds most endangered primates; the Delcaour's Langur.

reviews.author: H2753EDinfo
reviews.title: beautiful scenery
reviews.content: we were also very lucky to see close up family of 9 monkeysthe lady rower is very kind and helpful. do not forget to tip them after

reviews.author: Richard T
reviews.title: Peaceful boat trip with great views of the mountains
reviews.content: This was a very peaceful boat trip in a more remote area that doesn't receive quite so many tourists. You can park and simply buy a ticket. The boat men and women play cards while waiting for passengers and all seem to be in very high spirits. My girlfriend and I had a very talkative boat woman which was fortunate as she was able to tell us about the history of the place as well as the culture of the local people. If you go in the low season (November/December) then you are less likely to see the langurs and you won't be able to go through the cave, but you will see all of the pond plants taking over the lake and it seems more private and romantic. If you go in the high season (July/August) then you have a better chance to see the langurs, you will be able to go through the cave to the other side, but the lake will be more open with a lot of the pond plants flooded. The boats are more basic than those seen at Trang An and there are no spare oars for you to use, so you don't need to feel guilty about taking it all in.

reviews.author: spopey15
reviews.title: Stunning scenery
reviews.content: It's worth doing this at or just before sunset if you can - the light is beautiful in the late afternoon. We were very lucky and saw a group of the resident Delacour's langurs high up on the cliffs, going about their foraging business in their white shorts. The waterway is beautiful - lots of reeds and a good bird population. It is situated in the middle of a built-up area - near a motorway with a few biggish buildings around - and this is a bit of a disappointment, but once in the row boat, floating around with the cliffs above you, you can forget that. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: YnLing Y
reviews.title: For nature lovers
reviews.content: Yup, the boat ride may not be as fantastic as Trang An nor Tam Coc, but if you're staying at Emeralda Resort, rent a bike for 100k VND and make this the first stop after 500m out from the resort.  Boat tickets costs only a fraction of the other 2 places, and it's a different experience altogether. After the boat trip, ride further along the dyke and turn into the mountains to see the rural village charms of Gia Vien... paid fields, fish ponds, ducks, fowls, people going about their daily lives, children on bikes who greet you with a smile and "Hello!"Bring enough water to hydrate yourselves.

reviews.author: Roslyn V
reviews.title: River boat tour
reviews.content: This was a great experience, very romantic scenic and interesting. Mai who was our guide was lovely, and though he did not speak English one of our group was able to converse in a little Vietnamese- so we learnt more about the area and what was happening on the river. Mai was a lot of fun too. It's well worth the small fee

reviews.author: djcalberta
reviews.title: A long sampan trip for an unexceptional experience
reviews.content: Quite peaceful in the 2 person sampans. Scenery in general is good, but the caves are a little small and unexceptional. 90 minutes + is a bit uncomfortable on the hard, narrow wooden benches. The experience would have been great if the trip were half the time!!

reviews.author: Zachary Minh Lam
reviews.title: Panoramic View
reviews.content: The view was fantastic. Van Long reserved was smaller than Trang An. It's takes you 45 minutes to go around the place. If you are lucky enough. You will have chance to see the white monkey.

reviews.author: katie e
reviews.title: highly recommend
reviews.content: This was a peaceful, amazing mountain and landscape, boat trip very cheap,I pay 45.000 vnd. Should be go to there in the afternoon, there is some chance to see the wild langur, highly recommend.

reviews.author: LivingAbroad4Fun
reviews.title: Enjoyable Ride, can't compare to other cave trips
reviews.content: I knew we'd have time for only one boat tour on our trip, and based on the other reviews here we settled on Van Long. (Didn't hurt that it was walking distance from our hotel.) It might depend on what you'd like to get out of it, but it was fine for us. If it's the view you want, you can enjoy it just as well or better with a bike ride along the dike road. It was great for a boat ride without a lot of crowds. We went on a rainy day. It definitely wasn't crowded, but we still saw dozens of boats out on the water. (There were probably about a hundred or so boats docked.) The ticket booth was easy to find. There's not much there to confuse you. Get a ticket. Walk across the street and be directed into a boat. It's relaxing, and it's nice to see the view, but there is not much to it. We didn't see much wildlife. (Granted it was raining). The cave at the end was a little disappointing, but it was nice to shelter from the rain. The boat ride was about 20 minutes too long. By the time we got to the cave we were ready to be done. Tickets are cheap. I think 50,000 VND a person. We tipped 50% and were still accosted for more. Guess that never changes.

reviews.author: Diva Sicard
reviews.title: Peaceful Ninh Binh by boat
reviews.content: Discovering the beautiful region of Ninh Binh by a little boat rowed by an old lady, fear not she is very strong ! The views are beautiful and the area quiet seeing as there are a lot less tourists than at the other equivalent boat rides. It takes a little more than an hour which for me was enough and you get to see the stunning rock formations from the little barque flowing slowly through the shallow waters.It's really worth getting up a little early. We left at about 10:00 and there was only one other boat following us. The price was very cheap about 30K in Dong, we also left a well deserved tip to our rower. We were somewhat confused when we arrived for there are no huge signs or anything to really indicate that this is the place, on the right side of the road you'll see some kind of bus station and a booth, that is where you get the tickets. Last tip: check the weather. If stunning views and no tourists is your thing go (early) to Van Long nature reserve in Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: Amiram P
reviews.title: Not as good as people say
reviews.content: Reading the reviews here we were sure this is the best option for taking a boat ride in the area of Ninh Binh. It is true that the place is very quiet and not a lot of tourists go there. We went there around 2 PM and were the only people there. Finding the ticket booth is not as complicated as people wrote. In fact it's right there.The ride itself was peaceful although the scenery and the view are not as good as inTrang An. It takes about an hour and a half and you pretty much cruise along side the cliffs with one little cave at the end of the weed you turn around and go back the same way. We saw some birds but not much of a wildlife. Definitely not the top of the three options. The cheapest though. 100000 for a couple.

reviews.author: Lan D
reviews.title: Good sights
reviews.content: The view is good, very peaceful, not crowded. You can see trees and fish under the water. Should tips for the boatman.

reviews.author: JourneyImaged
reviews.title: Tranquil
reviews.content: As part of volunteering at the Endangered Primate Rescue Center in nearby Cuc Phuong National Park, we were treated to an afternoon at Van Long Nature Reserve.While gliding through the tranquil waterways is stunning, the area is also home to the critically endangered Delacour's Langur. Van Long is believed to contain the largest population left in the wild; and we were able to view a number of them.A very special afternoon!

reviews.author: JessiPalmer
reviews.title: Highlight of our trip to Vietnam
reviews.content: We chose to go to Van Long Nature Reserve instead of Tam Coc as we had heard there were less crowds and minimal pushy hawkers. We didn't have to wait in line at all and the boat trip was very relaxing......even with our 12 month old and 3.5 year old. It was one of the highlights of our trip to Vietnam.

reviews.author: collinL
reviews.title: See a different world
reviews.content: I took a motorcycle from my hotel near Ninh Bihn rode to Van Loong Viewpoint with my phone GPS. Arrived around 4:30pm. On motorcycle you can stop anywhere you want, take photos of farmers, fishermen, and of course the sceneries. Around 5:30pm the birds (storks) rested on the trees by the river before flying back to their nests. Need good zoom lens to get close, or take the boats. If you are lucky, the sunset will cast pretty lights on the whole valley.

reviews.author: allisoonm
reviews.title: Boat trip great... Long to get to
reviews.content: Pros: the boat trip itself was very nice. The scenery was beautiful. Price was cheap (50k per person and we gave a 50k tip). This was the opposite of touristy which  was nice. Boat ride was about an hour.Cons: to get here on your own from tam coc is a 40 minute motor bike ride on busy highway. You have to be an adept rider, which I am so it was fine.If you choose to go on your own, there is no clear signage at the "Pier".  There is a sign marking 2km at the turn. When you reach the end of this road (it's a t intersection) there is a white unmarked building to your right where you can buy tickets. On the left there were vendors selling embroidered cloths. If you go past the ticket office you will see the boats in the water and there may be no one at the boats, go back to the office and they will arrange.

reviews.author: Sagebomb
reviews.title: A quiet trip to see a critically endangered primate
reviews.content: I cycled from Ninh Binh to try and get a trip around 4pm (so I could cycle back before dark). I arrived around 4:20 and paid 80k for a single person trip, which took about a hour 20. At this time I didnt see any other boats on the water (At least not with tourists). I didnt see a large number of birds, but still at least 7 different species. But the highlight is definitly seeing the langur which is critically endangered. Its nice to know this reserve is being looked after to help thier population. The water is muddy/murky near the start but once you get closer to the cliffs the water clears up and you can see plenty of fish as well. There was a extremly low cave which was nice to go though, though probably wouldnt compare to other caves. But as a biologist there was plenty of animals to keep me interested.

reviews.author: Julia C
reviews.title: Boat ride with a tip
reviews.content: We read great things about Van Long on trip adviser, but were suprised to see how far away from Ninh Binh town it was (compared to the other attractions).Travellers be wary, this is more than 30 mins by scooter from Ninh Binh on a busy highway. When we arrived, we had no idea where to go, as there are no signs etc. We happened to find approx 30 boats tied up with no one else around. By chance, some fellow travelers had just asked a man working in the mangroves who advised there was a ticket desk about 100m around the corner.We arrived around 3:30 in the afternoon hoping to see some of the wildlife. Unfortunately we didn't see much wildlife, however the scenery and noiselessness of the surroundings was amazing. There were probably only 10 other couples on the water when we were there. The trip was one hour and cost 50,000 vnd each.At the end, we noticed that the others were tipping their rowers. As we thought this was the 'norm', we reached for a small note (1 US dollar) which was the only small change we had. The lady demanded two, and wouldn't take no for an answer. This also happened to the couple in front of us. A bit of a shame, we haven't found tipping as normal in Vietnam. A relaxing trip nevertheless.

reviews.author: Rekha R
reviews.title: Scenic Peaceful boating/cycling destination
reviews.content: Peaceful nature reserve - We were lucky to spot Delacour langurs as well. Not commercial unlike Tam Coc. Recommend going here vs. Tamcoc

reviews.author: Barbara M
reviews.title: Simply stunning
reviews.content: I would have preferred to visit Van Long late in the afternoon as suggested by previous reviewers to take in the wildlife. We didn't time it very well though and got there around midday. It was hot but oh my, it was stunning. Didn't see the wildlife I wanted to see but did see a bride and groom. A Japanese couple, not sure what was happening, but the groom got into the water and shortly after helped his bride into the water, (both dressed in full bridal costume) and of course a photographer was also present. Not sure what this was all about, unless it was one of those "trash the dress" ceremonies. Anyway, I was so happy because while I didn't manage to capture the wildlife, I certainly managed to get some rather unique photos. All of this aside, this is a glorious place to visit. The boat trip will take about an hour. There is only one small cave that you can go inside but can't go through, but the scenery is truly spectacular and even though it was hot, the trip was thoroughly relaxing for us, not so much for the amazing rowing lady though! We gave her a tip of about $6 (100,000 dong) which she truly earned.Make sure you bring a hat or umbrella, maybe a fan and definitely a camera, you never know what you might see! Oh and sunscreen is definitely a bonus. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: DxbKhurram
reviews.title: I'd rank it 1st i.e. Trang An being 2nd and Tam Coc as 3rd. Excellent and Peaceful boat ride.
reviews.content: We have done boat rides of Van Long, Trang An and Tam Coc and I'd rank Van Long as Number one!It is not expensive. VND 50,000 per person. There are no vendors on the way. The area is peaceful and quiet.Recommended time to go is approx one and half hour before sunset as at birds fly back to their nests around sunset and its a beautiful scene to watch. If you and your rower are patient then you may stop to see some monkeys as well :)Definitely a must visit in Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: Hannah
reviews.title: Incredible nature touch
reviews.content: The place is so peaceful espescially in the late afternoon when less guest and quite around. This place still rare of visitors so we can enjoy the most pure nature here without the touch of people effect as in Trang an or Tam coc. This place is the most enjoyable moment in my ninh binh trip. You can see crystal clear water with seaweed undernearth. Such amazing boatride experience for me.

reviews.author: Tushar M
reviews.title: Bamboo Boat Ride among Lotus Flowers
reviews.content: This is a place not to be missed...After being on all sorts of boat trips we were skeptical about another boat trip but this isn't another boat trip...This is sheer bliss and the beauty all around is enchanting

reviews.author: berver65
reviews.title: Monkeys and birds
reviews.content: To say it clear, I didn't do this ride because I didn't know that it existed. Besides, I already had done the boat ride in Trang An.The reason why I'm sending this review is just to inform you that this one might be interesting also because in the late afternoon, 4 or 5 I think, you will be able to see monkeys and birds. So, maybe for this animals, it's a destination to consider.Since it's less famous than Tam Coc and Trang An, maybe the price will even be better, and with fewer boats on the river.

reviews.author: GreenPlanetTraveller
reviews.title: Amazing to see the Delacour's Langurs in the wild in such a beautiful place!
reviews.content: Go early in the morning! Watching the limestone light up with the early morning sun is beautiful. We saw about 15 langurs - it's amazing to watch them jump and scramble around the rocks!

reviews.author: Mai H
reviews.title: Peaceful place.
reviews.content: Wonderful views of birds when they fly back to nets about 4-5pm, thousands of them, makes an awesome view. Take a rowing boat to discover those caves. Better to visit from 3pm when it's not too hot and humid.

reviews.author: Catherine Chan C
reviews.title: Very relax boat trip
reviews.content: We went there by a day trip arrangement.  The boat trip took more than one hour.   But the views of the place is amazing and value to visit .  We paid extra tips to the boat driver and buy him drinks as extra tips.  Just treat this as a supporting to the local people and this natural place

reviews.author: Phạm Xuân T
reviews.title: Comfortable the view nice
reviews.content: It's always worthwhile to take a day trip to Hanoi’s surroundings for refreshment away from the city noise. Ninh Binh is an outstanding destination that has many attractions and stunning landscapes. First, tour the wetland Van Long by rowboat, a perfect venue for you to relax and let your mind wander amongst the diverse limestone features of Van Long nature reserve. Then make a journey to the 10th century and visit the ancient capital Hoa Lu.

reviews.author: thanhlan789
reviews.title: Enjoyable boat trip
reviews.content: Super peaceful boat trip. This nature reserve is beautiful and serene, we were lucky enough to see two langurs. Less touristy than Tam Coc and Trang An.

reviews.author: myra k
reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.content: This was a peaceful,quiet ride on a small punt in a Jurassic setting,amazing beautiful,highly recommend.

reviews.author: shatzee1
reviews.title: Peaceful and scenic
reviews.content: Nice relaxing one hour (approx) boat ride for 25,000 VND, and let's you get an up close and personal view of the countryside that is otherwise inaccessible by car or motorbike.Highly recommend!

reviews.author: gillian F
reviews.title: Go in the afternoon to see the wild langurs
reviews.content: Van Long is a nature reserve close to Ninh Binh and it's beautiful. Soaring limestone mountains, meandering river and limestone caves which if you go during a dryer season you explore by boat. It has a colony of wild critically endangered Delacour Langurs and is an amazing spot for an birdwatchers.I've been a few times and I think it's actually at it's best when it is slightly overcast. You have a better chance of seeing the wildlife and it has a eerie calm that is enchanting. The easiest way to visit the reserve is to take slow boat ride. It's relaxing and lovely and would be a highlight of anyone's trip to the area.

reviews.author: PAN-Oz37
reviews.title: This is a must see for the Vietnamese locals
reviews.content: Do yourself a favor and try this boat ride. It takes you for a 150 minutes boat ride which is calm and you get to see some very nice views all the way, there are lots of locals most of the time, 9 caves to get thru...so be patient

reviews.author: Michal Drobny
reviews.title: Nice time
reviews.content: Very nice calm and quite place. The weather wasn' t best so we were there almost the only turists and the boat cruise was so relaxing. The cave there is fascinating.

reviews.author: Hansi Z
reviews.title: Interesting row boat trip
reviews.content: We had a great boat trip. Unfortunately  the weather was lousy with overcast and cold. Scenery was amazing. Should really visit this place a month later.

reviews.author: CindyAnn37
reviews.title: Peaceful and Relaxing
reviews.content: Compared to Tam Coc this is much less crowded and less commercialised.  The boats seemed slightly larger and more stable than the boats at Tam Coc.They had a large digger on a floating barge clearing mud from the waterway, so I assume silt is a problem here.Our lady rowed us to a large cave.  We could see no daylight at the other side, so I do not know whether you could go through the cave, but because of time constraints we turned around there and went back.The scenery was not as stunning as Tam Coc, but we enjoyed the peaceful and quiet environment.

reviews.author: 81Jay
reviews.title: Not the best day out
reviews.content: Went on a day tour from Hanoi. Environmentally nice. Over 100 boats (stated by our guide) on the waterway and your boat constantly getting pushed out of the way (or pushing another boat out of the way) to get to the end. One and a half hours rowing by elderly lady. Huge ripoff at halfway point. Most tourists were told 'pay for drink and food for rower or else'. And massive pressure at end to tip. Nothing like ads for area. Way too commercialised. Not anyone's fault but lunch at only 'restaurant' was dog and goat as dog is specialty food of Ninh Binh area. I'm aware I am in their country. (Goat not a problem). Probably need to ask more questions!!  As I said main grouch was how commercialised the day was

reviews.author: Scottiewife_17
reviews.title: Beware boat ladies
reviews.content: Had nice row round with boat lady, not much wildlife but nice scenery. Gave tip to boat lady who made it clear it wasn't enough so I stood firm and said take it or leave it. She remonstrated with me so I ended up walking away. Spoiled it for me but it is quieter than tam coc and trang an.

reviews.author: Andrea H
reviews.title: The best place for a boat trip in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: Located 15km. From Ninh Binh is this lovely Pearl. It is not at all touristy as Tam Coc and Trang An and it is a lot more relaxed, calm and quiet. It is a lot cheaper too - 100.000vnd for two people. There are no vendors, so you'll be able to enjoy the nature in a nice calm atmosphere. The trip takes 1,5  hours.

reviews.author: dieswaytoofast
reviews.title: Serene, quiet, and beautiful
reviews.content: Its right next to the Emeralda Resort (if thats where you're staying), or a bit of a haul from the town (if *that* is where you're staying).  But, in either case, it is well worth the trip, and beats the pants off of going to Tam Coc.You can hire a boat for about an hour - or more if you so choose - and get paddled around a small part of the reserve. The limestone karst is breath-taking, and quite possibly even more beautiful than Halong Bay.If you're particularly lucky, you'll get to see the Monkeys :-)

reviews.author: Hyeyoung A
reviews.title: Fun and worth the price
reviews.content: We had our tour to Trang An for one day arranged by our hotel in Ninh Binh. We paid 34$ per each person. Our final schedule was going through this place by boat. The views were amazing and going through caves by boat was a fun experience! But it's very crowded in weekends. It would have been a real hassle to ride the boat if it was not for our guide. I recommend to go on weekdays.

reviews.author: Etta007
reviews.title: Extrodinarily beautiful
reviews.content: Stunning sampan journey through caves and karst mountains.  Saw two sorts of kingfishers, egrets, a family of monkeys, Buffaloes grazing, very peaceful and beautiful.

reviews.author: Chin L
reviews.title: A nice surprise- Relaxing experience
reviews.content: Our family did not plan to visit Van Long natural reserve, as we thought it would just be similar to Trang An and Tam Coc. We just stopped by as we had a bit of free time, but to our surprise, this place was amazing. Comparing to Trang An and Tam Coc, Van Long is a lot more quiet  and relaxing. There was no vendors and shop around, so it did not give a very touristy vibe. The small wooden boat without life jacket can be a bit scary for people who cannot swim, but according to the local people, the water is less than 1 meter deep. I love the flocks of birds, caves and the crystal clearwater. The scene of the birds taking off and circling the sky is worth seeing. Overall I would highly recommend this place

reviews.author: Alexandra M
reviews.title: Highlight of Ninh Binh...saw wild monkeys!
reviews.content: Absolutely loved Van Long. We organised a day group tour with Tam coc homestay and went first to Cuc phuong NP and then here in the afternoon. Our guide requested the boat lady take us a different route as he knew we were interested in seeing wildlife. Instead of heading off to the right, we went left down through a quiet and tranquil river with limestone cliffs on each side. Managed to see a big group of Delacour langurs feeding on the cliffs which was amazing as they are a critically endangered species with less than 250 individuals left in the wild. This place is currently very clean, with no sign of litter or habitat degradation, hopefully it stays this way.

reviews.author: markmik
reviews.title: Fantastic caves
reviews.content: This cost 200000 dong for two hours. Incredible cave system involving nine caves. The first is 300 metres long while others are shorter they have the same impact. Throw in the odd temple as well. The boat is rowed by lady/man and can help as well. Very enjoyable trip,

reviews.author: Strabo
reviews.title: Beautiful in the evening
reviews.content: Go in the evening, say an hour or two before sunset when it is a lot cooler. Also, birds start coming back in flocks, flying overhead.Spectacular. We even managed to sight some gibbons!

reviews.author: DevonCatLady
reviews.title: Very lovely
reviews.content: The scenery was very lovely, even in poor weather.  When you are on the water it is very exposed, and can be very cold indeed in winter.  The boats here are rather Heath Robinson, and there are no life jackets as at Trang An.  We had a boat to ourselves, and only once did we see other boats.  I would like to do it again in better weather.

reviews.author: MrGuest2015
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: Amazing experience, a beautiful landscape, allthough cave is also impressive and they are happy with each tip you give, here there were happy and asked for the double!

reviews.author: TravellingBec
reviews.title: What a Peaceful end to our trip
reviews.content: This is mostly a boat ride through wetlands. The scenery is gorgeous. We saw many monkeys and birds. The boat ride lasts for an hour and half ours turned around in the cave based on some of the reviews it sounds like it can go further. I guess it depends who you get. We then went for a long flat walk next to the wetlands this is a great 2-3hr trip could easily be combined with something else.

reviews.author: DerekLSH
reviews.title: Nice mountain views and less touristy
reviews.content: We walked to the national park as it was near our Hotel, Emeralda Resort.  This place is good to explore on bicycles and they have boat rides there as well.

reviews.author: florencefatih
reviews.title: Feeling far away from everything in the middle of nature
reviews.content: Van long nature reserve is Incredible. There are not many people. Not expensive and it is a life experience to take a boattrip. We felt far away from this world. And also had chance to see local monkeys " langurs". This place is like a beautiful dream

reviews.author: heidigillingham
reviews.title: Beautiful boat trip
reviews.content: Amazing cheap boat trip in traditional boat down through the wetlands rowed by... an old lady! Scenery is breathtaking. The air is so still here, it's really hot so take a hat and cover up. They also expect a tip when you get off the boat. Don't go on an organised trip, walk there yourself

reviews.author: gael d
reviews.title: Great and still quiet
reviews.content: Went there at 4pm and it was beautiful. We saw a lot of monkeys, a lot of birds and we were the only boat. Entrance fee was 70k + 20k dongs per person. Recommended because it is very quiet and nice.

reviews.author: Geoff M
reviews.title: So peaceful
reviews.content: After the bustle of Tam Coc the previous day this was just so relaxing. We were almost the only ones on the water. Also, it was great to be rowed through natural wetlands with no human additions, rather than farmlands. And we got to see a Delacour's Langur!!

reviews.author: tuananhhoang
reviews.title: Back to nature in a beautiful landscape
reviews.content: I have been there sometime with colleagues for inspection but only recently, i took my family there in late September. This time is best for visiting the area because of the beauty of the weather of Autumn. We took a boat ride in a pure natural atmosphere, breathtaking surrounding, clear water, beautiful landscape, cheerful boat rowers. It it a memorable experience to my kids. Recommend this trip for natural lovers.

reviews.author: Petrajacobs
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: Amazing experience, what a beautiful landscape, allthough Linh Coc is also impressive and they are happy with each tip you give, here there were not happy and asked for the double! And we allready bought our rower some goodies by a passing boat.

reviews.author: BensonYap
reviews.title: See the endangered Delacour's Langurs
reviews.content: We went to visit the nature reserve in late September at around 9am. It was drizzling. Thankfully, the rain stopped. The rower lady spotted a troop of Delacour's Langurs foraging among the trees when we were 15-20mins into the boat ride. Though a rather brief encounter, it was a surreal experience. Along the way, there are many wetland birds.

reviews.author: Emma10801
reviews.title: Peaceful row (plus a neck massage!) but I'm still not sure it was worth the long trip from Hanoi
reviews.content: This is definitely a peaceful and beautiful setting for a row boat ride.  You ride up through a channel and then into a cave and out the other side.  The woman that rowed our boat stopped at the other side of the cave, and I've seen from some recent postings that we probably could/should have continued on further.  I thought that day perhaps we were supposed to go further because we passed someone coming back through from the other direction. But it was one of those "unseasonably hot" days and I'm not sure that it was horrible that we stopped.  I did think that day, though, that the ride was shorter than I had expected, and from looking at the photos I think we did actually miss a reasonable amount of scenery - so I wish we had continued. That said, instead of continuing on, the woman rowed into the shade just inside the cave and gave my wife a neck massage.  Since her neck was particularly bad that day and she was really suffering from the heat, I think that she still would vote for the massage over the longer trip.I have to say that I am torn in general about whether or not it was worth it to drive all the way from Hanoi to visit this area (even though we also had a really nice bike ride while we were in a nearby spot).  I got swayed by the sites that call Tam Coc the "Halong Bay" of the interior -- but to be honest, this area doesn't hold a candle to Halong Bay.  Perhaps I would have been less disappointed if we hadn't already seen Halong Bay, or if it was a little closer to Hanoi (ore we had been able to stop on our way to somewhere else), OR if it wasn't so near the end of our 3 week trip -- but in general, I was really pretty disappointed with this whole area.I had the stereotypical Tam Coc photo of the multicolored rice fields along the river - but we never saw anything even close to that.  I was thinking afterwards that maybe all those shots were taken from an airplane and that no one actually ever sees those scenes from the river level.I think I was also overly swayed by a Trip Advisor writer who said that she had been on all 3 boat rides in this area and that this was the best and the least crowded with tourists.  All other things being equal, we generally prefer to take the road less traveled -- but I feel like we might have just taken the wrong road on this one.

reviews.author: h m
reviews.title: Must Do.
reviews.content: Were rowed, 2 of us to a boat to see the Delacour Langurs. Wow what a rare treat, saw a troop of these monkeys climbing on the rock cliffs. Not busy on a week day is Sept. Tip the rowers they earn it.

reviews.author: Mirek a Petra N
reviews.title: Quiet boating
reviews.content: If you are done with busy Tam Coc and you feel like doing something quieter then drive to vang long nature reserve. It is good for birdwatching, lot of reeds around, locals do the boating, no hassle. There are also monkeys around but we weren't lucky to spot them. It was also too much water so we couldn't pass the cave but still very worthy. We recommend to visit late afternoon when there is chance to spot more birds.

reviews.author: thomasjonanthan
reviews.title: So Amazing nature
reviews.content: We drove beautiful countryside, pass water bufallos, stop in a local village and make a bamboo boat ride where you can see lots of water lilies and the Delacour's Langour monkeys. We had an awesome time in Van Long and would come back any time.

reviews.author: fitnfifty
reviews.title: Looking for monkeys
reviews.content: Our friend Scott took us here . It was a lovely peaceful place late in the afternoon so not too many tourists around. A nice slow paddle while keeping an eye out for the monkeys. They were a little hard to spot but we finally saw a few up the mountain.

reviews.author: Andrew S
reviews.title: An in land Halong Bay
reviews.content: The best kept secret in Vietnam. The boat ride is stunning, walks around the area are great and it is flat for family cycling. Well worth a visit

reviews.author: Christine H
reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.content: Not too touristy so we could enjoy this peaceful place. Saw langur in distance. Lots of fish and clear waters. We heard the rain heading our way and our kind rower made us hats from large lily leaves. Our tip was appreciated and no hassles. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Philip L
reviews.title: Very pleasant
reviews.content: We went on the boat trip late in the afternoon and it was very cheap and very good.Our trip was so quiet and peaceful. We saw monkeys (fleetingly) and had a lovely time.

reviews.author: hoangvl
reviews.title: A more authentic experience than Tam Coc
reviews.content: You cannot say that this place is less beautiful than Tam Coc or Trang An, but it is certainly less touristy and more tranquil. The boat trip takes about 1.5 hour and would've been perfect if we could have spotted some langurs along the way. Some rowers would cut the ride short by turning back right after reaching the cave mouth (they'd explain the water-level is too high to continue going inside) while it is still possible to go through the cave (although not much to see). Entrance fee is cheap (45k pp) but sadly will rise to 70k from October. A tip is expected and a 5usd per boat will do.

reviews.author: Paul_Wink
reviews.title: Go early!
reviews.content: Very nice nature, excellent views. Make sure you arrive around 7 am. Still nobody there and your trip will be magical!

reviews.author: cmcnallyJanJuc
reviews.title: Peaceful Paradise
reviews.content: We did a boat trip in Van Long Nature Reserve and Tam Coc. Personally we enjoyed Van Long as it was less touristy and just as spectacular. A must do in Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: LauncestonUpnabout
reviews.title: Enjoyable, peaceful experience
reviews.content: Very peaceful being rowed around this area of natural beauty. The lady rowing had very limited English but was enthusiastic about pointing out things of interest. We spent about an hour and a half on the water but neither heard nor saw any monkeys. The rowing lady seemed to be struggling to get the job done so we tried to help out which she seemed to appreciate.....or maybe she was angling for a good tip...which she got and was clearly very happy.

reviews.author: supecub
reviews.title: Great destination
reviews.content: This place is huge beautiful swamp, the beauty features are build up by limestone, villages and rice filed surround specially the dike is bearing typical picture of vietnam culture. located next to it is really nice resort, from here you can access to Cuc Phuong national park, Bai Dinh pagoda, then back to Hanoi easily. if any travelers would like to extend adventure trip to northwest or northeast of vietnam, it is definitely possible, generally this is highly recommended place to come for sightseeing, culture exploration and relaxing combine.

reviews.author: Craig-World-Travelle
reviews.title: Beautiful reserve for the views and birds
reviews.content: We really enjoyed riding bikes along the dike bordering the reserve and later taking a boat through the wetlands and up to the cave.  It was very relaxing being rowed through the channels in a small bamboo boat.We were able to see the family of Delacour's Langurs at the top of the hill - it was quite a treat so bring your binoculars and zoom lense.  Saw a good variety of birds in the wetlands.  Just down there road there is also a great rookery in the trees with hundreds of storks, egrets and herons. May is rice harvest time so it was interesting to watch the harvest process up close.  The bright color of the rice fields added to the already beautiful views.

reviews.author: Alena R
reviews.title: Bicycling through here is wonderfully peaceful
reviews.content: We rented bicycles at our hotel and cycled here from Tam Coc. The ride to the reserve is wonderfully quiet once you turn in the last village before the reserve. It goes past rice paddies and the karst formations and is truly spectacular. The reserve itself charges 100.000 Dong to enter but then you can bicycle around the peaceful setting. At first, we thought it was a resort and there is a resort inside but there's much more to see and explore. It was blissfully empty and we went to the birds garden, the orchard and veggie garden, the thousand year old tree and just enjoyed our time here in the quiet morning. A lovely reprieve from the pushy touts in Tam Coc.

reviews.author: shaynamin
reviews.title: Gorgeous place
reviews.content: I was lucky enough to take two boat tours through Van Long Nature Reserve during my stay in Vietnam - we went back for more at the end of our trip to enjoy the serenity again! Beautiful scenery and very peaceful ride - would recommend taking binoculars in order to spot the wildlife, which the lovely rowers should help you find!

reviews.author: Gynezt
reviews.title: We were sorry to miss the birds
reviews.content: This boat visit was really nice and relaxing. The driver was very cheerful and much nicer than the one we had in Tam Coc. I have to say the scenery was less impressive than Tam Coc but looked more preserved and authentic. Also, we thought we would see the famous birds and monkeys there but were unfortunately unlucky...apparently, you should go after 5pm to see them (though not sure until when the driver keeps working)!Also, while you are in the neighborhood, you should definitely go visit the Dich Long pagoda (not the Bich Dong!) which is not very famous but really amazing. There is a great temple along with amazing caves !

reviews.author: jurgen53
reviews.title: so romantic
reviews.content: very romantic rowing tour. Recommend the time before sunset. We where lucky to see some rare monkey's in the surrounding hills.

reviews.author: Rey_Maulana
reviews.title: Stunning Stone Pillars
reviews.content: It's litle bit tricky going here if you use local transportation, better use trip operator. no shop and just a few restaurant and hotel, be carefull also for the hot temperature in this area, don't forget bring your hat or even umbrella, also couple bottle of water

reviews.author: miray M
reviews.title: Peaceful, saw endangered langurs
reviews.content: We went late afternoon on a weekday and it was  very quiet with few boats out. We saw some waterbirds, but what made it truely memorable was seeing a troop of endangered langurs. We saw about 8, including some young ones. We were able to watch them for 10 minutes leaping across rocks and descending from trees. The boatman was very friendly, and when we asked if there were monkeys, he loked for a few minutes and spotted them for us. At the turnaround point in the cave the boatman asked for our camera and took lots of photos for us. If you are staying at Emeralda you don't need to book their bicycle tour if you don't want to as it is only a short walk.

reviews.author: soulbiker
reviews.title: Great bike ride through farms and limestone beauty
reviews.content: Our guide knew the local routes so we went off road on to a gravel path through traditional farms. That gave way to a bumpy dirt track for which our standard bikes were no match but the breath-taking scenery and tranquility made up for it. Our teens also got to go right up to rural life and animals, as well as God's rock creations. It was an unforgettable experience that was just the balm we needed to soothe our jagged nerves after two days in noisy Hanoi! The bamboo boat ride was similarly serene. We went to the one along the new road, rather than the touristy place that's swarming.

reviews.author: corion34
reviews.title: In touch with nature
reviews.content: I loved this trip it was so chilled and relaxing. We were lucky and had the place pretty much to ourselves - so it felt like it was just me and nature.  For 45k VND for each person it was much cheaper than tam coc or trang an!  The trip lasts around 1.5 to 2 hours depending on how fast your tower is and it was truly enjoyable.We went in the afternoon the best time to go to see the langur monkey but unfortunately we didn't see any!Would recommend doing this boat trip!

reviews.author: Saskiaphilipp T
reviews.title: Amazing boat ride through a mystic landscape.
reviews.content: The day we visited Van Long was pretty cold and rainy. Therefore we were not really in the mood for a boat ride but after having done it, we don't regret it at all. First of all it's probably one of the cheapest attractions around Ninh Binh with just about 45.000 VND admission fee per person and a little tip for the boat people. For that you get a 1.5 hour boat ride through an astonishing landscape that is pretty impressive and looks very mystic when it is foggy like on our rainy day. During the boat ride we were even able to spot some langurs (monkeys).Great is also that there were almost no tourists or any people at all, compared to Trang An, which was pretty crowded as we passed it earlier that day.

reviews.author: Alienz011093
reviews.title: Best non-mainstream attraction in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: Off the beaten track, Nature Reserve of Van Long Wetland is one attraction for those who want to immerse in the nature rather than tourist atmosphere. The boat trip takes more than one hour and only cover a small part of the wetland. Unfortunately I visited the place on a cold day and could not see any Delacour's langurs; therefore you guys should consider the weather before visit.Van Long is situated 15 km away from Ninh Binh City and accessible by a narrow road amidst the countryside, thus foreign visitors should be accompanied by a local driver.

reviews.author: koconn1983
reviews.title: No real wildlife!
reviews.content: Not a great stop. No wildlife to speak of and boat guide wanted a bigger tip than we gave him! Trang An far far better!

reviews.author: jack s
reviews.title: Kind peole but poor scenery
reviews.content: If you have been to Trang An and Bich Dong Tam Coc, no need to be here. I just feel sorry that the 400 or so boats in wait  have too few guests to serve because the Ninh Binh authority overuse the same kind of landscape in their wet land to lure tourists. In this one province those 3 places have the same things to see! Do not over use the nature this way!

reviews.author: WildlifeFan01
reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.content: We did two trips on the lake - one in the morning which was nice for kingfishers and other birds and on in the late afternoon when we saw the langurs. Take binoculars if you are interested in wildlife. Our guide told us there is a much better chance of langurs in the afternoon. The whole experience is lovely - very tranquil. Be aware that if you are there in the cool season the whole place will probably be shrouded in mist.

reviews.author: pw0867
reviews.title: Tremendous. Absolutely breathtaking scenery through marshlands for close to 2 hours
reviews.content: This place is spectacular.  Breathtaking (low) mountains and some caves that the river passes through.  You ride on a skiff through crystal clear water and really drink in the tranquility and unspoiled nature of the place.  Birds are abundant, and although we weren't lucky, apparently there are a species of monkey that live in the nature reserve.  The water flows through some caves (looowww ceiling - watch your head) and the rower needs to use a stick to keep the skiff moving.  This was truly amazing, and really made you feel how special the area is.  Thank goodness it's a reserve.  There is no high pressure sales on the river (see Tam Coc review) - just polite service.Some interesting facts - the fee you pay to get in goes to the government.  The rowers exist pretty much on tips and although I may not have understood, I think get a salary of 35 000 VND every couple weeks.  As well, there is a queue, and they are only allowed to work one day every 2 weeks, so this one day is pretty important to them to make money.  Please tip well (our rower was 70 years old, and had to keep doing this to survive)

reviews.author: Webeetravllingmand
reviews.title: No Tourists :)
reviews.content: Great, Awesome, Splendid. Of the three options, that I know of, in Ninh Binh for casual river guides this one was the most relaxing. Little to no tourist, no one selling you crafts from there boat. Rent a scooter and find your way out there. Best way to do it. It's also ridiculously cheap compared to Trang An and Tam Coc.

reviews.author: Juniper C
reviews.title: Nothing special
reviews.content: Our guide dropped us off first thing in the morning. We felt taken advantage of because he disappeared for 1.5 hours with the driver and we could have hired a boat on our own and just walked from the Emeralda.. Instead the highly  recommended Ninh Binh guide on TA, didn't say anything about not accompanying us until we were in the boat! But back to the actual nature reserve. In 1.5 hrs of the boat ride, we saw ONE bird. The scenery wasn't anything special. Much preferred our boat trip to the fishing village, and later, one in the less-visited canal past Tam Coc. If you have nothing else to do, then give it a quick visit. Perhaps, as some of the reviews state, it is prettier in late afternoon as the sun is setting, but when we were there it was pretty much gray skies until nightfall.

reviews.author: kaatje88
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.content: We loved it here, it was so quiet and peaceful we enjoyed our trip with a very nice old lady. It's a trip for about an hour and a half. No touristtraps. We didnt see any monkeys but the mountains and view were awesome!

reviews.author: Intertaekwondo
reviews.title: Perfect choice
reviews.content: Van Long is a perfect choice for you, if you love the nature. 2 hours on the boat and admire the mountain and river...

reviews.author: CHARLES K
reviews.title: The Quiet Reserve
reviews.content: After touring Tam Coc in Ninh Binh Provence, my 2 photography partners (Vietnamese) took me to Van Long. Only about 5 boats were out, late afternoon, not so hot weather wise. I had a solo boat, woman was amazing rolling the reserve. We did see the endanger monkey 7 of them come out of the mountain side. Cheap $$ to go here. Always give the women who do the rolling and tip. Just go, quiet, peaceful and beautiful.  Just finish a blog and book of my trip here.

reviews.author: Jeffrey B
reviews.title: Terrific Place
reviews.content: It's a short boat ride (less than 1 hour) but it's definitely worth a visit! The place was so serene and quiet, only a few boat operators (less than 10?) showing that this place is not really favored by tourists - but it doesn't mean this place is not beautiful.The way to Van Long was also lovely, you got to see local lives, paddy fields, villages and etc. It's a must-do!

reviews.author: Quynh-Nhu T
reviews.title: Beautiful, cheap, wonderful birds
reviews.content: This is very lovely and very good value. About an hour long leisurely boat ride through the wetlands with gorgeous karsts and great flocks of birds flying over to nest in nearby trees.We went in late afternoon, after 4 pm, and it was lovely. That said, perhaps this place is getting more popular? There weren't a ton a ton of boats, but we were definitely out at the same time as about 5 other groups, so maybe we just weren't quite as lucky as the other folks on here. Still was very calm and peaceful.That said, if you only have time for one river boat tour, go to the Trang An Grottos--there you go through like 9 caves which are amazing (here we just went into and back out the same entrance of one cave), it's a really long route and worth the extra money and the extra tourists. But if you have time for two river trips, this is absolutely worth it as the birds and the peacefulness of this ride distinguish it from what Trang An has to offer.Enjoy!

reviews.author: DeightonLodge
reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.content: Lovely place to spend a couple of hours, the boat trip was extremely peaceful and relaxing. We spent the afternoon here and took two boats out and felt under no pressure to tip or pay the people who were rowing, unlike sone of the other spots we had visited in the area. Great

reviews.author: maxrauleg
reviews.title: Beautiful place!
reviews.content: Van Long is a legendary land, a beautiful area and the largest natural reserve of wetlands. There are has moutain ranges creates a natural wall surrounded a vast expanse of water.If you lucky you can see the monkey on the moutain.The boat man very funny, they will be show to you small fish on the river, they also very clever when to use leg for rowing boat.Beautiful place for visit.

reviews.author: Marcel D
reviews.title: Halong Bay on Land
reviews.content: Beautiful and serene...also take a bike ride to neighboring villages. Plan your trip for you to get there before rice harvesting season.

reviews.author: Shh211
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: Took a 1 and a half hour boat ride through the nature reserve, beautiful scenery and very tranquil.  The boat rower totally made the trip, fishing out snails and making beautiful necklaces from flowers. Great experience and highly recommended.

reviews.author: Lefeuilletonkinois
reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.content: We got up at 6am to watch flocks of birds fly away. We had a long encounter with a rare and beautiful monkey called Delacour’s langur. We rode through the hills without meeting other tourists or being harassed by vendors.

reviews.author: Jeanique99
reviews.title: A little gem
reviews.content: Go after 16:00h and you will be there alone, floating on the river with a beautiful sunset. Unique!Also very cheap!

reviews.author: indochinanomads
reviews.title: Very peaceful
reviews.content: The best time visit Vanlong Natural reservoir is early in the morning or late afternoon. There is often Korean group come but not a big problem. If you were lucky you might see a couple have wedding picture are so romantic. Going through the cave as we did last time is the best experience!  We had good lunch ( set menu) only at the beginning of the road leading into the site.

reviews.author: Schonsar
reviews.title: beautiful
reviews.content: We visited Van long in the late afternoon. The reflexion of the mountains was beautiful. We were alone on the water. The boat trip was one hour and it was 45 Dong/pax. We didn't see any monkeys, but we saw/heard many birds.

reviews.author: Viking1910
reviews.title: So peaceful
reviews.content: We walked the 500 m from our hotel to the "tourist marina".  20 m away is the ticket booth where you can buy tickets for the boat trip.  Don't buy the trip through hotels or tour operators as they charge more.  We got to the marina ( just a few steps leading to the boats from the road), at 8am and had the whole boat ride, one and a half hours without seeing another boat.  We went through a beautiful cave, lotus flower beds and the most peaceful scenery.  The dragonflies were spectacular.

reviews.author: SballNewry
reviews.title: Breathtaking!
reviews.content: We visited a few of the sights in Ninh Binh and this was our favourite by far! It really was nature at its best - very untouched and not touristy at all. We met 2 small rowing boats during our 2hr boat trip.

reviews.author: JemA J
reviews.title: Oasis
reviews.content: We chose this place over tam Coc and were glad that we did. After hearing other peoples accounts of tam Coc we were a little put off over how aggressive it could be. This place was the opposit, we past one other boat and other than that had the whole place to ourselves. Very pretty and cost us 45000 dong. Very scenic and feels much more authentic than similar tours.

reviews.author: Clare
reviews.title: Serene and gorgeous
reviews.content: I went to both Van Long Nature Reserve and Tam Coc, and Van Long was the winner hands down. I visited in the late afternoon and was showed into a rowboat for a tour that lasted around an hour. Apart from a few fishermen, no one else was around, and the scenery was stunning. Tam Coc was half as pretty and such a hassle in comparison. I'm glad I made the call to check out Van Long or the whole trip to Ninh Binh would have been a bust. Note: you'll probably need to hire a taxi from your hotel to drive you there and back (there are no taxis around). Take an umbrella, some water, and money to tip your rower. Don't be surprised when you get there and see nothing but a parking lot and a ticket stand.

reviews.author: Karen150161
reviews.title: Serene and Beautiful
reviews.content: We did the boat trip early in the morning, stayed at Emeralda Resort so it was just a short walk to catch the boat.  It was so peaceful and beautiful, and we only saw one other boat the whole time we were out, far more enjoying able than the tourist spots.  Took some fantastic photo's.

reviews.author: avic L
reviews.title: Beautiful nature
reviews.content: Get the boat trip and it took about 1and a hafl hour along river. In the early morning with sun rise or sun set. The landscape is the same as Ha Long Bay, seaglass with many storks, and when you lucky, you can see wild monkey.

reviews.author: LongChau
reviews.title: Great place to visit
reviews.content: Van Long Nature Reserve is located near the resort where I stayed. And far from central of Ninh Binh 20km. Worth seing! As nice as Tam Coc Caves. Less crowded, very quiet!

reviews.author: Sheath27
reviews.title: Same, same but not the same!!!
reviews.content: A similar experience to Trang an but with different karst formations, flora and scenery. It can get hot on this tour so take plenty of water and sunscreen.

reviews.author: weimowner1
reviews.title: Scenic and peaceful
reviews.content: The ride to here wasn't the most scenic but once you cross to where you get on the boat, it was beautiful for the entire trip.  I got there early and was the only person out on the water for quite a while on a quiet sunny day.  Saw several fisherman out but otherwise didn't see a lot of wildlife other than the bats in the cave.  We rowed through cave and around a small cove on the otherside, very cool little tour.

reviews.author: Ivor H
reviews.title: Beautiful, tranquil, friendly
reviews.content: We were a little put off at first as the road goes right along part of the park but after paying our 150k VND, 2 adults, 3 kids, we were taken on a beautiful boat ride for about an hour and a half, saw many birds, 1 langur, microbats in the cave, met and had fun with the boat rowers, best of the three things we did in Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: Susan B
reviews.title: what a little tresure
reviews.content: We came late in the day for our tour.  We met all of one other boat on the water.The scenerywas awesome.  Come back we herad but didn't see the Howler monkies.  He herons were flying in to roost for the night, tons and tons of them.  Awesome to see.So glad that we skipped Tam Coc for this little gem.

reviews.author: goldenroadpilgrim
reviews.title: Will be fantastic in the future
reviews.content: We cycled out to the park which is about 6 km to the north of the cave pagoda. The turn off is 300m to the east before the pagoda. 4 km through lovely countryside gets you to the entrance to the park. As usual the staff at the ticket box are absolutely lovely and cannot do enough for you. They are usually local girls that have done well at English language. 100000 VND gets you into the park and includes a boat trip into the caves. They are doing some lovely work in conservation there but they don't have rangers yet it seems. This is a shame because Taiwanese are notoriously badly behaved and inconsiderate. The are signs everywhere to please be quiet near the stork and heron sanctuary but they yell and clap and whistle to get the birds to panic and fly off. What is wrong with these louts? Eventually there will be rangers and they will control the behaviour. The ride and walk is lovely and semi sealed to the bird observation point but sadly for us the screaming Taiwanese ruined the experience. The Vietnamese are too polite to tell them to be quiet even at the expense of scaring the birds that were trying to nest and roost for the evening:-(

reviews.author: 55erica
reviews.title: Erica L. and family from Canada and Hong Kong
reviews.content: Heard of it from the Tripadvisor as well prior the tripLove the beautiful scenerya bit windy that day on the boat ride

reviews.author: pierre b
reviews.title: amazing place
reviews.content: we really enjoyed the long tour there on our little boat, the people are paddling very well... we enjoyed the outstanding scenic, and the beauty of mother nature. we saw 2 groups of white bottom monkeys, that was superbe. we took many pictures, dont miss it

reviews.author: Tim M
reviews.title: Plenty of Nature
reviews.content: Boating in smooth water through reed beds in spectacular surroundings - the limestone karst formations you also get in Halong Bay.  Many interesting birds.  Also saw Delacour langurs up on the hillside.

reviews.author: reisei
reviews.title: Utterly stunning
reviews.content: I went on a grey and drizzly February morning, and Van Long was still utterly enchanting. So quiet - I was lucky to be in the only sampan in the water, in total silence apart from distant bird calls and the gentle splashing of the oars. So beautiful, I very highly recommend it.Only downside - you pay for a 1.5 hour ride, and my rower deliberately cut the trip short to just 1 hour (he turned round at the cave) and then aggressively demanded a tip afterwards! In order to discourage him from doing this to future visitors I refused to give him one, which made me feel rotten but frankly he owed ME money after cutting 30 minutes off the trip! So watch out for that and make a note of the time you set off.Other than this slight downer, it was an incredible experience.

reviews.author: emilykV6154AB
reviews.title: Gorgeous, peaceful, one of our favorite places in Vietnam
reviews.content: We were just about the only people on the water. There were no touts trying to sell us stuff. Our boat rower was so sweet, took us through a cave and paddled us around various nooks for 1.5 hours. This place is absolutely gorgeous. Water is clean; scenery is amazing; the only sounds you'll hear are the birds and the lapping from your boat's oars. This is the least touristy of the Ninh Binh sites and gives you an idea of what the area looked like before it became so developed. I'd say this place is an absolute must -- pair it with a climb up Mua Cave (where you see the karsts and rice paddies from up high) and you'll probably have one of your best day's in Vietnam.

reviews.author: Sharon R
reviews.title: Wetland wonderland
reviews.content: We loved  the bird life, tranquil setting,being rowed  through the wetlands. The hike above the Mua Cave, bicycle in countryside near Tam Coc.

reviews.author: Nancy C
reviews.title: Wonderful sunset - peaceful place
reviews.content: Our guide directed the boat paddler to take us far to the left of the shallow reserve in search of elusive monkey and away from the normal tourist route.  We didn't have any luck, but the large white herons were beautiful and we were the only boat in the reserve as the sun set = magnificent color.

reviews.author: loverhodeisland
reviews.title: langur,birds and quiet a sunset
reviews.content: we went during sunset and it was a nice time to visit. There were no tourists so it was very quiet. we saw 7 languars and our boat man was more excited than us that he insisted he takes more pics as he felt we did not do justice :) sweet man.

reviews.author: PeteWStone
reviews.title: embarrassing
reviews.content: wonderful landscapes but quite annoying and I don't like to be drived. It was the perfect hour to admire the sunset.

reviews.author: Whynot808
reviews.title: Beautiful scenery and wildlife but short trip
reviews.content: We were disappointed that we were not taken to the 3 caves as the lady in the boat was about 100 years old and couldn't row!  then proceded to ask for a tip, there are better organised trips in other areas

reviews.author: whirledgirl
reviews.title: Aaah. So peaceful.
reviews.content: Much less slick and quieter than Tam Coc or Trang An.  Not quite as spectacular, but still very nice scenery and the same sweet experience of being rowed along.  Here you do not need to share your boat with others.

reviews.author: KerenOr1978
reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.content: Less touristic than Trang An and Tam Coc and with a different vibe and different scenery. Yama, our old rower was amazing. She did not speak a word of English but went above and beyond for us to have an amazing tour. We came in a rainy day and still the view is unreal. Especially uncountable species of birds, flying directly toward you. Including wiled cocks and majestic herons.The view is mush wilder than the two other sights, and still almost untouched. The only thing that was upsetting a little bit is that even here there were enough people trying to sell you stuff in an unpleasant way.  Ignore them. It is so worth it. We ended up tipping our rower because she was supper cool - she tried to teach us Vietnamese songs and was happy and fun. Take a rain coat.

reviews.author: Chris H
reviews.title: Relaxing, authentic Vietnam. Set expectations accordingly.
reviews.content: We took a day trip from Hanoi to Van Long and then on to the hot springs at Kenh Ga. It was a long drive over a short distance but the hour-long row-boat ride around the nature reserve was very relaxing and scenic. We actually saw one Langur monkey, which made it worth it. A relaxing ride after the hustle and bustle of Hanoi. This and surrounding area is authentic Vietnam. It may be a tourist attraction but it's still not much of one. Take it for what it is and enjoy the peace and quiet.

reviews.author: Mavis N
reviews.title: Little disappointed
reviews.content: On our first day of visit at Trang An was fantastic with significant views and caves. When we were at Van Long Nature, nothing much to see no caves n the boat rides is so short. The boat paddler refuse to go any further even we ask them. We felt very disappointed!!

reviews.author: Aslam I
reviews.title: Good but too long
reviews.content: This place is a very good place to see the nature and experience being in canoe. The only thing i dislike about this place is the tour took so long and the water is very dirty. nevertheless you`ll see lots herds of ducks and limestones along the way. I also went for bike tour around here and there is nothing much besides good workout and fresh air with beautiful views.

reviews.author: Mervyn C
reviews.title: An ideal place for a retreat
reviews.content: Put every worries aside, just take 2 days (or more than if you can) here, it is worth for your visit. Since the village stay far away from the city and the main road, and is surrounded by endless fields, rivers, the air is fresh and the life is very peaceful. For accommodation, not many choices. You can choose between the Emeralda resort (4 star) and home-stay, depends on your interests, budget, ...For activities, I'd love to ride bicycle around the village in the afternoon or take a boat tour along the river. So wonderful :)

reviews.author: Louisd0r
reviews.title: Nature, pure and simple
reviews.content: This might be one of the most beautiful places within 3 hours of Hanoi. There's a small, paved path which you can cycle for 1-2 hours along the lake of the nature reserve, into a small town or to the pagoda in the area. The way has a few rocky spots, but otherwise could be a bicycle path in Europe. Amazingly and very uncommon for Vietnam, there's almost no traffic. A lonesome motorbike and maybe occasionally a small car.You can also hop on a small rowing boat and be paddled by a local guide around the lake. The scenery is breathtaking, there are all kinds of birds including storks and kingfishers. There's also the "mirror cave", where the light from the entrance lets the water reflect the ceiling. You can paddle through the whole cave and come out at the other side. Best point: No tourists. If you arrive at 7am in the morning, you'll have a chance to spot the endangered group of Delacour's langur (a black-white monkey), which lives in the hills next to the lake. They travel from their sleeping places to their feeding places. But you have to be punctual, otherwise, they are gone.All that being said, "no tourists" is actually a problem for the local population who used to be fishers but cannot use the nature reserve anymore (they are only allowed to collect snails). The government told them to earn their money by becoming rowboat guides. 400 families registered. That means: Every family can row a tourist maybe once a week. So be generous if you tip them, I am not sure how much money they actually get from the official tickets which you have to buy at the beginning (for us, it was 45.000 VND per person, 2 people per boat).Nevertheless, I hope tourists will stay away from this place. At the moment, it is too incredibly beautiful to be true.

reviews.author: FerrisMueller
reviews.title: Peaceful and less touristy
reviews.content: We went to Tam Coc and the scenery is amazing so worth going. What is not as good is the number of tourists (yes I know this is hypocritical) and how you get hassled by all and sundry trying to sell you something - no does not seem to work - sometimes aggressively.Van Long is very different - still magnificent scenery but a much more peaceful experience. There is a calmness about this area and it feels a little more authentic than Tam Coc. If you can do both, then you won't regret coming here as well.

reviews.author: Nick O
reviews.title: Unspoilt so far
reviews.content: PROS:- Scenery sincerely inspiring. Don't be put off by the rain, you get to see the mountains from a whole new perspective.- Came here on a rainy day, so not a tourist to be seen. Just me, the paddler and a wide array of wildlife. - Spotted kingfishers and storks, plucked some gigantic snails from the water.CONS:- Paid VND 110k for a 1.5hr boat tour, which for 1 person was a bit steep. Listed in guidebook as VND 60k.- Tipped the paddler VND 10k after, but she kept begging for more. Slightly negative ending to an otherwise great experience.

reviews.author: Dean C
reviews.title: Passion Nature
reviews.content: My Family had stay in Emeralda Resort for 3 days, we had spent a half day in Van Long. Being a beautiful landscape with consecutive limestone mountains, attractive caves surrounded by vast and peaceful swamps. Any one who like travel and love nature, this is the ideal destination and preserve the passion for scientific research on the inland wetlands. In compair with Trang An it not a large scale, but with differences beauty and special for people who stay in five star resort Emeralda can come here to enjoy.

reviews.author: SPatt0
reviews.title: So peaceful and quiet...why?
reviews.content: This place will go bonkers in a few years for sure...you arrive, feel like it's closed, with no sight of the river. Next thing you are on a little row boat, yourselves and your hard working rower. Was pretty hard work not having a set of oars yourself to help but a great chance to soak up the truly magic surrounds and take loads of photos. We thought Trang An was pretty quiet mostly, but Van Long even quieter. We went around mid afternoon but you could probably wait even a little later for a setting sun, more wildlife and a bit less heat in the sun. Might make it easier on your paddler too...mind you the smile on her face when we gave her a modest tip was priceless :-)

reviews.author: Simsee
reviews.title: peaceful, I was the only boat on the water
reviews.content: Did a day trip with driver from Ngoc Anh Hotel to this and Trang An, this quite different to Trang An as only one cave but a lot more wild life and more out doors I felt, certainly not at all touristy, tickets cost 65000d or about $4 you are out on the water for about 1.5 hours roughly including a cave visit, lots of fish and birdlife around, I did get asked to buy stuff off the stalls after the trip but no pressure at all if you dont want to, I would recommend this trip as good value and interesting, one thing was as we went in towards the hills there was a loud explosion which I found out later is the massive cement plant not far away blasting, that woke me up! Boat ladies are lovely and work very hard, I gave mine a tip of 50000d and you would have thought I had given her a car!

reviews.author: jeff_acklington
reviews.title: Better than Tam Coc
reviews.content: Did this trip on second day of trip to Ninh Binh.  We had been to Tam Coc previous day and found Van Long equally as beautiful with no commercialism.  There were also no other tourists.  Boats are a little uncomfortable for 1 hour but you forget that when admiring the natural beauty of the place.  Take an umbrella and lots of water because even at 9am it was hot.

reviews.author: Antilope
reviews.title: Stunning!
reviews.content: Almost more breathtaking than Halong Bay. The scale and serenity are beyond words. We went late afternoon and the light was just adding to the dramatic scenery.

reviews.author: skarna
reviews.title: Relaxing bit of nature spying opportunity
reviews.content: Short boat trip (about 1.5 hours) but worth the time.  Similar scenery as Trang An but no caves.  More fields of lotus flowers and weeds, allowing for more opportunity to see birds.  Other reviewers commented on the lack of tourists making this a peaceful trip.  That was our experience as we were the only ones on the water the entire trip.  It was also our experience the lady that rowed the boat was either disinterested, had not had enough sleep, was too old to be doing the paddling, or whatever because she spent a good bit of time yawning and sighing and even stopped once to soak her towel in the water and lay it across her face for a few minutes.  It was 8:30 a.m. for goodness sake and the heat had not even started to reach what it would be 3 hours hence.  We suspected she was angling for a tip.  When we tipped her, which was a quite nice tip, she acted unimpressed and did not even thank us.   If you can overlook this type of behavior, the trip is worthwhile and is quite inexpensive.

reviews.author: tara k
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.content: My fiance and I drove our motorbike out to Van Long. At first we though it was deserted because there was no one around and the boats were all empty. We went for a farther drive down the road to take in the scenery which was breathtaking. When we passed by on the way back we found out that there were plenty of people they were just all indoors across the street because of the heat. We were the only tourists there, compared to many more people  at Tam Coc. Our boat driver didn't speak any English but was super friendly and didn't ask us to buy anything. We left her a nice tip. The trip was peaceful and beautiful, tons of colorful birds and dragonflies. Unfortunately we didn't get to see the Decantour Langurs, but we did hear them as we were leaving. I was really hoping to see them, I heard its best to go late in the afternoon when they come down to sleep in the caves. Highly recommend visiting Van Long while in Ninh Binh. I wouldn't replace Tam Coc with it because that is equally beautiful in a different way, but would recommend saving time to do both!!

reviews.author: Chris Moonie
reviews.title: Van Long Nature Reserve, Nihn Bihn - 'Halong Bay' on land
reviews.content: It's known as 'Halong Bay on land' for all the right reasons and it's much closer to Ha Noi Old Quarter(1/2 the time).I was very disappointed in Halong Bay, due to overcrowding and pollution, and we only visited Nihn Bihn after changes in our itinerary and a recommendation from our personal guide.There are 2 tours; 1 hour/2 hours and 1 cave/2 caves respectively.We chose the longer tour and as the only ones there had the place to ourselves.As I understand it this is a relatively new area and probably one of very few attempts at ecotourism here in Vietnam so there are more caves but they haven't been opened up to the public yet while they are fully explored and researched.A Vietnamese speaking guide is essential. We picked up so much from our paddler along the way through our guide.The boat owners pay something like $150 for the boat and then go on a roster where every 20 days they can paddle their boat for the day instead of working in whatever menial, backbreaking job they have otherwise. Handing over a few dollars including a tip doesn't worry me one bit.Spectacular views throughout and a chance to get up close and personal with the wildlife, as well as the workers in and on the water; fishing, crabbing and looking for snails.ALSO, no garbage to be seen.Well worth the time.

reviews.author: worddict
reviews.title: Another karst landscape on land
reviews.content: Compared to Trang An Grottoes, this is much smaller and further out. But there were much fewer tourists, but the boat paddlers tend to be more demanding of a tip. They want US dollars, rather than dong. A much more quiet trip. but only one cave to go through and then they want to turn back, but you can request a full turn around among tall grass.
