But be prepared to tip for that. I went early and the birds were still resting on the top of the hills. It was quite a sight.

reviews.author: MichaelZZZ
reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.content: Simply stunning scenery viewed from a small paddle boat. Beautifully peaceful. A "must do". About half an hour from ninh binh. Boat ride takes about hour and a half and coats less than $2.50 per person. We stayed 2 nights in Ninh binh. Ninh binh is not very interesting and can be missed out. Try do van long and trang An grottos as a day trip from hanoi. Magical visuals. Don't miss it.

reviews.author: RieksLok
reviews.title: It was a beautifull trip. The scenery is spectacular
reviews.content: Nice trip on (partly) bamboo boats.  Our group was the only one there, which made it more special.   The trip is short (only around one hour).  Its a good idea to visit this area, but you also have to take a boattrip or/and bicycle ride around Tam Coc and/or Trang An to have a more complete feel about 'Halong Bay' on land.

reviews.author: EVOLeuvenBelgium
reviews.title: great visit
reviews.content: I only did the Van Long boat ride as I was told this is the quiet one - and indeed for most of the trip I was all alone enjoying the scenery - only minus was the rowing lady who after minuets started to ask for more money - I can appreciate but it was a minor annoyance (she got a good tip in the end) - a must do

reviews.author: Nigel H
reviews.title: Peaceful and beautiful reserve
reviews.content: We visited Van Long on the way back from Cuc Phuong National Park. We were lucky enough to see two groups of the endangered Delancours Langurs on the mountain sides, as well as numerous birds such as herons, storks, bitterns and kingfishers. It is a lovely boat ride and much quieter than Tam Coc or Trang An. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Treens
reviews.title: Langurs on the lake
reviews.content: Arriving at Van Long mid-morning, we were the only tourists at the lake. Our guide showed us to a small boat propelled by an elderly but enthusiastic lady. It was sitting close to the waterline unladen, and by the time two large westerners and one small Vietnamese had boarded, the water was literally 1cm from the lip of the boat. No-one seemed concerned though, and off we went on to the lake. The day was very misty and it was really atmospheric out on the lake with the limestone hills rising up in the background. After half an hour we caught sight of what we had hoped to see - a troupe of Delacour's Langurs come down to the lakeside to drink. We watched them and took photographs for 15 minutes before heading back to the landing stage, passing some strange cave-dwelling pigs on the way.Van Long is a great place to visit, and a must if you are interested in the critically endangered Delacour's Langur: possibly the rarest monkey in the world.

reviews.author: Carl Heist
reviews.title: Walking along the reserve.
reviews.content: Take a walk along the nature reserve and get overwelmed by the beauty. You just have to walk on the digue wich lies on the border of the reserve.

reviews.author: Ian R
reviews.title: Wonderful place
reviews.content: A really beautiful place and a great experience.  A short boat ride with a crazy Vietnamese lady who was frantically screaming and trying to show us where the monkeys were will stay with me forever!

reviews.author: yoram b
reviews.title: very pretty
reviews.content: Serene, mystic quiet, not commercial, highly recommended, expecially in early morning or late afternoon, Lots of birds and beautiful scenery.

reviews.author: RJ66-73
reviews.title: wonderful
reviews.content: Great experience and not a lot of tourists. We were there early in the morning and we were the only one.A little bit the same scenery like Trang An - but without the caves and without the local and foreign tourists.

reviews.author: c fieman
reviews.title: An enchantment
reviews.content: Arriving early in the morning, we were paddled through the morning mists in a traditional basket weave boat, seeing no other tourists until we began wrapping up the trip. Serene and magical, the trip was a highlight of our visit to Ninh Binh. It contrasted sharply with our paddle in Trang An, which we wished we had taken a pass on.

reviews.author: GoneThough
reviews.title: Peaceful refuge from the madness of Tam Coc
reviews.content: Tam Coc is beautiful and I do not believe that a visit to Van Long Nature Reserve should replace it.  Do both if you have the time.  It is quite a different experience apart from the hordes of visitors and lower degree of harassment for tips you experience here, as compared to Tam Coc. But do tip the rower since it is hard work.But more than that I believe that the vegetation is different and the birdlife amazing to watch in their own environment.I hired a motorbike with a driver to get there and drive to the reserve was also quite scenic.

reviews.author: Virgin J
reviews.title: Great for sightseeing
reviews.content: Great landscapes with open environment, pure and quiet atmosphere. Felt very naturally and beautifully with the amazing landscape, The trip was worth for value that made by Customized Tour, Mr Tin who was really helpful by organizing us the great trip to Van Long Nature Reserve

reviews.author: ChardeNed
reviews.title: Pristine
reviews.content: Great landscapes, quite and serene. We heard other local sites such as Tam Coc and Trang an were overcrowded and touristy. This was anything but.

reviews.author: Jeffrey W
reviews.title: Well worth a visit
reviews.content: We arrived here early in the morning and were the first boat to set off from the landing stage. This meant it was very peaceful on the water and we were therefore able to see a number of different bird species. It was misty and very calm the morning we visited and this added to the charm of the place. All you could hear was the gentle sound of the oars in the water. If you can avoid the coach parties I would certainly recommend this attraction.

reviews.author: zeusaustralia
reviews.title: Beautiful landscape
reviews.content: We hired a motobike to Vanlong natural reserve and did not regret it. Escaping from the noisy city, we faced a beautiful stream with rice paddies. We saw lots of buffalo and farmers working in the field. It was totally different from things we had seen.

reviews.author: Gaia-son
reviews.title: Cruising in the Van Long nature reserve
reviews.content: Last October we did a day trip to Van Long nature reserve from Hanoi.We went with Footprints Vietnam on a private trip.The ride there took about 3 hours.We first visited a couple of temples dedicated to King Dinh and King Le. The temple complex is not very big but quite interesting.After lunch we proceeded to the nature reserve.You ride on a small bamboo boat along a winding clear shallow stream. In the beginning it was pretty hot as the place is very open.As we rowed deeper into the reserve the scenery got better. On both side of the stream are limestone hills of all shapes and sizes.There are also,large reed beds and feeding flocks of egret. One interesting part is when you row into dark silent caves. Near to the caves certain part of the stream are so shallow that the boatman have to get out to push the boat.The nature reserve is very nice and have very little tourists. In fact there are only four of us for the most part. It is only when we are returning that we saw another group of tourist. I have not been to Tam Coc but would certainly recommend Van Long for an excellent day trip from Hanoi.

reviews.author: Pastelchris
reviews.title: superb !
reviews.content: It is definitely a great idea to go to Van Long and take a boat for yourself to discover a superb scenery.The day I was there,I was the only one in the reserve and that gorgeous place was just for me.Don't forget to tip the boat lady ( a 50000 dongs is not much for us but helps them a lot)...their work is real hard under the scorching sun, and when they have finished their rowing job, they work in the paddy fields to make both ends meet.

reviews.author: Pitchounette20
reviews.title: So beautiful!
reviews.content: We visited the reserve in the morning, the light was perfect to take pictures and we really enjoyed our visit here. It was very quiet and serene, only a few boats on the water. This place is really gorgeous!

reviews.author: havaholiday
reviews.title: A lovely row through the quiet nature reserve
reviews.content: The atmosphere was lovely as we arrived early in the day. A rower was called for us and off we went, there were many fisher people setting and pulling traps. Our lady rower had no english but was very friendly and indicated she would take photos of us. A group of 4 boats caught up with us later and on the row back we were lucky enough to all see one of the Langurs? which are dark brown with a white rear end up on the cliffs right above our boats, very exciting. The negative factor is the cement factory you can clearly see in the distance belching smoke out, a bit if a juxtaposition for a nature reserve.

reviews.author: F1veStar
reviews.title: The best of the three boat trips we took in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: Beautiful scenery that can be enjoyed in peace & quiet with no vendors. Only one other boat on a Saturday morning. 90,000 dong for two, with 1.5 hours on a boat - there is no walking to be done here. You'd need good binoculars to see birds, but we could hear the Langur monkeys.

reviews.author: HTH17
reviews.title: It's depressing witnessing the industrial destruction of the very sight you come to enjoy
reviews.content: Even as we drove into Ninh Binh area from Hanoi, we saw the roads and surroundings were covered with grayish dust. Our guide told us this is an area for cement factories. And where do they get the raw materials from? The limestones from those beautiful formations we came to see. Without judging whether it's right or wrong (maybe the local economy really needs this, and cement has to come from somewhere, I suppose), it still depressing seeing whole mountains-sides being carved and excavated.Van Long was indeed less touristy - we saw only 3 other boats when we were there. The 1.5 hour boat trip to a little cave and back was nice enough if you ignore the smokes stacks from the nearby monstrous cement factory. The cave was only big enough for us to row about 30 meters in, before we had to turn back - so it was a bit of an anti-climax. We were told Van Long was a more natural tour because they used bamboo instead of steel boats which were used at Tam Coc. They just did not mentioned that the inside of the bamboo boat was covered in cement so it did not leak. So much for being natural.We also stopped at the pier of Tam Coc as part of our tour. It was indeed more crowded and they did indeed use steel boats. But we saw very nice pictures of Tam Coc compared to what we saw in Van Long. So maybe Tam Coc was more touristy and crowded for a reason.It's probably not worth going out of your way to get there especially if you have been to Halong Bay or Phang Nga caves in Thailand. But looking on the bright side, it was good educational value for our kids to see how nature can be destroyed by human development.

reviews.author: michaelrturner
reviews.title: A lovely boat ride through the wetlands
reviews.content: Quite a far distance away fron Ninh Binh, but great once you're there. Reasonable price, nice guides and some excellent photo opportunities

reviews.author: coconutfarmer
reviews.title: peaceful beauty
reviews.content: Did the boat trip at Van Long. We tried for Trang An but they only do trips of 4 people or more and there was no-one else there so we left after waiting about 15 minutes. Trang An looked super touristy and was staffed by really rude people so we were happy to move on. Van Long was the complete opposite. The ticket sellers were super nice even though we were confused how everything worked when we arrived. After we paid our 90,000 Dong (45,000 each), the lady showed me where to park my motorcycle (in the shade) then came out of the booth and walked us down to the boats while yelling for someone to come take us. A very kind looking man appeared from one of the houses, helped us into his boat and off we went.The tour basically follows the local fishing route around one of the Karsts. It goes into a cave a short way then turns around and comes back out. Our guide did his best to communicate with us, showing us crab traps and various wildlife. My phrasebook actually came in handy but we mostly just guessed what the other was saying. While it was super hot out until we broke into the shade of the first Karst, the scenery was stunning and the atmosphere was peaceful. Overall the trip lasted about an hour and a half, at the end we tipped our guide because we figured he's probably not making much off the tour since we only paid $2.25 each and the government no doubt takes the bulk of that. While Van Long is probably not as beautiful as Tam Coc and the trip is a bit shorter than what is offered at Trang An, it still offered something that you won't find at either of the other two places. Genuine friendliness, unadulterated natural beauty, and complete solitude from the hordes of tour buses.If you arrive by motorcycle and have enough gas, don't miss the drive around Van Long and through the local villages. It was equal in experience to our boat ride. Just make sure you either have a map, a good sense of direction or can follow your route back because there are obviously no street signs and the roads are often gravel or dirt.cheers and happy travels

reviews.author: ellco
reviews.title: What a laugh - very skilled rowers - amazing sencery
reviews.content: Part of our cycling tour - we paid the rowers - 2 boats for our family - the ladies rowing even sang to us in Vietnamese - I'm not a small lad so we had a bit of fun with that - well the lady rowers did. The place was absolutely amazing - the caves and water ways just on going and going !

reviews.author: John F
reviews.title: The best sight in Ninh Binh
reviews.content: This is the place for a quiet boat ride with endangered langurs hooting, a lovely grotto to go through, and nobody else around.

reviews.author: TJB
reviews.title: Great for a bike trip
reviews.content: Nice and flat, we loved the biking, no guide needed.

reviews.author: minchead
reviews.title: A real nature reserve
reviews.content: Boat ride for 90 mins is well worth it, if you can a bike ride around and meet locals it is even better

reviews.author: DaveandMause
reviews.title: Tranquil & stunning
reviews.content: This peaceful, stunning scenery afforded  a more enjoyable experience that our trip to Trang An.  There were so few tourist traveling on the boats, it was quiet & we could appreciate the natural beauty of the area.

reviews.author: Retsyo
reviews.title: Silence is golden
reviews.content: Amazingly having seen no tourists all day we came across another couple taking a a ride on a local boat late in the afternoon.   Because of the weather the light was not good but we had an enjoyable time.  We saw several kingfishers and other birds.

reviews.author: bbb05
reviews.title: Hurry, the number of tour busses is growing
reviews.content: We stayed 5 nights in the nearby Emeralda Resort (I rated it "Excellent") because we wanted see the Halong Bay on land ,to avoid the crowds of Tam Coc ( described by Lonely Planet as "Surviving the Tam Coc Tango) , and to walk around to get a glimpse of Vietnam rural life. We did the boat ride three times ( buy a ticket for two at 90.000VND at the ticket counter) and achieved each time to do it practically alone. I know it is very selfish to expect to have every nice tourist attraction just for yourselve, but I also prefer not to sightsee an natural reserve in a traffic jam with Korean tour group participants. In March 2012 the tour busses (less than 10 per day I guess) started to arrive at 10.15 , so we took a trip at 10.00. It becomes quiet again after 16.00. But Emerald is just starting up, there is some building nearby and we did not see what happens in Ninh Binh City.We did some half day walkings in the neighbourhood, very pleasant.The locals call the great egrets, landing by thousands at the evening in the reserve, storks - kingfishers are abundant.To find it : Emerald resort (recommanded) and Van Long Resort ( to avoid) is nearby

reviews.author: Clive C
reviews.title: Quiet and relaxing
reviews.content: We were very lucky as we were the only ones on the lake and it was so serene and quiet. We cold hear the monkeys calling to each other, their echoes were bouncing off the karsts, which, in the stillness of a misty morning was quite eerie.  There is lots of bird life to be seen and advise people to go to this area early in the morning.

reviews.author: Proudmelbourneian
reviews.title: Stunning Ninh Binh Scenery!
reviews.content: This place is absolutely stunning. Our days spent leisurely floating around on boats are unforgettable events. This entire region is a Vietnamese treasure.

reviews.author: Julia255060
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.content: Took a day tour with Footprint travel and couldnt recommend this tour group and this venue highly enough. Beatiful scenery no hassles from the lady who rowed us, an excellent guide and driver with a good command of English, an enjoyable inclusive vietnamese lunch and a side trip to Hoa Lu. Only down side was the poor condition of the main highway - however you would travel the same general route if going to Tam Coc and then be faced with the hassles (heard how bad they were from fellow travellers who said their trip was spoilt by this).

reviews.author: rachrtravels
reviews.title: Van Long Nature Reserve and Hoa Lu Review
reviews.content: We did a day trip to the Ninh Binh Region, and instead of doing the typical Tam Coc cave tour, we requested going to the Van Long Nature Reserve. The views seemed to be nearly the same, but the Van Long NR is less touristy and not so crowded. For the first hour, we felt like we were the only ones rowing around the entire reserve. There is a cave to go through as well, and we had a great time. Several birds are in the area, and it’s just a very peaceful experience. After the Van Long Nature Reserve we went to Hoa Lu to visit the ancient city and the temples. Worth doing if you’re going to already be in the area. We went back to Hanoi for the night. This is all very doable in a single day trip without feeling too tired and run down.

reviews.author: worldtraveler3465
reviews.title: Rowboat rip through beautiful scenery without the Tam Coc sales pressure
reviews.content: The previous day we rode on the Tam Coc river experience which is as touristy and full of pushy sales tactics as everybody says. The only way we avoided this was to tell our guide from Oriental Bridge Travel that we didn't want to be hassled and that we would give a good tip if they left us alone. This worked! However, our wonderful experience at the Van Long preserve was completely different. We got into a boat near the end of the day, and for the next hour were rowed by a pleasant woman through this extremely scenic marsh and mountain preserve. We saw a large variety of birds and the serene calmness of the marsh was a welcome respite and reward from traveling the hectic and bumpy roads of Vietnam. Though there were no tunnels to row through, we would happily return here for such a great outdoor experience.

reviews.author: Marianna24
reviews.title: Impressive
reviews.content: This an impressive place to be, absolutely worth visiting it when in Vietnam, or at least when in North Vietnam

reviews.author: LJ
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.content: Much better than Tam Coc. Very few tourists. Beautiful and serene.

reviews.author: mostlyharmless
reviews.title: Peaceful serenity in a beautiful landscape
reviews.content: We traveled to the Van Long nature park from Hanoi, which was a 2 - 2 1/2 hour drive from Hanoi. The roads deteriorated the further away from Hanoi you were, so a reasonable tolerance for traveling is required. Once you arrive, the breathtaking scenery of the Van Long reserve takes your breath away. Aged limestone hills in a karst landscape, surrounded by fields of water and reeds. The pictures probably say more than any words would do. We boarded a bamboo boat, and were rowed through the landscape in peaceful serenity. The route taken was a circular route leading to a submerged limestone cave, and then returning to the embarkation point. It's obvious that the 1 hour row only scratched the surface of the area available, but it was still a lovely experience. The site was much less touristy than many other sites we visited in Vietnam. Although, having said which, about 30 mins after we arrived, a larger group of visitors also embarked on the rowing expedition, which made it slightly less serene. My suggestion would be to arrive early in the morning!We traveled here with Footprint Travel (http://www.footprintsvietnam.com), who organised everything from prompt pickup in Hanoi, the rowboat experience, a visit to Hoa Lu temple and return to Hanoi, all within a day.  I have nothing but praise for Footprint Travel, who provided a really professional experience for us.Recommended, but if you're traveling from Hanoi, remember the journey to and fro may be tiring.

reviews.author: travelfizz
reviews.title: Peaceful, untouched and monkeys!
reviews.content: We went out in Van Long around 10am and had a WONDERFUL time- it's so peaceful... our boat guide took us away from the other boats, and it was wonderful.  We went again at 5:30am and saw an almost extinct species of monkeys as the sun came out.... it is AMAZING!  Much less touristy than Tam Coc or Trang An!

reviews.author: frequentflyer033
reviews.title: Eternal Vietnam
reviews.content: Beautiful mountains at the middle of the rice paddies. Very pristine and still non commercial compared to the neighboring Tam Coc Caves. A good alternative.

reviews.author: Mr9xx
reviews.title: Lovely Cathedral
reviews.content: Charming old architecture with a serene atmosphere, beautifully combining traditional Vietnamese and French influences. A place worth visiting.

reviews.author: abra n
reviews.title: Sunny day exploring the stone-church!
reviews.content: Amazing church with wonderful architect. We have learnt a lot about the history of Vietnam and Catholic community which gave us some insights of the little country by the East-Sea (words of my guide).

reviews.author: Inspire05257523257
reviews.title: Surprising, charming, not to be missed
reviews.content: Very surprising architecture exterior then interior!In the middle of this country of temples and pagodas, an Asian interpretation of the Catholic religion…

reviews.author: Alessandro S
reviews.title: Nice surprise
reviews.content: Visit the complex which is very large. The Cathedral was built during the colonial period (1892) and the works for its construction were personally supervised by Father Peter Tran Luc, whose tomb is located near the structure.In 1954 Ho Chi Minh's communists occupied the area and ordered the Catholics to leave. As a result, the cathedral was closed and abandoned for several years and during the war it was seriously damaged by American bombing.Today it represents a point of reference for the numerous Catholic Christians present in this area of the country

reviews.author: Ron
reviews.title: Nice Church
reviews.content: Great history place for Catholic tradidions, French Church in the North of Vietnam. If you go to Ninh Binh, must visit for Christian

reviews.author: Joyce S
reviews.title: One of a kind Asian-Western cathedral
reviews.content: If you love heritage buildings, architecture and visiting cathedrals, this place is not to be missed. It is 2 hours away from Hanoi city, peaceful place to explore about 1 hour especially if you love photography.

reviews.author: kellyandrewtomas
reviews.title: oversized church in undersized town
reviews.content: As a fairly small nondescript town in Vietnam you wouldn't expect Phat Diem to have such an impressive cathedral. It was both the size and style that kept me wandering the grounds for about 1 hour. While I was there it is peaceful. Overall I would say it has been maintained well with only a few areas needing repair and no rubbish.

reviews.author: Quang Kiet Le
reviews.title: Beautiful blend of Vietnamese culture and Western religion
reviews.content: It took us more than 2 hours travelling from Hanoi. Phat Diem Cathedral actually consisted of one big church and 4 smaller ones surrounding. The churches were beautifully blended of the traditional Vietnamese culture and architecture and the Western religion reflecting in every single corner. Highly recommended to register a short tour with the sister at the Information Centre to understand more about the history.

reviews.author: srvctraveler
reviews.title: Fascinating fusion of Chinese and Catholic traditions.
reviews.content: Great architecture and a fascinating history giving insight into the role of the French and the Catholic Church in this part of Vietnam.

reviews.author: Gustave S
reviews.title: Worth the detour if you like architecture but ...
reviews.content: The place feels serene if not in desolation.  Only one of the four chapel is still in use, the others have been converted to what seems to be classes.  You are free to roam the area which is a nice way to visit at your own pace.  The grounds are nice but the buildings are in need of tender love and care (TLC).Most display a serious amount of grime and a good power washer would do wonders.  Still a nice place to see but I fear the future will not be kind to it.The interior of the cathedral is also very dusty, the golden leaves and ornaments are not maintained.  It seems like they don’t bother with maintaining the cathedral at all.In my opinion they should charge a fee for entrance except for mass and locals and take better care of the buildings.I am glad I went to see it, gave to the maintenance box but I wish the Church would take better care of it.People like to see historical buildings, give them a better experience so more people will want to come and visit them.

reviews.author: FrankSteve
reviews.title: A Place Between Heaven and Earth
reviews.content: Visiting the cathedral was an unforgettable highlight of our trip to Vietnam. The architecture is stunning, the atmosphere peaceful, and the gardens beautiful. The structures and grounds exude a vibrant and unique history. A blending of European and Vietnamese design, with pagoda style roofs, the cathedral was designed in 1892 by Father Tran Luc, a Vietnamese priest. Graham Greene featured the cathedral in a memorable scene of The Quiet American. We spent several hours exploring the place, in awe of everything we saw, and will surely return to Vietnam to see the cathedral again.

reviews.author: Carla Christina
reviews.title: Very Beautiful - Worth the Visit
reviews.content: It may be further away from all the other attractions but definitely worth the visits if you are interested in the olden buildings. The architecture is very unique and the scenery is lovely. I would recommend to choose a cooler day to visit as the sun can be quite harsh in the hot summer months.

reviews.author: Sunny K
reviews.title: Mix of European and Vietnamese Architecture
reviews.content: Its really beautiful and well preserved! A unique blend of European and Vietnamese Architecture and not to be missed if you are in Ninh Binh or TamCoc. It is built with pagoda type roofs in traditional Vietnamese temple architecture.The Cathedral is big and there are also small churches in the same complex. Some are not used and some are still being used. Its 35 km from TamCoc and can be easily reached on motorbike. Just follow Google Map.

reviews.author: planetawdrodze
reviews.title: It was more than I've expected
reviews.content: This cathedral is just amazing. It was far more what ive expected. If you have time to come here - do it. We took a motorbike from Ninh Binh and got there, see cathedral and came back.

reviews.author: girlgirl66
reviews.title: Beautiful architecture, large grounds, Vietnamese influence
reviews.content: I could see the toll of time on the stone walls of all the buildings here and I marvel at how it remains strong over the years. The carvings are so deep and intricate that they stand out at night. The interior has a lot of wood elements and is obviously influenced by Vietnamese compared to St Joseph’s Cathedral in Hanoi Old Quarter. I also like the large grounds that appears linked to what seemed like a community house and also how the faith had spilled over into what appears to be a lake with statue of worship in the middle. Everything is so wonderful and lovely here. I strongly recommend tourists to walk around the Kim Son District that is surrounding this beautiful place of worship.

reviews.author: Phu Truong Thang
reviews.title: Beautiful combination between two cultures
reviews.content: When we talk about the Roman Catholic architecture, we normally think about the design of Gothic, Romanesque or Renaissance. Surprisingly, this cathedral was mixed between the French culture and Vietnamese culture.

reviews.author: Peter V
reviews.title: A stunning monument
reviews.content: This cathedral is a stunning combination of sino vietnanese styke mixed with gothic. Itbiscan enormousvcomplex. FathervSix ( sau) started it. Itbgained world renown being described in graham greenebs ThecQuietvAmerican and was also filmed. For rc beliversveven an extra must see. We regard thos on par with another fatastic cathedral that of so kien, formerly khe sonbetween hanoi and ninh binh. That is in gothoc style, built in 1852,finished 1882 andvis mentioned in thevtravel exploitsvodvdrvhocquerd. Both mustvsee forvhidtoryband architecture buffs as well as rc believers.

reviews.author: Elisabeth K
reviews.title: Worth the long way
reviews.content: The way from Tam Coc to Phat Diem by motobike takes quite a while (1h), but it's totally worth it!! We enjoyed walking through the cathedral's area... many little chapels. It's a quiet place, only with some people visiting. Nearby we found a cute coffeeshop that serves great vietnamese coffee and mangoshake!

reviews.author: Daoni Nguyen
reviews.title: Unique architecture and peaceful environment
reviews.content: The architecture is amazing (mix of western and eastern). This site is the capital of catholicism in Vietnam. The space is very open and there’s a nice garden with statues.

reviews.author: BobsWorth1
reviews.title: Very nice place to visit
reviews.content: I visited today and it is well worth a visit if you are in Ninh Binh. You can take the number 2 bus from Ninh Binh bus station (Ben xe Ninh Binh) which is located about halfway between the train station and the centre of town. It only costs 25000 VND each way. No need to buy a ticket in the station, just pay the conductor on the bus. Journey time to Phat Diem is around 45 mins - 1 hour depending on the traffic.The bus will drop you off at a junction on the main road (Duong 10), outside a large yellow and black coloured electronics shop called The Gioi Di Dong). Look down the street to the side of the shop and you’ll see the cathedral at the bottom. To get the bus back to Ninh Binh, just stand opposite the electronics shop and flag it down like you would a taxi. Free entry and there are plenty of cafes in and around the area.

reviews.author: jaypep1
reviews.title: Worth a Visit
reviews.content: I liked this place. The cathedral was quite impressive with its wooden beams. Unfortunately you can't take photos inside. The cathedral is surrounded by four smaller churches and a stone chapel. There is also a statue of Jesus Christ on an island at the front of the cathedral. Various statues and grottoes. Cost: FREE. At the back of the cathedral is a museum but it was closed when I was there. Not many tourists or touts this time of year. The best photos are for myself.

reviews.author: jewel838c
reviews.title: Off the beaten path but worth a visit
reviews.content: Phat Diem Cathedral is slightly off the beaten path and takes about 30 minutes drive from Ninh Binh.  I think it is  definitely worth the visit. The architecture is unique - you could call it a chur-goda because it it had architectural elements that made it a pagoda more than a church.  But it was beautiful nevertheless. Some of the side chapels had some gaudy lights but if if you look past that you can still see the uniqueness of the Asian motifs in the original decoration, wood carving  and stone carving. When doing our research we stumbled on a website that described the Catholic churches and cathedrals in Ninh Binh and the neighboring province of Nam Dinh.  Some of these churches were beautiful Gothic, European style churches.  Unfortunately we didn't have time to visit so decided that we could only see Phat Diem Cathedral for this trip.  But I think a pilgrimage visit to the other churches in Nam Dinh would be well worth it in the future.

reviews.author: wildfirejc
reviews.title: Go for Mass, Nothing else worth it
reviews.content: The whole complex has an air of neglect. However the mass was nice. Fortunately I am Roman Catholic so even if the service was in Vietnamese, I enjoyed it. Lots of people though - very noisy. The stone temple was rather neglected.

reviews.author: Hung N
reviews.title: Peaceful Historical Place
reviews.content: Because we stay near Tam Coc, so it's really far to come here. Nevertheless, it would be wonderful to visit and study about memorable historical period of Catholic in Vietnam.This place is not big, not taking much time to go around, but with the peaceful atmosphere, just sit down and enjoy the place is good enough to us

reviews.author: Pham G
reviews.title: It's a historical place
reviews.content: It's a historical and religious place, that is not commercialized. There are several cathedrals in one place and all are well-maintained.

reviews.author: Buiduong
reviews.title: Biggest and beautiful cathedral in north Vietnam
reviews.content: I visited this place when travelling to Ninh Binh. Our group passed by it and deciced to stop to visit. We were very interested in the ancient architecture of this cathedral and spacious area,...Even it is too hot outside but when we step inside this, we feel we are in fridge, indeed

reviews.author: Phuong V
reviews.title: Nice Cathedral to visit in cool weather, not Summer
reviews.content: This is peacefull place for us to visit, we went there everytime we go to Ninh Binh :-), for hot weather, it d better not go there at noon as it's so unpleasant because of the heat, surrounded is stone, so you will feel headeach after few minutes.we come there when the weather is cool ( not in June to August). Have a nice time there.

reviews.author: HappyBingo
reviews.title: Unique architecture
reviews.content: We visited Phat Diem Cathedral as part of a tour of Ninh Binh. It was a rainy day but that didn't diminish the uniqueness of the architecture. A mix of East meets West, we were also interested in the story of Father Six who helped build this place. Interesting.

reviews.author: rajucnair
reviews.title: 16th century cathedral
reviews.content: Very peaceful place. well maintained cathedral where even now mass takes place everyday. special mass on sunday

reviews.author: Josine T
reviews.title: Very nice buildings and worth a visit!
reviews.content: Beautiful stone buildings to have a look at and grtounds to admire. Very different to other religious buildings seen in Vietnam and worth a visit!

reviews.author: jakehands78
reviews.title: A pleasant surprise!
reviews.content: This isn't your average Catholic Cathedral. Once you arrive you will be amazed how Father Six constructed it fuzing both eastern and western beliefs into one. The chapel to the left of the cathedral shows a clear example of this with a Ying Yang symbol covered by the heart of christ. It's worth getting a tour guide to show you more fascinating details of this cathedral. If you walk through the gates, on the right hand side theres a small reception. Inside you'll find tour guide who can speak English, Italian or french. We were very happy with our tour and couldn't believe it was completely free,though we did give a donation at the end.

reviews.author: Đôi Lời M
reviews.title: Vatican in Vietnam
reviews.content: It is one of the most beautiful and ancient churchs in Vietnam. It has unique architecture, linking between Easterm and Westerm architecture.

reviews.author: Hoàng Yen
reviews.title: nice structures
reviews.content: I went there on Sunday January here i had occassion to see the Sunday Pray.I went around to understand the history and structures

reviews.author: Mathieu L
reviews.title: Worth the detour for a picture
reviews.content: The cathedral is beautiful for it's special architecture that we are not used to see for a christian building.  It has an asian style of architecture which make it unique.  There is nothing to do there but take some pictures and hang around the site.

reviews.author: Alexis D
reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.content: I love this place. Have been there 4 or 5 times already, and I find it absolutely incredible. If you like architecture, dont miss it: this mix of Asian and European style is unique in the world. The pillars only, made on ironwood, deserve a visit. And the trip from Ninh Binh reveals a beautiful landscape along a canal.

reviews.author: Jodi R
reviews.title: Quite spectacular
reviews.content: Make sure you don't visit at mass time because they close the tower and you won't be able to visit the top of the church.  It is an interesting place to visit, particularly if you are Catholic.

reviews.author: T S
reviews.title: Spectacular Craftmanship
reviews.content: Unbelievable woodworking skills employed at this cathedral. We spent about an hour walking around. Was definitely the highlight of our tour that day.

reviews.author: Ryan Cao
reviews.title: Stunning destination
reviews.content: I was here for a whole morning to discover the architecture and stories behind those constructions. You definitely need a local guide to tell you about those things. There are some restricted areas that's you couldn't visit because of the religious regulations. Hope you have a good trips.

reviews.author: Phạm Xuân T
reviews.title: Phat Diem Memory
reviews.content: Phat Diem Stone Cathedral is one of the most famous and beautiful churches in Vietnam with special architecture: an elegant combination between Western church architecture style and Vietnamese religious buildings.

reviews.author: lavasi
reviews.title: Beautiful world heritage
reviews.content: Knowing it's an old church, I didn't expect to see a historic place that is stunning in architechture, particularly the main timber structure, built in the early colonial period.The surrounding is also well preserved, only the eyesore things are the colorful banners hanging here and there.

reviews.author: KevanEastYorkshire
reviews.title: Interesting Place
reviews.content: Spent a number of hours with a guide walking around the Cathedral. Seeing the bell from close up (gate/door opened by a nun) was good.Lots to see in around the site although its a bit of a drive from Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: pathfinderHcm
reviews.title: The architect of the cathedral so stunning
reviews.content: I was very impressed about the architect of the Cathedral which really the harmony of Vietnamese style and Catholic style.

reviews.author: Strabo
reviews.title: Fascinating
reviews.content: It is rather out of the way but we enjoyed it - to see the melding of eastern and western architecture of the cathedral and its surrounding buildings. Cannot be compared with the European cathedrals or duomos in terms of scale, grandeur. But if we consider it was built in a very poor third world country then, it is indeed very unique and an architectural feat for the time.

reviews.author: Peter C
reviews.title: A surprise cathedral
reviews.content: Although quite a long way from Ninh Binh town it is worth visiting and perhaps combining with a visit to another site. We combined it with Mru Caves and hired a car and driver. The cathedral has very unusual architecture and looks more like a temple than a church. We visited at Christmas so it was attractively decked out with lots of lights and cribs.  It's connections with Graham Greene add to the interest.

reviews.author: DevonCatLady
reviews.title: Very glad to have seen the interior
reviews.content: The interior of this cathedral is quite unexpected, unless you have seen photos.  I had, and so I turned up with my tripod, only to discover no photography whatsoever is permitted, even though we were the only people there.  It was quite a long drive to get there from where we were staying, and although I am very glad to have seen it, you probably need to be visiting something else in the area to make it worth while.

reviews.author: pinkdisguise
reviews.title: Interesting architecture
reviews.content: Found this to be an unexpected highlight of our trip to the Ninh Binh area. We really only came because we had a few hours to spend before our train left and Ninh Binh itself is void of anything interesting for tourists.Unlike most other churches in Vietnam, Phat Diem does not pretend to look like a copy of the Notre Dame cathedral. Instead, it is much more like an Asian temple. Beside the main cathedral building, there is a separate bell tower, plus 4 smaller chapels and 2 grottoes representing Bethlehem and Lourdes. There's not a lot of written information (found out later that at the church shop there's a little guid book), but the place looks beautiful and was a delight to visit.It takes around 45 min from the centre of Ninh Binh to get there (45km); we ordered a private car through our hotel. There are also tour packages available which include a visit to the cathedral with a visit to one of the nature parks in the area.

reviews.author: GohYH93
reviews.title: Old catholic church
reviews.content: Visited this old Catholic church of 1876-1899AD. Surprised by the large Catholic population in Kim Son. Ninh Binh.Now church is still in used by the locals. But applying for world UNESCO heritage.VERY peaceful place with cool weather now.Do get there early so to enter the cathedral.

reviews.author: arapuni
reviews.title: Interesting blend of Asian European Architecture
reviews.content: This complex incorporates Asian architecture very skilfully with european cathedral architecture to create a very pleasing style.  The complex was quiet and peaceful, although that may have been because we were there late in the afternoon.  The main cathedral is high ceilinged and one can visualize a european cathedral.  The smaller chapels in the complex look more like temples.  The statuary contained depictions of saints, but also included asian symbols.

reviews.author: TravelPause
reviews.title: Harmonic blend of architecture and religions
reviews.content: Perhaps it was the time of day but we arrived towards sunset and really enjoyed our perambulations around the cathedral and its many smaller buildings. (I'm not sure that it does shut at 5pm - comment in earlier post -  because we were still wandering around at the time of evening bell ringing). Intriguing blend of western and eastern architecture, including statues adorning rooftops which celebrated both religions. The  main cathedral is an impressive size, the interior finished in wood including the 52 massive single tree (yellow poincianas) trunks used for its main pillars. Locals were praying and outside a family was making an offering and prayers at one of the grottoes - once again a peculiar mixture of Asian and western religious artefacts. Walking around we did find plaques on inner walls explaining more of the history. When the massive bell in the tower chimed evensong it was beautiful... Sometimes the beauty of places like this can't be absorbed and appreciated in a 10 minute skip-around... and there's no point comparing them to their European counterparts either...have to remember its a blend of eastern simplicity and western reverence...take your time to observe the details in the carvings, the woodwork, the anomalies of east meets west. Watch the locals who are visiting it as their church. Sit and ponder... I'm not religious but this place had a really calming  energy..

reviews.author: BensonYap
reviews.title: Interesting architecture
reviews.content: The wood carvings in one of the chapel is exquisite. The cathedral and chapels are all relatively well-preserved. Interesting to see the blend of Far East and European designs on the buildings. Worth a trip from Ninh Binh!

reviews.author: Mirek a Petra N
reviews.title: Surprising place
reviews.content: It is around 30 km from ninh binh, it is popular site for Vietnamese people to visit. It looks like temple but is old Catholic Church with great chapels, wood carvings and big belltower. We went there on motorbike taxi.

reviews.author: Andrew P
reviews.title: Not worth the 35 km trip out
reviews.content: Maybe it's just because I've traveled through Europe and have seen lots of churches, but there was nothing spectacular about seeing this place in my opinion, especially given that its out of the way and all you can really do is look at the outside of the buildings, which aren't necessarily in the greatest shape. 15 mins and you're done for something incredibly mediocre.

reviews.author: Anna M
reviews.title: Impressive Cathedral!
reviews.content: It is quite far from Ninh Binh (28km) but it was a nice trip. We were the only tourists there. Due to that fact some people actually walked up to us and wanted to take photos which was funny. the cathedral itself was very impressive, a mix between european and asian decoration.

reviews.author: Txell D
reviews.title: Little treasure
reviews.content: If you are in Ninh Binh, just go! Peaceful and delicated cathedral, diferent of other cathedrals we have seen in Vietnam. A little treasure. We went there by motorbike from Tam Coc. Check route and you can go and come back by diferent routes and enjoy the countryside.

reviews.author: Vnvet68
reviews.title: A big part of Vietnamese history here........
reviews.content: Vietnam has a long history of Catholic influence due to the French colonolization. It is interesting to travel in the Vietnamese countryside and see enclaves of Christians scattered here and there. Phat Diem is a great example of this. A very interesting stop in Vietnam's vast and varied history.

reviews.author: Georgina W
reviews.title: Interesting mix of East meets West in Cathedral architecture.
reviews.content: A surprising number of churches,including Phat Diem Cathedral,clustered in one area.A must to visit for those interested in church architecture,and history. A large complex of Tower and Chapels,and large wooden Cathedral.A tour of complex can be arranged,by English speaking guide,eager to"brush up"on their English skills. Will need transport from Ninh Binh,but picturesque drive.

reviews.author: shaynamin
reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.content: Amazing architecture, would definitely recommend a visit for any who like ornate or interesting buildings. Guided tours are available to give you an insight into the history of the cathedral.

reviews.author: ouliviay
reviews.title: Really worth the detour
reviews.content: A really special mix of Catholic and Vietnamese influences makes this place worth the detour (26 km south of Ninh Binh, a 1 hour drive approximately).

reviews.author: Patrick T
reviews.title: Great
reviews.content: It's really a unique cathedral. They after 5 chapels surrounding the cathedral. One of the must see chapel is know as the stone chapel. The chapel is made of satin all around from floor up. The cathedral is facing a lake and inside is make by wood. Truly beautiful. Must see!!! There is a rich history about this cathedral that survive the World War II and also story behind the architecture of it. Truly amazing

reviews.author: Kita U
reviews.title: Mixing with East and West
reviews.content: Even the cathedral is christian location that from Europe but the style of building is mixing between Vietnamese.I havent seen in ASean area before.Quite unique.

reviews.author: E3242OSrobm
reviews.title: Part of a tour...
reviews.content: Went as part of a 2 day tour. I do not know if the inside was closed or not...we did not go inside for some reason. However, the walk around and photo ops were good. I enjoyed stopping here for some reason...I really don't know why.

reviews.author: Andrew C
reviews.title: Strangely familiar but alien nonetheless
reviews.content: I heard about this place and it sounded bizarre.  It is.  Several chapels, grootos and the main cathedral set in a large area.  Architecturally it is pretty unique.  The familiarity of a catholic church but with a blend of Buddhism.  The scenery you see getting there is interesting too (other churches, rivers and canals with limestone outcrops in the distance).

reviews.author: Edward S
reviews.title: An orient Church.
reviews.content: Quite a interesting experience. This is the main church of locals around the area, but it looked the same as a Vietnamese temple, only identifiable by the holy cross on top.

reviews.author: Danzelho
reviews.title: A must for architecture and history lover. Go!
reviews.content: Speeding off to Phat Diem Cathedral on a motorbike which is located in the Kim Son district. It was refreshing riding without much traffic and without any rules. Even if there are any rules on the road, it is pretty much dictate by the user. I have to agree that the noises from the excessive horn are terrible but it does serve as a great way to signal the driver in front that you are passing through or making a turn. It wasn't a very complicated journey, as we were travelling on one straight dusty road most of the time with farmlands, houses or catholic cemeteries by the side, however i am very certain we will be lost if we didn't have a google map. Take Nguyen Cong Tru Road (QL10). It is a straight route, and you will be spending most of your time riding on this route. Approximately 24km later, you will face a T or should i say Y junction with a river in front of you. At this junction turn right and carry riding on QL10. 3km later After make a final right turn into a small lane with a few potholes, and you will reach the compound of the Phat Diem Cathedral. The total distance from Ninh Binh train station to the cathedral is less than 30km. If you are riding or driving on your own, it will be good to save a offline google map since the entrance to the cathedral is a small road and you might miss it. However the cathedral is very famous in this district so ask around if you are unsure and i believe the locals will be able to point you correct way.The cathedral looks impressive and took 24 years to built, with the exterior totally in concrete and the interior made of wood. The cathedral exhibit a unique mix of Christian gothic style of architectural and Vietnamese pagoda structure. I was pretty surprised when i walk past one of the chapel and heard people chanting instead of singing hymns. Incense was also used as a form of worshiped in the cathedral which was predominantly an Asian tradition. It was an interesting mix of religion and culture. We were in Ninh Binh for one full day and we decided to visit Tam Coc, Mua cave in the morning and Phat Diem in the afternoon. If you are on a tight schedule, maybe it will not be wise for you to visit Phat Diem Cathedral due to the long distance. I have read quite a bit about the cathedral hence decided to head there. If you love unique architecture, history and riding on the outskirt of a town. Go, you will enjoy it. Just plan one whole afternoon for it so that you wouldn't have to rush and still have time to reach back before the sun set. Do take note that The Phat Diem Cathedral close at 5.00pm local time.I have included the cathedral website in the tripadvisor review, if you are Interested to know more about it. Not sure if they will show it. Drop me a message if you need more information. Cheers.

reviews.author: 55erica
reviews.title: Erica L. and family from Canada and Hong Kong
reviews.content: heard of it from the tripadvisor also prior the trip.Very nice historical building to see and some good historical stories to hear as well.People and tourists there are nice

reviews.author: maria j
reviews.title: sino vietnamese traditional style of cathidral
reviews.content: very peaceful,very large stone church in Phat diem town. not many tourist so it is really worth for visit.it seems all the complex church are sinic build in the past,with very nice decoration inside.if you would like to see the big old bell you should go to the gate and ask the man in the office for open the door

reviews.author: selvaggia_9
reviews.title: Unusual...nice
reviews.content: I liked it...nice more outside compare to the inside but is free and is different to all the same temples

reviews.author: ErvinTan
reviews.title: Interesting architecture.
reviews.content: The design of this cathedral is without a doubt unique. But if you're not interested in such places, don't make a special trip to this cathedral. Overall, I give it three stars for the interesting architecture featured, and a job done well in maintaining the cathedral.

reviews.author: HoanAnh
reviews.title: Great stone church and nice local Catherine people
reviews.content: I've been here many times but i always feel like the first time to see the church. This time, our family join in a tour in 2 days with Hanoi Biking Travel . The first day we visit Hoa Lu - Tam Coc then take a taxi to Kim Son - Phat Diem Stone church , then we visited local market nearby , people here are all very friendly and polite . Then went to a small beach town in Nam Dinh province where we had homestay for 1 night. We had not enough happy time with the local Family . We went to sea food market and do cooking with the host . We prefer to stay 2 or 3 nights here , may be go to stone church again by biking should be better . The local bus to get back Hanoi was convinience. This is the best trip to visit real Vietnam that we will do again.

reviews.author: Whynot808
reviews.title: Don't make a special trip
reviews.content: Unless you are Catholic or just passing through I would not make a special trip to Phat Diem Cathedral, it is nothing special.  It did feature in Graham Greene’s s book the Quiet American, so may be of interest if you are reading the book at the time.

reviews.author: rosaa1b
reviews.title: A MUST DESTINATION
reviews.content: It is very big , even bigger than a lot of European Church. The desigh is very unique.  I am a Catholic but I never seem a church in such a special design.  Outside was made with stone but inside was made with wood. It is only half hour's drive from the railway station.

reviews.author: Mervyn C
reviews.title: Nice, but have no difference
reviews.content: To JaimyB: you're right. There is no information tables, no brochures for visitors understand more than about this Cathedral. Overall, it is not different to others. I found the stone columns that are exquisitely sculpted. But that's all, nothing made me too impressed.

reviews.author: JaimyB
reviews.title: Lacking information
reviews.content: The building itself is looking nice but there is limited, to none, information available and also a lot of maintenance work is going on. We managed to see the complex in 15 minutes.

reviews.author: DigerTheTiger
reviews.title: A Cathedral
reviews.content: It is like many other Cathedrals around Vietnam, sure its beautifull but nothing amazing. Not as the national park close by!

reviews.author: worddict
reviews.title: Must visit
reviews.content: I'm not one for history or religion. But it's a beautiful Catholic complex.I think the locals still go to the churches there, so do talk softly as there are people praying in there. In fact, some Vietnamese tourists were so noisy, an old man stopped his praying and came out to give them a lecture.Worth a visit.

reviews.author: FloydTJenson
reviews.title: Great Cathedral if your into Cathedrals
reviews.content: Wow this place is so interesting. The blending of Buddhist architecture with Catholic beliefs, i.e Cathedral is quite surprising. Enquire about have a priest or brother show you around. If your not into chuches go elsewhere.

reviews.author: Lizlee2910
reviews.title: Historical Cathedral
reviews.content: I like the way the government remain the original texture of most of their historical tourism spot. A little bit far but worth to see, and remind you to try the Bun Moc on the way to the Cathedral... pork noodle which is very nice!!!

reviews.author: Jamshaid F
reviews.title: Spiritual Beauty and serenity
reviews.content: Stone Church, as locals called it, is a grand structure of its own class located in Kim Sơn District of Ninh Bình Province. Construction is vastly made of stone and enormous wooden pillars are carved out of single trees. It was cloudy and drizzling when we visited this marvelous monument. The wonderful weather and overall ambience further added to its silent beauty.  Phat Diem Cathedral is typical example of European structure, though it was designed by a local priest, known as Father Sau, in eighteen century. The Cathedrals was not untouched by country’s resistance against a foreign aggression. A Bombing in 1972 devastated a major portion of the church while the Cathedrals got tilted. Despite of the war the restoration work was carried on straight away and damaged was undone.

reviews.author: Jeffrey W
reviews.title: An interesting cultural experience
reviews.content: The strange mix of Asian and Western architecture and culture make this a fascinating place to visit. Set back off the main road it is also worth walking around the streets near the cathedral to give you a flavour of the area and the local community.

reviews.author: Tigergus
reviews.title: A most architecturally interesting building
reviews.content: A cross between a grand European cathedral and Asian temple architecture. And I have to say, i loved it.It is quite large and made mostly of wood. Because of its uniqueness I think it will stand out more than most other temples I have been to here in Vietnam.Around 30km south of Ninh binh. We hired a scooter to ride here, only problem was that we left it too late, and it was getting dark while we were looking at it.One further note, as with most places there are unofficial paid parking spots out side, and when we were given a ticket to park the bike in an empty street, I decided to ride a bit further away and park elsewhere, pretty much just around the corner. For free.However, upon walking in, it turns out all the locals ride right up to the church itself, and I don't see why we could not have done the same, if we had known.

reviews.author: Shirley M
reviews.title: worth the trip
reviews.content: Beautiful cathedrals especially at Christmas time. Wonderful carvings and elaborate architecture. Entirely worth the time it takes to travel to this destination.

reviews.author: hugo64
reviews.title: Piece of history
reviews.content: About 30 mins from Ninh Binh through a part of Vietnam that seems totally untouristed.I think our driver and guide also found it interesting as it`s not really part of the tourist trail.Phat Diem  Cathedral is a Catholic cathedral built of stone but with a beautiful wooden roof. It is a mixture of European and Vietnamese, built using traditional Vietnamese temple architecture. It was built of stone and wood in 24 years. There were also several other chapels and a shrine of the Virgin Mary. Father Six, the man responsible for its construction, while devout in his Catholicism, had a great sense of Vietnamese tradition and culture. It was he who ensured Phat Diem Cathedral was distinctly Vietnamese in character. He was central both to the architecture and engineering of the project.In 1951, Graham Greene stood from the cathedral bell-tower and witnessed raging battles between Ho Chi Minh’s Viet Minh forces and French colonial forces. He included the experience in his famous novel, The Quiet American.   In 1953, French shells hit the structure damaging the roof and 1972, American bombs fell across the complex flattening one of the surrounding chapels and severely damaging the main cathedral structure. The local community has rallied to repair the cathedral and repairs are still going on.The number of churches in this area is surprising and many of them wouldn`t look out of place in Paris although the Cathedral would!

reviews.author: hazel
reviews.title: Travel sites should go.
reviews.content: Very busy and busy at night. Many angles take beautiful photos, diverse cuisine and pleasant air. My family loved this place.

reviews.author: Valentino s
reviews.title: ninh binh
reviews.content: Ninh Binh is a beautiful and quiet destination. The scenery here is wonderful. I visited Tam Coc, which is beautiful, Bich Dong pagoda, Hoa Lu and also took a bike ride.

reviews.author: Mr9xx
reviews.title: Old Pagoda
reviews.content: Step to the Buddha.The One Pillar Pagoda is an ancient site overlooking Ninh Binh city.Enjoy an easy walk and discover the peaceful surroundings at your own pace.

reviews.author: Hair Salon 1995 Ninh Bình gần phố cổ
reviews.title: Very good food, friendly people, will be back often
reviews.content: Nice, cheap, good food, will be back

reviews.author: Luan Ha
reviews.title: Hoa Lư Old Town Photoshoot
reviews.content: Hoa Lu old town is very nice at night, when the hundred lantern is turned on. There are many street food and restaurants beside the lake. Many cultural and artistic activities are placed at the weekend, example water puppet show, traditional music show, fashion show...Many people chose this spot for photoshoot with lantern.

reviews.author: EvaEKM
reviews.title: Walking street Hoa Lu
reviews.content: Such a beautiful place in the evening. Good food, beautiful lights, friendly people, boat ride available. Highly recommend to visit.

reviews.author: Monriqui
reviews.title: Best place in all Vietnam
reviews.content: Pur favourite spot in all Vietnam. Small country vibe. Beautiful lanterns, people and restaurants.finally started enjoying our Vietnam holiday once we left HCM + Hanoi and came here. Highly recommend a visit if you are in Ninh Binh

reviews.author: Shropshire Boy
reviews.title: Lovely area to spend an evening if staying in the area.
reviews.content: Lovely place to spend a few  hours on an evening, Around the lake there are numerous bars and resteraunts. We found the area by mistake while on an evening walk from where we were staying in Ninh Binh.

reviews.author: Viet Exquisite Travel
reviews.title: Lovely green place to visit
reviews.content: If you have few days in Ninh Binh & wish other spots to visit beyond Trang An and Tam Coc, Tuyet Tinh Coc is worth your visit . It brings a green, relaxing pace & few view points that are reached by climbing some steps. This place is not much crowded as other area's popular attractions.

reviews.author: Sirisha D
reviews.title: Fun way to spend time
reviews.content: This is not a must visit in Ninh Binh when it’s  short of time. Otherwise, it’s a good place to spend couple of hours. Cycle rental is expensive. You can walk around as well. There are couple of small hikes with view points.

reviews.author: Lynn W
reviews.title: A less known tourist spot
reviews.content: Our driver took us here. No coaches full of people.Bit of peace & quiet, in serene area.Lovely walk around the lake.Plenty of photo spots.Local goats around the rocky hills.

reviews.author: Antonia
reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.content: Nice landscape and very relaxing since there weren't many tourists. The ticket for 50.000 VD is quite expensive and parking costs another 5.000 VD. You don't have to rent a bicycle and can just walk around the lake. If you have some extra time, it is worth it.

reviews.author: tessybear97
reviews.title: Stunning mountain canyon!
reviews.content: This is a lovely spot to stop and relax, read in the beautiful lakeside gardens, well looked after and stunning from all angles. Through a man-made tunnel, you arrive in a mountain canyon filled with a lake. It's not very big, good size to walk around and enjoy.  Recommend an umbrella for shade atm. Can climb up to viewpoints for great views at either ends. It's pretty much right next to Hoa Lu Ancient Capital.

reviews.author: João Batista
reviews.title: unmissable place...
reviews.content: Unmissable place in Vietnam. One of the most beautiful landscapes and one of the best-known tourist destinations in the country.

reviews.author: Shelley M
reviews.title: Fantastic view and peaceful
reviews.content: This is well worth the time to visit.  It is back from the road a bit, so easy to miss.  There was no one else here when we visited, they were all over the road at Hoa Lu.  So peaceful and beautiful.  Quite a long walk around the lake for some people, but it is flat and even ground.  There are a lot of stairs and it is well worth the effort for the beautiful views.  A couple arrived as we were leaving to take wedding photos on the lake.  This is a must see in my opinion and the cave is really cool too.  My family enjoyed this.

reviews.author: ctm7944
reviews.title: Tuyet Tinh Coc - Picturesque!
reviews.content: Tuyet Tinh Coc is a fantastic spot. So beautiful..Wow!!  50KVND admission. If on a private tour or on your own; insist on going here. Don't miss Am Tien Cave + Pagoda (200 steps - 3 levels). Which provides scenic, elevated views of Ao Giai Lake. Only saw 2 other people here.

reviews.author: Mathieu R
reviews.title: Underrated gem
reviews.content: We were very pleasantly surprised by this place. It is very quiet and isolated from the road noise (which is kind of rare in Vietnam). Not a lot of tourists go there, so that was a big plus for us. And the view is awesome, same for the landscaping. Bonus: there's a chance you see moutain goats minding their own business if you look around!

reviews.author: Yen Hoang
reviews.title: Hiden gem
reviews.content: Very nice lake and temples near old capital Hoa Lu, Ninh Binh. Price 20.000 vnd for a ticket and you can go by walk 100 m from old capital Hoa Lu.

reviews.author: Megan and Allan
reviews.title: Lucky find
reviews.content: What a great find. Hidden through a tunnel, this beautiful oasis was unexpected. Although it was pouring with rain, this was still beautiful. There were 3 wedding photo shots going on.

reviews.author: Nguyen Ngoc Phong ( Windy )
reviews.title: Tuyet Tinh Coc cave is brilliant place for taking photo
reviews.content: Windy just finish visiting and taking my friends to Tuyet Tinh Coc cave ( Tiger Cave ) and the Crocodile Lake , They are so beautiful ,I am so lucky to have so special pictures with wide angle to get overview of The Lake.if you want to get the Watcher point ,you have to trek up with 171 steps up ,it is not really high and steep , with me it is so easy hiiii . i hope that allof you also get the beautiful photos like mine . so now you can see my pictures below .Thank you so much for reading my review , I am windy photographer ,i like hunting landscape pictures.

reviews.author: DiNg|photographer
reviews.title: Must visit with best photos and memories
reviews.content: Inside the Trang An Landscape Complex, you can discover the most ancient place calls Tuyet Tinh Coc. From Trang An you drive about 15' and will reach this awesome place. Buy ticket 20k vnd and you will spend your endless time here. Follow a tunnel and the amazing scene appears in front of your eyes will definitely worth the visit. The old pagoda with around 250 stone stairs to climb will give you an amazing view of the place. Walka bit further inside, you will find an old gate of an ancient palace. The big lake with fresh green water which you can see the fish and the weeds. You will have many best photos in this place.

reviews.author: Big Asian Choice
reviews.title: Beautiful Place for A Short Visit
reviews.content: Tuyet Tinh Coc is a cave with a shrine inside, in Ninh Binh province, near to Mua Caves. Outside of this cave, there is a lake between the valley of limestone hills. To get there, one must walk through a short tunnel through the hill. There are steps to walk up to the cave. Outside the cave, there is a lookout to view the valley from high elevation. There are also walkway around the lake. The place was clean and had no crowd during my visit, might be because it did not coincide with large tour group visiting the place. There were several stalls on the way in and inside the location as well. May be worthwhile to drop by if travelling around the area.

reviews.author: Adrienne A
reviews.title: Beautiful quick stop
reviews.content: The cave is gorgeous, not to be missed. We had the whole place to ourselves the morning we went. We spent about an hour here. Easy to navigate, no need for a guide.

reviews.author: Minh T
reviews.title: Amazing place to see on lonely planet
reviews.content: It was so nice place to visit one time in your life. There was so green lake in the middle of the mountainous valley. After taking pictures of the beautiful lake, we climb up to see Am Tien cave and pagoda, Then take overview pictures of the lake. I saw there were many couples who took wedding picture there. It was so romantic place for couples

reviews.author: Tom V
reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.content: We went on the boat tour around the caves and the shooting of the king kong movie. The sight was absolutely amazing. Recommend this activity for anyone. Bring waterproof clothing and don't bring anything you do not want to get wet.

reviews.author: Minh T
reviews.title: So so
reviews.content: The entrance fee is 20,000 per person and motorbike parking fee is 10,000.You will experience 205 limestone steps to reach the Am Tien Temple but the trekking is not hard like Mua Cave (Hang Mua). The cave is small and has some altars.There is a large lake in front of the cave gate, folk called Ao League. The water is green and it’s a good place to see sunset.The last point of the lake is a gate. It is constructed like the model of ancient gate. Not many people know this place.

reviews.author: LuongParadise
reviews.title: Nothing special
reviews.content: I must to say it's nothing speacial. But the view is beautiful. For someone who like to selfie it would be a nice place.

reviews.author: Viet Exquisite Travel
reviews.title: Lovely green place to visit
reviews.content: If you have few days in Ninh Binh & wish other spots to visit beyond Trang An and Tam Coc, Tuyet Tinh Coc is worth your visit .
